### Query #1

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS, GL_DAILY_RATES, PO_LINES_ALL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID ACORDO_ID, pha.segment1 ACORDO_ORACLE, pha.ATTRIBUTE4 NUM_CONTRATO,
                   PHA.CREATION_DATE DATA_CRIACAO, ps.vendor_name NOME_FORNECEDOR,
                   to_char(pha.START_DATE, 'DD-MM-YYYY') DATA_INICIO_ACORDO_HEADER, to_char(pha.END_DATE,

                                                                                      'DD-MM-YYYY') DATA_TERMINO_ACORDO_HEADER,
                   to_char(pla.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'DD-MM-YYYY') DATA_TERMINO_ACORDO_LINE, PHA.APPROVED_DATE DATA_APROV,
                   PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS STATUS_DOCUMENTO, PHA.AMOUNT_LIMIT VALOR_ACORDO,
                   pHA.MIN_RELEASE_AMOUNT VALOR_LIBERADO, pha.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 VALOR_INICIAL_EBS,

     (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME
      FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
      WHERE PERSON_ID = nvl(PHA.AGENT_ID, -1)
        AND rownum = 1) AS COMPRADOR,

     (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME
      FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
      WHERE PERSON_ID = nvl(PHA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1, -1)
        AND rownum = 1) AS GESTOR_CONTRATO, pla.LINE_STATUS, PLA.LINE_NUM,

     (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
      FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
      WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND rownum = 1) AS CODIGO_ITEM, pla.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, pla.UOM_CODE,
                   PHA.CURRENCY_CODE MOEDA_ACORDO, nvl(GLDR.CONVERSION_RATE,
                                                     1) AS CONVERSION_RATE, pla.UNIT_PRICE,
                   pla.VENDOR_PRODUCT_NUM, pla.SUPPLIER_PART_AUXID, pla.CLOSED_DATE,
                   substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE, 1, 6) BU_ACORDO, pla.EXPIRATION_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                   ORDER BY PLA.LINE_NUM) LINE,
                                                                                                                          COUNT(1) OVER() total
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_V ps ON PS.VENDOR_ID = PHA.VENDOR_ID
   INNER JOIN PO_LINES_ALL PLA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
   INNER JOIN PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
   INNER JOIN FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU ON FABU.BU_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
   LEFT JOIN GL_DAILY_RATES GLDR ON GLDR.CONVERSION_TYPE = 'Corporate'
   AND GLDR.TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
   AND GLDR.FROM_CURRENCY = PHA.CURRENCY_CODE
   AND trunc(PHA.APPROVED_DATE) = trunc(GLDR.CONVERSION_DATE)
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'BLANKET'
     AND nvl(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
     AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'INCOMPLETE', 'WITHDRAWN')
     AND substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE, 1, 6) IN ('MEA001', 'MEA002', 'MEA003', 'GCM010','GCM001',
                                           'VIE004', 'VIE005','VIE006', 'VIE008','GCM002',
                                           'RIO001', 'RIO007', 'VIE012', 'VIE001', 'VIE002',
                                           'RIO003', 'GCM005', 'AMS001', 'RIO002', 'VIE011',
                                           'MEA005', 'VIX001', 'CGH001', 'MEA007', 'VIE008'))
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:P_LIMIT * (:P_PAGE - 1)) + 1) AND ((:P_LIMIT * (:P_PAGE - 1)) + :P_LIMIT)
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, POZ_SUPPLIERS, ZX_REGISTRATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, POZ_SUPPLIERS, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, ZX_REGISTRATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M`

```sql
SELECT PSSAM.VENDOR_ID, PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID,

  (SELECT UPPER(HAOU.NAME)
   FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
   WHERE HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID) NAME, nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                         TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS PCODPARCEIRO,
       nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS PCODPARCEIRO_ALT, HL.COUNTRY PCODPAIS, HP.PARTY_NAME SUPPLIER_NAME1,
       CASE
           WHEN PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(HAOU.NAME,
                                                   1, 6) || '-' || HP.PARTY_NAME ELSE HP.PARTY_NAME
       END SUPPLIER_NAME2,
       CASE
           WHEN PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(HAOU.NAME,
                                                   1, 6) || '-' || HPS.PARTY_SITE_NAME || '-' || HP.PARTY_NAME ELSE HPS.PARTY_SITE_NAME || '-' || HP.PARTY_NAME
       END SUPPLIER_NAME3,
       CASE
           WHEN PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
                  (SELECT SUBSTR(HAOU.NAME, 1, 6) || '-' || SUBSTR(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER,
                                                              1, 6) || '-' || HP.PARTY_NAME
                   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
                     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
                     AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
                     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,

                                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
                     AND ROWNUM = 1)
           ELSE
                  (SELECT SUBSTR(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, 1, 6) || '-' || HP.PARTY_NAME
                   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
                     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
                     AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
                     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,

                                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
                     AND ROWNUM = 1)
       END SUPPLIER_NAME4, UPPER(HP.PARTY_NAME) PRAZAOSOCIAL,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, 1, 14)
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PCNPJ,

  (SELECT ZR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZR, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE HP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
     AND ZR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZR.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZR.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PINSCRICAOESTADUAL, UPPER(HL.CITY) PCIDADE,

  (SELECT HG.GEOGRAPHY_CODE
   FROM HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG
   WHERE HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
     AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_USE = 'MASTER_REF'
     AND UPPER(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = UPPER(HL.CITY)
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(HG.START_DATE,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(HG.END_DATE,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PCODCIDADEIBGE, UPPER(HL.STATE) PESTADO, HL.POSTAL_CODE PCEP,
       UPPER(PSSAM.EMAIL_ADDRESS) PEMAIL, UPPER(HL.ADDRESS1) PADDRESS1, UPPER(HL.ADDRESS2) PADDRESS2,
       UPPER(HL.ADDRESS3) PADDRESS3, UPPER(HL.ADDRESS4) PADDRESS4,
       CASE
           WHEN PSSAM.FAX IS NOT NULL
                AND PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE || '-' || PSSAM.FAX ELSE PSSAM.FAX
       END PTELEFAX,
       CASE
           WHEN PSSAM.PHONE IS NOT NULL
                AND PSSAM.AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN PSSAM.AREA_CODE || '-' || PSSAM.PHONE ELSE PSSAM.PHONE
       END PTELPARC,

  (SELECT ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF'
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PCPF, HP.PARTY_ID PFLEXFIELD1, HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID PFLEXFIELD2,
       PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID PFLEXFIELD3,

  (SELECT PS.SEGMENT1
   FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS PS
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID) PCODPARCEIROEMPRESA, PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE PCODPARCEIROEMPRESA1
FROM POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, HZ_LOCATIONS HL,
     HZ_PARTIES HP, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND HPS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
  AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
  AND NVL(HPS.ATTRIBUTE2, 'N') = 'Y'
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = :P_ID
```

### Query #3

**Tabelas:** `DUAL, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, POZ_SUPPLIERS`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, DUAL, POZ_SUPPLIERS`

```sql
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS PS
   WHERE PS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > SYSDATE - 2 / 24
     AND PS.VENDOR_ID = :P_ID
     AND PS.VENDOR_ID IN
       (SELECT PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
        FROM POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS
        WHERE PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = PS.VENDOR_ID
          AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
          AND HPS.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y')) QTD_MODIF_FORN,

  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS
   WHERE HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND HPS.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
     AND PSSAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > SYSDATE - 2 / 24
     AND PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = :P_ID) QTD_MODIF_SITE
FROM DUAL
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `HR_LOCATIONS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, AP_TERMS_TL, HZ_PARTY_SITES, HZ_PARTIES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS`

### Query #4

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, HZ_PARTIES, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS, HZ_PARTY_SITES, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, PO_HEADERS_ALL, AP_TERMS_TL`

```sql
WITH tab_setup AS
  (SELECT flv.attribute1 bu_name, flv.attribute2 organization_code, flv.attribute3 location_code,
          flv.attribute4 bu_osgt, flv.attribute5 supplier_number, flv.attribute6 party_site_code,
          flv.attribute7 vendor_site_code, flv.attribute8 organization_osgt, flv.attribute9 location_osgt,
          flv.attribute10 terms_name
   FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl flv
   WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'OSGT_ORG_IMPORTADOR'
     AND flv.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND flv.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
     AND flv.end_date_active >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.PRC_BU_ID, '' "COUNTRY",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "ORGANIZATION_CODE_OSGT_ORG",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "AREANEGOCIO",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "CODIMPORTADOR", PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE Codincoterm,
                                           NVL(tab_setup.terms_name,
                                                 (SELECT ATT.NAME
                                                  FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
                                                  WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
                                                    AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS)) CONDPAGTO,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATALIMITE,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.CREATION_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATAPEDIDO,
                                           PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                    1,
                                                                    INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                      '-') - 1) AS NUMPEDIDO,
                                           CASE
                                               WHEN HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY != 'BR' THEN CASE
                                                                                       WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,

                                                                                              '*') = 'Y'
                                                                                            OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                 '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                                                       ELSE 'A'
                                                                                   END
                                               ELSE CASE
                                                        WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                                               '*') = 'Y'
                                                             OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                                  '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                        WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                               '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                                                    END
                                           END Codstatus, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE Tipopedido, 'N' Codprioridade,
                                                                                               'PO' Detalhetipo,
                                                                                                    PHA.COMMENTS Obs,
                                                                                                    9 piSCodSistema,
                                                                                                    NVL(PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                      '(não informado)') FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,
                                                                                                    PHA.TERMS_ID,
                                                                                                    'MARITIMA' CodViaTransporte,
                                                                                                               pha.ship_to_location_id,
                                                                                                               NVL(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT hps.attribute1
                                                                                                                      FROM hz_party_sites hps
                                                                                                                      WHERE hps.party_site_id = tab_setup.party_site_code), NVL(tab_setup.party_site_code,

                                                                                                                                                                              nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                                                                                                                TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)))) || 'S' Codigofornecedor,
                                                                                                               NVL(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT hps.attribute1
                                                                                                                      FROM poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssam,

                                                                                                                    hz_party_sites hps
                                                                                                                      WHERE pssam.vendor_site_id = tab_setup.vendor_site_code
                                                                                                                        AND pssam.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id), NVL(tab_setup.vendor_site_code,

                                                                                                                                                                        nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                                                                                                          TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)))) || 'S' Codigofornecedor_Alt,
                                                                                                               PHA.PO_HEADER_ID piSFlexField1,
                                                                                                               pha.vendor_id piSFlexField2,
                                                                                                               pha.vendor_site_id piSFlexField3,
                                                                                                               PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE piSFlexField4,
                                                                                                               pssam.vendor_site_code piSFlexField5,

  (SELECT hl1.location_code
   FROM hr_locations hl1
   WHERE hl1.location_id = pha.ship_to_location_id) local_entrega_original,
                                                                                                               tab_setup.organization_code organization_code_original,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
     AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS) cond_pgto_original,

  (SELECT hp.party_name
   FROM hz_parties hp, poz_suppliers ps
   WHERE hp.party_id = ps.party_id
     AND ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id) fornecedor_original,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN TRUNC(PHA.APPROVED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                   ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                               END VALIDA_DATA_APROVACAO,

  (SELECT hl1.inventory_organization_id
   FROM hr_locations hl1
   WHERE hl1.location_id = pha.ship_to_location_id) inventory_organization_id
FROM po_headers_all pha, hr_all_organization_units haou, hr_all_organization_units haou2,
     hr_locations hr_po_bu, poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssam, hz_party_sites hps,
     hz_locations hl, hr_locations hr_req_bu, tab_setup
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_PO_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
  AND HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
  AND PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND tab_setup.bu_name = SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                            1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME, '-') - 1)
  AND tab_setup.organization_code IN
    (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
     FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
     WHERE PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
       AND rownum = 1)
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, AP_TERMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.PRC_BU_ID, '' "COUNTRY",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "ORGANIZATION_CODE_OSGT_ORG",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "AREANEGOCIO",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "CODIMPORTADOR", PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE Codincoterm,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
     AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS) CONDPAGTO,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATALIMITE,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.CREATION_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATAPEDIDO,
                                           PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                    1,
                                                                    INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                      '-') - 1) AS NUMPEDIDO,
                                           CASE
                                               WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                                      '*') = 'Y'
                                                    OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                         '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                               WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                      '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                                           END Codstatus, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE Tipopedido, 'N' Codprioridade,
                                                                                               'PO' Detalhetipo,
                                                                                                    PHA.COMMENTS Obs,
                                                                                                    9 piSCodSistema,
                                                                                                    NVL(PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                      '(não informado)') FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,
                                                                                                    PHA.TERMS_ID,
                                                                                                    PHA.PO_HEADER_ID piSFlexField1,
                                                                                                    '' piSFlexField2,
                                                                                                       'MARITIMA' CodViaTransporte,
                                                                                                                  pha.ship_to_location_id
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
     HR_LOCATIONS HR_PO_BU, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS,
     HZ_LOCATIONS HL, HR_LOCATIONS HR_REQ_BU
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_PO_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY = 'BR'
  AND HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR'
  AND PHA.APPROVED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
  AND NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS, 'X') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'FINALLY CLOSED')
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
  AND PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `HR_LOCATIONS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, AP_TERMS_TL, HZ_PARTY_SITES, HZ_PARTIES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, HZ_PARTIES, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS, HZ_PARTY_SITES, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, PO_HEADERS_ALL, AP_TERMS_TL`

```sql
WITH tab_setup AS
  (SELECT flv.attribute1 bu_name, flv.attribute2 organization_code, flv.attribute3 location_code,
          flv.attribute4 bu_osgt, flv.attribute5 supplier_number, flv.attribute6 party_site_code,
          flv.attribute7 vendor_site_code, flv.attribute8 organization_osgt, flv.attribute9 location_osgt,
          flv.attribute10 terms_name
   FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl flv
   WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'OSGT_ORG_IMPORTADOR'
     AND flv.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND flv.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
     AND flv.end_date_active >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.PRC_BU_ID, '' "COUNTRY",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "ORGANIZATION_CODE_OSGT_ORG",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "AREANEGOCIO",
                                           tab_setup.organization_osgt "CODIMPORTADOR", PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE Codincoterm,
                                           NVL(tab_setup.terms_name,
                                                 (SELECT ATT.NAME
                                                  FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
                                                  WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
                                                    AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS)) CONDPAGTO,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATALIMITE,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.CREATION_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATAPEDIDO,
                                           PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                    1,
                                                                    INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                      '-') - 1) AS NUMPEDIDO,
                                           CASE
                                               WHEN HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY != 'BR' THEN CASE
                                                                                       WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,

                                                                                              '*') = 'Y'
                                                                                            OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                 '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                                                       ELSE 'A'
                                                                                   END
                                               ELSE CASE
                                                        WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                                               '*') = 'Y'
                                                             OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                                  '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                        WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                               '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                                                    END
                                           END Codstatus, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE Tipopedido, 'N' Codprioridade,
                                                                                               'PO' Detalhetipo,
                                                                                                    PHA.COMMENTS Obs,
                                                                                                    9 piSCodSistema,
                                                                                                    NVL(PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                      '(não informado)') FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,
                                                                                                    PHA.TERMS_ID,
                                                                                                    'MARITIMA' CodViaTransporte,
                                                                                                               pha.ship_to_location_id,
                                                                                                               NVL(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT hps.attribute1
                                                                                                                      FROM hz_party_sites hps
                                                                                                                      WHERE hps.party_site_id = tab_setup.party_site_code), NVL(tab_setup.party_site_code,

                                                                                                                                                                              nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                                                                                                                TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)))) || 'S' Codigofornecedor,
                                                                                                               NVL(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT hps.attribute1
                                                                                                                      FROM poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssam,

                                                                                                                    hz_party_sites hps
                                                                                                                      WHERE pssam.vendor_site_id = tab_setup.vendor_site_code
                                                                                                                        AND pssam.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id), NVL(tab_setup.vendor_site_code,

                                                                                                                                                                        nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                                                                                                          TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)))) || 'S' Codigofornecedor_Alt,
                                                                                                               PHA.PO_HEADER_ID piSFlexField1,
                                                                                                               pha.vendor_id piSFlexField2,
                                                                                                               pha.vendor_site_id piSFlexField3,
                                                                                                               PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE piSFlexField4,
                                                                                                               pssam.vendor_site_code piSFlexField5,

  (SELECT hl1.location_code
   FROM hr_locations hl1
   WHERE hl1.location_id = pha.ship_to_location_id) local_entrega_original,
                                                                                                               tab_setup.organization_code organization_code_original,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
     AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS) cond_pgto_original,

  (SELECT hp.party_name
   FROM hz_parties hp, poz_suppliers ps
   WHERE hp.party_id = ps.party_id
     AND ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id) fornecedor_original,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN TRUNC(PHA.APPROVED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                   ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                               END VALIDA_DATA_APROVACAO
FROM po_headers_all pha, hr_all_organization_units haou, hr_all_organization_units haou2,
     hr_locations hr_po_bu, poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssam, hz_party_sites hps,
     hz_locations hl, hr_locations hr_req_bu, tab_setup
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_PO_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
  AND HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
  AND PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND tab_setup.bu_name = SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                            1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME, '-') - 1)
  AND tab_setup.organization_code IN
    (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
     FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
     WHERE PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
       AND rownum = 1)
```

### Query #7

```sql
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.PRC_BU_ID, '' "COUNTRY",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "ORGANIZATION_CODE_OSGT_ORG",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "AREANEGOCIO",

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
   WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "CODIMPORTADOR", PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE Codincoterm,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID
     AND ATT.LANGUAGE = :P_LANG_AP_TERMS) CONDPAGTO,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATALIMITE,
                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.CREATION_DATE,
                                             'YYYYMMDD') DATAPEDIDO,
                                           PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                    1,
                                                                    INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                                      '-') - 1) AS NUMPEDIDO,
                                           CASE
                                               WHEN NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                                      '*') = 'Y'
                                                    OR NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                         '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                               WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                      '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                                           END Codstatus, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE Tipopedido, 'N' Codprioridade,
                                                                                               'PO' Detalhetipo,
                                                                                                    PHA.COMMENTS Obs,
                                                                                                    'IS' piSCodSistema,
                                                                                                         NVL(PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                           '(não informado)') FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE,
                                                                                                         PHA.TERMS_ID,
                                                                                                         PHA.PO_HEADER_ID piSFlexField1,
                                                                                                         '' piSFlexField2,
                                                                                                            'MARITIMA' CodViaTransporte,
                                                                                                                       pha.ship_to_location_id
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
     HR_LOCATIONS HR_PO_BU, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS,
     HZ_LOCATIONS HL, HR_LOCATIONS HR_REQ_BU
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_PO_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY = 'BR'
  AND HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR'
  AND PHA.APPROVED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
```

### Query #8

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

### Query #8

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS, RCV_TRANSACTIONS`

```sql
SELECT RT.TRANSACTION_ID, CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID,
       PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU_REQ.NAME,
                                1, INSTR(HAOU_REQ.NAME,
                                     '-') - 1) PISPEDIDOCOMPRA,
       SUBSTR(RT.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID, LENGTH(RT.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) PISNUMITEMPEDIDO, TO_CHAR(RT.TRANSACTION_DATE,

                                                                                              'RRRRMMDD') PISDATARECEBIMENTO,

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = RT.LOCATION_ID) PISORGANIZACAO,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PISPARTNUMBER, CFDL.PHYSICAL_RECEIPT_QUANTITY PISQTDERECEBIDA, '0' PISQTDEDISCREP,
                                                                                        JFLDAEA.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE6 PISREFIMPORTACAO,
                                                                                        CFDH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER PISNUMNOTAFISCAL,

  (SELECT AIA.INVOICE_NUM
   FROM AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL AILA, AP_INVOICES_ALL AIA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = CFDL.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
     AND AIA.SOURCE = 'ORA_CMF'
     AND AILA.SOURCE_EVENT_CLASS_CODE = 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_CAPTURE'
     AND AILA.SOURCE_TRX_ID = CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
     AND AILA.SOURCE_LINE_ID = CFDL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
     AND AIA.INVOICE_ID = AILA.INVOICE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PISNUMINVOICE,

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, HR_LOCATIONS HL_AREANEGOCIO
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HL_AREANEGOCIO.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = HL_AREANEGOCIO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) "ORGANIZATION_CODE_OSGT_ORG"
FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS RT, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA,
     CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS CFDH, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B CFDL, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU_REQ, HR_LOCATIONS HR_REQ_BU, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, HZ_LOCATIONS HL, JG_FSCL_LN_DTLS_ATRB_EXT_ALL JFLDAEA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND RT.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND RT.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND RT.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID = CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND RT.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = CFDL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
  AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND HAOU_REQ.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU_REQ.LOCATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY = 'BR'
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR'
  AND JFLDAEA.TRX_ID = CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND JFLDAEA.TRX_LINE_ID = CFDL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
  AND JFLDAEA.ENTITY_CODE = 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT'
  AND JFLDAEA.EVENT_CLASS_CODE = 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_CAPTURE'
  AND JFLDAEA.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE6 IS NOT NULL
  AND PHA.APPROVED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
  AND NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS, 'X') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'FINALLY CLOSED')
  AND RT.TRANSACTION_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                               TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                 'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND RT.TRANSACTION_ID = NVL(:P_ID, RT.TRANSACTION_ID)
```

### Query #9

### Query #9

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS, AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT A.INVOICE_ID,A.CHECK_ID,TO_CHAR(B.CHECK_DATE,
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "CHECK_DATE",
       A.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ID,A.AMOUNT AMOUNT_APA,A.PERIOD_NAME,A.ORG_ID,A.PAYMENT_NUM,H.NAME ORG_NAME,
       A.EXTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')"CREATION_DATE",
       TO_CHAR(A.ACCOUNTING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')"ACCOUNTING_DATE",B.AMOUNT AMOUNT_APC,B.CURRENCY_CODE,B.CHECK_NUMBER,B.VENDOR_NAME,
       B.PAYMENT_METHOD_LOOKUP_CODE,B.PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG,L.MEANING PAYMENT_TYPE,B.STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE,
       C.INVOICE_NUM,TO_CHAR(C.INVOICE_DATE,
                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "INVOICE_DATE",
       C.DESCRIPTION,C.SOURCE,C.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE,C.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
       BK_ACCT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM,BK_ACCT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,BK_ACCT.BANK,BK_ACCT.BRANCH,BK_ACCT.COUNTRY,
       BK_ACCT.STATE,BK_ACCT.CITY
FROM AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL A,AP_CHECKS_ALL B,AP_INVOICES_ALL C,FND_LOOKUP_VALUES L,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS H,

  (SELECT A.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,A.COUNTRY_CODE,A.BRANCH_ID,A.BANK_ID,A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM,
          A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,P.PARTY_NAME BANK,P1.PARTY_NAME BRANCH,P1.COUNTRY,P1.STATE,P1.CITY
   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS A, HZ_PARTIES P, HZ_PARTIES P1
   WHERE P.PARTY_ID = A.BANK_ID
     AND A.BRANCH_ID = P1.PARTY_ID) BK_ACCT
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND A.CHECK_ID = B.CHECK_ID
  AND A.INVOICE_ID = C.INVOICE_ID
  AND B.PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG = L.LOOKUP_CODE
  AND L.SOURCE_LANG = 'PTB'
  AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PAYMENT TYPE'
  AND H.ORGANIZATION_ID = A.ORG_ID
  AND B.CURRENCY_CODE = 'BRL'
  AND BK_ACCT.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = A.EXTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
  AND A.CREATION_DATE >= NVL(SYSDATE-30,
                           TO_DATE('01/01/1900', 'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND A.INVOICE_ID = NVL(:P_ID, A.INVOICE_ID)
```

### Query #10

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS, AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT A.INVOICE_ID,A.CHECK_ID,A.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ID,A.AMOUNT AMOUNT_APA,A.PERIOD_NAME,
       A.ORG_ID,A.PAYMENT_NUM,H.NAME ORG_NAME,A.EXTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,A.CREATION_DATE,
       A.ACCOUNTING_DATE,B.AMOUNT AMOUNT_APC,B.CHECK_DATE,B.CURRENCY_CODE,B.CHECK_NUMBER,
       B.VENDOR_NAME,B.PAYMENT_METHOD_LOOKUP_CODE,B.PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG,L.MEANING PAYMENT_TYPE,
       B.STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE,C.INVOICE_NUM,C.INVOICE_DATE,C.DESCRIPTION,C.SOURCE,
       C.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE,C.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,BK_ACCT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM,
       BK_ACCT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,BK_ACCT.BANK,BK_ACCT.BRANCH,BK_ACCT.COUNTRY,BK_ACCT.STATE,BK_ACCT.CITY
FROM AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL A,AP_CHECKS_ALL B,AP_INVOICES_ALL C,FND_LOOKUP_VALUES L,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS H,

  (SELECT A.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,A.COUNTRY_CODE,A.BRANCH_ID,A.BANK_ID,A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM,
          A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,P.PARTY_NAME BANK,P1.PARTY_NAME BRANCH,P1.COUNTRY,P1.STATE,P1.CITY
   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS A, HZ_PARTIES P, HZ_PARTIES P1
   WHERE P.PARTY_ID = A.BANK_ID
     AND A.BRANCH_ID = P1.PARTY_ID) BK_ACCT
WHERE A.CHECK_ID = B.CHECK_ID
  AND A.INVOICE_ID = C.INVOICE_ID
  AND B.PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG = L.LOOKUP_CODE
  AND L.SOURCE_LANG = 'PTB'
  AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PAYMENT TYPE'
  AND H.ORGANIZATION_ID = A.ORG_ID
  AND B.CURRENCY_CODE = 'BRL'
  AND C.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('PREPAYMENT', 'STANDARD')
  AND BK_ACCT.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = A.EXTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
  AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(REPLACE(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                  'T', ' '),
                              TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                'DD/MM/YYYY'))
```

### Query #11

### Query #11

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT rsh.receipt_num, pha.po_header_id, rsl.line_num receipt_line_num, rsl.quantity_received,
          rcv.po_unit_price, COUNT(1) OVER() AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                         ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num,
                                                                      rsl.line_num) LINE
   FROM po_headers_all pha, po_lines_all pla, rcv_transactions rcv,
        rcv_shipment_headers rsh, rcv_shipment_lines rsl
   WHERE pha.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
     AND pla.po_line_id = rcv.po_line_id
     AND rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
     AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
     AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
     AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
     AND pha.po_header_id = :P_PO_HEADER_ID
     AND pla.po_line_id = :P_PO_LINE_ID
     AND NOT EXISTS
       (SELECT NULL
        FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
        WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
          AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
          AND ((aia.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id)
               OR (aila.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
                   AND aila.po_line_id = po_line_id))
          AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id))
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT po_header_id,po_line_num,receipt_num,receipt_line_num,MIN(po_unit_price),
          SUM(quantity_received),COUNT(1) OVER() AS total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                            ORDER BY receipt_num) LINE
   FROM
     (SELECT rsh.receipt_num,pha.po_header_id,pla.line_num AS po_line_num,
             rsl.line_num receipt_line_num,rsl.quantity_received,rcv.po_unit_price,rcv.po_distribution_id,
             COUNT(1) OVER() AS total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                        ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num,
                                                     rsl.line_num) LINE
      FROM po_headers_all pha,po_lines_all pla,rcv_transactions rcv,
           rcv_shipment_headers rsh,rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE pha.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
        AND pla.po_line_id = rcv.po_line_id
        AND rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND pha.po_header_id = :p_po_header_id
        AND pla.po_line_id = :p_po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT NULL
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia,ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id))
   WHERE (:p_receipt_num IS NULL
          OR receipt_num = :p_receipt_num)
   GROUP BY po_header_id,po_line_num,receipt_num,receipt_line_num,po_unit_price)
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

### Query #13

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_PARTIES, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M`

### Query #13

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, HZ_PARTIES`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT hp.party_name AS "Supplier", ps.segment1 AS "SupplierNumber",
          hp.party_id AS "SupplierPartyId", ps.vendor_id AS "SupplierId", COUNT(1) OVER() AS total,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                            ORDER BY hp.party_name, ps.segment1) LINE
   FROM hz_parties hp, poz_suppliers ps
   WHERE ps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND UPPER(hp.party_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:P_PARTY_NAME) || '%'
     AND :p_vendor_id = 0
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa, fun_user_role_data_asgnmnts furda, per_users pu
        WHERE pssa.vendor_id = ps.vendor_id
          AND pssa.prc_bu_id = furda.org_id
          AND ((furda.role_name LIKE 'CLIA_RASTRE%JR')
               OR (furda.role_name LIKE 'ALT_RASTRE%JR'))
          AND furda.user_guid = pu.user_guid
          AND pu.username = :p_username
          AND furda.active_flag = 'Y'
          AND pu.active_flag = 'Y'
          AND furda.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND NVL(furda.end_date_active, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND pu.start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND NVL(pu.end_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL, AP_TERMS, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL, IBY_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, FUN_USER_ROLE_DATA_ASGNMNTS`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, FIN - Payables, FIN - Tax & Legal, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_USER_ROLE_DATA_ASGNMNTS, FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL, AP_TERMS, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, IBY_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT pss.vendor_site_code AS "SupplierSite", pss.vendor_site_id AS "SupplierSiteId",
          NVL(psa.bu_id, pss.prc_bu_id) prc_bu_id,

     (SELECT zpti.tax_payer_number
      FROM zx_party_tax_profile zptp, zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
      WHERE zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
        AND zptp.site_flag = 'Y'
        AND zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
        AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
        AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND zptp.party_id = pss.party_site_id
        AND ROWNUM = 1) CNPJ, pss.invoice_currency_code,

     (SELECT at.name
      FROM ap_terms AT
      WHERE at.term_id = pss.terms_id) terms_name,
          NVL(
                (SELECT ieppm.payment_method_code
                 FROM iby_ext_party_pmt_mthds ieppm,
               iby_external_payees_all iepa, iby_payment_methods_b ibpmb
                 WHERE ieppm.ext_pmt_party_id = iepa.ext_payee_id
                   AND ieppm.primary_flag = 'Y'
                   AND iepa.supplier_site_id = pss.vendor_site_id
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.start_date, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.end_date , SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.inactive_date, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND ieppm.payment_method_code = ibpmb.payment_method_code
                   AND NVL(ibpmb.end_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND NVL(ibpmb.inactive_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ,
                (SELECT ieppm.payment_method_code
                 FROM poz_suppliers_v psv,
             iby_ext_party_pmt_mthds ieppm, iby_external_payees_all iepa,
             iby_payment_methods_b ibpmb
                 WHERE psv.vendor_id = pss.vendor_id
                   AND ieppm.ext_pmt_party_id = iepa.ext_payee_id
                   AND ieppm.primary_flag = 'Y'
                   AND iepa.party_site_id IS NULL
                   AND iepa.payee_party_id = psv.party_id
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.start_date, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.end_date , SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.inactive_date, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND ieppm.payment_method_code = ibpmb.payment_method_code
                   AND NVL(ibpmb.end_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   AND NVL(ibpmb.inactive_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE))) payment_method_code,

     (SELECT ipmt.payment_method_name
      FROM iby_payment_methods_tl ipmt
      WHERE ipmt.language = 'PTB'
        AND ipmt.payment_method_code = NVL(
                                             (SELECT ieppm.payment_method_code
                                              FROM iby_ext_party_pmt_mthds ieppm,
                                            iby_external_payees_all iepa,
                                            iby_payment_methods_b ibpmb
                                              WHERE ieppm.ext_pmt_party_id = iepa.ext_payee_id
                                                AND ieppm.primary_flag = 'Y'
                                                AND iepa.supplier_site_id = pss.vendor_site_id
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.start_date,
                                                            SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.end_date ,
                                                            SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.inactive_date,
                                                            SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND ieppm.payment_method_code = ibpmb.payment_method_code
                                                AND NVL(ibpmb.end_date,
                                                      TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND NVL(ibpmb.inactive_date,
                                                      TRUNC(SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ,
                                             (SELECT ieppm.payment_method_code
                                              FROM poz_suppliers_v psv,
                                          iby_ext_party_pmt_mthds ieppm,
                                          iby_external_payees_all iepa, iby_payment_methods_b ibpmb
                                              WHERE psv.vendor_id = pss.vendor_id
                                                AND ieppm.ext_pmt_party_id = iepa.ext_payee_id
                                                AND ieppm.primary_flag = 'Y'
                                                AND iepa.party_site_id IS NULL
                                                AND iepa.payee_party_id = psv.party_id
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.start_date,
                                                            SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.end_date ,
                                                            SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND TRUNC(NVL(ieppm.inactive_date,
                                                            SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND ieppm.payment_method_code = ibpmb.payment_method_code
                                                AND NVL(ibpmb.end_date,
                                                      TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                AND NVL(ibpmb.inactive_date,
                                                      TRUNC(SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))) payment_method_name,

     (SELECT &PREPAY_ACCT
      FROM gl_code_combinations gcc
      WHERE gcc.code_combination_id = NVL(psa.prepay_code_combination_id ,
                                            (SELECT fspa.prepay_code_combination_id
                                             FROM financials_system_params_all fspa
                                             WHERE fspa.org_id = pss.prc_bu_id))) prepay_acct, COUNT(1) OVER() AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                                                           ORDER BY pss.vendor_site_code) LINE,
                                                                                                                                                                          pss.party_site_id
   FROM poz_supplier_sites_all_m pss, poz_site_assignments_all_x psa
   WHERE pss.inactive_date IS NULL
     AND psa.inactive_date IS NULL
     AND pss.vendor_site_id = psa.vendor_site_id (+)
     AND NVL(psa.bu_id, pss.prc_bu_id) = :p_bu_id
     AND pss.vendor_id = NVL(:p_vendor_id, pss.vendor_id)
     AND (pss.vendor_site_code LIKE '%'||:p_vendor_site_code||'%'
          OR :p_vendor_site_code IS NULL)
     AND (:p_cnpj IS NULL
          OR EXISTS
            (SELECT 1
             FROM zx_party_tax_profile zptp, zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
             WHERE zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
               AND zptp.site_flag = 'Y'
               AND zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
               AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
               AND zptp.party_id = pss.party_site_id
               AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
               AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
               AND zpti.tax_payer_number LIKE '%'||:p_cnpj||'%'))
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM fun_user_role_data_asgnmnts furda, per_users pu
        WHERE furda.org_id = :p_bu_id
          AND (furda.role_name LIKE 'CLIA_RASTRE%JR'
               OR furda.role_name LIKE 'ALT_RASTRE%JR')
          AND furda.user_guid = pu.user_guid
          AND pu.username = :p_username
          AND furda.active_flag = 'Y'
          AND pu.active_flag = 'Y'
          AND furda.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND NVL(furda.end_date_active, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND pu.start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
          AND NVL(pu.end_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

### Query #16

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, DUAL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, PER_USERS, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL, FND_VS_VALUES_VL`

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Payables, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `FND_VS_VALUES_VL, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, DUAL, PO_LINES_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, PER_USERS, AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT po_header_id, po_line_id, line_num, matching_basis, invoice_match_option,
       quantity_delivered, DECODE(INSTR(receipt_num,
                                    ','),
                             0, receipt_num, NULL) receipt_num,
       DECODE(INSTR(receipt_line_num, ','), 0, receipt_line_num, NULL) receipt_line_num,
       DECODE(INSTR(quantity_received, '/'), 0, quantity_received, NULL) quantity_received,
       CASE
           WHEN created_by = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(req_document_type,
                                                   'EBS_CARGA')
           ELSE CASE
                    WHEN pha_attribute1 IS NOT NULL
                         AND req_document_type IS NULL THEN
                           (SELECT TRIM(SUBSTR(fvvs.value_set_code,
                                          8, 30))
                            FROM fnd_vs_values_vl fvvv, fnd_vs_value_sets fvvs,
                                 financials_system_params_all fspa, gl_code_combinations gcc
                            WHERE fvvs.value_set_id = fvvv.value_set_id
                              AND fvvs.value_set_code IN ('CLIA_AP_REQ_PROJ_CLIENT_A',
                                                          'CLIA_AP_REQ_ESC_CLIENT_A', 'CLIA_AP_REQ_OFFSHORE_JV',
                                                          'CLIA_AP_REQ_ONSHORE_JV')
                              AND NVL(fvvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
                              AND NVL(fvvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
                              AND ROWNUM = 1
                              AND fvvv.value = gcc.segment1||'.'||gcc.segment2||'.'||:p_seg_cresultado
                              AND fspa.accts_pay_code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id
                              AND fspa.org_id = pha_req_bu_id
                              AND TRUNC(NVL(fvvv.start_date_active,
                                          SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                              AND TRUNC(NVL(fvvv.end_date_active,
                                          SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ELSE req_document_type
                END
       END req_document_type, req_requester, requester_id, line_counter
FROM
  (SELECT pla.po_header_id, pla.po_line_id, pla.line_num, pla.matching_basis, pha.created_by,
          pha.attribute1 pha_attribute1, pha.req_bu_id pha_req_bu_id,

     (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 0, 'Order', 'Receipt')
      FROM po_line_locations_all plla
      WHERE plla.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND plla.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND plla.match_option = 'R') invoice_match_option,

     (SELECT SUM(NVL(pda.quantity_ordered, 0) - (NVL(pda.quantity_billed,
                                                   0) + NVL(pda.quantity_cancelled,
                                                          0)))
      FROM po_distributions_all pda
      WHERE pda.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND pda.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id) quantity_delivered,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsh.receipt_num, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                        ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) receipt_num
      FROM po_headers_all phar,po_lines_all plar,rcv_transactions rcv,
           rcv_shipment_headers rsh,rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE phar.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = rcv.po_line_id
        AND rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND phar.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT NULL
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) receipt_num,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsl.line_num, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                     ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) receipt_line_num
      FROM po_headers_all phar,po_lines_all plar,rcv_transactions rcv,
           rcv_shipment_headers rsh,rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE phar.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = rcv.po_line_id
        AND rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND phar.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT NULL
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) receipt_line_num,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsl.quantity_received, '/') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                              ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) quantity_received
      FROM po_headers_all phar, po_lines_all plar, rcv_transactions rcv,
           rcv_shipment_headers rsh, rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE phar.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = rcv.po_line_id
        AND rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND phar.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND plar.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT NULL
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = phar.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) quantity_received,

     (SELECT CASE
                 WHEN UPPER(rstl.created_by) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                      AND (rstl.from_header_id IS NULL
                           OR (rstl.from_header_id IS NOT NULL
                               AND rstl.requisition_number IS NULL)) THEN
                        (SELECT TRIM(SUBSTR(fvvs.value_set_code,
                                       8, 30))
                         FROM fnd_vs_values_vl fvvv, fnd_vs_value_sets fvvs
                         WHERE fvvs.value_set_id = fvvv.value_set_id
                           AND fvvs.value_set_code IN ('CLIA_AP_REQ_PROJ_CLIENT_A', 'CLIA_AP_REQ_ESC_CLIENT_A',
                                                       'CLIA_AP_REQ_OFFSHORE_JV', 'CLIA_AP_REQ_ONSHORE_JV')
                           AND NVL(fvvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
                           AND NVL(fvvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
                           AND ROWNUM = 1
                           AND fvvv.value = rstl.segments
                           AND TRUNC(NVL(fvvv.start_date_active, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                           AND TRUNC(NVL(fvvv.end_date_active, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ELSE rstl.attribute1
             END attribute1
      FROM
        (SELECT prha1.requisition_number, prha1.attribute1,
                NVL2(prha1.requisition_number,
                  gcc1.segment1||'.'||gcc1.segment2||'.'||gcc1.segment3,
                  gcc_pda1.segment1||'.'||gcc_pda1.segment2||'.'||gcc_pda1.segment3) segments, pla1.from_header_id, pha1.created_by
         FROM po_headers_all pha1, po_lines_all pla1, po_line_locations_all plla1,
              po_distributions_all pda1, por_req_distributions_all prda1, por_requisition_lines_all prla1,
              por_requisition_headers_all prha1, gl_code_combinations gcc1, gl_code_combinations gcc_pda1
         WHERE pha1.po_header_id = pla1.po_header_id
           AND pha1.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
           AND pla1.attribute5 IS NULL
           AND pla1.po_line_id = plla1.po_line_id (+)
           AND plla1.line_location_id = pda1.line_location_id (+)
           AND pda1.req_distribution_id = prda1.distribution_id (+)
           AND prda1.requisition_line_id = prla1.requisition_line_id (+)
           AND prla1.requisition_header_id = prha1.requisition_header_id (+)
           AND prda1.code_combination_id = gcc1.code_combination_id (+)
           AND pda1.code_combination_id = gcc_pda1.code_combination_id (+)
           AND ROWNUM = 1
         UNION SELECT prha1.requisition_number, prha1.attribute1,
                      gcc1.segment1||'.'||gcc1.segment2||'.'||gcc1.segment3 segments, pla1.from_header_id, pha1.created_by
         FROM po_headers_all pha1, po_lines_all pla1, por_requisition_lines_all prla1,
              por_requisition_headers_all prha1, gl_code_combinations gcc1, por_req_distributions_all prda1
         WHERE pla1.po_header_id = pha1.po_header_id
           AND pha1.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
           AND pla1.attribute5 IS NOT NULL
           AND prla1.requisition_line_id (+) = pla1.attribute5
           AND prla1.requisition_header_id = prha1.requisition_header_id (+)
           AND prda1.requisition_line_id (+) = prla1.requisition_line_id
           AND gcc1.code_combination_id (+) = prda1.code_combination_id
           AND ROWNUM = 1) rstl
      WHERE ROWNUM = 1) req_document_type,
          CASE
              WHEN pla.attribute5 IS NOT NULL THEN
                     (SELECT pu.username
                      FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla, per_users pu
                      WHERE prla.requisition_line_id = pla.attribute5
                        AND pu.person_id = prla.requester_id
                        AND ROWNUM = 1)
              WHEN pha.attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN
                     (SELECT pu.username
                      FROM per_users pu
                      WHERE pu.person_id = pha.agent_id
                        AND ROWNUM = 1)
              ELSE
                     (SELECT pu.username req_requester
                      FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla, per_users pu
                      WHERE prla.requisition_line_id =
                          (SELECT MIN(prla2.requisition_line_id)
                           FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla2
                           WHERE prla2.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id)
                        AND pu.person_id = prla.requester_id
                        AND ROWNUM = 1)
          END req_requester,
          CASE
              WHEN pla.attribute5 IS NOT NULL THEN
                     (SELECT prla.requester_id
                      FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla
                      WHERE prla.requisition_line_id = pla.attribute5
                        AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN pha.attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN pha.agent_id
              ELSE
                     (SELECT prla.requester_id requester_id
                      FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla
                      WHERE prla.requisition_line_id =
                          (SELECT MIN(prla2.requisition_line_id)
                           FROM por_requisition_lines_all prla2
                           WHERE prla2.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id)
                        AND ROWNUM = 1)
          END requester_id, pla.line_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pla.po_header_id
                                                               ORDER BY pla.line_num) line_counter
   FROM po_lines_all pla,po_headers_all pha
   WHERE pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
     AND pla.line_status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED FOR RECEIVING')
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM po_line_locations_all plla
        WHERE plla.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
          AND plla.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id)
     AND pla.po_header_id IN
       (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(:po_ids, '[^' || ',' || ']+', 1, LEVEL) x
        FROM dual CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:po_ids,
                               '[^' || ',' || ']+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)
   ORDER BY pla.po_header_id, pla.line_num)
```
