### Query #17

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL`

### Query #17

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_LINES_ALL, AP_INVOICES_ALL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT po_header_id, po_number, po_line_id, line_num, total, invoice_match_option,
       line_type_lookup_code, item_description description, item, item_description, invetory_item_id,
       quantity, unit_price, matching_basis,
       DECODE(INSTR(receipt_num, ','), 0, receipt_num, NULL) receipt_num,
       DECODE(INSTR(receipt_line_num, ','), 0, receipt_line_num, NULL) receipt_line_num,
       DECODE(INSTR(quantity_received, '/'), 0, quantity_received, NULL) quantity_received, quantity_delivered
FROM
  (SELECT pla.po_header_id, pha.segment1 po_number, pla.po_line_id, pla.line_num,
          ROUND(NVL(pla.unit_price, 0) * NVL(pla.quantity,
                                           0), 2) total,

     (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 0, 'Order', 'Receipt')
      FROM po_line_locations_all plla
      WHERE plla.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND plla.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NVL(cancel_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND plla.match_option = 'R') invoice_match_option, 'Item' line_type_lookup_code,

     (SELECT esib.item_number
      FROM egp_system_items_b esib, inv_org_parameters iop
      WHERE esib.inventory_item_id = pla.item_id
        AND iop.organization_id = esib.organization_id
        AND iop.organization_id = iop.master_organization_id) item,

     (SELECT esit.description
      FROM egp_system_items_tl esit, inv_org_parameters iop
      WHERE esit.organization_id = iop.organization_id
        AND esit.inventory_item_id = pla.item_id
        AND iop.organization_id = iop.master_organization_id
        AND esit.language = 'PTB') item_description,
                                                                  pla.item_id invetory_item_id, pla.quantity,
                                                                  pla.unit_price,
                                                                  pla.matching_basis,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsh.receipt_num, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                        ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) receipt_num
      FROM rcv_transactions rcv, rcv_shipment_headers rsh, rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND rcv.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND rcv.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) receipt_num,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsl.line_num, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                     ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) receipt_line_num
      FROM rcv_transactions rcv, rcv_shipment_headers rsh, rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND rcv.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND rcv.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) receipt_line_num,

     (SELECT LISTAGG(rsl.quantity_received, '/') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                              ORDER BY rsh.receipt_num) quantity_received
      FROM rcv_transactions rcv, rcv_shipment_headers rsh, rcv_shipment_lines rsl
      WHERE rcv.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.shipment_line_id = rsl.shipment_line_id
        AND rsh.shipment_header_id = rsl.shipment_header_id
        AND rcv.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
        AND rsl.quantity_received > 0
        AND rcv.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND rcv.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
        AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
           FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_invoice_lines_all aila
           WHERE aia.invoice_id = aila.invoice_id
             AND aia.cancelled_date IS NULL
             AND (aia.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id
                  OR aila.po_header_id = rcv.po_header_id)
             AND aila.rcv_transaction_id = rcv.transaction_id)) quantity_received,

     (SELECT SUM(NVL(pda.quantity_ordered, 0) - (NVL(pda.quantity_billed,
                                                   0) + NVL(pda.quantity_cancelled,
                                                          0)))
      FROM po_distributions_all pda
      WHERE pda.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
        AND pda.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id) quantity_delivered
   FROM po_lines_all pla, po_headers_all pha
   WHERE pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
     AND pla.line_status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED FOR RECEIVING')
     AND pha.po_header_id = :p_po_header_id
   ORDER BY pla.po_header_id, pla.line_num)
```

### Query #18

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES, IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS, FND_TERRITORIES_TL, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, HZ_PARTIES, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL...`

### Query #18

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS, HZ_PARTIES, IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL, IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL, HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M...`

```sql
WITH valid_bu AS
  (SELECT haou.organization_id,NVL(gcc.segment2, haou.name) AS unidade
   FROM hr_all_organization_units haou,financials_system_params_all fspa,gl_code_combinations gcc,
        fnd_lookup_values_vl rst_lookup
   WHERE haou.organization_id = fspa.org_id(+)
     AND fspa.accts_pay_code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id(+)
     AND rst_lookup.lookup_type = 'RST_UNIDADE_VINCULADA'
     AND rst_lookup.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND rst_lookup.lookup_code = NVL(gcc.segment2, haou.name)),
     taxinfo AS
  (SELECT zptp.party_id,zpti.reporting_type_code,zpti.tax_payer_number
   FROM zx_party_tax_profile zptp,zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
   WHERE zptp.party_tax_profile_id = zpti.entity_id
     AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND zpti.reporting_type_code IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(zpti.effective_from, SYSDATE - 1) AND NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                                     SYSDATE + 1))
SELECT DISTINCT nome,identificador,tp_ident_id,raiz,filial,digito_verificador,
                site_cod,endereco,numero,complemento,bairro,cidade,cod_cidade,estado,
                cod_estado,pais,cod_pais,email,ind_desoneracao,ind_conta,cod_banco,
                nome_banco,cod_agencia,nome_agencia,cod_conta,dig_verif_conta,dt_final,
                unidade,nivel_conta,usuario,id_frne,id_frne_site,id_conta,id_unidade
FROM
  (SELECT aps.vendor_name nome,aps.segment1 identificador,
          CASE WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'CNPJ' WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'CPF' WHEN aps.vendor_type_lookup_code = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 'CPF' ELSE 'OUTROS'
          END tp_ident_id,
          CASE
              WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                      1, 8)
              WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                     1, 9) ELSE '000000000'
          END raiz,
          CASE
              WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                      9, 4) WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN '0000' ELSE '0000'
          END filial,
          CASE
              WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF') THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,

                                                                                      -2) ELSE '00'
          END digito_verificador,assa.vendor_site_code site_cod,
          CAST(hl.address1 AS VARCHAR2(240)) endereco,CAST(hl.address3 AS VARCHAR2(240)) numero,
          CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) complemento,CAST(hl.address2 AS VARCHAR2(240)) bairro,UPPER(hl.city) cidade,
          CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) cod_cidade,

     (SELECT geography_name
      FROM hz_geographies
      WHERE geography_type = 'STATE'
        AND (geography_code = hl.state
             OR geography_name = hl.state)
        AND country_code = hl.country
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN start_date AND NVL(end_date,
                                             SYSDATE)
      GROUP BY geography_name) estado,hl.state cod_estado,

     (SELECT ftt.territory_short_name
      FROM fnd_territories_tl ftt
      WHERE ftt.language = 'PTB'
        AND ftt.territory_code = hl.country) pais,hl.country cod_pais,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) email,'N' ind_desoneracao,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN conta.cod_conta IS NULL THEN 'N'
                                                                                                                ELSE 'S'
                                                                                                            END ind_conta,
                                                                                                            conta.cod_banco,
                                                                                                            conta.nome_banco,
                                                                                                            conta.cod_agencia,
                                                                                                            conta.nome_agencia,
                                                                                                            conta.cod_conta,
                                                                                                            conta.dig_verif_conta,
                                                                                                            conta.dt_final,
                                                                                                            vb.unidade,
                                                                                                            'SITE' nivel_conta,
                                                                                                                   CHR(35)||'INTEGRACAO' usuario,
                                                                                                                   aps.vendor_id id_frne,
                                                                                                                   assa.vendor_site_id id_frne_site,
                                                                                                                   NVL(conta.ext_bank_account_id,

                                                                                                                     -999999) id_conta,
                                                                                                                   NVL(conta.org_id,

                                                                                                                     -999999) id_unidade
   FROM poz_suppliers_v aps,poz_supplier_sites_all_m assa,hz_party_sites hps,hz_locations hl,taxinfo,
        valid_bu vb,

     (SELECT aps_in.vendor_id,assa_in.vendor_site_code,accts.ext_bank_account_id,payee.org_id,
             bank_profile.bank_or_branch_number cod_banco,bank_party.party_name nome_banco,
             branch_profile.bank_or_branch_number cod_agencia,branch_party.party_name nome_agencia,
             CASE
                 WHEN INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-') = 0 THEN accts.bank_account_num
                 ELSE SUBSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                        1, INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-')-1)
             END cod_conta,
             CASE WHEN INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-') = 0 THEN NULL
                 ELSE SUBSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                        INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-')+1)
             END dig_verif_conta,accts.end_date dt_final,
             GREATEST(payee.last_update_date,
               uses.last_update_date, accts.last_update_date,
               bank_party.last_update_date, bank_profile.last_update_date, branch_party.last_update_date,
               branch_profile.last_update_date) last_update_date
      FROM poz_suppliers_v aps_in
      JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m assa_in ON aps_in.vendor_id = assa_in.vendor_id
      JOIN iby_external_payees_all payee ON assa_in.vendor_site_id = payee.supplier_site_id
      AND (payee.org_id IS NULL
           OR assa_in.prc_bu_id = payee.org_id)
      JOIN iby_pmt_instr_uses_all uses ON payee.ext_payee_id = uses.ext_pmt_party_id
      AND uses.payment_flow = 'DISBURSEMENTS'
      JOIN iby_ext_bank_accounts accts ON uses.instrument_id = accts.ext_bank_account_id
      LEFT JOIN hz_parties bank_party ON accts.bank_id = bank_party.party_id
      LEFT JOIN hz_organization_profiles bank_profile ON bank_party.party_id = bank_profile.party_id
      AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(bank_profile.effective_start_date, SYSDATE-1) AND NVL(bank_profile.effective_end_date,

                                                                                  SYSDATE+1)
      LEFT JOIN hz_parties branch_party ON accts.branch_id = branch_party.party_id
      LEFT JOIN hz_organization_profiles branch_profile ON branch_party.party_id = branch_profile.party_id
      AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(branch_profile.effective_start_date, SYSDATE-1) AND NVL(branch_profile.effective_end_date,

                                                                                    SYSDATE+1)) conta
   WHERE aps.vendor_id = assa.vendor_id
     AND assa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
     AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
     AND aps.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND assa.inactive_date IS NULL
     AND assa.party_site_id = taxinfo.party_id(+)
     AND assa.prc_bu_id = vb.organization_id(+)
     AND conta.vendor_id(+) = assa.vendor_id
     AND conta.vendor_site_code(+) = assa.vendor_site_code
     AND GREATEST(aps.last_update_date,
           assa.last_update_date, hps.last_update_date, hl.last_update_date,
           conta.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
   UNION ALL SELECT aps.vendor_name nome,aps.segment1 identificador,
                    CASE
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'CNPJ'
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'CPF' WHEN aps.vendor_type_lookup_code = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 'CPF' ELSE 'OUTROS'
                    END tp_ident_id,
                    CASE
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                                1, 8)
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                               1, 9) ELSE '000000000'
                    END raiz,
                    CASE
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,
                                                                                9, 4)
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN '0000' ELSE '0000'
                    END filial,
                    CASE
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF') THEN SUBSTR(taxinfo.tax_payer_number,

                                                                                                -2) ELSE '00'
                    END digito_verificador,assa.vendor_site_code site_cod,
                    CAST(hl.address1 AS VARCHAR2(240)) endereco,CAST(hl.address3 AS VARCHAR2(240)) numero,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) complemento,CAST(hl.address2 AS VARCHAR2(240)) bairro,
                    UPPER(hl.city) cidade,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) cod_cidade,

     (SELECT UPPER(geography_name)
      FROM hz_geographies
      WHERE geography_type = 'STATE'
        AND (geography_code = hl.state
             OR geography_name = hl.state)
        AND country_code = hl.country
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN start_date AND NVL(end_date,
                                             SYSDATE)
      GROUP BY geography_name) estado,UPPER(hl.state) cod_estado,

     (SELECT UPPER(ftt.territory_short_name)
      FROM fnd_territories_tl ftt
      WHERE ftt.language = 'PTB'
        AND ftt.territory_code = hl.country) pais,UPPER(hl.country) cod_pais,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) email,
                    'N' ind_desoneracao,
                        CASE WHEN accts.bank_account_num IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
                        END ind_conta,bank_profile.bank_or_branch_number cod_banco,
                        bank_party.party_name nome_banco,branch_profile.bank_or_branch_number cod_agencia,
                        branch_party.party_name nome_agencia,
                        CASE
                            WHEN INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-') = 0 THEN accts.bank_account_num
                            ELSE SUBSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                                   1, INSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                                        '-')-1)
                        END cod_conta,
                        CASE WHEN INSTR(accts.bank_account_num, '-') = 0 THEN NULL
                            ELSE SUBSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                                   INSTR(accts.bank_account_num,
                                     '-')+1)
                        END dig_verif_conta,accts.end_date dt_final,
                        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) unidade,'HEADER' nivel_conta,
                                                                     CHR(35)||'INTEGRACAO' usuario,
                                                                     aps.vendor_id id_frne,
                                                                     assa.vendor_site_id id_frne_site,
                                                                     accts.ext_bank_account_id id_conta,
                                                                     -999999 id_unidade
   FROM poz_suppliers_v aps,poz_supplier_sites_all_m assa,hz_party_sites hps,hz_locations hl,
        iby_external_payees_all payee,iby_pmt_instr_uses_all uses,iby_ext_bank_accounts accts,
        hz_parties bank_party,hz_organization_profiles bank_profile,hz_parties branch_party,
        hz_organization_profiles branch_profile,taxinfo
   WHERE aps.vendor_id = assa.vendor_id
     AND assa.party_site_id = taxinfo.party_id(+)
     AND assa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
     AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
     AND aps.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND payee.payee_party_id = aps.party_id
     AND uses.ext_pmt_party_id = payee.ext_payee_id
     AND uses.payment_flow = 'DISBURSEMENTS'
     AND accts.ext_bank_account_id = uses.instrument_id
     AND accts.bank_id = bank_party.party_id(+)
     AND bank_party.party_id = bank_profile.party_id(+)
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(bank_profile.effective_start_date(+), SYSDATE-1) AND NVL(bank_profile.effective_end_date(+),

                                                                                    SYSDATE+1)
     AND accts.branch_id = branch_party.party_id(+)
     AND branch_party.party_id = branch_profile.party_id(+)
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(branch_profile.effective_start_date(+), SYSDATE-1) AND NVL(branch_profile.effective_end_date(+),

                                                                                      SYSDATE+1)
     AND payee.supplier_site_id IS NULL
     AND payee.org_id IS NULL
     AND assa.inactive_date IS NULL
     AND GREATEST(aps.last_update_date,
           assa.last_update_date, hps.last_update_date, hl.last_update_date,
           payee.last_update_date, uses.last_update_date, accts.last_update_date, bank_party.last_update_date,
           bank_profile.last_update_date, branch_party.last_update_date, branch_profile.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
   UNION ALL SELECT aps.vendor_name nome,aps.segment1 identificador,
                    CASE
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'CNPJ'
                        WHEN taxinfo.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'CPF' WHEN aps.vendor_type_lookup_code = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 'CPF' ELSE 'OUTROS'
                    END tp_ident_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) raiz,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) filial,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) digito_verificador,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) site_cod,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) endereco,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) numero,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) complemento,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) bairro,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cidade,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) cod_cidade,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) estado,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cod_estado,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) pais,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cod_pais,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) email,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) ind_desoneracao,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) ind_conta,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cod_banco,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) nome_banco,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cod_agencia,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) nome_agencia,
                    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) cod_conta,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) dig_verif_conta,
                    CAST(NULL AS DATE) dt_final,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) unidade,'HEADER_NO_ACCT' nivel_conta,
                                                                                                     CHR(35)||'INTEGRACAO' usuario,
                                                                                                     aps.vendor_id id_frne,
                                                                                                     -999999 id_frne_site,
                                                                                                     -999999 id_conta,
                                                                                                     -999999 id_unidade
   FROM poz_suppliers_v aps,poz_supplier_sites_all_m assa,taxinfo
   WHERE assa.vendor_id = aps.vendor_id
     AND assa.party_site_id = taxinfo.party_id(+)
     AND aps.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND GREATEST(aps.last_update_date, assa.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
   GROUP BY aps.vendor_name,aps.segment1,taxinfo.reporting_type_code,aps.vendor_type_lookup_code,
            aps.vendor_id)
ORDER BY unidade ASC,id_frne ASC
OFFSET :P_OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT :P_PAGE_SIZE ROWS ONLY
```

```sql
SELECT SUBSTR(
                (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
                 FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU

                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                   INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                     '-') - 1) COMPANY,

  (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
   WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID) COMPANY_BU_NAME, PSAAM.BU_ID COMPANY_BU_ID,
       CASE
           WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(

                                                                     FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                     WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
                                                                       AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                       AND ROWNUM = 1), PS.SEGMENT1) ELSE PS.SEGMENT1
       END COMPANY_COD_SUPPLIER,
       SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE, 1, INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,
                                           '-') - 1) COMPANY_SITE_CODE,
       CASE
           WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                AND
                  (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                   FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                   WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
                     AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                     AND ROWNUM = 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END EBS_MIGRATION_FLAG, 'V' TYPE, HP.PARTY_NAME NAME,
                                   HL.ADDRESS1 || ' ' || HL.ADDRESS2 || ' ' || HL.ADDRESS3 ADDRESS1, HL.CITY ADDRESS2,
                                   NVL(HL.STATE,
                                     HL.PROVINCE) ADDRESS3, HL.POSTAL_CODE || ' ' || HL.COUNTRY ADDRESS4,
                                   '' CONTACT,
                                      CASE
                                          WHEN PSSAM.PHONE IS NOT NULL
                                               AND PSSAM.AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN PSSAM.AREA_CODE || '-' || PSSAM.PHONE ELSE PSSAM.PHONE
                                      END PHONE, PSSAM.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE FOB,
                                      PSSAM.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE FREIGHTTERMS, PSSAM.SHIP_VIA_LOOKUP_CODE SHIPVIA,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
     AND ATT.TERM_ID = PSSAM.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,
                                      NVL(PSSAM.CUSTOMER_NUM,
                                        PS.CUSTOMER_NUM) CUSTOMERNUM,
                                      CASE
                                          WHEN PSSAM.FAX IS NOT NULL
                                               AND PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE || '-' || PSSAM.FAX ELSE PSSAM.FAX
                                      END FAX, PSSAM.LAST_UPDATED_BY CHANGEBY,
                                      TO_CHAR(
                                                (SELECT GREATEST(PS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                          PSSAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                          HP.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, HPS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                                                 FROM DUAL), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE, '' INCLUSIVE1,
                                                                                                       '' INCLUSIVE2,
                                                                                                          '' INCLUSIVE3,
                                                                                                             '' TAX1CODE,
                                                                                                                '' TAX2CODE,
                                                                                                                   '' TAX3CODE,
                                                                                                                      'USD' CURRENCYCODE,
                                                                                                                            '' LOCATION,
                                                                                                                               '' REGISTRATION1,
                                                                                                                                  '' REGISTRATION2,
                                                                                                                                     '' REGISTRATION3,
                                                                                                                                        '' APCONTROLACC,
                                                                                                                                           '' APSUSPENSEACC,
                                                                                                                                              '' RBNIACC,
                                                                                                                                                 NVL(
                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                        FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                      IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                      IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                        WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                        FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                      IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                      IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                        WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PAYEE_PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID IS NULL
                                                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1)) PAYVENDOR,
                                                                                                                                                 NVL(
                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
                                                                                                                                                        FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                      IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                      IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                        WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
                                                                                                                                                        FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                      IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                      IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                        WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PAYEE_PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                          AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID IS NULL
                                                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1)) BANKACCOUNT,
                                                                                                                                                 '' INCLUSIVE4,
                                                                                                                                                    '' INCLUSIVE5,
                                                                                                                                                       '' REGISTRATION4,
                                                                                                                                                          '' REGISTRATION5,
                                                                                                                                                             '' TAX4CODE,
                                                                                                                                                                '' TAX5CODE,
                                                                                                                                                                   CASE
                                                                                                                                                                       WHEN NVL(PS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                              SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                            OR NVL(PSSAM.INACTIVE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                 SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                            OR NVL(HPS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                                 SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                       ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                   END DISABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                   '' REMITADDRESS1,
                                                                                                                                                                      '' REMITADDRESS2,
                                                                                                                                                                         '' REMITADDRESS3,
                                                                                                                                                                            '' REMITADDRESS4,
                                                                                                                                                                               '' REMITCONTACT,
                                                                                                                                                                                  '' PAYONRECEIPT,
                                                                                                                                                                                     '' HOMEPAGE,
                                                                                                                                                                                        '' BANKNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                           '' DUNSNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                              '' TAXEXEMPTCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' TAXEXEMPTNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' ECOMMERCEENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' MNETCOMPANYID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' AUTORECEIVEONASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      '' VENDORSENDSASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '' VENDORSENDSINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '' ECOMINTERFACE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '' MNETECOMNUM1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' MNETECOMNUM2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' MNETECOMNUM3,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' MNETECOMNUM4,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           '' VENDORSENDSSTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' AUTOAPPROVEINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' AUTOSENDPOCANCEL,

  (SELECT GL.NAME
   FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF, GL_LEDGERS GL
   WHERE HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = GL.LEDGER_ID) ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' DEFAULTWAREHOUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' PARENTCOMPANY,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' USEPARENTREMITTO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' ADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' REMITADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' CATALOGNAME,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      '' PUNCHOUTENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '' NAME_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '' FREIGHTTERMS_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '' COMPANIESID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' POREQFOROUTLAB,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' INSUREXPDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            WHEN PSSAM.RECEIVING_ROUTING_ID = 2 THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        END INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' LANGCODE, ROWNUM TRANSID,

  (SELECT zpti.tax_payer_number
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ', 'ORA_BR_CPF', 'ORA_BR_OTHER')
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID(+) = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) OOG_CNPJ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            END OA_PURCHSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PAY_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            END OA_PAYSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '' OA_OLD_VNDSITECODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '1' TRANSSEQ,

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID) CLIA_BU_INFO
FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS PS, HZ_PARTIES HP, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, HZ_LOCATIONS HL,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_LOCATIONS HLO
WHERE HP.PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
  AND PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
  AND ((PSSAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                    TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                      'DD/MM/RRRR')))
       OR (PS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                    TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                      'DD/MM/RRRR')))
       OR (HP.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                    TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                      'DD/MM/RRRR')))
       OR (HPS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                     TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR'))))
  AND ((PSSAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                    PSSAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
       OR (PS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                    PS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
       OR (HP.LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                    HP.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
       OR (HPS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                     HPS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)))
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PSSAM.VENDOR_ID)
  AND HP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
  AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
  AND HLO.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND PS.VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE <> 'TAX AUTHORITY'
  AND HLO.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
```

                                                                                            '' CONTACT,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME

     AND ATT.TERM_ID = PSSAM.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,

                                                                                                   ELSE PSSAM.FAX
                                                                                               END FAX,

                                                                                               TO_CHAR(

                                                                                                                   HP.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                           '' TAX2CODE,

                                                                                                                 'USD' CURRENCYCODE,

                                                                                                                             '' REGISTRATION2,
                                                                                                                                '' REGISTRATION3,
                                                                                                                                   '' APCONTROLACC,
                                                                                                                                      '' APSUSPENSEACC,
                                                                                                                                         '' RBNIACC,
                                                                                                                                            NVL(
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID

                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
