```sql
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PAYEE_PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID IS NULL
                                                                                                                                                     AND ROWNUM = 1)) BANKACCOUNT,
                                                                                                                                            '' INCLUSIVE4,
                                                                                                                                               '' INCLUSIVE5,
                                                                                                                                                  '' REGISTRATION4,
                                                                                                                                                     '' REGISTRATION5,
                                                                                                                                                        '' TAX4CODE,
                                                                                                                                                           '' TAX5CODE,
                                                                                                                                                              CASE
                                                                                                                                                                  WHEN NVL(PS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                       OR NVL(PSSAM.INACTIVE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                            SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                       OR NVL(HPS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                            SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                  ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                              END DISABLED,
                                                                                                                                                              '' REMITADDRESS1,
                                                                                                                                                                 '' REMITADDRESS2,
                                                                                                                                                                    '' REMITADDRESS3,
                                                                                                                                                                       '' REMITADDRESS4,
                                                                                                                                                                          '' REMITCONTACT,
                                                                                                                                                                             '' PAYONRECEIPT,
                                                                                                                                                                                '' HOMEPAGE,
                                                                                                                                                                                   '' BANKNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                      '' DUNSNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                         '' TAXEXEMPTCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                            '' TAXEXEMPTNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                               '' ECOMMERCEENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' MNETCOMPANYID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                           PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                           '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' AUTORECEIVEONASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' VENDORSENDSASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' VENDORSENDSINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' ECOMINTERFACE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' MNETECOMNUM1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' MNETECOMNUM2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' MNETECOMNUM3,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' MNETECOMNUM4,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      '' VENDORSENDSSTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '' AUTOAPPROVEINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '' AUTOSENDPOCANCEL,

  (SELECT GL.NAME
   FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF, GL_LEDGERS GL
   WHERE HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = GL.LEDGER_ID) ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '' DEFAULTWAREHOUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' PARENTCOMPANY,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' USEPARENTREMITTO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' ADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           '' REMITADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' CATALOGNAME,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' PUNCHOUTENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' NAME_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' FREIGHTTERMS_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' COMPANIESID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' POREQFOROUTLAB,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' INSUREXPDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       WHEN PSSAM.RECEIVING_ROUTING_ID = 2 THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   END INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' LANGCODE, ROWNUM TRANSID,

  (SELECT zpti.tax_payer_number
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ', 'ORA_BR_CPF', 'ORA_BR_OTHER')
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID(+) = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) OOG_CNPJ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END OA_PURCHSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PAY_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END OA_PAYSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' OA_OLD_VNDSITECODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '1' TRANSSEQ,

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID) CLIA_BU_INFO
FROM FUSION.FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUN,FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS
INNER JOIN FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM ON PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
AND PS.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
AND PSSAM.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
INNER JOIN FUSION.FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU ON PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID = FABU.BU_ID
LEFT JOIN FUSION.POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM ON PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, sysdate)) <= trunc(sysdate)
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, sysdate + 1)) > trunc(sysdate)
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.INACTIVE_DATE, sysdate + 1)) > trunc(sysdate)
LEFT JOIN FUSION.FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUA ON PSAAM.BU_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTIES HP ON PS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
AND PS.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
AND HP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU ON PSAAM.BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HLO ON HAOU.LOCATION_ID = HLO.LOCATION_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND decode(FABUA.BU_NAME, 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID, PSAAM.BU_ID) = FABUA.BU_ID
  AND FABUN.BU_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = nvl(:P_VENDOR_ID, PSSAM.VENDOR_ID)
  AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = nvl(:P_VENDOR_SITE_ID,
                               PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)
  AND decode(FABU.BU_NAME, 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_ID, FABU.BU_ID) = nvl(:P_BU_ID,

                                                                               decode(FABU.BU_NAME,

                                                                                 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES',
                                                                                 FABUA.BU_ID,
                                                                                 FABU.BU_ID))
```

```sql
SELECT substr(decode(FABU.BU_NAME,
                'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_NAME, FABU.BU_NAME), 1, 6) || '-' || PS.SEGMENT1 || '-' || PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE AS COMPANY,
       decode(FABU.BU_NAME, 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_NAME, FABU.BU_NAME) AS BU_NAME,
       substr(decode(FABU.BU_NAME,
                'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_NAME, FABU.BU_NAME), 1, 6) || '-' || PS.SEGMENT1 || '-' || decode(FABU.BU_NAME,

                                                                                                             'BANCADA_REQUISICOES',
                                                                                                             FABUA.BU_NAME,
                                                                                                             FABU.BU_NAME) AS COMPANY_BU_NAME,
       decode(FABU.BU_NAME, 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_ID, FABU.BU_ID) AS COMPANY_BU_ID, PS.SEGMENT1 AS COMPANY_COD_SUPPLIER,
       PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE COMPANY_SITE_CODE, PSSAM.VENDOR_ID, PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID, 'V' TYPE,

                                                                                              HL.PROVINCE) ADDRESS3,

                                                                                                   ELSE PSSAM.PHONE
                                                                                               END PHONE,

                                                                                               PSSAM.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE FREIGHTTERMS,
                                                                                               PSSAM.SHIP_VIA_LOOKUP_CODE SHIPVIA,

  (SELECT ATT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS_TL ATT
   WHERE ATT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
     AND ATT.TERM_ID = PSSAM.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,
                                                                                               NVL(PSSAM.CUSTOMER_NUM,

                                                                                                 PS.CUSTOMER_NUM) CUSTOMERNUM,
                                                                                               CASE

                                                                                                        AND PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN PSSAM.FAX_AREA_CODE || '-' || PSSAM.FAX
                                                                                                   ELSE PSSAM.FAX
                                                                                               END FAX,

                                                                                               TO_CHAR(

                                                                                                                   HPS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                                                                                                          FROM DUAL), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE,

                                                                                                        '' TAX1CODE,
                                                                                                           '' TAX2CODE,
                                                                                                              '' TAX3CODE,
                                                                                                                 'USD' CURRENCYCODE,
                                                                                                                       '' LOCATION,
                                                                                                                          '' REGISTRATION1,
                                                                                                                             '' REGISTRATION2,
                                                                                                                                '' REGISTRATION3,
                                                                                                                                   '' APCONTROLACC,
                                                                                                                                      '' APSUSPENSEACC,
                                                                                                                                         '' RBNIACC,
                                                                                                                                            NVL(
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PAYEE_PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID IS NULL
                                                                                                                                                     AND ROWNUM = 1)) PAYVENDOR,
                                                                                                                                            NVL(
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
                                                                                                                                                   FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS IEBA,

                                                                                                                                                 IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL IPIUA,
                                                                                                                                                 IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL IEPA
                                                                                                                                                   WHERE IEBA.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = IPIUA.INSTRUMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IPIUA.EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID = IEPA.EXT_PAYEE_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PAYEE_PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                     AND IEPA.PARTY_SITE_ID IS NULL
                                                                                                                                                     AND ROWNUM = 1)) BANKACCOUNT,
                                                                                                                                            '' INCLUSIVE4,
                                                                                                                                               '' INCLUSIVE5,
                                                                                                                                                  '' REGISTRATION4,
                                                                                                                                                     '' REGISTRATION5,
                                                                                                                                                        '' TAX4CODE,
                                                                                                                                                           '' TAX5CODE,
                                                                                                                                                              CASE
                                                                                                                                                                  WHEN NVL(PS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                       OR NVL(PSSAM.INACTIVE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                            SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE
                                                                                                                                                                       OR NVL(HPS.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                            SYSDATE + 1) <= SYSDATE THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                  ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                              END DISABLED,
                                                                                                                                                              '' REMITADDRESS1,
                                                                                                                                                                 '' REMITADDRESS2,
                                                                                                                                                                    '' REMITADDRESS3,
                                                                                                                                                                       '' REMITADDRESS4,
                                                                                                                                                                          '' REMITCONTACT,
                                                                                                                                                                             '' PAYONRECEIPT,
                                                                                                                                                                                '' HOMEPAGE,
                                                                                                                                                                                   '' BANKNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                      '' DUNSNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                         '' TAXEXEMPTCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                            '' TAXEXEMPTNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                               '' ECOMMERCEENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' MNETCOMPANYID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                           PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                           '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' AUTORECEIVEONASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' VENDORSENDSASN,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' VENDORSENDSINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' ECOMINTERFACE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' MNETECOMNUM1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' MNETECOMNUM2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' MNETECOMNUM3,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' MNETECOMNUM4,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      '' VENDORSENDSSTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '' AUTOAPPROVEINV,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '' AUTOSENDPOCANCEL,

  (SELECT GL.NAME
   FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF, GL_LEDGERS GL
   WHERE HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = GL.LEDGER_ID) ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '' DEFAULTWAREHOUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '' PARENTCOMPANY,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '' USEPARENTREMITTO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '' ADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           '' REMITADDRESS5,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' CATALOGNAME,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' PUNCHOUTENABLED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    '' NAME_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' FREIGHTTERMS_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' COMPANIESID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '' POREQFOROUTLAB,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '' INSUREXPDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       WHEN PSSAM.RECEIVING_ROUTING_ID = 2 THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   END INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '' LANGCODE, ROWNUM TRANSID,

  (SELECT zpti.tax_payer_number
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
   WHERE ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ', 'ORA_BR_CPF', 'ORA_BR_OTHER')
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID(+) = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) OOG_CNPJ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END OA_PURCHSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN NVL(PSSAM.PAY_SITE_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'N') = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END OA_PAYSITE_FLG,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       '' OA_OLD_VNDSITECODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '1' TRANSSEQ,

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID
     AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID) CLIA_BU_INFO
FROM FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS
INNER JOIN FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM ON PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
AND PS.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
AND PSSAM.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
INNER JOIN FUSION.FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU ON PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID = FABU.BU_ID
LEFT JOIN FUSION.POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM ON PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, sysdate)) <= trunc(sysdate)
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, sysdate + 1)) > trunc(sysdate)
AND trunc(nvl(PSAAM.INACTIVE_DATE, sysdate + 1)) > trunc(sysdate)
LEFT JOIN FUSION.FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUA ON PSAAM.BU_ID = FABUA.BU_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTIES HP ON PS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
AND PS.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
AND HP.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HPS.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU ON PSAAM.BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
INNER JOIN FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HLO ON HAOU.LOCATION_ID = HLO.LOCATION_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_ID = nvl(:P_VENDOR_ID, PSSAM.VENDOR_ID)
  AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = nvl(:P_VENDOR_SITE_ID,
                               PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)
  AND decode(FABU.BU_NAME, 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES', FABUA.BU_ID, FABU.BU_ID) = nvl(:P_BU_ID,

                                                                               decode(FABU.BU_NAME,

                                                                                 'BANCADA_REQUISICOES',
                                                                                 FABUA.BU_ID,
                                                                                 FABU.BU_ID))
```
