**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, AP_TERMS, HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE...`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AP_TERMS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS, PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE, PO_VERSIONS, GL_DAILY_RATES, HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES...`

```sql
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 CONTRACTNUM, PLA.LINE_NUM CONTRACTLINENUM,
       'MAXADMIN' CHANGEBY, 'MAXADMIN' PURCHASEAGENT, PHA.APPROVED_FLAG APPROVED_FLAG,
                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE CONTRACTTYPE, 'USD' CURRENCYCODE,
                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                             WHEN PHA.CURRENCY_CODE = 'USD' THEN 1
                                                                                                                             ELSE
                                                                                                                                    (SELECT CONVERSION_RATE
                                                                                                                                     FROM GL_DAILY_RATES GDR
                                                                                                                                     WHERE GDR.FROM_CURRENCY = PHA.CURRENCY_CODE
                                                                                                                                       AND GDR.TO_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                                                                       AND GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE = 'Corporate'
                                                                                                                                       AND TRUNC(GDR.CONVERSION_DATE) =
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT MAX(GDR2.CONVERSION_DATE)
                                                                                                                                          FROM GL_DAILY_RATES GDR2
                                                                                                                                          WHERE GDR2.FROM_CURRENCY = GDR.FROM_CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                            AND GDR2.TO_CURRENCY = GDR.TO_CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                            AND GDR2.CONVERSION_TYPE = GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE
                                                                                                                                            AND TRUNC(GDR2.CONVERSION_DATE) <= TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)))
                                                                                                                         END EXCHANGERATE,
                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                             WHEN PHA.CURRENCY_CODE = 'USD' THEN TO_CHAR(PHA.RATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                             ELSE
                                                                                                                                    (SELECT MAX(TO_CHAR(GDR.CONVERSION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS'))
                                                                                                                                     FROM GL_DAILY_RATES GDR
                                                                                                                                     WHERE GDR.FROM_CURRENCY = PHA.CURRENCY_CODE
                                                                                                                                       AND GDR.TO_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                                                                       AND GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE = 'Corporate'
                                                                                                                                       AND TRUNC(GDR.CONVERSION_DATE) <= TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
                                                                                                                         END EXCHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                         TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,

                                                                                                                           'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') ENDDATE,
                                                                                                                         PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE FOB,
                                                                                                                         NVL(PHA.AMOUNT_LIMIT,

                                                                                                                           PHA.BLANKET_TOTAL_AMOUNT) MAXVOL,

  (SELECT AT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS AT
   WHERE AT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,
                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                             WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                    'Y') IN ('R',
                                                                                                                                             'Y')
                                                                                                                                  AND
                                                                                                                                    (SELECT REVISON
                                                                                                                                     FROM
                                                                                                                                       (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM,

                                                                                                                                                 '',
                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                 CO_NUM) REVISON
                                                                                                                                        FROM PO_VERSIONS
                                                                                                                                        WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                          AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
                                                                                                                                        ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
                                                                                                                                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1) <> 0 THEN 'oa_docrevised'
                                                                                                                             ELSE 'oa_doc_no_revised'
                                                                                                                         END REVCOMMENTS,
                                                                                                                         NULL CONTRACTLINEID,
                                                                                                                              CASE
                                                                                                                                  WHEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT SUBSTR(ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME,

                                                                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                                                                   4) CATEGORIA
                                                                                                                                          FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,
                                                                                                                                               INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT
                                                                                                                                          WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1) IN ('0003',
                                                                                                                                                                '0004',
                                                                                                                                                                '0005',
                                                                                                                                                                '0006',
                                                                                                                                                                '0070') THEN 'STDSERVICE'
                                                                                                                                  WHEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT SUBSTR(ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME,

                                                                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                                                                   4) CATEGORIA
                                                                                                                                          FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,
                                                                                                                                               INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT
                                                                                                                                          WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1) IN ('0001',
                                                                                                                                                                '0002',
                                                                                                                                                                '0008',
                                                                                                                                                                '0009',
                                                                                                                                                                '0010',
                                                                                                                                                                '0020',
                                                                                                                                                                '0040',
                                                                                                                                                                '0050',
                                                                                                                                                                '0060') THEN 'ITEM'
                                                                                                                                  WHEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT SUBSTR(ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME,

                                                                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                                                                   4) CATEGORIA
                                                                                                                                          FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,
                                                                                                                                               INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT
                                                                                                                                          WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1) IN ('0007',
                                                                                                                                                                '0030') THEN 'TOOL'
                                                                                                                                  ELSE ''
                                                                                                                              END LINETYPE,

  (SELECT ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME CATEGORIA
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
        EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
        EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID
     AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) LINETYPECODE,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS MP
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND MP.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) ITEMNUM,
                                                                                                                              NULL ITEMSETID,
                                                                                                                                   NULL CONDITIONCODE,
                                                                                                                                        PHA.COMMENTS DESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                        NULL CATALOGCODE,
                                                                                                                                             NULL MANUFACTURER,
                                                                                                                                                  SUBSTR(PLA.VENDOR_PRODUCT_NUM,

                                                                                                                                                    1,
                                                                                                                                                    200) MODELNUM,

  (SELECT IUOM.UNIT_OF_MEASURE
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS MP, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE IUOM
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND MP.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND IUOM.UOM_CODE = ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
     AND ROWNUM = 1) ORDERUNIT,
                                                                                                                                                  NULL ORDERQTY,
                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                           WHEN PHA.CURRENCY_CODE = 'USD' THEN PLA.UNIT_PRICE
                                                                                                                                                           ELSE
                                                                                                                                                                  (SELECT CONVERSION_RATE
                                                                                                                                                                   FROM GL_DAILY_RATES GDR
                                                                                                                                                                   WHERE GDR.FROM_CURRENCY = PHA.CURRENCY_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                     AND GDR.TO_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                                                                                                     AND GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE = 'Corporate'
                                                                                                                                                                     AND TRUNC(GDR.CONVERSION_DATE) =
                                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT MAX(GDR2.CONVERSION_DATE)
                                                                                                                                                                        FROM GL_DAILY_RATES GDR2
                                                                                                                                                                        WHERE GDR2.FROM_CURRENCY = GDR.FROM_CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                                                          AND GDR2.TO_CURRENCY = GDR.TO_CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                                                          AND GDR2.CONVERSION_TYPE = GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE
                                                                                                                                                                          AND TRUNC(GDR2.CONVERSION_DATE) <= TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))) * PLA.UNIT_PRICE
                                                                                                                                                       END UNITCOST,
                                                                                                                                                       DECODE(PLA.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                         'FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                         PLA.AMOUNT,
                                                                                                                                                         NULL) LINECOST,
                                                                                                                                                       NULL INSPECTION_REQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                            'MAXADMIN' ENTERBY,
                                                                                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') ENTERDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                       HOI.ORG_INFORMATION3 ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                       NULL DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                            NULL REMARK_LONGDESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL NEWPRICE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN PLA.CLOSED_DATE IS NOT NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                               OR NVL(PLA.CLOSED_REASON,

                                                                                                                                                                                                    '*') = 'FINALLY CLOSED'
                                                                                                                                                                                               OR PLA.LINE_STATUS = 'CANCELED'
                                                                                                                                                                                               OR PLA.EXPIRATION_DATE < SYSDATE THEN 'CAN'
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'APPR'
                                                                                                                                                                                      END LINESTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CAN'
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'CLOSE'
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 '*') = 'R'
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'Y') = 'Y' THEN 'APPR'
                                                                                                                                                                                      END STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                      TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') STATUSDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN PHA.END_DATE IS NOT NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND (PHA.END_DATE < NVL(PHA.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                     SYSDATE)) THEN TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(PHA.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE),

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                                                                                      END STARTDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                                                                               (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
                                                                                                                                                                                                FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU,

                                                                                                                                                                                             PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA,
                                                                                                                                                                                             HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
                                                                                                                                                                                             HR_LOCATIONS HL
                                                                                                                                                                                                WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND ROWNUM = 1), 1,

                                                                                                                                                                                          6) || '-' || PSUP.SEGMENT1 || '-' || SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '-') - 1) VENDOR,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      AND ROWNUM = 1), PSUP.SEGMENT1)
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE PSUP.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                                                                                                      END VENDORCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                        1,
                                                                                                                                                                                        INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                          '-') - 1) VENDORSITECODE,

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF,
        POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
        HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID
     AND PSAAM.BU_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
     AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
     AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
     AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) VENDORMIGOU,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND ROWNUM = 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                      END EBSMIGRATIONFLAG,
                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL COMMODITY,
                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL COMMODITYGROUP,

  (SELECT REVISON
   FROM
     (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM, '', 0, CO_NUM) REVISON
      FROM PO_VERSIONS
      WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
      ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) REVISIONNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL REVSTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     DECODE(PLA.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       0) CHGQTYONUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     DECODE(PLA.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       1) CHGPRICEONUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL LEADTIME,
                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL HASPAYMENTSCHED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL POREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL LEASEENDVALUE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL LANGCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              HAOU.NAME CLIA_ORG,

  (SELECT MSIT.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL MSIT, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS MP
   WHERE MSIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND MSIT.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND MP.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND LANGUAGE = 'US'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) CL_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PLA.NOTE_TO_VENDOR CL_DESCRIPTION_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' DESCRIPTION_LD2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'BASE-UNP' OOG_SITEID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'BASE-UNP' AUTHSITEID, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ORDER BY pha.po_header_id,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PLA.PO_LINE_ID) AS LINE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               COUNT(1) OVER() AS total
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI,
     PO_LINE_TYPES_VL PLTV, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, POZ_SUPPLIERS PSUP,
     POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM
WHERE HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.VENDOR_ID = PSUP.VENDOR_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND ((PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'OPEN'
        AND PHA.APPROVED_DATE > NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                  TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                    'DD/MM/RRRR')))
       OR (PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'CANCELED'
           AND PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                        TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                          'DD/MM/RRRR'))))
  AND PLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLA.LINE_TYPE_ID = PLTV.LINE_TYPE_ID(+)
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('BLANKET', 'CONTRACT', 'PLANNED')
  AND ((PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
          (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
           FROM PO_VERSIONS
           WHERE 1=1
             AND CO_CANCELED_FLAG = 'N'
             AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
             AND REJECTED_FLAG = 'N'
             AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                       LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
             AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                       LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
        AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) = 0)
       OR (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
           AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) <> 0))
  AND NVL(:P_COUNT, 'N') = 'N'
  AND
    (SELECT COUNT(PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM)
     FROM PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE PHI
     WHERE PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM = PHA.SEGMENT1
       AND PHI.PRC_BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
       AND PHI.PROCESS_CODE = 'IN PROCESS') = 0
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
    (SELECT PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
     FROM PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, HR_LOCATIONS HL
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
       AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
       AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y')
ORDER BY PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLA.PO_LINE_ID
```

SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 CONTRACTNUM, PLA.LINE_NUM CONTRACTLINENUM,

                                                                                                                                                                     AND GDR2.CONVERSION_TYPE = GDR.CONVERSION_TYPE
                                                                                                                                                                     AND trunc(GDR2.CONVERSION_DATE) <= trunc(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE))), 1) AS MAXVOL,

  (SELECT AT.NAME

                                                                                                                         CASE

                                                                                                                                             'Y')

                                                                                                                             ELSE 'oa_doc_no_revised'

                                                                                                                         NULL CONTRACTLINEID,
                                                                                                                              CASE

                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT

                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1) IN ('0003',
                                                                                                                                                                '0004',
                                                                                                                                                                '0005',
                                                                                                                                                                '0006',

                                                                                                                                  WHEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT SUBSTR(ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME,

                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,

                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT

                                                                                                                                            AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID

                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICT.ITEM_CLASS_ID

                                                                                                                                            AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA'

                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,
                                                                                                                                               INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC,
                                                                                                                                               EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT

                                                                                                                                            AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID

        EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL EICT
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+) = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID

     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'

     AND ecsvc.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID

     AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER

                                                                                                                                                                       NULL DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                            NULL REMARK_LONGDESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL NEWPRICE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE

                                                                                                                                                                                                    '*') = 'FINALLY CLOSED'

                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE

                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 '*') = 'R'
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'Y') = 'Y' THEN 'APPR'
                                                                                                                                                                                      END STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                      TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') STATUSDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN PHA.END_DATE IS NOT NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND (PHA.END_DATE < NVL(PHA.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                     SYSDATE)) THEN TO_CHAR(PHA.END_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(PHA.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE),

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                                                                                      END STARTDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                                                                               (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
                                                                                                                                                                                                FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU,

                                                                                                                                                                                             PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA,
                                                                                                                                                                                             HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
                                                                                                                                                                                             HR_LOCATIONS HL
                                                                                                                                                                                                WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                  AND ROWNUM = 1), 1,

                                                                                                                                                                                          6) || '-' || PSUP.SEGMENT1 || '-' || SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '-') - 1) VENDOR,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
