```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE PSUP.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                                                                                                      END VENDORCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                      SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                        1,
                                                                                                                                                                                        INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                          '-') - 1) VENDORSITECODE,

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF,
        POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,
        HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID
     AND PSAAM.BU_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
     AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
     AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
     AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) VENDORMIGOU,
                                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                                                                                               AND
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND ROWNUM = 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                      END EBSMIGRATIONFLAG,
                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL COMMODITY,
                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL COMMODITYGROUP,

  (SELECT REVISON
   FROM
     (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM, '', 0, CO_NUM) REVISON
      FROM PO_VERSIONS
      WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
      ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) REVISIONNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL REVSTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     DECODE(PLA.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       0) CHGQTYONUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     DECODE(PLA.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       1) CHGPRICEONUSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL LEADTIME,
                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL HASPAYMENTSCHED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL POREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL LEASEENDVALUE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL LANGCODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              HAOU.NAME CLIA_ORG,

  (SELECT MSIT.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL MSIT, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS MP
   WHERE MSIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND MSIT.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND MP.ORGANIZATION_ID = MP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND LANGUAGE = 'US'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) CL_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PLA.NOTE_TO_VENDOR CL_DESCRIPTION_LD,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' DESCRIPTION_LD2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'BASE-UNP' OOG_SITEID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'BASE-UNP' AUTHSITEID, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   WHEN TRUNC(PHA.APPROVED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               END VALIDA_DATA_APROVACAO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ORDER BY pha.po_header_id,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PLA.PO_LINE_ID) AS LINE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               COUNT(1) OVER() AS total,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               PLA.ITEM_ID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               PHA.VENDOR_ID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               PHA.PRC_BU_ID BU_ID
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI,
     PO_LINE_TYPES_VL PLTV, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, POZ_SUPPLIERS PSUP,
     POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM
WHERE HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.VENDOR_ID = PSUP.VENDOR_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLA.LINE_TYPE_ID = PLTV.LINE_TYPE_ID(+)
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('BLANKET', 'CONTRACT', 'PLANNED')
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN','INCOMPLETE')
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = :P_PO_HEADER_ID
  AND
    (SELECT COUNT(PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM)
     FROM PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE PHI
     WHERE PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM = PHA.SEGMENT1
       AND PHI.PRC_BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
       AND PHI.PROCESS_CODE = 'IN PROCESS') = 0
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
    (SELECT PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
     FROM PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, HR_LOCATIONS HL
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
       AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
       AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y')
ORDER BY PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLA.PO_LINE_ID
```

### Query #24

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AP_TERMS, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, ORACLE, PO_VERSIONS, PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES, HR_LOCATIONS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 "PONUM",
                NVL(PHA.COMMENTS, 'Purchase Order from Oracle Financials') "PODESCRIPTION", 'MAXADMIN' "PURCHASEAGENT",
                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.FIRM_DATE,

                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "ORDERDATE",
                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.FIRM_DATE,

                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "REQUIREDDATE",
                                                                                                       NULL "FOLLOWUPDATE",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN
                                                                                                                       (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                                                                                                        FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
                                                                                                                        WHERE PRLA.SOURCE_DOC_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID) > 0 THEN 'RELEASE'
                                                                                                                WHEN PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD' THEN 'STD'
                                                                                                            END "POTYPE",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN
                                                                                                                       (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                                                                                                        FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
                                                                                                                        WHERE PRLA.SOURCE_DOC_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID) > 0 THEN PHA.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                                ELSE ''
                                                                                                            END "ORIGINALPONUM",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                       '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CAN'
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                       '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'APPR'
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                       '*') = 'R'
                                                                                                                     AND PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN NULL
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                       'Y') = 'Y' THEN 'APPR'
                                                                                                            END STATUS,
                                                                                                            TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "STATUSDATE",
                                                                                                            SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
                                                                                                                      FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                                                                                                                      WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID), 1,

                                                                                                                6) || '-' || PSUP.SEGMENT1 || '-' || SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                       1,
                                                                                                                                                       INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                         '-')-1) VENDOR,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                         (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                                                                          FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                                                                          WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                            AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1), PSUP.SEGMENT1)
                                                                                                                ELSE PSUP.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                            END VENDORCODE,
                                                                                                            SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                              1,
                                                                                                              INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                '-')-1) VENDORSITECODE,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                     AND
                                                                                                                       (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                        FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                        WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                          AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                            END EBSMIGRATIONFLAG,
                                                                                                            'MAXADMIN' CONTACT,
                                                                                                                       PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE FREIGHTTERMS,

  (SELECT AT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS AT
   WHERE AT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,
                                                                                                                       UPPER(PSSAM.SHIP_VIA_LOOKUP_CODE) SHIPVIA,
                                                                                                                       PHA.VENDOR_ORDER_NUM "CUSTOMERNUM",
                                                                                                                       PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE "FOB",

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = nvl(PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID,
                                (SELECT PLLA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
                                 FROM FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
                                 WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                   AND rownum = 1))) "SHIPTO",
                                                                                                                       'MAXADMIN' "SHIPTOATTN",

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = PHA.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID) "BILLTO",
                                                                                                                                  NULL BILLTOATTN,
                                                                                                                                       NULL TOTALCOST,
                                                                                                                                            'MAXADMIN' "CHANGEBY",
                                                                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "CHANGEDATE",
                                                                                                                                                       '0' "PRIORITY",
                                                                                                                                                           NULL "HISTORYFLAG",
                                                                                                                                                                NULL "VENDELIVERYDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "RECEIPTS",
                                                                                                                                                                          'USD' "CURRENCYCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                1 "EXCHANGERATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "EXCHANGEDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "BUYAHEAD",
                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "TOTALTAX1",
                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "TOTALTAX2",
                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "INCLUSIVE1",
                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "INCLUSIVE2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "INCLUSIVE3",
                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "INTERNAL",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "TOTALTAX4",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "TOTALTAX5",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "INCLUSIVE4",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "INCLUSIVE5",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "STARTDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "ENDDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "PAYONRECEIPT",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "BUYERCOMPANY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "EXCHANGERATE2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "MNETSENT",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "ECOMSTATUSDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "SOURCESYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'OA' "OWNERSYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "EXTERNALREFID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "SENDERSYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' "SITEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' "ORGID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "FREIGHTTERMS_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "RECEIVEDTOTALCOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "POTYPEMODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "TOTALBASECOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "PRETAXTOTAL",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "CONTRACTREFNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "POID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "CONTRACTREFID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "CONTRACTREFREV",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "CONTRELEASESEQ",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "STORELOC",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "STORELOCSITEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         WHEN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (SELECT PLLA.RECEIVING_ROUTING_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHERE PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   AND ROWNUM = 1) = 2 THEN '1'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         ELSE '0'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     END "INSPECTIONREQUIRED",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "NP_STATUSMEMO",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "LANGCODE",

  (SELECT substr(REVISON, 1, 1) REVISON
   FROM
     (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM, '', '0', CO_NUM) REVISON
      FROM PO_VERSIONS
      WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
      ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) REVISIONNUM,

  (SELECT substr(REVISON, 1, 1) REVISON
   FROM
     (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM, '', '0', CO_NUM) REVISON
      FROM PO_VERSIONS
      WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
      ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) PO_REVISIONNUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   WHEN PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN 'oa_docrevised'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   ELSE NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               END "REVCOMMENTS", ROWNUM "TRANSSEQ",

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF,
        POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM
   WHERE HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID
     AND PSAAM.BU_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID) VENDORMIGOU,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             WHEN TRUNC(PHA.APPROVED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         END VALIDA_DATA_APROVACAO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         PHA.VENDOR_ID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         PHA.PRC_BU_ID BU_ID
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, POZ_SUPPLIERS PSUP, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
         (SELECT PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
          WHERE PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
            AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
            AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
          UNION SELECT PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
            AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = TO_NUMBER(PLA.ATTRIBUTE5)
            AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
            AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'))
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('STANDARD')
  AND PHA.VENDOR_ID = PSUP.VENDOR_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
  AND PHA.STYLE_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT PDSH.STYLE_ID
     FROM PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS PDSH
     WHERE UPPER(PDSH.STYLE_NAME) = 'ORDEM COMPRA - NACIONALIZAÇÃO')
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN','INCOMPLETE', 'PENDING APPROVAL', 'REJECTED')
```
