### Query #25

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, AP_TAX_CODES, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, HR_LOCATIONS, PO_HEADERS_ALL, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT PLA.po_header_id, PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.segment1 "PONUM",

  (SELECT MSIB.item_number
   FROM egp_system_items_b MSIB, inv_org_parameters MP
   WHERE MSIB.inventory_item_id = PLA.item_id
     AND MSIB.organization_id = MP.organization_id
     AND MP.organization_id = MP.master_organization_id) "ITEMNUM", NULL "STORELOC",
                                                                         SUBSTR(PLA.vendor_product_num,
                                                                           1, 50) "MODELNUM", NULL "CATALOGCODE",
                                                                                                   CASE
                                                                                                       WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code IN ('FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                           'RATE') THEN NULL
                                                                                                       ELSE PDA.quantity_ordered - Nvl(PDA.quantity_cancelled,

                                                                                                                                     0)
                                                                                                   END "ORDERQTY",

  (SELECT IUOM.UNIT_OF_MEASURE
   FROM INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE IUOM, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE IUOM.UOM_CODE = ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "ORDERUNIT",
                                                                                                   CASE
                                                                                                       WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code IN ('FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                           'RATE') THEN 0
                                                                                                       ELSE CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN PHA.currency_code <> 'USD' THEN ROUND(GL_CURRENCY_API.CONVERT_CLOSEST_AMOUNT_SQL(PHA.CURRENCY_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                             'USD',
                                                                                                                                                                             TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),
                                                                                                                                                                             'Corporate',
                                                                                                                                                                             NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                             NVL(PLA.UNIT_PRICE,

                                                                                                                                                                               0),
                                                                                                                                                                             365),

                                                                                                                                                       4)
                                                                                                                ELSE NVL(PLA.UNIT_PRICE,

                                                                                                                       0)
                                                                                                            END
                                                                                                   END "UNITCOST",
                                                                                                   PDA.quantity_delivered "RECEIVEDQTY",
                                                                                                   NULL "RECEIVEDUNITCOST",
                                                                                                        NULL "RECEIVEDTOTALCOST",
                                                                                                             NULL "REJECTEDQTY",
                                                                                                                  To_char(PLLA.firm_date,

                                                                                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "VENDELIVERYDATE",
                                                                                                                  NULL "SUPERVISOR",
                                                                                                                       To_char(PLA.last_update_date,

                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "ENTERDATE",
                                                                                                                       'MAXADMIN' "ENTERBY",
                                                                                                                                  '' "DESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                     NULL "REQUESTEDBY",
                                                                                                                                          CASE
                                                                                                                                              WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code = 'FIXED PRICE' THEN Decode(Trim(Upper(PLA.purchase_basis)),

                                                                                                                                                                                                     'TEMP LABOR',
                                                                                                                                                                                                     To_char(PLA.start_date,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS'),
                                                                                                                                                                                                     To_char(PLLA.need_by_date,

                                                                                                                                                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS'))
                                                                                                                                              WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code = 'RATE' THEN To_char(PLA.start_date,

                                                                                                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS')
                                                                                                                                          END "REQDELIVERYDATE",
                                                                                                                                          NULL "ISSUE",
                                                                                                                                               '1' || LTRIM(TO_CHAR(PLA.line_num,

                                                                                                                                                              '0999')) || LTRIM(TO_CHAR(PLLA.shipment_num,

                                                                                                                                                                                  '0999')) || LTRIM(TO_CHAR(PDA.DISTRIBUTION_NUM,

                                                                                                                                                                                                      '0999')) "POLINENUM",
                                                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                                                   WHEN PLLA.taxable_flag = 'Y' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                   ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                               END "TAXED",
                                                                                                                                               NULL "ASSETNUM",
                                                                                                                                                    NULL "CHARGESTORE",

  (SELECT GCC.segment1 || '.' || GCC.segment2 || '.' || GCC.segment3
   FROM gl_code_combinations GCC
   WHERE GCC.code_combination_id = PDA.code_combination_id) "GLDEBITACCT_SEGMENT1",

  (SELECT GCC.segment4
   FROM gl_code_combinations GCC
   WHERE GCC.code_combination_id = PDA.code_combination_id) "GLDEBITACCT_SEGMENT2",

  (SELECT GCC.segment5
   FROM gl_code_combinations GCC
   WHERE GCC.code_combination_id = PDA.code_combination_id) "GLDEBITACCT_SEGMENT3",

  (SELECT GCC.segment6 || '.' || GCC.segment7 || '.' || GCC.segment8
   FROM gl_code_combinations GCC
   WHERE GCC.code_combination_id = PDA.code_combination_id) "GLDEBITACCT_SEGMENT4",

  (SELECT GCC.segment9
   FROM gl_code_combinations GCC
   WHERE GCC.code_combination_id = PDA.code_combination_id) "GLDEBITACCT_SEGMENT5",
                                                                                                                                                         '' "GLCREDITACCT",
                                                                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                                                                WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code IN ('FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                    'RATE') THEN CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     WHEN PHA.currency_code <> 'USD' THEN ROUND(GL_CURRENCY_API.CONVERT_CLOSEST_AMOUNT_SQL(PHA.CURRENCY_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'USD',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Corporate',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NVL(PLA.AMOUNT,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    0),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  365),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            4)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     ELSE NVL(PLA.amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 END
                                                                                                                                                                ELSE (PDA.quantity_ordered - Nvl(PDA.quantity_cancelled,

                                                                                                                                                                                               0)) * (CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN PHA.currency_code <> 'USD' THEN ROUND(GL_CURRENCY_API.CONVERT_CLOSEST_AMOUNT_SQL(PHA.CURRENCY_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'USD',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'Corporate',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NVL(PLA.UNIT_PRICE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         0),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       365),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 4)
                                                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE NVL(PLA.unit_price,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                 0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                      END)
                                                                                                                                                            END "LINECOST",

  (SELECT ATC.name
   FROM ap_tax_codes ATC
   WHERE ATC.tax_id = PLLA.tax_code_id) "TAX1CODE",
                                                                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                                                                WHEN PHA.currency_code <> 'USD' THEN ROUND(GL_CURRENCY_API.CONVERT_CLOSEST_AMOUNT_SQL(PHA.CURRENCY_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                             'USD',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             TRUNC(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             'Corporate',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NVL(PLLA.estimated_tax_amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                               0),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             365),

                                                                                                                                                                                                       4)
                                                                                                                                                                ELSE NVL(PLLA.estimated_tax_amount,

                                                                                                                                                                       0)
                                                                                                                                                            END "TAX1",
                                                                                                                                                            NULL "TAX2CODE",
                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "TAX2",
                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "TAX3CODE",
                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "TAX3",
                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "RECEIPTREQD",
                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "MANUFACTURER",
                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "TAX4CODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "TAX4",
                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "TAX5CODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "TAX5",
                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "CATEGORY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "REMARK",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "LOCATION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "LOADEDCOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "PRORATESERVICE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "RECEIPTSCOMPLETE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "INSPECTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "REQUIRED",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "PRORATECOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "POLINEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "LINECOST2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "MRNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "MRLINENUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "PCARDNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "PCARDTYPE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "PCARDEXPDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "FINCNTRLID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "PCARDVERIFICATION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "VENDORPACKCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "VENDORPACK",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "QUANTITY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "VENDORWAREHOUSE",

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
   WHERE GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA
        WHERE PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "SITEID",

  (SELECT HOP.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOP
   WHERE HOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID) "ORGID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "ISDISTRIBUTED",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "REFWO",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "ENTEREDASTASK",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code IN ('FIXED PRICE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   'RATE',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   'AMOUNT') THEN 'SERVICE'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ELSE CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WHEN PLA.order_type_lookup_code = 'QUANTITY' THEN CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              WHEN (
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (SELECT DISTINCT MSIB.item_number
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       FROM egp_system_items_b MSIB,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            inv_org_parameters MP
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       WHERE MSIB.inventory_item_id = PLA.item_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         AND MSIB.organization_id = MP.organization_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         AND MP.organization_id = MP.master_organization_id)) IS NOT NULL THEN 'ITEM'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ELSE 'SERIVCE'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          END
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    END
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           END "LINETYPE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "ITEMSETID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "REMARK_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "UNINVOICEDCOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "UNINVOICEDQUANTITY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "TASKID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "WONUM",

  (SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4
   FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRDA.DISTRIBUTION_ID = PDA.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID
     AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PRLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.PRC_BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
     AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'
     AND ROWNUM = 1
   UNION SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4
   FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = TO_NUMBER(PLA.ATTRIBUTE5)
     AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL
     AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "PRLINENUM",

  (SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1
   FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRDA.DISTRIBUTION_ID = PDA.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID
     AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PRLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.PRC_BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
     AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'
     AND ROWNUM = 1
   UNION SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1
   FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = TO_NUMBER(PLA.ATTRIBUTE5)
     AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL
     AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "PRNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              100 "PERCENTAGE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "AMOUNTTORECEIVE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "RECEIVEDLINECOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "QTYTORECEIVE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "CONDITIONCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "CONTRACTREFNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "COMMODITYGROUP",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "COMMODITY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "CONTRACTREFID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "CONTRACTREFREV",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "SCHEDULEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "FCPROJECTID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "FCTASKID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "CONTREFLINEID",

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
   WHERE GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA
        WHERE PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) "TOSITEID",

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM hr_locations HL
   WHERE HL.location_id = PHA.ship_to_location_id) "SHIPTO",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'MAXADMIN' "SHIPTOATTN",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "LANGCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "INTRANSITQTY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "CONVERSION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             WHEN PLLA.qty_rcv_exception_code = 'REJECT' THEN Nvl(PLLA.qty_rcv_tolerance,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         END "RECEIPTTOLERANCE", ROWNUM "TRANSEQ",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            WHEN PLLA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (SELECT LOCATION_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    FROM HR_LOCATIONS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    WHERE LOCATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        END POL_SHIPTO,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '1' OA_RATELINE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1 COSTLINENUM,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'USD' AS OOG_CURRENCY_CODE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL OOG_OTHERCOSTS,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 SUBSTR(PHA.NOTE_TO_VENDOR,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   480) OOG_REMARKS_VENDOR,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 SUBSTR(PLA.NOTE_TO_VENDOR,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   480) POL_OOG_REMARKS_VENDOR,

  (SELECT SEGMENT5
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID) AS POLINE_OOG_UA,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN '1'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 END STATUSIFACE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 PLA.item_id
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA,
     PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
         (SELECT PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
          WHERE PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
            AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
            AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
          UNION SELECT PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
            AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = TO_NUMBER(PLA.ATTRIBUTE5)
            AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'))
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PDA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN','INCOMPLETE','PENDING APPROVAL', 'REJECTED')
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('STANDARD')
  AND PLA.item_id <> 300000651593449
```
