```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 "PONUM",
                NVL(PHA.COMMENTS, 'Purchase Order from Oracle Financials') "PODESCRIPTION", 'MAXADMIN' "PURCHASEAGENT",
                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.FIRM_DATE,

                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "ORDERDATE",
                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.FIRM_DATE,

                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "REQUIREDDATE",
                                                                                                       NULL "FOLLOWUPDATE",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN
                                                                                                                       (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                                                                                                        FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
                                                                                                                        WHERE PRLA.SOURCE_DOC_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID) > 0 THEN 'RELEASE'
                                                                                                                WHEN PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD' THEN 'STD'
                                                                                                            END "POTYPE",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN
                                                                                                                       (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                                                                                                        FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
                                                                                                                        WHERE PRLA.SOURCE_DOC_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID) > 0 THEN PHA.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                                ELSE ''
                                                                                                            END "ORIGINALPONUM",
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                       '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CAN'
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,

                                                                                                                       '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'CLOSE'
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                       '*') = 'R'
                                                                                                                     AND PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN NULL
                                                                                                                WHEN NVL(PHA.APPROVED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                       'Y') = 'Y' THEN 'APPR'
                                                                                                            END STATUS,
                                                                                                            TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "STATUSDATE",
                                                                                                            SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                     (SELECT TRIM(HOU.NAME)
                                                                                                                      FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                                                                                                                      WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID), 1,

                                                                                                                6) || '-' || PSUP.SEGMENT1 || '-' || SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                       1,
                                                                                                                                                       INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                                                         '-')-1) VENDOR,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                         (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                                                                          FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                                                                          WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                            AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1), PSUP.SEGMENT1)
                                                                                                                ELSE PSUP.SEGMENT1
                                                                                                            END VENDORCODE,
                                                                                                            SUBSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                              1,
                                                                                                              INSTR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE,

                                                                                                                '-')-1) VENDORSITECODE,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN UPPER(PSSAM.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                     AND
                                                                                                                       (SELECT HAPN.PARTY_NAME
                                                                                                                        FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN
                                                                                                                        WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = PSUP.PARTY_ID
                                                                                                                          AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
                                                                                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                            END EBSMIGRATIONFLAG,
                                                                                                            'MAXADMIN' CONTACT,
                                                                                                                       PHA.FREIGHT_TERMS_LOOKUP_CODE FREIGHTTERMS,

  (SELECT AT.NAME
   FROM AP_TERMS AT
   WHERE AT.TERM_ID = PHA.TERMS_ID) PAYMENTTERMS,
                                                                                                                       UPPER(PSSAM.SHIP_VIA_LOOKUP_CODE) SHIPVIA,
                                                                                                                       PHA.VENDOR_ORDER_NUM "CUSTOMERNUM",
                                                                                                                       PHA.FOB_LOOKUP_CODE "FOB",

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID) "SHIPTO",
                                                                                                                       'MAXADMIN' "SHIPTOATTN",

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL
   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = PHA.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID) "BILLTO",
                                                                                                                                  NULL BILLTOATTN,
                                                                                                                                       NULL TOTALCOST,
                                                                                                                                            'MAXADMIN' "CHANGEBY",
                                                                                                                                                       TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "CHANGEDATE",
                                                                                                                                                       '0' "PRIORITY",
                                                                                                                                                           NULL "HISTORYFLAG",
                                                                                                                                                                NULL "VENDELIVERYDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "RECEIPTS",
                                                                                                                                                                          'USD' "CURRENCYCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                1 "EXCHANGERATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                TO_CHAR(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "EXCHANGEDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "BUYAHEAD",
                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "TOTALTAX1",
                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "TOTALTAX2",
                                                                                                                                                                                               NULL "INCLUSIVE1",
                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "INCLUSIVE2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "INCLUSIVE3",
                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "INTERNAL",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "TOTALTAX4",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "TOTALTAX5",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "INCLUSIVE4",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "INCLUSIVE5",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "STARTDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "ENDDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "PAYONRECEIPT",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "BUYERCOMPANY",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "EXCHANGERATE2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "MNETSENT",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "ECOMSTATUSDATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "SOURCESYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'OA' "OWNERSYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "EXTERNALREFID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "SENDERSYSID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '' "SITEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '' "ORGID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NULL "DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NULL "FREIGHTTERMS_LONGDESCRIPTION",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NULL "RECEIVEDTOTALCOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NULL "POTYPEMODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NULL "TOTALBASECOST",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NULL "PRETAXTOTAL",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NULL "CONTRACTREFNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NULL "POID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NULL "CONTRACTREFID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NULL "CONTRACTREFREV",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NULL "CONTRELEASESEQ",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NULL "STORELOC",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NULL "STORELOCSITEID",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         WHEN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (SELECT PLLA.RECEIVING_ROUTING_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHERE PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   AND ROWNUM = 1) = 2 THEN '1'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         ELSE '0'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     END "INSPECTIONREQUIRED",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NULL "NP_STATUSMEMO",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NULL "LANGCODE",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NVL(PHA.REVISION_NUM,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 0) "REVISIONNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NVL(PHA.REVISION_NUM,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 0) "PO_REVISIONNUM",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   WHEN PHA.REVISION_NUM <> 0 THEN 'oa_docrevised'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   ELSE NULL
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               END "REVCOMMENTS", ROWNUM "TRANSSEQ",

  (SELECT GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOIF,
        POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M PSAAM
   WHERE HOIF.ORGANIZATION_ID = PSAAM.BU_ID
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION3 = TO_CHAR(GL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND HOIF.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
     AND GCC.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID = GL.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
     AND PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PSAAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID
     AND PSAAM.BU_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID
     AND GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = PSAAM.ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID) VENDORMIGOU
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, POZ_SUPPLIERS PSUP, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND ((PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
          (SELECT PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
           FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA
           WHERE 1 = 1
             AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL))
       OR (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
             (SELECT PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID
              FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
              WHERE PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
                AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO')))
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('STANDARD')
  AND PHA.VENDOR_ID = PSUP.VENDOR_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = :P_ID
  AND PHA.STYLE_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT PDSH.STYLE_ID
     FROM PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS PDSH
     WHERE UPPER(PDSH.STYLE_NAME) = 'ORDEM COMPRA - NACIONALIZAÇÃO')
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN','INCOMPLETE')
```

```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN '1'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 END STATUSIFACE
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA,
     PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
         (SELECT PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
          WHERE PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
            AND PRLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
            AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'))
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PDA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN','INCOMPLETE')
```

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, HZ_PARTIES, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, AP_INVOICES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT cfd.document_number numeronf ,cfd.issue_date data_emissao ,cfd.document_status status_nf ,
       cfd.invoice_num invoice_entrada ,hp.party_name nome_fornecedor ,cfdl.document_line_id ,
       cfdl.efd_item_description descricao_item ,cfdl.fd_quantity quantidade ,
       cfdl.fd_price valor_unitario ,cfdl.fd_amount valor_linha ,

  (SELECT gcc.Segment1 || '-' || gcc.Segment2 || '-' || gcc.Segment3 || '-' || gcc.Segment4 || '-' || gcc.Segment5 || '-' || gcc.Segment6 || '-' || gcc.Segment7 || '-' || gcc.Segment8 AS Dist_Combination
   FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia , AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aida , GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS gcc
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND aia.Invoice_Num = cfd.invoice_num
     AND aida.Invoice_Id = aia.Invoice_Id
     AND aida.Line_Type_Lookup_Code = 'ACCRUAL'
     AND gcc.Code_Combination_Id = aida.Dist_Code_Combination_Id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) Dist_Combination
FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_headers cfd ,cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdl ,cmf_fiscal_doc_schedules cmds ,
     hz_parties hp ,egp_system_items_b msib
WHERE cfd.document_header_id = cfdl.document_header_id
  AND cmds.fiscal_doc_header_id = cfd.document_header_id
  AND cfd.document_number = :pNFOriginal
  AND cfd.document_status = 'CAPTURED'
  AND cfd.shipfrom_party_id = hp.party_id
  AND msib.inventory_item_id = cfdl.item_id
  AND msib.organization_id =
    (SELECT inv.organization_id
     FROM hr_all_organization_units haou ,inv_org_parameters inv
     WHERE haou.name = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE'
       AND haou.organization_id = inv.organization_id)
```

### Query #29

### Query #29

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, AP_HOLDS_ALL, CORRETO`

```sql
SELECT SUP.VENDOR_ID, aia.APPROVAL_STATUS, aia.invoice_id AS InvoiceId,
       apsa.payment_num AS PaymentNum, aia.invoice_num AS InvoiceNumber,
       aia.invoice_date AS InvoiceDate, apsa.due_date AS DueDate,
       apsa.gross_amount AS GrossAmount, apsa.amount_remaining AS AmountRemaining,
       aia.invoice_currency_code AS Currency, fabu.bu_name AS BusinessUnit,
       xep.name AS LegalEntityName, xr.registration_number AS LegalEntityRegistrationNumber,
       hl.address1 || ', ' || hl.city || ', ' || hl.state AS LegalEntityAddress, hl.postal_code AS LegalEntityPostalCode,
       hp.party_name AS SupplierName, hps_sup.party_site_name AS SupplierSiteName,
       NVL(zr.registration_number, 'N/A') AS SupplierRegistrationNumber, NVL(aia.attribute1,
                                                                           'N/A') AS FiscalDocumentAccessKey,
       aia.last_update_date AS LastUpdateDate, aia.payment_status_flag AS PaymentStatus,
       aia.cancelled_date AS CancelledDate,
       CASE
           WHEN EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM ap_holds_all h
                   WHERE h.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS HasHold,
       CASE
           WHEN :P_VALOR_NEGOCIADO > NVL(apsa.amount_remaining,
                                       0) THEN 'VALOR_MAIOR_QUE_SALDO' ELSE 'OK'
       END AS ValorValidation,
       CASE WHEN aia.cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN aia.payment_status_flag = 'Y' THEN 'PAID'
           WHEN EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM ap_holds_all h
                   WHERE h.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id) THEN 'ON_HOLD' WHEN NVL(apsa.amount_remaining,
                                                                              0) <= 0 THEN 'NO_OPEN_BALANCE'
           WHEN :P_VALOR_NEGOCIADO > NVL(apsa.amount_remaining,
                                       0) THEN 'INVALID_AMOUNT' ELSE 'VALID'
       END AS ValidationStatus,
       CASE
           WHEN aia.cancelled_date IS NOT NULL
                OR aia.payment_status_flag = 'Y'
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM ap_holds_all h
                   WHERE h.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id)
                OR NVL(apsa.amount_remaining, 0) <= 0
                OR :P_VALOR_NEGOCIADO > NVL(apsa.amount_remaining,
                                          0) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y'
       END AS IS_VALID, ieba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS conta_bancaria
FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_payment_schedules_all apsa, fun_all_business_units_v fabu,
     xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_registrations xr, hz_parties hp_le, hz_party_sites hps_le,
     hz_locations hl, poz_suppliers sup, poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa, hz_party_sites hps_sup,
     hz_parties hp, zx_party_tax_profile tp, zx_registrations zr, iby_ext_bank_accounts ieba
WHERE apsa.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id
  AND aia.org_id = fabu.bu_id
  AND ieba.ext_bank_account_id(+) = apsa.external_bank_account_id
  AND fabu.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
  AND xr.source_id = xep.legal_entity_id
  AND xr.identifying_flag = 'Y'
  AND xep.party_id = hp_le.party_id
  AND hp_le.party_id = hps_le.party_id
  AND hps_le.location_id = hl.location_id
  AND aia.vendor_id = sup.vendor_id
  AND sup.party_id = hp.party_id
  AND sup.attribute1 = 'Y'
  AND aia.vendor_site_id = pssa.vendor_site_id
  AND pssa.party_site_id = hps_sup.party_site_id
  AND hp.party_id = tp.party_id(+)
  AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id(+)
  AND NVL(apsa.amount_remaining, 0) > 0
  AND fabu.bu_name = NVL(:P_BU, fabu.bu_name)
  AND apsa.amount_remaining >= NVL(:P_MIN_AMOUNT_REMAINING,
                                 apsa.amount_remaining)
  AND UPPER(hp.party_name) = UPPER(NVL(:P_SUPPLIER,
                                     hp.party_name))
  AND aia.invoice_id = NVL(:P_INVOICE_ID, aia.invoice_id)
  AND TRUNC(apsa.due_date) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE(:P_MIN_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                      'YYYY-MM-DD'))
  AND TRUNC(apsa.due_date) <= TRUNC(TO_DATE(:P_MIN_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                      'YYYY-MM-DD')) + TO_NUMBER(NVL(:P_DUE_DATE,
                                                                   0))
  AND apsa.payment_num = NVL(:P_PAYMENT_NUM, apsa.payment_num)
  AND aia.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
ORDER BY InvoiceNumber, PaymentNum
```

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

```sql
SELECT hps_cred.party_site_id, aia.invoice_id, aia.invoice_num,
       hp.party_name AS fornecedor_original, bu.bu_name AS business_unit, hp_cred.party_name AS destino,
       eba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS conta_bancaria, eba.bank_account_name AS nome_conta, eba.bank_branch_name AS agencia,
       eba.bank_name AS banco, hps_cred.party_site_name AS address
FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_payment_schedules_all apsa, iby_ext_bank_accounts ieba, poz_suppliers sup,
     poz_supplier_sites_all_m site, fun_all_business_units_v bu, hz_parties hp, hz_parties hp_cred,
     hz_party_sites hps_cred, poz_sup_thirdparty_payment_rel ptp, iby_external_payees_all epa,
     iby_pmt_instr_uses_all piu, iby_ext_bank_accounts eba
WHERE apsa.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id
  AND ieba.ext_bank_account_id(+) = apsa.external_bank_account_id
  AND aia.vendor_id = sup.vendor_id
  AND sup.party_id = hp.party_id
  AND aia.vendor_site_id = site.vendor_site_id
  AND ptp.vendor_site_id = site.vendor_site_id
  AND ptp.remit_to_supplier_id = hp_cred.party_id
  AND ptp.remit_to_address_id = hps_cred.party_site_id
  AND aia.org_id = bu.bu_id
  AND hps_cred.party_site_id = epa.party_site_id
  AND epa.ext_payee_id = piu.ext_pmt_party_id
  AND piu.instrument_id = eba.ext_bank_account_id
  AND piu.instrument_type = 'BANKACCOUNT'
  AND piu.payment_flow = 'DISBURSEMENTS'
  AND piu.primary_flag = 'Y'
  AND epa.supplier_site_id IS NOT NULL
  AND hp_cred.party_name = 'CREDI PLUS SERVICOS FINANCEIROS LTDA'
```

### Query #32

### Query #32

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT aia.INVOICE_NUM AS NF, aia.INVOICE_ID,
                to_char(aia.INVOICE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') data_emissao_nf, aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT AS Valor_total_nota,
                to_char(ipa.PAYMENT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DT_PAGAMENTO,

  (SELECT MAX(apsa2.PAYMENT_NUM) par
   FROM ap_payment_schedules_all apsa2
   WHERE apsa2.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id) ultima_par,
                apsa.PAYMENT_NUM ||'/'||
  (SELECT MAX(apsa2.PAYMENT_NUM) par
   FROM ap_payment_schedules_all apsa2
   WHERE apsa2.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id) parcela, to_char(apsa.DUE_DATE,
                                                       'DD/MM/YYYY') AS data_ven,
                CASE
                    WHEN aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT <> 0 THEN ROUND((apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT * AIL.AMOUNT / aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT), 3) ELSE 0
                END AS valor_parcela,
                CASE
                    WHEN apsa.AMOUNT_REMAINING = 0
                         AND aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT <> 0 THEN ROUND((apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT * AIL.AMOUNT / aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT), 3) ELSE 0
                END AS Valor_pago, apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS JUROS,
                apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS MULTA, IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME AS TP_BAIXA,
                ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS cnpj, psv.VENDOR_NAME AS FORNCEDOR, XLE.NAME AS Bu,
                gcc.segment4||'-'||gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                                                       4, gcc.segment4) AS centro_de_desc,
                gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                                    2, gcc.segment2) filial, nvl(aca.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
                                                               aia.INVOICE_NUM) AS banco,
                aia.DESCRIPTION AS Descrição_Histórico, aid.DESCRIPTION item,
                gcc.segment1 || '.' || gcc.segment2 || '.' || gcc.segment3 || '.' || gcc.segment4 || '.' || gcc.segment5 || '.' || gcc.segment6 || '.' || gcc.segment7 || '.' || gcc.segment8 AS conta_contabil, AIL.AMOUNT
FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL AIL, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL apsa,
     AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aipa, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V psv, AP_CHECKS_ALL aca, IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL IPA,
     IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL ipm, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZTPF, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI,
     XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES xle, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
WHERE 1=1
  AND AIL.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'ITEM'
  AND aia.PARTY_ID = psv.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND aid.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('ITEM','ACCRUAL')
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = apsa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aipa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND AIA.INVOICE_ID = AIL.INVOICE_ID
  AND aipa.CHECK_ID = aca.CHECK_ID (+)
  AND apsa.PAYMENT_NUM = aipa.PAYMENT_NUM (+)
  AND ail.LINE_NUMBER = aid.INVOICE_LINE_NUMBER
  AND aca.PAYMENT_ID = IPA.PAYMENT_ID (+)
  AND ACA.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE = IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE (+)
  AND AIA.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_ID
  AND AIA.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID
  AND aid.DIST_CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
  AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
  AND ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM =
    (SELECT MAX(ZPTI2.EFFECTIVE_FROM)
     FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI2
     WHERE ZPTI2.ENTITY_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
       AND ZPTI2.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF'))
  AND ((:P_Dt_pagamento_de IS NOT NULL
        AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate IS NOT NULL
        AND (ipa.PAYMENT_DATE) BETWEEN (:P_Dt_pagamento_de) AND (:P_Dt_pagamento_ate))
       OR (:P_Dt_pagamento_de IS NULL
           AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate IS NULL
           AND (apsa.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN (:P_Dt_vencimento_de) AND (:P_Dt_vencimento_ate)))
  AND gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                          2, gcc.segment2) IN (:p_filial)
  AND XLE.NAME IN (:p_bu)
  AND gcc.segment4 IN (:p_centro_custo)
  AND (:p_cnpj IS NULL
       OR ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IN (:p_cnpj))
  AND (:p_fornecedor IS NULL
       OR ACA.VENDOR_NAME IN (:p_fornecedor))
```

### Query #34

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT aia.INVOICE_NUM AS NF, aia.INVOICE_ID,
                to_char(aia.INVOICE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') data_emissao_nf, pha.segment1 AS PO, apsa.PAYMENT_NUM AS Parcela,
                to_char(apsa.DUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS data_ven, aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT AS Valor_total_nota,
                apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT AS valor_parcela, aia.AMOUNT_PAID AS Valor_pago,
                to_char(ipa.PAYMENT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DT_PAGAMENTO, apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS JUROS,
                apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS MULTA, IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME AS TP_BAIXA,
                ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS cnpj, psv.VENDOR_NAME AS FORNCEDOR, XLE.NAME AS Bu,
                gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                                    2, gcc.segment2) AS filial_desc, aca.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS banco,
                aia.DESCRIPTION AS Descrição_Histórico
FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL AIL, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL apsa, PO_HEADERS_ALL pha,
     AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aipa, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V psv, AP_CHECKS_ALL aca, IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL IPA,
     IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL ipm, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZTPF, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI,
     XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES xle, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
WHERE 1=1
  AND AIL.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'ITEM'
  AND aia.PARTY_ID = psv.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND aid.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('ITEM','ACCRUAL')
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = apsa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aipa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND AIA.INVOICE_ID = AIL.INVOICE_ID
  AND AIL.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id (+)
  AND aipa.CHECK_ID = aca.CHECK_ID (+)
  AND aca.PAYMENT_ID = IPA.PAYMENT_ID (+)
  AND ACA.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE = IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE (+)
  AND AIA.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_ID
  AND AIA.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID
  AND aid.DIST_CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
  AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
  AND ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM =
    (SELECT MAX(ZPTI2.EFFECTIVE_FROM)
     FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI2
     WHERE ZPTI2.ENTITY_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
       AND ZPTI2.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF'))
  AND TRUNC(apsa.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN :P_Dt_vencimento_de AND :P_Dt_vencimento_ate
  AND TRUNC(ipa.PAYMENT_DATE) BETWEEN :P_Dt_pagamento_de AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate
  AND XLE.NAME IN (:p_bu)
  AND gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                          2, gcc.segment2) IN (:p_filial)
  AND (:p_cnpj IS NULL
       OR ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IN (:p_cnpj))
  AND (:p_fornecedor IS NULL
       OR psv.VENDOR_NAME IN (:p_fornecedor))
```

### Query #35

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, AP_CHECKS_ALL, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL, IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT aia.INVOICE_NUM AS NF, req_pers.DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUISITANTE,
                buyer_pers.DISPLAY_NAME AS COMPRADOR, rla.REQUESTER_ID AS AREA_REQUISITANTE,
                aia.INVOICE_DATE AS DATA_EMISSAO_NF, pha.segment1 AS PO, apsa.PAYMENT_NUM AS PARCELA,
                apsa.DUE_DATE AS DATA_VEN,
                REPLACE(TO_CHAR(aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT, 'FM99999990.00'), '.', ',') AS VALOR_TOTAL_NOTA,
                REPLACE(TO_CHAR(apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT, 'FM99999990.00'), '.', ',') AS VALOR_PARCELA,
                REPLACE(TO_CHAR(CASE
                                    WHEN apsa.AMOUNT_REMAINING = 0 THEN apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT ELSE 0
                                END, 'FM99999990.00'), '.', ',') AS VALOR_PAGO, ipa.PAYMENT_DATE AS DT_PAGAMENTO,
                apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS JUROS, apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS MULTA,
                ipm.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME AS TP_BAIXA, zpti.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS CNPJ, psv.VENDOR_NAME AS FORNECEDOR,
                prh.REQUISITION_NUMBER AS N_REQUISICAO,
                REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(prh.DESCRIPTION,
                                                 CHR(9), ' '),
                                         CHR(10), ' '),
                                 CHR(13), ' '), ' {2,}', ' ') AS DESCRICAO_REQUISICAO, prh.CREATION_DATE AS DT_CRIACAO_REQ,
                prh.APPROVED_DATE AS DT_APROVACAO_REQ, pha.CREATION_DATE AS DT_CRIACAO_PO,
                pha.APPROVED_DATE AS DT_APROVACAO_PO, rla.CATEGORY_ID AS CATEGORIA_MATERIAL,
                aia.INVOICE_RECEIVED_DATE AS DT_RECEBIMENTO_FISCAL, ail.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS DT_LAST_UPDATE,
                aia.GOODS_RECEIVED_DATE AS DT_REC_FISICO,
                gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                                    2, gcc.segment2) AS FILIAL_DESC, psv.VENDOR_ID AS ID_FORNEC,
                psv.VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS TIPO_FORNECEDOR, xle.NAME AS BU, psv.enabled_flag AS STATUS_FORNECEDOR,
                NVL(aca.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, aia.INVOICE_NUM) AS BANCO, aia.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRICAO_HISTORICO,
                req_pers.FULL_NAME AS APROVADOR
FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia
JOIN AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL ail ON aia.INVOICE_ID = ail.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL apsa ON aia.INVOICE_ID = apsa.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aipa ON aia.INVOICE_ID = aipa.INVOICE_ID
AND apsa.PAYMENT_NUM = aipa.PAYMENT_NUM
LEFT JOIN AP_CHECKS_ALL aca ON aipa.CHECK_ID = aca.CHECK_ID
LEFT JOIN IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL ipa ON aca.PAYMENT_ID = ipa.PAYMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL ipm ON aca.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE = ipm.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_V psv ON aia.PARTY_ID = psv.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ztpf ON aia.PARTY_SITE_ID = ztpf.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS zpti ON zpti.ENTITY_ID = ztpf.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL pha ON ail.PO_HEADER_ID = pha.PO_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL rla ON pha.PO_HEADER_ID = rla.PO_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL prh ON rla.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = prh.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES xle ON aia.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = xle.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
INNER JOIN AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid ON aia.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID
INNER JOIN GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS gcc ON aid.DIST_CODE_COMBINATION_ID = gcc.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F req_pers ON prh.PREPARER_ID = req_pers.PERSON_ID
AND req_pers.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND req_pers.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('4712-12-31',
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD')
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F buyer_pers ON pha.AGENT_ID = buyer_pers.PERSON_ID
AND buyer_pers.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND buyer_pers.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('4712-12-31',
                                      'YYYY-MM-DD')
WHERE 1=1
  AND ((:P_Dt_vencimento_de IS NULL
        OR :P_Dt_vencimento_ate IS NULL)
       OR (TRUNC(apsa.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN :P_Dt_vencimento_de AND :P_Dt_vencimento_ate))
  AND ((:P_Dt_pagamento_de IS NULL
        OR :P_Dt_pagamento_ate IS NULL)
       OR (TRUNC(ipa.PAYMENT_DATE) BETWEEN :P_Dt_pagamento_de AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate))
  AND ((:P_Dt_emissao_de IS NULL
        OR :P_Dt_emissao_ate IS NULL)
       OR (TRUNC(aia.INVOICE_DATE) BETWEEN :P_Dt_emissao_de AND :P_Dt_emissao_ate))
  AND (:p_bu IS NULL
       OR xle.NAME IN (:p_bu))
  AND gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                          2, gcc.segment2) IN (:p_filial)
  AND (:p_banco IS NULL
       OR aca.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME IN (:p_banco))
  AND (:p_requisitante IS NULL
       OR req_pers.DISPLAY_NAME IN (:p_requisitante))
```

### Query #37

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AP_INVOICES_ALL`

### Query #37

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT aia.INVOICE_NUM AS NF, aia.INVOICE_ID,
                to_char(aia.INVOICE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') data_emissao_nf, pha.segment1 AS PO, apsa.PAYMENT_NUM AS Parcela,
                to_char(apsa.DUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS data_ven, aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT AS Valor_total_nota,
                apsa.INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT AS valor_parcela,
                CASE WHEN apsa.AMOUNT_REMAINING = 0 THEN INV_CURR_GROSS_AMOUNT ELSE 0
                END AS Valor_pago, to_char(ipa.PAYMENT_DATE,
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DT_PAGAMENTO,
                apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS JUROS, apsa.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS MULTA,
                IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME AS TP_BAIXA, ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS cnpj, psv.VENDOR_NAME AS FORNCEDOR,
                XLE.NAME AS Bu,
                gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                                    2, gcc.segment2) AS filial_desc, nvl(aca.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,

                                                                       aia.INVOICE_NUM) AS banco,
                aia.DESCRIPTION AS Descrição_Histórico
FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL AIL, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL apsa, PO_HEADERS_ALL pha,
     AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aipa, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V psv, AP_CHECKS_ALL aca, IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL IPA,
     IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_TL ipm, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZTPF, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI,
     XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES xle, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
WHERE 1=1
  AND AIL.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'ITEM'
  AND aia.PARTY_ID = psv.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND aid.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('ITEM','ACCRUAL')
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = apsa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aipa.INVOICE_ID (+)
  AND AIA.INVOICE_ID = AIL.INVOICE_ID
  AND AIL.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id (+)
  AND aipa.CHECK_ID = aca.CHECK_ID (+)
  AND apsa.PAYMENT_NUM = aipa.PAYMENT_NUM (+)
  AND aca.PAYMENT_ID = IPA.PAYMENT_ID (+)
  AND ACA.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE = IPM.PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE (+)
  AND AIA.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_ID
  AND AIA.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND aia.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID
  AND aid.DIST_CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZTPF.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
  AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
  AND ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM =
    (SELECT MAX(ZPTI2.EFFECTIVE_FROM)
     FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI2
     WHERE ZPTI2.ENTITY_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
       AND ZPTI2.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF'))
  AND ((:P_Dt_pagamento_de IS NOT NULL
        AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate IS NOT NULL
        AND ipa.PAYMENT_DATE BETWEEN :P_Dt_pagamento_de AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate)
       OR (:P_Dt_pagamento_de IS NULL
           AND :P_Dt_pagamento_ate IS NULL
           AND apsa.DUE_DATE BETWEEN :P_Dt_vencimento_de AND :P_Dt_vencimento_ate))
  AND XLE.NAME IN (:p_bu)
  AND gl_flexfields_pkg.get_description_sql(gcc.chart_of_accounts_id,
                          2, gcc.segment2) IN (:p_filial)
  AND (:p_cnpj IS NULL
       OR ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IN (:p_cnpj))
  AND (:p_fornecedor IS NULL
       OR psv.VENDOR_NAME IN (:p_fornecedor))
```

### Query #39

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B_V, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL, AP_INVOICES_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, PO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_LOCATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M...`

### Query #39

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PO_LINES_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B_V, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pha.segment1, pha.vendor_site_id, psites.vendor_site_code AS PARTY_SITE_NAME,
                CASE
                    WHEN ROUND(SUM(pla.LIST_PRICE * pla.quantity - aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT), 2) > 0 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE'
                END AS regra,

  (SELECT NVL(SUM(pre.invoice_amount), 0)
   FROM ap_invoices_all pre
   WHERE pre.invoice_type_lookup_code = 'PREPAYMENT'
     AND pre.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id) NFF_prepayment,

  (SELECT SUM(pol.unit_price * pol.quantity)
   FROM po_lines_all pol
   WHERE pol.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id) AS valor_total_po2, SUM(aia.INVOICE_AMOUNT) AS valor_total_nffs,
                CAST(ROUND((
                              (SELECT SUM(pol2.unit_price * pol2.quantity)
                               FROM po_lines_all pol2
                               WHERE pol2.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id) - NVL(
                                                                                   (SELECT SUM(pre.invoice_amount)
                                                                                    FROM ap_invoices_all pre,

                                                                                  ap_invoice_lines_all ail
                                                                                    WHERE pre.invoice_id = ail.invoice_id (+)
                                                                                      AND ail.line_type_lookup_code <> 'PREPAY'
                                                                                      AND PRE.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id),0) - nvl(
                                                                                                                                          (SELECT SUM(AIP.AMOUNT)
                                                                                                                                           FROM ap_invoices_all pre,

                                                                                                                                         ap_invoice_lines_all ail,
                                                                                                                                         AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aip
                                                                                                                                           WHERE pre.invoice_id = ail.invoice_id (+)
                                                                                                                                             AND ail.line_type_lookup_code <> 'PREPAY'
                                                                                                                                             AND ail.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
                                                                                                                                             AND pre.invoice_id = aip.invoice_id),0) - nvl(
                                                                                                                                                                                             (SELECT SUM(pre.INVOICE_AMOUNT)
                                                                                                                                                                                              FROM ap_invoices_all pre,

                                                                                                                                                                                            ap_invoice_lines_all ail
                                                                                                                                                                                              WHERE pre.invoice_id = ail.invoice_id (+)
                                                                                                                                                                                                AND pre.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'DEBIT'
                                                                                                                                                                                                AND ail.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id),0)),2) AS NUMBER(15,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     2)) AS saldo, pha.po_header_id, psv.VENDOR_NAME AS supplier,
                psv.SEGMENT1 AS suppliernumber, hls.postal_code, pha.CURRENCY_CODE,
                REPLACE(GCC.CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS, '-', '.')DistributionAccount, GCC.segment1 AS Bu_number, HRO.NAME AS bu, pha.prc_bu_id,
                EGP.ITEM_NUMBER, pha.document_status, PHA.terms_id, APT.NAME TERM_NAME,
                pla.unit_price, pla.quantity AS quantity_LINE,
                sum(replace(PDA.QUANTITY_ORDERED - PDA.QUANTITY_DELIVERED, '.', ',')) quantity,

  (SELECT count(pool.po_header_id)
   FROM po_lines_all pool
   WHERE pool.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   GROUP BY po_header_id) count_lines
FROM po_headers_all pha
LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL AIL ON pha.po_header_id = AIL.po_header_id
LEFT JOIN ap_invoices_all aia ON AIL.INVOICE_ID = aia.INVOICE_ID
JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_v psv ON pha.VENDOR_ID = psv.VENDOR_ID
JOIN
  (SELECT psa.*
   FROM POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V psa
   WHERE psa.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(psa2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
        FROM POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V psa2
        WHERE psa2.VENDOR_ID = psa.VENDOR_ID)) psa ON psv.VENDOR_ID = psa.VENDOR_ID
JOIN hz_locations hls ON psa.location_id = hls.location_id
JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m psites ON pha.vendor_site_id = psites.vendor_site_id
JOIN po_distributions_all pod ON pod.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
LEFT JOIN GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC ON pod.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl HRO ON pha.prc_bu_id = HRO.organization_id
JOIN po_system_parameters_all posystemparameters ON PHA.prc_bu_id = posystemparameters.prc_bu_id
JOIN PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA ON pla.PO_LINE_ID = PDA.PO_LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ap_terms_tl APT ON PHA.TERMS_ID = APT.TERM_ID
AND APT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN egp_system_items_b_v EGP ON PLA.ITEM_ID = EGP.inventory_item_id
AND posystemparameters.inventory_organization_id = EGP.organization_id
WHERE pha.segment1 = :p_number_oc
  AND HRO.NAME = :p_bu
  AND pha.po_header_id = :p_po_header_id
GROUP BY pha.segment1, pha.po_header_id, psv.VENDOR_NAME, EGP.ITEM_NUMBER, pha.prc_bu_id,
         psv.SEGMENT1, hls.postal_code, pha.CURRENCY_CODE, GCC.CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS,
         GCC.segment1, psa.PARTY_SITE_NAME, pha.document_status, HRO.NAME, PHA.terms_id, APT.NAME,
         pla.unit_price, pla.quantity, pla.LINE_NUM, pha.vendor_site_id, psites.vendor_site_code
```

### Query #41

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `TAB_AP_A_VENCER, AP_INVOICES_ALL, TAB_AP_VENCIDO`

### Query #41

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, TAB_AP_VENCIDO, TAB_AP_A_VENCER`

```sql
WITH TAB_AP_A_VENCER AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT DISTINCT aia.invoice_id, aia.invoice_num,
                      (CASE
                           WHEN NVL(aha.RELEASE_REASON, 'N') = 'N' THEN aha.hold_id ELSE 0
                       END) hold_id, (TRUNC(aps.due_date) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) quantity_day,
                      hp.party_name, aia.org_id
      FROM ap_invoices_all aia , ap_payment_schedules_all aps , ap_holds_all aha ,
           hz_parties hp
      WHERE aia.invoice_id = aps.invoice_id
        AND aia.ORG_ID = :P_BU_ID
        AND hp.party_id = aia.party_id
        AND NVL(aia.payment_status_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND aia.invoice_id = aha.invoice_id(+)
        AND TRUNC(aps.due_date) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND :P_CONDICAO = 'A_VENCER')
   WHERE quantity_day >= 0
     AND quantity_day = :P_QUANT_DAY),
     TAB_AP_VENCIDO AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT DISTINCT aia.invoice_id, aia.invoice_num,
                      (CASE
                           WHEN NVL(aha.RELEASE_REASON, 'N') = 'N' THEN aha.hold_id ELSE 0
                       END) hold_id, (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(aps.due_date)) quantity_day,
                      hp.party_name, aia.org_id
      FROM ap_invoices_all aia , ap_payment_schedules_all aps , ap_holds_all aha ,
           hz_parties hp
      WHERE aia.invoice_id = aps.invoice_id
        AND aia.ORG_ID = :P_BU_ID
        AND hp.party_id = aia.party_id
        AND NVL(aia.payment_status_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND aia.invoice_id = aha.invoice_id(+)
        AND TRUNC(aps.due_date) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND :P_CONDICAO = 'VENCIDO')
   WHERE quantity_day = :P_QUANT_DAY)
SELECT *
FROM TAB_AP_A_VENCER
UNION
SELECT *
FROM TAB_AP_VENCIDO
```

### Query #44

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

### Query #44

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `AP_INVOICES_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, POZ_SUP_THIRDPARTY_PAYMENT_REL`

```sql
SELECT aia.invoice_id, aps.payment_num
FROM ap_invoices_all aia, ap_payment_schedules_all aps,

  (SELECT DISTINCT hz.party_name, hz.party_id, th.remit_to_address_id party_site_id,
                   th.tpp_relationship_id
   FROM poz_sup_thirdparty_payment_rel th, hz_parties hz, poz_supp_sites_contacts_v psc,

     (SELECT supplier.vendor_id, party.party_id, party.party_name AS party_name_orig
      FROM poz_suppliers supplier, hz_parties party
      WHERE (supplier.party_id = party.party_id))vendor_ad
   WHERE 1=1
     AND psc.vendor_site_id = th.vendor_site_id (+)
     AND th.remit_to_supplier_id = hz.party_id
     AND psc.vendor_id = vendor_ad.vendor_id
     AND psc.vendor_site_id = nvl(:p_vendor_site_id, psc.vendor_site_id)
     AND vendor_ad.vendor_id = :p_vendor_id) sup
WHERE aia.org_id = :p_org_id
  AND aia.invoice_id = aps.invoice_id
  AND nvl(aps.payment_status_flag, 'N') != 'Y'
  AND aia.party_id = sup.party_id
  AND aia.party_site_id = sup.party_site_id
```

```sql
                                                                               AIA.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE moeda,
                                                                               aia.org_id,
                                                                               aia.party_site_id,
                                                                               aia.terms_date,
                                                                               aia.vendor_id,
                                                                               aia.source origem_nff,
                                                                               atl.name AS condicoes,
                                                                               hp.party_id,
                                                                               hp.party_name fornecedor,
                                                                               hps.party_site_id AS partysite_party_site_id,
                                                                               hps.party_site_name,
                                                                               PVS.VENDOR_SITE_CODE AS LOCAL_FORNECEDOR,
                                                                               aps.payment_num,
                                                                               aps.amount_remaining saldo_parcela,
                                                                               aps.external_bank_account_id bank_account_id,
                                                                               aps.due_date,
                                                                               aps.payment_method_code,
                                                                               aps.payment_status_flag,
                                                                               aps.discount_date AS primeiro_desconto,
                                                                               aps.second_discount_date AS segundo_desconto,
                                                                               APS.PAYMENT_PRIORITY AS PRIORIDADE,
                                                                               TO_CHAR (APS.DUE_DATE,
                                                                                        'DD/MM/YYYY') DTA_VENCIMENTO,
                                                                                       IBY.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME AS METODO_PAGAMENTO,
                                                                                       IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM conta_bancaria,
                                                                                       IEBA.CHECK_DIGITS dgto_conta,
                                                                                       AHC.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE AS RETENCAO,
                                                                                       AIA.APPROVAL_STATUS,
                                                                                       CBBV.BANK_NUMBER,
                                                                                       CBBV.BANK_NAME,
                                                                                       CBBV.BRANCH_NUMBER,
                                                                                       aia.CREATED_BY,
                                                                                       aia.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                                                       aia.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
                                                                                       CBBV.BANK_NUMBER ||'-'|| CBBV.BRANCH_NUMBER ||'-'|| IEBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM ||'-'|| IEBA.CHECK_DIGITS AS DADOS_BANCARIOS
FROM ap_invoices_all aia
JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl hro ON aia.org_id = hro.organization_id
AND HRO.language = 'PTB'
JOIN ap_terms_tl atl ON atl.term_id = aia.terms_id
AND atl.language = 'PTB'
JOIN ap_payment_schedules_all aps ON aia.invoice_id = aps.invoice_id
JOIN iby_payment_methods_tl iby ON iby.payment_method_code = aps.payment_method_code
AND iby.language = USERENV('LANG')
LEFT JOIN ap_holds_all aha ON aha.invoice_id = aia.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN ap_hold_codes ahc ON ahc.hold_lookup_code = aha.hold_lookup_code
LEFT JOIN iby_ext_bank_accounts ieba ON ieba.ext_bank_account_id = aps.external_bank_account_id
LEFT JOIN ce_bank_branches_v cbbv ON cbbv.PK_ID = ieba.BRANCH_ID
LEFT JOIN hz_parties hp ON aia.party_id = hp.party_id
LEFT JOIN poz_supplier_sites_v pvs ON pvs.vendor_site_id = aia.vendor_site_id
LEFT JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON aia.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
LEFT JOIN hz_locations hzl ON hps.location_id = hzl.location_id
WHERE 1=1
  AND aia.org_id = :p_bu_id
  AND (:p_supplierId IS NULL
       OR aia.vendor_id = :p_supplierId)
  AND (:p_currency IS NULL
       OR aia.invoice_currency_code = :p_currency)
  AND (:p_invoice_num IS NULL
       OR aia.invoice_num = :p_invoice_num)
  AND (:p_dueDateFrom IS NULL
       OR :p_dueDateTo IS NULL
       OR aps.due_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(:p_dueDateFrom,
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TO_DATE(:p_dueDateTo,
                                                     'DD/MM/YYYY'))
  AND (:p_payment_methode_code IS NULL
       OR IBY.PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME = :p_payment_methode_code)
  AND (:p_pay_group IS NULL
       OR AIA.PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE = :p_pay_group)
  AND (:p_inv_source IS NULL
       OR aia.source = :p_inv_source)
  AND (:p_APPROVAL_STATUS IS NULL
       OR AIA.APPROVAL_STATUS = :p_APPROVAL_STATUS)
  AND (:p_priorityFrom IS NULL
       OR aps.payment_priority >= :p_priorityFrom)
  AND (:p_priorityTo IS NULL
       OR aps.payment_priority <= :p_priorityTo)
```

### Query #47

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT bu.name AS business_unit_name, iop.organization_code AS org_code, aia.invoice_num,
                aia.invoice_id,
                TO_CHAR(aia.last_update_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS last_update_date_formatted, aia.last_update_date, aia.APPROVAL_STATUS AS InvoiceStatus,
                aia.created_by AS OperationUser, aia.last_updated_by AS ApproverUser
FROM ap_invoices_all aia

  AND aia.last_update_date >= :p_last_date
```
