### Query #48

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS, AC_PICK, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, DEPARA_RAW, POZ_SUPPLIERS, PO_LINES_ALL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, BU_DEST, HZ_PARTIES...`

### Query #48

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AC_PICK, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DUAL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE...`

```sql
WITH bu_dest AS
  (SELECT bu.bu_id
   FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
   JOIN xle_entity_profiles le ON le.legal_entity_id = bu.legal_entity_id
   JOIN xle_registrations reg ON reg.source_id = le.legal_entity_id
   AND reg.source_table = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES'
   WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(reg.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(reg.effective_to,
                                                                              SYSDATE)
     AND reg.registration_number = :p_cnpj_destinatario),
     depara_raw AS
  (SELECT :p_cnpj_fornecedor AS cnpj_fornecedor, :p_cnpj_destinatario AS cnpj_destinatario,
          :p_ElectronicInvoiceKey AS ElectronicInvoiceKey, TO_DATE(:p_InvoiceDate,
                                                             'YYYY-MM-DD') AS InvoiceDate,
          :p_InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber, nf.LineNumber, nf.ItemNumber AS Item_Entrada_NF, nf.Quantity,
          TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(nf.Quantity, ',', '.')) AS Payload_Quantity_Num, nf.QuantityUOM, esi1.item_number AS Item_Oracle_viaTP,
          esi1.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, esi2.item_number AS Item_Oracle_direto,
          esi2.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_direto
   FROM
     (SELECT LEVEL AS LineNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS ItemNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_Quantities,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS Quantity,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_UOMs,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS QuantityUOM
      FROM dual CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) nf
   LEFT JOIN egp_trading_partner_items tp ON tp.tp_item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN egp_item_relationships_b ir ON ir.tp_item_id = tp.tp_item_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi1 ON esi1.inventory_item_id = ir.inventory_item_id
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop1 ON iop1.item_definition_org_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   AND esi1.organization_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi2 ON esi2.item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop2 ON iop2.item_definition_org_id = iop2.master_organization_id
   AND esi2.organization_id = iop2.master_organization_id),
     depara AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT cnpj_fornecedor, cnpj_destinatario, ElectronicInvoiceKey, InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber,
             LineNumber, Item_Entrada_NF, Quantity, Payload_Quantity_Num, QuantityUOM,
             COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) AS Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id,
             COALESCE(Item_Oracle_viaTP, Item_Oracle_direto) AS Item_Oracle,
             CASE
                 WHEN COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS Localizado,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LineNumber
                                ORDER BY CASE
                                             WHEN Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2
                                         END,
                       NVL(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto)) AS rn
      FROM depara_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1),
     ac_raw AS
  (SELECT pha.po_header_id AS Agreement_Id, pha.segment1 AS numero_ac, pha.prc_bu_id,
          hp.party_name AS razao_social,

     (SELECT sup.vendor_id
      FROM poz_suppliers sup
      WHERE sup.party_id = hp.party_id) AS party_id,

     (SELECT site.vendor_site_id
      FROM poz_suppliers sup,poz_supplier_sites_all_m site
      WHERE sup.vendor_id = site.vendor_id
        AND sup.party_id = hp.party_id
        AND site.prc_bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id) AS party_site_id, pha.agent_id, pha.currency_code,
          pla.line_num AS numero_linha, pla.item_id, pla.po_header_id AS from_header_id,
          pla.po_line_id AS from_line_id, pla.item_description, pla.uom_code, pla.unit_price, pla.quantity,
          pha.type_lookup_code, zpti.tax_payer_number AS cnpj,

     (SELECT bu.bu_name
      FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
      WHERE bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id) AS bu_name,
          psa.address1 || ', ' || psa.address2 || '; ' || psa.address3 || ' - ' || psa.address4 || ' - ' || psa.city || ' - ' || psa.state || ' - ' || psa.postal_code AS endereco
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   AND pla.line_status = 'OPEN'
   JOIN poz_suppliers ps ON ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
   JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ps.party_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa ON pssa.vendor_site_id = pha.vendor_site_id
   JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_id = hp.party_id
   AND hps.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_address_v psa ON psa.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
   LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
   AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                      SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            SYSDATE))
   WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
     AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
     AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :p_cnpj_fornecedor
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM bu_dest bd
        WHERE bd.bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id)),
     ac_pick AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT ac_raw.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id
                                          ORDER BY numero_linha) AS rn
      FROM ac_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT ac.Agreement_Id, ac.numero_ac, ac.prc_bu_id, ac.bu_name, ac.razao_social AS "Razão Social",
       ac.party_id, ac.party_site_id, ac.agent_id, ac.currency_code, ac.numero_linha, ac.item_id,
       ac.from_header_id, ac.from_line_id, d.Item_Oracle AS item_number, ac.item_description,
       ac.uom_code, ac.unit_price, NVL(ac.quantity, 0) AS quantity, ac.type_lookup_code, ac.cnpj,
       ac.endereco, d.cnpj_fornecedor, d.cnpj_destinatario, d.ElectronicInvoiceKey,
       d.InvoiceDate, d.InvoiceNumber, d.LineNumber, d.Item_Entrada_NF,
       d.Quantity AS payload_quantity, d.Payload_Quantity_Num AS payload_quantity_num,
       d.QuantityUOM AS payload_uom, d.Localizado AS item_localizado,
       CASE WHEN ac.item_id IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN NVL(ac.quantity,
                                                    0) >= NVL(d.Payload_Quantity_Num,
                                                            0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS quantidade_ok
FROM depara d
LEFT JOIN ac_pick ac ON ac.item_id = d.Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id
ORDER BY d.Localizado, quantidade_ok, d.LineNumber, ac.numero_linha NULLS LAST
```

### Query #49

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `BU_DEST, XLE_REGISTRATIONS, HZ_PARTIES, POZ_SUPPLIERS, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M...`

```sql
WITH bu_dest AS
  (SELECT bu.bu_id
   FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
   JOIN xle_entity_profiles le ON le.legal_entity_id = bu.legal_entity_id
   JOIN xle_registrations reg ON reg.source_id = le.legal_entity_id
   AND reg.source_table = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES'
   WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(reg.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(reg.effective_to,
                                                                              SYSDATE)
     AND reg.registration_number = '35030372000145')
SELECT pha.po_header_id AS po_header_id, pha.segment1 AS numero_ac, pha.prc_bu_id,

  (SELECT bu.bu_name
   FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
   WHERE bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id) AS bu_name, hp.party_name AS razao_social,

  (SELECT sup.vendor_id
   FROM poz_suppliers sup
   WHERE sup.party_id = hp.party_id) AS party_id,

  (SELECT site.vendor_site_id
   FROM poz_suppliers sup, poz_supplier_sites_all_m site
   WHERE sup.vendor_id = site.vendor_id
     AND sup.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND site.prc_bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id) AS party_site_id, pha.agent_id, pha.currency_code, pha.type_lookup_code,
       zpti.tax_payer_number AS cnpj
FROM po_headers_all pha
JOIN poz_suppliers ps ON ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ps.party_id
JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa ON pssa.vendor_site_id = pha.vendor_site_id
JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_id = hp.party_id
AND hps.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
JOIN poz_supplier_address_v psa ON psa.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                   SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                         SYSDATE))
WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
  AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
  AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
  AND zpti.tax_payer_number = '21819182000440'
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM bu_dest bd
     WHERE bd.bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id)
```

### Query #50

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, AP_TERMS, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, BU_DEST, PO_HEADERS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, HEADERS_RAW...`

### Query #50

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, AP_TERMS, BU_DEST, HEADERS_RAW, HZ_PARTIES, POZ_SUPPLIERS, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, PO_LINES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, FUN_NAMES_BUSINESS_UNITS_V...`

```sql
WITH bu_dest AS
  (SELECT bu.bu_id
   FROM fun_names_business_units_v bu ,cmf_lelru_taxpayer_info_v tax
   WHERE bu.legal_entity_id = tax.legal_entity_id
     AND tax.taxpayer_id = :p_cnpj_destinatario),
     headers_raw AS
  (SELECT pha.po_header_id, pha.segment1 AS numero_ac, pha.prc_bu_id,

     (SELECT person_id
      FROM per_users
      WHERE username = 'INT.EXTENSIONS')agent_id, pha.currency_code, pha.type_lookup_code, ps.vendor_id, pssa.vendor_site_id,
          hp.party_id, hp.party_name AS razao_social,
          zpti.tax_payer_number AS cnpj_fornecedor ,

     (SELECT bu.bu_name
      FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
      WHERE bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id) AS bu_name ,

     (SELECT apt.name
      FROM ap_terms apt
      WHERE apt.term_id = pha.terms_id) terms_name
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   AND pla.line_status = 'OPEN'
   JOIN poz_suppliers ps ON ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
   JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ps.party_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa ON pssa.vendor_site_id = pha.vendor_site_id
   JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_id = hp.party_id
   AND hps.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_address_v psa ON psa.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
   LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
   AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                      SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            SYSDATE))
   WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
     AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
     AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :p_cnpj_fornecedor
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(pha.start_date,
                                        SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(pha.end_date,
                                                              SYSDATE))
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM bu_dest bd
        WHERE bd.bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id)),
     headers_pick AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT h.*,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.po_header_id
                                ORDER BY h.po_header_id) rn
      FROM headers_raw h)
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT hp.po_header_id, hp.numero_ac, hp.prc_bu_id, hp.agent_id, hp.currency_code,
       hp.type_lookup_code, hp.vendor_id, hp.vendor_site_id, hp.party_id, hp.razao_social,
       hp.cnpj_fornecedor, :p_cnpj_destinatario AS cnpj_destinatario,
       TO_DATE(:p_InvoiceDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS invoice_date, :p_ElectronicInvoiceKey AS electronic_invoice_key,
       :p_InvoiceNumber AS invoice_number, hp.terms_name ,hp.bu_name
FROM headers_pick hp
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hp.numero_ac
```

### Query #51

### Query #51

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AC_PICK, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DUAL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE...`

```sql
WITH bu_dest AS
  (SELECT bu.bu_id
   FROM fun_names_business_units_v bu ,cmf_lelru_taxpayer_info_v tax
   WHERE bu.legal_entity_id = tax.legal_entity_id
     AND tax.taxpayer_id = :p_cnpj_destinatario),
     shipTo AS
  (SELECT hl.location_code ship_to_location ,iodv.organization_name ship_to_organization ,
          xmsb.input_value_constant1 item_oracle ,xmsb.value_constant cnpj_destinatario ,
          xmsb.input_value_constant4 plu_po_centro_custo
   FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_values xmsb ,hr_locations hl ,INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V iodv
   WHERE xmsb.mapping_set_code = 'PLUMA_GAP_GCO15'
     AND xmsb.value_constant = :p_cnpj_destinatario
     AND hl.location_id = xmsb.input_value_constant2
     AND iodv.location_id = hl.location_id),
     depara_raw AS
  (SELECT :p_cnpj_fornecedor AS cnpj_fornecedor, :p_cnpj_destinatario AS cnpj_destinatario, nf.LineNumber,
          nf.ItemNumber AS Item_Entrada_NF, nf.Quantity,
          TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(nf.Quantity, ',', '.')) AS Payload_Quantity_Num, nf.QuantityUOM, esi1.item_number AS Item_Oracle_viaTP,
          esi1.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, esi2.item_number AS Item_Oracle_direto,
          esi2.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_direto
   FROM
     (SELECT LEVEL AS LineNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS ItemNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_Quantities,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS Quantity,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_UOMs,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS QuantityUOM
      FROM dual CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) nf
   LEFT JOIN egp_trading_partner_items tp ON tp.tp_item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN egp_item_relationships_b ir ON ir.tp_item_id = tp.tp_item_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi1 ON esi1.inventory_item_id = ir.inventory_item_id
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop1 ON iop1.item_definition_org_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   AND esi1.organization_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi2 ON esi2.item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop2 ON iop2.item_definition_org_id = iop2.master_organization_id
   AND esi2.organization_id = iop2.master_organization_id),
     depara AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT cnpj_fornecedor, cnpj_destinatario, LineNumber, Item_Entrada_NF, Quantity,
             Payload_Quantity_Num, QuantityUOM,
             COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) AS Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id,
             COALESCE(Item_Oracle_viaTP, Item_Oracle_direto) AS Item_Oracle,
             CASE
                 WHEN COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS Localizado,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LineNumber
                                ORDER BY CASE
                                             WHEN Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2
                                         END,
                       NVL(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto)) AS rn
      FROM depara_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1),
     ac_raw AS
  (SELECT pha.po_header_id, NVL(pla.quantity_committed, 0) AS quantity_committed,
          pha.segment1 AS numero_ac, pla.line_num AS numero_linha, pla.item_id,
          pha.prc_bu_id, hp.party_name AS razao_social, hp.party_id,
          hps.party_site_id, pha.agent_id, pha.currency_code, pla.from_header_id, pla.from_line_id,
          pla.item_description, pla.uom_code, pla.unit_price, pha.type_lookup_code,
          zpti.tax_payer_number AS cnpj_fornecedor, pla.po_line_id
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   AND pla.line_status = 'OPEN'
   JOIN poz_suppliers ps ON ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
   JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ps.party_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa ON pssa.vendor_site_id = pha.vendor_site_id
   JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_id = hp.party_id
   AND hps.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_address_v psa ON psa.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
   LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
   AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                      SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            SYSDATE))
   WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
     AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
     AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :p_cnpj_fornecedor
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(pha.start_date,
                                        SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(pha.end_date,
                                                              SYSDATE))
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM bu_dest bd
        WHERE bd.bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id)),
     ac_pick AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT ac_raw.*, d.Payload_Quantity_Num,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ac_raw.item_id
                                ORDER BY ac_raw.numero_linha) rn
      FROM ac_raw
      JOIN depara d ON d.Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id = ac_raw.item_id
      WHERE (ac_raw.quantity_committed > 0
             AND ac_raw.quantity_committed >= d.Payload_Quantity_Num)
        OR (ac_raw.quantity_committed = 0))
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT ac.po_header_id, ac.numero_ac, ac.prc_bu_id, ac.numero_linha, ac.item_id, ac.item_description,
       ac.uom_code, ac.unit_price,
       NVL(ac.quantity_committed, 0) AS quantity_committed, ac.type_lookup_code, ac.cnpj_fornecedor, ac.po_line_id,
       d.cnpj_fornecedor AS payload_cnpj_fornecedor, d.cnpj_destinatario AS payload_cnpj_destinatario, d.LineNumber,
       d.Item_Entrada_NF, d.Item_Oracle AS item_number_mapeado,
       d.Quantity AS payload_quantity, d.Payload_Quantity_Num AS payload_quantity_num,
       d.QuantityUOM AS payload_uom, d.Localizado AS item_localizado,

  (SELECT ectl.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories eic, egp_system_items_b esib, egp_categories_tl ectl,
        egp_category_sets_tl eict, inv_org_parameters iop
   WHERE esib.inventory_item_id = eic.inventory_item_id
     AND esib.inventory_organization_id = eic.organization_id
     AND ectl.category_id = eic.category_id
     AND eict.category_set_id = eic.category_set_id
     AND iop.organization_id = esib.organization_id
     AND iop.organization_code = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE'
     AND eict.category_set_name = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE'
     AND eict.language = 'PTB'
     AND ectl.language = 'PTB'
     AND esib.inventory_item_status_code = 'Active'
     AND esib.inventory_item_id = ac.item_id) AS NCM,
       CASE WHEN ac.item_id IS NULL THEN 'N'
           WHEN NVL(ac.quantity_committed, 0) >= NVL(d.Payload_Quantity_Num,
                                                   0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS quantidade_ok ,sht.ship_to_location ,sht.ship_to_organization ,sht.plu_po_centro_custo
FROM depara d
LEFT JOIN ac_pick ac ON ac.item_id = d.Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id
LEFT JOIN shipTo sht ON sht.item_oracle = d.Item_Oracle
ORDER BY ac.numero_ac, d.Localizado, quantidade_ok, d.LineNumber, ac.numero_linha NULLS LAST
```

### Query #52

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS, AC_PICK, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, DEPARA_RAW, POZ_SUPPLIERS, PO_LINES_ALL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, BU_DEST, HZ_PARTIES...`

### Query #52

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AC_PICK, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DUAL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE...`

```sql
WITH bu_dest AS
  (SELECT bu.bu_id
   FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
   JOIN xle_entity_profiles le ON le.legal_entity_id = bu.legal_entity_id
   JOIN xle_registrations reg ON reg.source_id = le.legal_entity_id
   AND reg.source_table = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES'
   WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(reg.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(reg.effective_to,
                                                                              SYSDATE)
     AND reg.registration_number = :p_cnpj_destinatario),
     depara_raw AS
  (SELECT :p_cnpj_fornecedor AS cnpj_fornecedor, :p_cnpj_destinatario AS cnpj_destinatario,
          :p_ElectronicInvoiceKey AS ElectronicInvoiceKey, TO_DATE(:p_InvoiceDate,
                                                             'YYYY-MM-DD') AS InvoiceDate,
          :p_InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber, nf.LineNumber, nf.ItemNumber AS Item_Entrada_NF, nf.Quantity,
          TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(nf.Quantity, ',', '.')) AS Payload_Quantity_Num, nf.QuantityUOM, esi1.item_number AS Item_Oracle_viaTP,
          esi1.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, esi2.item_number AS Item_Oracle_direto,
          esi2.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_direto
   FROM
     (SELECT LEVEL AS LineNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS ItemNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_Quantities,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS Quantity,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_UOMs,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS QuantityUOM
      FROM dual CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) nf
   LEFT JOIN egp_trading_partner_items tp ON tp.tp_item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN egp_item_relationships_b ir ON ir.tp_item_id = tp.tp_item_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi1 ON esi1.inventory_item_id = ir.inventory_item_id
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop1 ON iop1.item_definition_org_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   AND esi1.organization_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi2 ON esi2.item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop2 ON iop2.item_definition_org_id = iop2.master_organization_id
   AND esi2.organization_id = iop2.master_organization_id),
     depara AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT cnpj_fornecedor, cnpj_destinatario, ElectronicInvoiceKey, InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber,
             LineNumber, Item_Entrada_NF, Quantity, Payload_Quantity_Num, QuantityUOM,
             COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) AS Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id,
             COALESCE(Item_Oracle_viaTP, Item_Oracle_direto) AS Item_Oracle,
             CASE
                 WHEN COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS Localizado,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LineNumber
                                ORDER BY CASE
                                             WHEN Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2
                                         END,
                       NVL(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto)) AS rn
      FROM depara_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1),
     ac_raw AS
  (SELECT pha.segment1 AS numero_ac, pha.prc_bu_id, hp.party_name AS razao_social,
          hp.party_id, hps.party_site_id, pha.agent_id, pha.currency_code,
          pla.line_num AS numero_linha, pla.item_id, pla.from_header_id, pla.from_line_id, pla.item_description,
          pla.uom_code, pla.unit_price, pla.quantity, pha.type_lookup_code,
          zpti.tax_payer_number AS cnpj,
          psa.address1 || ', ' || psa.address2 || '; ' || psa.address3 || ' - ' || psa.address4 || ' - ' || psa.city || ' - ' || psa.state || ' - ' || psa.postal_code AS endereco
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   AND pla.line_status = 'OPEN'
   JOIN poz_suppliers ps ON ps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
   JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ps.party_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssa ON pssa.vendor_site_id = pha.vendor_site_id
   JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_id = hp.party_id
   AND hps.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN poz_supplier_address_v psa ON psa.party_site_id = pssa.party_site_id
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
   LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
   AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                      SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            SYSDATE))
   WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
     AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
     AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :p_cnpj_fornecedor
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM bu_dest bd
        WHERE bd.bu_id = pha.prc_bu_id)),
     ac_pick AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT ac_raw.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id
                                          ORDER BY numero_linha) AS rn
      FROM ac_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT ac.numero_ac, ac.prc_bu_id, ac.razao_social AS "Razão Social", ac.party_id,
       ac.party_site_id, ac.agent_id, ac.currency_code, ac.numero_linha, ac.item_id,
       ac.from_header_id, ac.from_line_id, d.Item_Oracle AS item_number, ac.item_description,
       ac.uom_code, ac.unit_price, NVL(ac.quantity, 0) AS quantity, ac.type_lookup_code, ac.cnpj,
       ac.endereco, d.cnpj_fornecedor, d.cnpj_destinatario, d.ElectronicInvoiceKey,
       d.InvoiceDate, d.InvoiceNumber, d.LineNumber, d.Item_Entrada_NF,
       d.Quantity AS payload_quantity, d.Payload_Quantity_Num AS payload_quantity_num,
       d.QuantityUOM AS payload_uom, d.Localizado AS item_localizado,
       CASE WHEN ac.item_id IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN NVL(ac.quantity,
                                                    0) >= NVL(d.Payload_Quantity_Num,
                                                            0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS quantidade_ok
FROM depara d
LEFT JOIN ac_pick ac ON ac.item_id = d.Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id
ORDER BY d.Localizado, quantidade_ok, d.LineNumber, ac.numero_linha NULLS LAST
```

### Query #53

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, POQ_QUALIFICATIONS`

### Query #53

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, POQ_QUALIFICATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V`

```sql
SELECT PSV.VENDOR_NAME AS "Fornecedor", PQ.QUALIFICATION_NUMBER AS "Qualificacao",
       PQ.QUALIFICATION_NAME AS "Nome da Qualificacao", FABUV.BU_NAME AS "Unidade de Negocios",
       PQ.STATUS AS "Status", PQ.QUALIFICATION_OUTCOME AS "Resultado",
       TO_CHAR(PQ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Data Inicial", TO_CHAR(PQ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                           'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Data Expiracao",
       PSSV.PARTY_SITE_ID AS "Party_Site_ID", FABUV.BU_ID AS "BU_ID"
FROM POQ_QUALIFICATIONS PQ
JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PSV ON PQ.SUPPLIER_ID = PSV.VENDOR_ID
JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V PSSV ON PQ.SUPPLIER_ID = PSSV.VENDOR_ID
AND PQ.PRC_BU_ID = PSSV.PRC_BU_ID
AND PQ.SUPPLIER_SITE_ID = PSSV.VENDOR_SITE_ID
JOIN FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUV ON PQ.PRC_BU_ID = FABUV.BU_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (:P_FORNECEDOR IS NULL
       OR UPPER(PSV.VENDOR_NAME) = UPPER(:P_FORNECEDOR))
  AND (:P_BU_NAME IS NULL
       OR UPPER(FABUV.BU_NAME) = UPPER(:P_BU_NAME))
  AND (:P_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE IS NULL
       OR TRUNC(PQ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) >= :P_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND (:P_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL
       OR TRUNC(PQ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) <= :P_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
```

### Query #54

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, POQ_QUALIFICATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V`

```sql
AND PQ.PRC_BU_ID = PSSV.PRC_BU_ID
AND PQ.SUPPLIER_SITE_ID = PSSV.VENDOR_SITE_ID
JOIN FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUV ON PQ.PRC_BU_ID = FABUV.BU_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (:P_FORNECEDOR IS NULL
       OR UPPER(PSV.VENDOR_NAME) = UPPER(:P_FORNECEDOR))
  AND (:P_BU_NAME IS NULL
       OR UPPER(FABUV.BU_NAME) = UPPER(:P_BU_NAME))
  AND (:P_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE IS NULL
       OR TRUNC(PQ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) >= :P_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND (:P_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL
       OR TRUNC(PQ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) <= :P_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
```

### Query #59

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, XLE_ASSOCIATIONS_V, HZ_PARTY_SITES, PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL`

### Query #59

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ASSOCIATIONS_V, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL, PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, HZ_PARTY_SITES`

```sql
SELECT HEADER.PO_HEADER_ID AS PoHeadaerId,
       HEADER.SEGMENT1 AS Segment1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_doc_revision_number(VERSION.CHANGE_ORDER_TYPE,
                                             VERSION.co_sequence,
                                             HEADER.po_header_id,
                                             VERSION.REVISION_NUM) AS RevisionNum,
       HEADER.SIGNATURE_REQUIRED_FLAG AS SignatureRequiredFlag,
       PozSupplierSite.CUSTOMER_NUM AS CustomerNum,
       HEADER.VENDOR_ORDER_NUM AS VendorOrderNum,
       Supplier.SEGMENT1 AS SupplierNumber,
       DocStyle.DISPLAY_NAME AS DocumentStyle,
       SoldToLeRegistration.REGISTRATION_NUMBER AS TaxRegistrationNumber,
       NVL(VERSION.CO_NUM, 0) AS CoNum,
       VERSION.CHANGE_ORDER_DESC AS ChangeOrderDesc,
       HEADER.ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED_FLAG AS AcceptanceRequiredFlag,
       HEADER.ACCEPTANCE_DUE_DATE AS AcceptanceDueDate,
       CarrierPartyName.PARTY_NAME AS PartyName2,
       FobPoLookupPEO.MEANING AS DisplayedField3,
       FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.MEANING AS DisplayedField2,
       PaymentTermsHeader.NAME AS Name3,
       HEADER.PAY_ON_CODE AS PayOnCode,

      , NVL(replace(Header.ATTRIBUTE6,',','.'),0) AS Attribute6_soma
      ,(SELECT distinct xr.registration_number
          FROM xle_associations_v  xa
             , xle_registrations_v xr
         WHERE xa.entity_id        = Header.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID
           AND xa.entity_type      = 'BILL_TO_LOCATION'
           AND xr.establishment_id = xa.legal_construct_id) CNPJ_BILL
       ,(SELECT distinct xr.registration_number
           FROM xle_associations_v  xa
              , xle_registrations_v xr
          WHERE xa.entity_id        = Header.ship_TO_LOCATION_ID
            AND xa.entity_type      = 'SHIP_TO_LOCATION'
            AND xr.establishment_id = xa.legal_construct_id) CNPJ_ship
       ,( SELECT distinct zr.registration_number
            FROM xle_associations_v  xa
               , xle_registrations_v xr
               , zx_registrations    zr
           WHERE xa.entity_id         = Header.ship_TO_LOCATION_ID
             AND xa.entity_type       = 'BILL_TO_LOCATION'
             AND xr.establishment_id  = xa.legal_construct_id
             AND zr.legal_location_Id = xr.location_id(+)
             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN zr.effective_from AND NVL(zr.effective_to,SYSDATE)  ) IE_BILL
       ,( SELECT distinct zr.registration_number
            FROM xle_associations_v  xa
               , xle_registrations_v xr
               , zx_registrations    zr
           WHERE xa.entity_id         = '300000001699218'
             AND xa.entity_type       = 'SHIP_TO_LOCATION'
             AND xr.establishment_id  = xa.legal_construct_id
             AND zr.legal_location_Id = xr.location_id(+)
             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN zr.effective_from AND NVL(zr.effective_to,SYSDATE)  ) IE_SHIP
        , (SELECT psa.party_site_name
             FROM poz_supplier_address_v psa
            WHERE psa.party_site_id = PozSupplierSite.party_site_id) CNPJ_FORNECEDOR
        , (SELECT hreg.registration_number registration_number
            FROM hz_party_sites       hps,
                 zx_party_tax_profile zptp,
                 zx_registrations     hreg
           WHERE hps.party_site_id    = zptp.party_id
             AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = hreg.party_tax_profile_id
             AND hreg.validation_type = 'ORA_BR_IE'
             AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
             AND zptp.site_flag       = 'Y'
             AND hps.party_site_id    = PozSupplierSite.party_site_id
             AND hreg.registration_number IS NOT NULL )  as IE_FORNECEDOR
            , (SELECT nvl(replace(SUM(discount),',','.'),0)
             FROM po_lines_archive_all line
            WHERE line.po_header_id = Header.po_header_id
              AND line.discount_type = 'DISCOUNT_AMOUNT') t_discount

  FROM PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL     HEADER,

       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    ShipToLoc,
       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    BillToLoc,
       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    ProcBuLocation,
       HR_ORGANIZATION_V        ProcurementBu,

       PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V     PersonName,
       PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V     PersonPhone,
       PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V     PersonFaxPhone,
       PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES      PersonEmailAddress,
       PER_ADDRESSES_F          BillToAddress,
       PER_ADDRESSES_F          ShipToAddress,
       FND_CURRENCIES_VL        Currency,
       HZ_LOCATIONS             SupplierLocation,
       PO_VERSIONS              FirstVersion,
       PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS     PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1,
       HR_ORGANIZATION_V        BillToBu,
       XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES      SoldToLe,
       XLE_REGISTRATIONS        SoldToLeRegistration,
       FND_LOOKUPS              ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
       FND_LOOKUPS              ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
       HZ_LOCATIONS             SoldToLeLocation,
       PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
       HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES    AdditionalPartyNamePEO
 WHERE (HEADER.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+) AND
       ProcurementBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE(+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
   AND (PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID =
       ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID)
   AND (HEADER.BILLTO_BU_ID = BillToBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+) AND
       BillToBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE(+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
   AND (HEADER.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID)
   AND (SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_ID)
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_TABLE = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES')
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y')
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.LOCATION_ID = SoldToLeLocation.LOCATION_ID)
   AND (SoldToLeLocation.INTERNAL_FLAG = 'Y')
   AND (HEADER.AGENT_ID = PersonName.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PersonName.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       PersonName.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (HEADER.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (HEADER.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID = BillToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (HEADER.VENDOR_ID = Supplier.VENDOR_ID(+) AND
       Supplier.PARTY_ID = SupplierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND (HEADER.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PozSupplierSite.VENDOR_SITE_ID(+) AND
       HEADER.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID = SupplierContact.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID(+))
   AND (SupplierContact.PER_PARTY_ID = SupplierContactPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND (HEADER.TERMS_ID = PaymentTermsHeader.TERM_ID(+))
   AND (HEADER.CARRIER_ID = Carrier.CARRIER_ID(+) AND
       Carrier.CARRIER_ID = CarrierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND (HEADER.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
   AND (HEADER.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
   AND (HEADER.freight_terms_lookup_code =
       FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FREIGHT TERMS')
   AND (HEADER.fob_lookup_code = FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FOB')
   AND (HEADER.style_id = DocStyle.STYLE_ID(+) AND
       HEADER.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = DocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+))
   AND (HEADER.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD')
   AND (HEADER.AGENT_ID = PersonEmailAddress.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonEmailAddress.EMAIL_TYPE(+) = 'W1' AND
       HEADER.AGENT_ID = PersonPhone.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) = 'W1')
   AND (PersonPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND
       NVL(PersonPhone.DATE_TO, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
   AND (HEADER.AGENT_ID = PersonFaxPhone.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonFaxPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) = 'WF')
   AND (PersonFaxPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND
       NVL(PersonFaxPhone.DATE_TO, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
   AND (ProcurementBu.LOCATION_ID = ProcBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (BillToLoc.ADDRESS_ID = BillToAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN BillToAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (ShipToLoc.ADDRESS_ID = ShipToAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+) AND
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ShipToAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ShipToAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (HEADER.PO_HEADER_ID = VERSION.PO_HEADER_ID)
   AND (HEADER.PRC_BU_ID = NegotiationTerms.PRC_BU_ID(+) AND
       NegotiationTerms.APPLICATION_ID(+) = 201)
   AND (HEADER.CURRENCY_CODE = Currency.CURRENCY_CODE(+))
   AND (PozSupplierSite.LOCATION_ID = SupplierLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
   AND (HEADER.PO_HEADER_ID = FirstVersion.PO_HEADER_ID AND
       FirstVersion.CO_SEQUENCE = 0)
   AND (PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1.STYLE_ID(+) = HEADER.STYLE_ID)
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_NAME_TYPE(+) = 'PHONETIC'
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.status_flag(+) = 'A'
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_ID(+) = Supplier.PARTY_ID
   AND ROWNUM = 1
 ORDER BY NegotiationTerms.VERSION_NUM DESC
```

```sql
      , NVL(replace(Header.ATTRIBUTE6,',','.'),0) AS Attribute6_soma
      ,(SELECT distinct xr.registration_number
          FROM xle_associations_v  xa
             , xle_registrations_v xr
         WHERE xa.entity_id        = Header.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID
           AND xa.entity_type      = 'BILL_TO_LOCATION'
           AND xr.establishment_id = xa.legal_construct_id) CNPJ_BILL
       ,(SELECT distinct xr.registration_number
           FROM xle_associations_v  xa
              , xle_registrations_v xr
          WHERE xa.entity_id        = Header.ship_TO_LOCATION_ID
            AND xa.entity_type      = 'SHIP_TO_LOCATION'
            AND xr.establishment_id = xa.legal_construct_id) CNPJ_ship
       ,( SELECT distinct zr.registration_number
            FROM xle_associations_v  xa
               , xle_registrations_v xr
               , zx_registrations    zr
           WHERE xa.entity_id         = Header.ship_TO_LOCATION_ID
             AND xa.entity_type       = 'BILL_TO_LOCATION'
             AND xr.establishment_id  = xa.legal_construct_id
             AND zr.legal_location_Id = xr.location_id(+)
             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN zr.effective_from AND NVL(zr.effective_to,SYSDATE)  ) IE_BILL
       ,( SELECT distinct zr.registration_number
            FROM xle_associations_v  xa
               , xle_registrations_v xr
               , zx_registrations    zr
           WHERE xa.entity_id         = '300000001699218'
             AND xa.entity_type       = 'SHIP_TO_LOCATION'
             AND xr.establishment_id  = xa.legal_construct_id
             AND zr.legal_location_Id = xr.location_id(+)
             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN zr.effective_from AND NVL(zr.effective_to,SYSDATE)  ) IE_SHIP
        , (SELECT psa.party_site_name
             FROM poz_supplier_address_v psa
            WHERE psa.party_site_id = PozSupplierSite.party_site_id) CNPJ_FORNECEDOR
        , (SELECT hreg.registration_number registration_number
            FROM hz_party_sites       hps,
                 zx_party_tax_profile zptp,
                 zx_registrations     hreg
           WHERE hps.party_site_id    = zptp.party_id
             AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = hreg.party_tax_profile_id
             AND hreg.validation_type = 'ORA_BR_IE'
             AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
             AND zptp.site_flag       = 'Y'
             AND hps.party_site_id    = PozSupplierSite.party_site_id
             AND hreg.registration_number IS NOT NULL )  as IE_FORNECEDOR
        , (SELECT nvl(replace(SUM(discount),',','.'),0)
             FROM po_lines_archive_all line
            WHERE line.po_header_id = Header.po_header_id
              AND line.discount_type = 'DISCOUNT_AMOUNT') t_discount

  FROM PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL   Header,
       FND_LOOKUPS              FreightTermsPoLookupPEO,
       FND_LOOKUPS              FobPoLookupPEO,
       PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL    DocStyle,
       POZ_SUPPLIERS            Supplier,
       POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PozSupplierSite,
       POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS    SupplierContact,
       WSH_CARRIERS             Carrier,
       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    ShipToLoc,
       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    BillToLoc,
       HR_ORGANIZATION_V        ProcurementBu,
       HR_ORGANIZATION_V        RequisitionBu,
       AP_TERMS_VL              PaymentTermsHeader,
       HZ_PARTIES               SupplierPartyName,
       HZ_PARTIES               SupplierContactPartyName,
       HZ_PARTIES               CarrierPartyName,
       PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V     PersonName,
       PO_VERSIONS              Version,
       PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES      PersonEmailAddress,
       PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V     PersonPhone,
       PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V     PersonFaxPhone,
       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL    ProcBuLocation,
       PER_ADDRESSES_F          BillToAddress,
       PER_ADDRESSES_F          ShipToAddress,
       PO_VERSIONS              FirstVersion,
       PON_BIDDING_TERMS_VL     Terms,
       FND_CURRENCIES_VL        Currency,
       HZ_LOCATIONS             SupplierLocation,
       HZ_CONTACT_POINTS        SupplierPhone,
       PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS     PurchasingDocStyleHeaderPEO,
       HR_ORGANIZATION_V        BillToBu,
       XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES      SoldToLe,
       XLE_REGISTRATIONS        SoldToLeRegistration,
       FND_LOOKUPS              ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
       FND_LOOKUPS              ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
       HZ_LOCATIONS             SoldToLeLocation,
       PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
       HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES    AdditionalPartyNamePEO,

       HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ReqBuLocation,
       PER_ADDRESSES_F       ReqBuAddress,
       PO_HEADERS_ALL        TxnHeader

 WHERE (Header.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) and
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+) AND
       ProcurementBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE(+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
   and (PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID =
       ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID)
   AND (Header.REQ_BU_ID = RequisitionBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN RequisitionBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       RequisitionBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+) AND
       RequisitionBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE(+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
   AND (Header.AGENT_ID = PersonName.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN PersonName.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       PersonName.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (Header.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (Header.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID = BillToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (Header.TERMS_ID = PaymentTermsHeader.TERM_ID(+))
   AND (Header.CARRIER_ID = Carrier.CARRIER_ID(+) AND
       Carrier.CARRIER_ID = CarrierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND (Header.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
   AND (Header.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
   AND (Header.freight_terms_lookup_code =
       FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FREIGHT TERMS')
   AND (Header.fob_lookup_code = FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+) AND
       FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FOB')
   AND (Header.style_id = DocStyle.STYLE_ID(+) AND
       Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = DocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+) AND
       Header.AGENT_ID = PersonEmailAddress.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonEmailAddress.EMAIL_TYPE(+) = 'W1' AND
       Header.AGENT_ID = PersonPhone.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) = 'W1' AND
       (PersonPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND
       NVL(PersonPhone.DATE_TO, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND
       Header.AGENT_ID = PersonFaxPhone.PERSON_ID(+) AND
       PersonFaxPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) = 'WF' AND
       (PersonFaxPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND
       NVL(PersonFaxPhone.DATE_TO, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
   AND (ProcurementBu.LOCATION_ID = ProcBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD')
   AND (BillToLoc.ADDRESS_ID = BillToAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (ShipToLoc.ADDRESS_ID = ShipToAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ShipToAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (Header.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE AND
       Header.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
   AND (Header.PO_HEADER_ID = FirstVersion.PO_HEADER_ID AND
       FirstVersion.CO_SEQUENCE = 0)
   AND (Header.PRC_BU_ID = Terms.PRC_BU_ID(+) AND
       Terms.APPLICATION_ID(+) = 201)
   AND (Header.CURRENCY_CODE = Currency.CURRENCY_CODE(+))
   AND (PozSupplierSite.LOCATION_ID = SupplierLocation.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       Header.VENDOR_ID = Supplier.VENDOR_ID(+) AND
       Supplier.PARTY_ID = SupplierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND (Header.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PozSupplierSite.VENDOR_SITE_ID(+) AND
       Header.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID = SupplierContact.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID(+))
   AND (SupplierContact.PER_PARTY_ID = SupplierContactPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
   AND SupplierPhone.OWNER_TABLE_ID(+) = PozSupplierSite.PARTY_SITE_ID
   AND SupplierPhone.OWNER_TABLE_NAME(+) = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
   AND SupplierPhone.STATUS(+) = 'A'
   AND SupplierPhone.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE(+) = 'PHONE'
   AND SupplierPhone.PHONE_LINE_TYPE(+) = 'GEN'
   AND SupplierPhone.PRIMARY_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
   AND Header.STYLE_ID = PurchasingDocStyleHeaderPEO.STYLE_ID
   AND (Header.BILLTO_BU_ID = BillToBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+) AND
       BillToBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE(+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
   AND (Header.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID)
   AND (SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_ID)
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_TABLE = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES')
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y')
   AND (SoldToLeRegistration.LOCATION_ID = SoldToLeLocation.LOCATION_ID AND
       SoldToLeLocation.INTERNAL_FLAG = 'Y')
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_NAME_TYPE(+) = 'PHONETIC'
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.status_flag(+) = 'A'
   AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_ID(+) = Supplier.PARTY_ID
   and rownum = 1

   AND (RequisitionBu.LOCATION_ID = ReqBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ReqBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ReqBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND (ReqBuLocation.ADDRESS_ID = ReqBuAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+) AND
       trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ReqBuAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND
       ReqBuAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
   AND Header.PO_HEADER_ID = TxnHeader.PO_HEADER_ID(+)

 ORDER BY Terms.VERSION_NUM desc
```

### Query #61

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, HZ_PARTY_SITES, PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL`

### Query #61

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL, POZ_SUPPLIERS, PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, HZ_PARTY_SITES`

```sql
WITH TABBU AS
  (SELECT FABU.BU_NAME BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME , XEP.NAME LEGAL_ENTITY_DESCRIPTION ,
          GLLV.LEDGER_NAME LEDGER_NAME , FABU.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID LEGAL_ENTITY_ID , FABU.BU_ID BU_ID
   FROM FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU , XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES XEP , GL_LEDGER_LE_V GLLV
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND FABU.STATUS = 'A'
     AND FABU.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = XEP.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
     AND GLLV.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = FABU.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
     AND GLLV.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE = 'PRIMARY')
SELECT DISTINCT TABBU.LEDGER_NAME AS LEDGERNAME,PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID ,
                TABBU.LEGAL_ENTITY_DESCRIPTION AS LEGALENTITYDESCRIPTION , TABBU.BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME AS BUSINESSUNITNAME ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyymmddhh24mmss') AS TRXNUMBER , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,

                                                                      'yyyy-mm-dd') AS TRXDATE ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS HDRGLDATE ,

  (SELECT SUP.SEGMENT1
   FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS SUP
   WHERE SUP.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID) AS FIRSTPARTYTAXREGNUMBER ,

  (SELECT DISTINCT BEST_BID_CURRENCY_CODE
   FROM PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL PAIT
   WHERE PAIT.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID) AS TRXCURRENCYCODE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,

                                                                                 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS CURRENCYCONVERSIONDATE ,
                HP.PARTY_NAME AS BILLTOPARTY ,

  (SELECT DISTINCT TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS , POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSA , ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP ,
        ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
   WHERE HPS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_ID = PSSA.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND ZPTP.SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ', 'ORA_BR_CPF')
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSA.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND HPS.LOCATION_ID = PSSA.LOCATION_ID
     AND PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSA.VENDOR_SITE_ID) AS BILLTOPARTYSITE , PSA.BID_NUMBER , PSA.BID_STATUS , PSA.TRADING_PARTNER_ID ,
                PSA.TRADING_PARTNER_CONTACT_ID , HPC.PARTY_NAME AS CONTACT_NAME ,
                PSA.LAST_ACTIVITY_TIME , PSA.LAST_ACTIVITY_CODE
FROM PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL PAHA , PON_SUPPLIER_ACTIVITIES PSA , HZ_PARTIES HP ,
     HZ_PARTIES HPC , TABBU TABBU
WHERE PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PSA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
  AND PSA.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HP.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND PSA.TRADING_PARTNER_CONTACT_ID = HPC.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = :pAuction_Header_id
  AND PSA.BID_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PSA.BID_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  AND TABBU.BU_ID = PAHA.PRC_BU_ID
ORDER BY PSA.BID_NUMBER , PSA.TRADING_PARTNER_ID
```

### Query #62

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Payables, SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, PARA, PO_HEADERS_ALL, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS`

### Query #62

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Shipping & Logistics, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Payables`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PARA, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, PO_HEADERS_ALL, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V`

```sql
SELECT 'PLUMA' AS release_domain, WDD.SALES_ORDER_NUMBER AS release_xid, 'I' AS transaction_code,
       'I' AS release_change_flag, TO_CHAR(CFDH.ISSUE_DATE,
                                     'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS late_delivery_dt,
       IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS organization_code,
       REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(FBU.BU_NAME,
                       '_BU$', ''), '^[^ ]+') AS cod_empresa,
       REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(FBU.BU_NAME,
                       '_BU$', ''), '^[^ ]+') AS business_unit_name, PHA.SEGMENT1 AS po_number,
       CFDH.SHIPFROM_PARTY_SITE_ID AS ship_from_location_xid, CFDH.RECEIVER_PARTY_SITE_ID AS ship_to_location_xid,

  (SELECT SUM(NVL(W2.REQUESTED_QUANTITY, 0))
   FROM WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS W2
   WHERE W2.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE LIKE 'RETUR%'
     AND W2.CUST_PO_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber) AS total_packaged_item_count,

  (SELECT SUM(NVL(ES2.UNIT_WEIGHT, 0) * NVL(W2.REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
                                          0))
   FROM WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS W2
   JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ES2 ON ES2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = W2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
   WHERE W2.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE LIKE 'RETUR%'
     AND W2.CUST_PO_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber) AS net_weight_value, 'KG' AS net_weight_uom_gid,

  (SELECT SUM(NVL(ES2.UNIT_VOLUME, 0) * NVL(W2.REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
                                          0))
   FROM WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS W2
   JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ES2 ON ES2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = W2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
   WHERE W2.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE LIKE 'RETUR%'
     AND W2.CUST_PO_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber) AS net_volume_value, 'CUMTR' AS net_volume_uom_gid, MAX(RT.ATTRIBUTE1) AS freight_terms,
       'RETORNO' AS tipo_movimento
FROM WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS WDD
JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS CFDH ON CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = WDD.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ON IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = WDD.ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FBU ON FBU.BU_ID = IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
LEFT JOIN HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HLAORIG ON HLAORIG.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = WDD.ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V PSSV ON CFDH.SHIPFROM_PARTY_SITE_ID = PSSV.PARTY_SITE_ID
LEFT JOIN RCV_TRANSACTIONS RT ON RT.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID = WDD.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = RT.PO_HEADER_ID
WHERE WDD.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE LIKE 'RETUR%'
  AND WDD.CUST_PO_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber
GROUP BY WDD.SALES_ORDER_NUMBER, CFDH.ISSUE_DATE, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, FBU.BU_NAME, HLAORIG.LOCATION_ID,
         CFDH.RECEIVER_PARTY_SITE_ID, CFDH.SHIPFROM_PARTY_SITE_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1
```

### Query #64

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, AP_TERMS_TL, POZ_SUP_PRODUCTS_SERVICES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES`

### Query #64

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `POZ_SUP_PRODUCTS_SERVICES, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, AP_TERMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT carrier.*
FROM
  (SELECT psav.party_site_id AS location_gid ,
          psav.address1 || ' ' || psav.address2 || ' ' || psav.address3 AS adress_line ,
          1 AS adress_line_number ,
          wcv.carrier_name AS location_name ,
          hp.party_name AS location_description ,psav.city AS city ,
          nvl(pascv.phone_number, pascv.mobile_number) AS phone ,
          'CARRIER' AS location_role ,
          zpti.tax_payer_number AS loglsbr_cnpj ,
          pascv.email_address AS loglsbr_email ,
          psav.address4 AS loglsbr_endereco_bairro ,
          psav.address2 AS loglsbr_endereco_nro_logradouro ,
          CASE
              WHEN zrie.registration_number = 'ISENTO' THEN zrie.registration_number
              WHEN zrie.registration_number != 'ISENTO' THEN psav.state||'_'||zrie.registration_number ELSE ''
          END AS loglsbr_ie ,
          CASE
              WHEN zrim.registration_number = 'ISENTO' THEN zrim.registration_number
              WHEN zrim.registration_number != 'ISENTO' THEN psav.state||'_'||zrim.registration_number ELSE ''
          END AS loglsbr_im ,
          nvl(ps.vendor_name_alt, hp.party_name) AS loglsbr_nome_fantasia ,
          ibyv.branch_number AS loglsbr_num_agencia ,
          ibyv.bank_account_number AS loglsbr_num_conta ,

     (SELECT pbct.category_name
      FROM poz_sup_products_services psps ,por_browse_categories_tl pbct
      WHERE pbct.category_id = psps.category_id
        AND psps.vendor_id = ps.vendor_id
        AND pbct.language = userenv('LANG')
        AND EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
           FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES FLV
           WHERE FLV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLU_PO_SERVICOS_TRANSPORTE'
             AND FLV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
             AND FLV.LOOKUP_CODE = pbct.category_name)) AS loglsbr_ramo_atividade ,
          hp.party_name AS loglsbr_razao_social ,

     (SELECT hca.class_code
      FROM zx_party_tax_profile zptp ,hz_code_assignments hca
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND zptp.party_id(+) = ps.party_id
        AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = hca.owner_table_id
        AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN nvl(hca.start_date_active,
                                     trunc(SYSDATE) - 1) AND nvl(hca.end_date_active,
                                                               trunc(SYSDATE + 1))) AS loglsbr_regime_tributacao ,
          replace(psav.postal_code, '-', '') AS postal_code ,
          psav.state AS province_code ,

     (SELECT DISTINCT AP.NAME
      FROM AP_TERMS_TL AP, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M SP
      WHERE AP.TERM_ID = SP.TERMS_ID
        AND sp.vendor_id = ps.vendor_id) AS condicao_pagamento ,
          psav.country AS country_code ,
          'Y' AS isactive ,
          'Y' AS isfleet ,'PLUMA' AS DOMAIN ,
          to_char(ps.last_update_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') last_update_date ,row_number() over(
                                                                                         ORDER BY ps.vendor_id,

                                                                                      psav.party_site_id) LINE
   FROM poz_suppliers_v ps ,poz_supplier_address_v psav ,poz_all_supplier_contacts_v pascv ,
        hz_locations hzl ,hz_parties hp ,zx_party_tax_profile zptp ,
        zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ,zx_registrations zrie ,zx_registrations zrim ,
        iby_ext_bank_accounts_v ibyv ,wsh_carriers_v wcv
   WHERE ps.vendor_id = psav.vendor_id
     AND pascv.sup_party_id = ps.party_id
     AND psav.location_id = hzl.location_id
     AND hp.party_id = ps.party_id
     AND zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
     AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND zptp.site_flag = 'Y'
     AND zpti.reporting_type_code IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ', 'ORA_BR_CPF')
     AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN nvl(zpti.effective_from,
                                  trunc(SYSDATE) - 1) AND nvl(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            trunc(SYSDATE + 1))
     AND zptp.party_id = psav.party_site_id
     AND zrie.party_tax_profile_id(+) = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
     AND zrie.validation_type(+) = 'ORA_BR_IE'
     AND zrim.party_tax_profile_id(+) = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
     AND zrim.validation_type(+) = 'ORA_BR_IM'
     AND ibyv.primary_acct_owner_party_id(+) = ps.party_id
     AND ibyv.bank_account_type(+) = 'CHECKING'
     AND wcv.attribute1 = hzl.location_id
     AND ps.last_update_date >= nvl(TO_DATE(:p_Last_Update_Date,
                                      'dd/mm/yyyy hh24:mi:ss'),
                                  ps.last_update_date)) carrier
WHERE 1=1
```

### Query #65

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, POZ_SUPPLIERS, HZ_PARTIES, HZ_PARTY_SITES`

### Query #65

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL, HZ_PARTIES, POZ_SUPPLIERS, HZ_PARTY_SITES, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M`

```sql
SELECT pos.vendor_id, hp.party_name AS nome_fornecedor, pos.segment1 AS numero_fornecedor,
       pssam.vendor_site_id, pssam.party_site_id AS supplier_address_id,
       pssam.vendor_site_code AS nome_site, hps.party_site_name AS nome_endereco, bu.name AS business_unit,
       COALESCE(hps.party_site_name, pssam.vendor_site_code) AS cnpj
FROM poz_suppliers pos
JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = pos.party_id
JOIN poz_supplier_sites_all_m pssam ON pssam.vendor_id = pos.vendor_id
JOIN hz_party_sites hps ON hps.party_site_id = pssam.party_site_id
JOIN hr_all_organization_units_f_vl bu ON bu.organization_id = pssam.prc_bu_id
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN bu.effective_start_date AND bu.effective_end_date
WHERE pssam.party_site_id = :P_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_ID
  AND UPPER(TRIM(bu.name)) = UPPER(TRIM(:P_BU_NAME))
  AND pssam.inactive_date IS NULL
```

### Query #66

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, HZ_LOCATIONS, CLIENTE, ZX_REGISTRATIONS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AP_TERMS_V, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V...`

### Query #66

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, HZ_LOCATIONS...`

```sql
WITH FORNECEDOR AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT PS.VENDOR_ID AS clicodint ,
                   PS.VENDOR_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                   HAPN.PARTY_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                   CASE WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER' THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                   END AS clifisjur ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicgc ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicpf ,
                   PSS.ADDRESS_LINE1 AS cliendere ,
                   PSS.ADDRESS_LINE4 AS clibairro ,
                   HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                   PSS.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                   PSS.PHONE AS clifone1 ,
                   '' AS clifone2 ,
                   NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                   PS.ATTRIBUTE4 AS clitpcli , '' AS clisitcli , '' AS climotivo , '' AS clinacest ,
                   PSS.STATE AS estestado ,
                   HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                   'PLUMA.TRP-' || PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS idotm ,
                   '' AS clicondpagto ,
                   '' AS clilimglobal ,
                   '' AS clilimpedido ,
                   '' AS climetopagto ,
                   '' AS cliretido ,
                   '' AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
   LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP ON ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
   LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
   AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
   AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
        OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
   LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
   JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V PSS ON PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS ON PS.VENDOR_ID = PSS.VENDOR_ID
   LEFT JOIN AP_TERMS_V APT ON APT.TERM_ID = PSS.TERMS_ID
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V PSA ON PSA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSA ON PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSS.VENDOR_SITE_ID
   AND PSSA.PAY_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
   AND PSSA.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS PSC ON PSC.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN ON HAPN.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   AND HZ.PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
   JOIN FUN_BU_USAGES_V FBU ON FBU.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = PSS.PRC_BU_ID
   AND FBU.SHORT_CODE = 'PLU_AGRO_BU'
   AND FBU.MODULE_KEY = 'PRC_CONTRACT_MANAGEMENT_BF'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = PSS.LOCATION_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
   AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
   AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = PSS.COUNTRY
   AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
   WHERE 1=1
     AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
          OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
     AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = NVL(:P_CNPJ,
                                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER)),
     CLIENTE AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER AS clicodint ,
                   HZ.PARTY_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                   HPS.PARTY_SITE_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                   CASE WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER' THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                   END AS clifisjur ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicgc ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicpf ,
                   HL.ADDRESS1 AS cliendere ,
                   HL.ADDRESS4 AS clibairro ,
                   HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                   HCP.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                   NVL2(HCP.PHONE_NUMBER,

                     HCP.PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_AREA_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_NUMBER|| '|' ||HCP.PHONE_EXTENSION, NULL) AS clifone1 ,
                   '' AS clifone2 ,
                   NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                   'C' AS clitpcli ,
                   CASE
                       WHEN HCASA.END_DATE IS NULL
                            OR HCASA.END_DATE > SYSDATE THEN 'ATIVO' ELSE 'INATIVO'
                   END AS clisitcli ,
                   HCA.ATTRIBUTE1 AS climotivo ,
                   '' AS clinacest ,
                   HL.COUNTRY AS estestado ,
                   HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                   'PLUMA.TRP-' || HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS idotm ,
                   RTV.NAME AS clicondpagto ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT AS clilimglobal ,
                   HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT AS clilimpedido ,
                   ARM.NAME AS climetopagto ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_HOLD AS cliretido ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_CHECKING AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
   LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP ON ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
   LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
   AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
   AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
        OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
   JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA ON HCA.PARTY_ID = HZ.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA ON HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = HPS.LOCATION_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
   AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
   AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_CONTACT_POINTS HCP ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HCP.OWNER_TABLE_ID
   AND HCP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
   AND HCP.STATUS = 'A'
   AND hcp.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
   AND hcp.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF ON HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   AND HCPF.STANDARD_TERMS IS NOT NULL
   AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HCPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
   LEFT JOIN RA_TERMS_TL RTV ON RTV.TERM_ID = HCPF.standard_terms
   AND RTV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
   LEFT JOIN RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS RCRM ON RCRM.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   AND RCRM.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN AR_RECEIPT_METHODS ARM ON ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID = RCRM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
   WHERE 1=1
     AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
          OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
     AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = NVL(:P_CNPJ,
                                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER))
SELECT NVL(FN.clicodint, CL.clicodint) AS clicodint , NVL(FN.clirazsoc,
                                                        CL.clirazsoc) AS clirazsoc ,
       NVL(FN.clifantasi, CL.clifantasi) AS clifantasi , NVL(FN.clifisjur,
                                                           CL.clifisjur) AS clifisjur ,
       NVL(FN.clicgc, CL.clicgc) AS clicgc , NVL(FN.clicpf,
                                               CL.clicpf) AS clicpf ,
       NVL(FN.cliendere, CL.cliendere) AS cliendere , NVL(FN.clibairro,
                                                        CL.clibairro) AS clibairro ,
       NVL(FN.clicodibge, CL.clicodibge) AS clicodibge , NVL(FN.climailfisc,
                                                           CL.climailfisc) AS climailfisc ,
       NVL(FN.clifone1, CL.clifone1) AS clifone1 , NVL(FN.clifone2,
                                                     CL.clifone2) AS clifone2 ,
       NVL(FN.cliinscest, CL.cliinscest) AS cliinscest , NVL(FN.clitpcli,
                                                           CL.clitpcli) AS clitpcli ,
       NVL(FN.idotm, CL.idotm) AS idotm , NVL(FN.clicondpagto,
                                            CL.clicondpagto) AS clicondpagto ,
       NVL(FN.clilimglobal, CL.clilimglobal) AS clilimglobal , NVL(FN.clilimpedido,
                                                                 CL.clilimpedido) AS clilimpedido ,
       NVL(FN.climetopagto, CL.climetopagto) AS climetopagto , NVL(FN.cliretido,
                                                                 CL.cliretido) AS cliretido ,
       NVL(FN.clichecacred, CL.clichecacred) AS clichecacred , NVL(FN.clisitcli,
                                                                 CL.clisitcli) AS clisitcli ,
       NVL(FN.climotivo, CL.climotivo) AS climotivo , NVL(FN.clinacest,
                                                        CL.clinacest) AS clinacest ,
       NVL(FN.estestado, CL.estestado) AS estestado , NVL(FN.paipais,
                                                        CL.paipais) AS paipais
FROM FORNECEDOR FN
FULL OUTER JOIN CLIENTE CL ON CL.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = FN.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
```

### Query #67

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, DUAL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, AP_INVOICES_ALL, AP_TERMS_TL`

```sql
WITH aia AS
  (SELECT gcc.Segment1 || '-' || gcc.Segment2 || '-' || gcc.Segment3 || '-' || gcc.Segment4 || '-' || gcc.Segment5 || '-' || gcc.Segment6 || '-' || gcc.Segment7 || '-' || gcc.Segment8 AS Dist_Combination,

     (SELECT name
      FROM ap_terms_tl
      WHERE term_id = aia.terms_id
        AND LANGUAGE = 'PTB') terms_name, aia.invoice_num
   FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL aia, AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aida, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS gcc
   WHERE aida.Invoice_Id = aia.Invoice_Id
     AND gcc.Code_Combination_Id = aida.Dist_Code_Combination_Id
     AND aida.Line_Type_Lookup_Code = 'ACCRUAL')
SELECT cfd.document_number || to_char(sysdate,
                                'ddmmyyyyhh24mmss') numeronf, cfd.issue_date data_emissao, cfd.document_status status_nf,
       cfd.invoice_num invoice_entrada, hp.party_name nome_fornecedor, cfdl.document_line_id,
       cfdl.efd_item_description descricao_item, cfdl.fd_quantity quantidade,
       cfdl.fd_price valor_unitario, cfdl.fd_amount valor_linha, aia.*
FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_headers cfd, cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdl, cmf_fiscal_doc_schedules cmds, hz_parties hp,
     egp_system_items_b msib, aia
WHERE cfd.document_header_id = cfdl.document_header_id
  AND cmds.fiscal_doc_header_id = cfd.document_header_id
  AND cfd.shipfrom_party_id = hp.party_id
  AND msib.inventory_item_id = cfdl.item_id
  AND aia.Invoice_Num (+) = cfd.invoice_num
  AND cfd.document_number = :pNFOriginal
  AND cfd.document_status = 'CAPTURED'
  AND msib.organization_id =
    (SELECT inv.organization_id
     FROM hr_all_organization_units haou, inv_org_parameters inv
     WHERE haou.name = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE'
       AND haou.organization_id = inv.organization_id)
```
