### Query #68

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V, POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V, HZ_LOCATIONS...`

```sql
WITH FORNECEDOR AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS clicodint ,
                   PS.VENDOR_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                   HAPN.PARTY_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                   CASE WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER' THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                   END AS clifisjur ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicgc ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicpf ,
                   PSS.ADDRESS_LINE1 AS cliendere ,
                   PSS.ADDRESS_LINE4 AS clibairro ,
                   HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                   PSS.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                   PSS.PHONE AS clifone1 ,
                   '' AS clifone2 ,
                   NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                   PS.ATTRIBUTE4 AS clitpcli , '' AS clisitcli , '' AS climotivo , '' AS clinacest ,
                   PSS.STATE AS estestado ,
                   HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                   'PLUMA.TRP-' || PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS idotm ,
                   '' AS clicondpagto ,
                   '' AS clilimglobal ,
                   '' AS clilimpedido ,
                   '' AS climetopagto ,
                   '' AS cliretido ,
                   '' AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
   LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP ON ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
   LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
   AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
   AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
        OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
   LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
   JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_V PSS ON PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS ON PS.VENDOR_ID = PSS.VENDOR_ID
   LEFT JOIN AP_TERMS_V APT ON APT.TERM_ID = PSS.TERMS_ID
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESS_V PSA ON PSA.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSA ON PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSS.VENDOR_SITE_ID
   AND PSSA.PAY_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
   AND PSSA.PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS PSC ON PSC.PARTY_SITE_ID = PSS.PARTY_SITE_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN ON HAPN.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   AND HZ.PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
   JOIN FUN_BU_USAGES_V FBU ON FBU.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = PSS.PRC_BU_ID
   AND FBU.SHORT_CODE = 'PLU_AGRO_BU'
   AND FBU.MODULE_KEY = 'PRC_CONTRACT_MANAGEMENT_BF'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = PSS.LOCATION_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
   AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
   AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = PSS.COUNTRY
   AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
   WHERE 1=1
     AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
          OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
     AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = NVL(:P_CNPJ,
                                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER)),
     CLIENTE AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS clicodint ,
                   HZ.PARTY_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                   HPS.PARTY_SITE_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                   CASE WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F' WHEN ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER' THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                   END AS clifisjur ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicgc ,
                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER AS clicpf ,
                   HL.ADDRESS1 AS cliendere ,
                   HL.ADDRESS4 AS clibairro ,
                   HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                   HCP.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                   NVL2(HCP.PHONE_NUMBER,

                     HCP.PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_AREA_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_NUMBER|| '|' ||HCP.PHONE_EXTENSION, NULL) AS clifone1 ,
                   '' AS clifone2 ,
                   NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                   'C' AS clitpcli ,
                   CASE
                       WHEN HCASA.END_DATE IS NULL
                            OR HCASA.END_DATE > SYSDATE THEN 'ATIVO' ELSE 'INATIVO'
                   END AS clisitcli ,
                   HCA.ATTRIBUTE1 AS climotivo ,
                   '' AS clinacest ,
                   HL.COUNTRY AS estestado ,
                   HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                   'PLUMA.TRP-' || HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS idotm ,
                   RTV.NAME AS clicondpagto ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT AS clilimglobal ,
                   HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT AS clilimpedido ,
                   ARM.NAME AS climetopagto ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_HOLD AS cliretido ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_CHECKING AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
   FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
   LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP ON ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
   LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
   AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
   AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
        OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
   JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA ON HCA.PARTY_ID = HZ.PARTY_ID
   JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA ON HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = HPS.LOCATION_ID
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
   AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
   AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
   AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_CONTACT_POINTS HCP ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HCP.OWNER_TABLE_ID
   AND HCP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
   AND HCP.STATUS = 'A'
   AND hcp.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
   AND hcp.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF ON HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   AND HCPF.STANDARD_TERMS IS NOT NULL
   AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HCPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
   LEFT JOIN RA_TERMS_TL RTV ON RTV.TERM_ID = HCPF.standard_terms
   AND RTV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
   LEFT JOIN RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS RCRM ON RCRM.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
   AND RCRM.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
   LEFT JOIN AR_RECEIPT_METHODS ARM ON ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID = RCRM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
   WHERE 1=1
     AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
          OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
     AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = NVL(:P_CNPJ,
                                   ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER))
SELECT NVL(FN.clicodint, CL.clicodint) AS clicodint , NVL(FN.clirazsoc,
                                                        CL.clirazsoc) AS clirazsoc ,
       NVL(FN.clifantasi, CL.clifantasi) AS clifantasi , NVL(FN.clifisjur,
                                                           CL.clifisjur) AS clifisjur ,
       NVL(FN.clicgc, CL.clicgc) AS clicgc , NVL(FN.clicpf,
                                               CL.clicpf) AS clicpf ,
       NVL(FN.cliendere, CL.cliendere) AS cliendere , NVL(FN.clibairro,
                                                        CL.clibairro) AS clibairro ,
       NVL(FN.clicodibge, CL.clicodibge) AS clicodibge , NVL(FN.climailfisc,
                                                           CL.climailfisc) AS climailfisc ,
       NVL(FN.clifone1, CL.clifone1) AS clifone1 , NVL(FN.clifone2,
                                                     CL.clifone2) AS clifone2 ,
       NVL(FN.cliinscest, CL.cliinscest) AS cliinscest , NVL(FN.clitpcli,
                                                           CL.clitpcli) AS clitpcli ,
       NVL(FN.idotm, CL.idotm) AS idotm , NVL(FN.clicondpagto,
                                            CL.clicondpagto) AS clicondpagto ,
       NVL(FN.clilimglobal, CL.clilimglobal) AS clilimglobal , NVL(FN.clilimpedido,
                                                                 CL.clilimpedido) AS clilimpedido ,
       NVL(FN.climetopagto, CL.climetopagto) AS climetopagto , NVL(FN.cliretido,
                                                                 CL.cliretido) AS cliretido ,
       NVL(FN.clichecacred, CL.clichecacred) AS clichecacred , NVL(FN.clisitcli,
                                                                 CL.clisitcli) AS clisitcli ,
       NVL(FN.climotivo, CL.climotivo) AS climotivo , NVL(FN.clinacest,
                                                        CL.clinacest) AS clinacest ,
       NVL(FN.estestado, CL.estestado) AS estestado , NVL(FN.paipais,
                                                        CL.paipais) AS paipais
FROM FORNECEDOR FN
FULL OUTER JOIN CLIENTE CL ON CL.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = FN.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
```

### Query #69

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_IMP_CLASSIFICS_T, POZ_SUP_CONTACTS_INT, POZ_SUP_ADDRESSES_INT, HZ_IMP_LOCATIONS_T, HZ_IMP_CONTACTS_T, IBY_TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCTS, POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_INT, POZ_SUPPLIER_INT_REJECTIONS, POZ_SUP_CONTACT_ADDRESSES_INT, ESS_REQUEST_PROPERTY...`

```sql
SELECT CASE
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 'ERROR'
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED'
                AND PSAI.STATUS = 'PROCESSED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
       END AS EXECUTABLE_STATUS , PSIR.REJECT_LOOKUP_CODE AS MESSAGE ,
       CASE
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 'ERROR'
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED'
                AND PSAI.STATUS = 'PROCESSED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
       END AS STATUS_ERRO_TABELA , 'POZ_SUPPLIERS_INT' TABLE_NAME
FROM ESS_REQUEST_HISTORY ERH
JOIN POZ_SUPPLIERS_INT PSAI ON PSAI.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = ERH.REQUESTID
LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_INT_REJECTIONS PSIR ON PSIR.REQUEST_ID = PSAI.REQUEST_ID
WHERE PSAI.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = :P_REQUEST_ID
UNION
SELECT CASE
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.IMPORT_STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 'ERROR'
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED'
                AND PSAI.IMPORT_STATUS = 'PROCESSED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
       END AS EXECUTABLE_STATUS , PSIR.REJECT_LOOKUP_CODE AS MESSAGE ,
       CASE
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.IMPORT_STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 'ERROR'
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED'
                AND PSAI.IMPORT_STATUS = 'PROCESSED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED'

           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.INTERFACE_STATUS IN ('E','W') THEN 'ERROR'
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED'
                AND PSAI.INTERFACE_STATUS = 'S' THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
       END AS EXECUTABLE_STATUS , COALESCE(PSIR.ERROR_MSG_TEXT,
                                    PSIR.MESSAGE_NAME) AS MESSAGE ,
       CASE
           WHEN ERH.EXECUTABLE_STATUS IN ('ERROR','WARNING')
                OR PSAI.INTERFACE_STATUS IN ('E','W') THEN 'ERROR'

JOIN HZ_IMP_PARTIES_T PSAI ON PSAI.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = ERH.REQUESTID
```

### Query #72

### Query #72

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_PARTIES, POZ_SUPPLIERS`

```sql
SELECT PARTY_ID , PARTY_NUMBER , PARTY_NAME
FROM HZ_PARTIES
WHERE PARTY_NUMBER = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND :P_TYPE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
UNION
SELECT PS.PARTY_ID , PS.SEGMENT1 , hp.PARTY_NAME
FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS PS , HZ_PARTIES HP
WHERE PS.SEGMENT1 = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND PS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
  AND :P_TYPE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
UNION
SELECT hp.PARTY_ID , hp.PARTY_NUMBER , hp.PARTY_NAME
FROM hz_parties hp , hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcasa , hz_party_sites hps ,
     hz_locations hl
WHERE 1=1
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND hcasa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
  AND hps.party_site_number = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' = :P_TYPE
UNION
SELECT hp.PARTY_ID , hp.PARTY_NUMBER , hp.PARTY_NAME
FROM hz_parties hp , HZ_PARTY_SITES hps , zx_party_tax_profile zptp ,
     zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
WHERE hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
  AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = zpti.entity_id
  AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND zpti.reporting_type_code = :P_TYPE
  AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF'
UNION
SELECT PARTY_ID , PARTY_NUMBER , PARTY_NAME
FROM HZ_PARTIES
WHERE PARTY_NAME = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND 'ORA_BR_OTHER' = :P_TYPE
UNION
SELECT PS.PARTY_ID , PS.SEGMENT1 , hp.PARTY_NAME
FROM POZ_SUPPLIERS PS , HZ_PARTIES HP
WHERE hp.PARTY_NAME = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND PS.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
  AND 'ORA_BR_OTHER' = :P_TYPE
UNION
SELECT hp.PARTY_ID , hp.PARTY_NUMBER , hp.PARTY_NAME
FROM hz_parties hp , hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcasa , hz_party_sites hps ,
     hz_locations hl
WHERE 1=1
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND hcasa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
  AND hps.party_site_name = :P_PARTY_NUMBER
  AND 'ORA_BR_OTHER' = :P_TYPE
ORDER BY PARTY_NAME
```

### Query #74

**Tags:** `FIN - Payables, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS, PAY_ORG_PAY_METHODS_TL, PAY_PERSON_PAY_METHODS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_id , paam.assignment_number , 'Pagamento' payment_name ,

  (SELECT org_payment_method_id
   FROM pay_org_pay_methods_tl
   WHERE LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND org_payment_method_name = 'ANM - Pagamento Mensal') org_payment_method_id ,
                                                                                                       ppa.payroll_relationship_id ,
                                                                                                       iao.ext_bank_account_id ,
                                                                                                       hosr.start_date_active ,
                                                                                                       hosr.end_date_active ,
                                                                                                       'P' Payment_Amount_Type ,
                                                                                                           NULL Amount ,
                                                                                                                100 Percentage ,
                                                                                                                10 Priority
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , pay_payroll_assignments ppa ,
     hz_orig_sys_references hosr ,

  (SELECT account_owner_party_id , MAX(ext_bank_account_id) ext_bank_account_id
   FROM iby_account_owners
   WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
     AND ext_bank_account_id IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY account_owner_party_id) iao
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.action_code IN ('HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION', 'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL', 'ADD_ASSIGN')
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND ppa.hr_assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND ppa.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppa.hr_term_id = paam.work_terms_assignment_id
  AND ppa.legal_employer_id = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hosr.orig_system_reference = TO_CHAR(papf.person_id)
  AND hosr.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
  AND hosr.orig_system = 'FUSION_HCM'
  AND iao.account_owner_party_id = hosr.owner_table_id
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM pay_person_pay_methods_f ppm
     WHERE ppm.payroll_relationship_id = ppa.payroll_relationship_id
       AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppm.effective_start_date AND ppm.effective_end_date)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number , papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
ORDER BY papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number
```

## FIN - Receivables & Cash

### Query #1

## FIN - Receivables & Cash

### Query #1

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS`

```sql
SELECT supplierInBase
FROM
  (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y'
          END supplierInBase, 'BR' country
   FROM zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti, zx_party_tax_profile zptp, hz_party_sites hps, hz_parties hp,
        POZ_SUPPLIERS_V psv
   WHERE zptp.party_tax_profile_id = zpti.entity_id
     AND hps.party_site_id = zptp.party_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hps.party_id = psv.party_id
     AND SUPPLIER_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND TRUNC (SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL (psv.start_date_active, TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL (psv.end_date_active,
                                                                                           TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 1)
     AND TRUNC (SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL (zpti.EFFECTIVE_FROM, TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL (zpti.EFFECTIVE_TO,
                                                                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 1)
     AND zpti.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER = :P_CNPJ_CPF
     AND :P_COUNTRY_CODE = 'BR'
   UNION SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y'
                END supplierInBase, 'EX' country
   FROM HZ_PARTIES hp, HZ_PARTY_SITES hps, HZ_PARTY_USG_ASSIGNMENTS hpa
   WHERE 1=1
     AND hp.PARTY_TYPE = 'ORGANIZATION'
     AND hp.CREATED_BY_MODULE = 'POS_SUPPLIER_MGMT'
     AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
     AND hps.PARTY_SITE_NAME= :P_CNPJ_CPF
     AND :P_COUNTRY_CODE <> 'BR'
     AND hp.party_id = hpa.party_id
     AND hpa.PARTY_USAGE_CODE = 'SUPPLIER')
WHERE country = CASE WHEN :P_COUNTRY_CODE <> 'BR' THEN 'EX' ELSE 'BR'
                END
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ADDRESSES_F, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ADDRESSES_F, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES`

```sql
SELECT ppauf.person_id, paf.address_id, paf.effective_start_date, paf.effective_end_date,
       paf.country, ppauf.address_type, paf.addl_address_attribute3, paf.address_line_1,
       paf.address_line_2, paf.address_line_3, paf.address_line_4, paf.region_2, paf.town_or_city,
       paf.postal_code,

  (SELECT hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE
   FROM hz_geography_identifiers hgi,hz_geographies hg
   WHERE identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE'
     AND hg.geography_id = hgi.geography_id
     AND hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hg.country_code = 'BR'
     AND hgi.language_code = 'US'
     AND upper(hg.geography_element3) = upper(paf.town_or_city)
     AND hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
     AND rownum = 1) IBGE_CODE,

  (SELECT hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE
   FROM hz_geography_identifiers hgi,hz_geographies hg
   WHERE identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE'
     AND hg.geography_id = hgi.geography_id
     AND hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hg.country_code = 'BR'
     AND hgi.language_code = 'US'
     AND upper(hg.geography_element3) = upper(pp.town_of_birth)
     AND hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
     AND rownum = 1) IBGE_CODE_NASCIMENTO,pp.town_of_birth cidade_nascimento,pp.REGION_OF_BIRTH estado_nascimento,

  (SELECT upper(GEOGRAPHY_NAME)
   FROM hz_geographies
   WHERE country_code = pp.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH
     AND geography_type = 'COUNTRY'
     AND rownum = 1) pais_nascimento
FROM per_addresses_f paf, per_person_addr_usages_f ppauf, per_persons pp
WHERE ppauf.person_id = nvl(:p_person_id, ppauf.person_id)
  AND ppauf.address_id = paf.address_id
  AND pp.person_id (+) = ppauf.person_id
  AND paf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(paf.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_addresses_f paf, per_person_addr_usages_f ppauf
     WHERE ppauf.person_id = nvl(:p_person_id, ppauf.person_id)
       AND ppauf.address_id = paf.address_id)
  AND rownum = 1
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PER_GRADE_STEPS_X, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIPS...`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, PER_LOCATIONS, PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_GRADES_F, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, PER_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIPS...`

```sql
WITH HIRE_DATES AS
  (SELECT PPS.DATE_START AS HIRE_DATE, PPS.PERSON_ID, PPS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID,
          PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE, PAAM.ACTION_CODE,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PPS.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY PPS.DATE_START DESC,
                    PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE DESC, PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC) AS RANK
   FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPS,

     (SELECT ASG.*,
             RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ASG.PERSON_ID, ASG.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                          ORDER BY ASG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, ASG.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE) AS RANK
      FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ASG
      WHERE ASG.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE='E'
        AND ASG.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE','REHIRE')) PAAM
   WHERE PAAM.RANK = 1
     AND PAAM.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NULL
     AND PAAM.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = PPS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
     AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = :p_person_id)
SELECT TRANSLATE(
                   (SELECT ORG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE
                    FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS ORG
                    WHERE ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID=paa.UNION_ID
                      AND ROWNUM=1),'a./-', 'a') UNION_INSCR, pai.first_name pai_first_name,
       pai.middle_names pai_middle_names, pai.last_name pai_last_name,
       pai.legislation_code pai_legislation_code, pai.name_type pai_name_type, pplf.attribute18 mae_first_name,
       pplf.attribute20 mae_middle_names, pplf.attribute19 mae_last_name,
       pplf.legislation_code mae_legislation_code, 'MTR' mae_name_type, paa.person_id,
                                                         ppnf.first_name first_name,
                                                         ppnf.middle_names middle_names,
                                                         ppnf.last_name last_name,
                                                         paa.union_name union_name, paa.union_id,
                                                         paa.odb_on_oog, paa.odb_prog,
                                                         paa.odb_area, paa.assignment_number,
                                                         paa.assignment_id, paa.grade_id,
                                                         paa.grade_code, paa.grade_name,
                                                         paa.step_id, paa.step_name,
                                                         paa.date_probation_end, paa.probation_period,
                                                         paa.probation_unit,
                                                         paa.employment_category, paa.reason_code,
                                                         paa.estab_name, paa.organization_id,
                                                         paa.location_id, paa.job_id,
                                                         paa.cod_depto, paa.empresa,
                                                         paa.centro_custo, paa.estab_depto,
                                                         paa.job_code, paa.location_code,
                                                         paa.labour_union_member_flag, paa.estab_Uo,
                                                         paa.full_part_time,
                                                         paa.permanent_temporary_flag, paa.normal_hours,
                                                         paa.hourly_salaried_code, paa.salary_amount,
                                                         paa.salary_basis_code, paa.currency_code,
                                                         paa.employee_category,
                                                         paa.assignment_status_type, paa.action_code,
                                                         paa.system_person_type, paa.assignment_type,
                                                         paa.creation_date, paa.last_update_date,
                                                         paa.effective_start_date, paa.RETIREMENT_DATE,
                                                         pplf.highest_education_level, '' completed_date,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute16 rg_issuedby_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute_date1 rg_issued_dt_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute13 rg_state_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute3 voter_zone_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute2 voter_section_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute4 voter_city_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute5 voter_state_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute6 militar_series_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute15 militar_region_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute14 militar_state_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute12 mil_cert_type_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute7 militar_cat_bra,
                                                                                          pplf.attribute_date2 pis_pasep_dt_bra,
                                                                                          paa.id_cronograma id_cronograma,
                                                                                          decode(paa.bate_ponto,

                                                                                            '01',
                                                                                            '1',
                                                                                            '0') bate_ponto,
                                                                                          paa.bate_ponto_descricao,
                                                                                          ppof.attribute10 aposentado,
                                                                                          ppof.projected_termination_date,
                                                                                          ppof.pds_information10 tp_contrato,
                                                                                          CASE
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.effective_start_date
                                                                                              ELSE NULL
                                                                                          END AS bgn_dt_cntr1,
                                                                                          CASE
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                                                   AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 44)
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.projected_assignment_end
                                                                                              ELSE NULL
                                                                                          END AS end_dt_cntr1,
                                                                                          CASE
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                                                   AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 45)
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL
                                                                                              ELSE NULL
                                                                                          END AS bgn_dt_cntr2,
                                                                                          CASE
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date + 89
                                                                                              WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL
                                                                                              ELSE NULL
                                                                                          END AS end_dt_cntr2,
                                                                                          paa.cd_executivo,
                                                                                          hd.hire_date,
                                                                                          tab_license.LICENSE_NUMBER,
                                                                                          tab_license.DATE_TO_LICENSE,
                                                                                          tab_license.LICENSE_TYPE,
                                                                                          tab_license.EMISSAO_CATEIRA,
                                                                                          tab_license.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                                                                                          tab_license.ISSUING_AUTHORITY,
                                                                                          paa.nome_departamento,
                                                                                          pplf.PER_INFORMATION1 NUMERO_CTPS,
                                                                                          pplf.PER_INFORMATION2 SERIE_CTPS,
                                                                                          Y6.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 UF_ESTADO_CTPS,
                                                                                          pplf.PER_INFORMATION_DATE1 DATA_CTPS
FROM per_all_people_f papf, per_person_names_f ppnf, hire_dates hd,

  (SELECT pl.*,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                       ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_people_legislative_f pl) pplf, per_periods_of_service ppof,

  (SELECT PDL.LICENSE_NUMBER,PDL.DATE_TO DATE_TO_LICENSE,PDLT.LICENSE_TYPE,PDL.person_id,
          PDL.DATE_FROM EMISSAO_CATEIRA,PDL.ISSUING_LOCATION,PDL.ISSUING_AUTHORITY
   FROM PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES PDL,PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES PDLT
   WHERE PDLT.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID = PDL.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID) tab_license,

  (SELECT pcrp.person_id, ppnp.first_name, ppnp.middle_names, ppnp.last_name, ppnp.legislation_code,
          'FTR' name_type
   FROM per_contact_relationships pcrp, per_all_people_f papfp, per_person_names_f ppnp
   WHERE papfp.person_id = pcrp.person_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papfp.effective_start_date AND papfp.effective_end_date
     AND ppnp.person_id(+) = pcrp.contact_person_id
     AND ppnp.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppnp.effective_start_date AND ppnp.effective_end_date
     AND pcrp.contact_type = 'IN_FR') pai,

  (SELECT paam.person_id, paam.union_id, houf.name union_name, paam.ass_attribute1 odb_on_oog,
          prog.description odb_prog, paam.ass_attribute5 odb_area, paam.assignment_number, paam.assignment_id,
          paam.grade_id, grade.grade_code, grade.grade_name, step.step_id, step.step_name,
          paam.date_probation_end, paam.probation_period, paam.probation_unit, paam.establishment_id,
          paam.employment_category, paam.reason_code, paam.labour_union_member_flag, paam.organization_id,
          paam.location_id, paam.job_id, estab.name estab_name, depto.attribute5 cod_depto,
          depto.attribute8 empresa, depto.attribute1 centro_custo, depto.attribute2 estab_depto, pjf.job_code,
          loc.location_code, loc.estab_Uo, paam.full_part_time, paam.permanent_temporary_flag,
          paam.normal_hours, paam.hourly_salaried_code, cmps.salary_amount, cmps.currency_code,
          paam.employee_category, paam.assignment_status_type, paam.action_code, paam.system_person_type,
          paam.assignment_type, paam.creation_date, paam.last_update_date, paam.last_updated_by,
          paam.effective_start_date, paam.period_of_service_id, cron.description id_cronograma,
          ponto.flex_value bate_ponto, ponto.description bate_ponto_descricao,
          paam.ass_attribute6 cd_executivo, paam.projected_assignment_end, paam.RETIREMENT_DATE,
          cmps.salary_basis_code,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY paam.person_id
                       ORDER BY paam.last_update_date DESC,
                    paam.effective_end_date DESC, paam.effective_start_date DESC) AS rank,

     (SELECT depto_name.name
      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl depto_name
      WHERE depto_name.language = 'PTB'
        AND depto_name.organization_id = depto.organization_id
        AND rownum = 1) nome_departamento
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, hr_organization_units_f_tl houf, hr_organization_units_f_tl estab,
        hr_all_organization_units_f depto, per_jobs_f pjf, cmp_salary cmps,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PROGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) prog,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_CRONOGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) cron,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PONTO'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) ponto,

     (SELECT ploc.location_id, ploc.internal_location_code location_code, pldf.attribute1 estab_Uo
      FROM per_locations ploc, per_location_details_f pldf
      WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc,

     (SELECT pgf.grade_id, pgf.grade_code, pgftl.name grade_name
      FROM per_grades_f pgf, per_grades_f_tl pgftl
      WHERE pgftl.grade_id = pgf.grade_id
        AND pgftl.language = 'PTB') grade,

     (SELECT pagsf.ASSIGNMENT_ID, pgsx.GRADE_STEP_ID step_id, pgsx.SEQUENCE step_name
      FROM PER_GRADE_STEPS_X pgsx, PER_ASSIGN_GRADE_STEPS_F pagsf
      WHERE pgsx.GRADE_STEP_ID = pagsf.GRADE_STEP_ID
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pgsx.effective_start_date AND pgsx.effective_end_date
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pagsf.effective_start_date AND pagsf.effective_end_date) step
   WHERE paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date(+), 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND paam.action_code != 'TERMINATION'
     AND paam.system_person_type = 'EMP'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND houf.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
     AND houf.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN houf.effective_start_date(+) AND NVL(houf.effective_end_date(+),

                                                                              TRUNC(SYSDATE))
     AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
     AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND NVL(estab.effective_end_date(+),

                                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))
     AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND NVL(depto.effective_end_date(+),

                                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))
     AND pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND NVL(pjf.effective_end_date,

                                                                          TRUNC(SYSDATE))
     AND loc.location_id(+) = paam.location_id
     AND grade.grade_id(+) = paam.grade_id
     AND step.ASSIGNMENT_ID(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN cmps.date_from(+) AND cmps.date_to(+)
     AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
     AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND prog.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute3
     AND cron.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute4
     AND ponto.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute2
   ORDER BY paam.last_update_date DESC) paa,

  (SELECT GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2,GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID,COUNT(GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID)
   FROM HZ_GEOGRAPHIES
   WHERE GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'STATE'
   GROUP BY GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2,GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID) Y6
WHERE papf.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, papf.person_id)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pai.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND paa.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND hd.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND hd.rank(+) = 1
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date(+) AND NVL(ppnf.effective_end_date(+),
                                                                TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND pplf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN pplf.effective_start_date(+) AND NVL(pplf.effective_end_date(+),
                                                                TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND ppof.period_of_service_id(+) = paa.period_of_service_id
  AND ppof.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND tab_license.person_id (+) = papf.person_id
  AND papf.person_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pplf.PER_INFORMATION_NUMBER1 = Y6.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID(+)
  AND paa.rank = 1
  AND pplf.rank = 1
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, PER_PHONES, PER_GRADE_STEPS_X, PER_ETHNICITIES, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_PERSONS, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES...`

```sql
WITH hire_dates AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pps.date_start AS hire_date,paam.assignment_name,pps.person_id,papf.person_number,
                   pni.national_identifier_number,ppnf.display_name,
                   rank() over(PARTITION BY pps.person_id
                               ORDER BY pps.date_start DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_periods_of_service pps,

     (SELECT asg.*,
             rank() over(PARTITION BY asg.person_id, asg.period_of_service_id
                         ORDER BY asg.effective_start_date, asg.effective_sequence) AS rank
      FROM per_all_assignments_m asg
      WHERE asg.assignment_type = 'E'
        AND assignment_name != 'ESTAGIARIO'
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN asg.effective_start_date AND asg.effective_end_date) paam,per_all_people_f papf,per_person_names_f ppnf,
        per_national_identifiers pni
   WHERE paam.rank = 1
     AND paam.source_assignment_id IS NULL
     AND paam.period_of_service_id = pps.period_of_service_id
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND to_char(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND pni.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
     AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'),
     empres_hire AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pps.date_start AS hire_date,pps.person_id,papf.person_number,
                   rank() over(PARTITION BY pps.person_id
                               ORDER BY pps.date_start) AS rank
   FROM per_periods_of_service pps,per_all_people_f papf
   WHERE papf.person_id = pps.person_id
     AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'),
     tab_license_table AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pdl.license_number,pdl.date_to date_to_license,pdlt.license_type,
                   pdl.person_id,pdl.date_from emissao_cateira,pdl.issuing_location,
                   pdl.issuing_authority
   FROM per_drivers_licenses pdl,per_drivers_license_types pdlt
   WHERE pdlt.drivers_license_id = pdl.drivers_license_id),
     approval_table AS
  (SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES' item
   FROM per_drivers_licenses x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES'
   FROM per_email_addresses x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_ETHNICITIES'
   FROM per_ethnicities x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS'
   FROM per_national_identifiers x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PASSPORTS'
   FROM per_passports x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F'
   FROM per_person_addr_usages_f x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F'
   FROM per_all_people_f x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PERSONS'
   FROM per_persons x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PEOPLE_EXTRA_INFO_F'
   FROM per_people_extra_info_f x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F'
   FROM per_people_legislative_f x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PERSON_NAMES_F'
   FROM per_person_names_f x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN x.effective_start_date AND x.effective_end_date
     AND x.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PERSON_TYPE_USAGES_M'
   FROM per_person_type_usages_m x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_PHONES'
   FROM per_phones x
   WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                'T', ' '),
                                         1, 19),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
   UNION ALL SELECT person_id,last_update_date,item
   FROM
     (SELECT x.person_id,x.last_update_date,'PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F' item,rank() over(PARTITION BY x.person_id
                                                                                            ORDER BY x.last_update_date DESC) rank
      FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f x
      WHERE x.last_update_date >= to_date(substr(REPLACE(:p_data_integracao,
                                                   'T', ' '),
                                            1, 19),
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
      ORDER BY x.last_update_date DESC)
   WHERE rank = 1),
     pai_table AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pcrp.person_id,ppnp.first_name,ppnp.middle_names,ppnp.last_name,
                   ppnp.legislation_code,'FTR' name_type
   FROM per_contact_relationships pcrp,per_all_people_f papfp,per_person_names_f ppnp
   WHERE papfp.person_id = pcrp.person_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papfp.effective_start_date AND papfp.effective_end_date
     AND ppnp.person_id(+) = pcrp.contact_person_id
     AND ppnp.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppnp.effective_start_date AND ppnp.effective_end_date
     AND pcrp.contact_type = 'IN_FR'),
     paa_table AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT paam.person_id,paam.union_id,houf.name union_name,
                   paam.ass_attribute1 odb_on_oog,prog.description odb_prog,paam.ass_attribute5 odb_area,
                   paam.assignment_number,paam.assignment_id,paam.grade_id,grade.grade_code,
                   grade.grade_name,step.step_id,step.step_name,paam.date_probation_end,
                   paam.probation_period,paam.probation_unit,paam.establishment_id,
                   paam.employment_category,paam.labour_union_member_flag,paam.reason_code,
                   paam.organization_id,paam.location_id,paam.job_id,estab.name estab_name,
                   depto.attribute5 cod_depto,depto.attribute8 empresa,depto.attribute1 centro_custo,
                   depto.attribute2 estab_depto,pjf.job_code,loc.location_code,loc.estab_uo,
                   paam.full_part_time,paam.permanent_temporary_flag,paam.normal_hours,

                   paam.assignment_status_type,paam.action_code,paam.system_person_type,paam.assignment_type,
                   paam.creation_date,paam.last_update_date,paam.last_updated_by,
                   paam.effective_start_date,paam.period_of_service_id,cron.description id_cronograma,
                   ponto.flex_value bate_ponto,ponto.description bate_ponto_descricao,
                   paam.ass_attribute6 cd_executivo,paam.projected_assignment_end,paam.retirement_date,
                   cmps.salary_basis_code,

     (SELECT depto_name.name
      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl depto_name
      WHERE depto_name.language = 'PTB'
        AND depto_name.organization_id = depto.organization_id
        AND rownum = 1) nome_departamento
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam,hr_organization_units_f_tl houf,hr_organization_units_f_tl estab,
        hr_all_organization_units_f depto,per_jobs_f pjf,cmp_salary cmps,approval_table apr_wf,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value,ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs,fnd_flex_values ffv,fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PROGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) prog,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value,ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs,fnd_flex_values ffv,fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_CRONOGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) cron,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value,ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs,fnd_flex_values ffv,fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PONTO'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) ponto,

     (SELECT ploc.location_id,ploc.internal_location_code location_code,
             pldf.attribute1 estab_uo
      FROM per_locations ploc,per_location_details_f pldf
      WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc,

     (SELECT pgf.grade_id,pgf.grade_code,pgftl.name grade_name
      FROM per_grades_f pgf,per_grades_f_tl pgftl
      WHERE pgftl.grade_id = pgf.grade_id
        AND pgftl.language = 'PTB') grade,

     (SELECT pagsf.assignment_id,pgsx.grade_step_id step_id,pgsx.sequence step_name
      FROM per_grade_steps_x pgsx,per_assign_grade_steps_f pagsf
      WHERE pgsx.grade_step_id = pagsf.grade_step_id
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pgsx.effective_start_date AND pgsx.effective_end_date
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pagsf.effective_start_date AND pagsf.effective_end_date) step
   WHERE paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam.action_code IN ('REHIRE','HIRE','MANAGER_CHANGE','JOB_CHANGE','PROMOTION',
                              'ORA_POS_SYNC','ASG_CHANGE','WORK_HOURS_CHANGE','ADD_ASSIGN',
                              'POSITION_CHANGE','TEMP_ASG','CMP_WKHR','3')
     AND paam.system_person_type = 'EMP'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.person_id = apr_wf.person_id
     AND houf.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
     AND houf.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
     AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
     AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
     AND pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND pjf.effective_end_date
     AND loc.location_id(+) = paam.location_id
     AND grade.grade_id(+) = paam.grade_id
     AND step.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN cmps.date_from(+) AND cmps.date_to(+)
     AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
     AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND prog.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute3
     AND cron.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute4
     AND ponto.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute2
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date)
SELECT DISTINCT translate(
                            (SELECT org.internal_address_line
                             FROM hr_all_organization_units org
                             WHERE org.organization_id = paa.union_id
                               AND rownum = 1) ,'a./-', 'a') union_inscr,pai.first_name pai_first_name,pai.middle_names pai_middle_names,
                pai.last_name pai_last_name,pai.legislation_code pai_legislation_code,
                pai.name_type pai_name_type,pplf.attribute18 mae_first_name,
                pplf.attribute20 mae_middle_names,pplf.attribute19 mae_last_name,
                pplf.legislation_code mae_legislation_code,'MTR' mae_name_type,paa.person_id,
                                                                 ppnf.first_name first_name,
                                                                 ppnf.middle_names middle_names,
                                                                 ppnf.last_name last_name,
                                                                 paa.union_name union_name,paa.union_id,
                                                                 paa.odb_on_oog,paa.odb_prog,
                                                                 paa.odb_area,
                                                                 paa.assignment_number,
                                                                 paa.assignment_id,paa.grade_id,
                                                                 paa.grade_code,paa.grade_name,
                                                                 paa.step_id,paa.step_name,
                                                                 paa.date_probation_end,
                                                                 paa.probation_period,
                                                                 paa.probation_unit,
                                                                 paa.employment_category,
                                                                 paa.reason_code,paa.estab_name,
                                                                 paa.organization_id,
                                                                 paa.location_id,paa.job_id,
                                                                 paa.cod_depto,paa.empresa,
                                                                 paa.centro_custo,
                                                                 paa.estab_depto,paa.job_code,
                                                                 paa.location_code,paa.estab_uo,
                                                                 paa.full_part_time,
                                                                 paa.permanent_temporary_flag,
                                                                 paa.normal_hours,
                                                                 paa.hourly_salaried_code,
                                                                 paa.salary_amount,
                                                                 paa.salary_basis_code,
                                                                 paa.currency_code,
                                                                 paa.employee_category,
                                                                 paa.assignment_status_type,
                                                                 paa.action_code,
                                                                 paa.system_person_type,
                                                                 paa.assignment_type,
                                                                 paa.creation_date,
                                                                 paa.last_update_date,
                                                                 paa.labour_union_member_flag,
                                                                 paa.effective_start_date,
                                                                 paa.retirement_date,
                                                                 pplf.highest_education_level,
                                                                 apr_wf.last_update_date completed_date,
                                                                 apr_wf.item item_changed,
                                                                 pplf.attribute16 rg_issuedby_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute_date1 rg_issued_dt_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute13 rg_state_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute3 voter_zone_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute2 voter_section_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute4 voter_city_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute5 voter_state_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute6 militar_series_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute15 militar_region_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute14 militar_state_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute12 mil_cert_type_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute7 militar_cat_bra,
                                                                 pplf.attribute_date2 pis_pasep_dt_bra,
                                                                 paa.id_cronograma id_cronograma,
                                                                 decode(paa.bate_ponto,
                                                                   '01', '1', '0') bate_ponto,
                                                                 paa.bate_ponto_descricao,
                                                                 ppof.attribute10 aposentado,
                                                                 ppof.projected_termination_date,
                                                                 ppof.pds_information10 tp_contrato,
                                                                 CASE
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.effective_start_date ELSE NULL
                                                                 END AS bgn_dt_cntr1,
                                                                 CASE
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                          AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 44)
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.projected_assignment_end ELSE NULL
                                                                 END AS end_dt_cntr1,
                                                                 CASE
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                          AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 45)
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL ELSE NULL
                                                                 END AS bgn_dt_cntr2,
                                                                 CASE
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date + 89
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL ELSE NULL
                                                                 END AS end_dt_cntr2,
                                                                 paa.cd_executivo,
                                                                 CASE
                                                                     WHEN ppof.pds_information2 <> 'ORA_HRX_BR_HI_NORM_01' THEN nvl(ed.hire_date,

                                                                                                                                  ppof.date_start)
                                                                     ELSE nvl(hd.hire_date,

                                                                            ppof.date_start)
                                                                 END AS hire_date,
                                                                 tab_license.license_number,
                                                                 tab_license.date_to_license,
                                                                 tab_license.license_type,
                                                                 tab_license.emissao_cateira,
                                                                 tab_license.issuing_location,
                                                                 tab_license.issuing_authority,
                                                                 paa.nome_departamento,
                                                                 pplf.per_information1 numero_ctps,
                                                                 pplf.per_information2 serie_ctps,
                                                                 y6.geography_element2 uf_estado_ctps,
                                                                 pplf.per_information_date1 data_ctps,

  (SELECT assignment_id
   FROM
     (SELECT paam.assignment_number,paam.assignment_id,
             rank() over(PARTITION BY pasf.person_id
                         ORDER BY pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                      pasf.effective_end_date DESC, paam.effective_end_date DESC) AS rank
      FROM per_all_assignments_m paam,per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
      WHERE pasf.assignment_id = paa.assignment_id
        AND paam.person_id = pasf.manager_id
        AND pasf.manager_assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
        AND assignment_type = 'E'
        AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pasf.effective_start_date AND pasf.effective_end_date)
   WHERE rank = 1) assignment_id_superior
FROM per_all_assignments_m papf,hire_dates hd,empres_hire ed,per_person_names_f ppnf,

  (SELECT pl.*,
          rank() over(PARTITION BY person_id
                      ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_people_legislative_f pl) pplf,per_periods_of_service ppof,tab_license_table tab_license,pai_table pai,
     paa_table paa,

  (SELECT geography_element2,geography_element2_id,COUNT(geography_element2_id)
   FROM hz_geographies
   WHERE geography_type = 'STATE'
   GROUP BY geography_element2,geography_element2_id) y6,approval_table apr_wf
WHERE papf.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, papf.person_id)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paa.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m m
     WHERE m.person_id = paa.person_id
       AND m.period_of_service_id = paa.period_of_service_id
       AND SYSDATE BETWEEN m.effective_start_date AND m.effective_end_date)
  AND apr_wf.last_update_date >= TO_DATE (substr(replace(:p_data_integracao,
                                                   'T', ' '),
                                            1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND pai.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND paa.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
  AND apr_wf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND to_char(pplf.effective_end_date(+), 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND ppof.period_of_service_id = paa.period_of_service_id
  AND ppof.person_id = paa.person_id
  AND tab_license.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND hd.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND ed.person_id = paa.person_id
  AND pplf.per_information_number1 = y6.geography_element2_id(+)
  AND hd.rank(+) = 1
  AND ed.rank = 1
  AND pplf.rank(+) = 1
```

### Query #5
