```sql
WITH HIRE_DATES AS
  (SELECT PPS.DATE_START AS HIRE_DATE, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME, PPS.PERSON_ID, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER,
          PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER, PPNF.DISPLAY_NAME,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PPS.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY PPS.DATE_START DESC) AS RANK
   FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPS,

     (SELECT ASG.*,
             RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ASG.PERSON_ID, ASG.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                          ORDER BY ASG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, ASG.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE) AS RANK
      FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ASG
      WHERE ASG.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE='E'
        AND ASSIGNMENT_NAME != 'ESTAGIARIO') PAAM, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
        PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI
   WHERE PAAM.RANK = 1
     AND PAAM.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NULL
     AND PAAM.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = PPS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
     AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
     AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
     AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND TO_CHAR(PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND PNI.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
     AND PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
     AND TO_CHAR(PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY') = '4712'),
     EMPRES_HIRE AS
  (SELECT PPS.DATE_START AS HIRE_DATE, PPS.PERSON_ID, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PPS.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY PPS.DATE_START) AS RANK
   FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF
   WHERE PAPF.PERSON_ID = PPS.PERSON_ID
     AND TO_CHAR(PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY') = '4712'),
     TAB_LICENSE_TABLE AS
  (SELECT PDL.LICENSE_NUMBER,PDL.DATE_TO DATE_TO_LICENSE,PDLT.LICENSE_TYPE,PDL.person_id,
          PDL.DATE_FROM EMISSAO_CATEIRA,PDL.ISSUING_LOCATION,PDL.ISSUING_AUTHORITY
   FROM PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES PDL,PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES PDLT
   WHERE PDLT.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID = PDL.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID),
     PAI_TABLE AS
  (SELECT pcrp.person_id, ppnp.first_name, ppnp.middle_names, ppnp.last_name, ppnp.legislation_code,
          'FTR' name_type
   FROM per_contact_relationships pcrp, per_all_people_f papfp, per_person_names_f ppnp
   WHERE papfp.person_id = pcrp.person_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papfp.effective_start_date AND papfp.effective_end_date
     AND ppnp.person_id(+) = pcrp.contact_person_id
     AND ppnp.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppnp.effective_start_date AND ppnp.effective_end_date
     AND pcrp.contact_type = 'IN_FR'),
     PAA_TABLE AS
  (SELECT paam.person_id, paam.union_id, houf.name union_name, paam.ass_attribute1 odb_on_oog,
          prog.description odb_prog, paam.ass_attribute5 odb_area, paam.assignment_number, paam.assignment_id,
          paam.grade_id, grade.grade_code, grade.grade_name, step.step_id, step.step_name,
          paam.date_probation_end, paam.probation_period, paam.probation_unit, paam.establishment_id,
          paam.employment_category, paam.labour_union_member_flag, paam.reason_code, paam.organization_id,
          paam.location_id, paam.job_id, estab.name estab_name, depto.attribute5 cod_depto,
          depto.attribute8 empresa, depto.attribute1 centro_custo, depto.attribute2 estab_depto, pjf.job_code,
          loc.location_code, loc.estab_Uo, paam.full_part_time, paam.permanent_temporary_flag,
          paam.normal_hours, paam.hourly_salaried_code, cmps.salary_amount, cmps.currency_code,
          paam.employee_category, paam.assignment_status_type, paam.action_code, paam.system_person_type,
          paam.assignment_type, paam.creation_date, paam.last_update_date, paam.last_updated_by,
          paam.effective_start_date, paam.period_of_service_id, cron.description id_cronograma,
          ponto.flex_value bate_ponto, ponto.description bate_ponto_descricao,
          paam.ass_attribute6 cd_executivo, paam.projected_assignment_end, paam.RETIREMENT_DATE,
          cmps.salary_basis_code,

     (SELECT depto_name.name
      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl depto_name
      WHERE depto_name.language = 'PTB'
        AND depto_name.organization_id = depto.organization_id
        AND rownum = 1) nome_departamento
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, hr_organization_units_f_tl houf, hr_organization_units_f_tl estab,
        hr_all_organization_units_f depto, per_jobs_f pjf, cmp_salary cmps,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PROGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) prog,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_CRONOGRAMA'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) cron,

     (SELECT ffv.flex_value, ffvt.description
      FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs, fnd_flex_values ffv, fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
      WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'CLIENT_A_PONTO'
        AND ffv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvt.flex_value_id = ffv.flex_value_id
        AND ffvt.language = userenv('LANG')) ponto,

     (SELECT ploc.location_id, ploc.internal_location_code location_code, pldf.attribute1 estab_Uo
      FROM per_locations ploc, per_location_details_f pldf
      WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc,

     (SELECT pgf.grade_id, pgf.grade_code, pgftl.name grade_name
      FROM per_grades_f pgf, per_grades_f_tl pgftl
      WHERE pgftl.grade_id = pgf.grade_id
        AND pgftl.language = 'PTB') grade,

     (SELECT pagsf.ASSIGNMENT_ID, pgsx.GRADE_STEP_ID step_id, pgsx.SEQUENCE step_name
      FROM PER_GRADE_STEPS_X pgsx, PER_ASSIGN_GRADE_STEPS_F pagsf
      WHERE pgsx.GRADE_STEP_ID = pagsf.GRADE_STEP_ID
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pgsx.effective_start_date AND pgsx.effective_end_date
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pagsf.effective_start_date AND pagsf.effective_end_date) step
   WHERE paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam.action_code IN ('HIRE','REHIRE')
     AND paam.system_person_type = 'EMP'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND houf.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
     AND houf.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date(+), 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
     AND depto.attribute2 NOT IN ('VIE001', 'VIE003')
     AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
     AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
     AND pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND pjf.effective_end_date
     AND loc.location_id(+) = paam.location_id
     AND grade.grade_id(+) = paam.grade_id
     AND step.ASSIGNMENT_ID(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN cmps.date_from(+) AND cmps.date_to(+)
     AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
     AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND prog.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute3
     AND cron.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute4
     AND ponto.flex_value(+) = paam.ass_attribute2),
     APPROVAL_TABLE AS
  (SELECT txnh.subject_id person_id, txnd.completed_date,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY txnh.subject_id, txnh.module_identifier
                       ORDER BY txnd.completed_date DESC) AS rank
   FROM fusion.hrc_txn_header txnh, fusion.hrc_txn_data txnd, fa_fusion_soainfra.wftask wft,
        fusion.hrc_txn_error txne
   WHERE txnh.transaction_id = txnd.transaction_id
     AND txnh.transaction_id = txne.transaction_id(+)
     AND TO_CHAR(txnh.transaction_id) = wft.identificationkey(+)
     AND txnd.status = 'APPROVED'
     AND txnh.subject = 'PER_PERSONS'
     AND txnh.object = 'PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F'
     AND txnh.module_identifier IN ('Hire an Employee','AddWorkRelationship')
     AND NOT EXISTS
       (SELECT 'x'
        FROM fusion.hrc_txn_data aux
        WHERE aux.transaction_id = txnd.transaction_id
          AND aux.status <> 'APPROVED'))
SELECT DISTINCT TRANSLATE(
                            (SELECT ORG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE
                             FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS ORG
                             WHERE ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID=paa.UNION_ID
                               AND ROWNUM=1),'a./-', 'a') UNION_INSCR, pai.first_name pai_first_name,
                pai.middle_names pai_middle_names, pai.last_name pai_last_name,
                pai.legislation_code pai_legislation_code, pai.name_type pai_name_type,
                pplf.attribute18 mae_first_name, pplf.attribute20 mae_middle_names,
                pplf.attribute19 mae_last_name, pplf.legislation_code mae_legislation_code, 'MTR' mae_name_type,
                                                                                                  paa.person_id,
                                                                                                  ppnf.first_name first_name,
                                                                                                  ppnf.middle_names middle_names,
                                                                                                  ppnf.last_name last_name,
                                                                                                  paa.union_name union_name,
                                                                                                  paa.union_id,
                                                                                                  paa.odb_on_oog,
                                                                                                  paa.odb_prog,
                                                                                                  paa.odb_area,
                                                                                                  paa.assignment_number,
                                                                                                  paa.assignment_id,
                                                                                                  paa.grade_id,
                                                                                                  paa.grade_code,
                                                                                                  paa.grade_name,
                                                                                                  paa.step_id,
                                                                                                  paa.step_name,
                                                                                                  paa.date_probation_end,
                                                                                                  paa.probation_period,
                                                                                                  paa.probation_unit,
                                                                                                  paa.employment_category,
                                                                                                  paa.reason_code,
                                                                                                  paa.estab_name,
                                                                                                  paa.organization_id,
                                                                                                  paa.location_id,
                                                                                                  paa.job_id,
                                                                                                  paa.cod_depto,
                                                                                                  paa.empresa,
                                                                                                  paa.centro_custo,
                                                                                                  paa.estab_depto,
                                                                                                  paa.job_code,
                                                                                                  paa.location_code,
                                                                                                  paa.estab_Uo,
                                                                                                  paa.full_part_time,
                                                                                                  paa.permanent_temporary_flag,
                                                                                                  paa.normal_hours,
                                                                                                  paa.hourly_salaried_code,
                                                                                                  paa.salary_amount,
                                                                                                  paa.salary_basis_code,
                                                                                                  paa.currency_code,
                                                                                                  paa.employee_category,
                                                                                                  paa.assignment_status_type,
                                                                                                  paa.action_code,
                                                                                                  paa.system_person_type,
                                                                                                  paa.assignment_type,
                                                                                                  paa.creation_date,
                                                                                                  paa.last_update_date,
                                                                                                  paa.labour_union_member_flag,
                                                                                                  paa.effective_start_date,
                                                                                                  paa.RETIREMENT_DATE,
                                                                                                  pplf.highest_education_level,
                                                                                                  apr_wf.completed_date,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute16 rg_issuedby_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute_date1 rg_issued_dt_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute13 rg_state_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute3 voter_zone_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute2 voter_section_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute4 voter_city_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute5 voter_state_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute6 militar_series_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute15 militar_region_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute14 militar_state_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute12 mil_cert_type_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute7 militar_cat_bra,
                                                                                                  pplf.attribute_date2 pis_pasep_dt_bra,
                                                                                                  paa.id_cronograma id_cronograma,
                                                                                                  decode(paa.bate_ponto,

                                                                                                    '01',
                                                                                                    '1',
                                                                                                    '0') bate_ponto,
                                                                                                  paa.bate_ponto_descricao,
                                                                                                  ppof.attribute10 aposentado,
                                                                                                  ppof.projected_termination_date,
                                                                                                  ppof.pds_information10 tp_contrato,
                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.effective_start_date
                                                                                                      ELSE NULL
                                                                                                  END AS bgn_dt_cntr1,
                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                                                           AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 44)
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN paa.projected_assignment_end
                                                                                                      ELSE NULL
                                                                                                  END AS end_dt_cntr1,
                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF'
                                                                                                           AND paa.probation_period IS NOT NULL THEN (paa.effective_start_date + 45)
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL
                                                                                                      ELSE NULL
                                                                                                  END AS bgn_dt_cntr2,
                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_UNDEF' THEN paa.effective_start_date + 89
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information10 = 'ORA_HRX_BR_DET' THEN NULL
                                                                                                      ELSE NULL
                                                                                                  END AS end_dt_cntr2,
                                                                                                  paa.cd_executivo,
                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                      WHEN ppof.pds_information2 <> 'ORA_HRX_BR_HI_NORM_01' THEN nvl(ed.hire_date,

                                                                                                                                                                   ppof.date_start)
                                                                                                      ELSE nvl(hd.hire_date,

                                                                                                             ppof.date_start)
                                                                                                  END AS HIRE_DATE,
                                                                                                  tab_license.LICENSE_NUMBER,
                                                                                                  tab_license.DATE_TO_LICENSE,
                                                                                                  tab_license.LICENSE_TYPE,
                                                                                                  tab_license.EMISSAO_CATEIRA,
                                                                                                  tab_license.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                                                                                                  tab_license.ISSUING_AUTHORITY,
                                                                                                  paa.nome_departamento,
                                                                                                  pplf.PER_INFORMATION1 NUMERO_CTPS,
                                                                                                  pplf.PER_INFORMATION2 SERIE_CTPS,
                                                                                                  Y6.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 UF_ESTADO_CTPS,
                                                                                                  pplf.PER_INFORMATION_DATE1 DATA_CTPS
FROM per_all_people_f papf, hire_dates hd, empres_hire ed,
     per_person_names_f ppnf,

  (SELECT pl.*,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                       ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_people_legislative_f pl
   WHERE pl.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR') pplf, per_periods_of_service ppof, tab_license_table tab_license, pai_table pai,
     paa_table paa,

  (SELECT GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2,GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID,COUNT(GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID)
   FROM HZ_GEOGRAPHIES
   WHERE GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'STATE'
   GROUP BY GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2,GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID) Y6, approval_table apr_wf
WHERE papf.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, papf.person_id)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paa.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m m
     WHERE m.person_id = paa.person_id
       AND m.period_of_service_id = paa.period_of_service_id)
  AND apr_wf.completed_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                 apr_wf.completed_date)
  AND apr_wf.rank(+) = 1
  AND pai.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND paa.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND papf.effective_start_date BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date(+) AND ppnf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND apr_wf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(pplf.effective_end_date(+), 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND ppof.period_of_service_id(+) = paa.period_of_service_id
  AND ppof.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND tab_license.person_id (+) = papf.person_id
  AND hd.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND hd.rank(+) = 1
  AND ed.person_id(+) = paa.person_id
  AND ed.rank(+) = 1
  AND pplf.PER_INFORMATION_NUMBER1 = Y6.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID(+)
  AND pplf.rank(+)=1
```

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, H2, J1, G, D, DOCUMENT_INFO, PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, K...`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `K, C, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD, PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, PER_PHONES, F3, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_PEOPLE_F, PAPF...`

```sql
WITH C AS
  (SELECT C1.*
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F C1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F C2 ON C1.PERSON_ID = C2.PERSON_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, C1.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN C2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(C2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                               TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     D AS
  (SELECT D1.*
   FROM PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F D1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F D2 ON D1.PERSON_ID = D2.PERSON_ID
   AND D1.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, D1.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN D2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(D2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                               TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     K AS
  (SELECT K1.*
   FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE K1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F K2 ON K1.PERSON_ID = K2.PERSON_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, K1.DATE_START)) BETWEEN K2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(K2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                     TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     PAPF AS
  (SELECT PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F.*,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_END_DATE DESC) AS RANK
   FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F),
     F3 AS
  (SELECT F1.*
   FROM PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V F1
   INNER JOIN PAPF F2 ON F1.PERSON_ID = F2.PERSON_ID
   AND F1.ADDRESS_ID = F2.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID
   AND F2.RANK=1
   LEFT JOIN PAPF F3 ON F1.PERSON_ID = F3.PERSON_ID
   AND F1.ADDRESS_ID = F3.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID
   AND F3.RANK=2),
     H1 AS
  (SELECT H1.*,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY H1.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY H1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC, H1.CREATION_DATE DESC) AS RANK
   FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES H1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F H2 ON H1.PERSON_ID = H2.PERSON_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, H1.DATE_FROM)) BETWEEN H2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(H2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                    TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD'))
   WHERE H1.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'),
     H2 AS
  (SELECT H1.*,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY H1.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY H1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC, H1.CREATION_DATE DESC) AS RANK
   FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES H1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F H2 ON H1.PERSON_ID = H2.PERSON_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, H1.DATE_FROM)) BETWEEN H2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(H2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                    TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD'))
   WHERE H1.EMAIL_TYPE = 'H1'),
     J1 AS
  (SELECT J1.*
   FROM PER_PHONES J1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F J2 ON J1.PERSON_ID = J2.PERSON_ID
   AND J2.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = J1.PHONE_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, J1.DATE_FROM)) BETWEEN J2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(J2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                    TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     DOCUMENT_INFO AS
  (SELECT P.PERSON_ID, TRIM(E1.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER) AS CPF_NUM,
          E1.EXPIRATION_DATE AS CPF_EXP_DATE, E1.ISSUE_DATE AS CPF_ISS_DATE, E1.PLACE_OF_ISSUE CPF_POI,
          E1.ATTRIBUTE1 CPF_A1, E1.ATTRIBUTE2 CPF_A2, E1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE CPF_LUD,
          TRIM(E2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER) AS RG_NUM, E2.EXPIRATION_DATE AS RG_EXP_DATE, E2.ISSUE_DATE AS RG_ISS_DATE,
          E2.PLACE_OF_ISSUE RG_POI, E2.ATTRIBUTE1 RG_A1, E2.ATTRIBUTE2 RG_A2, E2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE RG_LUD,
          TRIM(E3.DOCUMENT_NUMBER) AS TIT_NUM, E3.DATE_TO AS TIT_EXP_DATE, E3.ISSUED_DATE AS TIT_ISS_DATE,
          E3.ISSUING_LOCATION TIT_POI, E3.DEI_INFORMATION1 TIT_A1, E3.DEI_INFORMATION2 TIT_A2,
          E3.LAST_UPDATE_DATE TIT_LUD, TRIM(E4.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER) AS PIS_NUM,
          E4.EXPIRATION_DATE AS PIS_EXP_DATE, E4.ISSUE_DATE AS PIS_ISS_DATE, E4.PLACE_OF_ISSUE PIS_POI,
          E4.ATTRIBUTE1 PIS_A1, E4.ATTRIBUTE2 PIS_A2, E4.LAST_UPDATE_DATE PIS_LUD,
          TRIM(E5.DOCUMENT_NUMBER) AS RES_NUM, E5.DATE_TO AS RES_EXP_DATE, E5.ISSUED_DATE AS RES_ISS_DATE,
          E5.ISSUING_LOCATION RES_POI, E5.DEI_INFORMATION1 RES_A1, E5.DEI_INFORMATION2 RES_A2,
          E5.LAST_UPDATE_DATE RES_LUD, TRIM(E6.DOCUMENT_NUMBER) AS CTPS_NUM, E6.DATE_TO AS CTPS_EXP_DATE,
          E6.ISSUED_DATE AS CTPS_ISS_DATE, E6.DEI_ATTRIBUTE1 CTPS_POI, E6.DEI_ATTRIBUTE1 CTPS_A1,
          E6.DEI_ATTRIBUTE2 CTPS_A2, E6.LAST_UPDATE_DATE CTPS_LUD,
          TRIM(NVL(E7.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, E8.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER)) AS RNE_NUM, NVL(E7.DATE_TO,

                                                                                     E8.EXPIRATION_DATE) AS RNE_EXP_DATE,
          NVL(E7.ISSUED_DATE, E8.ISSUE_DATE) AS RNE_ISS_DATE, NVL(E8.PLACE_OF_ISSUE,
                                                                E7.DEI_ATTRIBUTE1) RNE_POI,
          NVL(E7.DEI_ATTRIBUTE1, E8.ATTRIBUTE1) RNE_A1, NVL(E7.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1,
                                                          E8.ATTRIBUTE2) RNE_A2,
          GREATEST(NVL(E7.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, E8.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), E8.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) RNE_LUD
   FROM PER_PEOPLE_F P
   LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS E1 ON E1.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
   AND P.PERSON_ID = E1.PERSON_ID
   LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS E2 ON E2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'RG'
   AND P.PERSON_ID = E2.PERSON_ID
   LEFT JOIN HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD E3 ON P.PERSON_ID = E3.PERSON_ID
   AND E3.DEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'ORA_HRX_BR_ELECTORAL_CARD'
   LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS E4 ON E4.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'PIS'
   AND P.PERSON_ID = E4.PERSON_ID
   LEFT JOIN HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD E5 ON P.PERSON_ID = E5.PERSON_ID
   AND E5.DEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'ORA_HRX_BR_MILITARY_CERTIFICATE'
   LEFT JOIN HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD E6 ON P.PERSON_ID = E6.PERSON_ID
   AND E6.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'BR_CTPS'
   LEFT JOIN HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD E7 ON E7.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'BR_RNE'
   AND P.PERSON_ID = E7.PERSON_ID
   LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS E8 ON E8.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'ORA_HRX_RNE'
   AND P.PERSON_ID = E8.PERSON_ID
   WHERE 1=1
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) AND TRUNC(P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)),
     G AS
  (SELECT NVL(G1.LICENSE_NUMBER, G3.DOCUMENT_NUMBER) AS LICENSE_NUMBER, NVL(G1.DATE_TO,

                                                                          G3.DATE_TO) AS DATE_TO,
          NVL(G1.DATE_FROM, G3.ISSUED_DATE) AS DATE_FROM,
          NVL(G1.ISSUING_LOCATION,

            CASE
                WHEN INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION, '/') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                                                                     1,
                                                                     INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                                                                       '/')-1))
                ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                            1, INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION, '-')-1))
            END) AS ISSUING_LOCATION,
          NVL(G1.ISSUING_AUTHORITY,

            CASE
                WHEN INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION, '/') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,

                                                                     INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                                                                       '/')+1))
                ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION,
                            1, INSTR(G3.ISSUING_LOCATION, '-')+1))
            END) AS ISSUING_AUTHORITY, NVL(G1.LICENSE_TYPE,
                                         G3.DEI_ATTRIBUTE1) AS LICENSE_TYPE,
          NVL(G1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, G3.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, G2.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PEOPLE_F G2
   LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT G1.LICENSE_NUMBER, G1.DATE_TO, G1.DATE_FROM, G1.ISSUING_LOCATION, G1.ISSUING_AUTHORITY,
             G1.PERSON_ID, G11.LICENSE_TYPE, G1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES G1
      INNER JOIN PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES G11 ON G1.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID = G11.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID) G1 ON G1.PERSON_ID = G2.PERSON_ID
   LEFT JOIN HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD G3 ON G2.PERSON_ID = G3.PERSON_ID
   AND G3.DOCUMENT_CODE LIKE '%DRIVERS_LICENSE%'
   WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN G2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(G2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                              TO_DATE('2417-12-31',
                                                                'YYYY-MM-DD'))),
     I AS
  (SELECT I1.*
   FROM PER_VISAS_PERMITS_F I1
   INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F I2 ON I1.PERSON_ID = I2.PERSON_ID
   AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, I1.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN I2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(I2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                               TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD')))
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(B.DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dtNasc, P.PERSON_NUMBER AS idempr, P.PERSON_ID AS pid,
                EMAIL.EMAIL_ADDRESS, B.BLOOD_TYPE AS gpsang,
                UPPER(TRANSLATE(C.FULL_NAME,
                        'ÁáÃãÄäÓóÖöÕõÉéÍíÚúÜüÇç', 'AaAaAaOoOoOoEeIiUuUuCc')) AS nomepf,
                SUBSTR(UPPER(C.DISPLAY_NAME), 1, 20) AS apelid, UPPER(C.KNOWN_AS) AS nomsoc,
                CASE D.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 'Feminino' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Masculino'
                END AS sexopf, D.MARITAL_STATUS AS estciv, DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_NUM AS ctpsnr,
                CASE
                    WHEN INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2, '/') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2,
                                                                           1,
                                                                           INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2,
                                                                             '/')-1))
                    WHEN INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2, '-') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2,
                                                                           1,
                                                                           INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2,
                                                                             '-')-1)) ELSE DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A2
                END AS ctpssr, DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_A1 AS ctpsuf,
                TO_CHAR(K.PROJECTED_TERMINATION_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS esdtpr,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_ISS_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_ISS_DATE,

                                                                        'DD/MM/YYYY')
                END AS dtctrb, H1.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS emailp, H2.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS mailAl,
                CASE F3.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3 WHEN 'Street' THEN 'Rua' WHEN 'Avenue' THEN 'Avenida' WHEN 'Estr.' THEN 'Estrada' WHEN 'Rod.' THEN 'Rodovia' ELSE F3.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3
                END AS logtip, UPPER(SUBSTR(F3.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
                                       1, 80)) AS nomend,
                UPPER(SUBSTR(F3.ADDRESS_LINE_2, 1, 10)) AS nroend, UPPER(SUBSTR(F3.ADDRESS_LINE_3,
                                                                           1, 30)) AS cplend,
                UPPER(SUBSTR(F3.ADDRESS_LINE_4, 1, 60)) AS nombai, REGEXP_REPLACE(F3.POSTAL_CODE,
                                                                     '-', '') AS nrocep,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_NUM AS docide,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_ISS_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_ISS_DATE,

                                                                      'DD/MM/YYYY')
                END AS datide,
                CASE
                    WHEN INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI, '/') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                                                          1,
                                                                          INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                                                            '/')-1))
                    ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                1, INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                     '-')-1))
                END AS docidu,
                CASE
                    WHEN INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI, '/') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,

                                                                          INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                                                            '/') +1))
                    ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI,
                                INSTR(DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_POI, '-') +1))
                END AS docido, DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_NUM AS titele,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_A1 AS titzon, DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_A2 AS titsec,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.RES_NUM AS cerres, DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_NUM AS nropis,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_POI AS locempis,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_ISS_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_ISS_DATE,

                                                                       'DD/MM/YYYY')
                END AS datpis, DOCUMENT_INFO.RNE_NUM AS doides, DOCUMENT_INFO.RNE_POI AS RNEemi,
                G.LICENSE_NUMBER AS crthab, TRANSLATE(J1.PHONE_NUMBER,
                                              'a-', 'a') AS telefp,
                J1.AREA_CODE AS dddtel, G.ISSUING_LOCATION AS ufcnh,
                TO_CHAR(G.DATE_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dtvlch, TO_CHAR(G.DATE_FROM,
                                                              'DD/MM/YYYY') AS cnhexp,
                G.ISSUING_AUTHORITY AS orghab, NVL(A.ESTABLISHMENT_ID,
                                                 A.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID) AS LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
                REPLACE(DOCUMENT_INFO.CPF_NUM, '-', '') AS NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.CREATION_DATE,
                CASE
                    WHEN B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS BASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN C.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS CASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN D.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS DASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.CPF_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS CPFASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS RGASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS TITASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS PISASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.RES_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS RESASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS CTPSASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN DOCUMENT_INFO.RNE_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS RNEASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN F3.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS F3ASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN H1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS H1ASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN H2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS H2ASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN J1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS J1ASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS GASS,
                CASE
                    WHEN I.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 'SIM'
                END AS IASS, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS BLUD, C.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS CLUD,
                D.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS DLUD, F3.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS F3LUD, H1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS H1LUD,
                H2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS H2LUD, J1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS J1LUD, G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS GLUD,
                I.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS ILUD, DOCUMENT_INFO.CPF_LUD, DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_LUD,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_LUD, DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_LUD, DOCUMENT_INFO.RES_LUD,
                DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_LUD, DOCUMENT_INFO.RNE_LUD
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M A
INNER JOIN
  (SELECT LAST_UPDATE_DATE,EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY PERSON_ID
                                                                                ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC,

                                                                             LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) RANK
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M
   WHERE TO_CHAR(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')='4712-12-31') ASSLUD ON A.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = ASSLUD.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = ASSLUD.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
AND A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE=ASSLUD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
AND ASSLUD.RANK=1
INNER JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F P ON A.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                          TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                            'YYYY-MM-DD'))
INNER JOIN PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE KR ON A.PERSON_ID = KR.PERSON_ID
AND A.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = KR.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
LEFT JOIN K ON A.PERSON_ID = K.PERSON_ID
AND A.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = K.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
LEFT JOIN PER_PEOPLE_F B ON A.PERSON_ID = B.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN B.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(B.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                          TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                            'YYYY-MM-DD'))
LEFT JOIN C ON A.PERSON_ID = C.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN C.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(C.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                          TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                            'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND C.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'
LEFT JOIN D ON A.PERSON_ID = D.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN D.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(D.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                          TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                            'YYYY-MM-DD'))
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT NAME, CONTENT_ITEM_CODE AS CNPJ
   FROM HRT_CONTENT_ITEMS_VL
   WHERE COUNTRY_ID=
       (SELECT GEOGRAPHY_ID
        FROM HZ_GEOGRAPHIES
        WHERE COUNTRY_CODE='BR'
          AND GEOGRAPHY_TYPE='COUNTRY'
          AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
     AND CONTENT_VALUE_SET_ID=100000000342952) ESC_EST ON ESC_EST.CNPJ = K.PDS_INFORMATION16
LEFT JOIN F3 ON A.PERSON_ID = F3.PERSON_ID
AND TO_CHAR(F3.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY')='4712'
LEFT JOIN H1 ON A.PERSON_ID = H1.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN H1.DATE_FROM AND COALESCE(H1.DATE_TO,

                                                                                TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND H1.RANK=1
LEFT JOIN H2 ON A.PERSON_ID = H2.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN H2.DATE_FROM AND COALESCE(H2.DATE_TO,

                                                                                TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND H2.RANK=1
LEFT JOIN J1 ON A.PERSON_ID = J1.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN J1.DATE_FROM AND COALESCE(J1.DATE_TO,

                                                                                TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD'))
LEFT JOIN G ON A.PERSON_ID = G.PERSON_ID
LEFT JOIN I ON A.PERSON_ID = I.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN I.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(I.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                          TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                            'YYYY-MM-DD'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F DAUX ON A.PERSON_ID = DAUX.PERSON_ID
AND TRUNC(GREATEST(SYSDATE, A.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)) BETWEEN DAUX.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND COALESCE(DAUX.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                                             TO_DATE('2417-12-31',

                                                                                               'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND DAUX.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
LEFT JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES Z1 ON Z1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'NU_DISABILITY_CATEGORY'
AND Z1.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND Z1.LOOKUP_CODE = D.ATTRIBUTE1
LEFT JOIN DOCUMENT_INFO ON A.PERSON_ID = DOCUMENT_INFO.PERSON_ID
LEFT JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMAIL ON EMAIL.PERSON_ID = A.PERSON_ID
AND EMAIL.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
WHERE 1=1
  AND A.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E','EMP')
  AND A.PRIMARY_FLAG='Y'
  AND A.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ((:pPersonNumber IS NULL
        AND :pPersonId IS NULL
        AND (B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                     'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR C.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR D.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.CPF_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.RG_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.TIT_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.PIS_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.RES_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.CTPS_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR DOCUMENT_INFO.RNE_LUD >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR F3.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                         'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR H1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                         'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR H2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                         'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR J1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                         'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
             OR I.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(:pDtProcessamento,
                                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
        AND EXTRACT (DAY
                     FROM ((A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE - A.CREATION_DATE)*1440)) > 15)
       OR A.PERSON_ID = :pPersonId
       OR P.PERSON_NUMBER=:pPersonNumber)
```

### Query #7

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_DISABILITIES_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, BEN_PL_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, PER_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIPS...`

### Query #7

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_DISABILITIES_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIPS, BEN_PL_F...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pcr.person_id, pcr.contact_type, papf.person_number,
                papd.person_number dep_person_number, pcr.effective_start_date, pcr.effective_end_date,
                CASE WHEN pcr.effective_end_date < SYSDATE THEN 'I' ELSE 'A'
                END status, ppn.name_type, ppn.first_name, ppn.middle_names, ppn.last_name,
                pp.date_of_birth, pp.date_of_death, pp.country_of_birth, pp.town_of_birth,
                pp.region_of_birth, pplfdep.sex, pplfdep.marital_status marital_status,
                pplfdep.highest_education_level, pni.national_identifier_type, pni.national_identifier_number,
                CASE WHEN pcd.disability_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END disabled_bra,
                NVL(SUBSTR(pcrf.statutory_dependent, 5, 1), 'N') statutory_dependent, NULL dml_operation,
                                                                                           NULL effdt_old,
                                                                                                NULL national_id_type_old,
                                                                                                     pplf.legislation_code,
                                                                                                     pcr.cont_attribute1 mother_name,

  (SELECT xr.registration_number
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
     AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
     AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
     AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                     1, instr(houft.name,
                                                          '-') - 1)
                                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                               per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                   WHERE houft.organization_id = perassign.establishment_id
                                     AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                     AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
     AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR,

  (SELECT hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE
   FROM hz_geography_identifiers hgi,hz_geographies hg
   WHERE identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE'
     AND hg.geography_id = hgi.geography_id
     AND hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hg.country_code = 'BR'
     AND hgi.language_code = 'US'
     AND upper(hg.geography_element3) = pp.town_of_birth
     AND rownum = 1) IBGE_CODE,

  (SELECT bep.PL_CD
   FROM ben_pl_f bep,ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bepe
   WHERE bep.pl_id = bepe.pl_id
     AND bepe.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND rownum = 1) CD_CONVENIO,
                                                                                                     tab_license.ISSUING_AUTHORITY,

  (SELECT pni2.national_identifier_number
   FROM per_national_identifiers pni2
   WHERE pni2.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
     AND pni2.national_identifier_type = 'RG'
     AND rownum = 1) NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER_RG,

  (SELECT pni2.issue_date
   FROM per_national_identifiers pni2
   WHERE pni2.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
     AND pni2.national_identifier_type = 'RG'
     AND rownum = 1) ISSUE_DATE_RG,
                                                                                                     pai.first_name PAI_FIRST_NAME,
                                                                                                     pai.middle_names PAI_MIDDLE_NAMES,
                                                                                                     pai.last_name PAI_LAST_NAME,
                                                                                                     mae.first_name MAE_FIRST_NAME,
                                                                                                     mae.middle_names MAE_MIDDLE_NAMES,
                                                                                                     mae.last_name MAE_LAST_NAME,
                                                                                                     pplf.attribute16 ORG_EMISSOR,
                                                                                                     perassign.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr, per_contact_relships_f pcrf, per_all_people_f papf,
     per_all_people_f papd, per_persons pp, per_person_names_f ppn,
     per_people_legislative_f_v pplf, per_people_legislative_f_v pplfdep, per_national_identifiers pni,
     per_all_assignments_m perassign,

  (SELECT person_id, MAX(disability_id) disability_id
   FROM per_disabilities_f
   GROUP BY person_id) pcd,

  (SELECT PDL.LICENSE_NUMBER,PDL.DATE_TO DATE_TO_LICENSE,PDLT.LICENSE_TYPE,PDL.person_id,
          PDL.DATE_FROM EMISSAO_CATEIRA,PDL.ISSUING_LOCATION,PDL.ISSUING_AUTHORITY
   FROM PER_DRIVERS_LICENSES PDL,PER_DRIVERS_LICENSE_TYPES PDLT
   WHERE PDLT.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID = PDL.DRIVERS_LICENSE_ID) tab_license,

  (SELECT pcrp.person_id, ppnp.first_name, ppnp.middle_names, ppnp.last_name, ppnp.legislation_code,
          'FTR' name_type
   FROM per_contact_relationships pcrp, per_all_people_f papfp, per_person_names_f ppnp
   WHERE papfp.person_id = pcrp.person_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papfp.effective_start_date AND papfp.effective_end_date
     AND ppnp.person_id(+) = pcrp.contact_person_id
     AND ppnp.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppnp.effective_start_date AND ppnp.effective_end_date
     AND pcrp.contact_type = 'IN_FR') pai,

  (SELECT pcrp.person_id, ppnp.first_name, ppnp.middle_names, ppnp.last_name, ppnp.legislation_code,
          'FTR' name_type
   FROM per_contact_relationships pcrp, per_all_people_f papfp, per_person_names_f ppnp
   WHERE papfp.person_id = pcrp.person_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papfp.effective_start_date AND papfp.effective_end_date
     AND ppnp.person_id(+) = pcrp.contact_person_id
     AND ppnp.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ppnp.effective_start_date AND ppnp.effective_end_date
     AND pcrp.contact_type = 'IN_MR') mae
WHERE (pcr.person_id = :p_person_id
       OR pcr.contact_person_id = :p_person_id)
  AND papf.person_id = pcr.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f aux
     WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.person_id)
  AND papd.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND papd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f aux
     WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
  AND pp.person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND ppn.person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND ppn.name_type(+) = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppn.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f aux
     WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
  AND pplf.person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND pplfdep.person_id(+) = papd.person_id
  AND pni.person_id (+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND pcd.person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND pcrf.contact_person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f aux
     WHERE aux.contact_person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
  AND tab_license.person_id (+) = papf.person_id
  AND pai.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND mae.person_id(+) = pcr.contact_person_id
  AND perassign.person_id (+) = papf.person_id
  AND perassign.effective_end_date > SYSDATE
  AND perassign.primary_flag = 'Y'
  AND perassign.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND perassign.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND pp.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL
```

### Query #8

### Query #8

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PER_LOCATION_DETAILS_F, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ADDRESSES_F`

```sql
SELECT pl.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE, plf.attribute1 estabelecimento, plf.ACTIVE_STATUS, pl.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
       plft.LOCATION_NAME, pla.LOCATION_ID, plft.DESCRIPTION, pa.ADDRESS_ID, pa.COUNTRY, pa.POSTAL_CODE,
       pa.REGION_2, pa.TOWN_OR_CITY, pa.ADDRESS_LINE_1, pa.ADDRESS_LINE_2, pa.ADDRESS_LINE_4,
       pa.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3,

  (SELECT hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE
   FROM hz_geography_identifiers hgi,hz_geographies hg
   WHERE identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE'
     AND hg.geography_id = hgi.geography_id
     AND hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hg.country_code = 'BR'
     AND hgi.language_code = 'US'
     AND upper(hg.geography_element3) = upper(pa.town_or_city)
     AND hgi.IDENTIFIER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
     AND rownum = 1) IBGE_CODE
FROM PER_LOCATIONS pl, PER_LOCATION_DETAILS_F plf, PER_LOCATION_DETAILS_F_TL plft,
     PER_LOC_ADDRESS_USAGES_F pla, PER_ADDRESSES_F pa
WHERE pl.LOCATION_ID = plf.LOCATION_ID
  AND plf.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = plft.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID
  AND plf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = plft.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
  AND plft.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = pla.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
  AND pl.LOCATION_ID = pla.LOCATION_ID
  AND pla.ADDRESS_ID = pa.ADDRESS_ID
  AND plf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT max(plf2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_LOCATION_DETAILS_F plf2
     WHERE plf2.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = plf.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID)
  AND pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT max(pa2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ADDRESSES_F pa2
     WHERE pa2.ADDRESS_ID = pa.ADDRESS_ID)
  AND plft.language = 'PTB'
  AND pa.COUNTRY = 'BR'
  AND pl.last_update_date >= :p_dt_ini
  AND pl.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE = nvl(:p_cd_amb,
                                    pl.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE)
```

### Query #9

### Query #9

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_PARTIES, HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES`

```sql
SELECT HP.PARTY_NAME Supplier, PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE
FROM HZ_PARTIES HP, POZ_SUPPLIERS PS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
WHERE HP.PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
  AND UPPER(PS.CREATED_BY) <> 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
  AND PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
  AND PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HAOU.NAME = :P_BU
  AND PS.SEGMENT1 = REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_VENDOR_NUM, '[^-]+', 1, 2)
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE LIKE REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_VENDOR_NUM,
                                    '[^-]+', 1, 3) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT HP.PARTY_NAME Supplier, PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE
FROM HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES HAPN, HZ_PARTIES HP, POZ_SUPPLIERS PS,
     POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
WHERE HAPN.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
  AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME_TYPE = 'ALIAS'
  AND HP.PARTY_ID = PS.PARTY_ID
  AND UPPER(PS.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
  AND HAPN.PARTY_NAME = REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_VENDOR_NUM,
                          '[^-]+', 1, 2)
  AND PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_CODE LIKE REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_VENDOR_NUM,
                                    '[^-]+', 1, 3) || '%'
  AND PS.VENDOR_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_ID
  AND PSSAM.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HAOU.NAME = :P_BU
  AND ROWNUM = 1
```

### Query #11

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, RA_TERMS, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #11

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, RA_TERMS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT CREDIT_HOLD Cliente_retido, HCPF.CREDIT_CHECKING cliente_verifica_credito,
       rctta.ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG abrir_AR,
       CASE WHEN rctta.TYPE IN ('INV', 'DM') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END tipo_faturamento ,
       decode(HCPF.CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE,

         nvl(
               (SELECT flv.lookup_code
                FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
                WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_AR_MOEDA_ANALISE'
                  AND flv.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                  AND flv.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND HCPF.CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE = flv.lookup_code
                  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(flv.START_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                     sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(flv.END_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                           sysdate))), 'X'), 'Y', 'N') moedas_iguais ,

  (SELECT Sum(DFLA.ORDERED_QTY * DFLA.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE)
   FROM DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DFLA
   WHERE DFLA.header_id = DHA.header_id) total_pedido,
       round(HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT + (HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT * (HCPF.TOLERANCE / 100)), 2) limite_por_pedido ,
       (
          (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE
                              WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                   AND A.CONVERSION_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * A.CONVERSION_RATE
                              WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                   AND A.CONVERSION_RATE IS NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT *
                                     (SELECT MAX(CONVERSION_RATE)
                                      FROM GL_DAILY_RATES
                                      WHERE FROM_CURRENCY = a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
                                        AND TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
                                        AND CONVERSION_DATE =
                                          (SELECT MAX(CONVERSION_DATE)
                                           FROM GL_DAILY_RATES
                                           WHERE FROM_CURRENCY = a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
                                             AND TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
                                             AND CONVERSION_DATE <= SYSDATE)) ELSE c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT
                          END), 0)
           FROM doo_headers_all a, doo_lines_all b, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL c, ra_cust_trx_types_all d
           WHERE b.header_id = a.header_id
             AND a.status_code = 'OPEN'
             AND a.open_flag = 'Y'
             AND b.open_flag = 'Y'
             AND a.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND b.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND c.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND c.header_id = b.header_id
             AND c.line_id = b.line_id
             AND c.INVOICE_ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
             AND c.INVOICEABLE_ITEM_FLAG = 'Y'
             AND c.INVOICE_INTERFACED_FLAG = 'N'
             AND d.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID = c.billing_trx_type_id
             AND d.ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG = 'Y'
             AND a.change_version_number =
               (SELECT MAX(a1.change_version_number)
                FROM doo_headers_all a1
                WHERE a1.source_order_id = a.source_order_id)
             AND NOT EXISTS
               (SELECT 1
                FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                  AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                  AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                  AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK', 'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
             AND c.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID = DFL.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID)) +
  (SELECT sum(apsa.amount_due_remaining)
   FROM ar_payment_schedules_all apsa
   WHERE apsa.CUSTOMER_ID = hca.cust_account_id
     AND apsa.CLASS IN ('DM', 'INV')
     AND apsa.amount_due_remaining > 0
     AND apsa.status = 'OP') Valor_aberto,
       round(HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT + (HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT * (HCPF.TOLERANCE / 100)), 2) limite_total_tol, DHA.order_number nro_ordem, HCA.ACCOUNT_NUMBER nro_cliente,
       DFL.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_entrega, DHA.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_header,
       DLA.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_linha,
       nvl(
             (SELECT sum(apsa.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING)
              FROM AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL APSA
              WHERE APSA.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
                AND APSA.CLASS IN ('DM', 'INV')
                AND APSA.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING > 0
                AND APSA.STATUS = 'OP'
                AND trunc(APSA.due_date) < trunc(sysdate)), 0) Titulo_aberto,
       NVL(
             (SELECT B.PREPAYMENT_FLAG
              FROM RA_TERMS B
              WHERE B.TERM_ID = DHA.PAYMENT_TERM_ID_F
                AND B.PREPAYMENT_FLAG = 'Y'), 'N') PRE_PAGAMENTO
FROM HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA, HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL HSUA, HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS,
     HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DFL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL DHA, DOO_LINES_ALL DLA,
     DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES happ, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B hld, ra_cust_trx_types_all rctta
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  AND HCASA.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND HSUA.cust_acct_site_id = hcasa.cust_acct_site_id
  AND HSUA.SITE_USE_CODE = 'BILL_TO'
  AND HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  AND HCPF.STATUS = 'A'
  AND HCPF.SITE_USE_ID IS NULL
  AND DHA.header_id = DFL.header_id
  AND DLA.header_id = DFL.header_id
  AND DLA.line_id = DFL.line_id
  AND HSUA.site_use_id = DFL.BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
  AND happ.HOLD_CODE_ID = hld.HOLD_CODE_ID
  AND happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = DFL.FULFILL_LINE_ID
  AND hld.hold_code = 'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'
  AND happ.HOLD_RELEASE_REASON_CODE IS NULL
  AND happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
  AND DFL.STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CLOSED', 'DOO_CANCEL_REQUESTED')
  AND DFL.BILLING_TRX_TYPE_ID = rctta.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
  AND (:DTALKUP IS NULL
       OR DFL.last_update_date > TO_DATE(:DTALKUP,
                                   'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))
```
