### Query #12

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, RA_TERMS, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, RA_TERMS, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT CLIENTE_RETIDO ,CLIENTE_VERIFICA_CREDITO ,ABRIR_AR ,TIPO_FATURAMENTO ,MOEDAS_IGUAIS ,
       TOTAL_PEDIDO ,LIMITE_POR_PEDIDO ,VALOR_ABERTO ,LIMITE_TOTAL_TOL ,NRO_ORDEM ,NRO_CLIENTE ,
       MAX(ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_ENTREGA) ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_ENTREGA ,ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_HEADER ,
       MAX(ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_LINHA) ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_LINHA ,TITULO_ABERTO ,PRE_PAGAMENTO ,ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO ,ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED_DATE ,
       COND_PAGTO_PED ,Metodo_pedido
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT DLA.CREATED_BY ultima_atualizacao ,HCA.ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED_DATE ,

     (SELECT rt.name
      FROM ra_terms rt
      WHERE rt.term_id = dfl.PAYMENT_TERM_ID)COND_PAGTO_PED ,

     (SELECT rm.name
      FROM DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B dff
      JOIN ar_receipt_methods rm ON rm.receipt_method_id = TO_NUMBER(dff.attribute_char3)
      WHERE dff.header_id = DHA.header_id
        AND rownum = 1) Metodo_pedido , CREDIT_HOLD Cliente_retido ,
                   HCPF.CREDIT_CHECKING cliente_verifica_credito ,rctta.ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG abrir_AR ,
                   CASE WHEN rctta.TYPE IN ('INV', 'DM') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                   END tipo_faturamento ,
                   decode(HCPF.CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE,

                     nvl(
                           (SELECT flv.lookup_code
                            FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
                            WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_AR_MOEDA_ANALISE'
                              AND flv.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                              AND flv.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
                              AND HCPF.CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE = flv.lookup_code
                              AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(flv.START_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                 sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(flv.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                       sysdate))), 'X'), 'Y', 'N') moedas_iguais ,

     (SELECT Sum(DFLA.ORDERED_QTY * DFLA.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE)
      FROM DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DFLA
      WHERE DFLA.header_id = DHA.header_id) total_pedido,
                   nvl(round(nvl(HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT, 0) + (nvl(HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT,
                                                                  0) * (nvl(HCPF.TOLERANCE,
                                                                          0) / 100)), 2), 0) limite_por_pedido ,
                   (
                      (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE
                                          WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                               AND A.CONVERSION_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * A.CONVERSION_RATE
                                          WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                               AND A.CONVERSION_RATE IS NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT *
                                                 (SELECT MAX(CONVERSION_RATE)
                                                  FROM GL_DAILY_RATES
                                                  WHERE FROM_CURRENCY = a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
                                                    AND TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
                                                    AND CONVERSION_DATE =
                                                      (SELECT MAX(CONVERSION_DATE)
                                                       FROM GL_DAILY_RATES
                                                       WHERE FROM_CURRENCY = a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
                                                         AND TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
                                                         AND CONVERSION_DATE <= SYSDATE)) ELSE c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT
                                      END), 0)
                       FROM doo_headers_all a, doo_lines_all b, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL c,
                            ra_cust_trx_types_all d
                       WHERE b.header_id = a.header_id
                         AND a.status_code = 'OPEN'
                         AND a.open_flag = 'Y'
                         AND b.open_flag = 'Y'
                         AND a.canceled_flag = 'N'
                         AND b.canceled_flag = 'N'
                         AND c.canceled_flag = 'N'
                         AND c.header_id = b.header_id
                         AND c.line_id = b.line_id
                         AND c.INVOICE_ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
                         AND c.INVOICEABLE_ITEM_FLAG = 'Y'
                         AND c.INVOICE_INTERFACED_FLAG = 'N'
                         AND d.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID = c.billing_trx_type_id
                         AND d.ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG = 'Y'
                         AND a.change_version_number =
                           (SELECT MAX(a1.change_version_number)
                            FROM doo_headers_all a1
                            WHERE a1.source_order_id = a.source_order_id)
                         AND c.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID = DFL.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID)) + nvl(
                                                                                       (SELECT sum(apsa.amount_due_remaining)
                                                                                        FROM ar_payment_schedules_all apsa
                                                                                        WHERE apsa.CUSTOMER_ID = hca.cust_account_id
                                                                                          AND apsa.CLASS IN ('DM',

                                                                                                           'INV')
                                                                                          AND apsa.amount_due_remaining > 0
                                                                                          AND apsa.status = 'OP'),0) Valor_aberto,
                   round(HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT + (HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT * (HCPF.TOLERANCE / 100)), 2) limite_total_tol, DHA.order_number nro_ordem, hp.party_NUMBER nro_cliente,
                   DFL.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_entrega, DHA.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_header,
                   DLA.last_update_date ultima_atualizacao_linha,
                   nvl(
                         (SELECT sum(apsa.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING)
                          FROM AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL APSA
                          WHERE APSA.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
                            AND APSA.CLASS IN ('DM',
                                             'INV')
                            AND APSA.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING > 0
                            AND APSA.STATUS = 'OP'
                            AND trunc(APSA.due_date) < trunc(sysdate)), 0) Titulo_aberto,
                   NVL(
                         (SELECT B.PREPAYMENT_FLAG
                          FROM RA_TERMS B
                          WHERE B.TERM_ID = DHA.PAYMENT_TERM_ID_F
                            AND B.PREPAYMENT_FLAG = 'Y'), 'N') PRE_PAGAMENTO
   FROM HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA, HZ_PARTIES HP, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA, HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL HSUA,
        HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL_V DFL,
        DOO_HEADERS_ALL DHA, DOO_LINES_ALL DLA, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES happ, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B hld,
        ra_cust_trx_types_all rctta
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
     AND HP.party_id = hca.party_id
     AND HCASA.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND HSUA.cust_acct_site_id = hcasa.cust_acct_site_id
     AND HSUA.SITE_USE_CODE = 'BILL_TO'
     AND HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
     AND HCPF.STATUS = 'A'
     AND HCPF.SITE_USE_ID IS NULL
     AND DHA.header_id = DFL.header_id
     AND DLA.header_id = DFL.header_id
     AND DLA.line_id = DFL.line_id
     AND HSUA.site_use_id = DFL.BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
     AND happ.HOLD_CODE_ID = hld.HOLD_CODE_ID
     AND happ.HOLD_CODE_ID = hld.HOLD_CODE_ID
     AND hld.hold_code = 'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'
     AND happ.HOLD_RELEASE_REASON_CODE IS NULL
     AND ((happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
           AND happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = DFL.FULFILL_LINE_ID
           AND happ.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
          OR (happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_V'
              AND happ.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = DHA.HEADER_ID
              AND happ.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'))
     AND DFL.STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CLOSED', 'DOO_CANCEL_REQUESTED')
     AND DFL.BILLING_TRX_TYPE_ID = rctta.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
     AND DHA.STATUS_CODE = 'OPEN'
     AND DLA.header_id = DHA.header_id
     AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(HCPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                                        sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                              sysdate))
     AND (:DTALKUP IS NULL
          OR DFL.last_update_date > (SYSDATE - TO_NUMBER(NVL(:DTALKUP,
                                                           '0'))))) x
GROUP BY CLIENTE_RETIDO ,CLIENTE_VERIFICA_CREDITO ,ABRIR_AR ,TIPO_FATURAMENTO ,MOEDAS_IGUAIS ,
         TOTAL_PEDIDO ,LIMITE_POR_PEDIDO ,VALOR_ABERTO ,LIMITE_TOTAL_TOL ,NRO_ORDEM ,NRO_CLIENTE ,
         ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_HEADER ,TITULO_ABERTO ,PRE_PAGAMENTO ,ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO ,
         ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED_DATE ,COND_PAGTO_PED ,Metodo_pedido
ORDER BY NRO_ORDEM
```

### Query #13

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, HZ_PARTIES, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS`

### Query #13

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, HZ_PARTIES, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT trx.org_id BU_ID,hp.party_name,hc.account_number ContaCliente,hc.cust_account_id,
          NVL(
                (SELECT r.doc_num
                 FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all r
                 WHERE r.trx_id = trx.customer_trx_id
                   AND r.entity_code = 'TRANSACTIONS'
                   AND r.event_class_code = 'INVOICE'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT r.doc_num
                 FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all r
                 WHERE r.trx_id = trx.interface_header_attribute7
                   AND trx.interface_header_context = 'DOO'
                   AND r.entity_code = 'SHIPMENTS'
                   AND r.event_class_code = 'SALES_ORDER_SHIPMENT'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) Fiscal_Number,
          NVL(
                (SELECT r.status
                 FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all r
                 WHERE r.trx_id = trx.customer_trx_id
                   AND r.entity_code = 'TRANSACTIONS'
                   AND r.event_class_code = 'INVOICE'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT r.status
                 FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all r
                 WHERE r.trx_id = trx.interface_header_attribute7
                   AND trx.interface_header_context = 'DOO'
                   AND r.entity_code = 'SHIPMENTS'
                   AND r.event_class_code = 'SALES_ORDER_SHIPMENT'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) Status,trx.trx_date,trx.trx_number,ps.terms_sequence_number Parcela,
          trx.ct_reference Order_number,trx.trx_class Classe ,trx.receipt_method_id,
          rm.name AS receipt_method_name,bac.global_attribute1 pix_key,bac.bank_account_id ID_CONTA,
          bac.bank_account_name NomeConta,bac.bank_account_num AS NumeroConta,bac.bank_id ID_BANCO,
          bac.bank_branch_id ID_AGENCIA,'AR_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL' source_reference,
                                                              trx.customer_trx_id SOURCE_ID,
                                                              ps.payment_schedule_id source_inst_id,
                                                              ps.amount_due_remaining trx_amount,
                                                              ps.invoice_currency_code,ps.due_date,
                                                              trx.attribute3 CodigoRomaneio,
                                                              trx.interface_header_attribute7 delivery_id,NULL id_debit_memo,
                                                                                                               NULL trx_debit_memo,
                                                                                                                    NULL CosmosDeliveryRomaneioId,
                                                                                                                         NULL NSU,
                                                                                                                              NULL SummaryNumber,
                                                                                                                                   NULL dtAuthorization,
                                                                                                                                        NULL dtReceipt,
                                                                                                                                             NULL dtPayment,
                                                                                                                                                  NULL dtCancel,
                                                                                                                                                       NULL TotalAmount,
                                                                                                                                                            NULL NetAmount,
                                                                                                                                                                 NULL DiscountAmount
   FROM ra_customer_trx_all trx
   JOIN ar_payment_schedules_all ps ON ps.customer_trx_id = trx.customer_trx_id
   JOIN ar_receipt_methods rm ON rm.receipt_method_id = trx.receipt_method_id
   JOIN ar_receipt_method_accounts_all rmc ON rmc.receipt_method_id = rm.receipt_method_id
   AND rmc.org_id = trx.org_id
   AND rmc.primary_flag = 'Y'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(rmc.start_date, SYSDATE - 1) AND NVL(rmc.end_date,
                                                                     SYSDATE + 1)
   JOIN ce_bank_accounts bac ON bac.bank_account_id = rmc.bank_account_id
   JOIN hz_cust_accounts hc ON hc.cust_account_id = trx.bill_to_customer_id
   JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = hc.party_id
   WHERE trx.complete_flag = 'Y'
     AND trx.trx_class = 'INV'
     AND ps.amount_due_remaining > 0
     AND ps.invoice_currency_code = 'BRL')
WHERE NVL(Status, 'X') = 'APPROVED'
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `SALDO_PEDIDOS, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, DOO_LINES_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, TAXA_CAMBIO, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, HZ_PARTIES, ULTIMA_TAXA...`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `TAXA_CAMBIO, RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL, SALDO_PEDIDOS, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_PARTIES, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, GL_DAILY_RATES...`

```sql
WITH ULTIMA_TAXA AS
  (SELECT r.FROM_CURRENCY, MAX(r.CONVERSION_DATE) AS MAX_DATE
   FROM GL_DAILY_RATES r
   WHERE r.TO_CURRENCY = 'BRL'
     AND r.CONVERSION_DATE <= SYSDATE
   GROUP BY r.FROM_CURRENCY),
     TAXA_CAMBIO AS
  (SELECT r.FROM_CURRENCY, r.CONVERSION_RATE
   FROM GL_DAILY_RATES r
   JOIN ULTIMA_TAXA u ON u.FROM_CURRENCY = r.FROM_CURRENCY
   AND u.MAX_DATE = r.CONVERSION_DATE),
     SALDO_PEDIDOS AS
  (SELECT c.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                       AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * a.CONVERSION_RATE
                  WHEN a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                       AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * NVL(tc.CONVERSION_RATE,
                                                                                1) ELSE c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT
              END) AS TOTAL_PEDIDOS ,SUM (CASE
                                              WHEN EXISTS
                                                     (SELECT 'Y'
                                                      FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                      WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                        AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                            'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
                                                   AND a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                                   AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * a.CONVERSION_RATE
                                              WHEN EXISTS
                                                     (SELECT 'Y'
                                                      FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                      WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                        AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                            'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
                                                   AND a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                                   AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * NVL(tc.CONVERSION_RATE,

                                                                                                            1)
                                              WHEN EXISTS
                                                     (SELECT 'Y'
                                                      FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x, DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                      WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                        AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                        AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                            'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO')) THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT ELSE 0
                                          END) AS SALDO_RETIDO ,SUM (CASE
                                                                         WHEN NOT EXISTS
                                                                                (SELECT 'Y'
                                                                                 FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x,
                                                                                      DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                                                 WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                                                   AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                   AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                                                       'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
                                                                              AND a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                                                              AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * a.CONVERSION_RATE
                                                                         WHEN NOT EXISTS
                                                                                (SELECT 'Y'
                                                                                 FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x,
                                                                                      DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                                                 WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                                                   AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                   AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                                                       'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
                                                                              AND a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                                                                              AND a.CONVERSION_RATE IS NULL THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT * NVL(tc.CONVERSION_RATE,

                                                                                                                                       1)
                                                                         WHEN NOT EXISTS
                                                                                (SELECT 'Y'
                                                                                 FROM DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES x,
                                                                                      DOO_HOLD_CODES_B y
                                                                                 WHERE TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                                                                                   AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                   AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE_ID = x.HOLD_CODE_ID
                                                                                   AND y.HOLD_CODE IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK',
                                                                                                       'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO')) THEN c.EXTENDED_AMOUNT ELSE 0
                                                                     END) AS SALDO_LIBERADO
   FROM doo_headers_all a
   JOIN doo_lines_all b ON b.header_id = a.header_id
   JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all c ON c.header_id = b.header_id
   AND c.line_id = b.line_id
   JOIN ra_cust_trx_types_all d ON d.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID = c.billing_trx_type_id
   LEFT JOIN TAXA_CAMBIO tc ON tc.FROM_CURRENCY = a.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
   WHERE a.status_code = 'OPEN'
     AND a.open_flag = 'Y'
     AND b.open_flag = 'Y'
     AND a.canceled_flag = 'N'
     AND b.canceled_flag = 'N'
     AND c.canceled_flag = 'N'
     AND c.INVOICE_ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND c.INVOICEABLE_ITEM_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND c.INVOICE_INTERFACED_FLAG = 'N'
     AND d.ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND a.change_version_number =
       (SELECT MAX(a1.change_version_number)
        FROM doo_headers_all a1
        WHERE a1.source_order_id = a.source_order_id)
     AND c.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID = :P_CUSTOMER_ID
   GROUP BY c.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID)
SELECT AC.cust_account_id customer_id, hp.party_name, SUM(nvl(aps.ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
                                                            0)) AS TotalAberto,
       AVG(cpc.CREDIT_LIMIT + (cpc.CREDIT_LIMIT * NVL(cpc.TOLERANCE,
                                                    0) / 100)) AS LimiteCliente,
       AVG(cpc.CREDIT_LIMIT + (cpc.CREDIT_LIMIT * NVL(cpc.TOLERANCE,
                                                    0) / 100)) - SUM(nvl(aps.ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
                                                                       0)) AS LimiteDisponivel, AVG(cpc.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT) AS LimitePorOrdem,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN nvl(aps.due_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                    AND aps.CLASS <> 'PMT' THEN nvl(aps.ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
                                                  0) ELSE 0
           END) AS TotalAtraso, AVG(NVL(sp.TOTAL_PEDIDOS,
                                      0)) AS SaldoPedidos,
       (AVG(NVL(sp.TOTAL_PEDIDOS, 0)) + SUM(nvl(aps.ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
                                              0))) AS "Saldo_em_Aberto", (AVG(NVL(SP.SALDO_RETIDO,
                                                                                0))) AS PedidosRetidos,
       (AVG(NVL(SP.SALDO_LIBERADO, 0))) AS PedidosLiberados
FROM hz_cust_accounts ac
JOIN hz_parties hp ON hp.party_id = ac.party_id
JOIN hz_customer_profiles_f cpc ON cpc.cust_account_id = ac.cust_account_id
LEFT JOIN ar_payment_schedules_all aps ON aps.customer_id = ac.cust_account_id
LEFT JOIN SALDO_PEDIDOS sp ON sp.CUSTOMER_ID = AC.cust_account_id
WHERE 1=1
  AND ac.cust_account_id = :P_CUSTOMER_ID
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(cpc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, SYSDATE - 1) AND NVL(cpc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                              SYSDATE)
GROUP BY AC.cust_account_id, hp.party_name
ORDER BY hp.party_name
```

### Query #15

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AR_RECEIPT_METHODS`

```sql
SELECT d.bank_account_num, f.bank_name, f.bank_number, f.branch_number
FROM ar_receipt_methods b, AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL c, CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS d,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL e, ce_bank_branches_v f
WHERE 1=1
  AND b.name = :P_RECEIPT_METHOD_NAME
  AND c.receipt_method_id = b.receipt_method_id
  AND c.primary_flag = 'Y'
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN nvl(c.start_date, sysdate-1) AND nvl(c.end_date,
                                                                sysdate+1)
  AND c.bank_account_id = d.bank_account_id
  AND c.org_id = e.organization_id
  AND f.pk_id= d.bank_branch_id
  AND e.language = 'PTB'
  AND e.name = :P_BU_NAME
```

### Query #19

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `AR_REMIT_TO_LOCS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT Q.ADDRESS_LOC_SEQ_ID,
       DECODE(SUBSTR(Q.REMIT_TO, Q.TAM, 1), ',', SUBSTR(Q.REMIT_TO,
                                                   1,(Q.TAM-1)), Q.REMIT_TO) REMIT_TO
FROM
  (SELECT R.ADDRESS_LOC_SEQ_ID, L.ADDRESS4,
          TRIM(REPLACE(L.ADDRESS1||', '||L.ADDRESS2||', '||L.ADDRESS3||', '||L.ADDRESS4, ', ,', ',')) AS REMIT_TO,
          SUBSTR(TRIM(REPLACE(L.ADDRESS1||', '||L.ADDRESS2||', '||L.ADDRESS3||', '||L.ADDRESS4, ', ,', ',')),

            LENGTH(TRIM(REPLACE(L.ADDRESS1||', '||L.ADDRESS2||', '||L.ADDRESS3||', '||L.ADDRESS4, ', ,', ','))), 1) VR,
          LENGTH(TRIM(REPLACE(L.ADDRESS1||', '||L.ADDRESS2||', '||L.ADDRESS3||', '||L.ADDRESS4, ', ,', ','))) TAM
   FROM AR_REMIT_TO_LOCS_ALL R , HZ_LOCATIONS L
   WHERE L.LOCATION_ID = R.LOCATION_ID
   ORDER BY SET_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) Q
```

### Query #22

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES, USANDO, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS, CMR_RCV_EVENT_COSTS, CMR_RCV_EVENTS, RECEIPTCOSTS...`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Order Management, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, RECEIPTCOSTS, USANDO, CMR_RCV_EVENT_COSTS, CMR_RCV_EVENTS, CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES, PO_HEADERS_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL...`

```sql
WITH ReceiptCosts AS
  (SELECT CRE.SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER AS RC_PO_NUMBER, CRE.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS RC_ITEM_ID,
          SUM(CRD.ENTERED_CURRENCY_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_VALUE, SUM(CRD.ACCOUNTED_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY
   FROM CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS CRD
   INNER JOIN CMR_RCV_EVENT_COSTS CREC ON CRD.EVENT_COST_ID = CREC.EVENT_COST_ID
   INNER JOIN CMR_RCV_EVENTS CRE ON CRE.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID = CREC.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
   WHERE CREC.EVENT_COST_SOURCE IN ('FD_PRICE', 'TRANSACTION_TAX', 'LANDED_COST')
   GROUP BY CRE.SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER, CRE.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID)
SELECT DH_COMP.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS FIXACAO_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 AS PO_NUMBER, DLA.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
       RCTLA.QUANTITY_INVOICED AS QUANTITY, RCTLA.UOM_CODE, NVL(DH_COMP.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2,
                                                              0) AS RETURN_AMOUNT,
       (NVL(RC.TOTAL_VALUE, 0) / NULLIF(RC.TOTAL_QTY,
                                   0)) AS PO_UNIT_COST, '00000103' AS ITEM_A_FIXAR, '00000099' AS ITEM_FIXO
FROM JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL JFHDR
LEFT JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL RCTLA ON JFHDR.TRX_ID = RCTLA.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
LEFT JOIN DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DLA ON TO_CHAR(DLA.FULFILL_LINE_ID) = RCTLA.INTERFACE_LINE_ATTRIBUTE6
LEFT JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES CFDS ON CFDS.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID = JFHDR.DOC_HDR_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = CFDS.SOURCE_DOC_ID1
LEFT JOIN DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DH_EFF ON DLA.HEADER_ID = DH_EFF.HEADER_ID
AND DH_EFF.CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesDaOrdem'
LEFT JOIN DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DH_COMP ON DLA.HEADER_ID = DH_COMP.HEADER_ID
AND DH_COMP.CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesComplementares'
LEFT JOIN ReceiptCosts RC ON PHA.SEGMENT1 = RC.RC_PO_NUMBER
AND DLA.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = RC.RC_ITEM_ID
WHERE DH_EFF.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR5 = 'GCO12'
```

### Query #23

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, HZ_PARTY_SITES, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS`

### Query #23

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, HZ_PARTY_SITES, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT 'PLUMA' AS release_domain, ITOH.HEADER_NUMBER AS release_xid, 'I' AS transaction_code,
       CASE WHEN ITOH.HEADER_ID IS NULL THEN 'I' ELSE 'IU'
       END AS release_change_flag, NVL(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                     '') AS organization_code,
       REGEXP_REPLACE(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_BU$', '') AS cod_empresa, REGEXP_REPLACE(FBU.BU_NAME,
                                                                           '_BU$',
                                                                           '') AS business_unit_name,
       NVL(TO_CHAR(HPS_FROM.PARTY_SITE_ID), TO_CHAR(HL_FROM.LOCATION_ID)) AS ship_from_location_xid,
       NVL(TO_CHAR(HPS_TO.PARTY_SITE_ID), TO_CHAR(HL_TO.LOCATION_ID)) AS ship_to_location_xid, SUM(NVL(PRLA.QUANTITY,

                                                                                                     0) * NVL(ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT,

                                                                                                            0)) AS net_weight_value,
       'KG' AS net_weight_uom_gid, SUM(NVL(PRLA.QUANTITY,
                                         0) * NVL(ESIB.UNIT_VOLUME,
                                                0)) AS net_volume_value,
       'CUMTR' AS net_volume_uom_gid, PRHA.ATTRIBUTE6 AS freight_terms,
       TO_CHAR(MAX(NVL(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE, DATE '1900-01-01')), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS late_delivery_dt, SUM(NVL(PRLA.QUANTITY,

                                                                                                              0)) AS packaged_item_count, PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
JOIN POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA ON PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS ITOH ON PRLA.TO_HEADER_ID = ITOH.HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ON ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PRLA.ITEM_ID
AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRLA.SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ON IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRLA.SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FBU ON FBU.BU_ID = IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
LEFT JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HOU_FROM ON HOU_FROM.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRLA.SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HL_FROM ON HL_FROM.LOCATION_ID = HOU_FROM.LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS_FROM ON HPS_FROM.LOCATION_ID = HL_FROM.LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HOU_TO ON HOU_TO.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRLA.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HL_TO ON HL_TO.LOCATION_ID = HOU_TO.LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS_TO ON HPS_TO.LOCATION_ID = HL_TO.LOCATION_ID
WHERE PRHA.INTERNAL_TRANSFER_REQ_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND ITOH.HEADER_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber
GROUP BY ITOH.HEADER_NUMBER, ITOH.HEADER_ID, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, FBU.BU_NAME,
         HPS_FROM.PARTY_SITE_ID, HL_FROM.LOCATION_ID, HPS_TO.PARTY_SITE_ID, HL_TO.LOCATION_ID,
         PRHA.ATTRIBUTE6, PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER
```

### Query #24

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

### Query #25

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_REF_ATTRIBUTES, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, MAX_LINE_DATE, HZ_PARTY_SITES, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL...`

### Query #25

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_REF_ATTRIBUTES, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS...`

```sql
WITH max_line_date AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT L.DOC_HDR_ID AS DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID ,
             CASE WHEN cfdh.document_number IS NOT NULL THEN -cfdlb.FD_AMOUNT ELSE -L.LINE_AMT
             END AS FD_AMOUNT ,cfdlb.CREATION_DATE AS TRX_LINE_DATE
      FROM JG_FSCL_DOC_lines_ALL L
      JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT msib.inventory_item_Id , msib.item_number , msibtl.description ,
                         msib.SERVICEABLE_PRODUCT_FLAG , msib.INVENTORY_ITEM_FLAG
         FROM egp_system_items_b msib
         JOIN egp_system_items_tl msibtl ON msib.inventory_item_Id = msibtl.inventory_item_Id
         AND msib.organization_id = msibtl.organization_id
         WHERE msibtl.language = userenv('LANG')
           AND msib.organization_id IN
             (SELECT organization_id
              FROM inv_org_parameters
              WHERE organization_id = master_organization_id)) IT ON l.PRODUCT_CODE = it.item_number
      JOIN JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL h ON h.DOC_HDR_ID = L.DOC_HDR_ID
      JOIN JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL jfdra ON L.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
      AND jfdra.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
      JOIN
        (SELECT hp.party_Id, hp.party_name, hps.party_site_id, hps.location_Id , hps.party_site_name
         FROM hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
         WHERE hps.party_id = hp.party_Id) cust ON h.RNDG_SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID = cust.party_site_Id
      JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_ref_attributes cfdra ON cfdra.ref_fd_tax_payer_id = cust.party_site_name
      AND TRIM(cfdra.REF_ACCESS_KEY_NBR) = TRIM(jfdra.FISCAL_DOC_KEY)
      JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B cfdlb ON cfdlb.document_header_id = cfdra.document_header_id
      AND cfdlb.item_id = it.inventory_item_Id
      JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_headers cfdh ON cfdh.document_header_id = cfdlb.document_header_id
      AND cfdh.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'CAPTURED'
      WHERE 1=1
        AND L.trx_LINE_TYPE = 'ITEM'
        AND substr(L.trx_business_category, 41, length(L.trx_business_category)) IN ('5451',
                                                                                     '5452',
                                                                                     '6451',
                                                                                     '6452')
        AND cfdlb.CREATION_DATE > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                         1, 19),
                                                 'T', ' '),
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND
      UNION ALL SELECT L.DOC_HDR_ID AS DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID ,L.LINE_AMT AS FD_AMOUNT ,rctl.CREATION_DATE AS TRX_LINE_DATE
      FROM JG_FSCL_DOC_lines_ALL L
      JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL rctl ON rctl.customer_trx_id = L.trx_id
      AND rctl.customer_trx_line_id = L.TRX_LINE_ID
      AND rctl.org_id = L.org_id
      JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT msib.inventory_item_Id , msib.item_number , msibtl.description ,
                         msib.SERVICEABLE_PRODUCT_FLAG , msib.INVENTORY_ITEM_FLAG
         FROM egp_system_items_b msib
         JOIN egp_system_items_tl msibtl ON msib.inventory_item_Id = msibtl.inventory_item_Id
         AND msib.organization_id = msibtl.organization_id
         WHERE msibtl.language = userenv('LANG')
           AND msib.organization_id IN
             (SELECT organization_id
              FROM inv_org_parameters
              WHERE organization_id = master_organization_id)) IT ON l.PRODUCT_CODE = it.item_number
      WHERE 1=1
        AND L.trx_LINE_TYPE = 'ITEM'
        AND substr(L.trx_business_category, 41, length(L.trx_business_category)) IN ('5451',
                                                                                     '5452',
                                                                                     '6451',
                                                                                     '6452')
        AND rctl.CREATION_DATE > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                        1, 19),
                                                'T', ' '),
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND)
   ORDER BY DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, TRX_LINE_DATE)
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT jfdha.doc_hdr_id AS DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID , cust.party_id AS id_fornecedor , cust.party_name AS fornecedor ,
                   jfdha.RNDG_SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID AS id_local_fornecedor , cust.party_site_name AS cnpj , jfdra.doc_num AS document_number ,
                   jfdra.FISCAL_DOC_KEY AS ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER , jfdha.trx_date AS DTA_EMISSAO , jfdra.model , jfdra.series ,
                   SUM(mld.FD_AMOUNT) AS total_amount , jfdra.STATUS AS DOCUMENT_STATUS ,
                   iop.organization_id AS DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID , iop.organization_code ,
                   MAX(mld.TRX_LINE_DATE) AS last_update_date , dhe.attribute_char20 LOT_KEY
   FROM JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL jfdha
   JOIN JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL jfdra ON jfdha.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
   AND jfdra.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
   JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL rcta ON rcta.customer_trx_id = jfdha.trx_id
   AND rcta.org_id = jfdha.org_id
   JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL rctla ON rctla.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
   AND rctla.org_id = rcta.org_id
   JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS iop ON iop.organization_id = rctla.warehouse_id
   AND iop.attribute4 = 'Y'
   JOIN doo_headers_all dha ON dha.order_number = rcta.INTERFACE_HEADER_ATTRIBUTE1
   AND dha.order_type_code IN ('INTEGRACAO REMESSA ANIMAL', 'INTEGRACAO REMESSA INSUMO')
   AND dha.change_version_number =
     (SELECT MAX(dha2.change_version_number)
      FROM doo_headers_all dha2
      WHERE dha2.source_order_id = dha.source_order_id)
   JOIN doo_headers_eff_b dhe ON dhe.header_id = dha.header_id
   JOIN
     (SELECT hp.party_Id, hp.party_name, hps.party_site_id, hps.location_Id , hps.party_site_name
      FROM hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
      WHERE hps.party_id = hp.party_Id) cust ON cust.party_site_id = jfdha.RNDG_SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID
   JOIN max_line_date mld ON mld.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = jfdha.doc_hdr_id
   GROUP BY jfdha.doc_hdr_id , cust.party_id , cust.party_name , jfdha.RNDG_SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_ID ,
            cust.party_site_name , jfdra.doc_num , jfdra.FISCAL_DOC_KEY , jfdha.trx_date , jfdra.model ,
            jfdra.series , jfdra.STATUS , iop.organization_id , iop.organization_code ,
            dhe.attribute_char20) FINAL
WHERE final.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                      1, 19),
                                              'T', ' '),
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND
ORDER BY final.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

### Query #26

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_INV_ORG_V, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_REF_ATTRIBUTES, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, DUAL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LOC_INFO_V...`

### Query #26

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, DUAL, HZ_PARTIES, MAX_LINE_DATE, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, CFOP_MATERIAL...`

```sql
WITH cfop_material AS
  (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_MATERIAL_CFOP, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS cfop_code
   FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_MATERIAL_CFOP,
                          '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL),
     cfop_product AS
  (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_PRODUCT_CFOP, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS cfop_code
   FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_PRODUCT_CFOP,
                          '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL),
     MAX_LINE_DATE AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, MAX(L.CREATION_DATE) AS LINE_DATE,
                   iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS ORG_CODE
   FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B L
   JOIN
     (SELECT msib.inventory_item_id
      FROM egp_system_items_b msib
      JOIN egp_system_items_tl msibtl ON msib.inventory_item_id = msibtl.inventory_item_id
      AND msib.organization_id = msibtl.organization_id
      WHERE msibtl.language = userenv('LANG')
        AND msib.organization_id IN
          (SELECT organization_id
           FROM inv_org_parameters
           WHERE organization_id = master_organization_id)
      GROUP BY msib.inventory_item_id) IT ON L.ITEM_ID = IT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
   JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_REF_ATTRIBUTES RA ON L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = RA.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
   JOIN JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL jfdra ON RA.REF_ACCESS_KEY_NBR = jfdra.FISCAL_DOC_KEY
   JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL cust ON jfdra.TRX_ID = cust.customer_trx_id
   AND jfdra.ORG_ID = cust.org_id
   JOIN RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL rctl ON cust.customer_trx_id = rctl.customer_trx_id
   AND rctl.org_id = cust.org_id
   JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS iop ON rctl.warehouse_id = iop.ORGANIZATION_ID
   WHERE (L.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP IN
            (SELECT cfop_code
             FROM cfop_material)
          OR L.FD_CONVERTED_CFOP IN
            (SELECT cfop_code
             FROM cfop_material))
     AND L.CREATION_DATE > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                  1, 19),
                                          'T', ' '),
                             'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND
     AND (:P_BACKFLUSH_CODES IS NULL
          OR NOT (SUBSTR(iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE, -2) IN
                    (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_BACKFLUSH_CODES,
                                   '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                     FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_BACKFLUSH_CODES,
                                            '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)))
     AND (:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES IS NULL
          OR iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT IN
            (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES,
                           '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
             FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES,
                                    '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL))
   GROUP BY L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, MAX(L.CREATION_DATE) AS LINE_DATE,
                             iop2.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS ORG_CODE
   FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B L
   JOIN
     (SELECT msib.inventory_item_id
      FROM egp_system_items_b msib
      JOIN egp_system_items_tl msibtl ON msib.inventory_item_id = msibtl.inventory_item_id
      AND msib.organization_id = msibtl.organization_id
      WHERE msibtl.language = userenv('LANG')
        AND msib.organization_id IN
          (SELECT organization_id
           FROM inv_org_parameters
           WHERE organization_id = master_organization_id)
      GROUP BY msib.inventory_item_id) IT ON L.ITEM_ID = IT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
   JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES S ON L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = S.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
   JOIN PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL pda ON S.SOURCE_DOC_ID1 = pda.PO_HEADER_ID
   JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS iop2 ON pda.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID = iop2.ORGANIZATION_ID
   WHERE L.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP IN
       (SELECT cfop_code
        FROM cfop_product)
     AND L.CREATION_DATE > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                  1, 19),
                                          'T', ' '),
                             'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND
     AND (:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES IS NULL
          OR iop2.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT IN
            (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES,
                           '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
             FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_ORG_CODES,
                                    '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL))
   GROUP BY L.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, iop2.ORGANIZATION_CODE)
SELECT DISTINCT h.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, h.ISSUER_PARTY_ID AS ID_FORNECEDOR, hp.PARTY_NAME AS FORNECEDOR,
                h.ISSUER_PARTY_SITE_ID AS ID_LOCAL_FORNECEDOR, cfinfo.ISSUER_TAXPAYER_ID AS CNPJ, h.DOCUMENT_NUMBER,
                h.ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER, h.ISSUE_DATE AS DTA_EMISSAO, h.MODEL, h.SERIES, h.TOTAL_AMOUNT,
                h.DOCUMENT_STATUS, inv_org.DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID, mld.ORG_CODE AS ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                MAX(mld.LINE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS h
JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_INV_ORG_V inv_org ON h.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = inv_org.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
JOIN HZ_PARTIES hp ON h.ISSUER_PARTY_ID = hp.PARTY_ID
JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_loc_info_v cfinfo ON h.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = cfinfo.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
AND h.ISSUER_TAX_ID = cfinfo.ISSUER_TAX_ID
INNER JOIN MAX_LINE_DATE mld ON h.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = mld.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
WHERE h.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'CAPTURED'
GROUP BY h.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID, h.ISSUER_PARTY_ID, hp.PARTY_NAME, h.ISSUER_PARTY_SITE_ID,
         cfinfo.ISSUER_TAXPAYER_ID, h.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, h.ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER, h.ISSUE_DATE, h.MODEL, h.SERIES,
         h.TOTAL_AMOUNT, h.DOCUMENT_STATUS, inv_org.DEST_INVENTORY_ORG_ID, mld.ORG_CODE
HAVING MAX(mld.LINE_DATE) > TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(:P_DATA_REF,
                                                   1, 19),
                                           'T', ' '),
                              'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' SECOND
ORDER BY MAX(mld.LINE_DATE) ASC
```

### Query #27

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLES, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, HZ_LOCATIONS, ZX_REGISTRATIONS, FND_SETID_SETS_VL, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, HZ_PARTIES...`

### Query #27

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_RELATIONSHIPS, FND_SETID_SETS_VL, HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, HZ_LOCATIONS, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE...`

```sql
WITH DADOS_CONTATO AS
  (SELECT R.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID, P.PERSON_FIRST_NAME AS PRIMEIRO_NOME,
          P.PERSON_LAST_NAME AS SOBRENOME,

     (SELECT CP.EMAIL_ADDRESS
      FROM HZ_CONTACT_POINTS CP
      WHERE CP.OWNER_TABLE_ID = REL.SUBJECT_ID
        AND CP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
        AND CP.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'EMAIL'
        AND CP.STATUS = 'A'
        AND CP.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS EMAIL,

     (SELECT CP.CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE
      FROM HZ_CONTACT_POINTS CP
      WHERE CP.OWNER_TABLE_ID = REL.SUBJECT_ID
        AND CP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
        AND CP.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'EMAIL'
        AND CP.STATUS = 'A'
        AND CP.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS EMAIL_FUNC,

     (SELECT NVL2(CP.PHONE_NUMBER,

               CP.PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE || ' ' || CP.PHONE_AREA_CODE || ' ' || CP.PHONE_NUMBER, NULL)
      FROM HZ_CONTACT_POINTS CP
      WHERE CP.OWNER_TABLE_ID = REL.SUBJECT_ID
        AND CP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
        AND CP.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
        AND CP.STATUS = 'A'
        AND CP.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS TELEFONE,

     (SELECT CP.CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE
      FROM HZ_CONTACT_POINTS CP
      WHERE CP.OWNER_TABLE_ID = REL.SUBJECT_ID
        AND CP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
        AND CP.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
        AND CP.STATUS = 'A'
        AND CP.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS TELEFONE_FUNC
   FROM HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLES R
   INNER JOIN HZ_RELATIONSHIPS REL ON R.RELATIONSHIP_ID = REL.RELATIONSHIP_ID
   AND REL.SUBJECT_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
   AND REL.DIRECTIONAL_FLAG = 'F'
   INNER JOIN HZ_PARTIES P ON REL.SUBJECT_ID = P.PARTY_ID
   WHERE R.ROLE_TYPE = 'CONTACT'
     AND R.STATUS = 'A'
     AND R.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y')
SELECT DISTINCT SET_DS.SET_NAME AS nome_set_unidade_negocio ,
                HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS clicodint ,
                HZ.PARTY_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                HPS.PARTY_SITE_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                CASE
                    WHEN HL.COUNTRY = 'BR'
                         AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J'
                    WHEN HL.COUNTRY = 'BR'
                         AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F'
                    WHEN (HL.COUNTRY = 'BR')
                         AND (ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER')
                         OR (HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR') THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                END AS clifisjur ,
                NVL(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER) AS clicgc ,
                NVL(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER) AS clicpf ,
                HL.CITY AS clicidade ,
                HL.ADDRESS1 AS cliendere ,
                HL.ADDRESS4 AS clibairro ,
                HL.ADDRESS2 AS cliendnumber ,
                HL.ADDRESS3 AS clicomplemento ,
                HL.POSTAL_CODE AS clizipcode ,
                HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                HCP.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                NVL2(HCP.PHONE_NUMBER,

                  HCP.PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_AREA_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_NUMBER|| '|' ||HCP.PHONE_EXTENSION, NULL) AS clifone1 ,
                '' AS clifone2 ,
                NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                'C' AS clitpcli ,
                CASE
                    WHEN HCASA.END_DATE IS NULL
                         OR HCASA.END_DATE > SYSDATE THEN 'ATIVO' ELSE 'INATIVO'
                END AS clisitcli ,
                HCA.ATTRIBUTE1 AS climotivo ,
                '' AS clinacest ,
                HL.STATE AS estestado ,
                HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                'PLUMA.TRP-' || HZ.PARTY_ID AS idotm ,
                RTV.NAME AS clicondpagto ,
                HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT AS clilimglobal ,
                HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT AS clilimpedido ,
                HCPF.NEXT_CREDIT_REVIEW_DATE AS clinextreviewdate ,
                ARM.NAME AS climetopagto ,
                HCPF.CREDIT_HOLD AS cliretido ,
                HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER ,
                OKH.CONTRACT_NUMBER AS nr_contrato ,
                OCT.NAME AS tipo_contrato ,
                OKH.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS contexto_contrato ,
                OKH.ATTRIBUTE1 AS perc_desconto_contrato ,
                OKH.START_DATE AS dt_inicio_contrato ,
                OKH.END_DATE AS dt_fim_contrato ,
                HPS.ATTRIBUTE1 AS cliiniciohoravisita ,
                HPS.ATTRIBUTE2 AS clifimhoravisita ,
                DC.PRIMEIRO_NOME AS contato_primeiro_nome ,
                DC.SOBRENOME AS contato_sobrenome ,
                DC.EMAIL AS contato_email ,
                DC.EMAIL_FUNC AS contato_email_func ,
                DC.TELEFONE AS contato_telefone ,
                DC.TELEFONE_FUNC AS contato_fone_func
FROM ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI ON ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
     OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA ON HCA.PARTY_ID = HZ.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN DADOS_CONTATO DC ON DC.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA ON HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND HCASA.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
LEFT JOIN FND_SETID_SETS_VL SET_DS ON SET_DS.SET_ID = HCASA.SET_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = HPS.LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
LEFT JOIN HZ_CONTACT_POINTS HCP ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HCP.OWNER_TABLE_ID
AND HCP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
AND HCP.STATUS = 'A'
AND hcp.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
AND hcp.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF ON HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND HCPF.STANDARD_TERMS IS NOT NULL
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HCPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN RA_TERMS_TL RTV ON RTV.TERM_ID = HCPF.standard_terms
AND RTV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
LEFT JOIN RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS RCRM ON RCRM.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND RCRM.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN AR_RECEIPT_METHODS ARM ON ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID = RCRM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
LEFT JOIN OKC_K_PARTY_ROLES_B OKPR ON OKPR.OBJECT1_ID1 = HZ.PARTY_ID
AND OKPR.RLE_CODE = 'CUSTOMER'
LEFT JOIN OKC_K_HEADERS_ALL_B OKH ON OKH.ID = OKPR.CHR_ID
AND OKH.ID = OKPR.DNZ_CHR_ID
AND OKH.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'PLU_CONTRATOS_VENDA'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN OKH.START_DATE AND OKH.END_DATE
LEFT JOIN OKC_CONTRACT_TYPES_TL OCT ON OCT.CONTRACT_TYPE_ID = OKH.CONTRACT_TYPE_ID
AND OCT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND OCT.NAME = 'PLU_OM_DESCONTO_PRECO'
WHERE 1=1
  AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
       OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
  AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = :P_SITE_ID
```

### Query #28

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_RELATIONSHIPS, FND_SETID_ASSIGNMENTS, HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, HZ_PARTIES, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, HZ_LOCATIONS, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  (SELECT flv.lookup_code
   FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
   WHERE flv.TAG = 'PRINCIPAL'
     AND flv.language = 'PTB'
     AND flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_EMPRESAS_GRUPO') AS nome_bu,
                HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID AS clicodint , HZ.PARTY_NAME AS clirazsoc ,
                HCA.ACCOUNT_NAME AS clifantasi ,
                HP_PERSON.PERSON_FIRST_NAME AS contato_primeiro_nome ,
                HP_PERSON.PERSON_LAST_NAME AS contato_sobrenome ,
                HP_PERSON.PARTY_NAME AS contato_nome_completo ,
                HCAR.ROLE_TYPE AS contato_funcao ,
                CASE
                    WHEN HL.COUNTRY = 'BR'
                         AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ' THEN 'J'
                    WHEN HL.COUNTRY = 'BR'
                         AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_CPF' THEN 'F'
                    WHEN (HL.COUNTRY = 'BR')
                         AND (ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE = 'ORA_BR_OTHER')
                         OR (HL.COUNTRY <> 'BR') THEN 'O' ELSE ''
                END AS clifisjur ,
                NVL(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER) AS clicgc ,
                NVL(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER) AS clicpf ,
                HL.CITY AS clicidade ,
                HL.ADDRESS1 AS cliendere ,
                HL.ADDRESS4 AS clibairro ,
                HL.ADDRESS2 AS cliendnumber ,
                HL.POSTAL_CODE AS ZIP_CODE ,
                HL.ADDRESS3 AS PO_BOX ,
                HGIS.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS clicodibge ,
                HCP.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS climailfisc ,
                NVL2(HCP.PHONE_NUMBER,

                  HCP.PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_AREA_CODE || '|' || HCP.PHONE_NUMBER|| '|' ||HCP.PHONE_EXTENSION, NULL) AS clifone1 ,
                '' AS clifone2 ,
                NVL(ZXR.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'ISENTO') AS cliinscest ,
                'C' AS clitpcli ,
                CASE
                    WHEN HCASA.END_DATE IS NULL
                         OR HCASA.END_DATE > SYSDATE THEN 'ATIVO' ELSE 'INATIVO'
                END AS clisitcli ,
                HCA.ATTRIBUTE1 AS climotivo ,
                '' AS clinacest ,
                HL.STATE AS estestado ,
                HGIE.IDENTIFIER_VALUE AS paipais ,
                'PLUMA.TRP-' || HZ.PARTY_ID AS idotm ,
                RTV.NAME AS clicondpagto ,
                HCPF.CREDIT_LIMIT AS clilimglobal ,
                HCPF.ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT AS clilimpedido ,
                ARM.NAME AS climetopagto ,
                HCPF.CREDIT_HOLD AS cliretido ,
                HCPF.CREDIT_CHECKING AS clichecacred , ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER ,
                OKH.CONTRACT_NUMBER AS nr_contrato ,
                OCT.NAME AS tipo_contrato ,
                OKH.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS contexto_contrato ,
                OKH.ATTRIBUTE1 AS perc_desconto_contrato ,
                OKH.START_DATE AS dt_inicio_contrato ,
                OKH.END_DATE AS dt_fim_contrato ,
                HPS.ATTRIBUTE1 AS cliiniciohoravisita ,
                HPS.ATTRIBUTE2 AS clifimhoravisita
FROM ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
LEFT JOIN ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI ON ZPTI.ENTITY_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
LEFT JOIN ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZXR ON ZXR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
AND ZXR.VALIDATION_TYPE = 'ORA_BR_IE'
AND (ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
     OR ZXR.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
JOIN HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
JOIN HZ_PARTIES HZ ON HZ.PARTY_ID = HPS.PARTY_ID
JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS HCA ON HCA.PARTY_ID = HZ.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLES HCAR ON HCAR.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND HCAR.ROLE_TYPE = 'CONTACT'
AND HCAR.STATUS = 'A'
AND HCAR.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN HZ_RELATIONSHIPS HR_REL ON HR_REL.RELATIONSHIP_ID = HCAR.RELATIONSHIP_ID
AND HR_REL.STATUS = 'A'
AND HR_REL.SUBJECT_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
AND HR_REL.OBJECT_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTIES'
AND HR_REL.DIRECTIONAL_FLAG = 'F'
LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES HP_PERSON ON HP_PERSON.PARTY_ID = HR_REL.SUBJECT_ID
AND HP_PERSON.STATUS = 'A'
JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL HCASA ON HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(HCASA.START_DATE,
                                   sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(HCASA.END_DATE,
                                                         sysdate))
LEFT JOIN HZ_LOCATIONS HL ON HL.LOCATION_ID = HPS.LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHIES HG ON upper(HG.GEOGRAPHY_NAME) = upper(HL.CITY)
AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2 = HL.STATE
AND HG.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
AND HG.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE = 'CITY'
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIS ON HGIS.GEOGRAPHY_ID = HG.GEOGRAPHY_ID
AND HGIS.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'IBGE_CODE'
LEFT JOIN HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS HGIE ON HGIE.COUNTRY_CODE = HL.COUNTRY
AND HGIE.IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE = 'ISO_COUNTRY_CODE'
LEFT JOIN HZ_CONTACT_POINTS HCP ON HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = HCP.OWNER_TABLE_ID
AND HCP.OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
AND HCP.STATUS = 'A'
AND hcp.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE = 'PHONE'
AND hcp.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F HCPF ON HCPF.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
AND HCPF.STANDARD_TERMS IS NOT NULL
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HCPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HCPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN RA_TERMS_TL RTV ON RTV.TERM_ID = HCPF.standard_terms
AND RTV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
LEFT JOIN RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS RCRM ON RCRM.CUSTOMER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
LEFT JOIN AR_RECEIPT_METHODS ARM ON ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID = RCRM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
LEFT JOIN OKC_K_PARTY_ROLES_B OKPR ON OKPR.OBJECT1_ID1 = HZ.PARTY_ID
AND OKPR.RLE_CODE = 'CUSTOMER'
LEFT JOIN OKC_K_HEADERS_ALL_B OKH ON OKH.ID = OKPR.CHR_ID
AND OKH.ID = OKPR.DNZ_CHR_ID
AND OKH.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'PLU_CONTRATOS_VENDA'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN OKH.START_DATE AND OKH.END_DATE
LEFT JOIN OKC_CONTRACT_TYPES_TL OCT ON OCT.CONTRACT_TYPE_ID = OKH.CONTRACT_TYPE_ID
AND OCT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND OCT.NAME = 'PLU_OM_DESCONTO_PRECO'
WHERE 1=1
  AND (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
       OR ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO > SYSDATE)
  AND nvl(ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER, HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER) = nvl(NVL(:P_CNPJ,

                                                                ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER),
                                                            HPS.PARTY_SITE_NUMBER)
```

### Query #29

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL, AR_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL, AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES`

### Query #29

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL, AR_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT ara.RECEIVABLE_APPLICATION_ID ExternalId , ara.RECEIVABLE_APPLICATION_ID Name ,
       haotl.NAME Enterprise , apsa.payment_schedule_id FinancialTitle ,

  (SELECT flv.ATTRIBUTE3
   FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
   WHERE flv.language = 'PTB'
     AND flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_PVF361_CENTRO_CUSTO'
     AND flv.ATTRIBUTE1 = rctta.ATTRIBUTE5
     AND flv.ATTRIBUTE2 = gcc.segment3) CentroCusto , RCTA.ATTRIBUTE2 BRANCH ,
       LPAD(SUBSTR(rcta.attribute2, -2), 3, '0') AS Negocio ,
       (NVL(
              (SELECT sum(arax.AMOUNT_applied)
               FROM ar_receivable_applications_all arax , ar_cash_receipts_all acrx
               WHERE arax.CASH_RECEIPT_ID = acrx.CASH_RECEIPT_ID
                 AND arax.APPLIED_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID = apsa.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID),0) * (((rctla.QUANTITY_INVOICED * rctla.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE)) / NVL(
                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT Sum(rctlax.QUANTITY_INVOICED * rctlax.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE)
                                                                                                                                                        FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all rctlax
                                                                                                                                                        WHERE rctlax.line_type = 'LINE'
                                                                                                                                                          AND rctlax.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id),0))) SettlementValue ,
       round((
                (SELECT sum(arax.AMOUNT_applied)
                 FROM ar_receivable_applications_all arax , ar_cash_receipts_all acrx
                 WHERE arax.CASH_RECEIPT_ID = acrx.CASH_RECEIPT_ID
                   AND arax.APPLIED_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID = apsa.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID) * 100) / (NVL(
                                                                                                    (SELECT Sum(apsaa.amount_due_original)
                                                                                                     FROM ar_payment_schedules_all apsaa
                                                                                                     WHERE apsaa.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID = apsa.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID),0) - (NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                             (SELECT sum(AMOUNT)
                                                                                                                                                                              FROM AR_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL aaa
                                                                                                                                                                              WHERE aaa.STATUS = 'A'
                                                                                                                                                                                AND aaa.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = rcta.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID),0) + NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT apsac.AMOUNT_applied * -1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            FROM ra_customer_trx_all rctac ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ar_payment_schedules_all apsac
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            WHERE rctac.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              AND rctac.previous_customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              AND apsac.customer_trx_id = rctac.customer_trx_id),0))), 2) SettlementPercentage ,
       ara.APPLY_DATE SettlementDate ,
       ROUND(fs.total_freight_cost / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rcta.customer_trx_id), 2) AS FreightExpenses ,

  (SELECT dff.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR10|| oola.SOURCE_LINE_NUMBER|| MSIB.ITEM_NUMBER OrderItem
   FROM DOO_LINES_ALL OOLA ,DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DFA , doo_headers_eff_b dff , EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B msib
   WHERE DFA.FULFILL_LINE_ID = rctla.INTERFACE_LINE_ATTRIBUTE6
     AND DFA.LINE_ID = OOLA.LINE_ID
     AND OOLA.inventory_item_id = msib.inventory_item_id
     AND OOLA.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = MSIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND OOLA.HEADER_ID = dff.HEADER_ID
     AND DFF.CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesDaOrdem') OrderItem , jtf.SALESREP_NUMBER Representative , ara.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM ar_cash_receipts_all acr , ar_receivable_applications_all ara , HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F hao ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL haotl , ar_payment_schedules_all apsa , ra_customer_trx_all rcta ,
     jtf_rs_salesreps jtf , ra_customer_trx_lines_all rctla , RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ALL dist ,
     gl_code_combinations gcc ,ra_cust_trx_types_all rctta ,

  (SELECT customer_trx_id , SUM(extended_amount) AS total_freight_cost
   FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all
   WHERE line_type = 'FREIGHT'
   GROUP BY customer_trx_id)fs ,RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_SALESREPS_ALL SL
WHERE acr.CASH_RECEIPT_ID = ara.CASH_RECEIPT_ID
  AND ara.DISPLAY = 'Y'
  AND ara.ORG_ID = hao.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND hao.ORGANIZATION_ID = haotl.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND haotl.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
  AND haotl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = hao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
  AND haotl.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = hao.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND apsa.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
  AND ara.APPLIED_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID = apsa.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
  AND sl.RESOURCE_SALESREP_ID = jtf.RESOURCE_SALESREP_ID (+)
  AND rctla.CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID = sl.CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID
  AND rctla.line_type = 'LINE'
  AND rctla.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
  AND apsa.amount_due_remaining <= 0
  AND rcta.customer_trx_id = fs.customer_trx_id (+)
  AND rcta.trx_number = apsa.trx_number
  AND rctta.cust_trx_type_seq_id = rcta.cust_trx_type_seq_id
  AND dist.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
  AND gcc.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = dist.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND dist.ACCOUNT_CLASS = 'REV'
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
     WHERE flv.language = 'PTB'
       AND flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_PVF361_CENTRO_CUSTO'
       AND flv.ATTRIBUTE1 = rctta.ATTRIBUTE5
       AND flv.ATTRIBUTE2 = gcc.segment3)
  AND CAST(ara.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_START_TIMESTAMP,
                                                           1, 19),
                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_END_TIMESTAMP,

                                                                                            1,
                                                                                            19),

                                                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
```

### Query #30

SELECT gcc.segment2 filial , flv.ATTRIBUTE3 Centro_custo,rcta.customer_trx_id,
       rctla.customer_trx_line_id,LPAD(SUBSTR(rcta.attribute2,
                                         -2),

### Query #32

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, HZ_LOCATIONS, RA_TERMS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_PARTY_SITES, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS...`

### Query #32

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Order Management, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, DOO_SALES_CREDITS, DOO_DOCUMENT_REFERENCES, RA_TERMS, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, JTF_RS_SALESREPS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dha.header_id, hca.account_number AS accountCode,
                dha.order_number AS oracleCode, TO_CHAR(dha.creation_date,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate,
                hou.name AS companyCode,

  (SELECT jrs.salesrep_number
   FROM doo_sales_credits dsc
   JOIN jtf_rs_salesreps jrs ON jrs.resource_id = dsc.salesperson_id
   WHERE dsc.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS representativeCode,

  (SELECT iop.organization_code
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   JOIN inv_org_parameters iop ON iop.organization_id = dfl.fulfill_org_id
   WHERE dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS branchCode, dha.order_type_code AS salesTypeCode,
                TO_CHAR(dha.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS requestDate,

  (SELECT rt.name
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   JOIN ra_terms rt ON rt.term_id = dfl.payment_term_id_f
   WHERE dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS paymentConditionCode,

  (SELECT rm.name
   FROM doo_headers_eff_b dff
   JOIN ar_receipt_methods rm ON rm.receipt_method_id = TO_NUMBER(dff.attribute_char3)
   WHERE dff.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS paymentMethodCode, dha.transactional_currency_code AS currencyCode,

  (SELECT dfl.fob_point_code
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   WHERE dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS freightType,

  (SELECT hl.address1
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS publicPlace,

  (SELECT hl.address2
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS numberPlace,

  (SELECT hl.address3
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS complement,

  (SELECT hl.address4
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS neighborhood,

  (SELECT hl.city
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS cityCode,

  (SELECT hl.state
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS stateCode,

  (SELECT hl.country
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS countryCode,

  (SELECT hl.postal_code
   FROM hz_locations hl ,hz_party_sites hps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE hl.location_id = hps.location_id
     AND hps.party_id = hp.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS zipCode,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(jfdra.fiscal_doc_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
   FROM wsh_delivery_details wdd ,wsh_delivery_assignments wda ,jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdha ,
        jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdra ,doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   WHERE wdd.delivery_detail_id = wda.delivery_detail_id
     AND wda.delivery_id = jfdha.trx_id
     AND jfdha.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
     AND dfl.fulfill_line_id = wdd.source_shipment_id
     AND dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND wdd.released_status = 'C'
     AND jfdra.trx_id = wda.delivery_id
     AND jfdra.status = 'APPROVED'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS billingDate,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(dfl.schedule_arrival_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   WHERE dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS deliveryDate,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(dfl.schedule_ship_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   WHERE dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS reservationDate,

  (SELECT MAX(dff.attribute_char10)
   FROM doo_headers_eff_b dff
   WHERE dff.header_id =
       (SELECT dha_orig.header_id
        FROM doo_headers_all dha_orig
        WHERE dha_orig.source_order_number =
            (SELECT MIN(dcr.doc_user_key)
             FROM doo_document_references dcr
             WHERE dcr.header_id = dha.header_id
               AND dcr.doc_ref_type = 'ORIGINAL_SALES_ORDER')
          AND ROWNUM = 1)
     AND dff.context_code = 'InformacoesDaOrdem') AS salesforceOrderNumber,

  (SELECT MAX(hps.party_site_id)
   FROM hz_party_sites hps
   WHERE hps.party_id =
       (SELECT MAX(dha_orig.sold_to_party_id)
        FROM doo_headers_all dha_orig
        WHERE dha_orig.source_order_number =
            (SELECT MIN(dcr.doc_user_key)
             FROM doo_document_references dcr
             WHERE dcr.header_id = dha.header_id
               AND dcr.doc_ref_type = 'ORIGINAL_SALES_ORDER'))) AS originalPartySiteId
FROM hz_party_sites hps ,doo_headers_all dha
JOIN hz_cust_accounts hca ON hca.party_id = dha.sold_to_party_id
LEFT JOIN hr_operating_units hou ON hou.organization_id = dha.org_id
WHERE dha.submitted_flag = 'Y'
```
