### Query #33

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CODE_ASSIGNMENTS, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B`

### Query #33

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CODE_ASSIGNMENTS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hp.party_name, iop.organization_code, NULL line_number, NULL source_line_id,
                                                                             NULL AS order_key,
                                                                             hp.country AS pais,
                                                                             tipocontr.class_code AS tipocontribuinte,
                                                                             condcontr.class_code AS condicaocontribuinte,
                                                                             fin.description AS finalidadeitem,
                                                                             NULL AS atoconcessorio,
                                                                             fabu.bu_name AS bu,
                                                                             SUBSTR(registered_name,

                                                                               LENGTH(alternate_registered_name || ' - ') + 1) AS lru,
                                                                             ncm.category_name AS ncm,
                                                                             unid.description AS unidadeprodutora,
                                                                             hla.region_2 AS uforigem,
                                                                             hl.state AS ufdestino,
                                                                             cest.category_name AS cest,
                                                                             fd_original_cfop AS cfopanterior,
                                                                             cfdlb.product_category classtrib
FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb, egp_system_items_b esib, inv_org_parameters iop,
     fun_all_business_units_v fabu, hz_parties hp, hz_party_sites hps, hz_locations hl, hr_locations hla,
     hz_cust_accounts hca,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') fin,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_CEST_CODE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') cest,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code IN ('PLU_UNID_PRODUZIDA_E_CONVENIO','PLU_CONDICAO_FISCAL')
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') unid,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') ncm, xle_associations xa, xle_registrations xr, zx_party_tax_profile tp,
     zx_registrations zr,

  (SELECT hcaa.class_code, hcaa.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcaa
   WHERE hcaa.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcaa.class_category = 'ORGANIZATION_TYPE'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcaa.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcaa.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)) tipocontr,

  (SELECT hcab.class_code, hcab.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcab
   WHERE hcab.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcab.class_category = 'PLU_COND_CONTR'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcab.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcab.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)
     AND hcab.creation_date =
       (SELECT MAX(hcab_inner.creation_date)
        FROM hz_code_assignments hcab_inner
        WHERE hcab_inner.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
          AND hcab_inner.class_category = 'PLU_COND_CONTR'
          AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcab_inner.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcab_inner.end_date_active,
                                                                               SYSDATE)
          AND hcab_inner.owner_table_id = hcab.owner_table_id)) condcontr, INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V IODV
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND cfdlb.item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND esib.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND fabu.bu_id = iop.business_unit_id
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
  AND hca.party_id = hp.party_id
  AND hps.party_id = hca.party_id
  AND iop.organization_id = iodv.organization_id
  AND iodv.location_id = hla.location_id
  AND fin.inventory_item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND fin.organization_id(+) = esib.organization_id
  AND cest.inventory_item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND cest.organization_id(+) = esib.organization_id
  AND unid.inventory_item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND unid.organization_id(+) = esib.organization_id
  AND ncm.inventory_item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND ncm.organization_id(+) = esib.organization_id
  AND iop.organization_id = xa.object_id(+)
  AND xa.subject_id = xr.source_id
  AND hps.party_site_id = tp.party_id(+)
  AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id(+)
  AND ((esib.sales_product_type LIKE '%GOODS%'
        AND zr.tax = 'ICMS')
       OR (esib.sales_product_type NOT LIKE '%GOODS%'
           AND zr.tax = 'ISS')
       OR (zr.tax IS NULL))
  AND tipocontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND condcontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND esib.item_number = NVL(:P_ITEM_NUMBER, esib.item_number)
  AND hp.party_id = NVL(:P_PARTY_ID, hp.party_id)
  AND hps.party_site_id = NVL(:P_PARTY_SITE_ID, hps.party_site_id)
  AND hca.cust_account_id = NVL(:P_CUSTOMER_ID, hca.cust_account_id)
  AND iop.organization_code = NVL(:P_WAREHOUSE,
                                iop.organization_code)
  AND cfdlb.creation_date(+) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                  -6)
  AND (cfdlb.creation_date IS NULL
       OR cfdlb.creation_date =
         (SELECT MAX(cfdlb2.creation_date)
          FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb2
          WHERE cfdlb2.creation_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                          -6)
            AND cfdlb2.item_id = cfdlb.item_id))
```

### Query #35

### Query #35

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CODE_ASSIGNMENTS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT dha.order_type_code,
       DECODE(dfla.subinventory, NULL, 'GRUPO', dfla.subinventory) AS subinventory, dfla.trx_business_category AS trx_business_category,
       dla.line_number AS line_number, dfla.fulfill_line_id AS fulfill_line_id,
       dla.source_line_id AS source_line_id, dha.source_order_system || ':' || dha.header_id AS order_key,
       hp.country AS pais, tipocontr.class_code AS tipocontribuinte,
       condcontr.class_code AS condicaocontribuinte, fin.description AS finalidadeitem,
       taxc.category_name AS taxclasscode, NULL AS atoconcessorio,
       fabu.bu_name AS bu,
       SUBSTR(registered_name, LENGTH(alternate_registered_name || ' - ') + 1) AS lru, ncm.category_name AS ncm, unid.description AS unidadeprodutora,
       hla.region_2 AS uforigem, hl.state AS ufdestino,
       cest.category_name AS cest, fd_original_cfop AS cfopanterior,
       CFDLB.PRODUCT_CATEGORY AS classtrib
FROM doo_headers_all dha, doo_lines_all dla, doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla,
     egp_system_items_b esib, inv_org_parameters iop, fun_all_business_units_v fabu,
     hz_parties hp, hz_party_sites hps, hz_locations hl,
     hr_organization_units hou, hr_locations_all hla, cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') fin,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_ORIGIN'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') taxc,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_CEST_CODE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') cest,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code IN ('PLU_UNID_PRODUZIDA_E_CONVENIO', 'PLU_CONDICAO_FISCAL')
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') unid,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') ncm, xle_associations xa, xle_registrations xr,
     zx_party_tax_profile tp, zx_registrations zr,

  (SELECT hcaa.class_code, hcaa.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcaa
   WHERE hcaa.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcaa.class_category = 'ORGANIZATION_TYPE'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcaa.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcaa.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)) tipocontr,

  (SELECT hcab.class_code, hcab.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcab
   WHERE hcab.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcab.class_category = 'PLU_COND_CONTR'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcab.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcab.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)
     AND hcab.creation_date =
       (SELECT MAX(hcab_inner.creation_date)
        FROM hz_code_assignments hcab_inner
        WHERE hcab_inner.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
          AND hcab_inner.class_category = 'PLU_COND_CONTR'
          AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcab_inner.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcab_inner.end_date_active,
                                                                               SYSDATE)
          AND hcab_inner.owner_table_id = hcab.owner_table_id)) condcontr
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND dla.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND dfla.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND dfla.line_id = dla.line_id
  AND dla.inventory_item_id = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND esib.organization_id = dfla.fulfill_org_id
  AND esib.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND fabu.bu_id = dha.org_id
  AND dha.sold_to_party_id = hp.party_id
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND hps.location_id = hl.location_id
  AND dfla.fulfill_org_id = hou.organization_id
  AND hou.location_id = hla.location_id
  AND fin.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND fin.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND taxc.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND taxc.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND cest.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND cest.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND unid.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND unid.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND ncm.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND ncm.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND iop.organization_id = xa.object_id(+)
  AND xa.subject_id = xr.source_id(+)
  AND hps.party_site_id = tp.party_id(+)
  AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id(+)
  AND ((esib.sales_product_type LIKE '%GOODS%'
        AND zr.tax = 'ICMS')
       OR (esib.sales_product_type NOT LIKE '%GOODS%'
           AND zr.tax = 'ISS')
       OR (zr.tax IS NULL))
  AND tipocontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND condcontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND dha.order_number = NVL(:p_order_number, dha.order_number)
  AND dha.header_id = NVL(:p_header_id, dha.header_id)
  AND cfdlb.item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND (cfdlb.creation_date IS NULL
       OR cfdlb.creation_date =
         (SELECT MAX(cfdlb2.creation_date)
          FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb2
          WHERE cfdlb2.creation_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                          -6)
            AND cfdlb2.item_id = cfdlb.item_id))
  AND (dfla.trx_business_category = 'SALES_TRANSACTION'
       OR dfla.trx_business_category IS NULL)
GROUP BY dha.order_type_code, DECODE(dfla.subinventory,
                                NULL, 'GRUPO', dfla.subinventory),
         dfla.trx_business_category, dla.line_number, dfla.fulfill_line_id, dla.source_line_id,
         dha.source_order_system || ':' || dha.header_id, hp.country, tipocontr.class_code, condcontr.class_code, fin.description,
         taxc.category_name, fabu.bu_name,
         SUBSTR(registered_name, LENGTH(alternate_registered_name || ' - ') + 1), ncm.category_name, unid.description, hla.region_2, hl.state,
         cest.category_name, fd_original_cfop, CFDLB.PRODUCT_CATEGORY
ORDER BY line_number
```

### Query #36

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CODE_ASSIGNMENTS, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

### Query #36

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CODE_ASSIGNMENTS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT CFDLB.PRODUCT_CATEGORY classtrib, wdd.delivery_detail_id source_line_number,
                dha.order_type_code AS order_type_code_om,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(wdd.subinventory,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS subinventory,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(wdd.trx_business_category,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS trx_business_category, NULL AS line_number, NULL AS source_line_id,
                wdd.source_header_id AS order_key,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hrl_from.country,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS pais,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(tipocontr.class_code,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS tipocontribuinte,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(condcontr.class_code,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS condicaocontribuinte,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(fin.description,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS finalidadeitem,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(taxc.category_name,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS taxclasscode, NULL AS atoconcessorio,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(fabu.bu_name,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS bu,
                SUBSTR(REGISTERED_NAME,
                  LENGTH(ALTERNATE_REGISTERED_NAME || ' - ') + 1) AS lru,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(ncm.description,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS ncm,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(unid.description,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS unidadeprodutora,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hrl_from.region_2,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS uforigem,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hzl_to.REGION_2,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS ufdestino,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(cest.category_name,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS cest,
                TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(cfdlb.fd_original_cfop,
                               CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')) AS cfopanterior
FROM egp_system_items_b esib, wsh_delivery_details wdd, inv_org_parameters iop,
     fun_all_business_units_v fabu, hr_locations_all hzl_to, hr_locations_all hrl_from,
     cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb, xle_associations xa, xle_registrations xr, zx_party_tax_profile tp,
     zx_registrations zr,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id
     AND dt.language = 'PTB') fin,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_ORIGIN'
     AND dt.language = 'PTB'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id) taxc,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.category_name
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_CEST_CODE'
     AND dt.language = 'PTB'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id) cest,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code IN ('PLU_UNID_PRODUZIDA_E_CONVENIO', 'PLU_CONDICAO_FISCAL')
     AND dt.language = 'PTB'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id) unid,

  (SELECT a.inventory_item_id, a.organization_id, dt.description
   FROM egp_item_categories a, egp_category_sets_b e, egp_categories_b d, egp_categories_tl dt
   WHERE e.category_set_id = a.category_set_id
     AND e.catalog_code = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE'
     AND dt.language = 'PTB'
     AND d.category_id = a.category_id
     AND dt.category_id = d.category_id) ncm,

  (SELECT hcaa.class_code, hcaa.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcaa
   WHERE hcaa.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcaa.class_category = 'ORGANIZATION_TYPE'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcaa.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcaa.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)) tipocontr,

  (SELECT hcab.class_code, hcab.owner_table_id AS party_tax_profile_id
   FROM hz_code_assignments hcab
   WHERE hcab.owner_table_name = 'ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE'
     AND hcab.class_category = 'PLU_COND_CONTR'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(hcab.start_date_active, SYSDATE) AND NVL(hcab.end_date_active,
                                                                    SYSDATE)) condcontr, hz_party_sites hzps_to, doo_headers_all dha
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND wdd.source_header_number = NVL(:P_ORDER_NUMBER,
                                   wdd.source_header_number)
  AND wdd.delivery_detail_id = NVL(:P_SHIPMENT_LINE,
                                 wdd.delivery_detail_id)
  AND iop.organization_code = nvl(:P_WAREHOUSE,
                                iop.organization_code)
  AND esib.item_number = NVL(:P_ITEM_NUMBER, esib.item_number)
  AND wdd.subinventory = NVL(:P_SUBINVENTORY, wdd.subinventory)
  AND esib.organization_id = wdd.organization_id
  AND esib.inventory_item_id = wdd.inventory_item_id
  AND iop.organization_id = wdd.organization_id
  AND fabu.bu_id = iop.business_unit_id
  AND HZL_TO.location_id(+) = wdd.ship_to_location_id
  AND hrl_from.location_id(+) = wdd.ship_from_location_id
  AND fin.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND fin.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND taxc.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND taxc.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND cest.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND cest.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND unid.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND unid.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND ncm.inventory_item_id (+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND ncm.organization_id (+) = esib.organization_id
  AND wdd.organization_id = xa.object_id(+)
  AND xa.subject_id = xr.source_id(+)
  AND tp.party_id (+) = wdd.SHIP_TO_PARTY_ID
  AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id(+)
  AND tipocontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND condcontr.party_tax_profile_id(+) = tp.party_tax_profile_id
  AND ((esib.sales_product_type LIKE '%GOODS%'
        AND zr.tax = 'ICMS')
       OR (esib.sales_product_type NOT LIKE '%GOODS%'
           AND zr.tax = 'ISS')
       OR zr.tax IS NULL)
  AND cfdlb.item_id(+) = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND (cfdlb.creation_date IS NULL
       OR cfdlb.creation_date =
         (SELECT MAX(cfdlb2.creation_date)
          FROM cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_b cfdlb2
          WHERE cfdlb2.creation_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                          -6)
            AND cfdlb2.item_id = cfdlb.item_id))
  AND dha.order_number (+)= wdd.SOURCE_HEADER_NUMBER
GROUP BY wdd.delivery_detail_id, dha.order_type_code,
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(wdd.subinventory, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(wdd.trx_business_category, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), wdd.source_header_id,
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hrl_from.country, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(tipocontr.class_code,

                                                                                            CHR(10),
                                                                                            ''),

                                                                                    CHR(13),
                                                                                    '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(condcontr.class_code, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(fin.description,

                                                                                                CHR(10),
                                                                                                ''),

                                                                                        CHR(13),
                                                                                        '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(taxc.category_name, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(fabu.bu_name,

                                                                                              CHR(10),
                                                                                              ''),

                                                                                      CHR(13),
                                                                                      '')),
         SUBSTR(REGISTERED_NAME, LENGTH(ALTERNATE_REGISTERED_NAME || ' - ') + 1), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(ncm.description,

                                                                                                 CHR(10),
                                                                                                 ''),

                                                                                         CHR(13),
                                                                                         '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(unid.description, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hrl_from.region_2,

                                                                                            CHR(10),
                                                                                            ''),

                                                                                    CHR(13),
                                                                                    '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(hzl_to.region_2, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(cest.category_name,

                                                                                           CHR(10),
                                                                                           ''),

                                                                                   CHR(13),
                                                                                   '')),
         TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(cfdlb.fd_original_cfop, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '')), CFDLB.PRODUCT_CATEGORY
```

### Query #37

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `FA_ADDITIONS_B, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, FA_BOOK_CONTROLS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_EFF_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL, FA_BOOKS`

### Query #37

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_FULFILL_LINES_EFF_B, RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, FA_BOOK_CONTROLS, FA_BOOKS, FA_ADDITIONS_B, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT rcta.customer_trx_id AS customer_trx_id, rcta.trx_number AS numero_transacao_ar,
       DECODE(fdg.status, 'APPROVED', 'EMISSAO', 'CANCEL', 'CANCELAMENTO') acao_processamento, fa.asset_id AS ASSET_ID,
       fb.book_type_code AS BOOK_TYPE_CODE, fb.cost AS COST_RETIRED,
       GREATEST(rcta.last_update_date, ctt.last_update_date, fdg.last_update_date) AS data_atualizacao_status
FROM ra_customer_trx_all rcta
JOIN ra_cust_trx_types_all ctt ON rcta.cust_trx_type_seq_id = ctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id
JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all fdg ON rcta.customer_trx_id = fdg.trx_id
AND fdg.application_id = 222
AND fdg.entity_code = 'TRANSACTIONS'
AND fdg.event_class_code = 'INVOICE'
JOIN ra_customer_trx_lines_all rctl ON rcta.customer_trx_id = rctl.customer_trx_id
AND rctl.line_type = 'LINE'
AND rctl.interface_line_context = 'DOO'
JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b eff ON TO_CHAR(eff.fulfill_line_id) = rctl.interface_line_attribute6
AND eff.context_code = 'InformacoesDaLinha'
JOIN fa_additions_b fa ON fa.asset_id = eff.attribute_number4
JOIN fa_books fb ON fa.asset_id = fb.asset_id
AND fb.transaction_header_id_out IS NULL
JOIN fa_book_controls fbc ON fb.book_type_code = fbc.book_type_code
AND fbc.book_class = 'CORPORATE'
WHERE rcta.complete_flag = 'Y'
  AND fdg.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CANCEL')
  AND GREATEST(rcta.last_update_date, ctt.last_update_date, fdg.last_update_date) >= NVL(:P_RUN_DATE,

                                                                                       TO_DATE('1950-01-01',

                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD'))
ORDER BY data_atualizacao_status DESC
```

### Query #38

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, DUAL, HZ_PARTY_SITES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #38

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, DUAL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F, HZ_PARTY_SITES`

```sql
SELECT
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN nvl(
                         (SELECT 'Y' aplicar_retencao
                          FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
                          WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_CM_MOEDA_RETER_CREDITO'
                            AND flv.lookup_code =
                              (SELECT dha.transactional_currency_code
                               FROM doo_headers_all dha
                               WHERE dha.header_id = dfla.header_id)
                            AND flv.language = 'PTB') ,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND nvl(
                             (SELECT nvl(hcpf.credit_checking, 'N')
                              FROM hz_customer_profiles_f hcpf
                              WHERE hcpf.cust_account_id = hca.cust_account_id
                                AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(hcpf.effective_start_date,
                                                                   SYSDATE)) AND trunc(nvl(effective_end_date,

                                                                                         SYSDATE))
                                AND site_use_id IS NULL) ,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND nvl(
                             (SELECT 'Y'
                              FROM ra_cust_trx_types_all rctt
                              WHERE rctt.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID= dfla.billing_trx_type_id
                                AND rctt.accounting_affect_flag = 'Y') ,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END reter
   FROM dual) criarRetencao
FROM hz_party_sites hps ,hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcasa ,hz_cust_accounts hca ,
     hz_parties hp ,hz_cust_site_uses_all hcsu ,doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
WHERE 1=1
  AND hcasa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND hca.cust_account_id = hcasa.cust_account_id
  AND hp.party_id = hca.party_id
  AND hcasa.cust_acct_site_id = hcsu.cust_acct_site_id
  AND hcsu.site_use_code = 'BILL_TO'
  AND dfla.ship_to_party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND dfla.fulfill_line_id = :pFulfill_line_id
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  (SELECT haotl.organization_id
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f hao ,hr_organization_units_f_tl haotl
   WHERE hao.organization_id = haotl.organization_id
     AND haotl.language = userenv('LANG')
     AND haotl.effective_start_date = hao.effective_start_date
     AND haotl.effective_end_date = hao.effective_end_date
     AND ROWNUM = 1
     AND haotl.name = :p_businessunit) requestingbusinessunitid ,

  (SELECT carrier_name shippingcarrier
   FROM hz_parties x ,poz_suppliers_v s ,poz_supplier_address_v p ,
        hz_party_sites k ,zx_party_tax_profile t ,zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs w ,
        wsh_carriers_v wc
   WHERE x.party_id = s.party_id
     AND s.business_relationship = 'SPEND_AUTHORIZED'
     AND p.vendor_id = s.vendor_id
     AND k.party_id = x.party_id
     AND k.party_site_id = p.party_site_id
     AND t.party_id(+) = k.party_site_id
     AND w.effective_to(+) IS NULL
     AND w.entity_id(+) = t.party_tax_profile_id
     AND to_char(p.location_id) = wc.attribute1
     AND w.tax_payer_number = :p_shippingmethod) shippingcarrier ,

  (SELECT NAME
   FROM ra_salesreps rs
   WHERE rs.salesrep_number = nvl(:p_salesrepresentativecode, -3)
     AND rownum = 1) salesperson ,hca.cust_account_id customeraccountid ,hp.party_id partyid ,
                hps.party_site_id siteid ,hcsu.site_use_id siteuseid ,hp.party_number buyingpartynumber ,
                100 percent ,'Quota Sales Credit' salescredittype ,'PRICE_OVERRIDE' adjustmenttypecode ,
                                                                                    'QP_SALE_PRICE' chargedefinitioncode ,
                                                                                                    'ORA_SALES_NEGOTIATION' reasoncode ,
                                                                                                                            '1' sourcemanualpriceadjustmentid ,
                                                                                                                                NVL(
                                                                                                                                      (SELECT flv.DESCRIPTION
                                                                                                                                       FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES flv
                                                                                                                                       WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_PVF25_FLUXO_PEDIDO'
                                                                                                                                         AND flv.language = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                         AND flv.lookup_code = UPPER(TRIM(:P_ACTION))), 'PLU_GENERICO_SEM_OTM') transactionlinetypecode ,
                                                                                                                                'VD - PRODUCAO' billingtransactiontypename ,
                                                                                                                                                'VENDA PRODUCAO' ordertype ,
                                                                                                                                                                 '6101-Venda de Produtos do Estabelecimento' transactionbusinesscategoryname ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                             'RM ANALISE' userdefinedfiscalclass ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          '' firstpartytaxregistrationnumber ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             'DOO_HEADERS_ADD_INFO' categoryCodeHeader ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    'InformacoesDaOrdem' contextCodeHeader ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         'DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ADD_INFO' categoryCodeLines ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'InformacoesDaLinha' contextCodeLines ,

  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN nvl(
                         (SELECT 'Y' aplicar_retencao
                          FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
                          WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'PLU_CM_MOEDA_RETER_CREDITO'
                            AND flv.lookup_code = :p_Moeda
                            AND flv.language = 'PTB') ,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND nvl(
                             (SELECT nvl(hcpf.credit_checking, 'N')
                              FROM hz_customer_profiles_f hcpf
                              WHERE hcpf.cust_account_id = hca.cust_account_id
                                AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(hcpf.effective_start_date,
                                                                   SYSDATE)) AND trunc(nvl(effective_end_date,

                                                                                         SYSDATE))
                                AND site_use_id IS NULL) ,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND nvl(
                             (SELECT 'Y'
                              FROM ra_cust_trx_types_all rctt
                              WHERE rctt.name = 'VD - PRODUCAO'
                                AND rctt.accounting_affect_flag = 'Y') ,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END reter
   FROM dual) criaRetencao ,

  (SELECT receipt_method_id
   FROM
     (SELECT rm.receipt_method_id,
             CASE WHEN rcm.primary_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 2
             END prioridade
      FROM ra_cust_receipt_methods rcm ,ar_receipt_methods rm
      WHERE rcm.customer_id = hca.cust_account_id
        AND rcm.site_use_id IS NULL
        AND rcm.receipt_method_id = rm.receipt_method_id
      ORDER BY prioridade, rm.receipt_method_id DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) metodoName ,

  (SELECT ETB.NAME
   FROM XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES LEP , HR_OPERATING_UNITS HRO , HZ_PARTIES HP , ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE TP ,
        ZX_REGISTRATIONS ZR , XLE_ETB_PROFILES ETB
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND LEP.TRANSACTING_ENTITY_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND LEP.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = HRO.DEFAULT_LEGAL_CONTEXT_ID
     AND LEP.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = ETB.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
     AND HP.PARTY_ID = TP.PARTY_ID
     AND TP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZR.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
     AND ETB.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
     AND ZR.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL
     AND ZR.TAX = 'ICMS'
     AND ETB.MAIN_ESTABLISHMENT_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND HRO.SHORT_CODE = :p_businessunit) OrganizacaoDispendio ,

  (SELECT person_id
   FROM per_users
   WHERE username = 'INT.EXTENSIONS') RequesterId ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           hp.party_number accountNumberPVF21 ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           hps.party_site_number partySiteNumberPVF21 ,

  (SELECT HL.LOCATION_CODE SHIP_TO_LOCATION
   FROM HR_LOCATIONS HL , INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V IODV
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND IODV.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
     AND IODV.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :p_DestinationOrganization) DeliverToLocationCode ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           hp.party_name supplierName
FROM hz_party_sites hps ,hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcasa ,hz_cust_accounts hca ,
     hz_parties hp ,hz_cust_site_uses_all hcsu
WHERE 1=1
  AND hcasa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND hca.cust_account_id = hcasa.cust_account_id
  AND hp.party_id = hca.party_id
  AND hcasa.cust_acct_site_id = hcsu.cust_acct_site_id
  AND hcsu.site_use_code = 'BILL_TO'
  AND hps.party_site_id = :p_addresscode
```

### Query #40

**Tabelas:** `WSH_ORG_CARRIER_SERVICES, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, WSH_CARRIERS_V, HZ_PARTIES`

```sql
SELECT WC.CARRIER_NAME, HP.PARTY_NUMBER AS CARRIER_NUMBER, WOCS.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT,
       WOCS.SERVICE_LEVEL, WOCS.SHIP_METHOD_CODE, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
FROM WSH_CARRIERS_V WC
JOIN HZ_PARTIES HP ON WC.PARTY_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
JOIN WSH_ORG_CARRIER_SERVICES WOCS ON WC.CARRIER_ID = WOCS.CARRIER_ID
AND WOCS.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ON IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = WOCS.ORGANIZATION_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (WC.CARRIER_NAME = :P_CARRIER
       OR HP.PARTY_NUMBER = :P_CARRIER)
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :P_ORG_CODE
```

### Query #41

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, AR_ADJUSTMENTS, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL`

### Query #41

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, AR_ADJUSTMENTS, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL`

```sql
WITH TAB_AR AS
(SELECT DISTINCT hca.account_number
     , NULL          shipment
     , NULL          seq_shipment
     , (SELECT c.order_number
	       FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all a
		      , doo_lines_all             b
			  , doo_headers_all            c
		   WHERE a.sales_order_line = b.source_line_id
		     AND b.header_id        = c.header_id
			 AND a.customer_trx_id  = rcta.customer_trx_id
			 AND a.org_id           = b.org_id
			 AND c.org_id           = b.org_id
			 AND a.sales_order_line IS NOT NULL
			 AND ROWNUM = 1
	    ) order_number
	 , rcta.trx_number

	 ,(SELECT organization_code
	     FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all a
		    , inv_org_parameters b
		WHERE a.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
		  AND a.warehouse_id    = b.organization_id
		  AND ROWNUM            = 1) organization_code
	 , decode(rctt.attribute3, 'Y', 'I', 'O') billing_type

     , NULL placa
     , NULL debit_settlement
     , aps.amount_due_original
     , nvl((SELECT sum(abs(adj.acctd_amount))
	          FROM ar_adjustments adj
		     WHERE adj.payment_schedule_id = aps.payment_schedule_id
               AND adj.org_id              = aps.org_id
			   AND adj.acctd_amount < 0), 0) amount_discount
     , aps.amount_due_remaining
	 , aps.terms_sequence_number

     ,(

            FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI,

	 , (select ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER

                                 AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'

FROM ra_customer_trx_all              rcta
     , ra_cust_trx_types_all          rctt

     , ar_payment_schedules_all       aps
     , jl_br_ar_rec_met_accts_ext_all rm
     , ce_bank_accounts               baa
     , ce_bank_branches_v             bb

     , ar_receipt_classes             arc
     , hz_cust_accounts               hca
     , hz_cust_acct_sites_all         hcasa
	 , hz_parties                     hp
	 , hz_party_sites                 hps
	 , hz_locations                   hl
     , hr_all_organization_units_tl   hao
	 , hz_cust_site_uses_all          hcsu
	 , AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL ARMA
WHERE 1=1
   AND rctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id       = rcta.cust_trx_type_seq_id
   AND rcta.interface_header_context   = 'DOO'
   AND NVL(rctt.global_attribute1,'1') <> '09'
   AND rbs.batch_source_seq_id         = rcta.batch_source_seq_id
   AND aps.customer_trx_id             = rcta.customer_trx_id
   AND aps.status                      = 'OP'

   AND rm.receipt_method_id(+)         = rcta.receipt_method_id
   AND rm.org_id(+)                    = rcta.org_id

   AND baa.bank_account_id = rm.bank_account_id(+)
   AND NVL(baa.end_date, SYSDATE + 1)  > SYSDATE
   AND rcta.receipt_method_id          = arm.receipt_method_id
   AND arm.receipt_class_id            = arc.receipt_class_id

   AND rcta.bill_to_customer_id        = hca.cust_account_id
   AND hca.cust_account_id             = hcasa.cust_account_id
   AND hcasa.status                    = 'A'
   AND hca.party_id                    = hp.party_id
   AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id
   AND hp.party_id                     = hps.party_id
   AND hl.location_id                  = hps.location_id
   AND baa.bank_id                     = bb.bank_party_id
   AND baa.bank_branch_id              = bb.branch_party_id
   AND rcta.org_id                     = hao.organization_id
   AND hao.language                    = 'PTB'
   AND hcsu.site_use_id                = rcta.bill_to_site_use_id
   AND hcsu.cust_acct_site_id          = hcasa.cust_acct_site_id
   AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id

   AND   ARMA.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID        = ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
   AND   ARMA.ORG_ID				   = rcta.org_id
   AND   ARMA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID		   = baa.bank_account_id)
select ar.account_number,
       wdd.attribute3 shipment,

	   dha.order_number,
	   ar.trx_number,
	   jfdra.doc_num invoice_number,
	   ar.organization_code,
	   ar.billing_type,
	   CASE WHEN jfdra.contingency_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END contingency,
	   REPLACE((wnd.ATTRIBUTE5 || '|' || wnd.attribute6 || '|' || wnd.attribute7 || '|' || wnd.attribute8), '|||', '') placa,
	   jfdra.series,
	   jfdra.status status_sefaz,
	   jfdra.rejection_reason,
	   NULL debit_settlement,
       ar.amount_due_original,
       ar.amount_discount,
	   ar.amount_due_remaining,
	   ar.terms_sequence_number,
	   ar.due_date,
	   ar.bank_number,
       ar.bank_branch_number,
       ar.receipt_method_name,
	   ar.customer_name,
	   ar.bu_name,
	   null billing_status,
	   ar.CHECK_DIGITS,
       ar.document_type,
       ar.customer_trx_id,
       ar.payment_schedule_id,
       ar.portfolio_code,
       ar.conv,
       ar.interest_perc,
       ar.fine_perc,
       ar.receipt_method_id,
       ar.class_receipt,
       dha.org_id,
       ar.trx_date,
	   jfdra.fiscal_doc_key,
	   jfdra.last_update_date,
	   ar.customer_identity,
       ar.address,
	   ar.city,
	   ar.state,
	   ar.country,
	   ar.postal_code,
	   ar.state_tax_id,
	   ar.municipal_tax_id,
	   ar.instruction1,
       ar.instruction2,
	   dha.header_id,
	   wnd.ATTRIBUTE3 driver_name,
	   ar.bank_account_id
  from wsh_delivery_details      wdd
     , wsh_delivery_assignments  wda
	 , WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES        wnd
     , JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL      jfdha
	 , JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL jfdra
	 , doo_fulfill_lines_all     dhl
	 , doo_headers_all           dha
	 , HR_OPERATING_UNITS        hou
	 , inv_org_parameters        mp
	 , tab_ar                    ar
where wdd.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = wda.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
   and wda.delivery_id       = wnd.delivery_id
   and wda.delivery_id       = jfdha.trx_id
   and jfdha.doc_hdr_id      = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
   and dhl.fulfill_line_id   = wdd.source_shipment_id
   and dha.header_id         = dhl.header_id
   and wdd.released_status   = 'C'
   and jfdra.trx_id          = wda.delivery_id
   and hou.organization_id   = dha.org_id
   and mp.organization_id    = dhl.fulfill_org_id
   and jfdra.application_id  = 401
   and jfdra.STATUS          = 'APPROVED'
   AND TO_CHAR(jfdra.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >=
                                         NVL(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(jfdra.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
   AND ar.header_id          = dha.header_id
   AND ar.org_id             = dha.org_id
UNION ALL
SELECT distinct hca.account_number

                   HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS,

                   ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP,
                   FND_SETID_ASSIGNMENTS a,
                   FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V b
             WHERE ZPTP.PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID = ZPTI.ENTITY_ID
               AND HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
               AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
               AND ZPTP.SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
               AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF')
               AND HCASA.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
               AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
               AND a.REFERENCE_GROUP_NAME = 'HZ_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SITE'
               AND a.SET_ID = HCASA.SET_ID
               AND a.DETERMINANT_VALUE = b.BU_ID
               AND b.BU_ID = rcta.org_id
               AND HCASA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = hca.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1
       ) customer_identity
     , NVL(hl.address1,' ') address
     , NVL(hl.city,' ') city
     , NVL(SUBSTR(hl.state,1,2),' ') state
     , NVL(hl.country,' ') country
     , SUBSTR(REPLACE(hl.postal_code,'-',''),1,5)
       || '-'
       || SUBSTR(REPLACE(hl.postal_code,'-',''),6,3) postal_code
     , NULL state_tax_id
     , NULL municipal_tax_id
     , rm.bank_instruction_code1
     , rm.bank_instruction_code2
     , NULL header_id
     , NULL driver_name

FROM ra_customer_trx_all              rcta
   , ra_cust_trx_types_all            rctt

   , ar_payment_schedules_all         aps
   , jl_br_ar_rec_met_accts_ext_all   rm

   , ce_bank_branches_v               bb
   , ar_receipt_methods               arm

   , hz_cust_accounts                 hca

   , hz_locations                     hl
   , hr_all_organization_units_tl     hao
   , hz_cust_site_uses_all            hcsu
   , ar_receipt_method_accounts_all   arma
WHERE 1=1
  AND rctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id       = rcta.cust_trx_type_seq_id
  AND rbs.batch_source_seq_id         = rcta.batch_source_seq_id
  AND aps.customer_trx_id             = rcta.customer_trx_id
  AND aps.status                      = 'OP'
  AND rm.receipt_method_id(+)         = rcta.receipt_method_id
  AND rm.org_id(+)                    = rcta.org_id
  AND baa.bank_account_id             = rm.bank_account_id(+)
  AND NVL(baa.end_date, SYSDATE + 1)  > SYSDATE
  AND rcta.receipt_method_id          = arm.receipt_method_id
  AND arm.receipt_class_id            = arc.receipt_class_id
  AND rcta.bill_to_customer_id        = hca.cust_account_id
  AND hca.cust_account_id             = hcasa.cust_account_id
  AND hcasa.status                    = 'A'
  AND hca.party_id                    = hp.party_id
  AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id
  AND hp.party_id                     = hps.party_id
  AND hl.location_id                  = hps.location_id
  AND baa.bank_id                     = bb.bank_party_id
  AND baa.bank_branch_id              = bb.branch_party_id
  AND rcta.org_id                     = hao.organization_id
  AND hao.language                    = 'PTB'
  AND hcsu.site_use_id                = rcta.bill_to_site_use_id

  AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id

  AND arma.bank_account_id            = baa.bank_account_id
  AND rcta.trx_class                  = 'INV'
  AND rctt.default_status             = 'OP'
  AND rcta.complete_flag              = 'Y'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all rctl
         WHERE rctl.customer_trx_id = rcta.customer_trx_id
           AND rctl.sales_order_line IS NOT NULL
      )
AND TO_CHAR(rcta.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >=
    NVL(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
        TO_CHAR(rcta.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))

UNION ALL

            FROM ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI,

            AND TRUNC (SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM, TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO, TRUNC (SYSDATE + 1))
            AND HCASA.PARTY_SITE_ID      = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID

                                                                                                  ,NULL
                                                                                                  ,', ')
                                                                                           ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                                                                           ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                                                                               || TRANSLATE(hl.address4
                                                                                           ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                                                                           ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                                                                               || '  ' || TRANSLATE(hl.address2
                                                                                                   ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                                                                                   ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                          ,' ') AS address
                     , NVL(TRANSLATE(hl.city
                                    ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                    ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                          ,' ') AS city
                     , NVL(TRANSLATE(SUBSTR(hl.state, 1, 2)
                                    ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                    ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                          ,' ') AS state
                     , NVL(TRANSLATE(hl.country
                                    ,'ãÃõÕçÇüÜâÂêÊôÔáÁàÀéÉíÍóÓúÚ!@#$%&*()_+=[]{}/\?:<>|'
                                    ,'aAoOcCuUaAeEoOaAaAeEiIoOuU            ')
                          ,' ') country
	 , SUBSTR(REPLACE(hl.postal_code
                      ,'-'
                      , '')
                      ,1
                      ,5) || '-' || SUBSTR(REPLACE(hl.postal_code
                                                         ,'-'
                                                         ,'')
                                                 ,
                                                 6,
                                                 3) postal_code
	 , (select ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
                                 from ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
                                     ,ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
                                 where HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
                                 AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = zpti.entity_id
                                 AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
                                 AND ZPTP.SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                 AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
                                 AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE in ('ORA_BR_IE')
                                 AND TRUNC (SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM, TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO, TRUNC (SYSDATE + 1))
                                 ) AS state_tax_id
	 , (select ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
                                 from ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS ZPTI
                                     ,ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE ZPTP
                                 where HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID = ZPTP.PARTY_ID
                                 AND zptp.party_tax_profile_id = zpti.entity_id
                                 AND ZPTP.PARTY_TYPE_CODE = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
                                 AND ZPTP.SITE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                 AND ZPTI.TAX_PAYER_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
                                 AND ZPTI.REPORTING_TYPE_CODE in ('ORA_BR_IM')
                                 AND TRUNC (SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_FROM, TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL (ZPTI.EFFECTIVE_TO, TRUNC (SYSDATE + 1))
                                 ) AS municipal_tax_id
     , rm.bank_instruction_code1 AS instruction1
     , rm.bank_instruction_code2 AS instruction2
	 , null header_id
     , null driver_name
     , baa.bank_account_id
FROM ra_customer_trx_all              rcta
     , ra_cust_trx_types_all          rctt
     , ra_batch_sources_all           rbs
     , ar_payment_schedules_all       aps
     , jl_br_ar_rec_met_accts_ext_all rm
     , ce_bank_accounts               baa
     , ce_bank_branches_v             bb
     , ar_receipt_methods             arm
     , ar_receipt_classes             arc
     , hz_cust_accounts               hca
     , hz_cust_acct_sites_all         hcasa
	 , hz_parties                     hp
	 , hz_party_sites                 hps
	 , hz_locations                   hl
     , hr_all_organization_units_tl   hao
     , jg_fscl_doc_relations_all      jfd
	 , hz_cust_site_uses_all          hcsu
	 , AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL ARMA
WHERE 1=1
   AND rctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id       = rcta.cust_trx_type_seq_id
   AND NVL(rctt.global_attribute1,'1') <> '09'
   AND rbs.batch_source_seq_id         = rcta.batch_source_seq_id
   AND aps.customer_trx_id             = rcta.customer_trx_id
   AND aps.status                      = 'OP'

   AND rm.receipt_method_id(+)         = rcta.receipt_method_id
   AND rm.org_id(+)                    = rcta.org_id

   AND baa.bank_account_id = rm.bank_account_id(+)
   AND NVL(baa.end_date, SYSDATE + 1)  > SYSDATE
   AND rcta.receipt_method_id          = arm.receipt_method_id
   AND arm.receipt_class_id            = arc.receipt_class_id

   AND rcta.bill_to_customer_id        = hca.cust_account_id
   AND hca.cust_account_id             = hcasa.cust_account_id
   AND hcasa.status                    = 'A'
   AND hca.party_id                    = hp.party_id
   AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id
   AND hp.party_id                     = hps.party_id
   AND hl.location_id                  = hps.location_id
   AND baa.bank_id                     = bb.bank_party_id
   AND baa.bank_branch_id              = bb.branch_party_id
   AND rcta.org_id                     = hao.organization_id
   AND hao.language                    = 'PTB'
   AND rcta.customer_trx_id            = jfd.trx_id
   AND jfd.application_id              = 222
   AND TO_CHAR(jfd.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >=
                                         NVL(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(jfd.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
   AND jfd.status                      = 'APPROVED'
   AND hcsu.site_use_id                = rcta.bill_to_site_use_id
   AND hcsu.cust_acct_site_id          = hcasa.cust_acct_site_id
   AND hcasa.party_site_id             = hps.party_site_id
   AND ARMA.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID          = ARM.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
   AND ARMA.ORG_ID				       = rcta.org_id
   AND ARMA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID		       = baa.bank_account_id
```
