```sql
      ,tab.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
      ,tab.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
FROM (
      SELECT nd.delivery_id                  AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER
            ,'OM'                            AS SOURCE
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER' THEN
                'Sales order shipment'
             WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN
                 'Returns to supplier shipment'
             WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'TRANSFER_ORDER' THEN
                 'Transfer order shipment'
             END                             AS EVENT_CLASS
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER' THEN
                (SELECT bu.bu_name
                 FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
                 WHERE bu.bu_id = dd.org_id
                 AND sysdate BETWEEN bu.date_from AND bu.date_to)
             WHEN dd.source_line_type IN ('TRANSFER_ORDER') THEN
                (SELECT bu.bu_name
                 FROM inv_transfer_order_headers toh
                 JOIN fun_all_business_units_v bu ON bu.bu_id = toh.req_bu_id  AND sysdate BETWEEN bu.date_from AND bu.date_to
                 WHERE toh.header_number = dd.source_header_number)
             WHEN dd.source_line_type IN ('RETURN_TO_VENDOR') THEN
                (SELECT bu.bu_name
                 FROM rcv_transactions rt
                 JOIN po_headers_all po ON po.po_header_id = rt.po_header_id
                 JOIN fun_all_business_units_v bu ON bu.bu_id = po.prc_bu_id AND sysdate BETWEEN bu.date_from AND bu.date_to
                 WHERE rt.fiscal_doc_line_id = dd.fiscal_doc_line_id
                 AND rt.destination_context = 'INVENTORY' AND rt.transaction_type = 'RETURN TO RECEIVING'
                 AND rownum = 1)
             END AS BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
            ,null                                AS TRANSACTION_BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
            ,nd.delivery_name                    AS TRANSACTION_NUMBER
            ,(SELECT distinct xrv.establishment_name
              FROM inv_org_parameters mp,
                   xle_associations xa,
                   xle_registrations XR,
                   xle_registrations_v xrv,
                   hz_parties hp,
                   zx_party_tax_profile tp,
                   zx_registrations zr
              WHERE mp.organization_id = xa.object_id
              AND xa.subject_id = xr.source_id
              AND hp.party_id = tp.party_id
              AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id

              AND XR.registration_number = xrv.registration_number
              AND mp.organization_code = SUBSTR(ouft.name, 1, INSTR(ouft.name, ' ') - 1)
              AND zr.tax = 'ICMS'
              AND xrv.establishment_name IS NOT NULL) AS LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_NAME
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER' THEN
                  'Goods shipment'
             WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN
                 'Return to supplier'
             WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'TRANSFER_ORDER' THEN
                 'Internal material transfers'
             END AS FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DETERMINANT_TYPE
            ,DECODE(dd.source_line_type,'RETURN_TO_VENDOR','4','1') AS DOCUMENT_NATURE
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type IN ('TRANSFER_ORDER','RETURN_TO_VENDOR') THEN
                90
             ELSE
                (SELECT DECODE(ct.accounting_affect_flag,'Y',18,90)
                 FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
                     ,ra_cust_trx_types_all ct
                 WHERE dfla.billing_trx_type_id = ct.cust_trx_type_seq_id
                 AND dfla.fulfill_line_id = dd.source_shipment_id
                 AND rownum = 1)
             END AS PAYMENT_METHOD
            ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'N','4',null)   AS GOODS_SERIES
            ,null                                           AS SERVICE_SERIES
            ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'Y','RPS',null) AS SERVICE_TYPE
            ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'Y','T',null)   AS SERVICE_SITUATION
            ,CASE WHEN nd.ship_method_code IS NULL THEN
                '9'
             ELSE
                nd.fob_code
             END                                            AS FREIGHT_TYPE
            ,null    AS WAGON_IDENTIFICATION
            ,null    AS FERRY_IDENTIFICATION
            ,CASE WHEN nd.ship_method_code IS NOT NULL THEN
                  nd.volume
             END AS GOODS_QUANTITY_CARRIED
            ,CASE WHEN nd.ship_method_code IS NOT NULL THEN
                  nd.volume_uom_code
             END AS GOODS_TYPE_CARRIED
            ,null    AS GOODS_BRAND_CARRIED
            ,null    AS SEAL_NUMBER
            ,CASE WHEN nd.ship_method_code IS NOT NULL THEN
                 nd.net_weight
             END    AS NET_WEIGHT
            ,CASE WHEN nd.ship_method_code IS NOT NULL THEN
                  nd.gross_weight
             END      AS GROSS_WEIGHT
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_MODEL
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES
            ,null     AS STATEMENT_OF_COMMITMENT
            ,null     AS PURCHASE_CONTRACT
            ,null   AS BATCH_NAME
            ,null     AS ISSUING_PURPOSE
            ,null     AS BILLING_TYPE
            ,null     AS APPROVER_SITE
            ,null     AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE
            ,null     AS HASH_CODE
            ,null     AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
            ,null     AS OPERATION_PURPOSE_CODE
            ,CASE WHEN (dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER') AND (dd.currency_code != 'BRL' OR dd.default_taxation_country != 'BR') THEN
                'JLxBRFsclHdrAtrbExtGoodsExport'
             END      AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
             ,CASE WHEN invoice_type.is_service = 'Y'
                      OR  0 < (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                FROM egp_item_cat_assignments itemcats,
                                     egp_category_sets_b catsets,
                                     egp_system_items_b items,
                                     inv_org_parameters org,
                                     egp_categories_tl ect,
                                     doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
                                WHERE catsets.category_set_id = itemcats.category_set_id
                                AND items.inventory_item_id = itemcats.inventory_item_id
                                AND org.organization_id = items.organization_id
                                AND itemcats.category_id=ect.category_id
                                AND ((catsets.control_level = 1 AND itemcats.organization_id = org.master_organization_id)
                                   OR (catsets.control_level = 2 AND itemcats.organization_id = org.organization_id ))
                                AND catsets.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
                                AND items.inventory_item_id = dfla.inventory_item_id
                                AND dfla.fulfill_line_id = dd.source_shipment_id)  THEN
                  null
               ELSE
                  'Y'
             END      AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_3
            ,'ORA_0'  AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_4
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_5
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_6
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_7
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_8
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_9
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_10
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_11
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_12
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_13
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_14
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_15
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_16
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_17
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_18
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_19
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_20
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
            ,null     AS INDUSTRY_TYPE
            ,DECODE(dd.source_line_type,'SALES_ORDER','LACLS_BR_ISV_CONTEXT') AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER' THEN
                (SELECT ct.attribute2
                 FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
                     ,ra_cust_trx_types_all ct
                 WHERE dfla.billing_trx_type_id = ct.cust_trx_type_seq_id
                 AND ct.attribute_category = 'LACLS_BR_REMITTANCE'
                 AND dfla.fulfill_line_id = dd.source_shipment_id
                 AND rownum = 1)
             END      AS ATTRIBUTE_1
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_2
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_3
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_4
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_5
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_6
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_7
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_8
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_9
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_10
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_11
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_12
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_13
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_14
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_15
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
            ,null     AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_1
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_2
            ,CASE WHEN (dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER') AND (dd.currency_code != 'BRL' OR dd.default_taxation_country != 'BR') THEN
                dd.ship_from_location_id
             END AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
            ,CASE WHEN (dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER') AND (dd.currency_code != 'BRL' OR dd.default_taxation_country != 'BR') THEN
                dd.ship_from_location_id
             END      AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
            ,null     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
        FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
        JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
        JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd ON da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
        JOIN (SELECT dd2.delivery_detail_id,
                     CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                       FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all l
                                       WHERE l.fulfill_line_id = dd2.source_shipment_id
                                       AND l.product_type = 'SERVICES') THEN
                          'Y'
                       ELSE
                          'N'
                     END AS is_service
                FROM wsh_delivery_details dd2) invoice_type ON invoice_type.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
        JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl ouft ON ouft.organization_id = nd.organization_id AND ouft.language = 'PTB'

        WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'OM'
        AND SUBSTR(ouft.name, 1, INSTR(ouft.name, ' ') - 1) = :P_ORGANIZATION_CODE
        AND nd.delivery_id = :P_SHIPMENT_NUMBER
        AND (REPLACE(dd.picked_from_subinventory, ' ', '_') = :P_SUBINVENTORY_CODE OR :P_SUBINVENTORY_CODE IS NULL)
        AND dd.source_line_type = :P_TYPE

        AND (:P_TRANSACTION_DATE IS NULL
             OR TRUNC(dd.last_update_date) >= TRUNC(CAST(:P_TRANSACTION_DATE AS DATE)))
		UNION ALL

        SELECT c.customer_trx_id               AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER
              ,'AR'                            AS SOURCE
              ,DECODE(ct.type ,'DM','Debit Memo','Invoice') AS EVENT_CLASS
              ,bu.bu_name                      AS BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
              ,bs.name                         AS TRANSACTION_BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
              ,c.trx_number                    AS TRANSACTION_NUMBER
              ,(SELECT xrv.establishment_name
                FROM inv_org_parameters mp
                    ,xle_associations xa
                    ,xle_registrations xr
                    ,xle_registrations_v xrv
                    ,hz_parties hp
                    ,zx_party_tax_profile tp
                    ,zx_registrations zr
                WHERE mp.organization_id = xa.object_id
                AND xa.subject_id = xr.source_id
                AND hp.party_id = tp.party_id
                AND tp.party_tax_profile_id = zr.party_tax_profile_id

                AND xr.registration_number = xrv.registration_number
                AND zr.tax = 'ICMS'
                AND mp.organization_id = (SELECT l.warehouse_id
                                          FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all l
                                          WHERE l.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
                                          AND l.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
                                          AND rownum = 1)
                AND xrv.establishment_name IS NOT NULL
                AND rownum = 1) AS LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_NAME
              ,CASE WHEN bs.name in ('Distributed Order Orchestration', 'Manual')  AND (order_type.value <> 'DEVOLUCAO' OR order_type.value IS NULL) THEN
                  'Goods shipment'
               WHEN order_type.value LIKE '%COMPLEMENTO%' THEN
                  'Goods shipment'
               WHEN bs.name = 'Distributed Order Orchestration' AND order_type.value = 'DEVOLUCAO' THEN
                  'Return material authorization'
               WHEN invoice_type.is_service = 'Y' THEN
                  'Service invoice'
               END AS FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DETERMINANT_TYPE
              ,CASE WHEN bs.name in ('Distributed Order Orchestration', 'Manual') AND invoice_type.is_service = 'N'  THEN
                  '1'
               WHEN order_type.value = 'COMPLEMENTO DE PRECO' THEN
                  '2_PRICE'
               WHEN order_type.value = 'COMPLEMENTO DE IMPOSTO'  THEN
                  '2_TAX'
               WHEN order_type.value = 'DEVOLUCAO' THEN
                  '4'
               WHEN invoice_type.is_service = 'Y' THEN
                  NULL
               END  AS DOCUMENT_NATURE
              ,DECODE(ct.accounting_affect_flag,'Y',18,90)  AS PAYMENT_METHOD
              ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'N','4',null) AS GOODS_SERIES
              ,null           AS SERVICE_SERIES
              ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'Y','RPS',null) AS SERVICE_TYPE
              ,DECODE(invoice_type.is_service,'Y','T',null) AS SERVICE_SITUATION
              ,CASE WHEN c.ship_via IS NOT NULL THEN
                  '0'
               WHEN c.ship_via IS NULL OR order_type.value = 'COMPLEMENTO DE PRECO' THEN
                  '9'
               END     AS FREIGHT_TYPE
              ,null    AS WAGON_IDENTIFICATION
              ,null    AS FERRY_IDENTIFICATION
              ,null    AS GOODS_QUANTITY_CARRIED
              ,null    AS GOODS_TYPE_CARRIED
              ,null    AS GOODS_BRAND_CARRIED
              ,null    AS SEAL_NUMBER
              ,null    AS NET_WEIGHT
              ,null    AS GROSS_WEIGHT
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_MODEL
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES
              ,null    AS STATEMENT_OF_COMMITMENT
              ,null    AS PURCHASE_CONTRACT
              ,null    AS BATCH_NAME
              ,null    AS ISSUING_PURPOSE
              ,null    AS BILLING_TYPE
              ,null    AS APPROVER_SITE
              ,null    AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE
              ,null    AS HASH_CODE
              ,null    AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
              ,null    AS OPERATION_PURPOSE_CODE
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
              ,CASE WHEN invoice_type.is_service = 'Y'
                     OR  0 < (SELECT COUNT(*)
                              FROM egp_item_cat_assignments itemcats,
                                   egp_category_sets_b catsets,
                                   egp_system_items_b items,
                                   inv_org_parameters org,
                                   egp_categories_tl ect,
                                   ra_customer_trx_lines_all cl
                              WHERE catsets.category_set_id = itemcats.category_set_id
                              AND items.inventory_item_id = itemcats.inventory_item_id
                              AND org.organization_id = items.organization_id
                              AND itemcats.category_id=ect.category_id
                              AND ((catsets.control_level = 1 AND itemcats.organization_id = org.master_organization_id)
                                   OR (catsets.control_level = 2 AND itemcats.organization_id = org.organization_id ))
                              AND catsets.catalog_code = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
                              AND items.inventory_item_id = cl.inventory_item_id
                              AND cl.line_type = 'LINE'
                              AND cl.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id)  THEN
                  null
               ELSE
                  'Y'
               END     AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_3
              ,'ORA_0' AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_4
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_5
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_6
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_7
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_8
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_9
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_10
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_11
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_12
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_13
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_14
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_15
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_16
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_17
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_18
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_19
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_20
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
              ,null    AS INDUSTRY_TYPE
              ,'LACLS_BR_ISV_CONTEXT'    AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
              ,DECODE(ct.attribute_category,'LACLS_BR_REMITTANCE',ct.attribute2) AS ATTRIBUTE_1
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_2
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_3
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_4
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_5
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_6
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_7
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_8
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_9
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_10
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_11
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_12
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_13
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_14
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_15
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
              ,null    AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_1
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_2
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
              ,null    AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
        FROM ra_customer_trx_all c
        JOIN ra_batch_sources_all bs ON bs.batch_source_seq_id = c.batch_source_seq_id
        JOIN ra_cust_trx_types_all ct ON ct.cust_trx_type_seq_id = c.cust_trx_type_seq_id
        JOIN fun_all_business_units_v bu ON bu.bu_id = c.org_id
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN bu.date_from AND bu.date_to
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT lkp.attribute1 value ,dh.order_number
                   FROM fnd_lookup_values lkp
                       ,doo_headers_all dh
                   WHERE lkp.lookup_type = 'ORA_DOO_ORDER_TYPES'
                   AND lkp.attribute_category = 'ValidacoesOrdemVenda'
                   AND lkp.meaning = dh.order_type_code) order_type ON c.interface_header_attribute1 = order_type.order_number
        JOIN (SELECT c2.customer_trx_id,
                       CASE
                           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                        FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all l2
                                        WHERE l2.customer_trx_id = c2.customer_trx_id
                                        AND l2.product_type = 'SERVICES'
                                        AND l2.line_type   = 'LINE')
                           THEN 'Y'
                           ELSE 'N'
                       END AS is_service
                FROM ra_customer_trx_all c2) invoice_type ON invoice_type.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id

        WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'AR'
        AND c.complete_flag != 'Y'
        AND c.creation_date >= :P_RUN_DATE ) tab
WHERE 1=1
```

```sql
	  FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd

      UNION ALL
      SELECT nd.delivery_id     AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER

	  WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'OM'
      AND dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT nd.delivery_id     AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER

      ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DAY

      ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
      ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
      ,null               AS HASH_CODE
      ,null               AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
      ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_NUMBER
FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da
  ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd
  ON da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
JOIN (
        SELECT cur.i i
              ,pi.delivery_id
              ,SUBSTR(
                    pi.full_text,
                    DECODE(cur.i,1,1,241),
                    240
               ) header_detail_attribute
        FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       (
                           h.packing_instructions
                           || CASE
                                 WHEN nd.attribute3 IS NOT NULL
                                   OR nd.attribute5 IS NOT NULL
                                   OR nd.attribute6 IS NOT NULL
                                   OR nd.attribute7 IS NOT NULL
                                   OR nd.attribute8 IS NOT NULL
                                 THEN
                                        CASE
                                           WHEN nd.attribute3 IS NOT NULL
                                           THEN ' | Motorista: ' || nd.attribute3
                                           ELSE ''
                                        END
                                     || CASE
                                           WHEN nd.attribute5 IS NOT NULL
                                           THEN ' | Cavalo: ' || nd.attribute5
                                           ELSE ''
                                        END
                                     || CASE
                                           WHEN nd.attribute6 IS NOT NULL
                                           THEN ' | Carreta1: ' || nd.attribute6
                                           ELSE ''
                                        END
                                     || CASE
                                           WHEN nd.attribute7 IS NOT NULL
                                           THEN ' | Carreta2: ' || nd.attribute7
                                           ELSE ''
                                        END
                                     || CASE
                                           WHEN nd.attribute8 IS NOT NULL
                                           THEN ' | Carreta3: ' || nd.attribute8
                                           ELSE ''
                                        END
                                 ELSE ''
                              END
                       ) full_text,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                           PARTITION BY dfla.fulfill_line_id
                           ORDER BY lae.object_version_number DESC
                       ) rn,
                       da.delivery_id
                FROM doo_headers_all h
                JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla
                  ON h.header_id = dfla.header_id
                JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd
                  ON dfla.fulfill_line_id = dd.source_shipment_id
                JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da
                  ON da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
                JOIN wsh_new_deliveries nd
                  ON nd.delivery_id = da.delivery_id
                LEFT JOIN jg_fscl_lines_atrb_ext_all lae
                  ON lae.trx_id = da.delivery_id
                 AND lae.entity_code = 'SHIPMENTS'
                WHERE h.packing_instructions IS NOT NULL
             ) pi,
             (
                SELECT LEVEL i
                  FROM dual
            CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 10
             ) cur
        WHERE NVL(pi.rn,1) = 1
          AND SUBSTR(
                pi.full_text,
                DECODE(cur.i,1,1,241),
                240
              ) IS NOT NULL
     ) instructions
  ON instructions.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
 AND dd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER'
 AND instructions.header_detail_attribute IS NOT NULL
WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'OM'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT nd.delivery_id     AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER
            ,8                  AS RECORD_TYPE
            ,'OM'               AS SOURCE

            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE2

            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DEDUCTION_AMOUNT

            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_6
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_7
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_8
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_9
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_10
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_11
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_12
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_13
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_14
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_15
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
            ,DECODE(dd.source_line_type,'RETURN_TO_VENDOR','ORA_INTERNAL_INBOUND','ORA_INTERNAL_OUTBOUND') AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN cfdh.invoice_num ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
    		,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN cfdh.access_key_number ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char13, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_MODEL
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
            ,null               AS HASH_CODE
            ,null               AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
            ,CASE WHEN dd.source_line_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN cfdl.line_number ELSE NULL END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_NUMBER
	  FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
	  JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
	  JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd ON da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
	  JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dfl.fulfill_line_id = dd.source_shipment_id
	  JOIN doo_headers_all dha ON dha.header_id = dfl.header_id
	  JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b dflb ON dflb.fulfill_line_id = dfl.fulfill_line_id
	  JOIN (
    		SELECT LEVEL lvl
    		  FROM dual
    	CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 100
								) splitter ON lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(dflb.attribute_char11, ',') + 1
	  LEFT JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_headers cfdh ON cfdh.invoice_num = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) AND cfdh.document_status = 'CAPTURED'
	  LEFT JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_vl cfdl ON cfdl.document_header_id = cfdh.document_header_id
	  LEFT JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_vl cfdl ON cfdl.document_header_id = cfdh.document_header_id AND cfdl.item_id = dfl.inventory_item_id
      WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'OM'
	    AND dha.change_version_number = (SELECT MAX(t.change_version_number)
    									   FROM doo_headers_all t
    								     WHERE t.source_order_id = dha.source_order_id)
        AND TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL

      SELECT c.customer_trx_id  AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER
            ,7                  AS RECORD_TYPE
            ,'AR'               AS SOURCE
            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE1
            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE2
            ,DECODE(c.trx_business_category,'SALES_TRANSACTION',c.comments || ' | Pedido: ' || c.interface_header_attribute1,c.comments) AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE3
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DAY
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_QUANTITY_PER_DAY
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DEDUCTION_AMOUNT
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DEDUCTION_DESCRIPTION
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_6
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_7
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_8
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_9
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_10
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_11
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_12
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_13
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_14
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_15
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_MODEL
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
            ,null               AS HASH_CODE
            ,null               AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_NUMBER
	  FROM ra_customer_trx_all c
	  WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'AR'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT c.customer_trx_id  AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER
            ,8                  AS RECORD_TYPE
            ,'AR'               AS SOURCE
            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE1
            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE2
            ,null               AS HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE3
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DAY
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_QUANTITY_PER_DAY
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DEDUCTION_AMOUNT
            ,null               AS SUGARCANE_DEDUCTION_DESCRIPTION
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_6
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_7
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_8
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_9
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_10
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_11
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_12
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_13
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_14
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_15
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4
            ,null               AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5
            ,CASE WHEN rctt.attribute3 = 'Y' THEN 'ORA_INTERNAL_OUTBOUND' ELSE 'ORA_INTERNAL_INBOUND' END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE
            ,CASE WHEN rctt.attribute3 <> 'Y' THEN cfdh.invoice_num ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
            ,CASE WHEN rctt.attribute3 <> 'Y' THEN cfdh.access_key_number ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char13, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) END  AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY
            ,null 				AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_MODEL
            ,null	            AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
            ,null               AS REFERENCE_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
            ,null               AS HASH_CODE
            ,null               AS SUBSTITUTION_REASON
            ,CASE WHEN rctt.attribute3 = 'Y' THEN cfdl.line_number ELSE NULL END AS REFERENCE_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_NUMBER
	  FROM ra_customer_trx_all c
	  JOIN ra_cust_trx_types_all rctt ON rctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id = c.cust_trx_type_seq_id
	  JOIN doo_headers_all dha ON dha.order_number = c.interface_header_attribute1
	  JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
	  JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b dflb ON dfl.fulfill_line_id = dflb.fulfill_line_id
	  JOIN (SELECT LEVEL lvl
    		  FROM dual
    	CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 100 ) splitter ON lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(dflb.attribute_char11, ',') + 1
	  LEFT JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_headers cfdh ON cfdh.invoice_num = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) AND cfdh.document_status = 'CAPTURED'
	  LEFT JOIN cmf_fiscal_doc_lines_vl cfdl ON cfdl.document_header_id = cfdh.document_header_id AND cfdl.item_id = dfl.inventory_item_id
  	  AND dha.change_version_number = (SELECT MAX(t.change_version_number)
                                          FROM doo_headers_all t
    									 WHERE t.source_order_id = dha.source_order_id)
      AND TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dflb.attribute_char11, '[^,]+', 1, lvl)) IS NOT NULL
	  AND :P_SOURCE = 'AR')tab
```

```sql
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5 ,shi.source_header_number AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER ,
          NULL AS LINE_DESCRIPTION ,NULL AS PREVIOUS_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_TYPE ,
          NULL AS PREVIOUS_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_KEY ,NULL AS PREVIOUS_FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_NUMBER ,
          NULL AS CUSTOMER_PO_NUMBER ,NULL AS CUSTOMER_PO_LINE_NUMBER ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1 ,

   FROM

                      dd.source_header_number
      FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
      JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
```

```sql
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_6 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_7 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_8 ,
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_9 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_10 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1 ,
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4 ,
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_6 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_7 ,
          NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_8 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_9 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_10 ,
          NULL AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER ,
          CASE
              WHEN shi.currency_code != 'BRL' THEN 'JLxBRFsclLnDtlAtrbExtGoodsExp'
          END AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_1 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_2 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_3 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_4 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_5 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_6 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_7 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_8 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_9 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_10 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_11 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_12 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_13 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_14 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_15 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_16 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_17 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_18 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_19 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_20 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_6 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_7 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_8 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_9 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_10 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_6 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_7 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_8 ,
          NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_9 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_10
   FROM
     (SELECT DISTINCT nd.delivery_id, dd.delivery_detail_id, dd.source_line_number,
                      dd.source_header_number, dd.currency_code
      FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
      JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
      JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd ON da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
      LEFT JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dl ON dd.source_shipment_id = dl.fulfill_line_id
      LEFT JOIN rcv_transactions rt ON rt.fiscal_doc_line_id = dd.fiscal_doc_line_id
      AND rt.destination_context = 'INVENTORY'
      AND rt.transaction_type = 'RETURN TO RECEIVING') shi
   WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'OM'
   UNION ALL SELECT c.customer_trx_id AS DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER ,'AR' AS SOURCE ,cl.customer_trx_line_id AS LINE_ID ,
                    to_char(cl.line_number) AS TRANSACTION_LINE_NUMBER ,to_char(cl.line_number) AS TRANSACTION_LINE_DETAIL_NUMBER ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2 ,
                    NULL AS TRANSACTION_LEVEL_TYPE ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_1 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_2 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_3 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_4 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_5 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_6 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_7 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_8 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_9 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_10 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_11 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_12 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_13 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_14 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_15 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_16 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_17 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_18 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_19 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_20 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_1 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_2 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_6 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_7 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_8 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_9 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_10 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_1 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_2 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_6 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_7 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_8 ,NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_9 ,
                    NULL AS ATTRIBUTE_DATE_10 ,NULL AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER ,
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.invoice_currency_code != 'BRL' THEN 'JLxBRFsclLnDtlAtrbExtGoodsExp'
                    END AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_1 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_2 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_3 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_4 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_5 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_6 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_7 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_8 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_9 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_10 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_11 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_12 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_13 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_14 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_15 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_16 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_17 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_18 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_19 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_20 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_3 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_4 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_5 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_6 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_7 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_8 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_9 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER_10 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_3 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_4 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_5 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_6 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_7 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_8 ,NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_9 ,
                    NULL AS GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_DATE_10
   FROM ra_customer_trx_all c
   JOIN ra_customer_trx_lines_all cl ON cl.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
   AND cl.line_type = 'LINE'
   WHERE :P_SOURCE = 'AR') tab
```

### Query #46

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_LINES_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #46

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS, AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dha.creation_date, dha.order_number numero_pedido, 'RECLASSIFICAR' status_reclassificacao,
                                                                                   hca.account_number,
                                                                                   hp.party_name cliente,
                                                                                   fabuv.bu_name bu,
                                                                                   NVL(
                                                                                         (SELECT MAX(arm_eff.name)
                                                                                          FROM ar_receipt_methods arm_eff
                                                                                          WHERE arm_eff.receipt_method_id = dhe.attribute_char3),'N/A') AS Metodo_recebimento,

  (SELECT SUM(NVL(dl_sum.extended_amount, 0))
   FROM doo_lines_all dl_sum
   WHERE dl_sum.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND dl_sum.open_flag = 'Y'
     AND dl_sum.canceled_flag = 'N') AS valor
FROM doo_headers_all dha, doo_headers_eff_b dhe, doo_lines_all dl,
     doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl, ra_cust_trx_types_all rctt, hz_cust_accounts hca,
     hz_parties hp, fun_all_business_units_v fabuv
WHERE dha.header_id = dhe.header_id(+)
  AND dhe.context_code = 'InformacoesDaOrdem'
  AND dha.header_id = dl.header_id
  AND dl.header_id = dfl.header_id
  AND dl.line_id = dfl.line_id
  AND dfl.billing_trx_type_id = rctt.cust_trx_type_seq_id(+)
  AND dha.sold_to_party_id = hca.party_id
  AND hca.party_id = hp.party_id
  AND dha.org_id = fabuv.bu_id
  AND dha.status_code = 'OPEN'
  AND dha.open_flag = 'Y'
  AND dha.canceled_flag = 'N'
  AND dl.open_flag = 'Y'
  AND dl.canceled_flag = 'N'
  AND dfl.canceled_flag = 'N'
  AND dfl.invoice_enabled_flag = 'Y'
  AND dfl.invoiceable_item_flag = 'Y'
  AND dfl.invoice_interfaced_flag = 'N'
  AND rctt.accounting_affect_flag (+)= 'Y'
  AND dha.creation_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(:P_CREATION_DATE,
                                          'Z', ''),
                             'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
  AND (EXISTS
         (SELECT 1
          FROM ra_cust_receipt_methods rcrm, ar_receipt_methods arm
          WHERE rcrm.customer_id = hca.cust_account_id
            AND rcrm.receipt_method_id = arm.receipt_method_id
            AND rcrm.primary_flag = 'Y'
            AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(rcrm.start_date,
                                         TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(rcrm.end_date,
                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))
            AND UPPER(TRIM(arm.name)) = 'RECLASSIFICAR')
       OR EXISTS
         (SELECT 1
          FROM ar_receipt_methods arm_eff
          WHERE arm_eff.receipt_method_id = dhe.attribute_char3
            AND UPPER(TRIM(arm_eff.name)) = 'RECLASSIFICAR')
       OR TRIM(dhe.attribute_char3) IS NULL
       OR NOT EXISTS
         (SELECT 1
          FROM ar_receipt_method_accounts_all arma_bu
          WHERE arma_bu.receipt_method_id = dhe.attribute_char3
            AND arma_bu.org_id = dha.org_id
            AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(arma_bu.start_date,
                                         TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(arma_bu.end_date,
                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))))
ORDER BY dha.order_number
```

### Query #47

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, AR_RECEIPT_METHODS, CE_BANKS_V, AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES, HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL...`

### Query #47

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ACCOUNTS_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, CE_BANKS_V, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL, HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL, HZ_PARTIES, FND_SETID_SETS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES...`

```sql
SELECT c.org_id AS BUSINESS_UNIT ,c.trx_number AS SOURCE_REF_NUMBER ,b.bank_number AS BANK_NUMBER ,
       arm.name AS RECEIPT_METHOD ,c.customer_trx_id AS SOURCE_REF_ID ,ba.global_attribute1 AS PIX_KEY ,
       'TRANSACTION' AS SOURCE_REF_TYPE ,ps.terms_sequence_number AS SOURCE_REF_INSTALLMENT_NUMBER ,

  (SELECT tax.tax_payer_number
   FROM zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs tax
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile ptp ON ptp.party_tax_profile_id = tax.entity_id
   WHERE ptp.party_id = ship_ps.party_site_id
     AND ptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND tax.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
     AND rownum = 1) AS CNPJ ,ps.amount_due_remaining AS AMOUNT ,

  (SELECT tax.tax_payer_number
   FROM zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs tax
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile ptp ON ptp.party_tax_profile_id = tax.entity_id
   WHERE ptp.party_id = ship_ps.party_site_id
     AND ptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND tax.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CPF'
     AND rownum = 1) AS CPF ,

  (SELECT l.warehouse_id
   FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all l
   WHERE l.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
     AND l.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
     AND rownum = 1) AS ORGANIZATION_CODE ,p.party_name AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,sysdate AS DUE_DATE ,

  (SELECT nd.attribute_number1
   FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all cl ,doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla ,wsh_delivery_details dd ,
        wsh_delivery_assignments da ,wsh_new_deliveries nd
   WHERE cl.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
     AND dfla.fulfill_line_id = cl.interface_line_attribute6
     AND dd.source_shipment_id = dfla.fulfill_line_id
     AND da.delivery_detail_id = dd.delivery_detail_id
     AND nd.attribute_category = 'LACLS_BR_FDGAUT_HDR'
     AND nd.delivery_id = da.delivery_id
     AND nd.attribute_number1 IS NOT NULL
     AND rownum = 1) AS TRUCK_DRIVER_PHONE
FROM ra_customer_trx_all c
JOIN ar_payment_schedules_all ps ON ps.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
JOIN ar_receipt_methods arm ON arm.receipt_method_id = c.receipt_method_id
JOIN ar_receipt_classes arc ON arc.receipt_class_id = arm.receipt_class_id
JOIN ar_receipt_method_accounts_all rma ON rma.receipt_method_id = c.receipt_method_id
AND rma.org_id = c.org_id
JOIN ce_bank_accounts ba ON rma.bank_account_id = ba.bank_account_id
JOIN ce_banks_v b ON b.bank_party_id = ba.bank_id
LEFT JOIN hz_parties p ON p.party_id = c.bill_to_customer_id
JOIN hz_cust_site_uses_all ship_su ON c.bill_to_site_use_id = ship_su.site_use_id
JOIN hz_cust_acct_sites_all ship_cas ON ship_su.cust_acct_site_id = ship_cas.cust_acct_site_id
JOIN hz_party_sites ship_ps ON ship_cas.party_site_id = ship_ps.party_site_id
JOIN fnd_setid_sets aaa ON aaa.set_id = ship_su.set_id
WHERE arc.name = 'PIX'
  AND aaa.set_code = 'GRUPOPLUMA'
  AND aaa.language = 'PTB'
  AND c.customer_trx_id = :P_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
```

### Query #48

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES, OKC_K_HEADERS_ALL_B, DUAL, AR_RECEIVABLES_TRX_ALL, ZMM_SR_SCHEDULE_DTLS, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, RA_TERMS_B`

### Query #48

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `AR_RECEIVABLES_TRX_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, DUAL, RA_TERMS_B, AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES, OKC_K_HEADERS_ALL_B, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, ZMM_SR_SCHEDULE_DTLS`

```sql
SELECT invoice.SOURCE ,invoice.INSTALLMENT_ID ,invoice.HEARDER_ID ,invoice.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID ,
       invoice.ORG_ID ,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY invoice.hearder_id, invoice.source
                          ORDER BY invoice.original_due_date) AS INSTALLMENT_NUMBER ,invoice.SPECIAL_PAYMENT ,invoice.IS_DEBIT ,invoice.IS_PIX ,
       invoice.ORIGINAL_DUE_DATE ,
       NVL(
             (SELECT MIN(candidate_date)
              FROM
                (SELECT (invoice.original_due_date + LEVEL - 1) AS candidate_date
                 FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6)
              WHERE TO_CHAR(candidate_date,
                      'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') NOT IN ('SAT',
                                                           'SUN')
                AND NOT EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM zmm_sr_schedule_dtls s
                   WHERE s.avl_exception_id IS NOT NULL
                     AND candidate_date >= s.start_date_time
                     AND candidate_date < s.end_date_time)),invoice.original_due_date) AS NEW_DUE_DATE ,invoice.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT ,
       CASE
           WHEN contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_PERCENTAGE IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(invoice.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT - (invoice.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT * contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_PERCENTAGE),
                                                                             2) - NVL(contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_DISCOUNT,

                                                                                    0)
           ELSE invoice.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT - NVL(contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_DISCOUNT,
                                            0)
       END AS NEW_AMOUNT ,invoice.CURRENCY_CODE ,invoice.STATUS ,invoice.PARTY_NUMBER ,
       invoice.TRX_NUMBER ,invoice.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY ,lk.attribute2 AS RECEIVABLES_ACTITIVY ,
       TRUNC(-1 * (NVL(invoice.original_amount * contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_PERCENTAGE, 0) + NVL(contract_data.ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_DISCOUNT,

                                                                                                   0)), 2) AS ADJUSTMENT_VALUE ,contract_data.CONTRACT_ID AS CONTRACT_ID ,'DISCOUNT' AS REASON_CODE ,
       rta.receivables_trx_id AS RECEIVABLES_TRX_ID ,rta.set_of_books_id AS SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
FROM
  (SELECT 'AR' AS SOURCE ,ps.payment_schedule_id AS INSTALLMENT_ID ,
          NULL AS HEARDER_ID ,c.customer_trx_id AS CUSTOMER_TRX_ID ,
          NVL(
                (SELECT t.attribute1
                 FROM ra_terms_b t
                 WHERE t.attribute_category = 'PLU_GRUPOPLUMACP'
                   AND t.term_id = c.term_id),'N') AS SPECIAL_PAYMENT ,DECODE(ct.type,
                                                                         'DM', 'Y',
                                                                         'N') AS IS_DEBIT ,
          NVL(
                (SELECT DECODE(arc.name, 'PIX', 'Y', 'N')
                 FROM ar_receipt_classes arc , ar_receipt_methods arm
                 WHERE arm.receipt_class_id = arc.receipt_class_id
                   AND arm.receipt_method_id = c.receipt_method_id),'N') AS IS_PIX ,ps.due_date AS ORIGINAL_DUE_DATE ,
          ps.amount_due_original AS ORIGINAL_AMOUNT ,c.org_id AS ORG_ID ,
          ps.invoice_currency_code AS CURRENCY_CODE ,
          CASE WHEN ps.status = 'OP'
                   AND ps.amount_due_remaining > 0 THEN 'OP' ELSE 'CL'
          END AS STATUS ,hp.party_number AS PARTY_NUMBER ,
          hp.party_id AS PARTY_ID ,c.trx_number AS TRX_NUMBER ,
          c.attribute_category AS ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
   FROM ra_customer_trx_all c ,ra_cust_trx_types_all ct ,ar_payment_schedules_all ps ,hz_parties hp
   WHERE ct.cust_trx_type_seq_id = c.cust_trx_type_seq_id
     AND ps.customer_trx_id = c.customer_trx_id
     AND ct.accounting_affect_flag = 'Y'
     AND hp.party_id = c.sold_to_party_id
     AND ct.type <> 'CM'
     AND :P_SOURCE = 'AR'
     AND c.customer_trx_id = :P_DOCUMENT_IDENTIFIER) invoice
LEFT JOIN fun_all_business_units_v bu ON bu.bu_id = invoice.org_id
AND sysdate BETWEEN bu.date_from AND bu.date_to
LEFT JOIN fnd_lookup_values_vl lk ON lk.lookup_type = 'PLU_PVF04_PARAMETROS'
AND lk.enabled_flag = 'Y'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(lk.start_date_active, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(lk.end_date_active,

                                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND lk.meaning = bu.bu_name
LEFT JOIN ar_receivables_trx_all rta ON rta.name = lk.attribute2
AND rta.org_id = invoice.org_id
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT ch.attribute_number1 / 100 AS ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_PERCENTAGE ,ch.attribute_number2 AS ADJUSTMENT_VALUE_DISCOUNT ,
          ch.contract_id AS CONTRACT_ID ,pr.object1_id1 AS PARTY_ID ,
          oct.chr_type AS CONTRACT_TYPE ,ch.org_id AS ORG_ID
   FROM okc_k_headers_all_b ch ,okc_k_party_roles_b pr ,okc_contract_types_b oct
   WHERE ch.attribute_category = 'PLU_CONTRATOS_VENDA'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ch.start_date AND NVL(ch.end_date,
                                             SYSDATE)
     AND pr.chr_id = ch.id
     AND pr.rle_code = 'CUSTOMER'
     AND ch.contract_type_id = oct.contract_type_id
     AND ch.sts_code = 'ACTIVE') contract_data ON contract_data.party_id = invoice.party_id
AND contract_data.CONTRACT_TYPE = lk.attribute1
AND contract_data.org_id = invoice.org_id
```

### Query #49

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #49

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Order Management, FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, GL_DAILY_RATES, DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES`

```sql
SELECT hcpf.cust_account_profile_id , hcpf.cust_account_id ,
       (
          (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE
                              WHEN a.transactional_currency_code <> 'BRL'
                                   AND a.conversion_rate IS NOT NULL THEN c.extended_amount * a.conversion_rate
                              WHEN a.transactional_currency_code <> 'BRL'
                                   AND A.conversion_rate IS NULL THEN c.extended_amount *
                                     (SELECT MAX(conversion_rate)
                                      FROM gl_daily_rates
                                      WHERE from_currency = a.transactional_currency_code
                                        AND to_currency = 'BRL'
                                        AND conversion_date =
                                          (SELECT MAX(conversion_date)
                                           FROM gl_daily_rates
                                           WHERE from_currency = a.transactional_currency_code
                                             AND to_currency = 'BRL'
                                             AND conversion_date <= SYSDATE)) ELSE c.extended_amount
                          END) , 0)
           FROM doo_headers_all a , doo_lines_all b , doo_fulfill_lines_all c ,
                ra_cust_trx_types_all d
           WHERE b.header_id = a.header_id
             AND a.status_code = 'OPEN'
             AND a.open_flag = 'Y'
             AND b.open_flag = 'Y'
             AND a.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND b.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND c.canceled_flag = 'N'
             AND c.header_id = b.header_id
             AND c.line_id = b.line_id
             AND c.invoice_enabled_flag = 'Y'
             AND c.invoiceable_item_flag = 'Y'
             AND c.invoice_interfaced_flag = 'N'
             AND d.cust_trx_type_seq_id = c.billing_trx_type_id
             AND d.accounting_affect_flag = 'Y'
             AND a.change_version_number =
               (SELECT MAX(a1.change_version_number)
                FROM doo_headers_all a1
                WHERE a1.source_order_id = a.source_order_id)
             AND NOT EXISTS
               (SELECT 1
                FROM doo_hold_instances x , doo_hold_codes_b y
                WHERE transaction_entity_name1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                  AND active_flag = 'Y'
                  AND transaction_entity_id1 = c.fulfill_line_id
                  AND y.hold_code_id = x.hold_code_id
                  AND y.hold_code IN ('DOO_CREDIT_CHECK', 'PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO'))
             AND c.bill_to_customer_id = hca.cust_account_id)) +
  (SELECT SUM(apsa.amount_due_remaining)
   FROM ar_payment_schedules_all apsa
   WHERE apsa.customer_id = hca.cust_account_id
     AND apsa.class IN ('DM', 'INV')
     AND apsa.amount_due_remaining > 0
     AND apsa.status = 'OP') Valor_aberto ,
       ROUND(hcpf.credit_limit + (hcpf.credit_limit * (hcpf.tolerance / 100)), 2) limite_total_tol
FROM hz_cust_accounts hca , hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcasa , hz_cust_site_uses_all hsua ,
     hz_party_sites hps , hz_customer_profiles_f hcpf , hz_parties hp
WHERE hp.party_id = hca.party_id
  AND hca.cust_account_id = hcasa.cust_account_id
  AND hcasa.party_site_id = hps.party_site_id
  AND hsua.cust_acct_site_id = hcasa.cust_acct_site_id
  AND hsua.site_use_code = 'BILL_TO'
  AND hcpf.cust_account_id = hcasa.cust_account_id
  AND hcpf.status = 'A'
  AND hcpf.site_use_id IS NULL
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(effective_start_date,
                                     SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(effective_end_date,
                                                           SYSDATE))
  AND hca.cust_account_id = :P_CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
```

### Query #51

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash`

**Tabelas:** `HZ_PARTIES`

```sql
SELECT hp.party_id , hca.cust_account_id , hca.account_number numero_pessoa ,
       hp.party_name razao_social , hca.account_name nome_fantasia ,
       hca.attribute3 clifor_pluma , hca.attribute4 clifor_bello ,
       hca.attribute5 clifor_levo , hca.attribute6 canal_vendas ,
       hca.attribute7 segmento , hca.attribute8 ramo_atividade ,
       hca.attribute9 dia_visita , hca.attribute10 semana_faturamento ,
       TO_CHAR(hca.account_established_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') data_fundacao , TO_CHAR(hca.account_termination_date,

                                                                             'DD/MM/YYYY') data_inativacao ,
       hp.party_number , hcpc.name profile_class
FROM hz_parties hp , hz_cust_accounts hca , hz_customer_profiles_f hcpf ,
     hz_cust_profile_classes hcpc
WHERE 1=1
  AND hp.party_id = :P_PARTY_ID
  AND hp.party_id = hca.party_id
  AND hca.cust_account_id = hcpf.cust_account_id
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hcpf.effective_start_date AND hcpf.effective_end_date
  AND hcpf.profile_class_id = hcpc.profile_class_id
```

```sql
FROM ra_cust_receipt_methods rcrm , ar_receipt_methods arm
WHERE 1=1
  AND rcrm.receipt_method_id = arm.receipt_method_id
```

### Query #60

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_TL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES`

```sql
SELECT person_number , paf.addl_address_attribute3 tipo_logradouro ,
       fnd_log.lookup_code cod_tipo_logradouro ,
       TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_1,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') endereco , paf.address_line_2 numero ,
       TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_3,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') complemento ,
       TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_4,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') bairro , paf.region_2 uf , paf.town_or_city , paf.postal_code ,
       ibge.ibge_code , SUBSTR(ibge.ibge_code, 3) cidade , paf.country ,
       GREATEST(paf.last_update_date, pauf.last_update_date) last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_person_addr_usages_f pauf , per_addresses_f paf ,

  (SELECT hg.country_code , hg.geography_element2 state , hg.geography_name city ,
          hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
   FROM hz_geographies hg , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
   WHERE hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hgi.geography_id = hg.geography_id
     AND hgi.identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE') ibge ,

  (SELECT lookup_code , meaning
   FROM fnd_lookup_values_tl
   WHERE lookup_type = 'ORA_HRX_BR_ADDRESS_SITE_TYPE'
     AND LANGUAGE = 'PTB') fnd_log
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pauf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pauf.ADDRESS_ID = papf.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID
  AND pauf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_addr_usages_f
     WHERE person_addr_usage_id = pauf.person_addr_usage_id
       AND person_id = pauf.person_id)
  AND paf.address_id = pauf.address_id
  AND ibge.country_code(+) = paf.country
  AND ibge.state(+) = paf.region_2
  AND ibge.city(+) = paf.town_or_city
  AND fnd_log.meaning(+) = paf.addl_address_attribute3
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(paf.last_update_date, pauf.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                 GREATEST(paf.last_update_date,

                                                                   pauf.last_update_date))
```

### Query #61

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CE_BANK_BRANCHES_V, PAY_BANK_ACCOUNTS, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD, CE_INDEX_BANKS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'MERGE' METADATA , 'ExternalBankAccount' ExternalBankAccount , 'BRL' CURRENCY_CODE ,
                                                                                     'BR' COUNTRY_CODE ,
                                                                                          bnk.bank_name || '|' || hdor.dei_attribute1 || '|' || agn.bank_branch_name || '|' || hdor.dei_attribute3 BANK_DETAILS ,
                                                                                          hdor.dei_attribute4 NUMERO_CONTA_BANCARIA ,
                                                                                          tipo.description TIPO_CONTA ,
                                                                                          hdor.dei_attribute5 DIGITO
FROM hr_documents_of_record hdor , per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam ,

  (SELECT cib.bank_number , cib.BANK_PARTY_ID , cib.bank_name
   FROM ce_index_banks cib
   WHERE cib.bank_institution_type IN ('BANK', 'CLEARINGHOUSE')
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN cib.start_date AND cib.end_date) bnk ,

  (SELECT cbb.bank_number , cbb.BANK_PARTY_ID , cbb.branch_number , cbb.bank_branch_name
   FROM ce_bank_branches_v cbb
   WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN cbb.start_date AND cbb.end_date
     AND cbb.start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(start_date)
        FROM ce_bank_branches_v
        WHERE bank_number = cbb.bank_number
          AND branch_number = cbb.branch_number)) agn ,

  (SELECT ffv.flex_value , ffvt.description
   FROM fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs , fnd_flex_values ffv , fnd_flex_values_tl ffvt
   WHERE ffvs.flex_value_set_id = ffv.flex_value_set_id
     AND ffv.flex_value_id = ffvt.flex_value_id
     AND ffvt.language = USERENV('LANG')
     AND flex_value_set_name = 'ANM_Tipo de Conta de Pagamento'
     AND ffv.enabled_flag = 'Y') tipo
WHERE 1=1
  AND hdor.dei_attribute_category = 'BR_COMPROVANTE_DA_AGÊNCIA_E_DE_CONTA_BANCÁRIA'
  AND hdor.dei_attribute1 IS NOT NULL
  AND hdor.dei_attribute3 IS NOT NULL
  AND hdor.dei_attribute4 IS NOT NULL
  AND papf.person_id = hdor.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_id = hdor.assignment_id
  AND paam.person_id = hdor.person_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id)
  AND bnk.BANK_PARTY_ID = agn.BANK_PARTY_ID
  AND agn.branch_number = hdor.dei_attribute3
  AND agn.bank_number = hdor.dei_attribute1
  AND tipo.flex_value(+) = hdor.dei_attribute2
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'x'
     FROM pay_bank_accounts pba , pay_person_pay_methods_f pppm , pay_pay_relationships_dn pprd ,
          pay_payroll_assignments ppa
     WHERE pba.bank_account_id = pppm.bank_account_id
       AND pprd.payroll_relationship_id = pppm.payroll_relationship_id
       AND pprd.person_id = hdor.person_id
       AND ppa.hr_assignment_id = hdor.assignment_id
       AND pba.bank_account_num = hdor.dei_attribute4)
  AND hdor.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 hdor.last_update_date)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #64

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PAY_PERSON_PAY_METHODS_F...`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number                                                        person_number
     , ppnf.full_name                                                            nome
     , TO_CHAR(ppos.actual_termination_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')               data_origem
     , org.organization_code                                                     organization_code
     , codpessoa.ext_identifier_number                                           codpessoa
     , paam.reason_code                                                          motivotransferencia
     , paam.assignment_number                                                    chapa
     , SUBSTR(hov.name, 1, INSTR(hov.name, ' - ') - 1)                           nomefilial
     , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ||'T00:00:00-03:00'                        data_hoje
     , paam.action_code                                                          acao
     , org_dest.organization_code                                                organization_code_dest
	 , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')             DATA_ACAO_PROCESS
     , TO_CHAR(ppos_dest.actual_termination_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')     data_destino
     , paam_dest.assignment_number                                               chapa_dest
     , CASE WHEN paam_dest.reason_code IS NULL THEN
                 'ANM_INTE_EMP'
            ELSE paam_dest.reason_code
       END                                                                       motivo_dest
     , SUBSTR(hov_dest.name, 1, INSTR(hov_dest.name, ' - ') - 1)                 nomefilial_dest
    , pjf.job_code                                                               job_code
    , paam_dest.ass_attribute_number2 * 60                                       escalatrabalho_dest
    , SUBSTR(paam_dest.ass_attribute5, 1,
      INSTR(paam_dest.ass_attribute5, ' - ') - 1)                                novohorario_dest
    , cmps.salary_amount                                                         salario
    , ppos_dest.pds_information8                                                 jornada_dest
    , ppos.pds_information8                                                      jornada_origem
    , ieb.bank_name                                                              nomebanco
    , ieb.bank_number                                                            numerobanco
    , ieb.bank_branch_name                                                       branch_banco
    , ieb.branch_number                                                          numeroagencia
    , iba.bank_account_num||iba.check_digits                                     numcontabancaria
    , ieb.check_digits                                                           digitoverificacao
    , ieb.bank_account_type                                                      tipocontabancaria
    , sind.internal_address_line                                                 novosindicato
    , paam_dest.action_code                                                      acao_destino
    , CASE WHEN ppttl.user_person_type IN ('CLT - Docente') THEN
           'true'
           ELSE
           'false'
      END                                                                        lancaeventossalcomposto
    , paam_dest.ass_attribute11                                                  multiplos_vinculos
    , CASE WHEN ppttl.USER_PERSON_TYPE IN ('CLT - Docente') THEN
           'false'
           ELSE
           'true'
      END                                                                        considerarateiofixo
    , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'DD/MM/YYYY')                                     data_admissao_consulta
    , NVL(paam_dest.ass_attribute15, 'N')                                        integra_base
    , pjfftl.job_family_name                                                     job_family_name
    , email.email_address                                                        email_pessoal
    , pplf.sex                                                                   sexo
    , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                     data_admissao
    , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')                             data_admissao_completa
    , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                           data_desligamento
    , pe.ethnicity                                                               corraca
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'DOCENTE' THEN
           'S'
           ELSE
           'N'
      END                                                                        indicadorprofessor
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'ESTAGIARIO' THEN
           'S'
           ELSE
           'N'
      END                                                                        indicadorestagiario
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'AUTONOMO' THEN
           'S'
           ELSE
           'N'
      END                                                                        indicadorautonomo
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'AUTONOMO' THEN
           paam.date_probation_end

    , REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''),'-','')           cpf

    , pplf.per_information1                                                      num_ctps

    , endereco.complemento                                                       endereco_complemento
    , endereco.número                                                            endereco_numero
    , endereco.tipo_logradouro                                                   endereco_tipo_logradouro
    , endereco.logradouro                                                        endereco_logradouro
    , endereco.ibge_code                                                         endereco_ibge_code
    , tel.mobile_area     || tel.mobile_number                                   celular
    , tel.home_phone_area || tel.home_phone_number                               telefoneresidencial
    , Nome_Mae.Nome_Mae                                                          nome_mae
    , Nome_Pai.Nome_pai                                                          nome_pai
    , pjf.name                                                                   nomecargo
    , pplf.highest_education_level                                               nivel_educacao
    , flv.meaning                                                                nivel_educacao_desc
    , pplf.marital_status                                                        estado_civil
    , flvc.meaning                                                               estado_civil_desc
    , SUBSTR(hov_dest.name, INSTR(hov_dest.name, '-') + 1)                       filial_dest
    , SUBSTR(hov.name, INSTR(hov.name, '-') + 1)                                 filial
    , secao.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE                                                secao
    , secao.name                                                                 secao_nome
    , CASE WHEN pdf.effective_start_date <= SYSDATE AND pdf.effective_end_date IS NULL THEN
           'S'
           WHEN pdf.effective_end_date > SYSDATE THEN
           'N'
           ELSE
           'N'
      END                                                                       desabilidade
    , mngr.nome_lider                                                           gestor
    , mngr.matricula_lider                                                      matricula_gestor
    , paam_dest.employee_category                                               tipo_pessoa
    ,paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE50                                                       reptransfglobal
  FROM per_all_assignments_m            paam
     , per_all_people_f                 papf
     , per_periods_of_service           ppos

     , hr_organization_v                org
     , hr_organization_v                hov
     , per_all_assignments_m            paam_dest
     , per_periods_of_service           ppos_dest
     , hr_organization_v                org_dest
     , hr_organization_v                hov_dest
     , per_person_types_tl              ppttl
     , per_jobs                         pjf

     , (SELECT pea.person_id,
               pea.email_type,

               pea.last_update_date
```
