### Query #75

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, FND_TERRITORIES_VL, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT

      papf.person_number                                                        PERSON_NUMBER
    , ppnf.full_name                                                            NOME
    , paam.assignment_number                                                    MATRICULA
    , org.organization_code                                                     ORGANIZATION_CODE
    , paam.reason_code                                                          MOTIVO
    , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy HH24:MI')                  DATA_ACAO
    , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')             DATA_ACAO_PROCESS
    , paam.action_code                                                          ACTION_CODE
    , codpessoa.ext_identifier_number                                           CODPESSOA
    , SUBSTR(hov.name, 1, INSTR(hov.name, ' - ') - 1)                           COD_FILIAL
    , SUBSTR(hov.name, INSTR(hov.name, '-') + 1)                                NOME_FILIAL
    , filialAntiga.COD_FILIAL_ANTERIOR                                          COD_FILIAL_ANTERIOR
    , filialAntiga.NOME_FILIAL_ANTERIOR                                         NOME_FILIAL_ANTERIOR

    , pjf.job_code                                                              JOB_CODE
    , paam.ass_attribute_number2 * 60                                           ESCALATRABALHO
    , SUBSTR(paam.ass_attribute5, 1,
      INSTR(paam.ass_attribute5, ' - ') - 1)                                    NOVOHORARIO
    , cs.salary_amount                                                          SALARIO
    , ppos.PDS_INFORMATION8                                                     JORNADA
    , ieb.bank_name                                                             NOMEBANCO
    , ieb.bank_number                                                           NUMEROBANCO
    , ieb.bank_branch_name                                                      BRANCH_BANCO
    , ieb.branch_number                                                         NUMEROAGENCIA
    , iba.bank_account_num||iba.check_digits                                    NUMCONTABANCARIA
    , ieb.check_digits                                                          DIGITOVERIFICACAO
    , ieb.bank_account_type                                                     TIPOCONTABANCARIA
    , sind.internal_address_line                                                SINDICATO
    , CASE WHEN ppttl.USER_PERSON_TYPE IN ('CLT - Docente') THEN 'true'
      ELSE 'false' END                                                          LancaEventosSalComposto
    , paam.ass_attribute11                                                      MULTIPLOS_VINCULOS
    , CASE WHEN ppttl.USER_PERSON_TYPE IN ('CLT - Docente') THEN 'false'
      ELSE 'true' END                                                           CONSIDERARATEIOFIXO

    , email.email_address                                                       EMAIL_PESSOAL
    , pplf.sex                                                                  SEXO
    , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                    DATA_ADMISSAO
    , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'dd/mm/yyyy HH24:MI')                            DATA_ADMISSAO_COMPLETA

    , pe.ETHNICITY                                                              CORRACA
    , REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''),'-','')          CPF
    , REPLACE(REPLACE(pis.national_identifier_number, '.', ''),'-','')          PIS
    , TO_CHAR(pis.issue_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                     DATA_CADASTRO_PIS
    , pplf.per_information1                                                     NUM_CTPS
    , pplf.per_information2                                                     SERIE_CTPS
    , ctps_uf.geography_name                                                    UF_CTPS
    , TO_CHAR(pp.date_of_birth, 'yyyy-mm-dd')                                   DATA_NASCIMENTO
    , pp.town_of_birth                                                          CIDADE_NASCIMENTO
    , per_ibge.ibge_code                                                        PERSON_IBGE_CODE
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name IN ('DOCENTE') THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END     INDICADORPROFESSOR
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name IN ('ESTAGIARIO') THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END  INDICADORESTAGIARIO
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name IN ('AUTONOMO') THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END    INDICADORAUTONOMO
    , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name IN ('AUTONOMO')
      THEN paam.DATE_PROBATION_END ELSE NULL END                                DATAEXPIRACAOTERCEIRO
    , flvn.meaning                                                              PAIS_NACIONALIDADE
    , ft.iso_territory_code                                                     PAIS_NACIONALIDADE_COD
    , pp.region_of_birth                                                        UF_NASCIMENTO
    , endereco.cep                                                              ENDERECO_CEP
    , endereco.estado                                                           ENDERECO_ESTADO
    , endereco.cidade                                                           ENDERECO_CIDADE
    , endereco.bairro                                                           ENDERECO_BAIRRO
    , endereco.complemento                                                      ENDERECO_COMPLEMENTO
    , endereco.número                                                           ENDERECO_NUMERO
    , endereco.tipo_logradouro                                                  ENDERECO_TIPO_LOGRADOURO
    , endereco.logradouro                                                       ENDERECO_LOGRADOURO
    , endereco.ibge_code                                                        ENDERECO_IBGE_CODE
    , tel.mobile_area     || tel.mobile_number                                   celular
    , tel.home_phone_area || tel.home_phone_number                               telefoneresidencial
    , pjftl.name                                                                NOMECARGO
    , pplf.highest_education_level                                              NIVEL_EDUCACAO
    , flv.meaning                                                               NIVEL_EDUCACAO_DESC
    , pplf.marital_status                                                       ESTADO_CIVIL
    , flvc.meaning                                                              ESTADO_CIVIL_DESC
    , secao.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE                                               SECAO
    , secao.name                                                                SECAO_NOME
    , CASE WHEN pdf.effective_start_date <= SYSDATE
      AND pdf.effective_end_date IS NULL THEN 'S'
      WHEN pdf.effective_end_date > SYSDATE THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END               DESABILIDADE
    , mngr.nome_lider                                                           GESTOR
    , mngr.matricula_lider                                                      MATRICULA_GESTOR
    , Nome_Mae.Nome_Mae                                                         NOME_MAE
    , Nome_Pai.Nome_pai                                                         NOME_PAI
    , NVL(paam.ass_attribute49,'N')                                             reptransflocal
FROM
      PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M                                                     paam
    , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F                                                        ppnf
    , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F                                                          papf
    , HR_ORGANIZATION_V                                                         org
    , HR_ORGANIZATION_V                                                         hov

    , PER_JOBS_F                                                                pjf
    , PER_JOBS_F_TL                                                             pjftl
    , PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE                                                    ppos
    , CMP_SALARY                                                                cs
    , pay_pay_relationships_dn                                                  ppr
    , pay_person_pay_methods_f                                                  ppp
    , iby_ext_bank_accounts_v                                                   ieb
    , iby_ext_bank_accounts                                                     iba
    , PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL                                                       ppttl
    , HR_ORGANIZATION_V                                                         sind

    , PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES                                                       email
    , PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F                                                  pplf
    , PER_ETHNICITIES                                                           pe
    , PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS                                                  cpf
    , PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS                                                  pis
    , hz_geographies                                                            ctps_uf
    , PER_PERSONS                                                               pp
    , PER_JOB_FAMILY_F                                                          pjff
    , PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL                                                       pjfftl
    , FND_LOOKUP_VALUES                                                         flvn
    , FND_TERRITORIES_VL                                                        ft
    , FND_LOOKUP_VALUES                                                         flv
    , FND_LOOKUP_VALUES                                                         flvc
    , HR_ORGANIZATION_V                                                         secao
    , PER_DISABILITIES_F                                                        pdf
    , (SELECT papf.person_id
           , TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    mobile_area
           , TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) mobile_number
           , CASE WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    ELSE NULL END AS home_phone_area
           , CASE WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS home_phone_number
           , CASE WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    ELSE NULL END AS work_phone_area
           , CASE WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS work_phone_number
           , GREATEST(NVL(telefone1.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(telefone2.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(telefone3.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
        FROM per_all_people_f papf
             LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone1 ON papf.person_id = telefone1.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id  = telefone1.phone_id
                                            AND telefone1.date_to = (SELECT MAX(date_to) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone1.person_id AND phone_id  = papf.primary_phone_id)

             LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone2 ON papf.person_id = telefone2.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id  <> telefone2.phone_id
                                            AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone2.date_from AND telefone2.date_to AND telefone2.phone_id = (SELECT MAX(phone_id) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone2.person_id AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id) )

             LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone3 ON papf.person_id = telefone3.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id AND telefone2.phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
                                            AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone3.date_from AND telefone3.date_to AND telefone2.phone_id = (SELECT MAX(phone_id) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone3.person_id AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id,telefone2.phone_id ) )

       WHERE papf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                             FROM per_all_people_f
                                            WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)) tel

    , (SELECT hg.country_code
            , hg.geography_element2 state
            , hg.geography_name city
            , hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
         FROM hz_geographies hg
            , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
        WHERE hg.geography_type      = 'CITY'
          AND hgi.geography_id       = hg.geography_id
          AND hgi.identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE')                             per_ibge
    , ( SELECT peai.person_id
                  , peai.assignment_id
                  , peai.ext_identifier_number
               FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
              WHERE peai.date_to IS NULL
                AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
                AND peai.ext_identifier_seq  = ( SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
                                                  FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
                                                    WHERE person_id            =  peai.person_id
                                                      AND NVL(assignment_id,0) =  NVL(peai.assignment_id,0)
                                                      AND ext_identifier_type  =  peai.ext_identifier_type)) codpessoa
    , (SELECT paam_old.person_id                                          PERSON_ID
      , SUBSTR(pl.internal_location_code, 1, INSTR(pl.internal_location_code, ' - ') - 1)     COD_FILIAL_ANTERIOR
      , SUBSTR(pl.internal_location_code, INSTR(pl.internal_location_code, '-') + 1)          NOME_FILIAL_ANTERIOR
        FROM    PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M                               paam_old
              , per_all_assignments_m                               paam
              , PER_LOCATIONS                                   pl
        WHERE paam.person_id = paam_old.person_id
        AND paam.action_code                               IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')
        AND paam.assignment_status_type                    = 'ACTIVE'
        AND paam.assignment_type                           = 'E'
        AND paam.effective_end_date = (SELECT MIN(effective_end_date)
                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                        WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
                                          AND effective_end_date > SYSDATE)
        AND paam_old.assignment_status_type                    = 'ACTIVE'
        AND paam_old.assignment_type                           =   'E'
        AND paam.effective_start_date                      = paam_old.effective_end_date + 1

        AND pl.location_id(+)                                  = paam_old.location_id)                                            filialAntiga
    , ( SELECT pauf.person_id
             , paf.addl_address_attribute3             tipo_logradouro
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_1,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') logradouro
             , paf.address_line_2                      número
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_3,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') complemento
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_4,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') bairro
             , paf.town_or_city                        cidade
             , paf.region_2                            estado
             , paf.postal_code                         cep
             , end_ibge.ibge_code
          FROM per_person_addr_usages_f  pauf
             , per_addresses_f           paf
             , (SELECT hg.country_code
                     , hg.geography_element2 state
                     , hg.geography_name city
                     , hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
                  FROM hz_geographies           hg
                     , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
                 WHERE hg.geography_type          = 'CITY'
                   AND hgi.geography_id           = hg.geography_id
                   AND hgi.identifier_subtype     = 'IBGE_CODE') end_ibge
         WHERE pauf.address_type         = 'HOME'
           AND pauf.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM per_person_addr_usages_f
                                             WHERE person_addr_usage_id = pauf.person_addr_usage_id
                                               AND person_id            = pauf.person_id)

           AND paf.address_id            = pauf.address_id

           AND end_ibge.country_code(+)      = paf.country
           AND end_ibge.state(+)             = paf.region_2
           AND end_ibge.city(+)              = paf.town_or_city ) endereco

     , (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider
             , ppnf2.display_name     nome_lider
             , pasf.assignment_id
             , pasf.person_id
             , pasf.effective_start_date
             , pasf.effective_end_date
          FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
             , per_all_assignments_m        pman
             , per_person_names_f           ppnf2
         WHERE pasf.manager_type           = 'LINE_MANAGER'
           AND pman.assignment_id          = pasf.manager_assignment_id
           AND pman.person_id              = pasf.manager_id
           AND pman.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
           AND pman.assignment_type        = 'E'
           AND pasf.effective_start_date   BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
           AND ppnf2.person_id             = pman.person_id
           AND ppnf2.name_type             = 'GLOBAL'
           AND ppnf2.effective_start_date  = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                 FROM per_person_names_f
                                                WHERE person_id = ppnf2.person_id
                                                  AND name_type = ppnf2.name_type)) mngr
      , (SELECT pcrf.person_id mae_person_id
              , ppnf.display_name Nome_Mae
          FROM  per_contact_relships_f pcrf
              , per_person_names_f ppnf
          WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
          AND ppnf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                FROM per_person_names_f
                                                WHERE ppnf.person_id = person_id
                                                AND ppnf.name_type = name_type)

          AND pcrf.contact_person_id = ppnf.person_id
          AND pcrf.contact_type = 'IN_MR')                                                                    Nome_Mae
        , (SELECT   pcrf.person_id pai_person_id
                  , ppnf.display_name Nome_Pai
              FROM  per_contact_relships_f pcrf
                  , per_person_names_f ppnf
              WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
              AND ppnf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                  FROM per_person_names_f
                                                  WHERE ppnf.person_id = person_id
                                                  AND ppnf.name_type = name_type)

              AND pcrf.contact_person_id = ppnf.person_id
              AND pcrf.contact_type = 'IN_FR')                                                                    Nome_Pai
WHERE   paam.person_id                                  = papf.person_id
    AND papf.effective_start_date                       = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                            FROM per_all_people_f
                                                            WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)

    AND ppnf.person_id                                  = papf.person_id
    AND ppnf.name_type                                  = 'GLOBAL'
    AND ppnf.effective_start_date                       = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                            FROM per_person_names_f
                                                            WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)

    AND paam.action_code                                IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')
    AND paam.assignment_status_type                     = 'ACTIVE'
    AND paam.assignment_type                            = 'E'
    AND paam.effective_end_date                      = (SELECT MIN(effective_end_date)
                                                      FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                      WHERE assignment_id           = paam.assignment_id
                                                        AND person_id               = paam.person_id
                                                        AND effective_end_date >= SYSDATE)

    AND org.classification_code                         = 'HCM_LEMP'
    AND org.status                                      = 'A'
    AND org.legislation_code                            = 'BR'
    AND SYSDATE BETWEEN org.effective_start_date AND org.effective_end_date
    AND org.organization_id(+)                          = paam.legal_entity_id

    AND codpessoa.person_id(+)                          = paam.person_id

    AND hov.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)                          = paam.establishment_id
    AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE                         = 'HCM_LRU'
    AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
    AND hov.status                                      = 'A'

    AND pjf.job_id(+)                                   = paam.job_id
    AND pjf.effective_start_date                        = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                            FROM PER_JOBS_F
                                                            WHERE job_id = pjf.job_id)
    AND pjftl.job_id(+)                                 = pjf.job_id
    AND pjftl.language                                  = 'PTB'
    AND pjftl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE                      = (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) FROM PER_JOBS_F_TL WHERE job_id = pjftl.job_id)

    AND cs.assignment_id(+)                             = paam.assignment_id
    AND cs.date_from                                    = (SELECT MAX(date_from)
                                                            FROM CMP_SALARY
                                                            WHERE cs.assignment_id  = assignment_id)

    AND ppos.person_id(+)                               = paam.person_id
    AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL

    AND ppr.person_id(+)                                = papf.person_id
    AND ppr.creation_date                               = (SELECT MAX(creation_date)
                                                            FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn
                                                            WHERE person_id(+) = ppr.person_id)
    AND ppr.START_DATE                                  = (SELECT MAX(START_DATE)
                                                            FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn
                                                            WHERE person_id(+) = ppr.person_id)

    AND ppr.payroll_relationship_id(+)                  = ppp.payroll_relationship_id
    AND ppp.effective_end_date                          = (SELECT MAX(a.effective_end_date)
                                                            FROM pay_person_pay_methods_f a
                                                            WHERE a.payroll_relationship_id = ppp.payroll_relationship_id)

    AND ieb.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ppp.bank_account_id(+)                          = ieb.bank_account_id

    AND ieb.ext_bank_account_id(+)                      = iba.ext_bank_account_id

    AND sind.organization_id(+)                         = paam.union_id
    AND sind.classification_code(+)                     = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
    AND sind.status(+)                                  = 'A'
    AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)

    AND ppttl.PERSON_TYPE_ID(+)                         = paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID
    AND ppttl.LANGUAGE                                  ='PTB'

    AND filialAntiga.person_id(+)                       = paam.person_id

    AND email.person_id(+)                              = papf.person_id
    AND email.email_type                                = 'H1'

    AND pplf.person_id(+)                               = papf.person_id
    AND pplf.effective_start_date                       = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                          FROM PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F
                                                          WHERE person_id  = pplf.person_id)

    AND pe.person_id(+)                                 = papf.person_id

    AND cpf.national_identifier_type(+)                 = 'CPF'
    AND cpf.person_id(+)                                = pplf.person_id
    AND cpf.legislation_code(+)                         = pplf.legislation_code

    AND pis.national_identifier_type(+)                 = 'PIS'
    AND pis.person_id(+)                                = pplf.person_id
    AND pis.legislation_code(+)                         = pplf.legislation_code

    AND ctps_uf.geography_id (+)                        = pplf.per_information_number1

    AND pp.person_id                                    = papf.person_id

    AND per_ibge.country_code(+)                        = pp.country_of_birth
    AND per_ibge.state(+)                               = pp.region_of_birth
    AND per_ibge.city(+)                                = pp.town_of_birth

    AND pjff.job_family_id(+)                           = pjf.job_family_id
    AND pjff.effective_start_date                       = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                          FROM PER_JOB_FAMILY_F
                                                          WHERE job_family_id = pjff.job_family_id)

    AND pjfftl.job_family_id(+)                         = pjff.job_family_id
    AND pjfftl.language                                 = 'PTB'
    AND pjfftl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE                     = (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
                                                          FROM PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL
                                                          WHERE job_family_id = pjfftl.job_family_id)

    AND flvn.lookup_code(+)                             = pp.country_of_birth
    AND flvn.lookup_type(+)                             = 'NATIONALITY'
    AND flvn.language                                   = 'PTB'

    AND ft.territory_code(+)                            = paam.legislation_code
    AND ft.LAST_UPDATE_DATE                             = (SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                                                            FROM FND_TERRITORIES_VL
                                                            WHERE territory_code = ft.territory_code)

    AND papf.person_id(+)                               = endereco.person_id

    AND tel.person_id(+)                                = papf.person_id

    AND flv.lookup_code(+)                              = pplf.highest_education_level
    AND flv.lookup_type                                 = 'PER_HIGHEST_EDUCATION_LEVEL'
    AND flv.language                                    = 'PTB'

    AND flvc.lookup_code(+)                             = pplf.marital_status
    AND flvc.lookup_type                                = 'MAR_STATUS'
    AND flvc.language                                   = 'PTB'

    AND secao.ORGANIZATION_ID                           =  paam.organization_id
    AND secao.CLASSIFICATION_CODE                       =  'DEPARTMENT'
    AND SYSDATE BETWEEN secao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND secao.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
    AND secao.status                                    = 'A'

    AND mngr.assignment_id(+)                           = paam.assignment_id
    AND mngr.person_id(+)                               = paam.person_id
    AND paam.effective_start_date                       BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)

    AND pdf.person_id(+)                                = papf.person_id

    AND Nome_Mae.mae_person_id(+)                       = papf.person_id

    AND Nome_Pai.pai_person_id(+)                       = papf.person_id

    AND papf.person_number                              = NVL(:p_person_number , papf.person_number)
    AND paam.assignment_number                          = NVL(:p_assignment_number, paam.assignment_number)
    AND paam.last_update_date                          >= NVL(:p_integration_date , paam.last_update_date)
```

### Query #76

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, HZ_GEOGRAPHIES`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_id , papf.person_number ,
       TRANSLATE(ppnf.first_name ,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') first_name ,
       TRANSLATE(ppnf.last_name ,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') last_name ,
       TRANSLATE(CASE
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ''
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.middle_names || ' ' || ppnf.last_name
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ppnf.first_name
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.middle_names
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.last_name
                 END,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') full_name ,
       TRANSLATE(CASE
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ''
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.middle_names || ' ' || ppnf.last_name
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ppnf.first_name
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.middle_names
                     WHEN ppnf.first_name IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.middle_names IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.last_name IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.first_name || ' ' || ppnf.last_name
                 END,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') display_name ,
       TRANSLATE(CASE
                     WHEN ppnf.known_as IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information16 IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information17 IS NULL THEN ''
                     WHEN ppnf.known_as IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information16 IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information17 IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.known_as || ' ' || ppnf.nam_information16 || ' ' || ppnf.nam_information17
                     WHEN ppnf.known_as IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information16 IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information17 IS NULL THEN ppnf.known_as
                     WHEN ppnf.known_as IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information16 IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information17 IS NULL THEN ppnf.known_as || ' ' || ppnf.nam_information16
                     WHEN ppnf.known_as IS NOT NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information16 IS NULL
                          AND ppnf.nam_information17 IS NOT NULL THEN ppnf.known_as || ' ' || ppnf.nam_information17
                 END,
         'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
         'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') known_as , pp.date_of_birth ,
       TRUNC((months_between(sysdate, pp.date_of_birth))/12) idade ,
       CASE
           WHEN TRUNC((months_between(sysdate,
                         pp.date_of_birth))/12) >= 65 THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END tem_mais_65_anos , pp.country_of_birth , pp.region_of_birth , pp.town_of_birth , ibge.ibge_code ,
       DECODE(pp.region_of_birth, 'EX', pp.town_of_birth, SUBSTR(ibge.ibge_code,
                                                            3)) cidade_nascimento , pplf.marital_status , pplf.highest_education_level , pplf.sex , pe.ethnicity ,
       pp.blood_type , tel.home_phone_area , tel.home_phone_number , tel.work_phone_area ,
       tel.work_phone_number , tel.mobile_area , tel.mobile_number , email.email_address work_email ,
       email_alt.email_address home_email , pai.nome_pai , mae.nome_mae ,
       GREATEST(papf.last_update_date,
         ppnf.last_update_date, pp.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date,
         NVL(pe.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(tel.last_update_date,
                                                            papf.last_update_date),
         NVL(email.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(email_alt.last_update_date,

                                                               papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_person_names_f ppnf , per_persons pp ,
     per_people_legislative_f pplf , per_ethnicities pe ,

  (SELECT papf.person_id ,
          TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.area_code, '0'), 1, 2), 2, '0')) mobile_area ,
          TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.phone_number, '0'), 1, 9), 9, '0')) mobile_number ,
          CASE
              WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.area_code,
                                                                              '0'),
                                                                       1, 2),
                                                                  2, '0')) ELSE NULL
          END AS home_phone_area ,
          CASE
              WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.phone_number,
                                                                              '0'),
                                                                       1, 9),
                                                                  9, '0')) ELSE NULL
          END AS home_phone_number ,
          CASE
              WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.area_code,
                                                                              '0'),
                                                                       1, 2),
                                                                  2, '0')) ELSE NULL
          END AS work_phone_area ,
          CASE
              WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.phone_number,
                                                                              '0'),
                                                                       1, 9),
                                                                  9, '0')) ELSE NULL
          END AS work_phone_number ,
          GREATEST(NVL(telefone1.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date),
            NVL(telefone2.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date),
            NVL(telefone3.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
   FROM per_all_people_f papf
   LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone1 ON papf.person_id = telefone1.person_id
   AND papf.primary_phone_id = telefone1.phone_id
   AND NVL(telefone1.date_to, SYSDATE) =
     (SELECT MAX(NVL(date_to, SYSDATE))
      FROM per_phones
      WHERE person_id = telefone1.person_id
        AND phone_id = papf.primary_phone_id)
   LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone2 ON papf.person_id = telefone2.person_id
   AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone2.phone_id
   AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone2.date_from AND NVL(telefone2.date_to,
                                                 SYSDATE+1)
   AND telefone2.phone_id =
     (SELECT MAX(phone_id)
      FROM per_phones
      WHERE person_id = telefone2.person_id
        AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id))
   LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone3 ON papf.person_id = telefone3.person_id
   AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
   AND telefone2.phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
   AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone3.date_from AND NVL(telefone3.date_to,
                                                 SYSDATE+1)
   AND telefone2.phone_id =
     (SELECT MAX(phone_id)
      FROM per_phones
      WHERE person_id = telefone3.person_id
        AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id,telefone2.phone_id))
   WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)) tel ,

  (SELECT pea.person_id , pea.email_type , pea.email_address , pea.last_update_date
   FROM per_email_addresses pea
   WHERE pea.email_address_id =
       (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'W1')) email ,

  (SELECT pea.person_id, pea.email_type, pea.email_address, pea.last_update_date
   FROM per_email_addresses pea
   WHERE pea.email_address_id =
       (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'H1')) email_alt ,

  (SELECT hg.country_code , hg.geography_element2 state , hg.geography_name city ,
          hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
   FROM hz_geographies hg , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
   WHERE hg.geography_type = 'CITY'
     AND hgi.geography_id = hg.geography_id
     AND hgi.identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE') ibge ,

  (SELECT pcrfa.person_id , ppnfd.full_name nome_pai
   FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrfa , per_person_names_f ppnfd
   WHERE pcrfa.contact_type = 'IN_FR'
     AND pcrfa.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_contact_relships_f
        WHERE CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID = pcrfa.CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID)
     AND ppnfd.person_id = pcrfa.contact_person_id
     AND ppnfd.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnfd.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnfd.person_id)) pai ,

  (SELECT pcrfa.person_id , ppnfd.full_name nome_mae
   FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrfa , per_person_names_f ppnfd
   WHERE pcrfa.contact_type = 'IN_MR'
     AND pcrfa.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_contact_relships_f
        WHERE CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID = pcrfa.CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID)
     AND ppnfd.person_id = pcrfa.contact_person_id
     AND ppnfd.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnfd.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnfd.person_id)) mae
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND pp.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pp.start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(start_date)
     FROM per_persons
     WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND pe.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND pe.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND pe.primary_flag(+) = 'Y'
  AND tel.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND email.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND email_alt.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ibge.country_code(+) = pp.country_of_birth
  AND ibge.state(+) = pp.region_of_birth
  AND ibge.city(+) = pp.town_of_birth
  AND pai.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND mae.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(papf.last_update_date,
        ppnf.last_update_date, pp.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date,
        NVL(pe.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(tel.last_update_date,
                                                           papf.last_update_date),
        NVL(email.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(email_alt.last_update_date,
                                                              papf.last_update_date)) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                           GREATEST(papf.last_update_date,

                                                                                             ppnf.last_update_date,
                                                                                             pp.last_update_date,
                                                                                             pplf.last_update_date,
                                                                                             NVL(pe.last_update_date,

                                                                                               papf.last_update_date),
                                                                                             NVL(tel.last_update_date,

                                                                                               papf.last_update_date),
                                                                                             NVL(email.last_update_date,

                                                                                               papf.last_update_date),
                                                                                             NVL(email_alt.last_update_date,

                                                                                               papf.last_update_date)))
```

### Query #77

**Tags:** `FIN - Receivables & Cash, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES...`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number                                                        person_number
     , paam.assignment_number
     , ppnf.full_name                                                            nome
     , CASE WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute3 , ppos.attribute18) = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END                    temavisoprevio

     , codpessoa.ext_identifier_number                                           codpessoa

     , CASE WHEN ppos.attribute8 = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END                     temprazocontr
     , NVL(paam.ass_attribute9, ppos.attribute12)                                motivodemissao
     , CASE WHEN ppos.attribute12 IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date2, 'DD/MM/YYY HH24:MI')
            ELSE NULL END                                                        fimprazocontr
     , TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date6, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')                       data_pagamento_rescisao

     , CASE WHEN ppos.attribute19 = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END                    dispensado_aviso
     , CASE WHEN paam.reason_code = 'ANM_SJC_2' THEN
            TO_CHAR(ppos.actual_termination_date + 1, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
            ELSE '0' END                                                         apmisto_dtavtrab

     , email.email_address                                                       email_pessoal

     , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                    data_admissao
     , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')                            data_admissao_completa

     , pe.ethnicity                                                              corraca
     , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'DOCENTE'    THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END     indicadorprofessor
     , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'ESTAGIARIO' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END     indicadorestagiario
     , CASE WHEN pjfftl.job_family_name = 'AUTONOMO'   THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END     indicadorautonomo
     , paam.date_probation_end                                                   dataexpiracaoterceiro
     , pjf.job_code                                                              job_code
     , paam.ass_attribute11                                                      multiplos_vinculos
     , REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''),'-','')          cpf
     , REPLACE(REPLACE(pis.national_identifier_number, '.', ''),'-','')          pis
     , TO_CHAR(pis.issue_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                     data_cadastro_pis
     , pplf.per_information1                                                     num_ctps
     , pplf.per_information2                                                     serie_ctps
     , ctps_uf.geography_name                                                    uf_ctps
     , TO_CHAR(pp.date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                   data_nascimento
     , pp.town_of_birth                                                          cidade_nascimento
     , per_ibge.ibge_code                                                        person_ibge_code
     , flvn.meaning                                                              pais_nacionalidade
     , ft.iso_territory_code                                                     pais_nacionalidade_cod
     , pp.region_of_birth                                                        uf_nascimento
     , endereco.cep                                                              endereco_cep
     , endereco.estado                                                           endereco_estado
     , endereco.cidade                                                           endereco_cidade
     , endereco.bairro                                                           endereco_bairro
     , endereco.complemento                                                      endereco_complemento
     , endereco.número                                                           endereco_numero
     , endereco.tipo_logradouro                                                  endereco_tipo_logradouro
     , endereco.logradouro                                                       endereco_logradouro
     , endereco.ibge_code                                                        endereco_ibge_code
     , tel.mobile_area     || tel.mobile_number                                  celular
     , tel.home_phone_area || tel.home_phone_number                              telefoneresidencial
     , Nome_Mae.Nome_Mae                                                         nome_mae
     , Nome_Pai.Nome_pai                                                         nome_pai
     , pplf.highest_education_level                                              nivel_educacao
     , flv.meaning                                                               nivel_educacao_desc
     , pplf.marital_status                                                       estado_civil
     , flvc.meaning                                                              estado_civil_desc
     , pjf.name                                                                  nomecargo
     , SUBSTR(hov.name, 1, INSTR(hov.name, ' - ') - 1)                           filial
     , SUBSTR(hov.name, INSTR(hov.name, '-') + 1)                                nome_filial
     , secao.internal_address_line                                               secao
     , secao.name                                                                secao_nome
     , mngr.nome_lider                                                           gestor
     , mngr.matricula_lider                                                      matricula_gestor
     , CASE WHEN pdf.effective_start_date <= SYSDATE AND pdf.effective_end_date IS NULL THEN
            'S'
            WHEN pdf.effective_end_date > SYSDATE THEN
            'N'
            ELSE 'N' END                                                        desabilidade
FROM  per_all_assignments_m                                                     paam
    , per_person_names_f                                                        ppnf
    , per_all_people_f                                                          papf
    , per_periods_of_service                                                    ppos
    , hr_organization_v                                                         org
    , hr_organization_v                                                         hov
    , hr_organization_v                                                         secao
    , ( SELECT peai.person_id
             , peai.assignment_id
             , peai.ext_identifier_number
          FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
         WHERE peai.date_to             IS NULL
           AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
           AND peai.ext_identifier_seq  = ( SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
                                              FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
                                             WHERE person_id            =  peai.person_id
                                               AND NVL(assignment_id,0) =  NVL(peai.assignment_id,0)
                                               AND ext_identifier_type  =  peai.ext_identifier_type)) codpessoa
    , ( SELECT paeim.assignment_id assignment_id
             , TO_CHAR(paeim.aei_information_date1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') data_aposentadoria
          FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_EXTRA_INFO_M paeim
         WHERE paeim.INFORMATION_TYPE = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
           AND paeim.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                               FROM per_assignment_extra_info_m
                                              WHERE assignment_extra_info_id = paeim.assignment_extra_info_id)) data_aposentadoria

    , (SELECT pea.person_id
            , pea.email_type
            , pea.email_address
            , pea.last_update_date
         FROM per_email_addresses pea
        WHERE pea.email_address_id = (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
                                        FROM per_email_addresses
                                       WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
                                         AND email_type = 'H1'))                email

    , per_people_legislative_f                                                  pplf
    , per_ethnicities                                                           pe
    , per_national_identifiers                                                  cpf
    , per_national_identifiers                                                  pis
    , hz_geographies                                                            ctps_uf
    , per_jobs                                                                  pjf
    , (SELECT pjft.job_family_id
            , pjft.job_family_name
         FROM per_job_family_f_tl pjft
        WHERE pjft.language             = 'PTB'
          AND pjft.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                             FROM per_job_family_f_tl
                                             WHERE job_family_id = pjft.job_family_id)) pjfftl

    , per_persons                                                               pp
    , fnd_lookup_values_vl                                                         flvn
    , fnd_territories_vl                                                        ft
    , (SELECT papf.person_id
            , TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    mobile_area
            , TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) mobile_number
            , CASE WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    ELSE NULL END AS home_phone_area
            , CASE WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS home_phone_number
            , CASE WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.area_code,'0'),1,2),2,'0'))    ELSE NULL END AS work_phone_area
            , CASE WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.phone_number,'0'),1,9),9,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS work_phone_number
            , GREATEST(NVL(telefone1.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date), NVL(telefone2.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(telefone3.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
         FROM per_all_people_f papf
              LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone1 ON papf.person_id = telefone1.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id  = telefone1.phone_id
                                             AND telefone1.date_to = (SELECT MAX(date_to) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone1.person_id AND phone_id  = papf.primary_phone_id)
               LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone2 ON papf.person_id = telefone2.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id  <> telefone2.phone_id
                                             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone2.date_from AND telefone2.date_to AND telefone2.phone_id = (SELECT MAX(phone_id) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone2.person_id AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id) )

              LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone3 ON papf.person_id = telefone3.person_id AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id AND telefone2.phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
                                             AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone3.date_from AND telefone3.date_to AND telefone2.phone_id = (SELECT MAX(phone_id) FROM per_phones WHERE person_id = telefone3.person_id AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id,telefone2.phone_id ) )

        WHERE papf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM per_all_people_f
                                             WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)) tel

    , fnd_lookup_values_vl                                                      flvc
    , fnd_lookup_values_vl                                                      flv
    , per_disabilities_f                                                        pdf
    , (SELECT hg.country_code
            , hg.geography_element2 state
            , hg.geography_name city
            , hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
         FROM hz_geographies hg
            , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
        WHERE hg.geography_type      = 'CITY'
          AND hgi.geography_id       = hg.geography_id
          AND hgi.identifier_subtype = 'IBGE_CODE')                             per_ibge
     , (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider
             , ppnf2.display_name     nome_lider
             , pasf.assignment_id
             , pasf.person_id
             , pasf.effective_start_date
             , pasf.effective_end_date
          FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
             , per_all_assignments_m        pman
             , per_person_names_f           ppnf2
         WHERE pasf.manager_type           = 'LINE_MANAGER'
           AND pman.assignment_id          = pasf.manager_assignment_id
           AND pman.person_id              = pasf.manager_id
           AND pman.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
           AND pman.assignment_type        = 'E'
           AND pasf.effective_start_date   BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
           AND ppnf2.person_id             = pman.person_id
           AND ppnf2.name_type             = 'GLOBAL'
           AND ppnf2.effective_start_date  = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                 FROM per_person_names_f
                                                WHERE person_id = ppnf2.person_id
                                                  AND name_type = ppnf2.name_type)) mngr
    , ( SELECT pauf.person_id
             , paf.addl_address_attribute3             tipo_logradouro
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_1,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') logradouro
             , paf.address_line_2                      número
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_3,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') complemento
             , TRANSLATE(paf.address_line_4,'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ','SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy') bairro
             , paf.town_or_city                        cidade
             , paf.region_2                            estado
             , paf.postal_code                         cep
             , end_ibge.ibge_code
          FROM per_person_addr_usages_f  pauf
             , per_addresses_f           paf
             , (SELECT hg.country_code
                     , hg.geography_element2 state
                     , hg.geography_name city
                     , hgi.identifier_value ibge_code
                  FROM hz_geographies           hg
                     , hz_geography_identifiers hgi
                 WHERE hg.geography_type          = 'CITY'
                   AND hgi.geography_id           = hg.geography_id
                   AND hgi.identifier_subtype     = 'IBGE_CODE') end_ibge
         WHERE pauf.address_type         = 'HOME'
           AND pauf.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM per_person_addr_usages_f
                                             WHERE person_addr_usage_id = pauf.person_addr_usage_id
                                               AND person_id            = pauf.person_id)

           AND paf.address_id            = pauf.address_id

           AND end_ibge.country_code(+)      = paf.country
           AND end_ibge.state(+)             = paf.region_2
           AND end_ibge.city(+)              = paf.town_or_city ) endereco
      , (SELECT pcrf.person_id mae_person_id
              , ppnf.display_name Nome_Mae
          FROM  per_contact_relships_f pcrf
              , per_person_names_f ppnf
          WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
          AND ppnf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                FROM per_person_names_f
                                                WHERE ppnf.person_id = person_id
                                                AND ppnf.name_type = name_type)

          AND pcrf.contact_person_id = ppnf.person_id
          AND pcrf.contact_type = 'IN_MR')                                                                    Nome_Mae
        , (SELECT   pcrf.person_id pai_person_id
                  , ppnf.display_name Nome_Pai
              FROM  per_contact_relships_f pcrf
                  , per_person_names_f ppnf
              WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
              AND ppnf.effective_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                  FROM per_person_names_f
                                                  WHERE ppnf.person_id = person_id
                                                  AND ppnf.name_type = name_type)

              AND pcrf.contact_person_id = ppnf.person_id
              AND pcrf.contact_type = 'IN_FR')                                                                    Nome_Pai
WHERE paam.person_id                                 = papf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date                      = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                          FROM per_all_people_f
                                                          WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)

  AND ppnf.person_id                                 = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type                                 = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date                      = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                              FROM per_person_names_f
                                                              WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)

  AND paam.action_code                               IN ('DEATH', 'TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number,1,1)             <> 'E'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type                    = 'INACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type                           =   'E'
  AND paam.effective_start_date                      = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                          FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                         WHERE person_id               =  paam.person_id
                                                           AND assignment_status_type  =  paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.last_updated_by                           <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'

  AND org.classification_code(+)                     = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND org.status(+)                                  = 'A'
  AND org.legislation_code(+)                        = 'BR'
  AND SYSDATE                                        BETWEEN org.effective_start_date(+) AND org.effective_end_date(+)
  AND org.organization_id(+)                         = paam.legal_entity_id

  AND ppos.person_id                                 = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id                      = paam.period_of_service_id

  AND codpessoa.person_id(+)                         = paam.person_id

  AND data_aposentadoria.assignment_id(+)            = paam.assignment_id

  AND email.person_id(+)                             = papf.person_id

  AND pplf.person_id                                 = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.effective_start_date                      = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                          FROM per_people_legislative_f
                                                         WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)

  AND pe.person_id(+)                                = pplf.person_id
  AND pe.legislation_code(+)                         = pplf.legislation_code
  AND pe.primary_flag(+)                             = 'Y'

  AND cpf.national_identifier_type(+)                = 'CPF'
  AND cpf.person_id(+)                               = pplf.person_id
  AND cpf.legislation_code(+)                        = pplf.legislation_code

  AND pis.national_identifier_type(+)                = 'PIS'
  AND pis.person_id(+)                               = pplf.person_id
  AND pis.legislation_code(+)                        = pplf.legislation_code

  AND ctps_uf.geography_id(+)                        = pplf.per_information_number1

  AND pjf.job_id(+)                                 = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date                     BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)

  AND pjfftl.job_family_id(+)                       = pjf.job_family_id

  AND pp.person_id                                  = papf.person_id
  AND pp.start_date                                 = (SELECT MAX(start_date)
                                                         FROM per_persons
                                                        WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)

  AND per_ibge.country_code(+)                      = pp.country_of_birth
  AND per_ibge.state(+)                             = pp.region_of_birth
  AND per_ibge.city(+)                              = pp.town_of_birth

  AND flvn.lookup_code(+)                           = pp.country_of_birth
  AND flvn.lookup_type(+)                           = 'NATIONALITY'

  AND ft.territory_code(+)                          = ppnf.legislation_code

  AND endereco.person_id(+)                        = papf.person_id

  AND tel.person_id(+)                             = papf.person_id

  AND Nome_Mae.mae_person_id(+)                    = papf.person_id

  AND Nome_Pai.pai_person_id(+)                    = papf.person_id

  AND flvc.lookup_code(+)                          = pplf.marital_status
  AND flvc.lookup_type(+)                          = 'MAR_STATUS'

  AND flv.lookup_code(+)                           = pplf.highest_education_level
  AND flv.lookup_type(+)                           = 'PER_HIGHEST_EDUCATION_LEVEL'

  AND hov.organization_id(+)                       = paam.establishment_id
  AND hov.classification_code(+)                   = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND hov.status(+)                                = 'A'
  AND SYSDATE                                      BETWEEN hov.effective_start_date(+) AND hov.effective_end_date(+)

  AND secao.organization_id(+)                      = paam.organization_id
  AND secao.classification_code(+)                  = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND secao.status(+)                               = 'A'
  AND SYSDATE                                       BETWEEN secao.effective_start_date(+) AND secao.effective_end_date(+)

  AND mngr.assignment_id(+)                         = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+)                             = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date                     BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)

  AND pdf.person_id(+)                              = papf.person_id

  AND papf.person_number                            = NVL(:p_person_number , papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number                        = NVL(:p_assignment_number, paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date                         >=  NVL(:p_integration_date , paam.last_update_date)
```

## FIN - General Ledger & SLA

### Query #1

## FIN - General Ledger & SLA

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, FIN - Projects`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, PJF_EXP_TYPES_TL, PJF_TASKS_V, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, GMS_ORGANIZATIONS_V`

```sql
SELECT pda.po_distribution_id, pda.po_header_id, pda.po_line_id, pda.line_location_id,
       pda.distribution_num, ROUND(NVL(pla.unit_price, 0) * NVL(pda.quantity_ordered,
                                                              0), 2) total,

  (SELECT DISTINCT gcc.segment1 ||'.'||gcc.segment2 ||'.'||gcc.segment3 ||'.'|| gcc.segment4 ||'.'||gcc.segment5 ||'.'||gcc.segment6 ||'.'|| gcc.segment7 ||'.'||gcc.segment8 ||'.'||gcc.segment9
   FROM gl_code_combinations gcc
   WHERE pda.code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id) po_charge_account, pda.code_combination_id po_charge_account_id,

  (SELECT DISTINCT ppa.segment1
   FROM pjf_projects_all_vl ppa
   WHERE ppa.project_id = pda.pjc_project_id) project_number,

  (SELECT DISTINCT ppa.name
   FROM pjf_projects_all_vl ppa
   WHERE ppa.project_id = pda.pjc_project_id) project_name,

  (SELECT DISTINCT pt.task_number
   FROM pjf_tasks_v pt
   WHERE pt.task_id = pda.pjc_task_id) task_number, pda.pjc_expenditure_item_date expenditure_item_date,

  (SELECT DISTINCT expenditure_type_name
   FROM pjf_exp_types_tl pt
   WHERE pt.language = 'PTB'
     AND pt.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID = pda.pjc_expenditure_type_id) expenditure_item_type,

  (SELECT gov.name
   FROM gms_organizations_v gov
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1
     AND gov.organization_id = pda.pjc_organization_id) expenditure_organization
FROM po_distributions_all pda, po_lines_all pla
WHERE pda.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
  AND pla.po_header_id = :p_po_header_id
ORDER BY pda.distribution_num
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B, XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID, ESIB.ATTRIBUTE4 ID_ITEM_KLASSMATT,
                ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER ITEM_CODE, ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE UOM, NULL DESC_SHORT_PTB,
                                                                            SUBSTR(ESIT_PTB.LONG_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                              1,
                                                                              2000) DESC_LONG_PTB,
                                                                            SUBSTR(ESIT_US.DESCRIPTION,
                                                                              1,
                                                                              100) DESC_SHORT_US,
                                                                            SUBSTR(ESIT_US.LONG_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                              1,
                                                                              2000) DESC_LONG_US,

  (SELECT VALUE_CONSTANT
   FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES
   WHERE MAPPING_SET_CODE = 'SEG_CONTA'
     AND INPUT_VALUE_CONSTANT1 = TO_CHAR(
                                           (SELECT EC.CATEGORY_ID
                                            FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC,
                                      EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
                                            WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                              AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                              AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
                                              AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
                                              AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = 'CATALOGO COMERCIAL'
                                              AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                              AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = NVL(:P_ID,

                                                                             ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID)))) CONTA,
                                                                            ETPI.TP_ITEM_NUMBER MFG_PART_NUM,
                                                                            SUBSTR(HP.PARTY_NAME,
                                                                              1,
                                                                              20) MANUFACTURER_NAME,
                                                                            ESIB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                                            sysdate
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B EIRB, EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS ETPI,
     HZ_PARTIES HP, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT_US, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT_PTB
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.MASTER_ORG_ID
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = EIRB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND EIRB.TP_ITEM_ID = ETPI.TP_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND ETPI.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HP.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID IN
    (SELECT EICB.ITEM_CLASS_ID
     FROM EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B EICB
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND EICB.ITEM_CLASS_CODE = 'ALTERA'
     UNION ALL SELECT EICB.ITEM_CLASS_ID
     FROM EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B EICB
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND EICB.PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_ID IN
         (SELECT EICB2.ITEM_CLASS_ID
          FROM EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B EICB2
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND EICB2.ITEM_CLASS_CODE = 'ALTERA'))
  AND ((ETPI.TP_TYPE = 'MANUFACTURER')
       OR (ETPI.TP_TYPE IS NULL))
  AND ((EIRB.ITEM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'MFG_PART_NUM')
       OR (EIRB.ITEM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE IS NULL))
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT_US.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT_US.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIT_US.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT_PTB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT_PTB.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIT_PTB.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND ESIB.ATTRIBUTE4 IS NOT NULL
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID != 300001216748433
  AND ((:P_ID IS NOT NULL
        AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = :P_ID)
       OR :P_ID IS NULL
       AND TRUNC(ESIB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) >= TRUNC(sysdate-1))
ORDER BY ESIB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_PERIODS, GL_JE_LINES`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_PERIODS, GL_JE_LINES`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'CTB01_NF' ORIGEM,
                           TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2023-03-01',
                                     'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                             'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_MOVIMENTO, AIA.INVOICE_NUM CONN_COD,
                           REPLACE(SUBSTR(XAH.DESCRIPTION,
                                     1, 240), ';', ',') CONN_DESC,
                           GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 SEGMENT
FROM GL_JE_LINES GJL, GL_JE_HEADERS GJH, AP_INVOICES_ALL AIA,
     XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS XDL, XLA_AE_HEADERS XAH, XLA_AE_LINES XAL,
     GL_JE_BATCHES GJB, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_LEDGERS GL
WHERE GJL.JE_HEADER_ID = GJH.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = 'Payables'
  AND XAH.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
  AND XAL.GL_SL_LINK_ID = GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID
  AND XDL.APPLICATION_ID = 200
  AND XDL.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
  AND XDL.AE_LINE_NUM = XAL.AE_LINE_NUM
  AND XDL.APPLIED_TO_SOURCE_ID_NUM_1 = AIA.INVOICE_ID
  AND TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
  AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
  AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
  AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
  AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY','SECONDARY')
  AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
  AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
    (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
     FROM GL_PERIODS GP
     WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
       AND to_date('01/03/2023', 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'DEP01_LIVRO_FISCAL' ORIGEM,
                                     TO_CHAR(:P_DATA_TRANSACAO,
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') DT_MOVIMENTO, FBC.BOOK_TYPE_CODE BOOK_TYPE_CODE,
                                     FBC.BOOK_TYPE_NAME BOOK_TYPE_NAME,

  (SELECT GL.CURRENCY_CODE
   FROM GL_LEDGERS GL
   WHERE GL.LEDGER_ID = FBC.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID) MOEDA, FDP.PERIOD_NAME,
                                     FBC.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID LEDGER_ID
FROM FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY FDH, FA_DEPRN_SUMMARY FDS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC,
     FA_BOOK_CONTROLS FBC, FA_DEPRN_PERIODS FDP
WHERE FDH.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
  AND FDH.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND FDS.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
  AND FDS.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
  AND FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FBC.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
  AND FDP.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FBC.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
  AND FDP.PERIOD_COUNTER = FDS.PERIOD_COUNTER
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_EMPRESA
  AND :P_DATA_TRANSACAO BETWEEN FDP.CALENDAR_PERIOD_OPEN_DATE AND FDP.CALENDAR_PERIOD_CLOSE_DATE
```
