### Query #5

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS_VL, GL_PERIODS, GL_LEDGERS, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL`

### Query #5

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, GL_PERIODS, FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS_VL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'CAD06_CONTA' ORIGEM,
                              TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO,
                                        'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                                'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_GERACAO, GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,
                              GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT4 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT5 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT6 CONTA_CONTABIL, FLEX_DESC.CONTA DESC_CONTA,
                              GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 SEGMENT1_DE_PARA_ORG, GCC.SEGMENT4 SEGMENT2_DE_PARA_CONTA,
                              SUBSTR(GCC.SEGMENT5, 5) SEGMENT3_CENTRO_CUSTO,
                              GCC.SEGMENT6 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT7 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT8 SEGMENT4_DE_PARA_ORG, GCC.SEGMENT9 SEGMENT5_FUTURO1, '00' SEGMENT6_FUTURO2
FROM GL_LEDGERS GL, GL_JE_BATCHES GJB,
     GL_JE_HEADERS GJH, GL_JE_LINES GJL,
     GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_JE_SOURCES_TL GJS,
     GL_JE_CATEGORIES_TL GJC, CST_ALL_COST_TRANSACTIONS_V CACTV, CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS CIT,
     FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS CCD, FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTION_LINES CDL,
     XLA_AE_LINES XAL, INV_MATERIAL_TXNS IMT,
     EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,

  (SELECT E.DESCRIPTION CONTA, D.FLEX_VALUE CODIGO
   FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL D, FND_FLEX_VALUES_TL E
   WHERE D.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID IN
       (SELECT FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
        FROM FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS_VL FNS
        WHERE FNS.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GL#'
          AND APPLICATION_COLUMN_NAME = 'SEGMENT4')
     AND D.FLEX_VALUE_ID = E.FLEX_VALUE_ID
     AND E.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND D.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND D.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
     AND D.END_DATE_ACTIVE IS NULL) FLEX_DESC
WHERE TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
  AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
  AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
  AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
  AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY')
  AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = GJS.JE_SOURCE_NAME
  AND GJS.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_CATEGORY = GJC.JE_CATEGORY_NAME
  AND GJC.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = 'Cost Accounting'
  AND CACTV.TRANSACTION_ID = CCD.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CCD.DISTRIBUTION_ID = CDL.DISTRIBUTION_ID
  AND CDL.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
  AND CDL.AE_LINE_NUM = XAL.AE_LINE_NUM
  AND GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID = XAL.GL_SL_LINK_ID
  AND CACTV.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID = CIT.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CIT.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND FLEX_DESC.CODIGO = GCC.SEGMENT4
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_CODE_COMBINATION
  AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
    (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
     FROM GL_PERIODS GP
     WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
       AND :P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
```

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, GL_PERIODS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'CAD09_LOTE' ORIGEM,
                             TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO,
                                       'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                               'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_GERACAO, GJB.JE_BATCH_ID LOTE_ID,
                             REPLACE(GJB.NAME,
                               ';', ',') LOTE_NOME, GJB.STATUS STATUS_LOTE,
                             GJH.LEDGER_ID LIVRO_CONTABIL_ID,
                             TO_CHAR(GJB.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                               'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_CONTABIL
FROM GL_LEDGERS GL, GL_JE_BATCHES GJB,
     GL_JE_HEADERS GJH, GL_JE_LINES GJL,
     GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_JE_SOURCES_TL GJS,
     GL_JE_CATEGORIES_TL GJC, CST_ALL_COST_TRANSACTIONS_V CACTV, CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS CIT,
     FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS CCD, FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTION_LINES CDL,
     XLA_AE_LINES XAL, INV_MATERIAL_TXNS IMT,
     EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
WHERE TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
  AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
  AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
  AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
  AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY')
  AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = GJS.JE_SOURCE_NAME
  AND GJS.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_CATEGORY = GJC.JE_CATEGORY_NAME
  AND GJC.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = 'Cost Accounting'
  AND CACTV.TRANSACTION_ID = CCD.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CCD.DISTRIBUTION_ID = CDL.DISTRIBUTION_ID
  AND CDL.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
  AND CDL.AE_LINE_NUM = XAL.AE_LINE_NUM
  AND GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID = XAL.GL_SL_LINK_ID
  AND CACTV.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID = CIT.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CIT.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_CODE_COMBINATION
  AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
    (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
     FROM GL_PERIODS GP
     WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
       AND :P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
```

### Query #7

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, CST_ITEM_COST_HISTORY_V, GL_PERIODS, PER_USERS`

```sql
SELECT IMT.TRANSACTION_ID||GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID TRANSACTION_ID, TO_CHAR(IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                                                               'DD/MM/YYYY') TRANSACTION_DATE,
       NVL(SUBSTR(GCC.SEGMENT5, 5), GCC.SEGMENT5) COD_UA, IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID,
       (-1 * IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY) QUANTIDADE,

  (SELECT ROUND(LAST_TRANSACTION_COST, 4) AS LAST_TRANSACTION_COST
   FROM
     (SELECT CICHV.TRANSACTION_COST * (-1 * IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY) AS LAST_TRANSACTION_COST,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CICHV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                ORDER BY CICHV.COST_DATE DESC) AS rn
      FROM CST_ITEM_COST_HISTORY_V CICHV, CST_COST_INV_ORGS CCIO
      WHERE CICHV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
        AND CCIO.INV_ORG_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND CCIO.COST_ORG_ID = CICHV.COST_ORG_ID) sub
   WHERE sub.rn = 1) AS LAST_TRANSACTION_COST, IMT.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID,
       GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID CODE_COMBINATION_ID, IMT.REASON_ID MOTIVO_APLICACAO,
       NVL(
             (SELECT PU.USERNAME
              FROM PER_USERS PU
              WHERE PU.USER_GUID = IMT.CREATED_BY),IMT.CREATED_BY) LOGIN, '' CUSTO_UNITARIO_ITEM_USD, '' CUSTO_TOTAL_TRANSACAO_USD,
                                                                                                         IMT.EMPLOYEE_CODE REQUISITANTE,
                                                                                                         GJH.PERIOD_NAME PERIODO,
                                                                                                         GJH.CURRENCY_CODE MOEDA,
                                                                                                         GJH.JE_BATCH_ID LOTE_ID,
                                                                                                         NVL(GJL.ACCOUNTED_DR,

                                                                                                           0) - NVL(GJL.ACCOUNTED_CR,

                                                                                                                  0) GL_COST
FROM GL_LEDGERS GL, GL_JE_BATCHES GJB,
     GL_JE_HEADERS GJH, GL_JE_LINES GJL,
     GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_JE_SOURCES_TL GJS,
     GL_JE_CATEGORIES_TL GJC, CST_ALL_COST_TRANSACTIONS_V CACTV, CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS CIT,
     FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS CCD, FUSION.CST_COST_DISTRIBUTION_LINES CDL,
     XLA_AE_LINES XAL, INV_MATERIAL_TXNS IMT,
     EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT
WHERE TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
  AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
  AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
  AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
  AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY')
  AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = GJS.JE_SOURCE_NAME
  AND GJS.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_CATEGORY = GJC.JE_CATEGORY_NAME
  AND GJC.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = 'Cost Accounting'
  AND CACTV.TRANSACTION_ID = CCD.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CCD.DISTRIBUTION_ID = CDL.DISTRIBUTION_ID
  AND CDL.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
  AND CDL.AE_LINE_NUM = XAL.AE_LINE_NUM
  AND GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID = XAL.GL_SL_LINK_ID
  AND CACTV.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID = CIT.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CIT.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_ID
  AND IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = NVL(:P_IDIOMA, 'PTB')
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_CODE_COMBINATION
  AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
    (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
     FROM GL_PERIODS GP
     WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
       AND :P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
ORDER BY IMT.TRANSACTION_ID
```

### Query #11

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, GL_PERIODS, FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS_VL`

```sql
SELECT A.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.SEGMENT3, A.SEGMENT4, A.SEGMENT5, A.SEGMENT6,
       A.SEGMENT7, A.SEGMENT8, A.SEGMENT9,
       SUBSTR(
                (SELECT E.DESCRIPTION
                 FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL D, FND_FLEX_VALUES_TL E
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND D.FLEX_VALUE_ID = E.FLEX_VALUE_ID
                   AND E.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
                   AND D.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID IN
                     (SELECT FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
                      FROM FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS_VL FNS
                      WHERE FNS.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GL#'
                        AND APPLICATION_COLUMN_NAME = 'SEGMENT4')
                   AND D.FLEX_VALUE = A.SEGMENT4),1, 240) DESC_CONTA
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, GCC.SEGMENT1, GCC.SEGMENT2, GCC.SEGMENT3, GCC.SEGMENT4,
                   GCC.SEGMENT5, GCC.SEGMENT6, GCC.SEGMENT7, GCC.SEGMENT8, GCC.SEGMENT9
   FROM GL_LEDGERS GL, GL_JE_BATCHES GJB, GL_JE_HEADERS GJH,
        GL_JE_LINES GJL, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
   WHERE TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
     AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
     AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
     AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
     AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
     AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
     AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
     AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
     AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
     AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY','SECONDARY')
     AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
     AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_CODE_COMBINATION
     AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
       (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
        FROM GL_PERIODS GP
        WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
          AND :P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)) A
ORDER BY A.SEGMENT4
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_LEDGERS, GL_PERIODS, XLA_AE_LINES`

```sql
SELECT 'CTB02_MOVIMENTO' ORIGEM, TO_CHAR(GJL.EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                                   'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_MOVIMENTO,
                         GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, GJB.JE_BATCH_ID LOTE_ID,
                         GJH.JE_HEADER_ID MOVTO_CONTABIL_ID, GJL.JE_LINE_NUM MOVTO_CONTABIL_SEQ,
                         GJS.USER_JE_SOURCE_NAME MODULO_ORIGEM, GJC.USER_JE_CATEGORY_NAME CATEGORIA,
                         CASE
                             WHEN GJH.JE_SOURCE = 'Payables' THEN
                                    (SELECT REPLACE(AIA.INVOICE_NUM,
                                              ';', '#')
                                     FROM XLA_AE_LINES XAL, xla_distribution_links XDL,
                                          AP_INVOICES_ALL AIA
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                       AND XAL.GL_SL_LINK_ID = GJL.GL_SL_LINK_ID
                                       AND XDL.APPLICATION_ID = 200
                                       AND XDL.AE_HEADER_ID = XAL.AE_HEADER_ID
                                       AND XDL.AE_LINE_NUM = XAL.AE_LINE_NUM
                                       AND XDL.APPLIED_TO_SOURCE_ID_NUM_1 = AIA.INVOICE_ID
                                       AND ROWNUM = 1) ELSE NULL
                         END CONN_COD, GJL.ENTERED_DR VALOR_INGRESSADO_DEB,
                         GJL.ENTERED_CR VALOR_INGRESSADO_CRED, GJB.CREATED_BY LOGIN, GJL.CURRENCY_CODE MOEDA,
                         GJL.LEDGER_ID LIVRO_CONTABIL_ID,
                         REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GJL.DESCRIPTION,
                                                            1, 240),
                                                    ';', ','),
                                          chr(10) || chr(13) || chr(09), ' '),
                           '[[:space:]]', ' ') HISTORICO,
                         REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GJH.DESCRIPTION,
                                                            1, 240),
                                                    ';', ','),
                                          chr(10) || chr(13) || chr(09), ' '),
                           '[[:space:]]', ' ') HISTORICO_COMPLEMENTAR, GJL.PERIOD_NAME PERIODO,
                         GJL.ACCOUNTED_DR VALOR_CONVERTIDO_DEB, GJL.ACCOUNTED_CR VALOR_CONVERTIDO_CRED,
                         GJH.CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE TAXA_CONVERSAO, NULL TAXA_CONV_DOLAR, NULL VALOR_DOLARIZADO_DEBITO,
                                                                                                 NULL VALOR_DOLARIZADO_CREDITO
FROM GL_LEDGERS GL, GL_JE_BATCHES GJB, GL_JE_HEADERS GJH, GL_JE_LINES GJL,
     GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, GL_JE_SOURCES_TL GJS, GL_JE_CATEGORIES_TL GJC
WHERE TRIM(GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE) <> 'NONE'
  AND GJB.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'
  AND GJB.STATUS = 'P'
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = GJH.LEDGER_ID
  AND GJB.JE_BATCH_ID = GJH.JE_BATCH_ID
  AND GJH.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID
  AND GJL.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND GCC.SUMMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND GCC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND GCC.ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND GL.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE IN ('PRIMARY','SECONDARY')
  AND GL.NAME NOT LIKE '%FISCAL%'
  AND GJH.JE_SOURCE = GJS.JE_SOURCE_NAME
  AND GJS.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GJH.JE_CATEGORY = GJC.JE_CATEGORY_NAME
  AND GJC.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_CODE_COMBINATION
  AND GJH.PERIOD_NAME IN
    (SELECT GP.PERIOD_NAME
     FROM GL_PERIODS GP
     WHERE GP.PERIOD_SET_NAME = GL.PERIOD_SET_NAME
       AND :P_DATA_PROCESSAMENTO BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE)
```

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS, FND_LOOKUPS, CMR_RCV_EVENTS, GL_JE_BATCHES, GL_LEDGER_RELATIONSHIPS`

### Query #16

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SYS & Foundation, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS, CMR_RCV_EVENTS, FND_LOOKUPS, GL_JE_BATCHES, GL_LEDGER_RELATIONSHIPS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT tab_ref.ref_inv, gl.name, gjb.name gl_batch_name,
                gjb.description gl_batch_description, gjs.user_je_source_name,
                gjc.user_je_category_name journal_category_name, gjl.period_name, gcc.segment1 rcv1, gcc.segment2 rcv2,
                gcc.segment3 rcv3, gcc.segment4 rcv4, gcc.segment5 rcv5, gcc.segment6 rcv6,
                gcc.segment7 rcv7, gcc.segment8 rcv8, gcc.segment9 rcv9, gjl.currency_code,
                gjl.entered_dr, gjl.entered_cr, gjl.currency_conversion_type,
                gjh.currency_conversion_rate,
                TO_CHAR(gjl.currency_conversion_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') currency_conversion_date, TO_CHAR(gjl.effective_date,

                                                                                                'YYYY-MM-DD') effective_date,
                gjl.accounted_dr, gjl.accounted_cr, gjh.je_header_id, gjl.je_line_num,
                TO_CHAR(gjb.creation_date, 'DD-MM-RRRR') creation_date, gjl.description descricao_linha, gjh.name nome_lancamento,
                gjh.description descricao_lancamento, gl.ledger_id, gjb.je_batch_id, gas.access_set_id, gjh.posted_date,
                gjb.created_by
FROM gl_je_batches gjb, gl_je_headers gjh, gl_je_lines gjl,
     gl_code_combinations gcc, gl_je_categories gjc, gl_je_sources gjs,
     gl_ledgers gl, gl_access_set_ledgers gasl, gl_access_sets gas,

  (SELECT source_doc_number ref_inv, event_id
   FROM cmr_rcv_events cre
   WHERE event_class_code = 'TRADE_ACCRUALS'
     AND event_type_code = 'TRADE_RECEIPT_ACCRUAL'
   UNION ALL SELECT transaction_number ref_inv, event_id
   FROM cst_cost_distributions ccd
   WHERE event_class_code = 'TRADE_COST_ACCOUNTING'
     AND event_type_code = 'TRADE_INTRANSIT_ISSUE') tab_ref,

  (SELECT DISTINCT gjl.je_header_id,gjl.je_line_num
   FROM gl_je_batches gjb, gl_je_headers gjh, gl_je_lines gjl,
        gl_code_combinations gcc, gl_ledgers gl, gl_access_set_ledgers gasl,
        gl_access_sets gas,

     (SELECT lookup_code acc
      FROM fnd_lookups
      WHERE lookup_type = 'CLIA_IOT_ACCOUNT'
        AND enabled_flag = 'Y') xx_acc_iot
   WHERE gjb.je_batch_id = gjh.je_batch_id
     AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
     AND gcc.code_combination_id = gjl.code_combination_id
     AND gl.ledger_id = gjh.ledger_id
     AND gcc.segment4 = xx_acc_iot.acc
     AND gcc.segment7 = '00'
     AND gcc.segment8 = '00'
     AND gjb.name = NVL(:P_BATCH_NAME, gjb.name)
     AND gas.access_set_id = gasl.access_set_id
     AND gasl.ledger_id = NVL(:P_LEDGER_ID, gasl.ledger_id)
     AND gasl.ledger_id = gl.ledger_id
     AND gl.implicit_access_set_id = gasl.access_set_id
     AND gas.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND (gjl.created_by != 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
          OR (gjl.created_by = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
              AND gjl.effective_date >= TO_DATE('01/01/2023',
                                          'DD/MM/RRRR')))
     AND gjh.period_name = NVL(:P_PERIOD, gjh.period_name)) gjl_intra
WHERE gjb.je_batch_id = gjh.je_batch_id
  AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
  AND gcc.code_combination_id = gjl.code_combination_id
  AND gjc.je_category_name = gjh.je_category
  AND gjs.je_source_name = gjh.je_source
  AND gl.ledger_id = gjh.ledger_id
  AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl_intra.je_header_id
  AND gjl.je_header_id = gjl_intra.je_header_id
  AND gjl.je_line_num = gjl_intra.je_line_num
  AND gas.access_set_id = gasl.access_set_id
  AND gasl.ledger_id = NVL(:P_LEDGER_ID, gasl.ledger_id)
  AND gasl.ledger_id = gl.ledger_id
  AND gl.implicit_access_set_id = gasl.access_set_id
  AND gas.enabled_flag = 'Y'
  AND (gjl.created_by != 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
       OR (gjl.created_by = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
           AND gjl.effective_date >= TO_DATE('01/01/2023',
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR')))
  AND gjc.user_je_category_name != 'Ajuste IC'
  AND gjh.period_name = NVL(:P_PERIOD, gjh.period_name)
  AND gjh.posted_date >= NVL(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_DT_PROCESSAMENTO), gjh.posted_date)
  AND gjb.name = NVL(:P_BATCH_NAME, gjb.name)
  AND gjl.reference_6 = tab_ref.event_id
  AND tab_ref.ref_inv = NVL(:P_NR_REF, tab_ref.ref_inv)
  AND gl.ledger_id NOT IN
    (SELECT target_ledger_id
     FROM gl_ledger_relationships glr, gl_ledgers gl
     WHERE gl.ledger_id = source_ledger_id
       AND glr.source_ledger_id != glr.target_ledger_id
       AND relationship_enabled_flag = 'Y'
       AND automatic_post_flag = 'Y')
ORDER BY tab_ref.ref_inv, TO_CHAR(gjb.creation_date,
                            'DD-MM-RRRR') DESC
```

```sql
SELECT PPA.SEGMENT1 PROJECTID,
       DECODE(PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE,
         'PENDING_CLOSE', 'PENDCLOSE', 'ACTIVE', 'APPR', PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE) FCSTATUS, NULL FINCNTRLID,
                                                                                                 NVL(PT.TASK_NAME,

                                                                                                   PPA.NAME) DESCRIPTION,

  (SELECT P.VERSION_NAME
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'

     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id
     AND rownum=1) BUDGETID,
                                                                                                 NULL BUDGETLINEID,
                                                                                                      PT.TASK_NUMBER TASKID,

  (SELECT NULL
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
     AND p.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) BUDGETCOST,
                                                                                                      NULL ACTUALCOST,
                                                                                                           NULL BURDENEDCOST,
                                                                                                                '0' ALLOCATEDCOST,
                                                                                                                    '' COMMITTEDCOST,
                                                                                                                       '' REMAININGCOST,
                                                                                                                          SYSDATE ASOFDATE,
                                                                                                                          NVL(PT.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                            PPA.START_DATE) STARTDATE,
                                                                                                                          NVL(PT.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                            PPA.COMPLETION_DATE) ENDDATE,
                                                                                                                          'TASK' FCTYPE,

  (SELECT T.NAME
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
     AND p.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) BUDGETTYPE,
                                                                                                                                 NULL BUDGETLINETYPE,
                                                                                                                                      PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE PROJECTTYPE,
                                                                                                                                      PT.SERVICE_TYPE_CODE TASKTYPE,
                                                                                                                                      NULL DISABLED,
                                                                                                                                           NULL PARENTTASKID,
                                                                                                                                                PT.WBS_LEVEL TASKLEVEL,
                                                                                                                                                NULL ISSUMMARY,

  (SELECT PA.SEGMENT1
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PA
   WHERE PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.CREATED_FROM_PROJECT_ID
     AND PPA.CREATED_FROM_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL) TEMPLATEID,
                                                                                                                                                     'OA' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                                          'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                               NULL SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                                    CASE
                                                                                                                                                                        WHEN PT.TASK_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 0
                                                                                                                                                                        ELSE NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                                   (SELECT 1
                                                                                                                                                                                    FROM PJF_TASKS_V PTV
                                                                                                                                                                                    WHERE PTV.PARENT_TASK_ID = PT.PARENT_TASK_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                      AND rownum=1), 1)
                                                                                                                                                                    END ISCHARGEABLE,
                                                                                                                                                                    NULL PARENTPROJECTID,
                                                                                                                                                                         NULL PARENTFINCNTRLID,
                                                                                                                                                                              SYSDATE CHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                              'FCEXTRACT API' CHANGEBY,
                                                                                                                                                                                              PT.TASK_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                                                                              HOU.ORG_INFORMATION3 ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                                              (
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PA,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES XLE
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE PA.legal_entity_id = XLE.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.project_id)||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT value_constant
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES m,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       pjf_projects_all_b p
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE m.input_value_constant1 = p.org_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND m.MAPPING_SET_CODE = 'CLIA_PJF_BU'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id) ||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT b.CLASS_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_B a,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CODES_TL b,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_PROJECT_CLASSES c,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_TL d,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CODES_b e
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = e.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = d.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND e.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND c.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND d.CLASS_CATEGORY = 'CENTRO DE RESULTADO'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND b.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND d.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND c.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID)) SITEID,
                                                                                                                                                                                              1 TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                              PPA.ATTRIBUTE1 CLIA_UA,

  (SELECT decode(PT.ENABLE_CAPITALIZATION_FLAG, 'Y', 'CAPEX', 'N', 'OPEX')
   FROM PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_B PT,PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PA
   WHERE PT.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PA.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
     AND PA.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) CLIA_TYPECAPEXOPEX,

  (SELECT h.name
   FROM hr_all_organization_units h,pjf_projects_all_vl p
   WHERE h.organization_id = p.project_unit_id
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) CLIA_EXP_ORG,
                                                                                                                                                                                              (
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PA,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES XLE
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE PA.legal_entity_id = XLE.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.project_id)||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT value_constant
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES m,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       pjf_projects_all_b p
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE m.input_value_constant1 = p.org_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND m.MAPPING_SET_CODE = 'CLIA_PJF_BU'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id) ||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                                 (SELECT b.CLASS_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                                                  FROM PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_B a,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CODES_TL b,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_PROJECT_CLASSES c,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_TL d,
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PJF_CLASS_CODES_b e
                                                                                                                                                                                                  WHERE a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = e.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = d.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND e.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND c.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND d.CLASS_CATEGORY = 'CENTRO DE RESULTADO'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND b.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND d.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                                    AND c.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID)) CLIA_UO
FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPA, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTV, PJF_TASKS_V PT,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOU
WHERE PPA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PPA.PROJECT_ID)
  AND HOU.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PPA.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID (+)
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID = PT.PROJECT_ID
  AND PPA.ORG_ID = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE IN ('PENDING_CLOSE','ACTIVE', 'CLOSED')
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT PPA.SEGMENT1 PROJECTID,
                DECODE(PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE,
                  'PENDING_CLOSE', 'PENDCLOSE', 'ACTIVE', 'APPR',
                  PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE) FCSTATUS, NULL FINCNTRLID, PPA.NAME DESCRIPTION,

  (SELECT VERSION_NAME
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
     AND p.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id
     AND rownum=1) BUDGETID, NULL BUDGETLINEID, '' TASKID,

  (SELECT TOTAL_PC_RAW_COST
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
     AND p.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) BUDGETCOST,
                                                   PPPA.ACT_PC_RAW_COST ACTUALCOST,
                                                   PPPA.ACT_PC_BURDENED_COST BURDENEDCOST, '0' ALLOCATEDCOST,
                                                                                               '' COMMITTEDCOST,
                                                                                                  '' REMAININGCOST,
                                                                                                     SYSDATE ASOFDATE,
                                                                                                     NVL(PT.START_DATE,

                                                                                                       PPA.START_DATE) STARTDATE,
                                                                                                     NVL(PT.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                       PPA.COMPLETION_DATE) ENDDATE,
                                                                                                     'PROJECT' FCTYPE,

  (SELECT T.NAME
   FROM PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL P,PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL T
   WHERE t.plan_type_id = p.plan_type_id
     AND p.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
     AND p.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND P.PLAN_CLASS_CODE = 'BUDGET'
     AND t.PLAN_TYPE_CODE = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) BUDGETTYPE,
                                                                                                               NULL BUDGETLINETYPE,
                                                                                                                    PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE PROJECTTYPE,
                                                                                                                    PT.SERVICE_TYPE_CODE TASKTYPE,
                                                                                                                    NULL DISABLED,
                                                                                                                         NULL PARENTTASKID,
                                                                                                                              NULL TASKLEVEL,
                                                                                                                                   NULL ISSUMMARY,

  (SELECT PA.SEGMENT1
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PA
   WHERE PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.CREATED_FROM_PROJECT_ID
     AND PPA.CREATED_FROM_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL) TEMPLATEID,
                                                                                                                                        'OA' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                             'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                  NULL SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                           WHEN PT.TASK_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 0
                                                                                                                                                           ELSE NVL(
                                                                                                                                                                      (SELECT NULL
                                                                                                                                                                       FROM PJF_TASKS_V PTV
                                                                                                                                                                       WHERE PTV.PARENT_TASK_ID = PT.PARENT_TASK_ID
                                                                                                                                                                         AND rownum=1), 1)
                                                                                                                                                       END ISCHARGEABLE,
                                                                                                                                                       NULL PARENTPROJECTID,
                                                                                                                                                            NULL PARENTFINCNTRLID,
                                                                                                                                                                 SYSDATE CHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                                                                 'FCEXTRACT API' CHANGEBY,
                                                                                                                                                                                 PPA.PROJECT_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                                                                 HOU.ORG_INFORMATION3 ORGID,
                                                                                                                                                                                 (
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PA,
                                                                                                                                                                                          XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES XLE
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE PA.legal_entity_id = XLE.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.project_id)||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT value_constant
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES m,
                                                                                                                                                                                          pjf_projects_all_b p
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE m.input_value_constant1 = p.org_id
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND m.MAPPING_SET_CODE = 'CLIA_PJF_BU'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id) ||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT b.CLASS_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_B a,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CODES_TL b,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_PROJECT_CLASSES c,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_TL d,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CODES_b e
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = e.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = d.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND e.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND c.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND d.CLASS_CATEGORY = 'CENTRO DE RESULTADO'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND b.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND d.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND c.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID)) SITEID,
                                                                                                                                                                                 1 TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                 PPA.ATTRIBUTE1 CLIA_UA,

  (SELECT decode(PT.ENABLE_CAPITALIZATION_FLAG, 'Y', 'CAPEX', 'N', 'OPEX')
   FROM PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_B PT,PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PA
   WHERE PT.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PA.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
     AND PA.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) CLIA_TYPECAPEXOPEX,

  (SELECT h.name
   FROM hr_all_organization_units h,pjf_projects_all_vl p
   WHERE h.organization_id = p.project_unit_id
     AND p.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID) CLIA_EXP_ORG,
                                                                                                                                                                                 (
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT XLE.LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PA,
                                                                                                                                                                                          XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES XLE
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE PA.legal_entity_id = XLE.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND PA.PROJECT_ID = PPA.project_id)||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT value_constant
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES m,
                                                                                                                                                                                          pjf_projects_all_b p
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE m.input_value_constant1 = p.org_id
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND m.MAPPING_SET_CODE = 'CLIA_PJF_BU'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND p.project_id = PPA.project_id) ||'.'||
                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT b.CLASS_CODE
                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_B a,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CODES_TL b,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_PROJECT_CLASSES c,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CATEGORIES_TL d,
                                                                                                                                                                                          PJF_CLASS_CODES_b e
                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = e.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND a.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID = d.CLASS_CATEGORY_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND e.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND c.CLASS_CODE_ID = b.CLASS_CODE_ID
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND d.CLASS_CATEGORY = 'CENTRO DE RESULTADO'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND b.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND d.language = 'US'
                                                                                                                                                                                       AND c.project_id = PPA.PROJECT_ID)) CLIA_UO
FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPA, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTV, PJO_TASK_ASSIGNMENTS_V PTA,
     PJF_TASKS_V PT, PJO_PROJECT_PLAN_ACTUALS PPPA, PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL PPV,
     PJO_PLAN_TYPES_VL PPT, HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOU
WHERE PPA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID = NVL(:P_ID, PPA.PROJECT_ID)
  AND HOU.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PPA.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID (+)
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID = PPPA.PROJECT_ID (+)
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID = PTA.PROJECT_ID (+)
  AND PPA.ORG_ID = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PTA.TASK_ID = PT.TASK_ID (+)
  AND PTA.PLAN_VERSION_ID = PPV.PLAN_VERSION_ID (+)
  AND PPV.PLAN_TYPE_ID = PPT.PLAN_TYPE_ID (+)
  AND PPA.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE IN ('PENDING_CLOSE','ACTIVE', 'CLOSED')
```

### Query #18

### Query #18

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID,

  (SELECT HAOU.NAME
   FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
   WHERE PRHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID) BU_NAME,PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER,PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 PRNUM,
                PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 PRID,
                CASE WHEN NVL(PRLA.ATTRIBUTE17, '0') = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END ATTACHMENT_FLAG,

  (SELECT SEGMENT1 || '.' || SEGMENT2 || '.' || SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE CODE_COMBINATION_ID =
       (SELECT PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA
        WHERE PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
          AND PRDA.DISTRIBUTION_NUMBER = 1)) SITEID,
                CASE
                    WHEN TRUNC(NVL(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE,
                                 TRUNC(SYSDATE))) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END SUBMIT_FOR_APPR_FLAG,
                TO_CHAR(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE, 'DD/MM/RRRR HH24:MI:SS') NEED_BY_DATE
FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA,POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
  AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                     PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
  AND PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #19

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID,

  (SELECT HAOU.NAME
   FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
   WHERE PRHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID) BU_NAME,PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER,PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 PRNUM,
                PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 PRID,
                CASE WHEN NVL(PRLA.ATTRIBUTE17, '0') = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END ATTACHMENT_FLAG,

  (SELECT SEGMENT1 || '.' || SEGMENT2 || '.' || SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE CODE_COMBINATION_ID =
       (SELECT PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA
        WHERE PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
          AND PRDA.DISTRIBUTION_NUMBER = 1)) SITEID,
                CASE
                    WHEN TRUNC(NVL(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE,
                                 TRUNC(SYSDATE))) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END SUBMIT_FOR_APPR_FLAG,
                TO_CHAR(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE, 'DD/MM/RRRR HH24:MI:SS') NEED_BY_DATE
FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA,POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
  AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
  AND UPPER(PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS) = 'INCOMPLETE'
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                     PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
  AND PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
ORDER BY 1
```
