### Query #20

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, PO_ACTION_HISTORY, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS`

### Query #20

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PO_ACTION_HISTORY, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT
  (SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1
   FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PRNUM, '' DESCRIPTION,
                               CASE
                                   WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('CANCELED') THEN 'CAN'
                                   WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'RETURNED') THEN 'UREV'
                               END STATUS,
                               TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') STATUSDATE,

  (SELECT SEGMENT1 || '.' || SEGMENT2 || '.' || SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND CODE_COMBINATION_ID =
       (SELECT PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA
        WHERE 1 = 1
          AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID(+)
          AND PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
          AND ROWNUM = 1)) "SITEID",

  (SELECT HOP.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOP
   WHERE HOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRHA.REQ_BU_ID) "ORGID", '' NOVENDOR,

  (SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1
   FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) PRID, '' CONTRACTREFID, '' CONTRACTREFREV, '' STORELOC, '' STORELOCSITEID,
                                                                                '' INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                   '' NP_STATUSMEMO, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                            PRHA.last_updated_by CHANGEBY,
                                                                                                            '1' STATUSIFACE,
                                                                                                                To_char(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                '' OA_IFACESTATUS,
                                                                                                                   '' OA_IFACETIMESTAMP, ROWNUM TRANSID,
                                                                                                                                                CASE
                                                                                                                                                    WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('CANCELED') THEN
                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT 'Reason: ' || PAH.note || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                                              (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                                               FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                                    PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                                               WHERE PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                                                 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                                            FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                                            WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'CANCEL'
                                                                                                                                                              AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
                                                                                                                                                    WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('REJECTED') THEN
                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT 'Reason: [' || PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS || '] ' || PAH.note || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                                              (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                                               FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF
                                                                                                                                                               WHERE 1 = 1
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAH.PERFORMER_ID
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                                                 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                                            FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                                            WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'REJECT'
                                                                                                                                                              AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
                                                                                                                                                    WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('RETURNED') THEN
                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT 'Reason: ' || PAH.note || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                                              (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                                               FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                                    PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                                               WHERE 1 = 1
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                                                 AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                                                 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                                            FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                                            WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'RETURN'
                                                                                                                                                              AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                                                                                                                              AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
                                                                                                                                                END MEMO,
                                                                                                                                                PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER FUSION_REQ_NUMBER,
                                                                                                                                                CASE
                                                                                                                                                    WHEN PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('RETURNED') THEN '1'
                                                                                                                                                    ELSE ''
                                                                                                                                                END OOG_PRREV,
                                                                                                                                                'R1' RULE,
                                                                                                                                                     PRHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'RETURNED')
  AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(PRHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,

                                                                                                             'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),

                                                                                                     'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                     PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'Y'
     FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA2, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA2
     WHERE PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRLA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRHA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 = PRLA2.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1
       AND PRLA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID <> PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRHA2.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('PENDING APPROVAL', 'APPROVED'))
UNION
SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 PRNUM, '' DESCRIPTION,
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELED',
                                                               'RETURNED') THEN 'UREV'
                                 END STATUS,
                                 To_char(SYSDATE,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') STATUSDATE,

  (SELECT SEGMENT1 || '.' || SEGMENT2 || '.' || SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE CODE_COMBINATION_ID =
       (SELECT PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA
        WHERE PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID)) "SITEID",

  (SELECT HOP.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOP
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRHA.REQ_BU_ID) "ORGID", '' NOVENDOR,
                                                           PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 PRID, '' CONTRACTREFID,
                                                                                           '' CONTRACTREFREV,
                                                                                              '' STORELOC,
                                                                                                 '' STORELOCSITEID,
                                                                                                    '' INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                       '' NP_STATUSMEMO,
                                                                                                          NULL TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                               PRHA.last_updated_by CHANGEBY,
                                                                                                               '1' STATUSIFACE,
                                                                                                                   To_char(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                   '' OA_IFACESTATUS,
                                                                                                                      '' OA_IFACETIMESTAMP,
                                                                                                                         NULL TRANSID,
                                                                                                                              CASE
                                                                                                                                  WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('CANCELED') THEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT 'Line: ' || PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4 || ' ' || 'Qty: ' || PRLA.quantity || ' ' || 'Reason: ' || PRLA.CANCEL_REASON || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                            (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                             FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                  PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                             WHERE PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                               AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                          FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                          WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'CANCEL LINE'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                                                                                                  WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('RETURNED') THEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT 'Line: ' || PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4 || ' ' || 'Qty: ' || PRLA.quantity || ' ' || 'Reason: ' || PRLA.RETURN_REASON || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                            (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                             FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                  PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                             WHERE 1 = 1
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                               AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                          FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                          WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'RETURN LINE'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                                                                                              END MEMO,
                                                                                                                              PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER FUSION_REQ_NUMBER,
                                                                                                                              '' OOG_PRREV,
                                                                                                                                 'R2' RULE,
                                                                                                                                      PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'RETURNED')
  AND PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('CANCELED', 'RETURNED')
  AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(PRLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,

                                                                                                             'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),

                                                                                                     'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                     PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
UNION
SELECT PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 PRNUM, '' DESCRIPTION,
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELED',
                                                               'RETURNED') THEN 'UREV'
                                 END STATUS,
                                 To_char(SYSDATE,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') STATUSDATE,

  (SELECT SEGMENT1 || '.' || SEGMENT2 || '.' || SEGMENT3
   FROM GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS
   WHERE CODE_COMBINATION_ID =
       (SELECT PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        FROM POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA
        WHERE PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID)) "SITEID",

  (SELECT HOP.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOP
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRHA.REQ_BU_ID) "ORGID", '' NOVENDOR,
                                                           PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 PRID, '' CONTRACTREFID,
                                                                                           '' CONTRACTREFREV,
                                                                                              '' STORELOC,
                                                                                                 '' STORELOCSITEID,
                                                                                                    '' INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                       '' NP_STATUSMEMO,
                                                                                                          NULL TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                               PRHA.last_updated_by CHANGEBY,
                                                                                                               '1' STATUSIFACE,
                                                                                                                   To_char(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CHANGEDATE,
                                                                                                                   '' OA_IFACESTATUS,
                                                                                                                      '' OA_IFACETIMESTAMP,
                                                                                                                         NULL TRANSID,
                                                                                                                              CASE
                                                                                                                                  WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('CANCELED') THEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT 'Line: ' || PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4 || ' ' || 'Qty: ' || PRLA.quantity || ' ' || 'Reason: ' || PRLA.CANCEL_REASON || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                            (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                             FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                  PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                             WHERE PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                               AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                          FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                          WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'CANCEL'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                                                                                                  WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('REJECTED') THEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT 'Line: ' || PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4 || ' ' || 'Qty: ' || PRLA.quantity || ' ' || 'Reason: ' || PRLA.LINE_STATUS || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                            (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                             FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                  PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                             WHERE PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                               AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                          FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                          WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'REJECT'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                                                                                                  WHEN PRLA.LINE_STATUS IN ('RETURNED') THEN
                                                                                                                                         (SELECT 'Line: ' || PRLA.ATTRIBUTE4 || ' ' || 'Qty: ' || PRLA.quantity || ' ' || 'Reason: ' || PRLA.RETURN_REASON || ' (' ||
                                                                                                                                            (SELECT PPNF.FULL_NAME
                                                                                                                                             FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
                                                                                                                                                  PER_USERS PU
                                                                                                                                             WHERE 1 = 1
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.USERNAME = PAH.CREATED_BY
                                                                                                                                               AND PU.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
                                                                                                                                               AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
                                                                                                                                               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) || ')'
                                                                                                                                          FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY PAH
                                                                                                                                          WHERE PAH.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQ'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.ACTION_CODE = 'RETURN LINE'
                                                                                                                                            AND PAH.OBJECT_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
                                                                                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                                                                                              END MEMO,
                                                                                                                              PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER FUSION_REQ_NUMBER,
                                                                                                                              '' OOG_PRREV,
                                                                                                                                 'R3' RULE,
                                                                                                                                      PRHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
  AND PRHA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'RETURNED')
  AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(PRHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,

                                                                                                             'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),

                                                                                                     'RRRR-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                     PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 'Y'
     FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA2, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA2
     WHERE PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRLA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRHA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRLA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 = PRLA2.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1
       AND PRLA2.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID <> PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
       AND PRHA2.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('PENDING APPROVAL', 'APPROVED'))
```

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

### Query #21

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `CST_COST_DISTRIBUTIONS, CMR_RCV_EVENTS, GL_JE_BATCHES, GL_LEDGER_RELATIONSHIPS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT gl.name, gjb.name GL_BATCH_NAME,gjb.description GL_BATCH_DESCRIPTION,
                gjs.USER_JE_SOURCE_NAME,gjc.user_je_category_name "JOURNAL_CATEGORY_NAME",
                gjl.PERIOD_NAME,gcc.segment1 rcv1,gcc.segment2 rcv2,gcc.segment3 rcv3,
                gcc.segment4 rcv4,gcc.segment5 rcv5,gcc.segment6 rcv6,gcc.segment7 rcv7,
                gcc.segment8 rcv8,gcc.segment9 rcv9,gjl.currency_code,gjl.entered_dr,
                gjl.entered_cr,gjl.CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE,
                to_char(gjl.currency_conversion_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') currency_conversion_date,to_char(gjl.effective_date,

                                                                                               'YYYY-MM-DD') effective_date,
                gjl.accounted_dr,gjl.accounted_cr,gjh.je_header_id,gjl.je_line_num,
                to_char(gjb.creation_date, 'DD-MM-RRRR') creation_date,gjl.description "DESCRICAO_LINHA",gjh.name NOME_LANCAMENTO,
                gjh.description DESCRICAO_LANCAMENTO,gl.ledger_id,gjb.je_batch_id,GAS.ACCESS_SET_ID,gjh.POSTED_DATE,
                gjl.currency_conversion_type
FROM gl_je_batches gjb,gl_je_headers gjh,gl_je_lines gjl,gl_code_combinations gcc,
     gl_je_categories gjc,gl_je_sources gjs,GL_LEDGERS gl,FUN_BAL_INTRA_RULES FBIR,
     GL_ACCESS_SET_LEDGERS GASL,GL_ACCESS_SETS GAS,

  (SELECT source_doc_number ref_inv, event_id
   FROM cmr_rcv_events cre
   WHERE event_class_code = 'TRADE_ACCRUALS'
     AND event_type_code = 'TRADE_RECEIPT_ACCRUAL'
   UNION ALL SELECT transaction_number ref_inv, event_id
   FROM cst_cost_distributions ccd
   WHERE event_class_code = 'TRADE_COST_ACCOUNTING'
     AND event_type_code = 'TRADE_INTRANSIT_ISSUE') tab_ref,

  (SELECT DISTINCT gjl.je_header_id,gjl.je_line_num
   FROM gl_je_batches gjb,gl_je_headers gjh,gl_je_lines gjl,gl_code_combinations gcc,
        gl_je_categories gjc,gl_je_sources gjs,GL_LEDGERS gl,FUN_BAL_INTRA_RULES FBIR,
        GL_ACCESS_SET_LEDGERS GASL,GL_ACCESS_SETS GAS
   WHERE gjb.je_batch_id = gjh.je_batch_id
     AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
     AND gcc.code_combination_id = gjl.code_combination_id
     AND gjc.je_category_name = gjh.je_category
     AND gjs.je_source_name = gjh.je_source
     AND gl.LEDGER_ID = gjh.LEDGER_ID
     AND gcc.segment4 like '118%'
     AND gjb.name = nvl(:P_BATCH_NAME, gjb.name)
     AND GL.LEDGER_ID = FBIR.LEDGER_ID
     AND FBIR.JE_SOURCE_NAME = GJS.je_source_name
     AND FBIR.Je_CATEGORY_NAME = gjC.je_CATEGORY_name
     AND GAS.ACCESS_SET_ID = GASL.ACCESS_SET_ID
     AND GASL.LEDGER_ID = NVL(:P_LEDGER_ID, GASL.LEDGER_ID)
     AND GASL.LEDGER_ID = GL.LEDGER_ID
     AND gl.IMPLICIT_ACCESS_SET_ID = GASL.ACCESS_SET_ID
     AND GAS.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND (gjl.created_by != 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
          OR (gjl.created_by = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
              AND gjl.effective_date >= TO_DATE('01/01/2023',
                                          'DD/MM/RRRR')))
     AND gjh.period_name= NVL(:P_PERIOD, gjh.period_name)) gjl_intra
WHERE 1=1
  AND gjb.je_batch_id = gjh.je_batch_id
  AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
  AND gcc.code_combination_id = gjl.code_combination_id
  AND gjc.je_category_name = gjh.je_category
  AND gjs.je_source_name = gjh.je_source
  AND gl.LEDGER_ID = gjh.LEDGER_ID
  AND gjh.je_header_id = gjl_intra.je_header_id
  AND gjl.je_header_id = gjl_intra.je_header_id
  AND gjl.je_line_num = gjl_intra.je_line_num
  AND GL.LEDGER_ID = FBIR.LEDGER_ID
  AND FBIR.JE_SOURCE_NAME = GJS.je_source_name
  AND FBIR.Je_CATEGORY_NAME = gjC.je_CATEGORY_name
  AND GAS.ACCESS_SET_ID = GASL.ACCESS_SET_ID
  AND GASL.LEDGER_ID = NVL(:P_LEDGER_ID, GASL.LEDGER_ID)
  AND GASL.LEDGER_ID = GL.LEDGER_ID
  AND gl.IMPLICIT_ACCESS_SET_ID = GASL.ACCESS_SET_ID
  AND GAS.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND (gjl.created_by != 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
       OR (gjl.created_by = 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
           AND gjl.effective_date >= TO_DATE('01/01/2023',
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR')))
  AND gjc.user_je_category_name != 'Ajuste IC'
  AND gjh.period_name= NVL(:P_PERIOD, gjh.period_name)
  AND gjh.POSTED_DATE >= NVL(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_DT_PROCESSAMENTO), gjh.POSTED_DATE)
  AND gjb.name = NVL(:P_BATCH_NAME, gjb.name)
  AND (gjl.reference_6 IS NULL
       OR gjl.reference_6 <> tab_ref.event_id)
  AND gl.LEDGER_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT TARGET_LEDGER_ID
     FROM GL_LEDGER_RELATIONSHIPS GLR,GL_LEDGERS GL
     WHERE GL.LEDGER_ID = SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
       AND GLR.SOURCE_LEDGER_ID != GLR.TARGET_LEDGER_ID
       AND RELATIONSHIP_ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND AUTOMATIC_POST_FLAG = 'Y')
ORDER BY to_char(gjb.creation_date, 'DD-MM-RRRR') DESC
```

### Query #25

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, GL_JE_HEADERS, GL_JE_LINES`

### Query #25

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, GL_JE_LINES, GL_JE_HEADERS`

```sql
SELECT 'REALIZADO' AS CENARIO, 'FY' || TO_CHAR(gjh.default_effective_date,
                                         'YY') AS ANO,
       UPPER(TO_CHAR(gjh.default_effective_date, 'MON', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=PORTUGUESE')) AS MES, 'E_' || gcc.segment1 AS EMPRESA, 'FL_' || gcc.segment2 AS FILIAL,
       'NG_' || gcc.segment3 AS NEGOCIO, 'CC_' || gcc.segment5 AS CENTRO_CUSTO, 'CT_' || gcc.segment4 AS CONTA,
       NVL(gjl.accounted_dr, 0) - NVL(gjl.accounted_cr, 0) AS VALOR,
       TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS DATA_EXTRACAO
FROM gl_je_headers gjh
JOIN gl_je_lines gjl ON gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
JOIN gl_code_combinations gcc ON gjl.code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id
WHERE gjh.status = 'P'
  AND gjh.actual_flag = 'A'
  AND gjh.last_update_date >= CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_LAST_RUN_DATE,
                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS DATE)
ORDER BY gjh.default_effective_date, gcc.segment1, gcc.segment2, gcc.segment3, gcc.segment5, gcc.segment4
```

### Query #26

### Query #26

**Tags:** `FIN - General Ledger & SLA`

**Tabelas:** `GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS, GL_JE_LINES, GL_JE_HEADERS`

```sql
SELECT gjh.je_header_id, gjl.je_line_num, gjh.period_name, gjh.je_source, gjh.je_category,
       gjh.currency_code, gcc.segment1, gcc.segment2, gcc.segment3, gcc.segment4, gcc.segment5,
       gcc.segment6, gcc.segment7, gcc.segment8, gjl.entered_dr, gjl.entered_cr, gjl.accounted_dr,
       gjl.accounted_cr, NVL(gjl.entered_dr, 0) - NVL(gjl.entered_cr,
                                                    0) AS valor_entered,
       NVL(gjl.accounted_dr, 0) - NVL(gjl.accounted_cr, 0) AS valor_accounted
FROM gl_je_headers gjh
JOIN gl_je_lines gjl ON gjh.je_header_id = gjl.je_header_id
JOIN gl_code_combinations gcc ON gjl.code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id
WHERE gjh.status = 'P'
  AND gjh.actual_flag = 'A'
  AND gjh.last_update_date >= CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_LAST_RUN_DATE,
                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS DATE)
ORDER BY gjh.default_effective_date, gjh.je_header_id, gjl.je_line_num
```

## FIN - Tax & Legal

### Query #1

## FIN - Tax & Legal

### Query #1

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL, PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1 AS BANCO,
       SUBSTR(PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1, 1, 3) AS COD_BANCO,
       regexp_replace(LPAD(XEV.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 14),
         '([0-9]{2})([0-9]{3})([0-9]{3})([0-9]{4})', '\1.\2.\3/\4-') AS CNPJ_MATRIZ
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'anmDadosBancarios'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V XEV ON substr(ESTABLISHMENT_NAME,
                                       1, 7) = substr(LOC.LOCATION_CODE,
                                                 1, 4) || '001'
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_CATEGORIES_TL, ZX_FC_CODES_B`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_FC_CODES_B, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL`

```sql
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '01' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b,zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'INTENDED_USE'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT t.CATEGORY_ID, b.CATEGORY_CODE, t.DESCRIPTION, v.END_DATE, '02' AS TIPO
FROM egp_categories_tl t, egp_categories_b b, egp_category_set_valid_cats v
WHERE t.category_id = b.category_id
  AND v.category_id = b.category_id
  AND v.category_set_id = 300000436625476
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND t.category_name LIKE '|%'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date, v.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '03' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'USER_DEFINED'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '04' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '05' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
  OFFSET :P_OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT :P_PAGE_SIZE ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `ZX_FC_CODES_B, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL`

```sql
SELECT b.classification_id AS ORIGEM_ID, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '01' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b,zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'INTENDED_USE'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT t.CATEGORY_ID, b.CATEGORY_CODE, t.DESCRIPTION, v.END_DATE, '02' AS TIPO
FROM egp_categories_tl t, egp_categories_b b, egp_category_set_valid_cats v
WHERE t.category_id = b.category_id
  AND v.category_id = b.category_id
  AND v.category_set_id = 300000436625476
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND t.category_name LIKE '|%'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date, v.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '03' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'USER_DEFINED'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '04' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT b.classification_id AS ID_ORIGINAL, b.classification_code AS COD, t.classification_name AS DESCR,
       b.effective_to AS DT_FINAL, '05' AS TIPO
FROM zx_fc_codes_b b, zx_fc_codes_tl t
WHERE b.classification_id = t.classification_id
  AND t.language = 'PTB'
  AND b.classification_type_code = 'TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY'
  AND b.country_code = 'BR'
  AND GREATEST (b.last_update_date, t.last_update_date) BETWEEN :P_WINDOW_START_DATE AND :P_WINDOW_END_DATE
  OFFSET :P_OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT :P_PAGE_SIZE ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_OPT_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, BEN_PER_LE_HABITS_COV_F, BEN_PER_IN_LER, BEN_PGM_F...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT DD_BEN_ADIC.IDENTIFICADOR,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_id,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_number,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PENLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.PLLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.full_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.NRO_INSCR,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Plan_Name,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.plan_Type,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Code,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_TYPE_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_OPT_ID,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_SHORT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_ID,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_STAT_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Option_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,DD_BEN_ADIC.per_in_ler_stat_cd,DD_BEN_ADIC.effective_end_date,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.CPF_DEPENDENTE,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_TYP_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name_old,
                NVL(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME, DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name) Short_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Type_Code_old,DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                DECODE(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME,
                  'PREVBRAD - ADESAO' , DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO' ,
                  DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,
                  'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC, 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC,
                  HSL_LKP.Benefit_Type_Code) Benefit_Type_Code,DD_BEN_ADIC.NOME_BU,DD_BEN_ADIC.IND_CARGO,DD_BEN_ADIC.ACAO
FROM
  (SELECT 'RCOLABCAMPADC' AS IDENTIFICADOR, papf.person_id, papf.person_number, pen.last_update_date AS PENLUD,
          pl.last_update_date AS PLLUD, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, ppnf.full_name,
          nvl(
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                             '-') - 1)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR, pl.name Benefit_Plan_Name, pt.name plan_Type,
          pl.short_name AS Plan_Short_Name, pl.short_code AS Plan_Short_Code, pl.CONFIG_CHAR_2 AS PLAN_TYPE_SP,
          DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID, DD_OPC.opt_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_ID, DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_CODE AS PLAN_SP, DD_OPC.OIPL_STAT_CD,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                                    DD_OPC.opt_NAME) Benefit_Option_Name,
          TO_CHAR(pen.ELECTION_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_ELECTION, TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt,
                                                                  'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_INSC,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),
            '31/12/4712', '', TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt,
                                'DD/MM/YYYY')) DT_EXC,
          DECODE(NVL(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '0'), '0', NULL, '19010101') LKP_DTADES,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '47121231', '', '19010102') LKP_DTEXCL, pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd,
          TO_CHAR(PL.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date,

     (SELECT pni.national_identifier_number
      FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr, per_all_people_f papd, per_national_identifiers pni
      WHERE papf.person_id = pcr.person_id (+)
        AND papd.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND papd.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
           FROM per_all_people_f aux
           WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
        AND pni.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) CPF_DEPENDENTE, pen.BNFT_TYP_CD, pen.BNFT_AMT, pen.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,
          nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME) AS Short_name_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , pl.short_name, 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' , pl.short_name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name),
              upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME))), pt.name) Short_name,
          DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE AS Benefit_Type_Code_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(NVL(DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR, '0'),
              '0', DD_BU.HROV_NAME,
              DECODE(NVL(DD_BU.HROV_NAME, '0'),
                '0', NULL, DD_BU.HROV_NAME ||'|'||DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR)),
            decode(pen.BNFT_TYP_CD,
              'CVG',
              DECODE(nvl(pl.short_name, '0'),
                'PREVVEXTY' , TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVIPP' ,
                TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVBRAD - PLANO' , pl.short_code, TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT))),
              DECODE(nvl(UPPER(pl.short_name), '0'),
                '0' , DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE, 'SEGVIDA - ACIDPESS', DD_OPC.opt_NAME,
                'SEGVIDA - SUPLEMENT', DD_OPC.opt_NAME, 'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'DESJEJ' ,
                UPPER(pl.short_name), DD_OPC.opt_NAME))) VALOR_DE,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' ,
            pl.short_name, 'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name), upper(DD_OPC.opt_NAME)), pt.name) APOIO_TAG, DD_BU.HROV_NAME NOME_BU, DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR IND_CARGO,
          decode(pl.short_name,
            'SUSPENSAO VEXTY', 0,
            decode(upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_NAME)),
              'CANCELAMENTO', '1',
              decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), '31/12/4712', '0', '', '0', '1'))) ACAO
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
   INNER JOIN PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE POS ON (POS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                                             AND POS.person_id = paam.person_id)
   INNER JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl estab ON (estab.language = 'PTB'
                                                   AND estab.organization_id = paam.establishment_id
                                                   AND TRUNC(sysdate) BETWEEN estab.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND estab.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT JOB.JOB_ID, JOB.JOB_CODE, JOB.NAME,
             decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'APREN'),
               0, decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'ESTAG'), 0, NULL, 'ESTAGIARIO'),
               'APRENDIZ') IND_EST_APR
      FROM per_jobs_f_vl job
      WHERE 1=1
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN job.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND job.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_JOB ON (DD_JOB.JOB_ID = paam.JOB_ID)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT HROV.ORGANIZATION_ID, HROV.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             decode(trim(HROV.NAME),
               'ITJ001-TKO CDI ESCRITORIO ITAJAI' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA001-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE SI' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA002-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE UNP' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA003-CLIENT_A DRILLING BASE MACAE UNP', trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA004-OOG TKP MACAE' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA005-CLIENT_A MACAE SUBSEA' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'RIO001-CLIENT_A ESCRITORIO RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'RIO005-TKO PDL ARMAZEM RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME), trim(HROV.NAME)) HROV_NAME, HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE, HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
             HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, HROV.STATUS
      FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V HROV
      WHERE 1=1
        AND HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_BU ON (DD_BU.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID) ,per_all_people_f papf
   LEFT OUTER JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON (ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
                                               AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL') ,ben_benefit_relations_f brn,
                                                                               ben_prtt_enrt_rslt pen
   INNER JOIN ben_per_in_ler pil ON (pil.per_in_ler_id = PEN.per_in_ler_id)
   INNER JOIN ben_pl_typ_f pt ON (Sysdate BETWEEN pt.effective_start_date AND pt.effective_end_date
                                  AND pt.OPT_TYP_CD <> 'HCVG'
                                  AND upper(pt.name) NOT IN ('VALE TRANSPORTE')
                                  AND pt.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                  AND pt.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pl_f pl ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PL.effective_start_date AND PL.effective_end_date
                                   AND pl.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                   AND pl.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id
                                   AND pl.pl_id = pen.pl_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pgm_f PGM ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PGM.effective_start_date AND PGM.effective_end_date
                                     AND PGM.pgm_id = PEN.pgm_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_per_le_habits_cov_f phf ON (Sysdate BETWEEN phf.effective_start_date AND phf.effective_end_date
                                                   AND phf.person_id = PEN.person_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_ler_f ler ON (Sysdate BETWEEN LER.effective_start_date AND LER.effective_end_date
                                     AND LER.ler_id = PEN.ler_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT opt.OPT_ID opt_OPT_ID,opt.NAME opt_NAME,opt.SHORT_CODE opt_SHORT_CODE,
             opt.SHORT_NAME opt_SHORT_NAME,opt.CARRIER_OPT_NAME opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             opt.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,opt.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,opt.CREATION_DATE,opt.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
             OIPL.OIPL_ID,OIPL.OIPL_STAT_CD,OIPL.SHORT_CODE OIPL_SHORT_CODE,
             OIPL.SHORT_NAME OIPL_SHORT_NAME,OIPL.PL_ID OIPL_PL_ID,
             OIPL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,OIPL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
             OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID OIPL_BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,OIPL.CREATION_DATE OIPL_CREATION_DATE,
             OIPL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE OIPL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM ben_opt_f opt
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_oipl_f OIPL ON (Sysdate BETWEEN OIPL.effective_start_date AND OIPL.effective_end_date
                                          AND OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                          AND oipl.opt_id = opt.opt_id)
      WHERE 1=1
        AND Sysdate BETWEEN opt.effective_start_date AND opt.effective_end_date) DD_OPC ON (DD_OPC.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = pen.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.OIPL_ID = PEN.oipl_id
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID = pen.opt_id)
   WHERE 1=1
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM per_periods_of_service ppos
        WHERE ppos.date_start =
            (SELECT max(ppos2.date_start)
             FROM per_periods_of_service ppos2
             WHERE ppos2.person_id = ppos.person_id)
          AND ppos.person_id < 99999999999999999
          AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
          AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id)
     AND (pen.last_update_date >= :pEffectiveDate
          OR pen.PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE >= :pEffectiveDate)
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN BRN.effective_start_date AND BRN.effective_end_date
     AND BRN.BENEFIT_RELATION_NAME = :playout
     AND BRN.benefit_relation_id = PEN.benefit_relation_id
     AND pen.prtt_enrt_rslt_stat_cd IS NULL
     AND pen.sspndd_flag ='N'
     AND pen.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND PEN.business_group_id = paam.business_group_id
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND paam.LEGISLATION_CODE NOT IN ('AT')
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.primary_work_relation_flag = 'Y') DD_BEN_ADIC
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT HSL.TAG,HSL.DESCRIPTION,
          SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
            DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'), 0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                                                    '#')+1)) Benefit_Type_Code,
          DECODE(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,

                          DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')+1)), 1, 2),
            'VA', 'VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO' , 'VR', 'VALE REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(SUBSTR(DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, HSL.MEANING,
                            SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                              1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')-1)), 1, 4),
              'REGI', 'PREVBRAD - REGIME', 'TIPO', 'PREVBRAD - TIPO', 'PREV', 'PREVBRAD',
              'PBDA', 'PREVBRAD - ADESAO', 'PVDA', 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO', 'PVDC',
              'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', 'PVDI', 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', 'PVDF', 'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', NULL)) NOVA_SHORT_NAME,HSL.MEANING
   FROM HR_STANDARD_LOOKUPS HSL
   WHERE HSL.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIENT_A_BR_INT_COMPLIANCE_CA') HSL_LKP ON (HSL_LKP.TAG IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                                                                                        'PREVBRAD - REGIME/TIPO')
                                                                        AND HSL_LKP.DESCRIPTION IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.OPT_NAME,
                                                                                                    TRIM(TO_CHAR(DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT)),
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name))
WHERE DD_BEN_ADIC.person_id = nvl(:p_person_id,
                                DD_BEN_ADIC.person_id)
ORDER BY 41 DESC,4 DESC
```

### Query #5

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES`

### Query #5

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_F`

```sql
SELECT iebc.bank_account_type tipo_conta, iebc.country_code cod_pais,
       iebc.bank_number cod_banco, iebc.branch_number cod_agencia,
       iebc.bank_account_num_electronic numero_conta, iebc.check_digits digito,
       iebc.iban_number swift_bank_code, NULL swift_bank_code_international,
                                              pppm.name nome_conta,
                                              popm.currency_code moeda,
                                              popm.org_payment_method_name ind_conta_salario, papf.person_id,
                                              paam.assignment_number,

  (SELECT listagg(DISTINCT xr.registration_number, ', ') within GROUP (
                                                                       ORDER BY 1)
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr,
        hr_organization_units_f_tl estab, hr_all_organization_units_f hrorg
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
     AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
     AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
     AND hrorg.establishment_id = xet.establishment_id
     AND estab.organization_id = hrorg.organization_id
     AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
     AND xr.identifying_flag = 'Y') nro_inscr,
                                              pppm.last_update_date AS account_last_update_date, pppm.last_update_date AS pppmlud,
                                              popm.last_update_date AS popmlud
FROM per_all_people_f papf, pay_pay_relationships_dn pprd, pay_personal_payment_methods_f pppm,
     pay_org_pay_methods_vl popm, iby_ext_bank_accounts_v iebc, pay_payroll_assignments ppasg,
     pay_bank_accounts pba,

  (SELECT per_all_assignments_f.*,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY per_all_assignments_f.person_id
                       ORDER BY per_all_assignments_f.effective_end_date DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_all_assignments_f
   WHERE per_all_assignments_f.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND per_all_assignments_f.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE') paam
WHERE papf.person_id = pprd.person_id (+)
  AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND pprd.payroll_relationship_id = pppm.payroll_relationship_id
  AND to_char(pppm.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND popm.org_payment_method_id = pppm.org_payment_method_id
  AND to_char(popm.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND iebc.bank_account_id = pppm.bank_account_id
  AND pppm.payroll_relationship_id = ppasg.payroll_relationship_id
  AND paam.LEGISLATION_CODE NOT IN ('AT')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.rank = 1
  AND ppasg.hr_assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam.LEGISLATION_CODE NOT IN ('AT')
  AND iebc.bank_account_id = pba.bank_account_id
  AND paam.assignment_number = nvl(:p_assign,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND (pba.account_last_update_date >= to_date(:pdataprocessamento,
                                         'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
       OR pppm.last_update_date >= to_date(:pdataprocessamento,
                                     'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
       OR popm.last_update_date >= to_date(:pdataprocessamento,
                                     'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pap.person_number person_number, pe.ext_identifier_number externalidentifiernumber,'BIP' externalidentifiertype,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_number assignmentnumberext,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_type workertype,
                                                                                                         pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                                                                                                         to_Char(pp.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE,

                                                                                                           'dd/mm/yyyy') terminationdate,
                                                                                                         replace(pe.ext_identifier_number,

                                                                                                           '_') assignmentnumber,
                                                                                                         pap.start_date start_date_people,
                                                                                                         pp.date_start start_date_assign,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_id,
                                                                                                         pap.person_id,
                                                                                                         pe.ext_identifier_id,

  (SELECT xr.registration_number
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
     AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
     AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
     AND hrorg.ESTABLISHMENT_ID = xet.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
     AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y') nro_inscr,

  (SELECT max(pprdn.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_NUMBER) a
   FROM PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN pprdn
   WHERE pa.person_id = pprdn.person_id
     AND pprdn.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_NUMBER not like 'CAND%') PAYROLL_RELATIONSHP_NUMBER
FROM per_all_people_f pap, per_ext_app_identifiers pe, per_all_assignments_m pa,
     per_periods_of_service pp, hr_organization_units_f_tl estab, hr_all_organization_units_f hrorg
WHERE pap.person_id = pa.person_id
  AND pa.person_id = pe.person_id(+)
  AND nvl(pe.ext_identifier_type, 'CLIENT_A_PSFT_EMPLID') = 'CLIENT_A_PSFT_EMPLID'
  AND pa.period_of_service_id = pp.period_of_service_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = pa.establishment_id
  AND estab.ORGANIZATION_ID = hrorg.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND pa.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND pa.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE >= :p_dt_adm
  AND pa.assignment_number = nvl(:p_assign,
                               pa.assignment_number)
  AND nvl(replace(pe.ext_identifier_number, '_'), '0') = nvl(nvl(:p_matricula,

                                                               replace(pe.ext_identifier_number,
                                                                 '_')),
                                                           '0')
  AND pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT max(pa2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m pa2
     WHERE pa2.assignment_id = pa.assignment_id
       AND pa2.establishment_id = pa.establishment_id)
```

### Query #7

### Query #7

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'PROGFERIAS' "IDENTIFICADOR", paam.person_id, paam.establishment_id,
                             APAE.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD,
                             decode(APAE.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD,
                               'ORA_WITHDRAWN', 1, 0) ABSENCE_STATUS_COMPLIANCE, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER MATRICULA,
                             APAE.DURATION DIA_FERIAS,
                             (CASE
                                  WHEN APAE.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
                                       AND APAE.DURATION <> 28 THEN '10'
                                  WHEN APAE.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
                                       AND APAE.DURATION = 28 THEN '2' WHEN APAE.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'N' THEN '0'
                              END) DIA_ABONO,
                             (CASE WHEN APAE.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'Y' THEN '1' WHEN APAE.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'N' THEN '0'
                              END) ADIANT_13S, APAE.START_DATETIME DT_INIC_GOZO,
                             APAE.END_DATETIME DT_FIN_GOZO,
                             TO_CHAR(paeim.AEI_INFORMATION_DATE1,
                               'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_INIC_AQUIS,
                             TO_CHAR(paeim.AEI_INFORMATION_DATE2,
                               'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_FIN_AQUIS, APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, APAE.PER_ABSENCE_ENTRY_ID,
                             nvl(
                                   (SELECT xr.registration_number
                                    FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,
                                  xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                                    WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                                      AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                                      AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                                      AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                                        (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                           1, instr(houft.name,
                                                                '-') - 1)
                                         FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                                     per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                         WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                                           AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                           AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                                           AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                                      AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                                      AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                   (SELECT xr.registration_number
                                    FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,
                                xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                                    WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                                      AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                                      AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                                      AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                                        (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                           1, 6)
                                         FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                                    per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                         WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                                           AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                           AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                                           AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                                      AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                                      AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR
FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, per_assignment_extra_info_m paeim, per_all_people_f papf,
     per_person_names_f ppnf, per_email_addresses ped, per_phones pp, per_people_legislative_f pplf,
     per_persons pps, hr_all_organization_units_f depto, hr_organization_units_f_tl estab,
     ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES APAE, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND APAE.period_of_service_id = ppos.period_of_Service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND APAE.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND APAE.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD IN ('SUBMITTED','ORA_WITHDRAWN')
  AND APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
  AND APAE.ABSENCE_TYPE_ID IN ('300000018797273','300000029284944','300000029284980',
                               '300001387643532')
  AND paam.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, paam.person_id)
  AND paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID = paeim.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND paeim.AEI_ATTRIBUTE3 = APAE.ATTRIBUTE1
  AND APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                 APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date AND ppnf.effective_end_date
  AND ped.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ped.email_address_id(+) = papf.primary_email_id
  AND pp.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND pp.phone_id(+) = papf.primary_phone_id
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pplf.effective_start_date AND pplf.effective_end_date
  AND pps.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date AND depto.effective_end_date
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND paam.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
  AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
ORDER BY APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC
```

### Query #8
