**Tabelas:** `DUAL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES`

### Query #8

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, DUAL`

```sql
SELECT NVL(
             (SELECT xr.registration_number
              FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                     1, instr(houft.name,
                                          '-') - 1)
                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                   WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                     AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                       (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                        WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                     AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                     AND paam2.person_id =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m
                        WHERE assignment_id = :P_NEW_SUP_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                          AND rownum = 1)
                     AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                AND ROWNUM = 1),
             (SELECT xr.registration_number
              FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                   WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                     AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                       (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                        WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                     AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                     AND paam2.person_id =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m
                        WHERE assignment_id = :P_NEW_SUP_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                          AND rownum = 1)
                     AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR,

  (SELECT assignment_number
   FROM
     (SELECT paam.assignment_number,assignment_type,
             rank() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                          ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
      FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
      WHERE paam.person_id =
          (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
           FROM per_all_assignments_m
           WHERE assignment_id = :P_NEW_SUP_ASSIGNMENT_ID
             AND rownum = 1))
   WHERE rank=1
     AND assignment_type = 'E'
     AND rownum=1) NRO_MATRICULA_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR
FROM DUAL
```

### Query #9

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES`

### Query #9

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT ppos.person_id, ppos.period_of_service_id,
       TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date2, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dt_pgto, TO_CHAR(ppos.actual_termination_date,
                                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dt_resc,
       TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dt_aviso_previo, TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date2,

                                                                         'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dt_homolog,
       ppos.attribute2 AS indeniz,paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER matricula, paam.action_code,
       paam.reason_code AS cd_demissao,

  (SELECT xr.registration_number
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
     AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
     AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
     AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(substr(estab.name,
                                  1, instr(estab.name,
                                       '-') - 1)), '-1')||'%'
     AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR,
       decode(upper(ppos.attribute2), 'TRABALHANDO', '0', 'INDENIZADO', '1', 'DISPENSADO', '1') AS td_resc, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
FROM per_periods_of_service ppos, per_person_names_f ppnf, per_all_people_f papf, per_all_assignments_m paam,
     hr_organization_units_f_tl estab
WHERE 1 =1
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NOT NULL
  AND papf.person_id = ppos.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(a.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f a
     WHERE a.person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(estab.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
  AND paam.period_of_service_id = ppos.period_of_service_id
  AND paam.person_id = ppos.person_id
  AND paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
  AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
  AND paam.primary_work_relation_flag = 'Y'
  AND paam.action_code IN ('TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION', 'DEATH')
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.system_person_type = 'EMP'
  AND papf.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, papf.person_id)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date >= :p_data_integracao - 10
  AND paam.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND estab.organization_id = paam.establishment_id
  AND nvl(paam.reason_code, '00') NOT IN ('XSE')
  AND estab.language = 'PTB'
  AND ppos.attribute_date2 IS NOT NULL
  AND ppos.attribute_date2 >= add_months(trunc(sysdate,
                                           'mm'),
                                -1)
ORDER BY paam.last_update_date DESC
```

### Query #10

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_DISABILITIES_F, PER_LOCATIONS, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, IRC_REQUISITIONS_B, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

### Query #10

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_DISABILITIES_F, IRC_REQUISITIONS_B, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT paam.person_id, papf.person_number, ppnf.first_name, ppnf.middle_names, ppnf.last_name,
          pplf.legislation_code country, paam.effective_start_date, paam.effective_end_date, paam.assignment_id,
          paam.assignment_number, paam.assignment_type, paam.assignment_status_type_id, paam.reason_code,
          paam.system_person_type, paam.last_update_date,
          CASE WHEN ped.email_address IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OTHR'
          END AS e_addr_type,
          CASE WHEN ped.email_address IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'Y'
          END AS pref_email_flag, ped.email_address, pp.phone_type, pp.phone_number, pp.extension,
          CASE WHEN pp.phone_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'Y'
          END AS pref_phone_flag, pplf.sex, pps.blood_type, pps.date_of_birth, pps.date_of_death,
          pps.country_of_birth, pps.region_of_birth, pps.town_of_birth, paam.organization_id,
          depto.ATTRIBUTE8 cod_depto, depto.attribute8 empresa, depto.attribute1 centro_custo,
          depto.attribute2 estab_depto, paam.job_id, pjf.job_code, paam.location_id, loc.location_code,
          loc.estab_Uo, NVL(tp_cand.tipo_candidato, 'Integrante') tipo_candidato,

     (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
      FROM per_disabilities_f pdf
      WHERE pdf.person_id = paam.person_id
        AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pdf.effective_start_date AND pdf.effective_end_date) odb_port_defc, NULL ppp_situation_bra,
                                                                                                                       '0' disabled_type_bra,
                                                                                                                           NULL odb_obs_defic,
                                                                                                                                paam.projected_start_date,
                                                                                                                                NVL(depto.attribute2,
                                                                                                                                      (SELECT xr.registration_number
                                                                                                                                       FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,

                                                                                                                                     xle_etb_profiles xet,
                                                                                                                                     xle_registrations xr
                                                                                                                                       WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                         AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                                                                                                                                         AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                                                                                                                                         AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                                                                                                                                                      (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,

                                                                                                                                                                                         1,
                                                                                                                                                                                         instr(houft.name,

                                                                                                                                                                                           '-') - 1)
                                                                                                                                                                       FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,

                                                                                                                                                                   per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                                                                                                                                                       WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                                                                                                                                                         AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                                                                                                                                                         AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                                                                                                                                                                            FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                                                                                                                                                                            WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                                                                                                                                                                         AND paam2.person_id =
                                                                                                                                                                           (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                                                                                                                                                                            FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                                                                                                                                            WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id)
                                                                                                                                                                         AND rownum = 1)),

                                                                                                                                                             '-1')||'%'
                                                                                                                                         AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                                                                                         AND ROWNUM = 1)) NR_INSCR2,
                                                                                                                                nvl(
                                                                                                                                      (SELECT xr.registration_number
                                                                                                                                       FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,

                                                                                                                                     xle_etb_profiles xet,
                                                                                                                                     xle_registrations xr
                                                                                                                                       WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                                                         AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                                                                                                                                         AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                                                                                                                                         AND xet.NAME = estab.name
                                                                                                                                         AND rownum = 1), depto.attribute2) NRO_INSCR,
                                                                                                                                paam.employee_category,
                                                                                                                                pplf.PER_INFORMATION1 NUMERO_CTPS
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, per_all_people_f papf, per_person_names_f ppnf,
        per_email_addresses ped, per_phones pp, per_national_identifiers pni,
        per_people_legislative_f pplf, per_persons pps, hr_all_organization_units_f depto,
        hr_organization_units_f_tl estab, per_jobs_f pjf,

     (SELECT irc.person_id, irb.job_id, MIN(flv.meaning) tipo_candidato
      FROM irc_requisitions_b irb, irc_submissions irs, irc_candidates irc,
           fnd_lookup_values flv
      WHERE 1=1
        AND irs.requisition_id = irb.requisition_id
        AND irc.person_id = irs.person_id
        AND flv.lookup_type = 'ORA_IRC_RECRUITING_TYPE'
        AND flv.lookup_code = irb.recruiting_type_code
        AND flv.language = 'PTB'
        AND flv.enabled_flag = 'Y'
      GROUP BY irc.person_id, irb.job_id) tp_cand,

     (SELECT ploc.location_id, ploc.internal_location_code location_code, pldf.attribute1 estab_Uo
      FROM per_locations ploc, per_location_details_f pldf
      WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc
   WHERE paam.person_id = NVL(:p_person_id, paam.person_id)
     AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                    paam.last_update_date)
     AND paam.system_person_type = 'PWK'
     AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'P'
     AND paam.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
     AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date AND ppnf.effective_end_date
     AND ped.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND ped.email_address_id(+) = papf.primary_email_id
     AND pp.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND pp.phone_id(+) = papf.primary_phone_id
     AND pni.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND pni.national_identifier_id = papf.primary_nid_id
     AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pplf.effective_start_date AND pplf.effective_end_date
     AND pps.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date AND depto.effective_end_date
     AND pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND pjf.effective_end_date
     AND loc.location_id = paam.location_id
     AND tp_cand.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
     AND tp_cand.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
     AND pni.national_identifier_type IS NOT NULL
     AND pni.national_identifier_number IS NOT NULL
     AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
     AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
     AND paam.effective_start_date >= add_months(trunc(sysdate),
                                        -3)
   ORDER BY paam.last_update_date DESC)
WHERE NRO_INSCR IN ('37964448000488','08091102001577','13920130000518','37964448000135',
                    '37964448000216','22027876000164','13920130000194','08091102000252',
                    '08091102000333','08091102000171')
```

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_OPT_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, BEN_PER_LE_HABITS_COV_F, BEN_PER_IN_LER, BEN_PGM_F...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT DD_BEN_ADIC.IDENTIFICADOR,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_id,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_number,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PENLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.PLLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.full_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.NRO_INSCR,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Plan_Name,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.plan_Type,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Code,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_TYPE_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_OPT_ID,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_SHORT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_ID,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_STAT_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Option_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD, ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT,
                ENRT_CVG_STRT_DT,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,DD_BEN_ADIC.per_in_ler_stat_cd,DD_BEN_ADIC.effective_end_date,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.CPF_DEPENDENTE,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_TYP_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name_old,
                NVL(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME, DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name) Short_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Type_Code_old,DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                DECODE(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME,
                  'PREVBRAD - ADESAO' , DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO' ,
                  DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,
                  'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC, 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC,
                  HSL_LKP.Benefit_Type_Code) Benefit_Type_Code,DD_BEN_ADIC.NOME_BU,DD_BEN_ADIC.IND_CARGO,DD_BEN_ADIC.ACAO
FROM
  (SELECT 'RCOLABCAMPADC' AS IDENTIFICADOR, papf.person_id, papf.person_number, pen.last_update_date AS PENLUD,
          pl.last_update_date AS PLLUD, pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD, pen.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, pen.ENRT_CVG_STRT_DT,
          paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, ppnf.full_name,
          nvl(
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                             '-') - 1)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR, pl.name Benefit_Plan_Name, pt.name plan_Type,
          pl.short_name AS Plan_Short_Name, pl.short_code AS Plan_Short_Code, pl.CONFIG_CHAR_2 AS PLAN_TYPE_SP,
          DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID, DD_OPC.opt_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_ID, DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_CODE AS PLAN_SP, DD_OPC.OIPL_STAT_CD,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                                    DD_OPC.opt_NAME) Benefit_Option_Name,
          TO_CHAR(pen.ELECTION_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_ELECTION, TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt,
                                                                  'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_INSC,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),
            '31/12/4712', '', TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt,
                                'DD/MM/YYYY')) DT_EXC,
          DECODE(NVL(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '0'), '0', NULL, '19010101') LKP_DTADES,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '47121231', '', '19010102') LKP_DTEXCL, pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd,
          TO_CHAR(PL.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date,

     (SELECT pni.national_identifier_number
      FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr, per_all_people_f papd, per_national_identifiers pni
      WHERE papf.person_id = pcr.person_id (+)
        AND papd.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND papd.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
           FROM per_all_people_f aux
           WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
        AND pni.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) CPF_DEPENDENTE, pen.BNFT_TYP_CD, pen.BNFT_AMT, pen.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,
          nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME) AS Short_name_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , pl.short_name, 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' , pl.short_name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name),
              upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME))), pt.name) Short_name,
          DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE AS Benefit_Type_Code_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(NVL(DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR, '0'),
              '0', DD_BU.HROV_NAME,
              DECODE(NVL(DD_BU.HROV_NAME, '0'),
                '0', NULL, DD_BU.HROV_NAME ||'|'||DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR)),
            decode(pen.BNFT_TYP_CD,
              'CVG',
              DECODE(nvl(pl.short_name, '0'),
                'PREVVEXTY' , TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVIPP' ,
                TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVBRAD - PLANO' , pl.short_code, TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT))),
              DECODE(nvl(UPPER(pl.short_name), '0'),
                '0' , DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE, 'SEGVIDA - ACIDPESS', DD_OPC.opt_NAME,
                'SEGVIDA - SUPLEMENT', DD_OPC.opt_NAME, 'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'DESJEJ' ,
                UPPER(pl.short_name), DD_OPC.opt_NAME))) VALOR_DE,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' ,
            pl.short_name, 'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name), upper(DD_OPC.opt_NAME)), pt.name) APOIO_TAG, DD_BU.HROV_NAME NOME_BU, DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR IND_CARGO,
          decode(pl.short_name,
            'SUSPENSAO VEXTY', 0,
            decode(upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_NAME)),
              'CANCELAMENTO', '1',
              decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), '31/12/4712', '0', '', '0', '1'))) ACAO
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
   INNER JOIN PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE POS ON (POS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                                             AND POS.person_id = paam.person_id)
   INNER JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl estab ON (estab.language = 'PTB'
                                                   AND estab.organization_id = paam.establishment_id
                                                   AND TRUNC(sysdate) BETWEEN estab.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND estab.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT JOB.JOB_ID, JOB.JOB_CODE, JOB.NAME,
             decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'APREN'),
               0, decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'ESTAG'), 0, NULL, 'ESTAGIARIO'),
               'APRENDIZ') IND_EST_APR
      FROM per_jobs_f_vl job
      WHERE 1=1
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN job.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND job.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_JOB ON (DD_JOB.JOB_ID = paam.JOB_ID)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT HROV.ORGANIZATION_ID, HROV.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             decode(trim(HROV.NAME),
               'ITJ001-TKO CDI ESCRITORIO ITAJAI' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA001-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE SI' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA002-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE UNP' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA003-CLIENT_A DRILLING BASE MACAE UNP', trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA004-OOG TKP MACAE' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA005-CLIENT_A MACAE SUBSEA' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'RIO001-CLIENT_A ESCRITORIO RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'RIO005-TKO PDL ARMAZEM RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME), trim(HROV.NAME)) HROV_NAME, HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE, HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
             HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, HROV.STATUS
      FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V HROV
      WHERE 1=1
        AND HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_BU ON (DD_BU.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID) ,per_all_people_f papf
   LEFT OUTER JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON (Sysdate BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date AND ppnf.effective_end_date
                                               AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
                                               AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL') ,ben_benefit_relations_f brn,
                                                                               ben_prtt_enrt_rslt pen
   INNER JOIN ben_per_in_ler pil ON (pil.per_in_ler_id = PEN.per_in_ler_id)
   INNER JOIN ben_pl_typ_f pt ON (Sysdate BETWEEN pt.effective_start_date AND pt.effective_end_date
                                  AND pt.OPT_TYP_CD <> 'HCVG'
                                  AND upper(pt.name) NOT IN ('VALE TRANSPORTE')
                                  AND pt.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                  AND pt.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pl_f pl ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PL.effective_start_date AND PL.effective_end_date
                                   AND pl.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                   AND pl.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id
                                   AND pl.pl_id = pen.pl_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pgm_f PGM ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PGM.effective_start_date AND PGM.effective_end_date
                                     AND PGM.pgm_id = PEN.pgm_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_per_le_habits_cov_f phf ON (Sysdate BETWEEN phf.effective_start_date AND phf.effective_end_date
                                                   AND phf.person_id = PEN.person_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_ler_f ler ON (Sysdate BETWEEN LER.effective_start_date AND LER.effective_end_date
                                     AND LER.ler_id = PEN.ler_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT opt.OPT_ID opt_OPT_ID,opt.NAME opt_NAME,opt.SHORT_CODE opt_SHORT_CODE,
             opt.SHORT_NAME opt_SHORT_NAME,opt.CARRIER_OPT_NAME opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             opt.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,opt.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,opt.CREATION_DATE,opt.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
             OIPL.OIPL_ID,OIPL.OIPL_STAT_CD,OIPL.SHORT_CODE OIPL_SHORT_CODE,
             OIPL.SHORT_NAME OIPL_SHORT_NAME,OIPL.PL_ID OIPL_PL_ID,
             OIPL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,OIPL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
             OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID OIPL_BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,OIPL.CREATION_DATE OIPL_CREATION_DATE,
             OIPL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE OIPL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM ben_opt_f opt
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_oipl_f OIPL ON (Sysdate BETWEEN OIPL.effective_start_date AND OIPL.effective_end_date
                                          AND OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                          AND oipl.opt_id = opt.opt_id)
      WHERE 1=1
        AND Sysdate BETWEEN opt.effective_start_date AND opt.effective_end_date) DD_OPC ON (DD_OPC.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = pen.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.OIPL_ID = PEN.oipl_id
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID = pen.opt_id)
   WHERE 1=1
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM per_periods_of_service ppos
        WHERE ppos.date_start =
            (SELECT max(ppos2.date_start)
             FROM per_periods_of_service ppos2
             WHERE ppos2.person_id = ppos.person_id)
          AND ppos.person_id < 99999999999999999
          AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
          AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id)
     AND ((1=1
           AND TO_CHAR(pen.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY') = '4712'
           AND ((pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD NOT IN ('BCKDT', 'VOIDD'))
                OR (pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL))))
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN BRN.effective_start_date AND BRN.effective_end_date
     AND BRN.BENEFIT_RELATION_NAME = :playout
     AND BRN.benefit_relation_id = PEN.benefit_relation_id
     AND pen.prtt_enrt_rslt_stat_cd IS NULL
     AND pen.sspndd_flag ='N'
     AND pen.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND PEN.business_group_id = paam.business_group_id
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND paam.LEGISLATION_CODE NOT IN ('AT')
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.primary_work_relation_flag = 'Y') DD_BEN_ADIC
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT HSL.TAG,HSL.DESCRIPTION,
          SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
            DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'), 0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                                                    '#')+1)) Benefit_Type_Code,
          DECODE(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,

                          DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')+1)), 1, 2),
            'VA', 'VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO' , 'VR', 'VALE REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(SUBSTR(DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, HSL.MEANING,
                            SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                              1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')-1)), 1, 4),
              'REGI', 'PREVBRAD - REGIME', 'TIPO', 'PREVBRAD - TIPO', 'PREV', 'PREVBRAD',
              'PBDA', 'PREVBRAD - ADESAO', 'PVDA', 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO', 'PVDC',
              'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', 'PVDI', 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', 'PVDF', 'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', NULL)) NOVA_SHORT_NAME,HSL.MEANING
   FROM HR_STANDARD_LOOKUPS HSL
   WHERE HSL.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIENT_A_BR_INT_COMPLIANCE_CA') HSL_LKP ON (HSL_LKP.TAG IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                                                                                        'PREVBRAD - REGIME/TIPO')
                                                                        AND HSL_LKP.DESCRIPTION IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.OPT_NAME,
                                                                                                    TRIM(TO_CHAR(DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT)),
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name))
WHERE DD_BEN_ADIC.person_number = :p_person_number
ORDER BY DD_BEN_ADIC.PENLUD DESC,DD_BEN_ADIC.PLLUD DESC
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, HR_LEGAL_ENTITIES, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT, BEN_OPT_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, BEN_PER_IN_LER, BEN_PGM_F...`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT 'TITDEPPLANSAU' AS IDENTIFICADOR, HLE.ORGANIZATION_CODE, HLE.NAME DS_EMPRESA, papf.person_id,
                   BECD.DPNT_PERSON_ID, papf.person_number, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID,
                   ppnf.full_name, pen.last_update_date AS PENLUD, pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt,
                   pl.last_update_date AS PLLUD,
                   nvl(
                         (SELECT xr.registration_number
                          FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,
                        xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                          WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                            AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                            AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                            AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                              (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                 1, instr(houft.name,
                                                      '-') - 1)
                               FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                               WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                                 AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                 AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                                 AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                            AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                            AND ROWNUM = 1),
                         (SELECT xr.registration_number
                          FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,
                      xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                          WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                            AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                            AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                            AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                              (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                 1, 6)
                               FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                               WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                                 AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                 AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                                 AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                            AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                            AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR, BRN.BENEFIT_RELATION_NAME, pl.name Benefit_Plan_Name_OLD,

     (SELECT SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
               DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'), 0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                                                       '#')+1)) MEANING
      FROM HR_STANDARD_LOOKUPS HSL
      WHERE HSL.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIENT_A_BR_INT_PLSAUDE_COMPLIANC'
        AND HSL.TAG = 'PLANOS SAÚDE ODONTO'
        AND HSL.DESCRIPTION = pl.name) Benefit_Plan_Name, pt.name Benefit_Type, pl.short_code Benefit_Type_Code,
                   DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID, DD_OPC.opt_NAME Benefit_Option_Name, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE,

     AND Sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.primary_work_relation_flag = 'Y'
     AND ((pen.last_update_date >= :pEffectiveDate)
          OR (pen.PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE >= :pEffectiveDate))
     AND NOT EXISTS
       (SELECT '1'
        FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M asg
        WHERE asg.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
          AND asg.assignment_type='E'
          AND asg.work_terms_assignment_id IS NOT NULL
          AND asg.primary_flag = 'Y'
          AND asg.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND asg.assignment_status_type = 'INACTIVE'
          AND asg.assignment_id = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
          AND to_char(asg.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
ORDER BY ACAO DESC,nvl(CPF_DEPENDENTE, '0')
```

```sql
                                                                                         591,
                                                                                         'LONG TERM DISABILITY_BR',
                                                                                         1,
                                                                                         'MANDATO SINDICAL_BR',
                                                                                         21,
                                                                                         'CLIENT_A BABY_BR',
                                                                                         13,
                                                                                         'RECESSO ESTAGIÁRIO_BR',
                                                                                         22,
                                                                                         'SHORT TERM DISABILITY_BR',
                                                                                         2,
                                                                                         'LICENÇA NÃO REMUNERADA_BR',

                                                                                                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'

                                                                                             (SELECT xr.registration_number
                                                                                              FROM xle_entity_profiles xep,

                                                                                          xle_etb_profiles xet,
                                                                                          xle_registrations xr
                                                                                              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                                                                                                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                                                                                                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                                                                                                AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                                                                                                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,

                                                                                                                     1,
                                                                                                                     6)
                                                                                                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,

WHERE 1 = 1

                          'LICENÇA REMUNERADA_BR','LONG TERM DISABILITY_BR','MANDATO SINDICAL_BR',
                          'CLIENT_A BABY_BR','RECESSO ESTAGIÁRIO_BR','SHORT TERM DISABILITY_BR',

  AND APAE.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD IN ('SUBMITTED','ORA_WITHDRAWN')

  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'

  AND paam.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_JOBS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_LOCATIONS, CMP_SALARY, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_JOBS_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT B.*,
          rank() OVER (PARTITION BY B.person_id
                       ORDER BY B.effective_end_date DESC,
                    B.assignment_sequence DESC, B.last_update_date DESC) AS r
   FROM
     (SELECT NVL(paam.assignment_type, 'xpto') assignment_type, paam.ass_attribute7 cd_executivo, paam.ass_attribute1,
             paam.hourly_salaried_code tipo_marcacao_ponto, paam.person_id, papf.person_number, paam.assignment_id,
             paam.legal_entity_id, paam.business_unit_id, paam.action_code, paam.establishment_id,
             ppnf.full_name,
             lead(paam.establishment_id) OVER (PARTITION BY paam.person_id
                                               ORDER BY paam.effective_end_date DESC,
                                            paam.assignment_sequence DESC,
                                            paam.last_update_date DESC) AS last_establishment,

        (SELECT CASE WHEN pp.effective_end_date < SYSDATE THEN 'I' ELSE 'A'
                END status
         FROM
           (SELECT paux.effective_end_date,
                   rank() OVER (PARTITION BY paux.person_id
                                ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC, last_update_date DESC) AS rank
            FROM per_all_assignments_m paux
            WHERE paux.person_id=paam.person_id) pp
         WHERE pp.rank = 1) status,
             CASE
                 WHEN cmps.date_from > paam.effective_start_date THEN cmps.date_from ELSE paam.effective_start_date
             END effective_start_date, paam.effective_end_date, paam.last_update_date, paam.assignment_sequence,
             lead(paam.business_unit_id) OVER (PARTITION BY paam.person_id
                                               ORDER BY paam.effective_end_date DESC,
                                            paam.assignment_sequence DESC,
                                            paam.last_update_date DESC) AS last_business_unit,
             lead(paam.legal_entity_id) OVER (PARTITION BY paam.person_id
                                              ORDER BY paam.effective_end_date DESC,
                                           paam.assignment_sequence DESC,
                                           paam.last_update_date DESC) AS last_legal_entity,

        (SELECT xr.registration_number
         FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
           AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
           AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
           AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                        (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                           1, instr(houft.name,
                                                                '-') - 1)
                                         FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                                     per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                         WHERE houft.organization_id = paam.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                           AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                           AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
           AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR,
             NVL(
                   (SELECT xr.registration_number
                    FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                    WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                      AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                      AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                      AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                                   (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                                      1,
                                                                      instr(houft.name,
                                                                        '-') - 1)
                                                    FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,


                                                      (SELECT LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                   EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                   ESTABLISHMENT_ID, ORGANIZATION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID,
                                                   LEGAL_ENTITY_ID, PERSON_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                                                            ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC,

                                                                                         LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) RANK
                                                       FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M
                                                       WHERE effective_end_date <= paam.effective_end_date) paam2
                                                    WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                                      AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                                      AND paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam2.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                      AND paam2.RANK = 2
                                                      AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
                      AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                      AND ROWNUM = 1),
                   (SELECT xr.registration_number
                    FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                    WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                      AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                      AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                      AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                                   (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                                      1,
                                                                      instr(houft.name,
                                                                        '-') - 1)
                                                    FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,


                                                      (SELECT LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                   EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                   ESTABLISHMENT_ID, ORGANIZATION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID,
                                                   LEGAL_ENTITY_ID, PERSON_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                                                            ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC,

                                                                                         LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) RANK
                                                       FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M
                                                       WHERE effective_end_date <= paam.effective_end_date) paam2
                                                    WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                                      AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                                      AND paam.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam2.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                      AND paam2.RANK = 1
                                                      AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
                      AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                      AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR_ANT,

        (SELECT xr.registration_number
         FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
           AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
           AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
           AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                        (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                           1, instr(houft.name,
                                                                '-') - 1)
                                         FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                                     per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                         WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                                           AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                           AND paam2.assignment_id =
                                             (SELECT assignment_id
                                              FROM
                                                (SELECT paux.assignment_id,
                                             assignment_type,
                                             rank() OVER (PARTITION BY paux.person_id
                                                          ORDER BY paux.effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
                                                 FROM per_all_assignments_m paux
                                                 WHERE paux.person_id =
                                                     (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                                                      FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                      WHERE assignment_id =
                                                          (SELECT MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                           FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F pasf
                                                           WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
                                                             AND sysdate BETWEEN pasf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pasf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
                                                             AND rownum = 1)
                                                        AND rownum = 1))
                                              WHERE rank = 1
                                                AND assignment_type = 'E'
                                                AND rownum = 1)
                                           AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
           AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR,

        (SELECT assignment_number
         FROM
           (SELECT paux.assignment_number, assignment_type,
                   rank() OVER (PARTITION BY paux.person_id
                                ORDER BY paux.effective_start_date DESC) AS rank
            FROM per_all_assignments_m paux
            WHERE paux.person_id =
                (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                 FROM per_all_assignments_m
                 WHERE assignment_id =
                     (SELECT MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                      FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F pasf
                      WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
                        AND sysdate BETWEEN pasf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pasf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
                        AND rownum = 1)
                   AND rownum = 1))
         WHERE rank = 1
           AND assignment_type = 'E'
           AND rownum=1) NRO_MATRICULA_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR, cmps.SALARY_BASIS_CODE, paam.reason_code, paam.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE,

        (SELECT pjf.job_code
         FROM per_jobs_f pjf
         WHERE pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
           AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND pjf.effective_end_date
           AND rownum = 1) CD_FUNCAO,

        (SELECT haouf.attribute1
         FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haouf
         WHERE haouf.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
           AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN haouf.effective_start_date(+) AND haouf.effective_end_date(+)
           AND rownum = 1) CD_CCUSTO,

        (SELECT haouf2.attribute8
         FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haouf2
         WHERE haouf2.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
           AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN haouf2.effective_start_date(+) AND haouf2.effective_end_date(+)
           AND rownum = 1) DESCR_LOC_TRAB, paam.employee_category,
             paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER MATRICULA_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, loc.location_code,
             nvl(
                   (SELECT DISTINCT tb1.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
                    FROM per_all_assignments_m tb1
                    WHERE tb1.assignment_id = paam.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                      AND sysdate BETWEEN tb1.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND tb1.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
                      AND rownum = 1), paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER) MATRICULA_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER_ANT
      FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, per_all_people_f papf, per_person_names_f ppnf,

        (SELECT sal.*,
                rank() OVER (PARTITION BY sal.assignment_id
                             ORDER BY sal.last_update_date DESC) AS rank
         FROM cmp_salary sal) cmps,

        (SELECT ploc.location_id, ploc.internal_location_code location_code, pldf.attribute1 estab_Uo
         FROM per_locations ploc, per_location_details_f pldf
         WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
           AND sysdate BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc
      WHERE paam.assignment_type = 'E'
        AND to_char(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
        AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
        AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
        AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
        AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
        AND cmps.rank(+) = 1
        AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
        AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
        AND loc.location_id(+) = paam.location_id
        AND paam.action_code != 'TERMINATION'
        AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE') B
   WHERE last_update_date >= to_date(:p_data_min,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
     AND last_day(effective_start_date) > to_date(:p_data_min,
                                            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
     AND last_update_date <= to_date(NVL(:p_data_max,
                                       '4712-12-31 00:00:00'),
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
     AND (business_unit_id != last_business_unit
          OR legal_entity_id != last_legal_entity)
     AND action_code IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','TRANSFER')
     AND NRO_INSCR NOT IN ('034491548', '032260648')
   ORDER BY PERSON_ID, effective_end_date DESC,last_update_date DESC,
            assignment_sequence DESC)
WHERE r = 1
  AND to_char(effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
ORDER BY person_number
```

### Query #15

**Tabelas:** `PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, BEN_OPT_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, BEN_PER_IN_LER, BEN_PGM_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, BEN_OIPL_F...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT DD_BEN_ADIC.IDENTIFICADOR,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_id,DD_BEN_ADIC.person_number,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PENLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.PLLUD,DD_BEN_ADIC.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.full_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.NRO_INSCR,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Plan_Name,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.plan_Type,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Code,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_TYPE_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_OPT_ID,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_SHORT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_ID,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.PLAN_SP,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_STAT_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Option_Name,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC,DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,DD_BEN_ADIC.per_in_ler_stat_cd,DD_BEN_ADIC.effective_end_date,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.CPF_DEPENDENTE,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_TYP_CD,DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name_old,
                NVL(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME, DD_BEN_ADIC.Short_name) Short_name,DD_BEN_ADIC.Benefit_Type_Code_old,DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                DECODE(HSL_LKP.NOVA_SHORT_NAME,
                  'PREVBRAD - ADESAO' , DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO' ,
                  DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC, 'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC,
                  'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_EXC, 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', DD_BEN_ADIC.DT_INSC,
                  HSL_LKP.Benefit_Type_Code) Benefit_Type_Code,DD_BEN_ADIC.NOME_BU,DD_BEN_ADIC.IND_CARGO,DD_BEN_ADIC.ACAO
FROM
  (SELECT 'RCOLABCAMPADC' AS IDENTIFICADOR, papf.person_id, papf.person_number, pen.last_update_date AS PENLUD,
          pl.last_update_date AS PLLUD, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, ppnf.full_name,
          nvl(
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                             '-') - 1)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.establishment_id = estab.organization_id
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR, pl.name Benefit_Plan_Name, pt.name plan_Type,
          pl.short_name AS Plan_Short_Name, pl.short_code AS Plan_Short_Code, pl.CONFIG_CHAR_2 AS PLAN_TYPE_SP,
          DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID, DD_OPC.opt_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_ID, DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_CODE AS PLAN_SP, DD_OPC.OIPL_STAT_CD,
          DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME,
                                    DD_OPC.opt_NAME) Benefit_Option_Name,
          TO_CHAR(pen.ELECTION_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_ELECTION, TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt,
                                                                  'DD/MM/YYYY') DT_INSC,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),
            '31/12/4712', '', TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt,
                                'DD/MM/YYYY')) DT_EXC,
          DECODE(NVL(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_strt_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '0'), '0', NULL, '19010101') LKP_DTADES,
          decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'YYYYMMDD'), '47121231', '', '19010102') LKP_DTEXCL, pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd,
          TO_CHAR(PL.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date,

     (SELECT pni.national_identifier_number
      FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr, per_all_people_f papd, per_national_identifiers pni
      WHERE papf.person_id = pcr.person_id (+)
        AND papd.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND papd.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT max(aux.effective_start_date)
           FROM per_all_people_f aux
           WHERE aux.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id)
        AND pni.person_id = pcr.contact_person_id
        AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) CPF_DEPENDENTE, pen.BNFT_TYP_CD, pen.BNFT_AMT, pen.BNFT_NNMNTRY_UOM,
          nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME) AS Short_name_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , pl.short_name, 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' , pl.short_name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name),
              upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_NAME))), pt.name) Short_name,
          DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE AS Benefit_Type_Code_old,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(NVL(DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR, '0'),
              '0', DD_BU.HROV_NAME,
              DECODE(NVL(DD_BU.HROV_NAME, '0'),
                '0', NULL, DD_BU.HROV_NAME ||'|'||DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR)),
            decode(pen.BNFT_TYP_CD,
              'CVG',
              DECODE(nvl(pl.short_name, '0'),
                'PREVVEXTY' , TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVIPP' ,
                TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT)), 'PREVBRAD - PLANO' , pl.short_code, TRIM(TO_CHAR(pen.BNFT_AMT))),
              DECODE(nvl(UPPER(pl.short_name), '0'),
                '0' , DD_OPC.opt_SHORT_CODE, 'SEGVIDA - ACIDPESS', DD_OPC.opt_NAME,
                'SEGVIDA - SUPLEMENT', DD_OPC.opt_NAME, 'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'DESJEJ' ,
                UPPER(pl.short_name), DD_OPC.opt_NAME))) VALOR_DE,
          DECODE(pt.name,
            'SEGURO DE VIDA' , UPPER(pl.short_name), 'PREVIDÊNCIA PRIVADA' ,
            pl.short_name, 'VALES ALIMENTAÇÃO E REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(UPPER(SUBSTR(pl.short_name, 1, 6)),
              'DESJEJ', UPPER(pl.short_name), upper(DD_OPC.opt_NAME)), pt.name) APOIO_TAG, DD_BU.HROV_NAME NOME_BU, DD_JOB.IND_EST_APR IND_CARGO,
          decode(pl.short_name,
            'SUSPENSAO VEXTY', 0,
            decode(upper(nvl(DD_OPC.OIPL_SHORT_NAME, DD_OPC.opt_NAME)),
              'CANCELAMENTO', '1',
              decode(TO_CHAR(pen.enrt_cvg_thru_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), '31/12/4712', '0', '', '0', '1'))) ACAO
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
   INNER JOIN PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE POS ON (POS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                                             AND POS.person_id = paam.person_id)
   INNER JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl estab ON (estab.language = 'PTB'
                                                   AND estab.organization_id = paam.establishment_id
                                                   AND TRUNC(sysdate) BETWEEN estab.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND estab.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT JOB.JOB_ID, JOB.JOB_CODE, JOB.NAME,
             decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'APREN'),
               0, decode(INSTR(upper(JOB.NAME), 'ESTAG'), 0, NULL, 'ESTAGIARIO'),
               'APRENDIZ') IND_EST_APR
      FROM per_jobs_f_vl job
      WHERE 1=1
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN job.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND job.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_JOB ON (DD_JOB.JOB_ID = paam.JOB_ID)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT HROV.ORGANIZATION_ID, HROV.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             decode(trim(HROV.NAME),
               'ITJ001-TKO CDI ESCRITORIO ITAJAI' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA001-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE SI' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA002-CLIENT_A BASE MACAE UNP' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA003-CLIENT_A DRILLING BASE MACAE UNP', trim(HROV.NAME), 'MEA004-OOG TKP MACAE' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'MEA005-CLIENT_A MACAE SUBSEA' , trim(HROV.NAME), 'RIO001-CLIENT_A ESCRITORIO RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME),
               'RIO005-TKO PDL ARMAZEM RIO' , trim(HROV.NAME), trim(HROV.NAME)) HROV_NAME, HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE, HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
             HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, HROV.STATUS
      FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V HROV
      WHERE 1=1
        AND HROV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN HROV.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HROV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) DD_BU ON (DD_BU.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID) ,per_all_people_f papf
   LEFT OUTER JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON (ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
                                               AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL') ,ben_benefit_relations_f brn,
                                                                               ben_prtt_enrt_rslt pen
   INNER JOIN ben_per_in_ler pil ON (pil.per_in_ler_id = PEN.per_in_ler_id)
   INNER JOIN ben_pl_typ_f pt ON (Sysdate BETWEEN pt.effective_start_date AND pt.effective_end_date
                                  AND pt.OPT_TYP_CD <> 'HCVG'
                                  AND upper(pt.name) NOT IN ('VALE TRANSPORTE')
                                  AND pt.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                  AND pt.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pl_f pl ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PL.effective_start_date AND PL.effective_end_date
                                   AND pl.business_group_id = PEN.business_group_id
                                   AND pl.pl_typ_id = pen.pl_typ_id
                                   AND pl.pl_id = pen.pl_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_pgm_f PGM ON (Sysdate BETWEEN PGM.effective_start_date AND PGM.effective_end_date
                                     AND PGM.pgm_id = PEN.pgm_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_per_le_habits_cov_f phf ON (Sysdate BETWEEN phf.effective_start_date AND phf.effective_end_date
                                                   AND phf.person_id = PEN.person_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_ler_f ler ON (Sysdate BETWEEN LER.effective_start_date AND LER.effective_end_date
                                     AND LER.ler_id = PEN.ler_id)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (SELECT opt.OPT_ID opt_OPT_ID,opt.NAME opt_NAME,opt.SHORT_CODE opt_SHORT_CODE,
             opt.SHORT_NAME opt_SHORT_NAME,opt.CARRIER_OPT_NAME opt_CARRIER_OPT_NAME,opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,
             opt.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,opt.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,opt.CREATION_DATE,opt.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
             OIPL.OIPL_ID,OIPL.OIPL_STAT_CD,OIPL.SHORT_CODE OIPL_SHORT_CODE,
             OIPL.SHORT_NAME OIPL_SHORT_NAME,OIPL.PL_ID OIPL_PL_ID,
             OIPL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,OIPL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE OIPL_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
             OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID OIPL_BUSINESS_GROUP_ID,OIPL.CREATION_DATE OIPL_CREATION_DATE,
             OIPL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE OIPL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM ben_opt_f opt
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ben_oipl_f OIPL ON (Sysdate BETWEEN OIPL.effective_start_date AND OIPL.effective_end_date
                                          AND OIPL.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = opt.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                          AND oipl.opt_id = opt.opt_id)
      WHERE 1=1
        AND Sysdate BETWEEN opt.effective_start_date AND opt.effective_end_date) DD_OPC ON (DD_OPC.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID = pen.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.OIPL_ID = PEN.oipl_id
                                                                                            AND DD_OPC.opt_OPT_ID = pen.opt_id)
   WHERE 1=1
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM per_periods_of_service ppos
        WHERE ppos.date_start =
            (SELECT max(ppos2.date_start)
             FROM per_periods_of_service ppos2
             WHERE ppos2.person_id = ppos.person_id)
          AND ppos.person_id < 99999999999999999
          AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
          AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id)
     AND ((1=1
           AND TO_CHAR(pen.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY') = '4712'
           AND ((pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD NOT IN ('BCKDT', 'VOIDD'))
                OR (pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL))
           AND pen.ENRT_CVG_STRT_DT-1 NOT IN
             (SELECT AUX.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT
              FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT AUX
              WHERE AUX.ASSIGNMENT_ID = pen.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                AND nvl(AUX.BNFT_AMT, 0) = nvl(pen.BNFT_AMT, 0)
                AND nvl(AUX.OIPL_ID, 0) = nvl(pen.OIPL_ID, 0)
                AND AUX.PL_ID = pen.PL_ID))
          OR (1=1
              AND TO_CHAR(pen.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY') <> '4712'
              AND ((pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IN ('VOIDD'))
                   OR (pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL))
              AND pen.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT+1 NOT IN
                (SELECT AUX.ENRT_CVG_STRT_DT
                 FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT AUX
                 WHERE AUX.ASSIGNMENT_ID = pen.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                   AND nvl(AUX.OIPL_ID, 0) = nvl(pen.OIPL_ID,
                                               0)
                   AND AUX.PL_ID = pen.PL_ID
                   AND AUX.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID <> pen.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
                   AND ((AUX.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD NOT IN ('VOIDD', 'BCKDT'))
                        OR (AUX.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL)))))
     AND (pen.last_update_date >= :pEffectiveDate
          OR pen.PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE >= :pEffectiveDate)
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN BRN.effective_start_date AND BRN.effective_end_date
     AND BRN.BENEFIT_RELATION_NAME = :playout
     AND BRN.benefit_relation_id = PEN.benefit_relation_id
     AND pen.prtt_enrt_rslt_stat_cd IS NULL
     AND pen.sspndd_flag ='N'
     AND pen.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND PEN.business_group_id = paam.business_group_id
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND paam.LEGISLATION_CODE NOT IN ('AT')
     AND Sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.primary_work_relation_flag = 'Y') DD_BEN_ADIC
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT HSL.TAG,HSL.DESCRIPTION,
          SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
            DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'), 0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                                                    '#')+1)) Benefit_Type_Code,
          DECODE(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,

                          DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, 1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')+1)), 1, 2),
            'VA', 'VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO' , 'VR', 'VALE REFEIÇÃO',
            DECODE(SUBSTR(DECODE(INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#'),
                            0, HSL.MEANING,
                            SUBSTR(HSL.MEANING,
                              1, INSTR(HSL.MEANING, '#')-1)), 1, 4),
              'REGI', 'PREVBRAD - REGIME', 'TIPO', 'PREVBRAD - TIPO', 'PREV', 'PREVBRAD',
              'PBDA', 'PREVBRAD - ADESAO', 'PVDA', 'PREVVEXTY - ADESAO', 'PVDC',
              'PREVVEXTY - Cancelam', 'PVDI', 'PREVVEXTY - INI SUSP', 'PVDF', 'PREVVEXTY - FIM SUSP', NULL)) NOVA_SHORT_NAME,HSL.MEANING
   FROM HR_STANDARD_LOOKUPS HSL
   WHERE HSL.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIENT_A_BR_INT_COMPLIANCE_CA') HSL_LKP ON (HSL_LKP.TAG IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.APOIO_TAG,
                                                                                        'PREVBRAD - REGIME/TIPO')
                                                                        AND HSL_LKP.DESCRIPTION IN (DD_BEN_ADIC.VALOR_DE,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.OPT_NAME,
                                                                                                    TRIM(TO_CHAR(DD_BEN_ADIC.BNFT_AMT)),
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTADES,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.LKP_DTEXCL,
                                                                                                    DD_BEN_ADIC.Plan_Short_Name))
ORDER BY 41 DESC
```

### Query #16

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT NVL(paam.assignment_type, 'xpto') assignment_type, paam.ass_attribute1,
          CASE
              WHEN cmps.date_from > paam.effective_start_date THEN cmps.date_from ELSE paam.effective_start_date
          END effective_start_date, paam.assignment_sequence,
          CASE WHEN paam.effective_end_date < SYSDATE THEN 'I' ELSE 'A'
          END status, paam.assignment_id, paam.ass_attribute7 cd_executivo,
          paam.hourly_salaried_code tipo_marcacao_ponto,

     (SELECT xr.registration_number
      FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
      WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
        AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
        AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
        AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                                             '-') - 1)
```
