```sql
                                  per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                      WHERE houft.organization_id = TO_NUMBER(:p_new_assignment_id)
                                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                        AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
        AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR_NOVO_TRANSFER,

     (SELECT TRANSLATE(INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE, 'a./-', 'a')
      FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V
      WHERE ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.UNION_ID
        AND TO_CHAR(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31') AS sindicato,

     (SELECT xr.registration_number
      FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
      WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
        AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
        AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
        AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                                             '-') - 1)
                                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,
                                  per_all_assignments_m paam2
                                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                        AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                                          (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                                           FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                                           WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                                        AND paam2.person_id =
                                          (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                                           FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                           WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id)
                                        AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
        AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND ROWNUM = 1) NRO_INSCR,
          NVL(
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                                (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                                   1,
                                                                   instr(houft.name,
                                                                     '-') - 1)
                                                 FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,


                                                   (SELECT LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                ESTABLISHMENT_ID, ORGANIZATION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID,
                                                LEGAL_ENTITY_ID, PERSON_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                                                         ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC,

                                                                                      LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) RANK
                                                    FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M) paam2
                                                 WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                                   AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                                   AND paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam2.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                   AND paam2.RANK = 2
                                                   AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE NVL(TRIM(
                                                (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                                                   1,
                                                                   instr(houft.name,
                                                                     '-') - 1)
                                                 FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft,


                                                   (SELECT LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                                EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                ESTABLISHMENT_ID, ORGANIZATION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID,
                                                LEGAL_ENTITY_ID, PERSON_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                                                         ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC,

                                                                                      LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) RANK
                                                    FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M) paam2
                                                 WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
                                                   AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                                                   AND paam.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam2.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                                                   AND paam2.RANK = 1
                                                   AND rownum = 1)), '-1')||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR_ANT,
          NVL(
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                        1, instr(houft.name,
                                             '-') - 1)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                          (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                           FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                           WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.assignment_id =
                          (SELECT DISTINCT assignment_id
                           FROM per_all_assignments_m
                           WHERE assignment_id =
                               (SELECT assignment_id
                                FROM
                                  (SELECT paam.assignment_id,

                                 rank() OVER (PARTITION BY pasf.person_id
                                              ORDER BY pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                                           pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                                           paam.effective_end_date DESC) AS rank
                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
                                   WHERE pasf.assignment_id = :p_assignment_id
                                     AND paam.PERSON_ID = pasf.MANAGER_ID
                                     AND pasf.MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.assignment_id
                                     AND assignment_type = 'E'
                                     AND pasf.MANAGER_TYPE = 'LINE_MANAGER'
                                     AND sysdate BETWEEN pasf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pasf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
                                WHERE rank = 1)
                             AND rownum = 1)
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
                (SELECT xr.registration_number
                 FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
                 WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                   AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                   AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                   AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                     (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                      FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                      WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                        AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                          (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                           FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                           WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                        AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                        AND paam2.assignment_id =
                          (SELECT DISTINCT assignment_id
                           FROM per_all_assignments_m
                           WHERE assignment_id =
                               (SELECT assignment_id
                                FROM
                                  (SELECT paam.assignment_id,

                                 rank() OVER (PARTITION BY pasf.person_id
                                              ORDER BY pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                                           pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                                           paam.effective_end_date DESC) AS rank
                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
                                   WHERE pasf.assignment_id = :p_assignment_id
                                     AND paam.PERSON_ID = pasf.MANAGER_ID
                                     AND pasf.MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.assignment_id
                                     AND assignment_type = 'E'
                                     AND pasf.MANAGER_TYPE = 'LINE_MANAGER'
                                     AND sysdate BETWEEN pasf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pasf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
                                WHERE rank = 1)
                             AND rownum = 1)
                        AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                   AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR,

     (SELECT assignment_number
      FROM
        (SELECT paam.assignment_number,
                rank() OVER (PARTITION BY pasf.person_id
                             ORDER BY pasf.effective_end_date DESC,
                          pasf.effective_end_date DESC, paam.effective_end_date DESC) AS rank
         FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
         WHERE pasf.assignment_id = :p_assignment_id
           AND paam.PERSON_ID = pasf.MANAGER_ID
           AND pasf.MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.assignment_id
           AND assignment_type = 'E'
           AND pasf.MANAGER_TYPE = 'LINE_MANAGER'
           AND sysdate BETWEEN pasf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pasf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
      WHERE rank = 1) NRO_MATRICULA_TRANSFER_SUPERIOR,cmps.SALARY_BASIS_CODE,cmps.action_code_salary,paam.action_code,
          paam.reason_code,paam.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE,

     (SELECT pjf.job_code
      FROM per_jobs_f pjf
      WHERE pjf.job_id = paam.job_id
        AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date AND pjf.effective_end_date
        AND rownum = 1) CD_FUNCAO,

     (SELECT haouf.attribute1
      FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haouf
      WHERE haouf.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
        AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN haouf.effective_start_date(+) AND haouf.effective_end_date(+)
        AND rownum = 1) CD_CCUSTO,

     (SELECT haouf2.attribute8
      FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haouf2
      WHERE haouf2.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
        AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN haouf2.effective_start_date(+) AND haouf2.effective_end_date(+)
        AND rownum = 1) DESCR_LOC_TRAB,paam.employee_category,
          paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER MATRICULA_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,loc.location_code,
          nvl(
                (SELECT DISTINCT tb1.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
                 FROM per_all_assignments_m tb1
                 WHERE tb1.assignment_id = paam.SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
                   AND rownum = 1), paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER) MATRICULA_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER_ANT
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam,

     (SELECT sal.*, pv.action_code action_code_salary,
             rank() OVER (PARTITION BY sal.assignment_id
                          ORDER BY sal.date_from DESC) AS rank
      FROM cmp_salary sal, per_actions_vl pv
      WHERE sal.ACTION_ID = pv.ACTION_ID(+)) cmps,

     (SELECT ploc.location_id, ploc.internal_location_code location_code, pldf.attribute1 estab_Uo
      FROM per_locations ploc, per_location_details_f pldf
      WHERE pldf.location_id(+) = ploc.location_id
        AND sysdate BETWEEN pldf.effective_start_date AND pldf.effective_end_date) loc
   WHERE paam.assignment_id = :p_assignment_id
     AND cmps.rank(+) = 1
     AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
     AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
     AND paam.effective_end_date > SYSDATE
     AND loc.location_id(+) = paam.location_id)
WHERE NRO_INSCR NOT IN ('034491548', '032260648')
```

```sql
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'

                AND ROWNUM = 1) ,
             (SELECT xr.registration_number

              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'

                   WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id

                       (SELECT DISTINCT person_id

                        WHERE assignment_id = pa.assignment_id
                          AND rownum = 1)
                     AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                AND ROWNUM = 1)) NRO_INSCR, paam.assignment_number assignment_number_sup,
       NVL(
             (SELECT xr.registration_number
              FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name,
                                     1, instr(houft.name,
                                          '-') - 1)
                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                   WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                     AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                       (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                        WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                     AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                     AND paam2.person_id =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT person_id
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m
                        WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
                          AND rownum = 1)
                     AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND xr.registration_number <> '08091102001305'
                AND ROWNUM = 1) ,
             (SELECT xr.registration_number
              FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
              WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
                AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
                AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
                AND xet.NAME LIKE '%'||
                  (SELECT DISTINCT substr(houft.name, 1, 6)
                   FROM hr_organization_units_f_tl houft, per_all_assignments_m paam2
                   WHERE houft.organization_id = paam2.establishment_id
                     AND paam2.effective_start_date =
                       (SELECT max(aux_assign.effective_start_date)
                        FROM per_all_assignments_m aux_assign
                        WHERE aux_assign.person_id = paam2.person_id)
                     AND houft.language = 'PTB'
                     AND paam2.person_id =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT person_id

                     AND rownum = 1)||'%'
                AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y'

FROM per_all_assignments_m pa, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF, per_all_assignments_m paam
```

### Query #18

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pap.person_number person_number, pe.ext_identifier_number externalidentifiernumber,'BIP' externalidentifiertype,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_number assignmentnumberext,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_type workertype,
                                                                                                         pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                                                                                                         to_Char(pp.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE,

                                                                                                           'dd/mm/yyyy') terminationdate,
                                                                                                         replace(pe.ext_identifier_number,

                                                                                                           '_') assignmentnumber,
                                                                                                         pap.start_date start_date_people,
                                                                                                         pp.date_start start_date_assign,
                                                                                                         pa.assignment_id,
                                                                                                         pap.person_id,
                                                                                                         pe.ext_identifier_id,

  (SELECT xr.registration_number
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep, xle_etb_profiles xet, xle_registrations xr
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = xet.legal_entity_id
     AND xet.establishment_id = xr.source_id
     AND xr.source_table = 'XLE_ETB_PROFILES'
     AND hrorg.ESTABLISHMENT_ID = xet.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
     AND xr.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y') nro_inscr,
                                                                                                         papdn.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_NUMBER,
                                                                                                         papdn.START_DATE,
                                                                                                         papdn.END_DATE,
                                                                                                         ppr.effective_start_date effective_start_datea,
                                                                                                         ppr.effective_end_date effective_end_datea,
                                                                                                         ppr.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID,
                                                                                                         ppr.OVERRIDING_PERIOD_ID
FROM per_all_people_f pap, per_ext_app_identifiers pe, per_all_assignments_m pa,
     per_periods_of_service pp, hr_organization_units_f_tl estab, hr_all_organization_units_f hrorg,
     PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_F ppr, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN papdn
WHERE pap.person_id = pa.person_id
  AND pa.person_id = pe.person_id(+)
  AND nvl(pe.ext_identifier_type, 'CLIENT_A_PSFT_EMPLID') = 'CLIENT_A_PSFT_EMPLID'
  AND pa.period_of_service_id = pp.period_of_service_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = pa.establishment_id
  AND estab.ORGANIZATION_ID = hrorg.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND papdn.person_id = pa.person_id
  AND papdn.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID = ppr.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID
  AND sysdate BETWEEN ppr.effective_start_date(+) AND ppr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND estab.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND pa.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date AND estab.effective_end_date
  AND pa.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE >= :p_dt_adm
  AND pa.assignment_number = nvl(:p_assign,
                               pa.assignment_number)
  AND nvl(replace(pe.ext_identifier_number, '_'), '0') = nvl(nvl(:p_matricula,

                                                               replace(pe.ext_identifier_number,
                                                                 '_')),
                                                           '0')
  AND pa.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT max(pa2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m pa2
     WHERE pa2.assignment_id = pa.assignment_id
       AND pa2.establishment_id = pa.establishment_id)
  AND PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_NUMBER not like 'CAND-%'
```

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Tax & Legal`

**Tabelas:** `INV_TO_ETB, INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V, XLE_ASSOCIATIONS_V, XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V, ETB_REG, ETB_ADDR, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V, WH`

### Query #21

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V, INV_TO_ETB, ETB_ADDR, INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V, XLE_ASSOCIATIONS_V, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V, ETB_REG, WH`

```sql
WITH wh AS
  (SELECT iod.organization_id, iod.organization_code, iod.organization_name, iod.business_unit_id,
          iod.business_unit_name, iod.legal_entity
   FROM inv_organization_definitions_v iod),
     inv_to_etb AS
  (SELECT xla.entity_id AS organization_id, xla.legal_construct_id AS establishment_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY xla.entity_id
                             ORDER BY NVL(xla.effective_to, DATE '4712-12-31') DESC, xla.effective_from DESC) AS rn
   FROM xle_associations_v xla
   WHERE xla.entity_type = 'INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION'
     AND xla.legal_construct = 'ESTABLISHMENT'
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(xla.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(xla.effective_to, DATE '4712-12-31')),
     etb_reg AS
  (SELECT xr.establishment_id, xr.registration_number AS cnpj,
          xr.alternate_registered_name AS alternate_name, xr.registered_name AS registered_name,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY xr.establishment_id
                             ORDER BY NVL(xr.effective_to, DATE '4712-12-31') DESC, xr.effective_from DESC) AS rn
   FROM xle_registrations_v xr
   WHERE xr.identifying = 'Y'
     AND xr.registration_code_etb = 'CNPJ'
     AND xr.registration_number IS NOT NULL
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(xr.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(xr.effective_to, DATE '4712-12-31')),
     etb_addr AS
  (SELECT xe.establishment_id, xe.establishment_name, xe.legal_entity_id, xe.main_establishment_flag,
          xe.address_line_1, xe.address_line_2, xe.address_line_3, xe.town_or_city, xe.region_2,
          xe.postal_code, xe.country
   FROM xle_establishment_v xe)
SELECT wh.organization_id, wh.organization_code, wh.organization_name, wh.business_unit_name,
       COALESCE(addr_map.establishment_name, addr_main.establishment_name) AS establishment_name, COALESCE(reg_map.cnpj,

                                                                                                    reg_main.cnpj) AS cnpj,
       COALESCE(reg_map.alternate_name, reg_main.alternate_name) AS alternate_name ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.address_line_1, addr_main.address_line_1) AS address_line_1 ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.address_line_2, addr_main.address_line_2) AS address_line_2 ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.address_line_3, addr_main.address_line_3) AS address_line_3 ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.town_or_city, addr_main.town_or_city) AS town_or_city ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.region_2, addr_main.region_2) AS state_region_2 ,
       COALESCE(addr_map.postal_code, addr_main.postal_code) AS postal_code , COALESCE(addr_map.country,

                                                                                addr_main.country) AS country
FROM wh
LEFT JOIN inv_to_etb m ON m.organization_id = wh.organization_id
AND m.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN etb_addr addr_map ON addr_map.establishment_id = m.establishment_id
LEFT JOIN etb_reg reg_map ON reg_map.establishment_id = m.establishment_id
AND reg_map.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN etb_addr addr_main ON addr_main.legal_entity_id = wh.legal_entity
AND addr_main.main_establishment_flag = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN etb_reg reg_main ON reg_main.establishment_id = addr_main.establishment_id
AND reg_main.rn = 1
ORDER BY wh.organization_code
```

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS, AC_PICK, EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B, ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, AC_RAW, PO_HEADERS_ALL, DEPARA_RAW, DUAL...`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Tax & Legal, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DEPARA, AC_PICK, EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS, DUAL, AC_RAW, ZX_PARTY_TAXPAYER_IDNTFS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL...`

```sql
WITH depara_raw AS
  (SELECT :p_cnpj_fornecedor AS cnpj_fornecedor, :p_cnpj_destinatario AS cnpj_destinatario,
          :p_ElectronicInvoiceKey AS ElectronicInvoiceKey, TO_DATE(:p_InvoiceDate,
                                                             'YYYY-MM-DD') AS InvoiceDate,
          :p_InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber, nf.LineNumber, nf.ItemNumber AS Item_Entrada_NF,
          nf.Quantity, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(nf.Quantity,
                                   ',', '.')) AS Payload_Quantity_Num,
          nf.QuantityUOM, esi1.item_number AS Item_Oracle_viaTP,
          esi1.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, esi2.item_number AS Item_Oracle_direto,
          esi2.inventory_item_id AS Inventory_Item_Id_direto
   FROM
     (SELECT LEVEL AS LineNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS ItemNumber,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_Quantities,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS Quantity,
                      TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_UOMs,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS QuantityUOM
      FROM dual CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:p_ItemNumbers,
                             '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) nf
   LEFT JOIN egp_trading_partner_items tp ON tp.tp_item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN egp_item_relationships_b ir ON ir.tp_item_id = tp.tp_item_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi1 ON esi1.inventory_item_id = ir.inventory_item_id
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop1 ON iop1.item_definition_org_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   AND esi1.organization_id = iop1.master_organization_id
   LEFT JOIN egp_system_items_b esi2 ON esi2.item_number = nf.ItemNumber
   LEFT JOIN inv_org_parameters iop2 ON iop2.item_definition_org_id = iop2.master_organization_id
   AND esi2.organization_id = iop2.master_organization_id),
     depara AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT cnpj_fornecedor, cnpj_destinatario, ElectronicInvoiceKey, InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber,
             LineNumber, Item_Entrada_NF, Quantity, Payload_Quantity_Num, QuantityUOM,
             COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) AS Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id,
             COALESCE(Item_Oracle_viaTP, Item_Oracle_direto) AS Item_Oracle,
             CASE
                 WHEN COALESCE(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS Localizado,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LineNumber
                                ORDER BY CASE
                                             WHEN Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2
                                         END,
                       NVL(Inventory_Item_Id_viaTP, Inventory_Item_Id_direto)) AS rn
      FROM depara_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1),
     ac_raw AS
  (SELECT pla.line_num AS numero_linha, pla.item_id, pla.po_header_id AS from_header_id,
          pla.po_line_id AS from_line_id, pla.item_description, pla.uom_code, pla.unit_price, pla.quantity
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
   JOIN zx_party_tax_profile zptp ON zptp.party_id = pha.vendor_id
   LEFT JOIN zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti ON zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
   AND zpti.reporting_type_code = 'ORA_BR_CNPJ'
   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_from,
                                      SYSDATE)) AND TRUNC(NVL(zpti.effective_to,
                                                            SYSDATE))
   WHERE pha.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND pha.document_status = 'OPEN'
     AND pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'
     AND zpti.tax_payer_number = :p_cnpj_fornecedor),
     ac_pick AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT ac_raw.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id
                                          ORDER BY numero_linha) AS rn
      FROM ac_raw)
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT ac.numero_linha, ac.item_id, ac.from_header_id, ac.from_line_id,
       d.Item_Oracle AS item_number, ac.item_description, ac.uom_code, ac.unit_price,
       NVL(ac.quantity, 0) AS quantity, d.cnpj_fornecedor, d.cnpj_destinatario, d.ElectronicInvoiceKey,
       d.InvoiceDate, d.InvoiceNumber, d.LineNumber, d.Item_Entrada_NF,
       d.Quantity AS payload_quantity, d.Payload_Quantity_Num AS payload_quantity_num,
       d.QuantityUOM AS payload_uom, d.Localizado AS item_localizado,
       CASE WHEN ac.item_id IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN NVL(ac.quantity,
                                                    0) >= NVL(d.Payload_Quantity_Num,
                                                            0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS quantidade_ok
FROM depara d
LEFT JOIN ac_pick ac ON ac.item_id = d.Mapped_Inventory_Item_Id
ORDER BY d.Localizado, quantidade_ok, d.LineNumber, ac.numero_linha NULLS LAST
```

**Tabelas:** `FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, CMF_LELRU_TAXPAYER_INFO_V`

```sql
SELECT cmf.taxpayer_id
FROM fun_all_business_units_v bu
JOIN xle_entity_profiles xep ON bu.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
LEFT JOIN cmf_lelru_taxpayer_info_v cmf ON xep.legal_entity_id = cmf.legal_entity_id
WHERE bu.status = 'A'
  AND bu.bu_name = :P_BU
```

```sql
SELECT Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS OrderTypeLookupCode, Line.CONSIGNMENT_LINE_FLAG AS IsLineConsigned,
       Line.PO_LINE_ID AS PoLineId, Line.PO_HEADER_ID AS PoHeaderId, Item.ORGANIZATION_ID AS OrganizationId,

       NVL(BaseModelPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID, PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) AS BaseModelOrgId, Line.LINE_NUM AS LineNum, Item.ITEM_NUMBER AS ItemNumber,
       Line.ITEM_REVISION AS ItemRevision, Line.ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS ItemDescription,
       Item.DESCRIPTION AS ItemOriginalDescription, Line.VENDOR_PRODUCT_NUM AS VendorProductNum,
       LineType.LINE_TYPE AS LineType1, SourceHdr.SEGMENT1 AS Segment1,
       BlanketHdr.SEGMENT1 AS BlanketHeaderDocNumber, ContractHdr.SEGMENT1 AS ContractHeaderDocNumber,
       Line.SUPPLIER_REF_NUMBER AS SupplierRefNumber, SourceLine.SUPPLIER_PART_AUXID AS SupplierPartAuxid,
       Line.QUANTITY AS Quantity, Line.UOM_CODE AS UomCode, UOM.UNIT_OF_MEASURE AS UnitOfMeasure,
       Line.BASE_QTY AS BaseQty, Line.BASE_UOM AS BaseUom, Line.UNIT_PRICE AS UnitPrice,
       Line.CANCEL_FLAG AS CancelFlag, UnNumber.UN_NUMBER AS UnNumber1,
       UnNumber.DESCRIPTION AS UnNumberDescription, HazardClass.HAZARD_CLASS AS HazardClass1,
       Line.PURCHASE_BASIS AS PurchaseBasis, Line.CANCEL_DATE AS CancelDate, Line.CANCEL_REASON AS CancelReason,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS AttributeCategory, Line.ATTRIBUTE1 AS Attribute1, Line.ATTRIBUTE2 AS Attribute2,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE3 AS Attribute3, Line.ATTRIBUTE4 AS Attribute4, Line.ATTRIBUTE5 AS Attribute5,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE6 AS Attribute6, Line.ATTRIBUTE7 AS Attribute7, Line.ATTRIBUTE8 AS Attribute8,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE9 AS Attribute9, Line.ATTRIBUTE10 AS Attribute10, Line.ATTRIBUTE11 AS Attribute11,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE12 AS Attribute12, Line.ATTRIBUTE13 AS Attribute13, Line.ATTRIBUTE14 AS Attribute14,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE15 AS Attribute15, Line.ATTRIBUTE16 AS Attribute16, Line.ATTRIBUTE17 AS Attribute17,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE18 AS Attribute18, Line.ATTRIBUTE19 AS Attribute19, Line.ATTRIBUTE20 AS Attribute20,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE1 AS AttributeDate1, Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE2 AS AttributeDate2,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE3 AS AttributeDate3, Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE4 AS AttributeDate4,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE5 AS AttributeDate5, Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE6 AS AttributeDate6,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE7 AS AttributeDate7, Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE8 AS AttributeDate8,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE9 AS AttributeDate9, Line.ATTRIBUTE_DATE10 AS AttributeDate10,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1 AS AttributeTimestamp1, Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2 AS AttributeTimestamp2,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP3 AS AttributeTimestamp3, Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP4 AS AttributeTimestamp4,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP5 AS AttributeTimestamp5, Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP6 AS AttributeTimestamp6,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS AttributeTimestamp7, Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS AttributeTimestamp8,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS AttributeTimestamp9, Line.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS AttributeTimestamp10,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS AttributeNumber1, Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS AttributeNumber2,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3 AS AttributeNumber3, Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4 AS AttributeNumber4,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS AttributeNumber5, Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER6 AS AttributeNumber6,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER7 AS AttributeNumber7, Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER8 AS AttributeNumber8,
       Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER9 AS AttributeNumber9, Line.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER10 AS AttributeNumber10,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS GlobalAttributeCategory, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE1 AS GlobalAttribute1,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE2 AS GlobalAttribute2, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE3 AS GlobalAttribute3,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE4 AS GlobalAttribute4, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE5 AS GlobalAttribute5,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE6 AS GlobalAttribute6, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE7 AS GlobalAttribute7,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE8 AS GlobalAttribute8, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE9 AS GlobalAttribute9,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE10 AS GlobalAttribute10, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE11 AS GlobalAttribute11,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE12 AS GlobalAttribute12, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE13 AS GlobalAttribute13,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE14 AS GlobalAttribute14, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE15 AS GlobalAttribute15,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE16 AS GlobalAttribute16, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE17 AS GlobalAttribute17,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE18 AS GlobalAttribute18, Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE19 AS GlobalAttribute19,
       Line.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE20 AS GlobalAttribute20, Line.FROM_HEADER_ID AS FromHeaderId, Line.CONTRACT_ID AS ContractId,
       Line.WORK_ORDER_PRODUCT, Line.MAX_RETAINAGE_AMOUNT AS MaxRetainageAmount,
       CategoryPEO.CATEGORY_NAME AS CategoryName, BaseModelPEO.ITEM_NUMBER AS BaseModelItemNumber,
       BaseModelPEO.DESCRIPTION AS BaseModelDescription, BlanketDocStyle.DISPLAY_NAME AS BlanketStyleDisplayName,
       ContractDocStyle.DISPLAY_NAME AS ContractStyleDisplayName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_org_amount_display(Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                       Line.QUANTITY, Line.UNIT_PRICE, Line.AMOUNT,
                       SourceHdr.CURRENCY_CODE) AS OrgAmountBeforeCanDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_cancelled_amount_display(Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                       Line.CO_QUANTITY_CANCELLED, Line.UNIT_PRICE,
                       Line.CO_AMOUNT_CANCELLED) AS CancelledAmountDisplay, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('AMOUNT_CALC') AS AmountCalc,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_total_tax(Line.PO_LINE_ID, 'LINES') AS TotalTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('RECOVERABLETAX_DISPLAY') AS RecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('NONRECOVERABLETAX_DISPLAY') AS NonRecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('RECOVERABLEINCLUSIVETAX_DISPLAY') AS RecoverableInclusiveTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('NONRECOVERABLEINCLUSIVETAX_DISPLAY') AS NonRecoverableInclTaxDisplay, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_amount_display AS AmountDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.format_price(Line.UNIT_PRICE) AS FormattedUnitPrice,
       DECODE(Line.CANCEL_FLAG,
         'Y', 'CANCELLED',
         DECODE(Line.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)) AS LineStatus,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(NVL(Line.BASE_MODEL_PRICE,
                                             0)) AS BaseModelPriceDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_requester_name(NULL,
                       Line.PO_LINE_ID, 'DRAFT', '0') AS Requester,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_lines(Line.PO_HEADER_ID,
                       Line.PO_LINE_ID, Line.ITEM_ID, Item.ORGANIZATION_ID,
                       NVL(Line.FROM_HEADER_ID, Line.CONTRACT_ID), Line.FROM_LINE_ID) AS Attachments,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_draft_config_component_xml(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                       PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID,
                       Line.PO_HEADER_ID) AS ctodata,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINE') AS TextAttachmentsContent, LineType.LINE_TYPE AS "LineType2", Line.LIST_PRICE AS BasePrice,
       PoDiscountTypeLookup.DISPLAYED_FIELD AS DiscountType, Line.DISCOUNT AS Discount, Line.DISCOUNT_REASON AS DiscountReason,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.format_price(Line.LIST_PRICE) AS BasePriceDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_po_discount(Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                       Line.DISCOUNT_TYPE, Line.DISCOUNT) AS DiscountDisplay ,NVL(zx.ipi_tax_rate,
                                                                                0) ipi_tax_rate ,NVL(zx.ipi_tax_amt,

                                                                                                   0) ipi_tax_amt ,
       (Line.QUANTITY * Line.list_PRICE) total_linha_list ,(Line.QUANTITY * Line.unit_PRICE) total_linha_unit
FROM PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL LINE, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL SourceHdr,
                        PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL BlanketHdr, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL ContractHdr,
                        PO_HAZARD_CLASSES_VL HazardClass, PO_UN_NUMBERS_VL UnNumber,
                        PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL SourceDocStyle, PO_LINE_TYPES_VL LineType,
                        INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                        PO_LINES_ALL SourceLine, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL CategoryPEO,
                        EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL BaseModelPEO, PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                        PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL BlanketDocStyle, PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL ContractDocStyle,
                        PO_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES_DRAFT DraftAttributeValuePEO, PO_LOOKUP_CODES PoDiscountTypeLookup,

  (SELECT zx.tax_rate ipi_tax_rate, sum(zx.tax_amt) ipi_tax_amt, pla.po_line_id, pha.po_header_id
   FROM zx_lines zx, po_headers_all pha, po_lines_all pla,
        po_line_locations_all plla
   WHERE pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
     AND pla.po_line_id = plla.po_Line_id
     AND zx.entity_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER'
     AND zx.trx_id = pha.po_header_id
     AND zx.trx_line_id = plla.line_location_id
     AND zx.tax_regime_code = 'IPI REGIME'
   GROUP BY zx.tax_rate, pla.po_line_id, pha.po_header_id) zx
WHERE Line.LINE_TYPE_ID = LineType.LINE_TYPE_ID
  AND Line.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.HAZARD_CLASS_ID = HazardClass.HAZARD_CLASS_ID(+)
  AND Line.UN_NUMBER_ID = UnNumber.UN_NUMBER_ID(+)
  AND Line.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND SourceHdr.style_id = SourceDocStyle.STYLE_ID
  AND SourceHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = SourceDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE
  AND Line.FROM_HEADER_ID = BlanketHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.CONTRACT_ID = ContractHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.FROM_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND Line.CATEGORY_ID = CategoryPEO.CATEGORY_ID(+)
  AND Line.BASE_MODEL_ID = BaseModelPEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND BlanketHdr.style_id = BlanketDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND BlanketHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = BlanketDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND ContractHdr.style_id = ContractDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND ContractHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = ContractDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID = DraftAttributeValuePEO.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND Line.discount_type = PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_code(+)
  AND PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_DISCOUNT_TYPE'
  AND Line.po_line_id = zx.po_line_id(+)
  AND Line.po_header_id = zx.po_header_id(+)
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM
```

```sql
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_po_discount(Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                       Line.DISCOUNT_TYPE, Line.DISCOUNT) AS DiscountDisplay ,NVL(zx.ipi_tax_rate,
                                                                                0) ipi_tax_rate ,NVL(zx.ipi_tax_amt,

                                                                                                   0) ipi_tax_amt ,
       (Line.QUANTITY * Line.list_PRICE) total_linha_list ,(Line.QUANTITY * Line.unit_PRICE) total_linha_unit
FROM PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL LINE, PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL PoHdr,
                          PO_UN_NUMBERS_VL UnNumber, PO_HAZARD_CLASSES_VL HazardClass,
                          PO_LINE_TYPES_VL LineType, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                          EGP_CATEGORIES_VL CategoryPEO, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM, PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                                                                  PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL BlanketHdr,
                                                                                                  PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL ContractHdr,
                                                                                                  EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL BaseModelPEO,
                                                                                                  PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                                                  PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL BlanketDocStyle,
                                                                                                  PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL ContractDocStyle,
                                                                                                  PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL BlanketLine,
                                                                                                  PO_ATTR_VALUES_ARCHIVE ArchivedAttributePEO,
                                                                                                  PO_LOOKUP_CODES PoDiscountTypeLookup,

  (SELECT zx.tax_rate ipi_tax_rate, sum(zx.tax_amt) ipi_tax_amt, pla.po_line_id, pha.po_header_id
   FROM zx_lines zx, po_headers_all pha, po_lines_all pla,
        po_line_locations_all plla
   WHERE pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
     AND pla.po_line_id = plla.po_Line_id
     AND zx.entity_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER'
     AND zx.trx_id = pha.po_header_id
     AND zx.trx_line_id = plla.line_location_id
     AND zx.tax_regime_code = 'IPI REGIME'
   GROUP BY zx.tax_rate, pla.po_line_id, pha.po_header_id) zx
WHERE Line.LINE_TYPE_ID = LineType.LINE_TYPE_ID
  AND Line.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.HAZARD_CLASS_ID = HazardClass.HAZARD_CLASS_ID(+)
  AND Line.UN_NUMBER_ID = UnNumber.UN_NUMBER_ID(+)
  AND Line.PO_HEADER_ID = PoHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.CATEGORY_ID = CategoryPEO.CATEGORY_ID(+)
  AND Line.FROM_HEADER_ID = BlanketHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND 9999999 = BlanketHdr.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND Line.BASE_MODEL_ID = BaseModelPEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Line.CONTRACT_ID = ContractHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND 9999999 = ContractHdr.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND PoHdr.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND PoHdr.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND Line.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND (Line.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_line_locations_archive_all sa1
                   WHERE sa1.po_line_id = Line.po_line_id
                     AND sa1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND sa1.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999
                     AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999)
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_distributions_archive_all da1
                   WHERE da1.po_line_id = Line.po_line_id
                     AND da1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND da1.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999
                     AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999))))
  AND BlanketHdr.style_id = BlanketDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND BlanketHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = BlanketDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND ContractHdr.style_id = ContractDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND ContractHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = ContractDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND Line.FROM_LINE_ID = BlanketLine.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND 9999999 = BlanketLine.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND BlanketLine.PO_LINE_ID = ArchivedAttributePEO.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND 9999999 = ArchivedAttributePEO.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND Line.discount_type = PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_code(+)
  AND PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_DISCOUNT_TYPE'
  AND Line.po_line_id = zx.po_line_id(+)
  AND Line.po_header_id = zx.po_header_id(+)
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM
```

### Query #32

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL , PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1 AS BANCO ,
       SUBSTR(PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1, 1, 3) AS COD_BANCO ,
       regexp_replace(LPAD(XEV.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 14),
         '([0-9]{2})([0-9]{3})([0-9]{3})([0-9]{4})', '\1.\2.\3/\4-') AS CNPJ_MATRIZ
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'anmDadosBancarios'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN XLE_ESTABLISHMENT_V XEV ON substr(ESTABLISHMENT_NAME,
                                       1, 7) = substr(LOC.LOCATION_CODE,
                                                 1, 4) || '001'
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #33

**Tags:** `FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, SYSDATE, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, LE_CTE, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_USERS...`

```sql
WITH le_cte AS
  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id, xep.NAME, haou.organization_id AS le_organization_id,
          haou.organization_code AS le_organization_code
   FROM xle_entity_profiles xep
   JOIN hr_all_organization_units_f haou ON xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
   JOIN xle_registrations_v xrv ON xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
   WHERE haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id))
SELECT papf.person_number , ppnf.nome , hire.data_contratacao , hire.dias_admissao ,
       hire.flag_atualizacao_hire , paf.data_mudanca_endereco , paf.ultima_mudanca_endereco ,
       paf.flag_atualizacao_endereco , trans.flag_atualizacao_trans , trans.data_transferencia ,
       trans.dias_transferencia , paam.modeloDeTrabalho , cpf.cpf_numero ,
       CASE
           WHEN le.le_organization_code LIKE 'BRA00%' THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(le.le_organization_code,
                                                                       'BRA00', '')) ELSE NULL
       END AS CODCOLIGADA , le.NAME AS EMPRESA , paam.chapa , paam.organization_id ,
       email.email_address AS USERNAME , paf.rua , paf.complemento , paf.bairro , paf.cep , paf.cidade , paf.estado ,
       CASE WHEN ppttl.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'CLT - Docente' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END docente,
       to_char(CASE
                   WHEN trans.flag_atualizacao_trans = 'Y' THEN CASE
                                                                    WHEN SYSDATE <= TO_DATE(trans.data_transferencia,

                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD') + 30 THEN TO_DATE(trans.data_transferencia,

                                                                                                                'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                                                    ELSE CASE
                                                                             WHEN EXTRACT(DAY
                                                                                          FROM SYSDATE) <= 10 THEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                           1),

                                                                                                                     'MM')
                                                                             ELSE TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,

                                                                                          2),

                                                                                    'MM')
                                                                         END
                                                                END
                   WHEN hire.flag_atualizacao_hire = 'Y' THEN CASE
                                                                  WHEN SYSDATE <= TO_DATE(hire.data_contratacao,

                                                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD') + 15 THEN TO_DATE(hire.data_contratacao,

                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                                                  ELSE CASE
                                                                           WHEN EXTRACT(DAY
                                                                                        FROM SYSDATE) <= 10 THEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                         1),

                                                                                                                   'MM')
                                                                           ELSE TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,

                                                                                        2),

                                                                                  'MM')
                                                                       END
                                                              END
                   ELSE CASE
                            WHEN EXTRACT(DAY
                                         FROM SYSDATE) <= 10 THEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,
                                                                          1),
                                                                    'MM') ELSE TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,

                                                                                       2),

                                                                                 'MM')
                        END
               END, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATA_VIGENCIA ,NVL(paam.diasUteis,
                                                      22) AS DIAS_UTEIS
FROM
  (SELECT person_id , person_number , mailing_address_id , PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM per_all_people_f
   WHERE (:p_person_number IS NULL
          OR person_number = :p_person_number)) papf
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id , display_name AS nome ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE name_type = 'GLOBAL') ppnf ON (papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
                                        AND ppnf.rn = 1)
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id , ASSIGNMENT_ID , legal_entity_id , establishment_id , organization_id ,
          PERSON_TYPE_ID ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn ,
          CASE WHEN ASS_ATTRIBUTE8 = 'Teletrabalho' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END modeloDeTrabalho , REPLACE(ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,
                                   'E', '') AS chapa ,
          ass_attribute21 diasUteis
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assignment_type = 'E') paam ON (papf.person_id = paam.person_id
                                         AND paam.rn = 1)
JOIN
  (SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID , person_id , EFFECTIVE_START_DATE ,
          TO_CHAR(effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS data_contratacao , (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(effective_start_date)) AS dias_admissao ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn ,
          CASE
              WHEN (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(effective_start_date)) BETWEEN 1 AND 15 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END flag_atualizacao_hire
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND action_code IN ('HIRE','REHIRE', 'ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION')) hire ON (paam.person_id = hire.person_id
                                                                                           AND hire.rn = 1)
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID , person_id , EFFECTIVE_START_DATE ,
          TO_CHAR(effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS data_transferencia , (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(effective_start_date)) AS dias_transferencia ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn ,
          CASE
              WHEN (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(effective_start_date)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END flag_atualizacao_trans
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND action_code IN ('GLB_TRANSFER', 'GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE', 'GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY',
                         'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE',
                         'ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO', 'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO')) trans ON (paam.person_id = trans.person_id
                                                                                                      AND trans.rn = 1)
JOIN
  (SELECT TO_CHAR(last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') data_mudanca_endereco ,
          (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(last_update_date)) ultima_mudanca_endereco ,
          CASE
              WHEN (TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(last_update_date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END flag_atualizacao_endereco ,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY address_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn , address_id , ADDRESS_LINE_1 rua ,
          ADDRESS_LINE_3 complemento , ADDRESS_LINE_4 bairro , POSTAL_CODE cep ,
          TOWN_OR_CITY cidade , REGION_2 AS estado
   FROM per_addresses_f) paf ON (paf.address_id = papf.mailing_address_id
                                 AND paf.rn = 1)
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id ,
          REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') cpf_numero
   FROM per_national_identifiers cpf
   WHERE cpf.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
     AND cpf.legislation_code(+) = 'BR') cpf ON (cpf.person_id = papf.person_id)
INNER JOIN le_cte le ON le.le_organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id , USERNAME
   FROM per_users
   WHERE (:p_user IS NULL
          OR UPPER(USERNAME) = UPPER(:p_user))) pu ON (pu.person_id = papf.person_id)
JOIN per_person_types_tl ppttl ON (ppttl.PERSON_TYPE_ID = paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID
                                   AND ppttl.SOURCE_LANG IN ('PTB')
                                   AND ppttl.LANGUAGE IN ('PTB'))
JOIN
  (SELECT pea.person_id , pea.email_type , pea.email_address , pea.last_update_date ,
          pea.email_address_id
   FROM per_email_addresses pea) email ON email.email_address_id = papf.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID
WHERE papf.rn = 1
  AND ROWNUM = 1
ORDER BY papf.person_number, nome
```

### Query #34

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, FIN - Tax & Legal, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_LOCATIONS, PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F, BEN_PRTT_RT_VAL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, HR_ORGANIZATION_V...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID, BEN.PERSON_ID,

  (SELECT DISTINCT FLV.MEANING
   FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES FLV
   WHERE FLV.LOOKUP_CODE = OPT.CARRIER_OPT_NAME
     AND FLV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ANM_BEN_ESTIPULANTE'
     AND FLV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND TO_CHAR(FLV.END_DATE_ACTIVE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31') Estipulante, OPT.CARRIER_OPT_NAME AS APOLICE, PEO.PERSON_NUMBER,
                BPF.NAME InsuranceName, BPF.PL_ID InsuranceId, BPT.NAME BenefitName,
                CASE WHEN :p_adesao = '1' THEN '☒' ELSE '☐'
                END TABELA_ADESAO,
                CASE WHEN :p_alteracao = '1' THEN '☒' ELSE '☐'
                END TABELA_ALTERACAO,
                CASE WHEN :p_cancelamento = '1' THEN '☒' ELSE '☐'
                END TABELA_CANCELAMENTO, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                                           'DD/MM/YYYY') AS SYS_DATE,
                BPT.PL_TYP_ID BenefitTypeId, HRL.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE AS LOCATION_CODE,
                HRL.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS LOC_AD_LINE1, HRL.ADDRESS_LINE_2 AS LOC_AD_LINE2,
                HRL.ADDRESS_LINE_4 AS LOC_AD_LINE3, HRL.ADDRESS_LINE_3 AS LOC_AD_LINE4,
                HRL.POSTAL_CODE AS LOC_POSTAL_CODE, HRL.REGION_2 AS LOC_REGION, HRL.TOWN_OR_CITY AS LOC_CITY,
                HRL.LOC_INFORMATION15 AS LOC_ADINFO, EMP.NAME LegalEntityName, EMP.ORGANIZATION_CODE LegalEntityCode,

  (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
                                                                 3, 3) || '.' || SUBSTR(REGISTRATION_NUMBER,

                                                                                   6,
                                                                                   3) || '/' || SUBSTR(REGISTRATION_NUMBER,

                                                                                                  9,
                                                                                                  4) || '-' || SUBSTR(REGISTRATION_NUMBER,

                                                                                                                 13,
                                                                                                                 2)
   FROM XLE_LE_FROM_REGISTRATIONS XFR
   WHERE XFR.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = EMP.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID) AS CNPJ,

  (SELECT PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI3
   WHERE BEN.PERSON_ID = PNI3.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'CPF') AS CPF, NAM.DISPLAY_NAME DisplayName,
                NVL(NAM.FULL_NAME,
                      (SELECT NAM2.FULL_NAME
                       FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM2
                       WHERE ((BEN.PERSON_ID = NAM2.PERSON_ID)
                              AND (TO_CHAR(NAM2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                     'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                              AND (NAM2.NAME_TYPE = 'BR')))) FullName,
                (NAM.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || NAM.MIDDLE_NAMES || ' ' || NAM.LAST_NAME) GeneratedName, PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_1, PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_2, PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_3,
                PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_4, PPAV.TOWN_OR_CITY, PPAV.REGION_2, PPAV.COUNTRY, PPAV.POSTAL_CODE
FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN
INNER JOIN BEN_PL_F BPF ON BEN.PL_ID = BPF.PL_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(BPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                             TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(BPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                       TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1)
LEFT JOIN BEN_OPT_F opt ON OPT.OPT_ID = BEN.OPT_ID
LEFT JOIN BEN_PRTT_RT_VAL BVAL ON BVAL.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
AND BVAL.RATE_DISPLAY_CD = 'P'
INNER JOIN BEN_PL_TYP_F BPT ON BPF.PL_TYP_ID = BPT.PL_TYP_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(BPT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                             TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND NVL(BPT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                       TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1)
INNER JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ASG ON ((BEN.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ASG.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
                                         AND (ASG.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C'))
                                         AND (TO_CHAR(ASG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                                         AND (ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM ON ((BEN.PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID)
                                     AND (TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                            'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                                     AND (NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'))
LEFT JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_V EMP ON ((ASG.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = EMP.ORGANIZATION_ID)
                                    AND (TO_CHAR(EMP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                           'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                                    AND (EMP.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'))
LEFT JOIN HR_LOCATIONS HRL ON ((HRL.LOCATION_ID = ASG.LOCATION_ID)
                               AND (TO_CHAR(ASG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                      'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PEO ON ((BEN.PERSON_ID = PEO.PERSON_ID)
                                   AND (TO_CHAR(PEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                          'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON ((PEO.PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV ON ((PEO.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID)
                                          AND (TO_CHAR(PPAV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND BPT.NAME LIKE '%Seguro%de%Vida%'
  AND BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = NVL(:P_BEN_ID,
                                BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID)
  AND (BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD NOT IN ('BCKDT', 'VOIDD')
       OR BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL)
  AND TO_CHAR(BEN.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND (BEN.INTERIM_FLAG NOT IN ('Y'))
  AND PEO.PERSON_NUMBER = NVL(:p_person_number, PEO.PERSON_NUMBER)
  AND BEN.PERSON_ID = NVL(:P_PERSON_ID, BEN.PERSON_ID)
  AND BPF.NAME IN ('SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE: Capital Uniforme de 31 mil', 'SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE: Capital limitado a 1,5 Milhão',
                   'SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE - APRENDIZ', 'SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE: Capital limitado a 3 Milhão',
                   'SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE: Capital Uniforme de 6 mil', 'SEGURO DE VIDA - METLIFE - COMPULSÓRIO')
  AND TO_CHAR(OPT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
```

## FIN - Projects

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Projects, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT X.*, COUNT(1) OVER() AS TOTAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                           ORDER BY X.PO_LINE_ID) RNUM
   FROM
     (SELECT DISTINCT HOUFTR.NAME REQ,pha.segment1 po,PHA.ATTRIBUTE1 REF,
                                                                     PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                                     pha.CURRENCY_CODE moeda,
                                                                     PDSH.STYLE_NAME,PLA.LINE_NUM N,
                                                                     ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER ITEM,
                                                                     PLTB.LINE_TYPE_CODE TYPE,
                                                                                         PLA.UOM_CODE UOM,
                                                                                         PLA.UNIT_PRICE PRICE,
                                                                                         TO_CHAR(PLLA.NEED_BY_DATE,

                                                                                           'RRRR/MM/DD') NEED_BY_DATE,
                                                                                         TO_CHAR(PLLA.PROMISED_DATE,

                                                                                           'RRRR/MM/DD') PROMISED_DATE,
                                                                                         PLA.QUANTITY QT_PLA,
                                                                                         ps.vendor_name FORNECEDOR,

        (SELECT SEGMENT1
         FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B
         WHERE PROJECT_ID = PDA.PJC_PROJECT_ID
           AND rownum=1)PROJ,
                                                                                         HLAB.LOCATION_NAME BILL_TO_LOCATION,
                                                                                         HLAS.LOCATION_NAME SHIP_TO_LOCATION,

        (SELECT DISTINCT ppf.DISPLAY_NAME
         FROM per_person_names_f ppf
         WHERE ppf.PERSON_ID = pha.agent_id
           AND rownum = 1) comprador,

        (SELECT pha1.segment1
         FROM po_headers_all pha1
         WHERE pha1.po_header_id = pla.FROM_HEADER_ID) acordo,
                                                                                         GCC.SEGMENT1 AS EMPRESA,
                                                                                         GCC.SEGMENT2 AS BU,
                                                                                         GCC.SEGMENT3 AS CR,
                                                                                         TO_CHAR(PHA.CREATION_DATE,

                                                                                           'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CREATION_DATE,
                                                                                         PLA.PO_LINE_ID
      FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,PO_LINES_ALL PLA,PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA,
           PO_LINE_TYPES_B PLTB,PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS PDSH,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB,
           INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HOUFTR,POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS,
           PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA,HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HLAS,HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HLAB,
           GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
      WHERE PLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND PLLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
        AND PLTB.LINE_TYPE_ID = PLA.LINE_TYPE_ID
        AND PDSH.STYLE_ID = PHA.STYLE_ID
        AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD'
        AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND HOUFTR.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.REQ_BU_ID
        AND NVL(PHA.CANCEL_FLAG, 'N') ='N'
        AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELED','INCOMPLETE')
        AND PS.VENDOR_ID = PHA.VENDOR_ID
        AND PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
        AND HLAS.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
        AND HLAB.LOCATION_ID = PHA.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID
        AND PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
        AND PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) X)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((:P_LIMIT * (:P_PAGE - 1)) + 1) AND ((:P_LIMIT * (:P_PAGE - 1)) + :P_LIMIT)
```
