### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, FIN - Projects, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PJF_TASKS_V, PO_LINES_ALL, PJC_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Projects, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `PJC_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PJF_TASKS_V, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL, PO_LINES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID, PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,
       PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                     '-') - 1) AS NUMPEDIDO,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Partnumber, PDA.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID IdDistribuicao,

  (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
   FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
   WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
       (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
        FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
        WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
            (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
             FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
             WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
               AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
          AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) IdProjeto,

  (SELECT SUBSTR((PPAV.DESCRIPTION || ' || ' || PPAV.NAME), 1, 100)
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) DescricaoProjeto,

  (SELECT PTV.TASK_ID
   FROM PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE PTV.TASK_NUMBER = '3'
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) IdTarefa,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(PTV.DESCRIPTION, 1, 100)
   FROM PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE PTV.TASK_NUMBER = '3'
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) DescricaoTarefa, PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID IdCombinacaoContabil,
       PDA.QUANTITY_ORDERED PercentualDistribuicao, 'CUSTOS_IMPORTACAO' Flexfield1,
                                                                        TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,

                                                                          'DD/MM/RRRR HH24:MI:SS') Flexfield2,

  (SELECT PPAV.PROJECT_UNIT_ID
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield3, '3' Flexfield4,

  (SELECT HAOU.NAME
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_UNIT_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield5,
                                     NVL(
                                           (SELECT PPAV.ATTRIBUTE1
                                            FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
                                            WHERE 1 = 1
                                              AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
                                                (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
                                                 FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
                                                 WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
                                                     (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
                                                      FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
                                                      WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                                                          (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                                                           FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                                                           WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                             AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
                                                        AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                                   AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
                                              AND ROWNUM = 1), GCC.SEGMENT5) Flexfield6,

  (SELECT PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTV
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield7,

  (SELECT CASE WHEN PRH.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE IN ('MAXIMO') THEN PRL.ATTRIBUTE1
          END PRWO
   FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRH, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRD,
        PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA, PO_HEADERS_ALL POH
   WHERE PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
     AND PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRD.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRD.DISTRIBUTION_ID = PDA.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID
     AND PDA.PO_HEADER_ID = POH.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PDA.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
   GROUP BY PRH.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE, PRL.ATTRIBUTE1) Flexfield8,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(('STATUS_PROJETO: ' || PPAV.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE || ' || INICIO_PRJ: ' || TO_CHAR(PPAV.START_DATE,

                                                                                            'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_PRJ: ' || TO_CHAR(PPAV.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                  'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || INICIO_TRF: ' || TO_CHAR(PTV.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                           'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_TRF: ' || TO_CHAR(PTV.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/RRRR')), 1, 250) FLEX_FIELD_9
   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE PTV.PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.TASK_NUMBER = '3'
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield9,

  (SELECT SUBSTR('DISP: ' || PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_NAME || ' || INICIO_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.START_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                             'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || COBRAVEL: ' || PTC.CHARGEABLE_FLAG || ' || FATURAVEL: ' || PTC.BILLABLE_FLAG, 1, 250)
   FROM PJC_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS PTC, PJF_TASKS_V PTV, PJF_EXP_CATEGORIES_TL PECT,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE PTC.PROJECT_ID = PTV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTC.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID = PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID
     AND PECT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PTC.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.TASK_NUMBER = '3'
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID IN
       (SELECT PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
        FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
        WHERE PDA2.PO_LINE_ID =
            (SELECT PLA2.PO_LINE_ID
             FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA2
             WHERE PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID =
                 (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                  FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2
                  WHERE PHA2.SEGMENT1 = PLA.ATTRIBUTE1
                    AND PLA.ATTRIBUTE3 = PHA2.REQ_BU_ID)
               AND PLA2.LINE_NUM = (PLA.ATTRIBUTE2))
          AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield10, GCC.SEGMENT8 CENTROCUSTO,
                                     GCC.SEGMENT3 ProfitCenter,
                                     SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                                       LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA,
     PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2
WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PDA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID(+)
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `FIN - Projects, CX & CRM, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ZCA_REF_ENTITIES, HR_OPERATING_UNITS, MKT_REF_ENTITIES, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, FIN - Projects, CX & CRM, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ZCA_REF_ENTITIES, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS, MKT_REF_ENTITIES, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B, PO_HEADERS_ALL, HR_OPERATING_UNITS`

```sql
SELECT PLA.PRC_BU_ID, PHA.SEGMENT1 CONTRACT_NUMBER, PLA.LINE_NUM CONTRACT_LINE_NUMBER,
       PHA.CURRENCY_CODE "CURRENCY_CODE", CASE
                                              WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                                          END ATT5,
       CASE WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL THEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5
           WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL
                AND PHA.CURRENCY_CODE = 'BRL' THEN
                  (SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN2'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN2'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN1'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 BU_BRASIL
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN1'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003')
           WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL
                AND PHA.CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                AND :P_PROJECT_NUMBER IS NULL THEN
                  (SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN2'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN2'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN1'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004 BU_CAYMAN
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN1'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003')
           WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL
                AND PHA.CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                AND :P_PROJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
                AND
                  (SELECT PPTB.PROJECT_TYPE
                   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PPAB, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTB
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND PPAB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPTB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
                     AND PPAB.SEGMENT1 = :P_PROJECT_NUMBER) LIKE '%CAPEX%' THEN
                  (SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005 BU_AUSTRIA
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005 BU_AUSTRIA
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA NOT IN ('ODN1', 'ODN2')
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005 BU_AUSTRIA
                   FROM ZCA_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA
                     AND :P_SONDA = 'ODN2'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = 'MEA003'
                   UNION ALL SELECT EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005 BU_AUSTRIA
                   FROM MKT_REF_ENTITIES
                   WHERE ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                     AND EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001 = :P_SONDA

                     AND PPAB.SEGMENT1 = :P_PROJECT_NUMBER) LIKE '%CAPEX%' THEN 'AT'
           WHEN PHA.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL
                AND PHA.CURRENCY_CODE <> 'BRL'
                AND :P_PROJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
                AND
                  (SELECT PPTB.PROJECT_TYPE
                   FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PPAB, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTB
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND PPAB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPTB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
                     AND PPAB.SEGMENT1 = :P_PROJECT_NUMBER) LIKE '%OPEX%' THEN 'KY'
       END BU_COUNTRY
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.SEGMENT1 = NVL(:P_CONTRACT_NUMBER, PHA.SEGMENT1)
  AND PLA.LINE_NUM = NVL(:P_CONTRACT_LINE_NUMBER, PLA.LINE_NUM)
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'BLANKET'
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND NVL(PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS, 'OPEN') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'FINALLY CLOSED')
  AND NVL(PHA.END_DATE, SYSDATE + 1) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND PHA.APPROVED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND PLA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HAOU.NAME = NVL(:P_PRC_BU, PLA.PRC_BU_ID)
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
    (SELECT PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
     FROM PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA
     WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `FIN - Projects, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PJF_EXP_TYPES_TL, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B, PJF_EXP_TYPES_B`

### Query #4

**Tags:** `FIN - Projects, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B, PJF_EXP_TYPES_TL, PJF_EXP_TYPES_B`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PPA.NAME "PROJECT_NAME",
                CASE WHEN :V_TASKID IS NOT NULL THEN PTV.TASK_NAME
                END "TASK_NAME",

  (SELECT PL.COUNTRY
   FROM PER_LOCATIONS PL
   WHERE PL.LOCATION_ID = HRU.LOCATION_ID) "COUNTRY", PPTB.ENABLE_CAPITALIZATION_FLAG "ENABLE_CAPITALIZATION_FLAG",
                PPTB.ATTRIBUTE1 "Project_Type_Attribute1",

  (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1
   FROM PJF_EXP_TYPES_B
   WHERE EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID IN
       (SELECT PETT.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
        FROM PJF_EXP_TYPES_TL PETT
        WHERE PETT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
          AND UPPER(TRIM(PETT.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(:V_EXPENDTYPE)))) "Expense_Type_Attribute1"
FROM PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_B PPAB, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPA, PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_TL PPAT,PJF_TASKS_V PTV,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HRU,PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_B PPTB
WHERE 1=1
  AND PPAB.PROJECT_ID = PPA.PROJECT_ID
  AND PPA.PROJECT_ID=PPAT.PROJECT_ID
  AND PPAB.PROJECT_ID=PTV.PROJECT_ID
  AND PPAB.ORG_ID=HRU.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
  AND PPAB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPTB.PROJECT_TYPE_ID(+)
  AND PPAT.LANGUAGE ='US'
  AND PPA.SEGMENT1 = :V_PROJECTID
  AND PTV.TASK_NUMBER = NVL(:V_TASKID, PTV.TASK_NUMBER)
```

## SCM - Purchasing

### Query #1

## SCM - Purchasing

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `RCV_TRANSACTIONS, PER_USERS`

```sql
SELECT hre.name legal_entity_name, iop.legal_entity_id, fabu.bu_name, pha.po_header_id, iop.organization_code,
       egi.item_number, pla.item_description, rsh.receipt_num, CFDH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER NF,
       cfdh.document_type, psv.vendor_name, PDA.destination_type_code type_code_PDA,
       rcv1.primary_quantity received_quantity, rcv1.primary_uom_code, pla.unit_price po_unit_price, rcv1.amount_billed,
       to_char(rcv1.transaction_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy') transaction_date, pha.segment1 po_number, pla.line_num po_line_num, pla.uom_code po_uom_code,
       pla.quantity po_quantity, rcv1.transaction_id,

  (SELECT person_id
   FROM PER_USERS
   WHERE username = 'OIC.INTEGRADOR') EmployeeId
FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS rcv1, inv_org_parameters iop, PO_HEADERS_ALL pha, PO_LINES_ALL pla,
     rcv_shipment_headers rsh, egp_system_items_vl egi, POZ_SUPPLIERS_v psv, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL,
     CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES FDS, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS CFDH,
     FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU, HR_LEGAL_ENTITIES hre
WHERE 1=1
  AND hre.legal_entity_id = iop.legal_entity_id
  AND hre.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = '4712-12-31'
  AND rcv1.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
  AND PLL.PO_LINE_ID = PDA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
  AND PDA.req_bu_id = FABU.bu_id
  AND rcv1.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
  AND rcv1.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND rcv1.shipment_header_id = rsh.shipment_header_id
  AND egi.inventory_item_id = pla.item_id
  AND egi.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND rsh.vendor_id = psv.vendor_id
  AND PLL.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLL.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = FDS.SOURCE_DOC_ID3
  AND FDS.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID = CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND FDS.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'PURCHASE_ORDER'
  AND rcv1.transaction_type = 'RECEIVE'
  AND hre.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND PDA.destination_type_code = 'EXPENSE'
  AND fabu.bu_name IN ('MEA007-MALHA DE GAS','SJB002-MALHA DE GAS','ITJ001-TKP CDI ESCRITORIO ITAJAI',
                       'ITJ002-TKO CDI BASE ITAJAI','RIO004-TKO PDL ESCRITORIO RIO',
                       'RIO005-TKP PDL ARMAZEM RIO','SGL001-OOG-TKP ARMAZEM PAPA TERRA','MEA004-OOG-TKP MACAE',
                       'SSZ001-TKO PDL ESCRITORIO SANTOS','SJB001-TKO CDI BASE SAO JOAO DA BARRA')
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS rcv2
     WHERE 1=1
       AND rcv2.transaction_type IN ('DELIVER','RETURN TO VENDOR')
       AND rcv2.SHIPMENT_LINE_ID = rcv1.SHIPMENT_LINE_ID)
ORDER BY iop.organization_code, rcv1.transaction_date, pha.segment1, pla.line_num
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, PER_USERS, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_X`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_X, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PER_USERS, RCV_TRANSACTIONS`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT 'RECEIVING' DestinationTypeCode, pos.line_num DocumentLineNumber, pos.po_num DocumentNumber,
                      rcv.po_line_location_id, pos.item_number ItemNumber,
                      to_char(rcv.PRIMARY_QUANTITY) PrimaryQuantity,

     (SELECT person_id
      FROM PER_USERS
      WHERE username = 'OIC.INTEGRADOR') EmployeeId, orgs.business_unit_name BusinessUnit,
                      orgs.organization_code OrganizationCode, to_char(rcv.QUANTITY) Quantity, rcv.UOM_CODE UOMCode,

     (SELECT UNIT_OF_MEASURE
      FROM INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL
      WHERE uom_code = rcv.UOM_CODE) UOMDescription, 'VENDOR' ReceiptSourceCode,
                                                              orgs.legal_entity_name SoldtoLegalEntity, 'PO' SourceDocumentCode,
                                                                                                             'DELIVER' TransactionType,
                                                                                                                       rcv.TRANSACTION_ID ParentTransactionId,
                                                                                                                       'CENTRAL' Subinventory,
                                                                                                                                 rcv.ROUTING_HEADER_ID
   FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS rcv,

     (SELECT DISTINCT hou.organization_id, hou.name organization_name,
                      iop.organization_code organization_code, Decode(hoi.status,
                                                                 'A', 'Y', 'N') inv_enabled_flag,
                      bu.bu_name business_unit_name, iop.business_unit_id business_unit_id,
                      iop.legal_entity_id legal_entity, hre.name legal_entity_name
      FROM hr_all_organization_units_x hou, hr_org_unit_classifications_x hoi, inv_org_parameters iop, gl_ledgers lgr,
           fun_all_business_units_v bu, HR_LEGAL_ENTITIES hre
      WHERE hou.organization_id = hoi.organization_id
        AND hou.organization_id = iop.organization_id
        AND hoi.classification_code = 'INV'
        AND bu.primary_ledger_id = lgr.ledger_id(+)
        AND lgr.object_type_code(+) = 'L'
        AND NVL(lgr.complete_flag, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND bu.bu_id(+) = iop.business_unit_id
        AND hre.legal_entity_id = iop.legal_entity_id) orgs,

     (SELECT ph.segment1 po_num, pl.line_num, pl.po_line_id, it.item_number, it.organization_id
      FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL ph, PO_LINES_ALL pl, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B it
      WHERE ph.po_header_id = pl.po_header_id
        AND it.inventory_item_id = pl.item_id) pos
   WHERE rcv.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RECEIVE'
     AND rcv.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'RCV'
     AND NOT EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS rcv2
        WHERE 1=1
          AND rcv2.PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID = rcv.transaction_id)
     AND orgs.organization_id = rcv.organization_id
     AND rcv.po_line_id = pos.po_line_id
     AND pos.organization_id = rcv.organization_id
   ORDER BY orgs.legal_entity_name, orgs.organization_code, pos.po_num , pos.line_num)
WHERE SOLDTOLEGALENTITY NOT IN ('CLIENT_A S.A','FORESEA S.A.')
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B`

```sql
SELECT PRH.REQUISITION_NUMBER REQUISICAO, PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRH, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES FLV
WHERE 1=1
  AND PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
  AND FLV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND FLV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIA_RELAT_REQUISICAO_ATR'
  AND FLV.LOOKUP_CODE= PRH.REQ_BU_ID
  AND PRH.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
  AND PRL.LINE_STATUS != 'CANCELED'
  AND PRL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >=:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE-1
  AND NOT PRL.ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'OK'
     FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIA_POR_ATRIBUIDO_POR'
       AND LOOKUP_CODE = PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
       AND TAG = PRL.ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID)
GROUP BY PRH.REQUISITION_NUMBER, PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID, TO_CHAR(PRL.last_update_date,
                                             'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_ATRIBUICAO,
                PRL.last_updated_by ATRIBUIDO_POR, PRL.ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID ID_COMPRADOR, PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
FROM POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL,

  (SELECT pap3.DISPLAY_NAME NAME, pap3.person_id
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F pap3
   WHERE pap3.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(xx.effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f xx
        WHERE xx.person_id = pap3.person_id)
     AND name_type = 'BR') PER
WHERE 1=1
  AND PRL.ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID = PER.PERSON_ID
  AND PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = :P_REQ_HEADER_ID
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'OK'
     FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CLIA_POR_ATRIBUIDO_POR'
       AND LOOKUP_CODE = PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
       AND TAG = PRL.ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID)
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PO_HEADERS_ALL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F`

```sql
SELECT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID ACORDO_ID, pha.segment1 ACORDO_ORACLE, pha.ATTRIBUTE4 NUM_CONTRATO,
       PHA.CREATION_DATE DATA_CRIACAO, ps.vendor_name NOME_FORNECEDOR,
       TO_CHAR(pha.START_DATE, 'DD-MM-YYYY') DATA_INICIO, TO_CHAR(pha.END_DATE,
                                                            'DD-MM-YYYY') DATA_TERMINO,
       PHA.CURRENCY_CODE MOEDA_ACORDO, LISTAGG(DISTINCT substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,
                                                          1, 6),
                                         ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (
                                                              ORDER BY substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,
                                                                         1, 6)) BU,
                                                             ppf.DISPLAY_NAME COMPRADOR,
                                                             PHA.APPROVED_DATE DATA_APROV,
                                                             PHA.AMOUNT_RELEASED VALOR_CONSUMIDO,
                                                             PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS STATUS_DOCUMENTO,
                                                             pha.COMMENTS Description,
                                                             ppf1.DISPLAY_NAME Gestor_contrato,
                                                             (LISTAGG(DISTINCT CASE
                                                                                   WHEN substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          6) IN ('MEA003',

                                                                                            'VIE004',
                                                                                            'VIE005',
                                                                                            'VIE006',
                                                                                            'VIE008',
                                                                                            'GCM010',
                                                                                            'LUX001',
                                                                                            'BEL001',
                                                                                            'RIO008',
                                                                                            'MEA006') THEN 'FORESEA'
                                                                                   WHEN substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          6) IN ('MEA001') THEN 'CLIENT_A_MSO'
                                                                                   WHEN substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          6) IN ('MEA002',

                                                                                            'GCM001') THEN 'CLIENT_A_UNP'
                                                                                   WHEN substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          6) IN ('GCM002',

                                                                                            'RIO001',
                                                                                            'VIE001',
                                                                                            'VIE002',
                                                                                            'RIO003',
                                                                                            'GCM001',
                                                                                            'VIE011',
                                                                                            'CGH001') THEN 'CLIENT_A_OD'
                                                                                   WHEN substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          6) IN ('MEA002',

                                                                                            'MEA005',
                                                                                            'VIX001',
                                                                                            'RIO007',
                                                                                            'VIE012',
                                                                                            'MEA007') THEN 'CLIENT_A_SUBSEA'
                                                                                   ELSE 'NÃO MAPEADO'
                                                                               END,
                                                                ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (
                                                                                     ORDER BY substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE,

                                                                                                1,
                                                                                                6))) AS UNIDADE_ORIGEM,
                                                             CASE
                                                                 WHEN trunc(pha.end_date) >= trunc(sysdate) THEN 'VIGENTE'
                                                                 ELSE 'VENCIDO'
                                                             END status_contrato,
                                                             PHA.AMOUNT_LIMIT VALOR_ACORDO,
                                                             pHA.MIN_RELEASE_AMOUNT VALOR_Min_LIBERACAO,
                                                             pha.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 VALOR_INICIAL_EBS
FROM po_headers_all pha, PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS pgoa, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V PS,

  (SELECT DISTINCT DISPLAY_NAME, PERSON_ID
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE) ppf, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABU,

  (SELECT DISTINCT DISPLAY_NAME, PERSON_ID
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE) ppf1
WHERE 1=1
  AND pha.po_header_id = pgoa.po_header_id
  AND FABU.BU_ID = pgoa.REQ_BU_ID
  AND PS.VENDOR_ID = pha.VENDOR_ID
  AND ppf.PERSON_ID(+) = pha.agent_id
  AND ppf1.PERSON_ID(+) = pha.attribute_number1
  AND pha.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE= 'BLANKET'
  AND pha.DOCUMENT_STATUS != 'INCOMPLETE'
  AND pha.DOCUMENT_STATUS != 'WITHDRAW'
  AND PGOA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND substr(FABU.SHORT_CODE, 1, 6) IN ('MEA001', 'MEA002', 'MEA003','GCM010', 'GCM001',
                                        'VIE004', 'VIE005','VIE006', 'VIE008', 'LUX001',
                                        'BEL001', 'RIO008', 'GCM002', 'RIO001', 'RIO007',
                                        'VIE012', 'VIE001', 'VIE002', 'RIO003', 'GCM005',
                                        'AMS001', 'RIO002', 'VIE011', 'MEA005', 'VIX001',
                                        'CGH001', 'MEA007')
GROUP BY PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, pha.segment1, pha.ATTRIBUTE4, PHA.CREATION_DATE, ps.vendor_name,
         pha.START_DATE, pha.END_DATE, PHA.CURRENCY_CODE, ppf.DISPLAY_NAME, PHA.APPROVED_DATE,
         PHA.AMOUNT_RELEASED, PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS, pha.COMMENTS, ppf1.DISPLAY_NAME,
         CASE WHEN trunc(pha.end_date) >= trunc(sysdate) THEN 'VIGENTE' ELSE 'VENCIDO'
         END, PHA.AMOUNT_LIMIT, pHA.MIN_RELEASE_AMOUNT, pha.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
       nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor,
       nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor_Alt,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(HPS.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END FLAGMIGRACAO, '' Codexternocfop, NULL AS Codfabricante,
                            TO_CHAR(PLLA.PROMISED_DATE,
                              'YYYYMMDD') Dataprevista,
                            CASE
                                WHEN NVL(:P_DESCRIPTION_ITEM_PO,
                                       'X') = 'ITEM_DA_ORDEM_DE_COMPRA' THEN REPLACE(PLA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION,

                                                                               ';',
                                                                               ',')
                                ELSE REPLACE(
                                               (SELECT ESIT.DESCRIPTION
                                                FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT
                                                WHERE ESIT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
                                                  AND ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID),';',
                                       ',')
                            END Descricao,
                            SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                              LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido, PHA.CURRENCY_CODE Moeda,
                            PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                     1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                          '-') - 1) AS Numpedido,

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, HR_LOCATIONS HL_AREANEGOCIO
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HL_AREANEGOCIO.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = HL_AREANEGOCIO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) ORGANIZACAO, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Partnumber,
                            NVL(
                                  (SELECT ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT
                                   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
                                   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                     AND ROWNUM = 1), 0) Pesoliquido, NULL Pnfabricante,
                                                                           PLA.UNIT_PRICE Precoliq,
                                                                           PLLA.QUANTITY Qtdpedido,
                                                                           CASE
                                                                               WHEN HR_REQ_BU.COUNTRY != 'BR' THEN CASE
                                                                                                                       WHEN NVL(PLA.CANCEL_FLAG,

                                                                                                                              '*') = 'Y'
                                                                                                                            OR NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,

                                                                                                                                 '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                                                                                       ELSE 'A'
                                                                                                                   END
                                                                               ELSE CASE
                                                                                        WHEN NVL(PLA.CANCEL_FLAG,

                                                                                               '*') = 'Y'
                                                                                             OR NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,

                                                                                                  '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                                                                        WHEN NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,

                                                                                               '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F'
                                                                                        ELSE 'A'
                                                                                    END
                                                                           END Status,

  (SELECT ESIB.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Unidadepeso,
                                                                           PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmeditempedido,
                                                                           PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmedpreco,
                                                                           PLA.PO_HEADER_ID Flexfield1,
                                                                           PLA.PO_LINE_ID Flexfield2,
                                                                           PHA.PRC_BU_ID Flexfield3,
                                                                           PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID Flexfield4,
                                                                           PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID Flexfield5,
                                                                           PLA.UOM_CODE Flexfield6, '' Flexfield7,
                                                                                                       PLA.LINE_NUM Flexfield8,
                                                                                                       PLLA.SHIPMENT_NUM Flexfield9,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                    'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) Flexfield10,
                                                                                                       PLA.ITEM_ID,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                    'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) PCATEGORIA,
                                                                                                       PLLA.PRICE_OVERRIDE,
                                                                                                       '' SERVICE_ITEM_UOM,
                                                                                                          '' SERVICE_ITEM_WEIGHT
FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, hr_locations hr_req_bu
WHERE PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
```

```sql
                AND ROWNUM = 1) , GCC.SEGMENT5) Flexfield6,

  (SELECT PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID

  (SELECT prl2.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PRWO
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRD2, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL2
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(('STATUS_PROJETO: ' || PPAV.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE || ' || INICIO_PRJ: ' || TO_CHAR(PPAV.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                           'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_TRF: ' || TO_CHAR(PTV.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/RRRR')), 1, 250) FLEX_FIELD_9
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PTV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.task_id = PDA2.PJC_task_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield9,

  (SELECT SUBSTR('DISP: ' || PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_NAME || ' || INICIO_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.START_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                             'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || COBRAVEL: ' || PTC.CHARGEABLE_FLAG || ' || FATURAVEL: ' || PTC.BILLABLE_FLAG, 1, 250)
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJC_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS PTC, PJF_TASKS_V PTV, PJF_EXP_CATEGORIES_TL PECT,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID = PDA2.PJC_task_id
     AND PTC.PROJECT_ID = PTV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTC.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID = PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID
     AND PECT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PTC.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield10, GCC.SEGMENT8 CENTROCUSTO, GCC.SEGMENT3 ProfitCenter,
       SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID, LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA,
     PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2
WHERE PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PDA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID(+)
```

```sql
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND ROWNUM = 1)IdProjeto,

  (SELECT ppav.segment1
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) nroProjeto,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(ppav.name, 1, 100)
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) DescricaoProjeto,

  (SELECT PTV.TASK_ID
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND ptv.task_id = PDA2.pjc_task_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) IdTarefa,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(NVL(PTV.DESCRIPTION, ptv.task_name), 1, 100)
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND ptv.task_id = PDA2.pjc_task_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) DescricaoTarefa, PDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID IdCombinacaoContabil,
       PDA.QUANTITY_ORDERED PercentualDistribuicao,

  (SELECT PETV.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_NAME
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2, PJF_EXP_TYPES_VL PETV
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PETV.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID = PDA2.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield1,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(PDA2.PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE, 'DD/MM/RRRR HH24  MI:SS')
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE IS NOT NULL
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield2,

  (SELECT PDA2.PJC_ORGANIZATION_ID
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE IS NOT NULL
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield3,

  (SELECT PETV.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2, PJF_EXP_TYPES_VL PETV
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PETV.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID = PDA2.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield4,

  (SELECT POEV.NAME
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_ORGANIZATIONS_EXPEND_V POEV
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND POEV.ORGANIZATION_ID = PDA2.PJC_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield5,
       NVL(
             (SELECT PPAV.ATTRIBUTE1
              FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2,
            PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
            PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
              WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
                AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,
                      NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,
                                                                           NULL,
                                                                           TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                           PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
                AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                      NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,

                                                                                  NULL,
                                                                                  TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID),
                                                                                  PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
                AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                                NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID),
                                                PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
                AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
                AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
                AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
                AND ROWNUM = 1) , GCC.SEGMENT5) Flexfield6,

  (SELECT PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_PROJECT_TYPES_VL PPTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PPTV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_TYPE_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield7,

  (SELECT prl2.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PRWO
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRD2, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL2
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID = PRD2.DISTRIBUTION_ID
     AND PRD2.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRL2.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
     AND PRL2.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'MAXIMO'
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield8,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(('STATUS_PROJETO: ' || PPAV.PROJECT_STATUS_CODE || ' || INICIO_PRJ: ' || TO_CHAR(PPAV.START_DATE,

                                                                                            'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_PRJ: ' || TO_CHAR(PPAV.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                  'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || INICIO_TRF: ' || TO_CHAR(PTV.START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                           'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_TRF: ' || TO_CHAR(PTV.COMPLETION_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/RRRR')), 1, 250) FLEX_FIELD_9
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV, PJF_TASKS_V PTV
   WHERE pha2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND DECODE(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PTV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.task_id = PDA2.PJC_task_id
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield9,

  (SELECT SUBSTR('DISP: ' || PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_NAME || ' || INICIO_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.START_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || FIM_CTR: ' || TO_CHAR(PTC.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                             'DD/MM/RRRR') || ' || COBRAVEL: ' || PTC.CHARGEABLE_FLAG || ' || FATURAVEL: ' || PTC.BILLABLE_FLAG, 1, 250)
   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA2, PO_LINES_ALL PLA2, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA2,
        PJC_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS PTC, PJF_TASKS_V PTV, PJF_EXP_CATEGORIES_TL PECT,
        PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL PPAV
   WHERE PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1, NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA2.PO_HEADER_ID), PHA2.SEGMENT1) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                     NULL,
                                                                                     TO_CHAR(PHA.PO_HEADER_ID),
                                                                                     PLA.ATTRIBUTE1)
     AND decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
           NULL, TO_CHAR(PLA2.PO_LINE_ID), TO_CHAR(PLA2.LINE_NUM)) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE2,
                                                                       NULL,
                                                                       TO_CHAR(PLA.PO_LINE_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE2)
     AND TO_CHAR(PHA2.REQ_BU_ID) = decode(PLA.ATTRIBUTE3,
                                     NULL, TO_CHAR(PHA.REQ_BU_ID), PLA.ATTRIBUTE3)
     AND PLA2.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA2.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PLA2.PO_LINE_ID = PDA2.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PDA2.PJC_PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID = PDA2.PJC_task_id
     AND PTC.PROJECT_ID = PTV.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTC.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID = PECT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID
     AND PECT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
     AND PPAV.PROJECT_ID = PTC.PROJECT_ID
     AND PTV.PROJECT_ID = PPAV.PROJECT_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Flexfield10, GCC.SEGMENT8 CENTROCUSTO, GCC.SEGMENT3 ProfitCenter,
       SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID, LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido
FROM po_headers_all pha, po_lines_all pla, po_line_locations_all plla,
     po_distributions_all pda, gl_code_combinations gcc, hr_all_organization_units haou,
     hr_all_organization_units haou2
WHERE pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
  AND pla.po_line_id = plla.po_line_id
  AND pla.po_line_id = pda.po_line_id
  AND plla.line_location_id = pda.line_location_id
  AND pha.po_header_id = pda.po_header_id
  AND pha.prc_bu_id = haou.organization_id
  AND pha.req_bu_id = haou2.organization_id
  AND pda.code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id(+)
  AND pda.po_distribution_id = :p_po_dist_id
```

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, EGP_MFG_PART_NUMBERS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL`

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_MFG_PART_NUMBERS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
       nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor,
       nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor_Alt,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(HPS.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END FLAGMIGRACAO, '' Codexternocfop,
                            CASE
                                WHEN NVL(:P_COMP_COD_PARCEIRO,
                                       'PARTY_SITE_ID') <> 'VENDOR_SITE_ID' THEN nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                   TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S'
                                ELSE nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,
                                       TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S'
                            END AS Codfabricante,
                            TO_CHAR(PLLA.PROMISED_DATE,
                              'YYYYMMDD') Dataprevista,
                            CASE
                                WHEN NVL(:P_DESCRIPTION_ITEM_PO,
                                       'X') = 'ITEM_DA_ORDEM_DE_COMPRA' THEN REPLACE(PLA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION,

                                                                               ';',
                                                                               ',')
                                ELSE REPLACE(
                                               (SELECT ESIT.DESCRIPTION
                                                FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT
                                                WHERE ESIT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
                                                  AND ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID),';',
                                       ',')
                            END Descricao,
                            SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                              LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido, PHA.CURRENCY_CODE Moeda,
                            PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                     1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                          '-') - 1) AS Numpedido,

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
   FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, HR_LOCATIONS HL_AREANEGOCIO
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HL_AREANEGOCIO.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = HL_AREANEGOCIO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) ORGANIZACAO, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Partnumber,
                            NVL(
                                  (SELECT ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT
                                   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
                                   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                     AND ROWNUM = 1), 0) Pesoliquido,

  (SELECT EMPN.MFG_PART_NUM
   FROM EGP_MFG_PART_NUMBERS EMPN
   WHERE EMPN.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Pnfabricante, PLA.UNIT_PRICE Precoliq, PLLA.QUANTITY Qtdpedido,
                            CASE
                                WHEN NVL(PLA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                       '*') = 'Y'
                                     OR NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                          '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                WHEN NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                       '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                            END Status,

  (SELECT ESIB.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Unidadepeso, PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmeditempedido,
                            PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmedpreco, PLA.PO_HEADER_ID Flexfield1,
                            PLA.PO_LINE_ID Flexfield2, PHA.PRC_BU_ID Flexfield3,
                            PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID Flexfield4, PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID Flexfield5,
                            PLA.UOM_CODE Flexfield6, '' Flexfield7, PLA.LINE_NUM Flexfield8,
                                                        PLLA.SHIPMENT_NUM Flexfield9,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                    'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) Flexfield10, PLA.ITEM_ID,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                    'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) PCATEGORIA, PLLA.PRICE_OVERRIDE, '' SERVICE_ITEM_UOM,
                                                                                               '' SERVICE_ITEM_WEIGHT
FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
WHERE PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
```
