### Query #10

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL`

### Query #10

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
          nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor,
          nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1, TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S' AS Codigofornecedor_Alt,
          CASE WHEN UPPER(HPS.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
          END FLAGMIGRACAO, '' Codexternocfop,
                               CASE
                                   WHEN NVL(:P_COMP_COD_PARCEIRO,
                                          'PARTY_SITE_ID') <> 'VENDOR_SITE_ID' THEN nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                      TO_CHAR(HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID)) || 'S'
                                   ELSE nvl(HPS.ATTRIBUTE1,
                                          TO_CHAR(PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID)) || 'S'
                               END AS Codfabricante,
                               TO_CHAR(PLLA.PROMISED_DATE,
                                 'YYYYMMDD') Dataprevista,
                               CASE
                                   WHEN NVL(:P_DESCRIPTION_ITEM_PO,
                                          'X') = 'ITEM_DA_ORDEM_DE_COMPRA' THEN REPLACE(PLA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION,

                                                                                  ';',
                                                                                  ',')
                                   ELSE REPLACE(
                                                  (SELECT ESIT.DESCRIPTION
                                                   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT
                                                   WHERE ESIT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
                                                     AND ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID),';',
                                          ',')
                               END Descricao,
                               SUBSTR(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                                 LENGTH(PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID) - 5) Itempedido, PHA.CURRENCY_CODE Moeda,
                               PHA.SEGMENT1 || '.' || SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                        1,
                                                        INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                          '-') - 1) AS Numpedido,

     (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
      FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, HR_LOCATIONS HL_AREANEGOCIO
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND HL_AREANEGOCIO.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
        AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = HL_AREANEGOCIO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) ORGANIZACAO, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,

     (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
      FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
      WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND ROWNUM = 1) Partnumber,
                               NVL(
                                     (SELECT ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT
                                      FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
                                      WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                        AND ROWNUM = 1), 0) Pesoliquido, pla.manufacturer_part_num Pnfabricante,
                               PLA.UNIT_PRICE Precoliq, PLLA.QUANTITY Qtdpedido,
                               CASE
                                   WHEN NVL(PLA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                          '*') = 'Y'
                                        OR NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                             '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                   WHEN NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                          '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                               END Status,

     (SELECT ESIB.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE
      FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
      WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND ROWNUM = 1) Unidadepeso, PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmeditempedido,
                               PLA.UOM_CODE Unidmedpreco, PLA.PO_HEADER_ID Flexfield1,
                               PLA.PO_LINE_ID Flexfield2, PHA.PRC_BU_ID Flexfield3,
                               PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID Flexfield4, PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID Flexfield5,
                               PLA.UOM_CODE Flexfield6, '' Flexfield7,
                                                           PLA.LINE_NUM Flexfield8,
                                                           PLLA.SHIPMENT_NUM Flexfield9,

     (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
      FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
      WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
        AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
        AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                       'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) Flexfield10, PLA.ITEM_ID,

     (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
      FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
      WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
        AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
        AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
        AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = NVL(:P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME,
                                       'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE')) PCATEGORIA, PLLA.PRICE_OVERRIDE, '' SERVICE_ITEM_UOM,
                                                                                                  '' SERVICE_ITEM_WEIGHT,
                                                                                                     COUNT(1) OVER() AS TOTAL,
                                                                                                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                                       ORDER BY PLA.PO_LINE_ID) LINE
   FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,
        HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
        HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
   WHERE PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
     AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
     AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
     AND PSSAM.PARTY_SITE_ID = HPS.PARTY_SITE_ID
     AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND pla.po_header_id= :P_ID)
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

**Tabelas:** `EGP_MFG_PART_NUMBERS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, PO_LINES_ALL, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES`

```sql
SELECT PLA.PO_LINE_ID, PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID,

       CASE WHEN UPPER(HPS.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'

                                                     1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                          '-') - 1) AS Numpedido,

  (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE

   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND HL_AREANEGOCIO.LOCATION_ID = PHA.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = HL_AREANEGOCIO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID) ORGANIZACAO, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,

  (SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB

     AND ROWNUM = 1) Partnumber,

                                     AND ROWNUM = 1), 0) Pesoliquido,

  (SELECT EMPN.MFG_PART_NUM
   FROM EGP_MFG_PART_NUMBERS EMPN
   WHERE EMPN.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND ROWNUM = 1) Pnfabricante, PLA.UNIT_PRICE Precoliq, PLLA.QUANTITY Qtdpedido,
                            CASE
                                WHEN NVL(PLA.CANCEL_FLAG,
                                       '*') = 'Y'
                                     OR NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                          '*') = 'CANCELED' THEN 'C'
                                WHEN NVL(PLA.LINE_STATUS,
                                       '*') LIKE '%CLOSED%' THEN 'F' ELSE 'A'
                            END Status,
                            NVL(
                                  (SELECT ESIB.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE
                                   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
                                   WHERE ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
                                     AND ROWNUM = 1), '#') Unidadepeso, NVL(PLA.UOM_CODE,
                                                                          '#') Unidmeditempedido,
                            NVL(PLA.UOM_CODE, '#') Unidmedpreco, PLA.PO_HEADER_ID Flexfield1,
                            PLA.PO_LINE_ID Flexfield2, PHA.PRC_BU_ID Flexfield3,
                            PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID Flexfield4, PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID Flexfield5,
                            PLA.UOM_CODE Flexfield6, '' Flexfield7, PLA.LINE_NUM Flexfield8,
                                                        PLLA.SHIPMENT_NUM Flexfield9,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE') Flexfield10, PLA.ITEM_ID,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PLA.ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID

     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE') PCATEGORIA, PLLA.PRICE_OVERRIDE, '' SERVICE_ITEM_UOM,
                                                                                            '' SERVICE_ITEM_WEIGHT
FROM PO_LINES_ALL PLA, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM,
     HZ_PARTY_SITES HPS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
WHERE PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_LINES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_LINES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT LISTAGG(po_header_id, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
                                               ORDER BY po_header_id) po_ids, total
FROM
  (SELECT pha.segment1 order_number, pha.po_header_id, COUNT(1) OVER() AS TOTAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                                   ORDER BY pha.segment1 DESC,

                                                                                                pha.po_header_id DESC) LINE
   FROM po_headers_all pha
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND pha.approved_flag = 'Y'
     AND UPPER(pha.segment1) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:p_order_number) || '%'
     AND pha.req_bu_id = :p_bu_id
     AND pha.vendor_id = :p_supplier_id
     AND pha.po_header_id = NVL(:p_po_header_id, pha.po_header_id)
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM po_lines_all pla, po_line_locations_all plla, po_distributions_all pda,
             gl_code_combinations gcc
        WHERE pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id
          AND pla.po_header_id = plla.po_header_id
          AND pla.po_line_id = plla.po_line_id
          AND pla.po_header_id = pda.po_header_id
          AND pla.po_line_id = pda.po_line_id
          AND plla.line_location_id = pda.line_location_id
          AND pda.code_combination_id = gcc.code_combination_id
          AND gcc.segment3 = :P_SEG_CRESULTADO
          AND pla.line_status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED FOR RECEIVING')))
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
GROUP BY total
```

```sql
ORGANIZATION,

   WHERE HL.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID) LOCATION,
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_AGENT_ACCESSES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, FUN_CLIENT_BU_V`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, PO_AGENT_ACCESSES, FUN_CLIENT_BU_V`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hou.name BU_NAME, hou.ORGANIZATION_ID ProcurementBUId, paa.access_action_code,
                paa.active_flag
FROM po_agent_accesses paa, per_person_names_f_v ppf, per_users pu,
     hr_organization_units hou
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND paa.agent_id = ppf.person_id
  AND pu.person_id = ppf.person_id
  AND hou.organization_id = paa.prc_bu_id
  AND paa.active_flag = 'Y'
  AND 1=1
  AND paa.access_action_code = 'MANAGE_PURCHASE_ORDERS'
  AND hou.ORGANIZATION_ID IN
    (SELECT DISTINCT b.SERVICE_PROVIDER_BU_ID
     FROM FUN_CLIENT_BU_V b,

       (SELECT description comb1, tag comb2, MEANING bu_name, lookup_type
        FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES
        WHERE lookup_type = 'XSUPPLIER_COMB_'||upper(:P_ORGANIZATION)||'_'||CASE
                                                                                WHEN upper(:P_COUNTRY_CODE) <> 'BR'THEN 'EX'
                                                                                ELSE 'BR'
                                                                            END
          AND LANGUAGE='US'
          AND ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND nvl(END_DATE_ACTIVE, sysdate+1) > sysdate) cc
     WHERE b.UPSTREAM_MODULE_KEY = 'REQUISITIONING_BF'
       AND cc.bu_name = b.bu_name
       AND b.SERVICE_PROVIDER_BU_ID != '300000926923916')
```

### Query #15

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQ_IMPORT_ERRORS, POR_REQ_HEADERS_INTERFACE_ALL`

### Query #15

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQ_IMPORT_ERRORS, POR_REQ_HEADERS_INTERFACE_ALL`

```sql
SELECT PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID, PRHIA.PROCESS_FLAG HEADER_PROCESS_FLAG,
       TO_CHAR(PRHIA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') HEADER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID INTERFACE_ID, PRLIA.ATTRIBUTE1 PRNUM,
       PRLIA.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 PRID, PRLIA.PROCESS_FLAG LINE_PROCESS_FLAG, PRLIA.ATTRIBUTE4 PRLINE_NUM,
       SUBSTR(
                (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(PRIE.TEXT_LINE || ' - ' || PRIE.COLUMN_NAME || ': "' || COLUMN_VALUE||'"',
                                   '/ ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                      ORDER BY PRIE.REQ_IMPORT_ERROR_ID)
                 FROM POR_REQ_IMPORT_ERRORS PRIE
                 WHERE PRIE.INTERFACE_ID = PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID
                   AND PRIE.INTERFACE_TYPE = 'HEADER') ||
                (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(PRIE.TEXT_LINE || ' - ' || PRIE.COLUMN_NAME || ': "' || COLUMN_VALUE||'"',
                                   '/ ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                      ORDER BY PRIE.REQ_IMPORT_ERROR_ID)
                 FROM POR_REQ_IMPORT_ERRORS PRIE
                 WHERE PRIE.INTERFACE_ID = PRLIA.REQ_LINE_INTERFACE_ID
                   AND PRIE.INTERFACE_TYPE = 'LINE')||
                (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(PRIE.TEXT_LINE || ' - ' || PRIE.COLUMN_NAME || ': "' || COLUMN_VALUE||'"',
                                   '/ ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                      ORDER BY PRIE.REQ_IMPORT_ERROR_ID)
                 FROM POR_REQ_IMPORT_ERRORS PRIE
                 WHERE PRIE.INTERFACE_ID = PRDIA.REQ_DIST_INTERFACE_ID
                   AND PRIE.INTERFACE_TYPE = 'DISTRIBUTION'), 1, 2000) MESSAGE_ERROR,PRDIA.PROCESS_FLAG LINE_DIST_PROCESS_FLAG
FROM POR_REQ_HEADERS_INTERFACE_ALL PRHIA, POR_REQ_LINES_INTERFACE_ALL PRLIA, POR_REQ_DISTS_INTERFACE_ALL PRDIA
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PRHIA.INTERFACE_SOURCE_CODE = 'MAXIMO'
  AND PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID = PRLIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID
  AND PRHIA.PROCESS_FLAG IN ('ERROR', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED')
  AND PRLIA.PROCESS_FLAG IN('ERROR', 'FAILED')
  AND PRLIA.REQ_LINE_INTERFACE_ID = PRDIA.REQ_LINE_INTERFACE_ID (+)
  AND NVL(PRDIA.PROCESS_FLAG, 'ERROR') IN('ERROR', 'FAILED')
  AND PRHIA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                  TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                    'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                        PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID)
ORDER BY PRHIA.REQ_HEADER_INTERFACE_ID, PRLIA.ATTRIBUTE1, PRLIA.ATTRIBUTE4
```

### Query #16

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS, PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PO_VERSIONS`

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_RECORDS, CEIL(COUNT(*) / :P_QTY_LINES) BATCH_QTY
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,PO_LINES_ALL PLA,HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION_F HOI,
     PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA,PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA,PO_LINE_TYPES_VL PLTV,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU,POZ_SUPPLIERS PSUP,POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PSSAM
WHERE HOI.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HOI.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND PHA.VENDOR_ID = PSUP.VENDOR_ID
  AND PHA.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PSSAM.VENDOR_SITE_ID
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'CANCELED')
  AND PLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PDA.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND PLA.LINE_TYPE_ID = PLTV.LINE_TYPE_ID(+)
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('BLANKET', 'CONTRACT', 'PLANNED')
  AND ((PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
          (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
           FROM PO_VERSIONS
           WHERE 1=1
             AND CO_CANCELED_FLAG = 'N'
             AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
             AND REJECTED_FLAG = 'N'
             AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                       LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
             AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE_TO,
                                       LAST_UPDATE_DATE))
        AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) = 0)
       OR (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
           AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) <> 0))
  AND
    (SELECT COUNT(PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM)
     FROM PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE PHI
     WHERE PHI.DOCUMENT_NUM = PHA.SEGMENT1
       AND PHI.PRC_BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
       AND PHI.PROCESS_CODE = 'IN PROCESS') = 0
  AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
    (SELECT PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID
     FROM PO_GA_ORG_ASSIGNMENTS PGOA,HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU2,HR_LOCATIONS HL
     WHERE 1=1
       AND PGOA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID = PGOA.REQ_BU_ID
       AND HAOU2.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
       AND HL.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y')
  AND NVL(:P_COUNT, 'N') = 'Y'
```

### Query #17

```sql
SELECT PHA.SEGMENT1 "CLIA_CONTRACTNUM", PHA.ATTRIBUTE2 "CLIA_AUTHCR",

  (SELECT REVISON
   FROM
     (SELECT DECODE(CO_NUM, '', 0, CO_NUM) REVISON
      FROM PO_VERSIONS
      WHERE PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
        AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
      ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC)
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1) CLIA_REVISIONNUM,

  (SELECT HOU.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
   WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID) "CLIA_AUTHORG", ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,

WHERE 1 = 1
  AND PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE IN ('BLANKET', 'CONTRACT', 'PLANNED')
  AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'CANCELED')
  AND NVL(PHA.ATTRIBUTE2, 'All') <> 'Normal'
  AND (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID IN
         (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
          FROM PO_VERSIONS
          WHERE 1=1
            AND CO_CANCELED_FLAG = 'N'
            AND CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS = 'PROCESSED'
            AND REJECTED_FLAG = 'N'
            AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                      LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) = 0)
       OR (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                PHA.PO_HEADER_ID)
           AND NVL(:P_ID, 0) <> 0))
```

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `CALC4, CALC2, BASE, CALC1, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL, CALC3`

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `CALC2, CALC4, CALC3, PO_LINES_ALL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, BASE, CALC1`

```sql
WITH base AS
  (SELECT (pll.quantity - pll.quantity_billed) AS saldo_qtd_line, pll.quantity AS quantity_original,
          pll.quantity_billed AS quantity_billed, pll.shipment_num AS schedule_number, pll.po_line_id,
          pll.price_override, pla.line_num, pll.assessable_value AS valor_linha,

     (SELECT SUM(pll1.assessable_value)
      FROM po_line_locations_all pll1
      WHERE pll1.po_header_id = pll.po_header_id) valor_total_po
   FROM po_line_locations_all pll
   JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pll.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
   WHERE pll.po_header_id = 142007),
     calc1 AS
  (SELECT b.*, b.saldo_qtd_line * b.price_override AS saldo_line
   FROM base b),
     calc2 AS
  (SELECT c.*, c.saldo_line / c.valor_total_po AS divisivel
   FROM calc1 c),
     calc3 AS
  (SELECT c.*, ROUND(c.divisivel * :P_VALUE, 2) AS vlr_line
   FROM calc2 c),
     calc4 AS
  (SELECT c.*, SUM(vlr_line) OVER () AS total_calculado,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                             ORDER BY vlr_line DESC) AS rn
   FROM calc3 c)
SELECT c.po_line_id, c.saldo_line, c.divisivel,
       CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN vlr_line + (:P_VALUE - total_calculado) ELSE vlr_line
       END AS LINE_VALUE, c.line_num, c.saldo_qtd_line, c.quantity_original, c.quantity_billed,
       c.schedule_number, c.price_override, c.valor_linha, c.valor_total_po
FROM calc4 c
ORDER BY c.line_num, c.schedule_number
```

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_HEADERS_ALL, ORDERED_PO`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `ORDERED_PO, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
WITH ordered_po AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pha.segment1 AS oc, esib.item_number AS item,
                   esib.inventory_item_id AS inventory_item_id, pla.unit_price AS preco, pha.creation_date AS data_compra,
                   psv.vendor_name AS fornecedor,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY esib.inventory_item_id
                                      ORDER BY pha.creation_date DESC) AS oc_seq, pbv.first_name || ' ' || pbv.last_name AS comprador,
                   hla.description AS LOCAL
   FROM po_headers_all pha, po_lines_all pla, po_line_locations_all pll, egp_system_items_b esib,
        hr_operating_units hou, poz_suppliers_v psv, po_buyers_val_v pbv, hr_locations_all hla
   WHERE pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
     AND pha.po_header_id = pll.po_header_id
     AND pla.po_line_id = pll.po_line_id
     AND pla.item_id = esib.inventory_item_id
     AND pll.ship_to_organization_id = esib.organization_id
     AND pll.ship_to_location_id = hla.location_id(+)
     AND pla.prc_bu_id = hou.organization_id
     AND pha.vendor_id = psv.vendor_id
     AND pha.agent_id = pbv.person_id
     AND pla.line_status IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN', 'CLOSED FOR INVOICING', 'CLOSED FOR RECEIVING')
     AND pha.document_status IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN', 'CLOSED FOR INVOICING',
                                 'CLOSED FOR RECEIVING'))
SELECT oc, item, inventory_item_id, preco, data_compra, fornecedor, comprador, LOCAL
FROM ordered_po
WHERE oc_seq <= 4
ORDER BY inventory_item_id, data_compra DESC
```

```sql
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS3') AS ShipToCustAddress3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS4') AS ShipToCustAddress4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE1') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE2') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt2,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE4') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE5') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt5, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('REQUESTEREMAIL') AS RequesterEmail,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONENUMBER') AS HdrDeliverToCustPhoneNumber,

                       'DRAFT', 0) AS DropShipSchedExists,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('ISBIPCLIENTENABLED') AS IsBipClientEnabled, PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1.RETAINAGE_FLAG AS "IsRetainageFlagEnabled",
       PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1.PROGRESS_PAYMENT_FLAG AS "IsProgressPaymentFlagEnabled", Header.ALT_CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS AdditionalContactEmail,

       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE2 AS ShAttribute2, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE3 AS ShAttribute3,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE4 AS ShAttribute4, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE5 AS ShAttribute5,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE6 AS ShAttribute6, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE7 AS ShAttribute7,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE8 AS ShAttribute8, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE9 AS ShAttribute9,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE10 AS ShAttribute10, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE11 AS ShAttribute11,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE12 AS ShAttribute12, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE13 AS ShAttribute13,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE14 AS ShAttribute14, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE15 AS ShAttribute15,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE16 AS ShAttribute16, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE17 AS ShAttribute17,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE18 AS ShAttribute18, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE19 AS ShAttribute19,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE20 AS ShAttribute20, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS ShAttributeNumber1,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS ShAttributeNumber2, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3 AS ShAttributeNumber3,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4 AS ShAttributeNumber4, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS ShAttributeNumber5,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER6 AS ShAttributeNumber6, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER7 AS ShAttributeNumber7,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER8 AS ShAttributeNumber8, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER9 AS ShAttributeNumber9,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER10 AS ShAttributeNumber10, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1 AS ShAttributeDate1,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE2 AS ShAttributeDate2, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE3 AS ShAttributeDate3,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE4 AS ShAttributeDate4, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE5 AS ShAttributeDate5,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE6 AS ShAttributeDate6, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE7 AS ShAttributeDate7,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE8 AS ShAttributeDate8, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE9 AS ShAttributeDate9,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE10 AS ShAttributeDate10, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1 AS ShAttributeTimestamp1,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2 AS ShAttributeTimestamp2, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP3 AS ShAttributeTimestamp3,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP4 AS ShAttributeTimestamp4, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP5 AS ShAttributeTimestamp5,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP6 AS ShAttributeTimestamp6, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS ShAttributeTimestamp7,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS ShAttributeTimestamp8, Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS ShAttributeTimestamp9,
       Header.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS ShAttributeTimestamp10, ShTypes.special_handling_type AS SpecialHandlingType,
       Header.SPECIAL_HANDLING_TYPE_CODE AS SpecialHandlingTypeCode
FROM PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL Header, FND_LOOKUPS FreightTermsPoLookupPEO, FND_LOOKUPS FobPoLookupPEO,
     PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL DocStyle, PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                 PON_BIDDING_TERMS_VL NegotiationTerms, POZ_SUPPLIERS Supplier,
                                                 POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M PozSupplierSite,
                                                 POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS SupplierContact, WSH_CARRIERS Carrier,
                                                 HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ShipToLoc,
                                                 HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL BillToLoc,
                                                 HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ProcBuLocation,
                                                 HR_ORGANIZATION_V ProcurementBu, AP_TERMS_VL PaymentTermsHeader,
                                                 HZ_PARTIES SupplierPartyName,
                                                 HZ_PARTIES SupplierContactPartyName, HZ_PARTIES CarrierPartyName,
                                                 PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PersonName,
                                                 PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V PersonPhone,
                                                 PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V PersonFaxPhone,
                                                 PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PersonEmailAddress, FND_CURRENCIES_VL Currency,
                                                 HZ_LOCATIONS SupplierLocation, PO_VERSIONS FirstVersion,
                                                 PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1, HR_ORGANIZATION_V BillToBu,
                                                 XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES SoldToLe,
                                                 XLE_REGISTRATIONS SoldToLeRegistration,
                                                 FND_LOOKUPS ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
                                                 FND_LOOKUPS ServiceLevelLookupPEO, HZ_LOCATIONS SoldToLeLocation,
                                                 PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                 HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES AdditionalPartyNamePEO, po_spcl_handling_types ShTypes
WHERE (Header.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
       AND ProcurementBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE (+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
  AND (PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID)
  AND (Header.BILLTO_BU_ID = BillToBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
       AND BillToBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE (+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
  AND (Header.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID)
  AND (SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_ID)
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_TABLE = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES')
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y')
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.LOCATION_ID = SoldToLeLocation.LOCATION_ID)
  AND (SoldToLeLocation.INTERNAL_FLAG='Y')
  AND (Header.AGENT_ID = PersonName.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN PersonName.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonName.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID = BillToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.VENDOR_ID = Supplier.VENDOR_ID(+)
       AND Supplier.PARTY_ID = SupplierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND (Header.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PozSupplierSite.VENDOR_SITE_ID(+)
       AND Header.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID = SupplierContact.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID(+))
  AND (SupplierContact.PER_PARTY_ID = SupplierContactPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND (Header.TERMS_ID = PaymentTermsHeader.TERM_ID(+))
  AND (Header.CARRIER_ID = Carrier.CARRIER_ID(+)
       AND Carrier.CARRIER_ID = CarrierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND (Header.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (Header.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (Header.freight_terms_lookup_code = FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FREIGHT TERMS')
  AND (Header.fob_lookup_code = FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FOB')
  AND (Header.style_id = DocStyle.STYLE_ID (+)
       AND Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = DocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE (+))
  AND (Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD')
  AND (Header.AGENT_ID = PersonEmailAddress.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonEmailAddress.EMAIL_TYPE(+) = 'W1'
       AND Header.AGENT_ID = PersonPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) ='W1')
  AND (PersonPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
       AND NVL(PersonPhone.DATE_TO(+), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND (Header.AGENT_ID = PersonFaxPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonFaxPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) ='WF')
  AND (PersonFaxPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
       AND NVL(PersonFaxPhone.DATE_TO(+), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND (ProcurementBu.LOCATION_ID = ProcBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.PO_HEADER_ID = Version.PO_HEADER_ID)
  AND (Header.PRC_BU_ID = NegotiationTerms.PRC_BU_ID(+)
       AND NegotiationTerms.APPLICATION_ID(+) = 201)
  AND (Header.CURRENCY_CODE = Currency.CURRENCY_CODE(+))
  AND (PozSupplierSite.LOCATION_ID = SupplierLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
  AND (Header.PO_HEADER_ID = FirstVersion.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND FirstVersion.CO_SEQUENCE = 0)
  AND (PurchasingDocumentStyleHeade1.STYLE_ID(+) = Header.STYLE_ID)
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_NAME_TYPE(+) = 'PHONETIC'
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.status_flag(+) = 'A'
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_ID(+) = Supplier.PARTY_ID
  AND rownum = 1
  AND ShTypes.SPECIAL_HANDLING_TYPE_CODE(+) = Header.special_handling_type_code
ORDER BY NegotiationTerms.VERSION_NUM DESC
```

```sql
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(NVL(Line.BASE_MODEL_PRICE,
                                             0)) AS BaseModelPriceDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_requester_name(NULL,
                       Line.PO_LINE_ID, 'DRAFT', '0') AS Requester,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_lines(Line.PO_HEADER_ID,
                       Line.PO_LINE_ID, Line.ITEM_ID, Item.ORGANIZATION_ID,
                       NVL(Line.FROM_HEADER_ID, Line.CONTRACT_ID), Line.FROM_LINE_ID) AS Attachments,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_draft_config_component_xml(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                       PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID,
                       Line.PO_HEADER_ID) AS ctodata,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINE') AS TextAttachmentsContent, LineType.LINE_TYPE AS "LineType2", Line.LIST_PRICE AS BasePrice,
       PoDiscountTypeLookup.DISPLAYED_FIELD AS DiscountType, Line.DISCOUNT AS Discount, Line.DISCOUNT_REASON AS DiscountReason,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.format_price(Line.LIST_PRICE) AS BasePriceDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_po_discount(Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                       Line.DISCOUNT_TYPE, Line.DISCOUNT) AS DiscountDisplay,
       DECODE(COALESCE(Line.MANUFACTURER, Line.MANUFACTURER_PART_NUM),
         NULL,
         DECODE(SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID,
           NULL, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_manufacturer_part_num(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                                 'DRAFT'),
           DraftAttributeValuePEO.MANUFACTURER_PART_NUM), Line.MANUFACTURER_PART_NUM) AS ManufacturerPartNumber,
       DECODE(COALESCE(Line.MANUFACTURER, Line.MANUFACTURER_PART_NUM),
         NULL,
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_manufacturer_name(Line.PO_LINE_ID,
                         SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID, 'DRAFT'), Line.MANUFACTURER) AS ManufacturerName, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_retainage_rate(Line.PO_LINE_ID) AS "RetainageRate",
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('ISRETAINAGERATEMULTIPLE') AS "IsRetainageRateMultiple", Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS ShAttributeCategory,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE1 AS ShAttribute1, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE2 AS ShAttribute2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE3 AS ShAttribute3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE4 AS ShAttribute4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE5 AS ShAttribute5, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE6 AS ShAttribute6,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE7 AS ShAttribute7, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE8 AS ShAttribute8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE9 AS ShAttribute9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE10 AS ShAttribute10, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE11 AS ShAttribute11,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE12 AS ShAttribute12, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE13 AS ShAttribute13,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE14 AS ShAttribute14, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE15 AS ShAttribute15,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE16 AS ShAttribute16, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE17 AS ShAttribute17,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE18 AS ShAttribute18, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE19 AS ShAttribute19,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE20 AS ShAttribute20, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS ShAttributeNumber1,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS ShAttributeNumber2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3 AS ShAttributeNumber3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4 AS ShAttributeNumber4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS ShAttributeNumber5,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER6 AS ShAttributeNumber6, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER7 AS ShAttributeNumber7,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER8 AS ShAttributeNumber8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER9 AS ShAttributeNumber9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER10 AS ShAttributeNumber10, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1 AS ShAttributeDate1,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE2 AS ShAttributeDate2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE3 AS ShAttributeDate3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE4 AS ShAttributeDate4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE5 AS ShAttributeDate5,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE6 AS ShAttributeDate6, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE7 AS ShAttributeDate7,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE8 AS ShAttributeDate8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE9 AS ShAttributeDate9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE10 AS ShAttributeDate10, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1 AS ShAttributeTimestamp1,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2 AS ShAttributeTimestamp2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP3 AS ShAttributeTimestamp3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP4 AS ShAttributeTimestamp4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP5 AS ShAttributeTimestamp5,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP6 AS ShAttributeTimestamp6, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS ShAttributeTimestamp7,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS ShAttributeTimestamp8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS ShAttributeTimestamp9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS ShAttributeTimestamp10
FROM PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL LINE, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL SourceHdr,
                        PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL BlanketHdr, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL ContractHdr,
                        PO_HAZARD_CLASSES_VL HazardClass, PO_UN_NUMBERS_VL UnNumber,
                        PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL SourceDocStyle, PO_LINE_TYPES_VL LineType,
                        INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SHIPPING_UOM, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL PRICING_UOM,
                        EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item, PO_LINES_ALL SourceLine, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL CategoryPEO,
                        EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL BaseModelPEO, PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                        PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL BlanketDocStyle, PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL ContractDocStyle,
                        PO_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES_DRAFT DraftAttributeValuePEO, PO_LOOKUP_CODES PoDiscountTypeLookup
WHERE Line.LINE_TYPE_ID = LineType.LINE_TYPE_ID
  AND Line.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = SHIPPING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.UOM_CODE = PRICING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.HAZARD_CLASS_ID = HazardClass.HAZARD_CLASS_ID(+)
  AND Line.UN_NUMBER_ID = UnNumber.UN_NUMBER_ID(+)
  AND Line.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND SourceHdr.style_id = SourceDocStyle.STYLE_ID
  AND SourceHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = SourceDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE
  AND Line.FROM_HEADER_ID = BlanketHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.CONTRACT_ID = ContractHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.FROM_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND Line.CATEGORY_ID = CategoryPEO.CATEGORY_ID(+)
  AND Line.BASE_MODEL_ID = BaseModelPEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND BlanketHdr.style_id = BlanketDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND BlanketHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = BlanketDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND ContractHdr.style_id = ContractDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND ContractHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = ContractDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID = DraftAttributeValuePEO.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND Line.discount_type = PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_code(+)
  AND PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_DISCOUNT_TYPE'
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM
```

```sql
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('RECOVERABLEINCLUSIVETAX_DISPLAY') AS RecoverableInclusiveTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('NONRECOVERABLEINCLUSIVETAX_DISPLAY') AS NonRecoverableInclTaxDisplay,

                       ModeOfTransportLookupPEO.MEANING,
                       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.MEANING) AS ShippingMethod,
       DECODE(LineLocation.CANCEL_FLAG,
         'Y', 'CANCELLED',
         DECODE(LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)) AS ScheduleStatus, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_change_order_status AS ChangeOrderStatus,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_customer_item_num(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SALESORDERLINENUMBER') AS SalesOrderLineNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SALESORDERSCHEDULENUMBER') AS SalesOrderSchedule,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS ShiptoCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTEMAILADDRESS') AS ShipToCustConEmailAddress,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTFLOORNUMBER') AS ShipToCustFloorNumber,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALCODE') AS ShipToCustPostalCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALPLUS4CODE') AS ShipToCustPostalPlus4Code,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS1') AS ShipToCustAddress1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS2') AS ShipToCustAddress2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS3') AS ShipToCustAddress3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS4') AS ShipToCustAddress4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE1') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE2') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE3') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE4') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE5') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt5,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONENUMBER') AS DeliverToCustPhoneNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONETYPE') AS DeliverToCustPhoneType,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS DelivertoCustPrefMethod,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS DeliveToCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DESTINATIONTYPECODE') AS DestinationTypeCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_address(ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, ShipToLocation.TOWN_OR_CITY,
                       ShipToLocation.POSTAL_CODE, ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.FLOOR_NUMBER, ShipToLocation.BUILDING,
                       ShipToLocation.COUNTRY, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION13,
                       ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION14, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION15,
                       ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION17, 'N') AS LineLocShipToAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_line_loc(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID) AS Attachments, Header.BUYER_MANAGED_TRANSPORT_FLAG AS BuyerManagedTransportation,
       LineLocation.WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_SEQ AS WorkOrderOperationSeq,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS IsShiptoNameSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsShiptoContactSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS IsShiptoAddressSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsDelivertoConSameAsHeader,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINELOCATION') AS TextAttachmentsContent, PaymentTypeLookupPEO.MEANING AS PaymentType,
       LineLocation.DESCRIPTION AS ScheduleDescription
FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_DRAFT_ALL LineLocation, PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL LINE,
                                                                  INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SHIPPING_UOM,
                                                                  INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL PRICING_UOM,
                                                                  INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SecondaryUOM,
                                                                  EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                                                                  HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ShipToLocation,
                                                                  PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL Header,
                                                                  HZ_PARTIES PartyPEO,
                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS PaymentTypeLookupPEO,
                                                                  PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                  HZ_LOCATIONS NonInternalLocation
WHERE LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = SHIPPING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.UOM_CODE = PRICING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE = SecondaryUOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_LINE_ID = Line.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID = Header.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND LineLocation.CARRIER_ID = PartyPEO.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND (LineLocation.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (LineLocation.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (LineLocation.PAYMENT_TYPE = PaymentTypeLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND PaymentTypeLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_PAYMENT_TYPE')
  AND (LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = NonInternalLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM, LineLocation.SHIPMENT_NUM
```

```sql
                       Distribution.PJC_TASK_ID, 'NUMBER') AS TaskNumber,

                       Distribution.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID) AS ExpenditureTypeName,

                       Distribution.PJC_WORK_TYPE_ID) AS WorkTypeName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_state_province(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_3, DeliverToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16) AS DeliverToLocStateProvn,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_region(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2) AS DeliverToLocRegion,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_county(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1) AS DeliverToLocCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_tax_display_dist(SourceHdr.CURRENCY_CODE,
                       Distribution.RECOVERABLE_TAX) AS RecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.NONRECOVERABLE_TAX) AS NonRecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.RECOVERABLE_INCLUSIVE_TAX) AS RecoverableInclusiveTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.NONRECOVERABLE_INCLUSIVE_TAX) AS NonRecoverableInclTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_account_flex_data(Distribution.CODE_COMBINATION_ID)AS FlexData
FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_DRAFT_ALL Distribution, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL SourceHdr, PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL SourceLine,
     PO_LOOKUP_CODES DestTypeLookup, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL DeliverToLocation, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V Requester,
     INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES RequesterEmail,
     PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V RequesterPhone, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PersonDPEO, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M AssignmentDPEO,
     HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL RequesterLocation, HZ_LOCATIONS DelivertoCustLocation, HZ_PARTIES DeliverToCustContactPEO,
     GMS_AWARD_HEADERS_INFO_V GMSAHIV,PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO
WHERE Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = Requester.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN Requester.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Requester.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID = DeliverToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE = DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_CODE(+)
  AND DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'DESTINATION TYPE'
  AND Distribution.PO_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Distribution.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND SourceLine.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND SourceLine.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND SourceHdr.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND (Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterEmail.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = RequesterEmail.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = RequesterPhone.PHONE_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterPhone.DATE_FROM(+) AND NVL(RequesterPhone.DATE_TO(+),
                                                                    TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
  AND ((PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = AssignmentDPEO.PERSON_ID(+))
       AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
       AND (AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE(+) = 'Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.PRIMARY_FLAG(+)='Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE(+) IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')))
  AND AssignmentDPEO.LOCATION_ID = RequesterLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND RequesterLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = DelivertoCustLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_CONTACT_ID = DeliverToCustContactPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND GMSAHIV.contract_id(+) = Distribution.pjc_contract_id
ORDER BY SourceLine.LINE_NUM, Distribution.DISTRIBUTION_NUM
```

```sql
                                                                               PO_HEADERS_ALL TxnHeader,
                                                                               po_spcl_handling_types shtypes
WHERE (Header.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ProcurementBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
       AND ProcurementBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE (+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
  AND (PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID = ProcurementBu.ORGANIZATION_ID)
  AND (Header.REQ_BU_ID = RequisitionBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN RequisitionBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND RequisitionBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
       AND RequisitionBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE (+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
  AND (Header.AGENT_ID = PersonName.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN PersonName.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonName.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID = BillToLoc.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND BillToLoc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.TERMS_ID = PaymentTermsHeader.TERM_ID(+))
  AND (Header.CARRIER_ID = Carrier.CARRIER_ID(+)
       AND Carrier.CARRIER_ID = CarrierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND (Header.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (Header.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (Header.freight_terms_lookup_code = FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND FreightTermsPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FREIGHT TERMS')
  AND (Header.fob_lookup_code = FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND FobPoLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'FOB')
  AND (Header.style_id = DocStyle.STYLE_ID (+)
       AND Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = DocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE (+)
       AND Header.AGENT_ID = PersonEmailAddress.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonEmailAddress.EMAIL_TYPE(+) = 'W1'
       AND Header.AGENT_ID = PersonPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) ='W1'
       AND (PersonPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
            AND NVL(PersonPhone.DATE_TO(+), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
       AND Header.AGENT_ID = PersonFaxPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonFaxPhone.PHONE_TYPE(+) ='WF'
       AND (PersonFaxPhone.DATE_FROM(+) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
            AND NVL(PersonFaxPhone.DATE_TO(+), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
  AND (ProcurementBu.LOCATION_ID = ProcBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ProcBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (Header.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'STANDARD')
  AND (Header.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
       AND Header.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
  AND (Header.PO_HEADER_ID = FirstVersion.PO_HEADER_ID
       AND FirstVersion.CO_SEQUENCE = 0)
  AND (Header.PRC_BU_ID = Terms.PRC_BU_ID(+)
       AND Terms.APPLICATION_ID(+) = 201)
  AND (Header.CURRENCY_CODE = Currency.CURRENCY_CODE(+))
  AND (PozSupplierSite.LOCATION_ID = SupplierLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND Header.VENDOR_ID = Supplier.VENDOR_ID(+)
       AND Supplier.PARTY_ID = SupplierPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND (Header.VENDOR_SITE_ID = PozSupplierSite.VENDOR_SITE_ID(+)
       AND Header.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID = SupplierContact.VENDOR_CONTACT_ID(+))
  AND (SupplierContact.PER_PARTY_ID = SupplierContactPartyName.PARTY_ID(+))
  AND SupplierPhone.OWNER_TABLE_ID(+) = PozSupplierSite.PARTY_SITE_ID
  AND SupplierPhone.OWNER_TABLE_NAME(+) = 'HZ_PARTY_SITES'
  AND SupplierPhone.STATUS(+) = 'A'
  AND SupplierPhone.CONTACT_POINT_TYPE(+) = 'PHONE'
  AND SupplierPhone.PHONE_LINE_TYPE (+) = 'GEN'
  AND SupplierPhone.PRIMARY_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
  AND Header.STYLE_ID=PurchasingDocStyleHeaderPEO.STYLE_ID
  AND (Header.BILLTO_BU_ID = BillToBu.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND BillToBu.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
       AND BillToBu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE (+) = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT')
  AND (Header.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID)
  AND (SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_ID)
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.SOURCE_TABLE = 'XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES')
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.IDENTIFYING_FLAG = 'Y')
  AND (SoldToLeRegistration.LOCATION_ID = SoldToLeLocation.LOCATION_ID
       AND SoldToLeLocation.INTERNAL_FLAG='Y')
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_NAME_TYPE(+) = 'PHONETIC'
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.status_flag(+) = 'A'
  AND AdditionalPartyNamePEO.PARTY_ID(+) = Supplier.PARTY_ID
  AND rownum = 1
  AND (RequisitionBu.LOCATION_ID = ReqBuLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
       AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ReqBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ReqBuLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND Header.PO_HEADER_ID = TxnHeader.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND shtypes.special_handling_type_code(+) = Header.special_handling_type_code
ORDER BY Terms.VERSION_NUM DESC
```

```sql
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER8 AS ShAttributeNumber8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER9 AS ShAttributeNumber9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER10 AS ShAttributeNumber10, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1 AS ShAttributeDate1,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE2 AS ShAttributeDate2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE3 AS ShAttributeDate3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE4 AS ShAttributeDate4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE5 AS ShAttributeDate5,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE6 AS ShAttributeDate6, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE7 AS ShAttributeDate7,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE8 AS ShAttributeDate8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE9 AS ShAttributeDate9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_DATE10 AS ShAttributeDate10, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1 AS ShAttributeTimestamp1,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2 AS ShAttributeTimestamp2, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP3 AS ShAttributeTimestamp3,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP4 AS ShAttributeTimestamp4, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP5 AS ShAttributeTimestamp5,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP6 AS ShAttributeTimestamp6, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS ShAttributeTimestamp7,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS ShAttributeTimestamp8, Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS ShAttributeTimestamp9,
       Line.SH_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS ShAttributeTimestamp10
FROM PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL LINE, PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL PoHdr,
                          PO_UN_NUMBERS_VL UnNumber, PO_HAZARD_CLASSES_VL HazardClass,
                          PO_LINE_TYPES_VL LineType, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                          EGP_CATEGORIES_VL CategoryPEO, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SHIPPING_UOM,
                          INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL PRICING_UOM, PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                                           PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL BlanketHdr,
                                                                           PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL ContractHdr,
                                                                           EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL BaseModelPEO,
                                                                           PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                           PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL BlanketDocStyle,
                                                                           PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_VL ContractDocStyle,
                                                                           PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL BlanketLine,
                                                                           PO_ATTR_VALUES_ARCHIVE ArchivedAttributePEO,
                                                                           PO_LOOKUP_CODES PoDiscountTypeLookup
WHERE Line.LINE_TYPE_ID = LineType.LINE_TYPE_ID
  AND Line.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = SHIPPING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.UOM_CODE = PRICING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.HAZARD_CLASS_ID = HazardClass.HAZARD_CLASS_ID(+)
  AND Line.UN_NUMBER_ID = UnNumber.UN_NUMBER_ID(+)
  AND Line.PO_HEADER_ID = PoHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND Line.CATEGORY_ID = CategoryPEO.CATEGORY_ID(+)
  AND Line.FROM_HEADER_ID = BlanketHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence = BlanketHdr.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND Line.BASE_MODEL_ID = BaseModelPEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Line.CONTRACT_ID = ContractHdr.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
  AND PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence = ContractHdr.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND PoHdr.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND PoHdr.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND Line.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND (Line.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_line_locations_archive_all sa1
                   WHERE sa1.po_line_id = Line.po_line_id
                     AND sa1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND sa1.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence
                     AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence)
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_distributions_archive_all da1
                   WHERE da1.po_line_id = Line.po_line_id
                     AND da1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND da1.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence
                     AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence))))
  AND BlanketHdr.style_id = BlanketDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND BlanketHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = BlanketDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND ContractHdr.style_id = ContractDocStyle.STYLE_ID(+)
  AND ContractHdr.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = ContractDocStyle.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE(+)
  AND Line.FROM_LINE_ID = BlanketLine.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence = BlanketLine.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND BlanketLine.PO_LINE_ID = ArchivedAttributePEO.PO_LINE_ID(+)
  AND PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence = ArchivedAttributePEO.TO_CO_SEQ(+)
  AND Line.discount_type = PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_code(+)
  AND PoDiscountTypeLookup.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_DISCOUNT_TYPE'
  AND (Line.LINE_NUM >= :param_from_line
       OR :param_from_line IS NULL)
  AND (Line.LINE_NUM <= :param_to_line
       OR :param_to_line IS NULL)
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM
```

```sql
       LineLocation.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE18 AS GlobalAttribute18, LineLocation.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE19 AS GlobalAttribute19,
       LineLocation.GLOBAL_ATTRIBUTE20 AS GlobalAttribute20, Line.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS OrderTypeLookupCode,
       LineLocation.WORK_ORDER_NUMBER AS WorkOrderNumber, LineLocation.REQUESTED_SHIP_DATE AS RequestedShipDate,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('CUSTOMERPONUMBER') AS CustomerPONumber,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS ShipToCustomerName,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS ShiptoCustPrefMethod, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS ShiptoCustAddress,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPROVINCE') AS ShipToCustProvince, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCOUNTY') AS ShipToCustCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTSTATE') AS ShipToCustState, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCOUNTRY') AS ShipToCustCountry,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALCODE') AS ShipToCustPostalCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALPLUS4CODE') AS ShipToCustPostalPlus4Code,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS1') AS ShipToCustAddress1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS2') AS ShipToCustAddress2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS3') AS ShipToCustAddress3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS4') AS ShipToCustAddress4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE1') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE2') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE3') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE4') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE5') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt5,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONENUMBER') AS DeliverToCustPhoneNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONETYPE') AS DeliverToCustPhoneType,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS DelivertoCustPrefMethod,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS DeliveToCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DESTINATIONTYPECODE') AS DestinationTypeCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_address(ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, ShipToLocation.TOWN_OR_CITY,
                       ShipToLocation.POSTAL_CODE, ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.FLOOR_NUMBER, ShipToLocation.BUILDING,
                       ShipToLocation.COUNTRY, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION13,
                       ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION14, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION15,
                       ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION17, 'N') AS LineLocShipToAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_line_loc(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID) AS Attachments, LineLocation.WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_SEQ AS WorkOrderOperationSeq,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS IsShiptoNameSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsShiptoContactSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS IsShiptoAddressSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsDelivertoConSameAsHeader,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINELOCATION') AS TextAttachmentsContent, Item.OUTSIDE_PROCESS_SERVICE_FLAG AS "OutsideProcessServiceFlag",
       LineLocation.allow_substitute_receipts_flag AS AllowSubstituteReceiptsFlag, LineLocation.amount AS Amount, PartyPEO.party_name AS CarrierName,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'C') ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, NULL)) AS EntityChangeTypeCode, Line.CONSIGNMENT_LINE_FLAG AS IsLineConsigned,
       LineLocation.last_accept_date AS LastAcceptDate, ModeOfTransportLookupPEO.MEANING AS ModeOfTransportName,
       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.MEANING AS ServiceLevelName, LineLocation.SHIPPING_UOM_QUANTITY AS Quantity,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(LineLocation.CANCEL_FLAG,
             'Y', 'CANCELLED',
             DECODE(LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE,
               'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)), 'CHANGED') ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(LineLocation.CANCEL_FLAG,
             'Y', 'CANCELLED',
             DECODE(LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE,
               'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)), NULL)) AS ScheduleStatus,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS1) AS ShipToLocAddressLine1,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS2) AS ShipToLocAddressLine2,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS3) AS ShipToLocAddressLine3,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS4) AS ShipToLocAddressLine4,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL,
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_county(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_1), NonInternalLocation.COUNTY) AS ShipToLocCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_region(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2) AS ShipToLocRegion,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL,
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_state_province(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16), NVL(NonInternalLocation.STATE,

                                                                                       NonInternalLocation.PROVINCE)) AS ShipToLocStateProvn, ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_1 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber1,
       ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_2 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber2, ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_3 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber3,
       LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID AS ShipToLocationId, ShipToLocation.LOCATION_NAME AS ShipToLocationName,
       LineLocation.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID AS ShipToOrganizationId,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_uom_base_language(LineLocation.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE) AS UomBaseLanguage, PaymentTypeLookupPEO.MEANING AS PaymentType,
       LineLocation.DESCRIPTION AS ScheduleDescription
FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ARCHIVE_ALL LineLocation, PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL LINE,
                                                                      INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SHIPPING_UOM,
                                                                      INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL PRICING_UOM,
                                                                      INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SecondaryUOM,
                                                                      EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                                                                      HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ShipToLocation,
                                                                      PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                                                  PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL Header,
                                                                                  PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL TransLineLocation,
                                                                                  HZ_PARTIES PartyPEO,
                                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
                                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
                                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS PaymentTypeLookupPEO,
                                                                                  PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                                  HZ_LOCATIONS NonInternalLocation
WHERE LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = SHIPPING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.UOM_CODE = PRICING_UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE = SecondaryUOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_LINE_ID = Line.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Line.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID = Header.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND Header.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Header.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Header.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID = TransLineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND LineLocation.CARRIER_ID = PartyPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND (LineLocation.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (LineLocation.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (LineLocation.PAYMENT_TYPE = PaymentTypeLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND PaymentTypeLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PO_PAYMENT_TYPE')
  AND (LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = NonInternalLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND (LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_distributions_archive_all da1
                   WHERE da1.line_location_id = LineLocation.line_location_id
                     AND da1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND da1.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence
                     AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ = PO_BIP_HELPER.get_max_co_sequence))))
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM, LineLocation.SHIPMENT_NUM
```
