```sql
         DelivertoCustLocation.POSTAL_PLUS4_CODE) AS DeliverToLocLongPostalCode, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY AS AttributeCategory ,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE1 AS Attribute1 , Distribution.ATTRIBUTE2 AS Attribute2 ,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE3 AS Attribute3 , Distribution.ATTRIBUTE4 AS Attribute4 ,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE5 AS Attribute5 , Distribution.ATTRIBUTE6 AS Attribute6 ,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE7 AS Attribute7 , Distribution.ATTRIBUTE8 AS Attribute8 ,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE9 AS Attribute9 , Distribution.ATTRIBUTE10 AS Attribute10,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE11 AS Attribute11, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE12 AS Attribute12,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE13 AS Attribute13, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE14 AS Attribute14,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE15 AS Attribute15, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE16 AS Attribute16,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE17 AS Attribute17, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE18 AS Attribute18,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE19 AS Attribute19, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE20 AS Attribute20,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE1 AS AttributeDate1, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE2 AS AttributeDate2,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE3 AS AttributeDate3, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE4 AS AttributeDate4,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE5 AS AttributeDate5, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE6 AS AttributeDate6,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE7 AS AttributeDate7, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE8 AS AttributeDate8,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE9 AS AttributeDate9, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_DATE10 AS AttributeDate10,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1 AS AttributeTimestamp1, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2 AS AttributeTimestamp2,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP3 AS AttributeTimestamp3, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP4 AS AttributeTimestamp4,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP5 AS AttributeTimestamp5, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP6 AS AttributeTimestamp6,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS AttributeTimestamp7, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS AttributeTimestamp8,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS AttributeTimestamp9, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS AttributeTimestamp10,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS AttributeNumber1, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS AttributeNumber2,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3 AS AttributeNumber3, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4 AS AttributeNumber4,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5 AS AttributeNumber5, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER6 AS AttributeNumber6,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER7 AS AttributeNumber7, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER8 AS AttributeNumber8,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER9 AS AttributeNumber9, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER10 AS AttributeNumber10,
       DeliverToCustContactPEO.PARTY_NAME AS DeliverToContactName, DeliverToCustContactPEO.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS DeliverToContactEmail,
       DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_LINE_TYPE AS DeliverToContactPhoneType, Version.VERSION_ID,
       hz_format_pub.get_formatted_phone(p_phone_country_code => DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE,

                       p_phone_area_code => DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
                       p_phone_number => DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER,
                       p_phone_extension => DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_EXTENSION,
                       p_phone_line_type => DeliverToCustContactPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_LINE_TYPE, p_display_purpose => 'F') AS DeliverToContactPhone, GMSAHIV.CONTRACT_NUMBER AS AwardContractNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_person_contact_info(Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID,
                       'FAX', 'N') AS RequesterFaxNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_projectinfo_from_id(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       'NAME') AS ProjectName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_projectinfo_from_id(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       'NUMBER') AS ProjectNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_taskinfo_from_id(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_TASK_ID, 'NAME') AS TaskName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_taskinfo_from_id(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_TASK_ID, 'NUMBER') AS TaskNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_exporgname(Distribution.REQ_BU_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_ORGANIZATION_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE) AS ExpenditureOrganizationName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_exptype_name(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID) AS ExpenditureTypeName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_worktype_name(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_WORK_TYPE_ID) AS WorkTypeName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_state_province(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_3, DeliverToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16) AS DeliverToLocStateProvn,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_region(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2) AS DeliverToLocRegion,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_county(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1) AS DeliverToLocCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_tax_display_dist(SourceHdr.CURRENCY_CODE,
                       Distribution.RECOVERABLE_TAX) AS RecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.NONRECOVERABLE_TAX) AS NonRecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_account_flex_data(Distribution.CODE_COMBINATION_ID)AS FlexData, Distribution.AMOUNT_ORDERED AS AmountOrdered,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'Y', PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.AMOUNT_ORDERED),
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_org_amount_display(SourceLine.ORDER_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                         Distribution.QUANTITY_ORDERED, SourceLine.UNIT_PRICE,
                         Distribution.AMOUNT_ORDERED, SourceHdr.CURRENCY_CODE)) AS AmountOrderedDisplay, DeliverToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_1 AS DeliverToLocTelephoneNumber1,
       Distribution.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID AS DeliverToLocationId, DeliverToLocation.LOCATION_NAME AS DeliverToLocationName,
       DestTypeLookup.DISPLAYED_FIELD AS DestinationType, Distribution.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE AS DestinationTypeCode,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, Distribution.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'C') ,
         DECODE(Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, Distribution.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, NULL)) AS EntityChangeTypeCode,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(Distribution.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)) ,
         DECODE(Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(Distribution.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL))) AS DistributionStatus, Distribution.EXTERNAL_CHANGE_FLAG AS ExternalChangeFlag,
       Distribution.QUANTITY_ORDERED AS QuantityOrdered, Distribution.RATE AS Rate, Distribution.RATE_DATE AS RateDate,
       Distribution.REASON_FOR_CHANGE AS ReasonForChange
FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ARCHIVE_ALL Distribution, PO_LOOKUP_CODES DestTypeLookup, PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL SourceHdr,
     PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL SourceLine, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL DeliverToLocation, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V Requester,
     EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM, PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                                        PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES RequesterEmail,
                                                                        PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PersonDPEO,
                                                                        PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M AssignmentDPEO,
                                                                        PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V RequesterPhone,
                                                                        HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL RequesterLocation,
                                                                        HZ_PARTIES DeliverToCustContactPEO,
                                                                        GMS_AWARD_HEADERS_INFO_V GMSAHIV,
                                                                        PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                        HZ_LOCATIONS DelivertoCustLocation
WHERE Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = Requester.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN Requester.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Requester.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID = DeliverToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE = DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_CODE(+)
  AND DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'DESTINATION TYPE'
  AND Distribution.PO_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Distribution.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND SourceLine.SHIPPING_UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND SourceLine.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Distribution.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND SourceLine.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceLine.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterEmail.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = RequesterEmail.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = RequesterPhone.PHONE_ID(+)
       AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterPhone.DATE_FROM(+) AND NVL(RequesterPhone.DATE_TO(+),
                                                                    TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
  AND (Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND ((PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = AssignmentDPEO.PERSON_ID(+))
       AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
       AND (AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE(+) = 'Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.PRIMARY_FLAG(+)='Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE(+) IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')))
  AND AssignmentDPEO.LOCATION_ID = RequesterLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND RequesterLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_CONTACT_ID = DeliverToCustContactPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND GMSAHIV.contract_id(+) = Distribution.pjc_contract_id
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND Distribution.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE))
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = DelivertoCustLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
ORDER BY SourceLine.LINE_NUM, Distribution.DISTRIBUTION_NUM
```

### Query #31

### Query #31

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `DUAL, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL`

```sql
SELECT COALESCE (TO_NUMBER(:param_header_id),
                   (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                    FROM PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL Header, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES SoldToLe
                    WHERE Header.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
                      AND Header.SEGMENT1 = :param_doc_num
                      AND SoldToLe.NAME = :param_sold_to_le)) AS DocNum, NVL (:param_co_num,0) AS CoNum,
                                                                             :param_is_doc_status_draft_flag AS DraftFlag
FROM DUAL
WHERE 'Y' = :param_is_doc_status_draft_flag
```

### Query #32

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_HEADERS_ALL, DUAL`

```sql
SELECT COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(:param_header_id),
                  (SELECT PO_HEADER_ID
                   FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL Header, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES SoldToLe
                   WHERE Header.SOLDTO_LE_ID = SoldToLe.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
                     AND Header.SEGMENT1 = :param_doc_num
                     AND SoldToLe.NAME = :param_sold_to_le)) AS DocNum, NVL(:param_co_num,
                                                                          0) AS CO_NUM,
       :param_is_doc_status_draft_flag AS DraftFlag
FROM DUAL
WHERE 'N' = :param_is_doc_status_draft_flag
```

```sql
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS DelivertoCustPrefMethod,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS DeliveToCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DESTINATIONTYPECODE') AS DestinationTypeCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_address(ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, ShipToLocation.TOWN_OR_CITY,
                       ShipToLocation.POSTAL_CODE, ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.FLOOR_NUMBER, ShipToLocation.BUILDING,
                       ShipToLocation.COUNTRY, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE1,
                       Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE2, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3,
                       Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE4, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE5, 'N') AS LineLocShipToAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_line_loc(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID) AS Attachments, Header.BUYER_MANAGED_TRANSPORT_FLAG AS BuyerManagedTransportation,
       LineLocation.WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_SEQ AS WorkOrderOperationSeq,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS IsShiptoNameSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsShiptoContactSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS IsShiptoAddressSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsDelivertoConSameAsHeader,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINELOCATION') AS TextAttachmentsContent
FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_DRAFT_ALL LineLocation, PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL LINE,
                                                                  INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM,
                                                                  INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SecondaryUOM,
                                                                  EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                                                                  HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ShipToLocation,
                                                                  PER_ADDRESSES_F Address,
                                                                  PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL Header,
                                                                  HZ_PARTIES PartyPEO,
                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
                                                                  PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                  HZ_LOCATIONS NonInternalLocation
WHERE LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE = SecondaryUOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_LINE_ID = Line.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Line.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_ID = Address.ADDRESS_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN Address.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Address.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID = Header.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND LineLocation.CARRIER_ID = PartyPEO.PARTY_ID (+)
  AND (LineLocation.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (LineLocation.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = NonInternalLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM, LineLocation.SHIPMENT_NUM
```

```sql
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE1 AS Attribute1, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE2 AS Attribute2,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE3 AS Attribute3, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE4 AS Attribute4,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE5 AS Attribute5, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE6 AS Attribute6,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE7 AS Attribute7, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE8 AS Attribute8,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE9 AS Attribute9, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE10 AS Attribute10,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE11 AS Attribute11, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE12 AS Attribute12,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE13 AS Attribute13, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE14 AS Attribute14,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE15 AS Attribute15, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE16 AS Attribute16,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE17 AS Attribute17, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE18 AS Attribute18,

       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP7 AS AttributeTimestamp7, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP8 AS AttributeTimestamp8,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP9 AS AttributeTimestamp9, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP10 AS AttributeTimestamp10,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS AttributeNumber1, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2 AS AttributeNumber2,
       Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3 AS AttributeNumber3, Distribution.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4 AS AttributeNumber4,

       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_exptype_name(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID) AS ExpenditureTypeName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_worktype_name(Distribution.PJC_PROJECT_ID,
                       Distribution.PJC_WORK_TYPE_ID) AS WorkTypeName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_state_province(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_3, DeliverToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16) AS DeliverToLocStateProvn,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_region(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1, DeliverToLocation.REGION_2) AS DeliverToLocRegion,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_county(DeliverToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       DeliverToLocation.REGION_1) AS DeliverToLocCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_tax_display_dist(SourceHdr.CURRENCY_CODE,
                       Distribution.RECOVERABLE_TAX) AS RecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.NONRECOVERABLE_TAX) AS NonRecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.RECOVERABLE_INCLUSIVE_TAX) AS RecoverableInclusiveTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_display(Distribution.NONRECOVERABLE_INCLUSIVE_TAX) AS NonRecoverableInclTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_account_flex_data(Distribution.CODE_COMBINATION_ID)AS FlexData
FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_DRAFT_ALL Distribution, PO_HEADERS_DRAFT_ALL SourceHdr, PO_LINES_DRAFT_ALL SourceLine,
     PO_LOOKUP_CODES DestTypeLookup, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL DeliverToLocation, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V Requester,
     INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES RequesterEmail,
     PER_DISPLAY_PHONES_V RequesterPhone, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PersonDPEO, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M AssignmentDPEO,
     HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL RequesterLocation, PER_ADDRESSES_F RequesterAddress, HZ_LOCATIONS DelivertoCustLocation,
     HZ_PARTIES DeliverToCustContactPEO,GMS_AWARD_HEADERS_INFO_V GMSAHIV,
     PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO
WHERE Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = Requester.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN Requester.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Requester.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID = DeliverToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE = DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_CODE(+)
  AND DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'DESTINATION TYPE'
  AND Distribution.PO_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Distribution.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND SourceLine.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND SourceLine.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND SourceHdr.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND (Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterEmail.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = RequesterEmail.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = RequesterPhone.PHONE_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterPhone.DATE_FROM(+) AND NVL(RequesterPhone.DATE_TO(+),
                                                                    TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
  AND ((PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = AssignmentDPEO.PERSON_ID(+))
       AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
       AND (AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE(+) = 'Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.PRIMARY_FLAG(+)='Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE(+) IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')))
  AND AssignmentDPEO.LOCATION_ID = RequesterLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND RequesterLocation.ADDRESS_ID = RequesterAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+)
  AND TRUNC(sysdate) BETWEEN RequesterAddress.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND RequesterAddress.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = DelivertoCustLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_CONTACT_ID = DeliverToCustContactPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND GMSAHIV.contract_id(+) = Distribution.pjc_contract_id
ORDER BY SourceLine.LINE_NUM, Distribution.DISTRIBUTION_NUM
```

```sql
                       LineLocation.CO_QUANTITY_CANCELLED,
                       LineLocation.PRICE_OVERRIDE, LineLocation.CO_AMOUNT_CANCELLED) AS CancelledAmountDisplay, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('AMOUNT_CALC') AS AmountCalc,
       (NVL(LineLocation.QUANTITY, 0)- NVL(LineLocation.CO_QUANTITY_CANCELLED,
                                         0)) AS QuantityDisplay, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_amount_display AS AmountDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_total_tax_arch(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'LINELOCATIONS', Version.CO_SEQUENCE) AS TotalTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('RECOVERABLETAX_DISPLAY') AS RecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('NONRECOVERABLETAX_DISPLAY') AS NonRecoverableTaxDisplay,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_shipping_method(PartyPEO.PARTY_NAME,
                       ModeOfTransportLookupPEO.MEANING,
                       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.MEANING) AS ShippingMethod,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_customer_item_num(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'ARCHIVE') AS CustomerItem, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('CUSTOMERITEMDESC') AS CustomerItemDesc,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('CUSTOMERPONUMBER') AS CustomerPONumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('CUSTOMERPOLINENUMBER') AS CustomerPOLineNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('CUSTOMERPOSCHEDULENUMBER') AS CustomerPOScheduleNumber, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SALESORDERNUMBER') AS SalesOrderNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SALESORDERLINENUMBER') AS SalesOrderLineNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SALESORDERSCHEDULENUMBER') AS SalesOrderSchedule,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS ShipToCustomerName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS ShiptoCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTEMAILADDRESS') AS ShipToCustConEmailAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTPHONENUMBER') AS ShipToCustConPhoneNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTPHONETYPE') AS ShipToCustContactPhoneType,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS ShiptoCustPrefMethod, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS ShiptoCustAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTFLOORNUMBER') AS ShipToCustFloorNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTBUILDING') AS ShipToCustBuilding, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCITY') AS ShipToCustCity,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPROVINCE') AS ShipToCustProvince, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCOUNTY') AS ShipToCustCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTSTATE') AS ShipToCustState, PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTCOUNTRY') AS ShipToCustCountry,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALCODE') AS ShipToCustPostalCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTPOSTALPLUS4CODE') AS ShipToCustPostalPlus4Code,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS1') AS ShipToCustAddress1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS2') AS ShipToCustAddress2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS3') AS ShipToCustAddress3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS4') AS ShipToCustAddress4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE1') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt1,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE2') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt2,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE3') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt3,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE4') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt4,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('SHIPTOCUSTADDRELEMENTATTRIBUTE5') AS ShipToCustAddrElementAtt5,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONENUMBER') AS DeliverToCustPhoneNumber,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPHONETYPE') AS DeliverToCustPhoneType,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTPREFERREDCONTACTMETHOD') AS DelivertoCustPrefMethod,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS DeliveToCustContactName,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_global_attr('DESTINATIONTYPECODE') AS DestinationTypeCode,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_formatted_address(ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
                       ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, ShipToLocation.TOWN_OR_CITY,
                       ShipToLocation.POSTAL_CODE, ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.FLOOR_NUMBER, ShipToLocation.BUILDING,
                       ShipToLocation.COUNTRY, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE1,
                       Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE2, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3,
                       Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE4, Address.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE5, 'N') AS LineLocShipToAddress,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_attachments_data_line_loc(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID) AS Attachments, LineLocation.WORK_ORDER_OPERATION_SEQ AS WorkOrderOperationSeq,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTOMERNAME') AS IsShiptoNameSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsShiptoContactSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('SHIPTOCUSTADDRESS') AS IsShiptoAddressSameAsHeader,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.is_attr_same_as_header('DELIVERTOCUSTCONTACTNAME') AS IsDelivertoConSameAsHeader,
       po_bip_helper.get_text_attachment_data(LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID,
                       'PO', 'LINELOCATION') AS TextAttachmentsContent, Item.OUTSIDE_PROCESS_SERVICE_FLAG AS "OutsideProcessServiceFlag",
       LineLocation.allow_substitute_receipts_flag AS AllowSubstituteReceiptsFlag, LineLocation.amount AS Amount, PartyPEO.party_name AS CarrierName,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, 'C') ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE, LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE, NULL)) AS EntityChangeTypeCode, Line.CONSIGNMENT_LINE_FLAG AS IsLineConsigned,
       LineLocation.last_accept_date AS LastAcceptDate, ModeOfTransportLookupPEO.MEANING AS ModeOfTransportName,
       ServiceLevelLookupPEO.MEANING AS ServiceLevelName, LineLocation.QUANTITY AS Quantity,
       DECODE(NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y'),
         'N' ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(LineLocation.CANCEL_FLAG,
             'Y', 'CANCELLED',
             DECODE(LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE,
               'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)), 'CHANGED') ,
         DECODE(LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ,
           Version.CO_SEQUENCE,
           DECODE(LineLocation.CANCEL_FLAG,
             'Y', 'CANCELLED',
             DECODE(LineLocation.ENTITY_CHANGE_TYPE_CODE,
               'I', 'NEW', 'U', 'CHANGED', 'C', 'CHANGED', NULL)), NULL)) AS ScheduleStatus,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_1, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS1) AS ShipToLocAddressLine1,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_2, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS2) AS ShipToLocAddressLine2,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_3, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS3) AS ShipToLocAddressLine3,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL, ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_LINE_4, NonInternalLocation.ADDRESS4) AS ShipToLocAddressLine4,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL,
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_county(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_1), NonInternalLocation.COUNTY) AS ShipToLocCounty,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_region(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                       ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2) AS ShipToLocRegion,
       DECODE(LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID,
         NULL,
         PO_BIP_HELPER.get_state_province(ShipToLocation.COUNTRY,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_1, ShipToLocation.REGION_2,
                         ShipToLocation.REGION_3, ShipToLocation.LOC_INFORMATION16), NVL(NonInternalLocation.STATE,

                                                                                       NonInternalLocation.PROVINCE)) AS ShipToLocStateProvn, ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_1 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber1,
       ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_2 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber2, ShipToLocation.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_3 AS ShipToLocTelephoneNumber3,
       LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID AS ShipToLocationId, ShipToLocation.LOCATION_NAME AS ShipToLocationName,
       LineLocation.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID AS ShipToOrganizationId,
       PO_BIP_HELPER.get_uom_base_language(LineLocation.UOM_CODE) AS UomBaseLanguage
FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ARCHIVE_ALL LineLocation, PO_LINES_ARCHIVE_ALL LINE,
                                                                      INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL UOM,
                                                                      INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_VL SecondaryUOM,
                                                                      EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL Item,
                                                                      HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL ShipToLocation,
                                                                      PO_VERSIONS VERSION,
                                                                                  PER_ADDRESSES_F Address,
                                                                                  PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL Header,
                                                                                  PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL TransLineLocation,
                                                                                  HZ_PARTIES PartyPEO,
                                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ModeOfTransportLookupPEO,
                                                                                  FND_LOOKUPS ServiceLevelLookupPEO,
                                                                                  PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                                  HZ_LOCATIONS NonInternalLocation
WHERE LineLocation.SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID = ShipToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND ShipToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE = SecondaryUOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND LineLocation.PO_LINE_ID = Line.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Line.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND ShipToLocation.ADDRESS_ID = Address.ADDRESS_ID(+)
  AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN Address.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Address.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Line.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Line.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.PO_HEADER_ID = Header.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND Header.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND Header.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Header.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND LineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID = TransLineLocation.LINE_LOCATION_ID
  AND LineLocation.CARRIER_ID = PartyPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND (LineLocation.MODE_OF_TRANSPORT = ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ModeOftransportLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT')
  AND (LineLocation.SERVICE_LEVEL = ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_code(+)
       AND ServiceLevelLookupPEO.lookup_type(+) = 'WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS')
  AND (LineLocation.SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = NonInternalLocation.LOCATION_ID(+))
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND (LineLocation.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                OR EXISTS
                  (SELECT 'x'
                   FROM po_distributions_archive_all da1
                   WHERE da1.line_location_id = LineLocation.line_location_id
                     AND da1.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE
                     AND da1.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999
                     AND LineLocation.TO_CO_SEQ = 9999999))))
ORDER BY Line.LINE_NUM, LineLocation.SHIPMENT_NUM
```

```sql
                                                                        PO_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_ALL PurchasingSystemParameterPEO,
                                                                        HZ_LOCATIONS DelivertoCustLocation
WHERE Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = Requester.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN Requester.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND Requester.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID = DeliverToLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND DeliverToLocation.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND Distribution.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE = DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_CODE(+)
  AND DestTypeLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'DESTINATION TYPE'
  AND Distribution.PO_LINE_ID = SourceLine.PO_LINE_ID
  AND Distribution.PO_HEADER_ID = SourceHdr.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND SourceLine.UOM_CODE = UOM.UOM_CODE(+)
  AND SourceLine.ITEM_ID = Item.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID(+)
  AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND Distribution.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceHdr.PRC_BU_ID = PurchasingSystemParameterPEO.PRC_BU_ID
  AND SourceLine.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND SourceLine.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterEmail.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = RequesterEmail.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID(+))
  AND (PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = RequesterPhone.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = RequesterPhone.PHONE_ID(+)
       AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN RequesterPhone.DATE_FROM(+) AND NVL(RequesterPhone.DATE_TO(+),
                                                                    TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
  AND (Distribution.DELIVER_TO_PERSON_ID = PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID(+)
       AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
  AND ((PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID = AssignmentDPEO.PERSON_ID(+))
       AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
       AND (AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE(+) = 'Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.PRIMARY_FLAG(+)='Y'
            AND AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE(+) IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')))
  AND AssignmentDPEO.LOCATION_ID = RequesterLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND RequesterLocation.ADDRESS_ID = RequesterAddress.ADDRESS_ID(+)
  AND TRUNC(sysdate) BETWEEN RequesterAddress.effective_start_date(+) AND RequesterAddress.effective_end_date(+)
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_CONTACT_ID = DeliverToCustContactPEO.PARTY_ID(+)
  AND GMSAHIV.contract_id(+) = Distribution.pjc_contract_id
  AND ((NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'Y'
        AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ <= Version.CO_SEQUENCE
        AND Distribution.TO_CO_SEQ > Version.CO_SEQUENCE)
       OR (NVL(:param_pdf_mode, 'Y') = 'N'
           AND Distribution.FROM_CO_SEQ = Version.CO_SEQUENCE))
  AND Distribution.DELIVER_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID = DelivertoCustLocation.LOCATION_ID(+)
ORDER BY SourceLine.LINE_NUM, Distribution.DISTRIBUTION_NUM
```

### Query #39

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_CATEGORIES_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_HEADERS_ALL, BASE, INV_UOM_CONVERSIONS, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL`

### Query #39

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_CATEGORIES_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, PO_LINES_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, BASE, INV_UOM_CONVERSIONS`

```sql
WITH base AS
  (SELECT it.item_number AS itemnumber ,it.inventory_item_id AS itemid ,it.organization_id AS organizationid ,
          it.primary_uom_code AS uomitem ,pl.uom_code AS uomlinha ,pll.closed_date AS datafechamento ,
          ec.category_code AS codcateg ,ph.segment1 AS ordemcompra ,it.list_price_per_unit AS listpriceit ,
          pl.uom_code ,it.primary_uom_code ,pl.unit_price ,it.list_price_per_unit ,
          CASE
              WHEN pl.uom_code != it.primary_uom_code
                   AND ph.currency_code = 'USD' THEN
                     (SELECT round(((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate) * ph.rate), 2)
                      FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                      WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                        AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                        AND rownum = 1)
              WHEN pl.uom_code != it.primary_uom_code
                   AND ph.currency_code != 'USD' THEN
                     (SELECT round((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate), 2)
                      FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                      WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                        AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                        AND rownum = 1)
              WHEN pl.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                   AND ph.currency_code = 'USD' THEN
                     (SELECT round(((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate) * ph.rate), 2)
                      FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                      WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                        AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                        AND rownum = 1) ELSE round(pl.unit_price,
                                               2)
          END AS listpriceoc ,ph.rate ,ph.last_update_date ,row_number() over(PARTITION BY it.inventory_item_id
                                                                              ORDER BY pll.closed_date DESC,

                                                                           ph.last_update_date DESC) rn
   FROM egp_system_items_b it ,po_line_locations_all pll ,po_lines_all pl ,
        po_headers_all ph ,egp_categories_b ec
   WHERE it.organization_id = pll.ship_to_organization_id
     AND pl.po_line_id = pll.po_line_id
     AND pl.po_header_id = ph.po_header_id
     AND pl.category_id = ec.category_id
     AND nvl(ec.attribute1, 'N') = 'Y'
     AND pll.schedule_status = 'CLOSED'
     AND pl.item_id = it.inventory_item_id
     AND CASE
             WHEN pl.uom_code != it.primary_uom_code
                  AND ph.currency_code = 'USD' THEN
                    (SELECT round(((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate) * ph.rate), 2)
                     FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                     WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                       AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                       AND rownum = 1)
             WHEN pl.uom_code != it.primary_uom_code
                  AND ph.currency_code != 'USD' THEN
                    (SELECT round((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate), 2)
                     FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                     WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                       AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                       AND rownum = 1)
             WHEN pl.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                  AND ph.currency_code = 'USD' THEN
                    (SELECT ((pl.unit_price / iuc.conversion_rate * iuc1.conversion_rate) * ph.rate)
                     FROM inv_uom_conversions iuc ,inv_uom_conversions iuc1
                     WHERE iuc.uom_code = pl.uom_code
                       AND iuc1.uom_code = it.primary_uom_code
                       AND rownum = 1) ELSE pl.unit_price
         END != it.list_price_per_unit
     AND ph.last_update_date >=(FROM_TZ(TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_update_date,
                                          'dd/mm/yyyy hh24:mi:ss'),
                                  'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
SELECT itemnumber ,itemid ,organizationid ,uomitem ,uomlinha ,datafechamento ,codcateg ,
       ordemcompra ,round(listpriceit, 2) listpriceit ,uom_code ,primary_uom_code ,unit_price ,
       round(list_price_per_unit, 2) list_price_per_unit ,listpriceoc ,rate ,last_update_date
FROM base
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY itemid
```

### Query #40

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `RCV_TRANSACTIONS`

### Query #40

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `RCV_TRANSACTIONS`

```sql
SELECT rt.ATTRIBUTE3 ATTRIBUTE3, fubuv.BU_NAME BU, pua.USER_GUID GUID_COMPRADOR,
       pub.USER_GUID GUID_CRIADOR_DEVOLUCAO, pha.PO_HEADER_ID, pha.SEGMENT1 PO, rt.CREATED_BY CRIADOR_DA_DEVOLUCAO,
       peb.EMAIL_ADDRESS EMAIL_CRIADO_DEVOLUCAO, pha.AGENT_ID ID_COMPRADOR, pea.EMAIL_ADDRESS, iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE ORG,
       fdh.DOCUMENT_NUMBER DOCUMENT_NUMBER
FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS RT, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FUBUV, PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PEA, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PEB, PER_USERS PUA, PER_USERS PUB,
     CMF_RCV_TRANSACTIONS_DTLS CRT, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS FDH, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
WHERE RT.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RETURN TO VENDOR'
  AND RT.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND FUBUV.BU_ID = PHA.PRC_BU_ID
  AND RT.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND PUA.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PHA.AGENT_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PUB.USERNAME = RT.CREATED_BY
  AND PEA.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PEB.PERSON_ID = PUB.PERSON_ID
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND PEA.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
  AND RT.CREATION_DATE >= NVL(TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_CREATION_DATE,
                                'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"'), TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND RT.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
     FROM RCV_TRANSACTIONS B
     WHERE B.TRANSACTION_ID = RT.TRANSACTION_ID)
  AND RT.CREATION_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_CREATION_DATE,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')
  AND CRT.RCV_TRANSACTION_ID = RT.PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
  AND CRT.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID = FDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
GROUP BY pha.SEGMENT1, rt.CREATED_BY, pha.AGENT_ID, pea.EMAIL_ADDRESS, rt.ATTRIBUTE3,
         pha.PO_HEADER_ID, pub.USER_GUID, pua.USER_GUID, peb.EMAIL_ADDRESS, fubuv.BU_NAME,
         fdh.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, iop.ORGANIZATION_CODE
ORDER BY PO
```

### Query #41

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `RCV_TRANSACTIONS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

```sql
SELECT pla.po_header_id, pla.po_line_id, pla.item_description, esib.item_number,
       iop.organization_code, rt.attribute1, itr.reason_name
FROM egp_system_items_b esib, po_lines_all pla, inv_org_parameters iop,

  (SELECT r.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.po_header_id, r.po_line_id
                             ORDER BY r.last_update_date DESC) rn
   FROM rcv_transactions r
   WHERE r.transaction_type = 'RETURN TO VENDOR') rt, inv_transaction_reasons_tl itr
WHERE pla.item_id = esib.inventory_item_id
  AND rt.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
  AND rt.po_line_id = pla.po_line_id
  AND iop.organization_id = rt.organization_id
  AND esib.organization_id = rt.organization_id
  AND itr.reason_id (+) = rt.reason_id
  AND itr.language (+) = 'PTB'
  AND itr.source_lang (+) = USERENV('LANG')
  AND RT.CREATION_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:P_CREATION_DATE,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')
  AND rt.rn = 1
```

### Query #42

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES, DOO_LINES_ALL, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS, RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES, RCV_TRANSACTIONS...`

### Query #42

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL, RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS, RCV_TRANSACTIONS, RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES...`

```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' THEN PHA.SEGMENT1
           WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'INTERNAL_REQUISITION' THEN PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER
           WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'RETURN_MATERIAL_AUTHORIZATION' THEN DHA.ORDER_NUMBER
       END AS PO,
       CASE WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' THEN PLA.LINE_NUM
           WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'INTERNAL_REQUISITION' THEN PRLA.LINE_NUMBER
           WHEN FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'RETURN_MATERIAL_AUTHORIZATION' THEN DLA.LINE_NUMBER
       END AS PO_LINE_NUMBER, FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID3 AS LINE_LOCATION_ID, FDCL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID,

  (SELECT PDA_PO.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE
   FROM PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA_PO
   WHERE PDA_PO.PO_LINE_ID = PLA.PO_LINE_ID
     AND rownum <=1) AS PO_DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE, PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER AS REQUISITION_NUMBER,
       PRLA.LINE_NUMBER AS REQ_LINE_NUMBER, RCV_PO.TRANSACTION_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID_PO,
       RCV_PO.PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID AS PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID_PO, RCV_REQ.TRANSACTION_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID_REQ,
       RCV_REQ.PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID AS PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID_REQ, RCV_REQ.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE AS DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE_REQ,
       RCV_REQ.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID AS SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID_REQ, RSH.SHIPMENT_NUM AS SHIPMENT_NUM_REQ,
       RCV_RMA.TRANSACTION_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID_RMA, RCV_RMA.PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID AS PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID_RMA,
       RCV_RMA.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE AS DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE_RMA
FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES FD_SCHDL
LEFT JOIN CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_VL FDCL ON FD_SCHDL.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FDCL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA ON (PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID3
                                         AND FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'PURCHASE_ORDER')
LEFT JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA ON (PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID)
LEFT JOIN PO_LINES_ALL PLA ON (PLA.PO_LINE_ID = PLLA.PO_LINE_ID)
LEFT JOIN RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS RSH ON (RSH.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID1)
LEFT JOIN RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES RSL ON (RSL.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID1
                                     AND RSL.SHIPMENT_LINE_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID2
                                     AND FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'INTERNAL_REQUISITION')
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA ON (PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = RSL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID)
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA ON (PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID)
LEFT JOIN DOO_HEADERS_ALL DHA ON (DHA.HEADER_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID1
                                  AND FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE = 'RETURN_MATERIAL_AUTHORIZATION')
LEFT JOIN DOO_LINES_ALL DLA ON (DLA.LINE_ID = FD_SCHDL.SOURCE_DOC_ID2)
LEFT JOIN RCV_TRANSACTIONS RCV_PO ON RCV_PO.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FDCL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
AND RCV_PO.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID = PLLA.LINE_LOCATION_ID
AND RCV_PO.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RECEIVE'
AND RCV_PO.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CODE = 'PO'
LEFT JOIN RCV_TRANSACTIONS RCV_REQ ON RCV_REQ.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FDCL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
AND RCV_REQ.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RECEIVE'
AND RCV_REQ.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CODE = 'TRANSFER ORDER'
LEFT JOIN RCV_TRANSACTIONS RCV_RMA ON RCV_RMA.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FDCL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
AND RCV_RMA.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RECEIVE'
AND RCV_RMA.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CODE = 'RMA'
WHERE 1=1
```

### Query #43

```sql
SELECT rsh.receipt_num AS numero_recebimento, rsl.line_num AS linha_recebimento,
```

### Query #44

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, CORRETO, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL`

### Query #44

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, CORRETO, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ITOH.HEADER_NUMBER AS release_xid, ITOL.LINE_ID AS release_line_xid,
                ITOL.LINE_NUMBER AS release_line_number, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER AS item_xid, ESIITL.DESCRIPTION AS item_name,
                ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id, ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS inventory_item_id,
                PRLA.QUANTITY AS packaged_item_count, 'KG' AS weight_uom_gid,
                NVL(ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT, 0) * NVL(PRLA.QUANTITY,
                                             0) AS total_weight, 'CUMTR' AS volume_uom_gid,
                NVL(ESIB.UNIT_VOLUME, 0) * NVL(PRLA.QUANTITY,
                                             0) AS total_volume,
                TO_CHAR(NVL(PRLA.NEED_BY_DATE, DATE '1900-01-01'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS late_delivery_dt, NVL(WDD.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE,

                                                                                                              '33333') AS ind_return,
                WDD.SOURCE_HEADER_ID, NVL(TO_CHAR(WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID),
                                        '') AS delivery_detail_id
FROM POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
JOIN POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA ON PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS ITOH ON PRLA.TO_HEADER_ID = ITOH.HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES ITOL ON PRLA.TO_LINE_ID = ITOL.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS WDD ON WDD.SOURCE_LINE_ID = ITOL.LINE_ID
AND WDD.SOURCE_HEADER_ID = ITOH.HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ON ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PRLA.ITEM_ID
AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = PRLA.SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_ID
LEFT JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL ON ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND ESIITL.LANGUAGE = 'US'
WHERE PRHA.INTERNAL_TRANSFER_REQ_FLAG = 'Y'
```

### Query #45

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `PO_HEADERS_ALL, CMR_TRANSACTIONS, DUAL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS`

### Query #45

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `DUAL, CMR_TRANSACTIONS, PO_LINES_ALL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT NUMERO_NFE, SERIE_NFE, CHAVE_NFE, VALOR_TOTAL_NFE, DATA_EMISSAO, STATUS_NFE,
       CNPJ_FORNECEDOR, CNPJ_EMPRESA, UNIDADE_NEGOCIO, LOCAL_ENTREGA, NUMERO_ORDEM_COMPRA,
       NUMERO_LINHA_PO
FROM
  (SELECT H.DOCUMENT_NUMBER AS NUMERO_NFE, H.SERIES AS SERIE_NFE, H.ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER AS CHAVE_NFE,
          H.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS VALOR_TOTAL_NFE, H.ISSUE_DATE AS DATA_EMISSAO, H.DOCUMENT_STATUS AS STATUS_NFE,
          H.ISSUER_TAX_ID AS CNPJ_FORNECEDOR, H.RECEIVER_TAX_ID AS CNPJ_EMPRESA,
          H.BILL_TO_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID AS UNIDADE_NEGOCIO, H.SHIPTO_LOCATION_ID AS LOCAL_ENTREGA,
          PO.SEGMENT1 AS NUMERO_ORDEM_COMPRA, POL.LINE_NUM AS NUMERO_LINHA_PO, H.CREATION_DATE,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
                             ORDER BY H.CREATION_DATE DESC) AS RN
   FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS H
   INNER JOIN CMR_TRANSACTIONS T ON H.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = T.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
   INNER JOIN PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL ON T.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID = PLL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
   INNER JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL PO ON PLL.PO_HEADER_ID = PO.PO_HEADER_ID
   INNER JOIN PO_LINES_ALL POL ON PO.PO_HEADER_ID = POL.PO_HEADER_ID
   WHERE H.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'CAPTURED'
     AND PO.SEGMENT1 = 'OC644'
     AND (:P_EXCLUDED_KEYS IS NULL
          OR :P_EXCLUDED_KEYS = ''
          OR H.ACCESS_KEY_NUMBER NOT IN
            (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_KEYS, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
             FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(:P_EXCLUDED_KEYS,
                                    '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)))
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE DESC
```

### Query #46

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Order Management, SCM - Purchasing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #46

**Tags:** `SCM - Purchasing, SCM - Order Management, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, INV_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADERS, POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT 'SALES_ORDER' AS document_type, TO_CHAR(h.order_number) AS order_number,
          h.freight_terms_code AS original_fob,
          CASE WHEN UPPER(h.freight_terms_code) = 'CIF' THEN '0' WHEN UPPER(h.freight_terms_code) = 'FOB' THEN '1' ELSE h.freight_terms_code
          END AS final_fob_code
   FROM doo_headers_all h
   WHERE TO_CHAR(h.order_number) = :P_ORDER_NUMBER
   UNION ALL SELECT 'TRANSFER_ORDER', TO_CHAR(t.header_number), rh.attribute6 AS original_fob,
                    CASE WHEN UPPER(rh.attribute6) = 'CIF' THEN '0' WHEN UPPER(rh.attribute6) = 'FOB' THEN '1' ELSE NULL
                    END AS final_fob_code
   FROM inv_transfer_order_headers t
   LEFT JOIN inv_transfer_order_lines tl ON tl.header_id = t.header_id
   LEFT JOIN por_requisition_lines_all rl ON rl.requisition_line_id = tl.requisition_line_id
   LEFT JOIN por_requisition_headers_all rh ON rh.requisition_header_id = rl.requisition_header_id
   WHERE TO_CHAR(t.header_number) = :P_ORDER_NUMBER
   UNION ALL SELECT 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR', TO_CHAR(r.requisition_number), r.attribute6 AS original_fob,
                    CASE WHEN UPPER(r.attribute6) = 'CIF' THEN '0' WHEN UPPER(r.attribute6) = 'FOB' THEN '1' ELSE NULL
                    END AS final_fob_code
   FROM por_requisition_headers_all r
   WHERE TO_CHAR(r.requisition_number) = :P_ORDER_NUMBER) base
ORDER BY CASE WHEN document_type = 'SALES_ORDER' THEN 1 WHEN document_type = 'TRANSFER_ORDER' THEN 2 WHEN document_type = 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR' THEN 3
         END FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
```

## SCM - Order Management

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `ORDERED, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, INVOICED, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL`

```sql
WITH ordered AS
  (SELECT header_id, order_number, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all
   GROUP BY header_id, order_number),
     invoiced AS
  (SELECT dfl.header_id, SUM(jfdla.quantity) AS invoiced_qty
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   JOIN wsh_delivery_details wdd ON wdd.source_shipment_id = dfl.fulfill_line_id
   JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments wda ON wda.delivery_detail_id = wdd.delivery_detail_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdha ON jfdha.trx_id = wda.delivery_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdra ON jfdra.doc_hdr_id = jfdha.doc_hdr_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_lines_all jfdla ON jfdla.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
   WHERE jfdra.status = 'APPROVED'
   GROUP BY dfl.header_id)
SELECT o.order_number,
       CASE WHEN NVL(i.invoiced_qty, 0) < o.ordered_qty THEN 'PartialInvoicing' ELSE 'Invoiced'
       END AS new_status
FROM ordered o
JOIN invoiced i ON i.header_id = o.header_id
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT dha.header_id, dha.order_number, dha.org_id,
       dha.transactional_currency_code currency_code, dha.status_code status, dha.open_flag, dha.canceled_flag,
       dha.payment_term_id_f payment_term_id, hp.party_name, doa.party_site_id,
       to_char(dha.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') creation_date, dha.created_by,
       to_char(dha.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') last_update_date, dha.last_updated_by
FROM doo_headers_all dha, ra_terms RT, hz_parties hp, doo_order_addresses doa
WHERE dha.payment_term_id_f = RT.term_id
  AND RT.prepayment_flag = 'Y'
  AND dha.sold_to_party_id = hp.party_id(+)
  AND doa.header_id(+) = dha.header_id
  AND doa.address_use_type(+) = 'SHIP_TO'
  AND (:dtlast IS NULL
       OR dha.last_update_date > TO_DATE(:dtlast,
                                   'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL`

```sql
WITH effOrdem AS
  (SELECT DHEFB.*
   FROM DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DHEFB
   WHERE DHEFB.CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesDaOrdem'),
     effComp AS
  (SELECT DHEFB.*
   FROM DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DHEFB
   WHERE DHEFB.CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesComplementares')
SELECT rcta.TRX_NUMBER AS TRX_NUMBER ,JFDRA.DOC_NUM AS DOC_NUM ,JFDRA.STATUS AS STATUS ,
       DH_COMP.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS FixacaoId
FROM JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL JFHDR ,JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL JFDRA ,JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL JFDLA ,
     RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL RCTA ,RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL RCTLA ,DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL DLA ,
     effOrdem DH_EFF ,effComp DH_COMP
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND JFDRA.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
  AND JFHDR.ENTITY_CODE = 'TRANSACTIONS'
  AND JFHDR.EVENT_CLASS_CODE = 'INVOICE'
  AND JFHDR.DOC_HDR_ID = JFDRA.DOC_HDR_ID
  AND JFDLA.DOC_HDR_ID = JFHDR.DOC_HDR_ID
  AND JFDLA.TRX_LEVEL_TYPE = 'LINE'
  AND JFDLA.TRX_LINE_NUMBER = 1
  AND RCTA.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = JFHDR.TRX_ID
  AND RCTLA.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = RCTA.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
  AND RCTLA.CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID = JFDLA.TRX_LINE_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(DLA.FULFILL_LINE_ID) = RCTLA.INTERFACE_LINE_ATTRIBUTE6
  AND DH_EFF.HEADER_ID = DLA.HEADER_ID
  AND DH_EFF.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR5 = 'GCO12'
  AND DH_COMP.HEADER_ID = DLA.HEADER_ID
  AND DH_COMP.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 IS NOT NULL
  AND DH_COMP.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 = :pFixacaoId
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dol.source_order_number, 'Cancelled' AS new_status
FROM doo_headers_all dha , doo_headers_eff_b dheb , doo_fulfill_lines_all dol
WHERE dha.header_id = dheb.header_id
  AND dha.header_id = dol.header_id
  AND dheb.attribute_char1 = 'SALESFORCE'
  AND dol.status_code = 'CANCELED'
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dol2
     WHERE dol2.header_id = dol.header_id
       AND dol2.status_code <> 'CANCELED')
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, FUSION, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS`

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, FUSION, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT OH.SOURCE_ORDER_NUMBER , HDI.DOO_HEADER_ID , HDI.DOO_LINE_ID , HDI.FULFILL_LINE_ID ,
       HDI.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 , DHCB.HOLD_CODE , DHCT.HOLD_NAME , DHCT.HOLD_DESCRIPTION , DHCT.HOLD_CODE_ID ,
       DHCB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE , DHCB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE , DHCB.GENERAL_HOLD_FLAG , DHCB.SYSTEM_FLAG ,
       DHCB.APPLY_HOLD_ROLE_ELIGIBILITY , DHCB.RELEASE_HOLD_ROLE_ELIGIBILITY , HDI.PENDING_FLAG , HDI.DELETED_FLAG ,
       HDI.HOLD_INSTANCE_ID , HDI.APPLY_SYSTEM , HDI.APPLY_DATE , HDI.APPLY_USER_ID , HDI.RELEASE_USER_ID ,
       HDI.RELEASE_DATE , HDI.HOLD_RUNNING_TASK_FLAG , HDI.HOLD_COMMENTS ,
       HDI.HOLD_RELEASE_REASON_CODE , HDI.HOLD_RELEASE_COMMENTS , HDI.ACTIVE_FLAG , HDI.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 ,
       OH.last_update_date , OH.ON_HOLD
FROM FUSION.DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES HDI , FUSION.DOO_HEADERS_ALL OH , FUSION.DOO_LINES_ALL OL ,
     FUSION.DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL FL , FUSION.DOO_HOLD_CODES_B DHCB , FUSION.DOO_HOLD_CODES_TL DHCT ,
     FUSION.DOO_FULFILL_LINES_EFF_B DFLEB , DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DHEB
WHERE HDI.HOLD_CODE_ID = DHCB.HOLD_CODE_ID
  AND OH.HEADER_ID = OL.HEADER_ID
  AND OH.HEADER_ID = FL.HEADER_ID
  AND FL.LINE_ID = OL.LINE_ID
  AND OH.HEADER_ID = DHEB.HEADER_ID
  AND TRUNC(oh.creation_date) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND ((TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_LINES_V'
        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = OL.LINE_ID)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = OH.HEADER_ID)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = FL.FULFILL_LINE_ID))
  AND DHCT.HOLD_CODE_ID = DHCB.HOLD_CODE_ID
  AND DHCT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
  AND OH.SUBMITTED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND DFLEB.fulfill_line_id = FL.fulfill_line_id
  AND dhcb.HOLD_CODE IN ('PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO', 'PLU_RECLASSIFICACAO_LIMITE')
  AND DHEB.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR1 = 'SALESFORCE'
  AND OH.ON_HOLD = 'Y'
  AND CAST(OH.last_update_date AS DATE) BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_START_TIMESTAMP,
                                                          1, 19),
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_END_TIMESTAMP,

                                                                                           1,
                                                                                           19),

                                                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl2
     JOIN wsh_delivery_details wdd ON wdd.source_shipment_id = dfl2.fulfill_line_id
     JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments wda ON wda.delivery_detail_id = wdd.delivery_detail_id
     JOIN jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdha ON jfdha.trx_id = wda.delivery_id
     JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdra ON jfdra.doc_hdr_id = jfdha.doc_hdr_id
     WHERE dfl2.header_id = OH.header_id
       AND jfdra.status = 'APPROVED')
ORDER BY OH.CREATION_DATE DESC
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL, ORDERED, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, INVOICED, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Order Management, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B, ORDERED, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_LINES_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, INVOICED, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL`

```sql
WITH ordered AS
  (SELECT dha.header_id, dha.order_number, SUM(dfl.ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
   FROM doo_headers_all dha
   JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dfl.header_id = dha.header_id
   WHERE 1=1
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM doo_headers_eff_b dheb
        WHERE dheb.header_id = dha.header_id
          AND dheb.attribute_char1 = 'SALESFORCE')
   GROUP BY dha.header_id, dha.order_number),
     invoiced AS
  (SELECT dfl.header_id, SUM(jfdla.trx_line_quantity) AS invoiced_qty
   FROM doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl
   JOIN wsh_delivery_details wdd ON wdd.source_shipment_id = dfl.fulfill_line_id
   JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments wda ON wda.delivery_detail_id = wdd.delivery_detail_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdha ON jfdha.trx_id = wda.delivery_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdra ON jfdra.doc_hdr_id = jfdha.doc_hdr_id
   JOIN jg_fscl_doc_lines_all jfdla ON jfdla.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
   WHERE jfdra.status = 'APPROVED'
   GROUP BY dfl.header_id)
SELECT o.order_number,
       CASE WHEN i.invoiced_qty < o.ordered_qty THEN 'PartialInvoicing' ELSE 'Invoiced'
       END AS new_status
FROM ordered o
JOIN invoiced i ON i.header_id = o.header_id
```

### Query #7

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DOO_LINES_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, DOO_DOCUMENT_REFERENCES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #7

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, DOO_LINES_ALL, DOO_DOCUMENT_REFERENCES, DOO_HEADERS_ALL, DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dha.source_order_number AS oracleCode,

  (SELECT MIN(dcr.doc_user_key)
   FROM doo_document_references dcr
   WHERE dcr.header_id = dha.header_id
     AND dcr.doc_ref_type = 'ORIGINAL_SALES_ORDER') AS originalOrder,

  (SELECT SUM(dla_orig.ordered_qty)
   FROM doo_headers_all dha_orig
   JOIN doo_lines_all dla_orig ON dha_orig.header_id = dla_orig.header_id
   WHERE dha_orig.source_order_number =
       (SELECT MIN(dcr.doc_user_key)
        FROM doo_document_references dcr
        WHERE dcr.header_id = dha.header_id
          AND dcr.doc_ref_type = 'ORIGINAL_SALES_ORDER')
     AND dla_orig.inventory_item_id = dfl.inventory_item_id) AS originalQuantity, dla.line_id AS itemOracleCode, esi.item_number AS productCode,
                dla.unit_selling_price AS unitPrice, dla.ordered_qty AS quantity, dha.header_id,
                dfl.fulfill_line_number AS lineNumber
FROM doo_headers_all dha
JOIN doo_lines_all dla ON dha.header_id = dla.header_id
JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dfl.line_id = dla.line_id
JOIN egp_system_items_b esi ON dfl.inventory_item_id = esi.inventory_item_id
AND dfl.fulfill_org_id = esi.organization_id
```

### Query #9

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dha.header_id, dha.order_number AS oracleCode,
                MIN(TO_CHAR(jfdra.fiscal_doc_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS invoiceDate, SUM(jfdla.trx_line_quantity) AS invoiceQuantity
FROM doo_headers_all dha
JOIN doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dha.header_id = dfl.header_id
JOIN wsh_delivery_details wdd ON dfl.fulfill_line_id = wdd.source_shipment_id
JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments wda ON wdd.delivery_detail_id = wda.delivery_detail_id
JOIN jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdha ON wda.delivery_id = jfdha.trx_id
JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdra ON jfdha.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
JOIN jg_fscl_doc_lines_all jfdla ON jfdra.doc_hdr_id = jfdla.doc_hdr_id
WHERE jfdra.status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY dha.header_id, dha.order_number
```

### Query #10

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `MSC_XREF_MAPPING, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #10

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_ALL, MSC_XREF_MAPPING`

```sql
SELECT wdd.REQUESTED_QUANTITY SourceRequestedQuantity, dha.order_number OrderNumber, dfla.SOURCE_LINE_NUMBER LineNumber,
       mp.organization_code OrganizationCode, hp.party_number CustomerNumber,

  (SELECT mxm.SOURCE_VALUE
   FROM MSC_XREF_MAPPING MXM, MSC_APPs_INSTANCEs Mai
   WHERE mxm.SR_INSTANCE_ID = MAI.instance_id
     AND entity_name LIKE 'FOB'
     AND dha.fob_point_code = mxm.target_value
     AND mxm.target_value = dha.fob_point_code) FOBCode, da_peso.attribute_number2 GrossWeight,
       da_peso.attribute_number3 NetWeight, da_peso.attribute_number4 Volume, hps.party_site_number PartySiteNumber,
       dfle.attribute_char4 Shipment, dfle.attribute_char2 preloadpedid, da.attribute_char14 Driver,
       da.attribute_char15 PlacaCavalinho, da.attribute_char16 PlacaCarreta1, da.attribute_char17 PlacaCarreta2,
       da.attribute_char18 PlacaCarreta3
FROM doo_headers_All dha, doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla, doo_headers_eff_b da, doo_headers_eff_b da_peso,
     doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b dfle, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS wda, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS wdd,
     wsh_new_deliveries wnd, inv_org_parameters mp, hz_parties hp, hz_party_sites hps
WHERE DHA.HEADER_ID = DFLA.HEADER_ID
  AND DFLA.FULFILL_LINE_ID = WDD.SOURCE_SHIPMENT_ID
  AND wda.delivery_id = wnd.delivery_id(+)
  AND Wdd.Delivery_detail_id = wda.delivery_detail_id
  AND da.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND da_peso.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND mp.organization_id = wdd.organization_id
  AND mp.organization_id = dfla.fulfill_org_id
  AND hp.party_id = dfla.ship_to_party_id
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND hps.party_site_id = dfla.ship_to_party_site_id
  AND wdd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER'
  AND da.context_code = 'InformacoesDaOrdem'
  AND da_peso.context_code = 'InformacoesComplementares'
  AND dfle.context_code(+) = 'InformacoesDaLinha'
  AND (da.attribute_char5 IN ('CREATE_SHIP', 'SHIP')
       OR da.attribute_char1 IN ('MANUAL', 'CREATE', 'COPIA'))
  AND wdd.released_status IN ('R', 'B')
  AND dfle.fulfill_line_id(+) = dfla.fulfill_line_id
  AND dha.change_version_number =
    (SELECT MAX(t.change_version_number)
     FROM doo_headers_all t
     WHERE t.source_order_id = dha.source_order_id)
ORDER BY dha.creation_date DESC, dha.order_number
```

```sql
SELECT wdd.REQUESTED_QUANTITY SourceRequestedQuantity, dha.order_number OrderNumber, wdd.SOURCE_LINE_NUMBER LineNumber,
       mp.organization_code OrganizationCode, hp.party_number CustomerNumber, nvl(wdd.gross_weight,
                                                                                0) GrossWeight,
       nvl(wdd.net_weight, 0) NetWeight, nvl(volume,
                                           0) Volume, hps.party_site_number PartySiteNumber,
       dfle.attribute_char4 Shipment, dfle.attribute_char2 preloadpedid, da.attribute_char14 Driver,
       da.attribute_char15 PlacaCavalinho, da.attribute_char16 PlacaCarreta1, da.attribute_char17 PlacaCarreta2,
       da.attribute_char18 PlacaCarreta3
FROM doo_headers_All dha, doo_fulfill_lines_all dfla, doo_headers_eff_b da,
     doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b dfle, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS wda, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS wdd,
     inv_org_parameters mp, hz_parties hp, hz_party_sites hps
WHERE DHA.HEADER_ID = DFLA.HEADER_ID
  AND DFLA.FULFILL_LINE_ID = WDD.SOURCE_SHIPMENT_ID
  AND Wdd.Delivery_detail_id = wda.delivery_detail_id
  AND da.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND mp.organization_id = wdd.organization_id
  AND mp.organization_id = dfla.fulfill_org_id
  AND hp.party_id = dfla.ship_to_party_id
  AND hp.party_id = hps.party_id
  AND wdd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER'
  AND da.context_code = 'InformacoesDaOrdem'
  AND dfle.context_code(+) = 'InformacoesDaLinha'
  AND (da.attribute_char5 = 'CREATE_SHIP'
       OR da.attribute_char1 IN ('MANUAL', 'CREATE', 'COPIA'))
  AND wdd.released_status = 'R'
  AND dfle.fulfill_line_id(+) = dfla.fulfill_line_id
  AND dha.change_version_number =
    (SELECT MAX(t.change_version_number)
     FROM doo_headers_all t
     WHERE t.source_order_id = dha.source_order_id)
  AND dha.order_number = '1523'
ORDER BY dha.order_number, dha.creation_date DESC
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_LINES_ALL, DOO_HEADERS_ALL`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Order Management`

**Tabelas:** `DOO_HEADERS_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL`

```sql
SELECT dha.order_number ,hp.party_name ,dha.creation_date ,rcta.trx_number ,
       SUM(DLA.EXTENDED_AMOUNT) TotalPedido ,SUM(nvl(rctla.EXTENDED_AMOUNT,
                                                   0)) TotalFatura ,hou.name ,
       arm.name MetodoPagamento
FROM DOO_HEADERS_ALL dha ,DOO_LINES_ALL dla ,RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL rcta ,RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL rctla ,
     DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B dheb ,ar_receipt_methods arm ,HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS hou ,HZ_PARTIES HP
WHERE 1=1
  AND dha.order_number = rcta.interface_header_attribute1(+)
  AND dha.order_number = rctla.SALES_ORDER(+)
  AND dla.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND dheb.header_id = dha.header_id
  AND arm.receipt_method_id = dheb.attribute_char3
  AND hou.organization_id = dha.org_id
  AND dha.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX (dha2.last_update_date)
     FROM doo_headers_all dha2
     WHERE dha.header_id = dha2.header_id)
  AND dla.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX (dla2.last_update_date)
     FROM doo_lines_all dla2
     WHERE dla.line_id = dla2.line_id)
  AND dha.status_CODE = 'OPEN'
  AND TO_CHAR(dha.creation_date) > TO_CHAR(:P_DATE)
  AND dha.SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID = hp.PARTY_ID
GROUP BY dha.order_number, rcta.trx_number, hou.name, arm.name, dha.creation_date, hp.party_name
```

### Query #13

```sql
SELECT 'OV' operacao, hp.party_number customerNumber,
```
