## SCM - Inventory & Costing

### Query #1

## SCM - Inventory & Costing

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL_V, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL`

```sql
WITH tab_orgs AS
  (SELECT flv.attribute1 bu_name, flv.attribute2 organization_code, flv.attribute3 location_code,
          flv.attribute4 bu_osgt, flv.attribute5 supplier_number, flv.attribute6 party_site_code,
          flv.attribute7 vendor_site_code, flv.attribute8 organization_osgt, flv.attribute9 location_osgt,
          flv.attribute10 terms_name, flv.attribute11 area_negocio, flv.attribute12 importador
   FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl flv
   WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'OSGT_ORG_IMPORTADOR'
     AND flv.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND flv.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
     AND flv.end_date_active >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
SELECT esiv.inventory_item_id, esiv.organization_id, iop.master_organization_id,
       esiv.item_number ppartnumber, tab_orgs.organization_osgt pcodorganizacao,
       esiv.primary_uom_code punidadeestoque,

  (SELECT ec.category_code
   FROM egp_item_categories eic, egp_categories_vl ec, egp_category_sets_vl ecsv
   WHERE eic.inventory_item_id = esiv.inventory_item_id
     AND eic.organization_id = esiv.organization_id
     AND eic.category_set_id = ecsv.category_set_id
     AND ec.category_id = eic.category_id
     AND ecsv.category_set_name = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE') pncm, esiv.unit_weight ppesobruto, esiv.unit_weight ppesoliquido,
       esiv.unit_weight ppesoquilo, esiv.unit_weight ppesounidcomercializada,

  (SELECT esit.description
   FROM egp_system_items_tl_v esit
   WHERE esiv.inventory_item_id = esit.inventory_item_id
     AND esiv.organization_id = esit.organization_id
     AND esit.language = 'PTB') pdescricaoresumida,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(esiv.inventory_item_status_code) = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N'
       END pstatus, esiv.weight_uom_code punidadepeso, esiv.primary_uom_code pcodunidadeqtde,
       esiv.primary_uom_code pcodunidadecomercializada, esiv.primary_uom_code pcodunidadeunitaria, esiv.item_type ptipoproduto,

  (SELECT CASE WHEN ec.category_code IN ('0', '4', '5', '8') THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
          END pprocedencia
   FROM egp_item_categories eic, egp_categories_vl ec, egp_category_sets_vl ecsv
   WHERE eic.inventory_item_id = esiv.inventory_item_id
     AND eic.organization_id = esiv.organization_id
     AND eic.category_set_id = ecsv.category_set_id
     AND ec.category_id = eic.category_id
     AND ecsv.category_set_name = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_ORIGIN') pprocedencia, esiv.primary_uom_code pcodunidadevenda, esiv.organization_id pflexfield1,
       esiv.inventory_item_id pflexfield2,

  (SELECT esit.long_description
   FROM egp_system_items_tl_v esit
   WHERE esiv.inventory_item_id = esit.inventory_item_id
     AND esiv.organization_id = esit.organization_id
     AND esit.language = 'PTB') pdescricaodetalhada, '0' pdifemb,
                                                         TO_CHAR(esiv.creation_date,
                                                           'YYYYMMDD') pdatainicio, '' pdescricaoanvisa,
                                                                                       esiv.unit_volume pvolume,
                                                                                       esiv.dimension_uom_code pcodunidademedidadimensao,
                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                           WHEN NVL(esiv.container_item_flag,

                                                                                                  'N') = 'N' THEN 'N'
                                                                                           ELSE 'S'
                                                                                       END pflagembalagem,
                                                                                       '' pcodprodanp,
                                                                                          '' ppercentualglp,
                                                                                             '' pscodprodanvisa,
                                                                                                '' psdescprodanp,
                                                                                                   '' pnpercglpnac,
                                                                                                      '' pnpercglpimp,
                                                                                                         '' pnvalorpartida,
                                                                                                            esiv.last_update_date,

  (SELECT ec.description
   FROM egp_item_categories eic, egp_categories_vl ec, egp_category_sets_vl ecsv
   WHERE eic.inventory_item_id = esiv.inventory_item_id
     AND eic.organization_id = esiv.organization_id
     AND eic.category_set_id = ecsv.category_set_id
     AND ec.category_id = eic.category_id
     AND ecsv.category_set_name = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE') pcategoria,

  (SELECT ec.category_code
   FROM egp_item_categories eic, egp_categories_vl ec, egp_category_sets_vl ecsv
   WHERE eic.inventory_item_id = esiv.inventory_item_id
     AND eic.organization_id = esiv.organization_id
     AND eic.category_set_id = ecsv.category_set_id
     AND ec.category_id = eic.category_id
     AND ecsv.category_set_name = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_ORIGIN') pcodorigem,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN (UPPER(esiv.created_by) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO')
                                                                                                                     OR (UPPER(esiv.created_by) != 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                         AND esiv.creation_date != esiv.last_update_date) THEN TO_CHAR(esiv.last_update_date,

                                                                                                                                                                                 'RRRRMMDD')
                                                                                                            END patualizacao,
                                                                                                            NVL2(esiv.hazard_class_id,

                                                                                                              'S',
                                                                                                              'N') pcargaperigosa,
                                                                                                            'ORACLE_ERP_CLOUD' pprocedenciainfo,
                                                                                                                               tab_orgs.importador
FROM egp_system_items_vl esiv, inv_org_parameters iop, hr_organization_units houa,
     hr_locations hl, tab_orgs
WHERE esiv.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND iop.organization_id != iop.master_organization_id
  AND esiv.organization_id = houa.organization_id
  AND houa.location_id = hl.location_id(+)
  AND hl.country (+) = 'BR'
  AND iop.organization_code = tab_orgs.organization_code
  AND esiv.inventory_item_id = :p_inventory_item_id
  AND esiv.organization_id = :p_organization_id
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL_V`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL_V, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES`

```sql
SELECT ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID, IOP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID,
       ESIV.ITEM_NUMBER PPARTNUMBER, IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE PCODORGANIZACAO,
       ESIV.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE PUNIDADEESTOQUE,

  (SELECT EC.CATEGORY_CODE
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = :P_NCM_CATEGORY_SET_NAME) PNCM, ESIV.UNIT_WEIGHT PPESOBRUTO, ESIV.UNIT_WEIGHT PPESOLIQUIDO,
       ESIV.UNIT_WEIGHT PPESOQUILO, ESIV.UNIT_WEIGHT PPESOUNIDCOMERCIALIZADA,

  (SELECT ESIT.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL_V ESIT
   WHERE ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB') PDESCRICAORESUMIDA,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE) = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N'
       END PSTATUS, ESIV.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE PUNIDADEPESO, ESIV.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE PCODUNIDADEQTDE,
       ESIV.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE PCODUNIDADECOMERCIALIZADA, ESIV.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE PCODUNIDADEUNITARIA, ESIV.ITEM_TYPE PTIPOPRODUTO,

  (SELECT CASE WHEN EC.CATEGORY_CODE IN ('0', '4', '5', '8') THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
          END PPROCEDENCIA
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = :P_ITEM_ORIGIN_CATEGORY_SET_NAME) AS PPROCEDENCIA, ESIV.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE PCODUNIDADEVENDA, ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID PFLEXFIELD1,
       ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID PFLEXFIELD2,

  (SELECT ESIT.LONG_DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL_V ESIT
   WHERE ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB') PDESCRICAODETALHADA, '0' PDIFEMB,
                                                         TO_CHAR(ESIV.CREATION_DATE,
                                                           'YYYYMMDD') PDATAINICIO, '' PDESCRICAOANVISA,
                                                                                       ESIV.UNIT_VOLUME PVOLUME,
                                                                                       ESIV.DIMENSION_UOM_CODE PCODUNIDADEMEDIDADIMENSAO,
                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                           WHEN NVL(ESIV.CONTAINER_ITEM_FLAG,

                                                                                                  'N') = 'N' THEN 'N'
                                                                                           ELSE 'S'
                                                                                       END PFLAGEMBALAGEM,
                                                                                       '' PCODPRODANP,
                                                                                          '' PPERCENTUALGLP,
                                                                                             '' PSCODPRODANVISA,
                                                                                                '' PSDESCPRODANP,
                                                                                                   '' PNPERCGLPNAC,
                                                                                                      '' PNPERCGLPIMP,
                                                                                                         '' PNVALORPARTIDA,
                                                                                                            ESIV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

  (SELECT EC.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = :P_ITEM_TYPE_CATEGORY_SET_NAME) PCATEGORIA,

  (SELECT EC.CATEGORY_CODE
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND EC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = :P_ITEM_ORIGIN_CATEGORY_SET_NAME) PCODORIGEM,
                                                                                                            CASE
                                                                                                                WHEN (UPPER(ESIV.CREATED_BY) = 'EBS.MIGRACAO')
                                                                                                                     OR (UPPER(ESIV.CREATED_BY) <> 'EBS.MIGRACAO'
                                                                                                                         AND ESIV.CREATION_DATE <> ESIV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) THEN TO_CHAR(ESIV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                 'RRRRMMDD')
                                                                                                            END PATUALIZACAO,
                                                                                                            NVL2(ESIV.HAZARD_CLASS_ID,

                                                                                                              'S',
                                                                                                              'N') PCARGAPERIGOSA,
                                                                                                            'ORACLE_ERP_CLOUD' PPROCEDENCIAINFO
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HOUA,
     HR_LOCATIONS HL
WHERE ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID <> IOP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = HOUA.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND HOUA.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID(+)
  AND HL.COUNTRY(+) = 'BR'
  AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                 ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID)
  AND ESIV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                   'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = NVL(:P_ORGANIZATION_ID,
                               ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID)
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS`

### Query #4

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS`

```sql
SELECT CFDH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER NUMERO_NOTA, HAOU.NAME
ORGANIZATION,
                                                   TO_CHAR(CFDH.CREATION_DATE,
                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD') DATA_ENTRADA_NF,
                                                   DECODE(CFDH.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
                                                     'CAPTURED', 'ENTRADA',
                                                     'CANCELED', 'REVERSAO') TIPO_NOTA,
                                                   CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID NUMERO_RI, HP.PARTY_NAME FORNECEDOR,
                                                   IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID ORG_INV_ID,
                                                   HAOU.NAME || ' - ' || IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE PARA_DE, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER CODIGO_ITEM,
                                                   PRL.ATTRIBUTE2 REFERENCIA_SISEPC, CFDL.FD_PRICE VALOR_UNITARIO,
                                                   CFDL.FD_QUANTITY QUANTIDADE_RECEBIDA, CFDL.FD_UOM UNIDADE_MEDIDA,
                                                   RT.TRANSACTION_ID TRANSACTION_ID, RLS.LOT_NUM LOTE,
                                                   RSS.SERIAL_NUM NUMERO_SERIE, IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS CFDH, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B CFDL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES CFDS,
     HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, RCV_TRANSACTIONS RT, RCV_LOTS_SUPPLY RLS,
     RCV_SERIALS_SUPPLY RSS, HZ_PARTIES HP, POZ_SUPPLIERS PV,
     POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
WHERE CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = CFDL.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND CFDH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = CFDS.FISCAL_DOC_HEADER_ID
  AND CFDL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID = CFDS.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID
  AND CFDH.BILL_TO_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND CFDS.FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID = RT.FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULE_ID(+)
  AND RT.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'RECEIVE'
  AND CFDS.RECEIVING_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND RT.TRANSACTION_ID = RLS.TRANSACTION_ID(+)
  AND RT.TRANSACTION_ID = RSS.TRANSACTION_ID(+)
  AND CFDH.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('CAPTURED', 'CANCELED')
  AND hp.party_id = cfdh.issuer_party_id
  AND hp.party_id = PV.PARTY_ID
  AND PV.VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'SUPPLIER'
  AND CFDS.SOURCE_DOC_ID1 = PRL.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND CFDS.SOURCE_DOC_ID2 = PRL.PO_LINE_ID
  AND CFDL.ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND esib.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND PRL.ATTRIBUTE2 IS NOT NULL
  AND CFDH.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                 TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                   'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = NVL(:P_ORG_INV_ID, IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID)
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID IN
    (SELECT IOP2.ORGANIZATION_ID
     FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP2, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU, HR_LOCATIONS HL
     WHERE IOP2.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
       AND HAOU.LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
       AND HL.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
       AND HL.ATTRIBUTE1 = :P_ORGANIZATION
     UNION ALL SELECT IOP2.ORGANIZATION_ID
     FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP2, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAOU
     WHERE IOP2.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
       AND HAOU.NAME = :P_ORGANIZATION)
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

```sql
SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID ORGANIZATION_ID, ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID ITEM_ID, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER COD_ITEM,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ESIT.DESCRIPTION,
                                 ',', ';'), CHR(9), ''), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') DESCRIPTION, ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE COD_UN_MEDIDA,
       DECODE(ESIB.LOT_CONTROL_CODE, '1', 'N', '2', 'S', NULL, 'N') CONTROLE_LOTE,
       DECODE(ESIB.SERIAL_NUMBER_CONTROL_CODE, '1', 'N', '2', 'S', NULL, 'N') CONTROLE_SERIE,

  (SELECT EGV.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL EGV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_TL ECSV
   WHERE EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EGV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EGV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECSV.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = 'LACLS_BR_ITEM_TYPE'
     AND ECSV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND EGV.CATEGORY_NAME <> '08') CLASSE_COND_TRANSACAO,
       DECODE(ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE, 'Active', 'Compravel', 'Inactive', 'Inativo') STATUS, HAOU.NAME PARA_DE
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
     HR_LOCATIONS_ALL HLA, HR_ORGANIZATION_V HAOU
WHERE HLA.LOCATION_ID = HAOU.LOCATION_ID
  AND HAOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIT.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND HAOU.STATUS = 'A'
  AND HLA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE IN ('Active', 'Inactive')
  AND TRUNC(ESIB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - :P_DIAS)
  AND HLA.ATTRIBUTE1 = :P_UO
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, FUSION, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, FUSION`

```sql
SELECT PO_HEADER_ID, TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE, MAIOR_DATA, osgt_flag
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT PHA.PO_HEADER_ID, PHA.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE,
                   greatest(nvl(nvl(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                  PHA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7),
                     nvl(nvl(PLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PLA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7),
                     nvl(nvl(PLLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PLLA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7), nvl(nvl(PDA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                             PDA.CREATION_DATE),

                                                                                         sysdate - 7)) - (180 / (24 * 60)) AS MAIOR_DATA,
                   NVL(
                         (SELECT 'Y'
                          FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl flv,
                        hr_all_organization_units haou2,
                        hr_locations hr_req_bu
                          WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'OSGT_ORG_IMPORTADOR'
                            AND flv.enabled_flag = 'Y'
                            AND flv.start_date_active <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                            AND flv.end_date_active >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                            AND PHA.REQ_BU_ID = HAOU2.ORGANIZATION_ID
                            AND HR_REQ_BU.LOCATION_ID = HAOU2.LOCATION_ID
                            AND flv.attribute1 = SUBSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                   1, INSTR(HAOU2.NAME,
                                                        '-') - 1)
                            AND flv.attribute2 IN
                              (SELECT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE
                               FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA
                               WHERE PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID = PHA.PO_HEADER_ID
                                 AND PLLA.SHIP_TO_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                 AND rownum = 1)), 'N') osgt_flag
   FROM FUSION.PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA
   LEFT JOIN FUSION.PO_LINES_ALL PLA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLA.PO_HEADER_ID
   AND trunc(PLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) >= trunc(sysdate) - 7
   LEFT JOIN FUSION.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLLA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PLLA.PO_HEADER_ID
   AND trunc(PLLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) >= trunc(sysdate) - 7
   LEFT JOIN FUSION.PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PDA ON PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PDA.PO_HEADER_ID
   AND trunc(PDA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) >= trunc(sysdate) - 7
   WHERE greatest(nvl(nvl(PHA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PHA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7),
           nvl(nvl(PLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PLA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7),
           nvl(nvl(PLLA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PLLA.CREATION_DATE), sysdate - 7), nvl(nvl(PDA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,

                                                                                   PDA.CREATION_DATE),

                                                                               sysdate - 7)) >= trunc(sysdate) - 6)
WHERE MAIOR_DATA >= SYSDATE - NUMTODSINTERVAL(210,
                                'MINUTE')
```

### Query #7

### Query #7

**Tags:** `HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, HR_OPERATING_UNITS`

```sql
SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER "ITEMNUM", 'ITEMSET1' "ITEMSETID",
                                              ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID "EXTERNALREFID", 'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                           'OA' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                'ITEM' ITEMTYPE,

  (SELECT HOU.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
   WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID) "ORGID",
                                                                                                       ETPI.TP_ITEM_NUMBER "CATALOGCODE",
                                                                                                       HP.PARTY_NAME "MANUFACTURER", ROWNUM "TRANSSEQ",
                                                                                                                                            TO_CHAR(ETPI.END_DATE,

                                                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') "CLIA_ENDDATE",

  (SELECT HOU.NAME
   FROM HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
   WHERE HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID) "CLIA_ORG"
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP, EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B EIRB,
     EGP_TRADING_PARTNER_ITEMS ETPI, HZ_PARTIES HP
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ETPI.TP_TYPE = 'MANUFACTURER'
  AND HP.PARTY_ID = ETPI.TRADING_PARTNER_ID
  AND ETPI.TP_ITEM_ID = EIRB.TP_ITEM_ID
  AND EIRB.ITEM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'MFG_PART_NUM'
  AND EIRB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND EIRB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                   'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = NVL(:P_ID,
                                 ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID)
```

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, EGO_ITEM_EFF_VL, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL`

```sql
SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER ITEMNUM, ESIT.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION,

  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN LTRIM(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                           0, INSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, '.') - 1), '0') IN ('9', '10',
                                                                           '20') THEN '1' ELSE '0'
          END
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA') ROTATING, '' STOCKTYPE,

  (SELECT ECV.CATEGORY_NAME
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'LOT_TYPE') LOTTYPE,
                                                                   CASE
                                                                       WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'N' THEN 0
                                                                       WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'S' THEN 1
                                                                   END "CAPITALIZED", '' MSDSNUM,
                                                                                         0 OUTSIDE,
                                                                                         0 SPAREPARTAUTOADD,
                                                                                         0 CLASSSTRUCTUREID,
                                                                                         'OA' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                              'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                   ESIB.inventory_item_id EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                   '' INTERID,
                                                                                                      '' MIGCHANGEID,
                                                                                                         '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                            '' LIFEEXP,
                                                                                                               IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE ITEMSETID,

  (SELECT IUOM.unit_of_measure
   FROM inv_units_of_measure IUOM
   WHERE IUOM.uom_code = ESIB.primary_uom_code) ORDERUNIT,

  (SELECT IUOM.unit_of_measure
   FROM inv_units_of_measure IUOM
   WHERE IUOM.uom_code = ESIB.primary_uom_code) ISSUEUNIT,
                                                                                                               0 CONDITIONENABLED,
                                                                                                               '' GROUPNAME,
                                                                                                                  '' METERNAME,
                                                                                                                     '' COMMODITYGROUP,
                                                                                                                        '' COMMODITY,
                                                                                                                           'ITEM' ITEMTYPE,
                                                                                                                                  0 PRORATE,
                                                                                                                                  '' ITEMID,
                                                                                                                                     0 ISKIT,
                                                                                                                                     '' LANGCODE,
                                                                                                                                        ESIT.long_description LONGDESC2,
                                                                                                                                        CASE
                                                                                                                                            WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'N' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                            WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'S' THEN 'N'
                                                                                                                                        END CATEGORY,
                                                                                                                                        1 REORDER,
                                                                                                                                        ESIB.inventory_item_id ITEM_EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                                                        'OA' ITEM_OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                                                             'OA' ITEM_SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                                                                                  'DONE' OA_IFACESTATUS,
                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE OA_IFACETIMESTAMP,

  (SELECT LTRIM(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, '0')
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA') IN20,

  (SELECT LTRIM(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, 0, INSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                               '.') - 1), '0')
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA') IN19,
                                                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                                                             WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'N' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                             WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'S' THEN 'N'
                                                                                                                                                         END OOG_IN19,
                                                                                                                                                         0 INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                         '' STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                            '' ITEMORG_STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                               DECODE(UPPER(ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE),

                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRA',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRÁVEL',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 'ACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'INACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 1) OOG_KLASSMATT,
                                                                                                                                                               DECODE(UPPER(ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE),

                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRA',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRÁVEL',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'ACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'INACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 1) OOG_ORACLE,

  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN INSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, '|') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                                                   2,
                                                                   LENGTH(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME)),
                                                            1,
                                                            INSTR(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                                                    2,
                                                                    LENGTH(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME)),
                                                              '|') - 1) ELSE ECV.CATEGORY_NAME
          END CATEGORY_NAME
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE') OOG_NCM,

  (SELECT ESIT2.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT2
   WHERE ESIT2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIT2.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIT2.LANGUAGE = 'PTB') OOG_PURCHASE_DESCRIPTION,

  (SELECT ECV.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CATALOGO_COMERCIAL') IN25,
                                                                                                                                                               ESIB.ATTRIBUTE1 IN21,
                                                                                                                                                               nvl(SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                                                            (SELECT EIEV.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR28
                                                                                                                                                                             FROM EGO_ITEM_EFF_VL EIEV
                                                                                                                                                                             WHERE EIEV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                                                               AND EIEV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                                                               AND CONTEXT_CODE = 'GA_CERTIFIC_MATERIAIS'), 1,

                                                                                                                                                                     238),

                                                                                                                                                                 '.') IN24,
                                                                                                                                                               '' VSEGMENT1,
                                                                                                                                                                  '' VSEGMENT2,
                                                                                                                                                                     '' VSEGMENT3,
                                                                                                                                                                        '' VSEGMENT4,
                                                                                                                                                                           '' VSEGMENT5,
                                                                                                                                                                              '1' TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                  0 "CERTIFICATEREQUIRED",
                                                                                                                                                                                  0 "ISCERTIFICATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                      WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'N' THEN 0
                                                                                                                                                                                      WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'S' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                  END "OOG_SAFETY",
                                                                                                                                                                                  eicb.last_update_date,
                                                                                                                                                                                  ESIB.last_update_date last_update_date1,
                                                                                                                                                                                  EFFB.last_update_date last_update_date2,
                                                                                                                                                                                  ESIB.inventory_item_status_code
FROM egp_system_items_b ESIB, egp_system_items_tl ESIT, inv_org_parameters IOP, ego_item_eff_b EFFB,
     egp_item_classes_b eicb
WHERE ESIB.inventory_item_id = ESIT.inventory_item_id
  AND ESIB.organization_id = ESIT.organization_id
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND IOP.organization_id = IOP.master_organization_id
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
  AND ESIB.inventory_item_id = EFFB.inventory_item_id(+)
  AND ESIB.organization_id = EFFB.organization_id(+)
  AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND LENGTH(ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER) < = 20
  AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICB.ITEM_CLASS_ID
  AND EICB.ITEM_CLASS_CODE IN ('CLIENT_A', 'COMMON')
  AND ESIB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'UNP'
  AND ((ESIB.last_update_date > Nvl(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                  To_date('01/01/1900',
                                    'DD/MM/RRRR')))
       OR (EFFB.last_update_date > Nvl(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                     To_date('01/01/1900',
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR'))))
  AND ESIB.inventory_item_id = Nvl(:P_ID,
                                 ESIB.inventory_item_id)
  AND ROWNUM <= 100
  AND ESIB.ATTRIBUTE14 = 'CH'
ORDER BY ESIB.last_update_date
```

```sql
                                                                                                                                                         SYSDATE OA_IFACETIMESTAMP,

   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA') IN20,

  (SELECT LTRIM(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, 0, INSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                               '.') - 1), '0')
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CLASSIFICACAO_TECNICA') IN19,
                                                                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                                                                             WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'N' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                             WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE11 = 'S' THEN 'N'
                                                                                                                                                         END OOG_IN19,
                                                                                                                                                         0 INSPECTIONREQUIRED,
                                                                                                                                                         '' STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                            '' ITEMORG_STATUS,
                                                                                                                                                               DECODE(UPPER(ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE),

                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRA',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRÁVEL',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 'ACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'INACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 1) OOG_KLASSMATT,
                                                                                                                                                               DECODE(UPPER(ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE),

                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRA',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'NÃO COMPRÁVEL',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'ACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 1,
                                                                                                                                                                 'INACTIVE',
                                                                                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                                                                                 1) OOG_ORACLE,

  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN INSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME, '|') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                                                   2,
                                                                   LENGTH(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME)),
                                                            1,
                                                            INSTR(SUBSTR(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME,
                                                                    2,
                                                                    LENGTH(ECV.CATEGORY_NAME)),
                                                              '|') - 1) ELSE ECV.CATEGORY_NAME
          END CATEGORY_NAME
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE') OOG_NCM,

  (SELECT ESIT2.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIT2
   WHERE ESIT2.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIT2.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIT2.LANGUAGE = 'PTB') OOG_PURCHASE_DESCRIPTION,

  (SELECT ECV.DESCRIPTION
   FROM EGP_CATEGORIES_VL ECV, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   WHERE ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
     AND ECV.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
     AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'CATALOGO_COMERCIAL') IN25,
                                                                                                                                                               ESIB.ATTRIBUTE1 IN21,
                                                                                                                                                               nvl(SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                                                            (SELECT EIEV.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR28
                                                                                                                                                                             FROM EGO_ITEM_EFF_VL EIEV
                                                                                                                                                                             WHERE EIEV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                                                                                                                                                                               AND EIEV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                                                                                                                                                               AND CONTEXT_CODE = 'GA_CERTIFIC_MATERIAIS'), 1,

                                                                                                                                                                     238),

                                                                                                                                                                 ' ') IN24,
                                                                                                                                                               '' VSEGMENT1,
                                                                                                                                                                  '' VSEGMENT2,
                                                                                                                                                                     '' VSEGMENT3,
                                                                                                                                                                        '' VSEGMENT4,
                                                                                                                                                                           '' VSEGMENT5,
                                                                                                                                                                              '1' TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                                                                  0 "CERTIFICATEREQUIRED",
                                                                                                                                                                                  0 "ISCERTIFICATE",
                                                                                                                                                                                  CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                      WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'N' THEN 0
                                                                                                                                                                                      WHEN ESIB.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'S' THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                  END "OOG_SAFETY",
                                                                                                                                                                                  eicb.last_update_date,
                                                                                                                                                                                  ESIB.last_update_date last_update_date1,
                                                                                                                                                                                  EFFB.last_update_date last_update_date2,
                                                                                                                                                                                  ESIB.inventory_item_status_code
FROM egp_system_items_b ESIB, egp_system_items_tl ESIT, inv_org_parameters IOP, ego_item_eff_b EFFB,
     egp_item_classes_b eicb
WHERE ESIB.inventory_item_id = ESIT.inventory_item_id
  AND ESIB.organization_id = ESIT.organization_id
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND IOP.organization_id = IOP.master_organization_id
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'CLIENT_A_MESTRE'
  AND ESIB.inventory_item_id = EFFB.inventory_item_id(+)
  AND ESIB.organization_id = EFFB.organization_id(+)
  AND ESIT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND LENGTH(ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER) < = 20
  AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = EICB.ITEM_CLASS_ID
  AND EICB.ITEM_CLASS_CODE IN ('CLIENT_A', 'COMMON')
  AND ESIB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'UNP'
  AND ESIB.inventory_item_id = Nvl(:P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                 ESIB.inventory_item_id)
ORDER BY ESIB.last_update_date
```

### Query #11

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `CST_COST_INV_ORGS, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, CST_COST_BOOKS_TL, PERIOD_ACTUAL, EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS, CST_VAL_UNITS_B, VALID_ITEMS, RESULT, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B...`

### Query #11

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, CST_VAL_UNITS_B, EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS, PERIOD_ACTUAL, CST_COST_INV_ORGS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS, CST_COST_ORGS_V, RESULT, CST_PERIOD_STATUSES...`

```sql
WITH VALID_ITEMS AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID
   FROM EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC ON ECSVC.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB ON ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSVC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
   WHERE ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'Comercial'),
     PERIOD_ACTUAL AS
  (SELECT cost_org_id, cost_book_id, period_name
   FROM
     (SELECT cps.cost_org_id, cps.cost_book_id, cps.period_name,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cps.cost_org_id, cps.cost_book_id
                                ORDER BY cps.end_date DESC) rn
      FROM CST_PERIOD_STATUSES cps
      WHERE cps.status_code <> 'N')
   WHERE rn = 1),
     PERIOD_LAST AS
  (SELECT cost_org_id, cost_book_id, period_name
   FROM
     (SELECT cps.cost_org_id, cps.cost_book_id, cps.period_name,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cps.cost_org_id, cps.cost_book_id
                                ORDER BY cps.end_date DESC) rn
      FROM CST_PERIOD_STATUSES cps
      WHERE cps.status_code IN ('F','C'))
   WHERE rn = 1),
     COST_ACTUAL AS
  (SELECT c.cost_org_id, c.cost_book_id, c.inventory_item_id, c.val_unit_id, c.period_name,
          MAX(c.periodic_avg_cost) periodic_avg_cost, MAX(c.last_update_date) last_update_date
   FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS c
   JOIN PERIOD_ACTUAL p ON p.period_name = c.period_name
   AND p.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
   AND p.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
   WHERE c.periodic_avg_cost <> 0
   GROUP BY c.cost_org_id, c.cost_book_id, c.inventory_item_id, c.val_unit_id, c.period_name),
     COST_LAST AS
  (SELECT c.cost_org_id, c.cost_book_id, c.inventory_item_id, c.val_unit_id, c.period_name,
          MAX(c.periodic_avg_cost) periodic_avg_cost, MAX(c.last_update_date) last_update_date
   FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS c
   JOIN PERIOD_LAST p ON p.period_name = c.period_name
   AND p.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
   AND p.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
   WHERE c.periodic_avg_cost <> 0
   GROUP BY c.cost_org_id, c.cost_book_id, c.inventory_item_id, c.val_unit_id, c.period_name), RESULT AS
  (SELECT cco.cost_org_name AS COST_ORG, cb.cost_book_desc AS COST_BOOK,
          b.period_name AS PERIOD_NAME, f.status_code AS STATUS_CODE,
          b.inventory_item_id AS INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, i.item_number AS ITEM_NUMBER,
          ic.item_class_code AS ITEM_SUBCLASS, ic.item_class_code AS ITEM_CLASS,
          i.organization_id AS ORGANIZATION_ID, iop.organization_code AS ORGANIZATION_CODE,
          e.val_unit_code AS VAL_UNIT, ROUND(b.periodic_avg_cost,
                                         2) AS CUSTO_UNITARIO,
          b.last_update_date AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ic.attribute5 AS SALESFORCE_INT,
          ic.enabled_flag AS ATIVO
   FROM COST_ACTUAL b
   JOIN CST_COST_INV_ORGS cio ON cio.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   JOIN egp_system_items_b i ON i.inventory_item_id = b.inventory_item_id
   AND i.organization_id = cio.inv_org_id
   JOIN VALID_ITEMS vi ON vi.inventory_item_id = i.inventory_item_id
   AND vi.organization_id = i.organization_id
   JOIN egp_item_classes_b ic ON i.item_catalog_group_id = ic.item_class_id
   JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS iop ON i.organization_id = iop.organization_id
   JOIN CST_PERIOD_STATUSES f ON f.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   AND f.cost_book_id = b.cost_book_id
   AND f.period_name = b.period_name
   JOIN CST_VAL_UNITS_B e ON b.val_unit_id = e.val_unit_id
   AND SUBSTR(e.val_unit_code, INSTR(e.val_unit_code, '-')+1) = iop.organization_code
   JOIN CST_COST_ORGS_V cco ON b.cost_org_id = cco.cost_org_id
   JOIN CST_COST_ORG_BOOKS cob ON cob.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   AND cob.cost_book_id = b.cost_book_id
   JOIN CST_COST_BOOKS_TL cb ON cb.cost_book_id = cob.cost_book_id
   AND cb.language = 'US'
   WHERE :P_COST_PERIOD_REF = 'ACTUAL'
     AND ic.attribute5 = 'Y'
     AND ic.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND ic.item_class_code LIKE 'REVENDA_DE_MERCADORIA%'
   UNION ALL SELECT cco.cost_org_name AS COST_ORG, cb.cost_book_desc AS COST_BOOK,
                    b.period_name AS PERIOD_NAME, f.status_code AS STATUS_CODE,
                    b.inventory_item_id AS INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, i.item_number AS ITEM_NUMBER,
                    ic.item_class_code AS ITEM_SUBCLASS, ic.item_class_code AS ITEM_CLASS,
                    i.organization_id AS ORGANIZATION_ID, iop.organization_code AS ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                    e.val_unit_code AS VAL_UNIT, ROUND(b.periodic_avg_cost,
                                                   2) AS CUSTO_UNITARIO,
                    b.last_update_date AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ic.attribute5 AS SALESFORCE_INT,
                    ic.enabled_flag AS ATIVO
   FROM COST_LAST b
   JOIN CST_COST_INV_ORGS cio ON cio.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   JOIN egp_system_items_b i ON i.inventory_item_id = b.inventory_item_id
   AND i.organization_id = cio.inv_org_id
   JOIN VALID_ITEMS vi ON vi.inventory_item_id = i.inventory_item_id
   AND vi.organization_id = i.organization_id
   JOIN egp_item_classes_b ic ON i.item_catalog_group_id = ic.item_class_id
   JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS iop ON i.organization_id = iop.organization_id
   JOIN CST_PERIOD_STATUSES f ON f.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   AND f.cost_book_id = b.cost_book_id
   AND f.period_name = b.period_name
   JOIN CST_VAL_UNITS_B e ON b.val_unit_id = e.val_unit_id
   AND SUBSTR(e.val_unit_code, INSTR(e.val_unit_code, '-')+1) = iop.organization_code
   JOIN CST_COST_ORGS_V cco ON b.cost_org_id = cco.cost_org_id
   JOIN CST_COST_ORG_BOOKS cob ON cob.cost_org_id = b.cost_org_id
   AND cob.cost_book_id = b.cost_book_id
   JOIN CST_COST_BOOKS_TL cb ON cb.cost_book_id = cob.cost_book_id
   AND cb.language = 'US'
   WHERE :P_COST_PERIOD_REF = 'LAST_CLOSED'
     AND ic.attribute5 = 'Y'
     AND ic.enabled_flag = 'Y'
     AND ic.item_class_code IN ('PRODUTO_ACABADO_FFO', 'PRODUTO_ACABADO_FRIGORIFICO',
                                'PRODUTO_ACABADO_RACAO', 'INSUMO_AGROPECUARIO_ATIV_RURAL',
                                'INSUMO_AGROPECUARIO_BIOMASSA', 'INSUMO_INDUSTRIAL_FFO',
                                'INSUMO_INDUSTRIAL_FAB_RACAO', 'INSUMO_INDUSTRIAL_FRIGORIFICO', 'USO_E_CONSUMO'))
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT R.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY R.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, R.ORGANIZATION_CODE
                             ORDER BY R.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC) AS RN
   FROM RESULT R)
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_CODE
OFFSET :OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT :FETCH_NEXT ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS, CST_VAL_UNITS_B, CST_COST_BOOKS_TL, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS, CST_COST_BOOKS_TL, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS, CST_VAL_UNITS_B`

```sql
SELECT c.name Cost_org, c.COST_BOOK_DESC cost_book, b.period_name, f.STATUS_CODE,
       a.inventory_item_id, d.item_number, d.Item_Subclass, d.Item_Class, d.organization_id,
       iop.organization_code, e.val_unit_code val_unit, ROUND(b.periodic_avg_cost,
                                                          2) custo_uniario,
       b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, d.ATTRIBUTE5 SALESFORCE_INT, d.ENABLED_FLAG Ativo
FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS b, CST_PERIOD_STATUSES f,

  (SELECT MAX(periodic_cost_id) periodic_cost_id, cost_org_id, cost_book_id, inventory_item_id, val_unit_id
   FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS
   GROUP BY cost_org_id, cost_book_id, inventory_item_id, val_unit_id) a,

  (SELECT cb.cost_book_id, cost_book_desc, cob.cost_org_id, org.name
   FROM cst_cost_books_tl cb, cst_cost_org_books cob, hr_organization_units_f_tl org
   WHERE cb.cost_book_id = cob.cost_book_id
     AND cob.cost_org_id = org.organization_id
     AND cb.language = org.language
     AND cb.language = 'US') c,

  (SELECT DISTINCT esi.inventory_item_id, esi.item_number, esi.organization_id,
                   ic_sub.item_class_code AS Item_Subclass, ic_parent.item_class_code AS Item_Class, ic_sub.ATTRIBUTE5,
                   ic_sub.ENABLED_FLAG
   FROM egp_system_items esi, egp_item_classes_b ic_sub, egp_item_classes_b ic_parent
   WHERE esi.item_catalog_group_id = ic_sub.item_class_id
     AND ic_sub.parent_item_class_id = ic_parent.item_class_id(+)
     AND ic_sub.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y'
     AND ic_sub.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') d,

  (SELECT val_unit_id, val_unit_code
   FROM cst_val_units_b) e, inv_org_parameters iop
WHERE b.periodic_cost_id = a.periodic_cost_id
  AND a.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND b.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND f.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND a.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
  AND b.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
  AND a.inventory_item_id = d.inventory_item_id
  AND b.inventory_item_id = d.inventory_item_id
  AND a.val_unit_id = e.val_unit_id
  AND b.val_unit_id = e.val_unit_id
  AND d.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND CAST(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_START_TIMESTAMP,
                                                         1, 19),
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_END_TIMESTAMP,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          19),

                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #13

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS, CST_COST_BOOKS_TL, CST_PERIOD_STATUSES, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS`

### Query #13

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS, CST_PERIOD_STATUSES, CST_COST_BOOKS_TL, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS`

```sql
SELECT c.name Cost_org, c.COST_BOOK_DESC cost_book, b.period_name, f.STATUS_CODE,
       a.inventory_item_id, d.item_number, d.Item_Subclass, d.Item_Class, d.organization_id,
       iop.organization_code, ROUND(b.periodic_avg_cost, 2) custo_uniario, b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
       d.ATTRIBUTE5 SALESFORCE_INT, d.ENABLED_FLAG Ativo
FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS b, CST_PERIOD_STATUSES f,

  (SELECT MAX(periodic_cost_id) periodic_cost_id, cost_org_id, cost_book_id, inventory_item_id
   FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS
   GROUP BY cost_org_id, cost_book_id, inventory_item_id) a,

  (SELECT cb.cost_book_id, cost_book_desc, cob.cost_org_id, org.name
   FROM cst_cost_books_tl cb, cst_cost_org_books cob, hr_organization_units_f_tl org
   WHERE cb.cost_book_id = cob.cost_book_id
     AND cob.cost_org_id = org.organization_id
     AND cb.language = org.language
     AND cb.language = 'US') c,

  (SELECT DISTINCT esi.inventory_item_id, esi.item_number, esi.organization_id,
                   ic_sub.item_class_code AS Item_Subclass, ic_parent.item_class_code AS Item_Class, ic_sub.ATTRIBUTE5,
                   ic_sub.ENABLED_FLAG
   FROM egp_system_items esi, egp_item_classes_b ic_sub, egp_item_classes_b ic_parent
   WHERE esi.item_catalog_group_id = ic_sub.item_class_id
     AND ic_sub.parent_item_class_id = ic_parent.item_class_id(+)
     AND ic_sub.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y'
     AND ic_sub.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') d, inv_org_parameters iop
WHERE b.periodic_cost_id = a.periodic_cost_id
  AND a.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND b.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND f.cost_org_id = c.cost_org_id
  AND a.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
  AND b.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
  AND f.cost_book_id = c.cost_book_id
  AND b.period_name = f.period_name
  AND a.inventory_item_id = d.inventory_item_id
  AND b.inventory_item_id = d.inventory_item_id
  AND d.organization_id = iop.organization_id
  AND f.end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(cps.end_date)
     FROM CST_PERIOD_STATUSES cps
     WHERE cps.cost_org_id = f.cost_org_id
       AND cps.cost_book_id = f.cost_book_id
       AND cps.status_code IN ('F', 'C'))
  AND CAST(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_START_TIMESTAMP,
                                                         1, 19),
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_END_TIMESTAMP,

                                                                                          1,
                                                                                          19),

                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B`

```sql
SELECT 'FY' || TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'YY') AS ANO,
       CASE TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'MM') WHEN '01' THEN 'JAN' WHEN '02' THEN 'FEV' WHEN '03' THEN 'MAR' WHEN '04' THEN 'ABR' WHEN '05' THEN 'MAI' WHEN '06' THEN 'JUN' WHEN '07' THEN 'JUL' WHEN '08' THEN 'AGO' WHEN '09' THEN 'SET' WHEN '10' THEN 'OUT' WHEN '11' THEN 'NOV' WHEN '12' THEN 'DEZ'
       END AS MES, 'E_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 3) AS EMPRESA,
       'F_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 4) AS FILIAL,
       CASE
           WHEN SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                  INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1) IS NULL THEN 'NA_NEGOCIO'
           ELSE 'NG_' || LPAD(SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1), 3, '0')
       END AS NEGOCIO, 'ORG_' || IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS ORG_CODE_INV,
       WAT.WORK_AREA_NAME AS AREA_TRABALHO, WCT.WORK_CENTER_NAME AS CENTRO_TRABALHO, WRT.RESOURCE_NAME AS RECURSO,
       ROUND(SUM(NVL(WWOR.ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE, 0)), 5) AS QTDE_RECURSO, SYSDATE AS DATA_EXTRACAO
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B WWO, WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WOS, WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WMB,
     WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B WWOP, WIE_WO_OPERATION_RESOURCES WWOR, WIS_RESOURCES_B WR,
     WIS_RESOURCES_TL WRT, WIS_WORK_CENTERS_B WCB, WIS_WORK_CENTERS_TL WCT,
     WIS_WORK_AREAS_B WAB, WIS_WORK_AREAS_TL WAT, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS_V IOP
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID = WOS.WO_STATUS_ID
  AND WOS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE = 'CLOSED'
  AND WWO.WORK_METHOD_ID = WMB.WORK_METHOD_ID
  AND WMB.WORK_METHOD_CODE = 'MAINTENANCE'
  AND WWO.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID = WWOP.WORK_ORDER_ID
  AND WWOP.WO_OPERATION_ID = WWOR.WO_OPERATION_ID
  AND WWOR.RESOURCE_ID = WR.RESOURCE_ID
  AND WR.RESOURCE_ID = WRT.RESOURCE_ID
  AND WRT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WWOR.WORK_CENTER_ID = WCB.WORK_CENTER_ID
  AND WCB.WORK_CENTER_ID = WCT.WORK_CENTER_ID
  AND WCT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WCB.WORK_AREA_ID = WAB.WORK_AREA_ID
  AND WAB.WORK_AREA_ID = WAT.WORK_AREA_ID
  AND WAT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WWO.CLOSED_DATE >= TO_DATE('01/' || :P_PERIODO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND WWO.CLOSED_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('01/' || :P_PERIODO,
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY'), 1)
  AND (:P_ORGANIZATION_CODE IS NULL
       OR IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :P_ORGANIZATION_CODE)
  AND NVL(WWOR.ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE, 0) <> 0
GROUP BY 'FY' || TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'YY'),
         CASE TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'MM') WHEN '01' THEN 'JAN' WHEN '02' THEN 'FEV' WHEN '03' THEN 'MAR' WHEN '04' THEN 'ABR' WHEN '05' THEN 'MAI' WHEN '06' THEN 'JUN' WHEN '07' THEN 'JUL' WHEN '08' THEN 'AGO' WHEN '09' THEN 'SET' WHEN '10' THEN 'OUT' WHEN '11' THEN 'NOV' WHEN '12' THEN 'DEZ'
         END, 'E_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 3),
         'F_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 4),
         CASE
             WHEN SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                    INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1) IS NULL THEN 'NA_NEGOCIO'
             ELSE 'NG_' || LPAD(SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                  INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                    '_') + 1), 3, '0')
         END, 'ORG_' || IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, WAT.WORK_AREA_NAME,
         WCT.WORK_CENTER_NAME, WRT.RESOURCE_NAME
ORDER BY ORG_CODE_INV, AREA_TRABALHO, CENTRO_TRABALHO, RECURSO
```

### Query #15

**Tabelas:** `WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B`

### Query #15

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B`

```sql
SELECT 'FY' || TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'YY') AS ANO,
       CASE TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'MM') WHEN '01' THEN 'JAN' WHEN '02' THEN 'FEV' WHEN '03' THEN 'MAR' WHEN '04' THEN 'ABR' WHEN '05' THEN 'MAI' WHEN '06' THEN 'JUN' WHEN '07' THEN 'JUL' WHEN '08' THEN 'AGO' WHEN '09' THEN 'SET' WHEN '10' THEN 'OUT' WHEN '11' THEN 'NOV' WHEN '12' THEN 'DEZ'
       END AS MES, 'E_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 3) AS EMPRESA,
       'F_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 4) AS FILIAL,
       CASE
           WHEN SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                  INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1) IS NULL THEN 'NA_NEGOCIO'
           ELSE 'NG_' || LPAD(SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1), 3, '0')
       END AS NEGOCIO, 'ORG_' || IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS ORG_CODE_INV,
       WAT.WORK_AREA_NAME AS AREA_TRABALHO, WCT.WORK_CENTER_NAME AS CENTRO_TRABALHO, WRT.RESOURCE_NAME AS RECURSO,
       ROUND(SUM(NVL(WWOR.ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE, 0)), 5) AS QTDE_RECURSO, SYSDATE AS DATA_EXTRACAO
FROM WIE_WORK_ORDERS_B WWO, WIE_WO_STATUSES_B WOS, WIS_WORK_METHODS_B WMB,
     WIE_WO_OPERATIONS_B WWOP, WIE_WO_OPERATION_RESOURCES WWOR, WIS_RESOURCES_B WR,
     WIS_RESOURCES_TL WRT, WIS_WORK_CENTERS_B WCB, WIS_WORK_CENTERS_TL WCT,
     WIS_WORK_AREAS_B WAB, WIS_WORK_AREAS_TL WAT, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS_V IOP
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND WWO.WORK_ORDER_STATUS_ID = WOS.WO_STATUS_ID
  AND WOS.WO_SYSTEM_STATUS_CODE = 'CLOSED'
  AND WWO.WORK_METHOD_ID = WMB.WORK_METHOD_ID
  AND WMB.WORK_METHOD_CODE IN ('DISCRETE_MANUFACTURING', 'FLOW_MANUFACTURING', 'PROCESS_MANUFACTURING')
  AND WWO.ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND WWO.WORK_ORDER_ID = WWOP.WORK_ORDER_ID
  AND WWOP.WO_OPERATION_ID = WWOR.WO_OPERATION_ID
  AND WWOR.RESOURCE_ID = WR.RESOURCE_ID
  AND WR.RESOURCE_ID = WRT.RESOURCE_ID
  AND WRT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WWOR.WORK_CENTER_ID = WCB.WORK_CENTER_ID
  AND WCB.WORK_CENTER_ID = WCT.WORK_CENTER_ID
  AND WCT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WCB.WORK_AREA_ID = WAB.WORK_AREA_ID
  AND WAB.WORK_AREA_ID = WAT.WORK_AREA_ID
  AND WAT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND WWO.CLOSED_DATE >= TO_DATE('01/' || :P_PERIODO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND WWO.CLOSED_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('01/' || :P_PERIODO,
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY'), 1)
  AND (:P_ORGANIZATION_CODE IS NULL
       OR IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :P_ORGANIZATION_CODE)
  AND NVL(WWOR.ACTUAL_RESOURCE_USAGE, 0) <> 0
GROUP BY 'FY' || TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'YY'),
         CASE TO_CHAR(WWO.CLOSED_DATE, 'MM') WHEN '01' THEN 'JAN' WHEN '02' THEN 'FEV' WHEN '03' THEN 'MAR' WHEN '04' THEN 'ABR' WHEN '05' THEN 'MAI' WHEN '06' THEN 'JUN' WHEN '07' THEN 'JUL' WHEN '08' THEN 'AGO' WHEN '09' THEN 'SET' WHEN '10' THEN 'OUT' WHEN '11' THEN 'NOV' WHEN '12' THEN 'DEZ'
         END, 'E_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 3),
         'F_' || SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 4),
         CASE
             WHEN SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                    INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, '_') + 1) IS NULL THEN 'NA_NEGOCIO'
             ELSE 'NG_' || LPAD(SUBSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                  INSTR(IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                    '_') + 1), 3, '0')
         END, 'ORG_' || IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, WAT.WORK_AREA_NAME,
         WCT.WORK_CENTER_NAME, WRT.RESOURCE_NAME
ORDER BY ORG_CODE_INV, AREA_TRABALHO, CENTRO_TRABALHO, RECURSO
```

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

```sql
SELECT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER, ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE, ESIV.DESCRIPTION,
       ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME NCM_PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION, EICT.CATEGORY_SET_NAME CATALAGO, CLASS.ITEM_CLASS_CODE
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_VL ESIV, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL,
     EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_TL EICT, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B CLASS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
WHERE 1=1
  AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE'
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ESIV.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND ESIV.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
  AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND EICT.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
  AND EICT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND EICT.CATEGORY_SET_NAME = 'LACLS_NCM_SERVICE_CODE'
  AND ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = CLASS.ITEM_CLASS_ID
  AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE = 'Active'
  AND ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER = :p_item
ORDER BY ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
```

### Query #17
