### Query #17

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_VL, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL, EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT cat.category_name AS display_value
FROM egp_categories_vl cat
JOIN egp_category_set_valid_cats svc ON cat.category_id = svc.category_id
JOIN egp_category_sets_vl
SETS ON svc.category_set_id = sets.category_set_id
WHERE sets.category_set_name = 'Compras'
  AND cat.enabled_flag = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(cat.start_date_active, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(cat.end_date_active,

                                                                              TRUNC(SYSDATE))
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #19

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_MATERIAL_TXNS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, CST_VAL_UNIT_COMBINATIONS, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS, CST_TRANSACTION_COSTS, SUB, SALDO_INICIAL`

### Query #19

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `SALDO_INICIAL, SUB, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, INV_MATERIAL_TXNS, CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS, CST_TRANSACTION_COSTS, CST_VAL_UNIT_COMBINATIONS`

```sql
WITH saldo_inicial AS
  (SELECT SUM(NVL(IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY, 0)) AS saldo_anterior
   FROM INV_MATERIAL_TXNS IMT ,INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL ITTL ,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ,
        EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL ,INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ,INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V IODV ,
        INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_B ITTB ,INV_SECONDARY_INVENTORIES ISI
   WHERE IMT.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ISI.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ISI.SECONDARY_INVENTORY_NAME = IMT.SUBINVENTORY_CODE
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIITL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND IODV.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE < :P_DATA_INICIAL
     AND (least(:P_AGRUPADOR) IS NULL
          OR ITTB.attribute6 IN (:P_AGRUPADOR))
     AND (least(:P_ORGANIZACAO) IS NULL
          OR IODV.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN (:P_ORGANIZACAO))
     AND (least(:P_TRANSACAO) IS NULL
          OR ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME IN (:P_TRANSACAO))
     AND (least(:P_ITEM) IS NULL
          OR (ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER IN
                (SELECT ITEM_NUMBER
                 FROM
                   (SELECT *
                    FROM
                      (SELECT DISTINCT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER || ' - ' || substr(ESIITL.description,
                                                                      1, 25) AS ITEM, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
                       FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL
                       WHERE 1 = 1
                         AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                         AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID
                         AND ESIITL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB')
                    WHERE ITEM IN (:p_item)))))
     AND (least(:P_SUBINVENTARIO) IS NULL
          OR ISI.SECONDARY_INVENTORY_NAME IN (:P_SUBINVENTARIO))),
     sub AS
  (SELECT IODV.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS NOME_ORGANIZACAO ,IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS COD_ORGANIZACAO ,
          IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ID_ORGANIZACAO ,IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE AS DATA_TRANSACAO ,
          ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID AS TIPOS_TRANSACAO ,ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME AS NOME_TRANSACAO ,
          ITTL.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRICAO_TRANSACAO ,ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER AS NUMERO_ITEM ,ESIITL.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRICAO_ITEM ,
          IMT.SUBINVENTORY_CODE AS CODIGO_SUBINVENTARIO ,ITTB.attribute6 AS AGRUPADOR ,IMT.SOURCE_CODE AS ORIGEM ,
          IMT.CREATED_BY AS USUARIO ,
          CASE WHEN IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY < 0 THEN IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY ELSE NULL
          END AS QTDE_NEGATIVA ,
          CASE WHEN IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY >= 0 THEN IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY ELSE NULL
          END AS QTDE_POSITIVA ,
          NVL(
                (SELECT sum(CTC.UNIT_COST)
                 FROM CST_TRANSACTION_COSTS CTC , CST_TRANSACTIONS CT , CST_INV_TRANSACTIONS CIT
                 WHERE CIT.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_ID
                   AND CIT.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID = CT.CST_INV_TRANSACTION_ID
                   AND CT.TRANSACTION_ID = CTC.TRANSACTION_ID), 0) AS CUSTO_TRANSACAO_NUMERICO ,IMT.PRIMARY_QUANTITY ,IMT.TRANSACTION_ID AS TRANSACAO_ORACLE ,
          IMT.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1 AS ID_AGROSYS
   FROM INV_MATERIAL_TXNS IMT ,INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_TL ITTL ,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ,
        EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL ,INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ,INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V IODV ,
        INV_TRANSACTION_TYPES_B ITTB ,INV_SECONDARY_INVENTORIES ISI
   WHERE IMT.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = IMT.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ISI.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ISI.SECONDARY_INVENTORY_NAME = IMT.SUBINVENTORY_CODE
     AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ESIITL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND IODV.ORGANIZATION_ID = IMT.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID = IMT.TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID
     AND ITTB.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID = ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
     AND IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE >= :P_DATA_INICIAL
     AND (:P_DATA_FINAL IS NULL
          OR IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE <= :P_DATA_FINAL)
     AND (least(:P_AGRUPADOR) IS NULL
          OR ITTB.attribute6 IN (:P_AGRUPADOR))
     AND (least(:P_ORGANIZACAO) IS NULL
          OR IODV.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN (:P_ORGANIZACAO))
     AND (least(:P_TRANSACAO) IS NULL
          OR ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME IN (:P_TRANSACAO))
     AND (least(:P_ITEM) IS NULL
          OR (ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER IN
                (SELECT ITEM_NUMBER
                 FROM
                   (SELECT *
                    FROM
                      (SELECT DISTINCT ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER || ' - ' || substr(ESIITL.description,
                                                                      1, 25) AS ITEM, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER
                       FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL
                       WHERE 1 = 1
                         AND ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                         AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID
                         AND ESIITL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB')
                    WHERE ITEM IN (:p_item)))))
     AND (least(:P_SUBINVENTARIO) IS NULL
          OR ISI.SECONDARY_INVENTORY_NAME IN (:P_SUBINVENTARIO))
   ORDER BY IMT.TRANSACTION_DATE ,ITTB.attribute6 ,ITTL.TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME)
SELECT NOME_ORGANIZACAO ,COD_ORGANIZACAO ,ID_ORGANIZACAO ,DATA_TRANSACAO ,TIPOS_TRANSACAO ,
       NOME_TRANSACAO ,DESCRICAO_TRANSACAO ,NUMERO_ITEM ,DESCRICAO_ITEM ,CODIGO_SUBINVENTARIO ,
       AGRUPADOR ,ORIGEM ,USUARIO ,QTDE_NEGATIVA ,QTDE_POSITIVA ,
       TO_CHAR(x.CUSTO_TRANSACAO_NUMERICO,
         '999G999G999G999G999G999G990D99', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=,.') AS CUSTO_TRANSACAO ,SALDO_PERIODO ,PRIMARY_QUANTITY ,TRANSACAO_ORACLE ,ID_AGROSYS ,
       SALDO_ATE_DATA_INICIAL ,
       TO_CHAR(x.PRIMARY_QUANTITY * x.inf_custo_numerico,
         '999G999G999G999G999G999G990D99', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=,.') AS VALOR_TRANSACAO ,x.inf_custo_numerico ,
       TO_CHAR(x.inf_custo_numerico,
         '999G999G999G999G999G999G990D99', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=,.') AS inf_custo
FROM
  (SELECT sub.NOME_ORGANIZACAO ,sub.COD_ORGANIZACAO ,sub.ID_ORGANIZACAO ,
          TO_CHAR(sub.DATA_TRANSACAO, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_TRANSACAO ,sub.TIPOS_TRANSACAO ,sub.NOME_TRANSACAO ,sub.DESCRICAO_TRANSACAO ,
          sub.NUMERO_ITEM ,sub.DESCRICAO_ITEM ,sub.CODIGO_SUBINVENTARIO ,sub.AGRUPADOR ,sub.ORIGEM ,
          sub.USUARIO ,sub.QTDE_NEGATIVA ,sub.QTDE_POSITIVA ,sub.CUSTO_TRANSACAO_NUMERICO ,
          COALESCE(
                     (SELECT saldo_anterior
                      FROM saldo_inicial), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(NVL(sub.PRIMARY_QUANTITY,
                                                               0)) OVER (
                                                                         ORDER BY sub.DATA_TRANSACAO ,

                                                                       sub.AGRUPADOR ,
                                                                       sub.NOME_TRANSACAO ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
                                                  0) AS SALDO_PERIODO ,sub.PRIMARY_QUANTITY ,sub.TRANSACAO_ORACLE ,sub.ID_AGROSYS ,
          COALESCE(
                     (SELECT saldo_anterior
                      FROM saldo_inicial), 0) AS SALDO_ATE_DATA_INICIAL ,
          CASE
              WHEN sub.CUSTO_TRANSACAO_NUMERICO = 0 THEN
                     (SELECT DISTINCT CPAC.PERIODIC_AVG_COST
                      FROM CST_PERIODIC_AVG_COSTS CPAC ,EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB_INNER
                      WHERE CPAC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB_INNER.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
                        AND ESIB_INNER.ITEM_NUMBER = sub.NUMERO_ITEM
                        AND (cpac.VAL_UNIT_ID, cpac.COST_BOOK_ID) IN
                          (SELECT cvud.VAL_UNIT_ID ,cvud.COST_BOOK_ID
                           FROM CST_VAL_UNIT_COMBINATIONS cvuc, cst_val_unit_details cvud
                           WHERE INV_ORG_CODE = sub.COD_ORGANIZACAO
                             AND cvuc.VAL_UNIT_COMBINATION_ID = cvud.VAL_UNIT_COMBINATION_ID)
                        AND rownum = 1) ELSE sub.CUSTO_TRANSACAO_NUMERICO
          END AS inf_custo_numerico
   FROM sub) X
```

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_MATERIAL_TXNS`

### Query #21

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_MATERIAL_TXNS`

```sql
SELECT iop.organization_code AS ORGANIZATION_NAME ,imt.transaction_id AS TRANSACTION_ID ,
       ittl.transaction_type_id AS TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID ,ittl.transaction_type_name AS TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME ,
       ittl.description AS TRANSACTION_TYPE_DESCR ,esib.item_number AS ITEM_NUMBER ,
       esiitl.description AS ITEM_DESCR ,imt.subinventory_code AS SUBINVENTORY_CODE ,
       imt.transaction_date AS TRANSACTION_DATE ,ABS(imt.transaction_quantity) AS TRANSACTION_QUANTITY ,
       imt.transaction_uom AS TRANSACTION_UOM ,imt.transaction_reference AS TRANSACTION_REFERENCE ,
       lot.lot_number AS LOT_NUMBER ,ser.serial_number AS SERIAL_NUMBER, imt.last_update_date
FROM inv_material_txns imt ,inv_transaction_types_tl ittl ,egp_system_items_b esib ,
     egp_system_items_tl esiitl ,inv_transaction_lot_numbers lot ,inv_unit_transactions ser ,
     inv_org_parameters iop ,inv_transaction_types_b ittb
WHERE imt.transaction_type_id = ittl.transaction_type_id
  AND ittl.language = 'PTB'
  AND esib.inventory_item_id = imt.inventory_item_id
  AND esib.organization_id = imt.organization_id
  AND esib.inventory_item_id = esiitl.inventory_item_id
  AND esib.organization_id = esiitl.organization_id
  AND esiitl.language = 'PTB'
  AND imt.transaction_id = lot.transaction_id (+)
  AND imt.transaction_id = ser.transaction_id (+)
  AND iop.organization_id = imt.organization_id
  AND ittb.transaction_type_id = ittl.transaction_type_id
  AND ittb.attribute4='Oracle'
  AND (imt.transaction_id = :P_TRANSACTION_ID
       OR :P_TRANSACTION_ID IS NULL)
  AND (imt.last_update_date >= :P_RUN_DATE)
```

### Query #26

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B, FUSION, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS...`

### Query #26

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_TL, EGP_CATEGORIES_TL, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B, EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, EGO_ITEM_EFF_B, FUSION, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES...`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT IOP.ORGANIZATION_CODE, EICB.ITEM_CLASS_CODE PRODUCT_SUBCLASS__C,
                EICB2.ITEM_CLASS_CODE PRODUCT_CLASS__C, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER ORACLECODE__C,
                ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_FLAG ITE_TIPESTOQUE, ESITL.DESCRIPTION NAME, ESITL.LONG_DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION,
                ESIB.ENABLED_FLAG IS_ACTIVE, ESIB.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENABLED_FLAG ITE_COMERCIAL,
                ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE QUANTITY_UNIT_OF_MEASURE, ESIB.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE SECONDARY_QUANTITY_UOM,
                CASE WHEN ESIB.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE NULLIF(inv_convert.inv_um_convert(item_id => ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                              lot_number => NULL,
                                              organization_id => ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID, PRECISION => 3,
                                              from_quantity => 1,
                                              from_unit => ESIB.SECONDARY_UOM_CODE, to_unit => ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE,
                                              from_name => NULL, to_name => NULL), -99999)
                END MULTIPLY__C, ESIB.ITEM_TYPE ORI_CODIGO, ECSB.CATALOG_CODE CATALOGO,
                ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME ITE_PROCEDENCIA, ESIB.PLANNING_MAKE_BUY_CODE ITE_ORIGEM,
                ESIB.ITEM_TYPE GRU_ORIGEM, EICB.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY, EICB.ATTRIBUTE1 BELLO_INTEGRA,
                EICB.ATTRIBUTE3 PLUSVAL_INTEGRA, EICB.ATTRIBUTE4 MAIS_FRANGO_INTEGRA,
                EIEB.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR1 PRO_EXPORT, ECSB.CATALOG_CODE CATALOGO_tipo_sped,
                ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME tip_sped, EIRB.EPC_GTIN_SERIAL uni_abac, EIEB.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR2 ite_agranel,
                EICB.ATTRIBUTE5 INTEGRA_SF, EIEB.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR12 PLU_SUBINV_DEFAULT_SALES_FORCE,
                ECTL.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_LEVEL3,

  (SELECT MAX(C2.CATEGORY_NAME)
   FROM FUSION.EGP_FULL_CATEGORY_LIST L3
   JOIN FUSION.EGP_FULL_CATEGORY_LIST L2 ON L2.CATEGORY_ID = L3.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORIES_TL C2 ON C2.CATEGORY_ID = L2.CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC_SUB ON EIC_SUB.CATEGORY_ID = L3.CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB_SUB ON ECSB_SUB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC_SUB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
   WHERE C2.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
     AND EIC_SUB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC_SUB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ECSB_SUB.CATALOG_CODE = 'Comercial') CATEGORY_LEVEL2,

  (SELECT MAX(C1.CATEGORY_NAME)
   FROM FUSION.EGP_FULL_CATEGORY_LIST L3
   JOIN FUSION.EGP_FULL_CATEGORY_LIST L2 ON L2.CATEGORY_ID = L3.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN FUSION.EGP_FULL_CATEGORY_LIST L1 ON L1.CATEGORY_ID = L2.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORIES_TL C1 ON C1.CATEGORY_ID = L1.CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC_SUB ON EIC_SUB.CATEGORY_ID = L3.CATEGORY_ID
   JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB_SUB ON ECSB_SUB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = EIC_SUB.CATEGORY_SET_ID
   WHERE C1.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
     AND EIC_SUB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
     AND EIC_SUB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND ECSB_SUB.CATALOG_CODE = 'Comercial') CATEGORY_LEVEL1, NULL ITEM_UPDATE_DATE
FROM EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB
JOIN INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP ON IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESITL ON ESITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND ESITL.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND ESITL.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
JOIN EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B EICB ON EICB.ITEM_CLASS_ID = ESIB.ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID
JOIN EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B EICB2 ON EICB.PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_ID = EICB2.ITEM_CLASS_ID
JOIN EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES EIC ON EIC.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND EIC.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
JOIN EGP_CATEGORIES_TL ECTL ON ECTL.CATEGORY_ID = EIC.CATEGORY_ID
AND ECTL.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SET_VALID_CATS ECSVC ON ECSVC.CATEGORY_ID = ECTL.CATEGORY_ID
JOIN EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B ECSB ON ECSB.CATEGORY_SET_ID = ECSVC.CATEGORY_SET_ID
AND ECSB.CATALOG_CODE = 'Comercial'
LEFT JOIN EGO_ITEM_EFF_B EIEB ON EIEB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND EIEB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND EIEB.CONTEXT_CODE = 'PLU_ATRIBUTOS_INTEGRA'
LEFT JOIN EGP_ITEM_RELATIONSHIPS_B EIRB ON EIRB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND EIRB.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND EIRB.ITEM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'GTIN_XREF'
WHERE EICB.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y'
  AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID =
    (SELECT ORGANIZATION_ID
     FROM INV_ORG_PARAMETERS
     WHERE ORGANIZATION_CODE = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE')
  AND ESIB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_START_TIMESTAMP,
                                              1, 19),
                                      'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:P_END_TIMESTAMP,
                                                                               1, 19),

                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
```

### Query #27

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, SCM - Shipping & Logistics`

**Tabelas:** `WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

### Query #27

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'PLUMA' AS release_domain, WDD.SALES_ORDER_NUMBER AS release_xid,
                TO_CHAR(WDD.SOURCE_LINE_ID) AS release_line_xid, ESIB.ITEM_NUMBER AS item_xid,
                ESIITL.DESCRIPTION AS item_name, ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
                WDD.REQUESTED_QUANTITY AS packaged_item_count, ESIB.WEIGHT_UOM_CODE AS weight_uom_gid,
                CASE
                    WHEN NVL(ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT, 0) * NVL(WDD.REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
                                                      0) > 0 THEN NVL(ESIB.UNIT_WEIGHT,
                                                                    0) * NVL(WDD.REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
                                                                           0) ELSE 0
                END AS total_weight, ESIB.VOLUME_UOM_CODE AS volume_uom_gid,
                NVL(ESIB.UNIT_VOLUME, 0) * NVL(WDD.REQUESTED_QUANTITY,
                                             1) AS total_volume, WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID AS delivery_detail_id,
                ESIB.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE AS primary_uom, ESIB.UNIT_LENGTH AS unit_length,
                ESIB.UNIT_WIDTH AS unit_width, ESIB.UNIT_HEIGHT AS unit_height,
                ESIB.ATTRIBUTE8 AS cargo_nature,
                ESIB.ATTRIBUTE7 AS item_classification, ESIB.ATTRIBUTE6 AS package_type,
                ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS inventory_item_id
FROM WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS WDD
JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B ESIB ON ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = WDD.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID = WDD.ORGANIZATION_ID
JOIN EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL ESIITL ON ESIITL.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = ESIB.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
AND ESIITL.ORGANIZATION_ID = ESIB.ORGANIZATION_ID
WHERE WDD.SOURCE_LINE_TYPE LIKE 'RETUR%'
  AND WDD.CUST_PO_NUMBER = :P_HeaderNumber
```

### Query #28

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_B, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL, EGP_CATEGORIES_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_TL, EGP_ITEM_CLASSES_B, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B, ITEM_DESC, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS...`

### Query #28

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_CATEGORIES_B, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B, UOM, EGP_CATEGORY_SETS_B, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_TL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, ITEM_DESC, INV_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_B, EGP_ITEM_CATEGORIES, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL...`

```sql
WITH ITEM_DESC AS
  (SELECT inventory_item_id, organization_id, description, long_description,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_item_id, organization_id
                             ORDER BY LENGTH(description) DESC) AS rn
   FROM egp_system_items_tl
   WHERE LANGUAGE IN ('PTB','US'))
SELECT DISTINCT esi.inventory_item_id, esi.organization_id,
                iop.organization_code AS inv_org, esi.item_number AS itemnumber,
                idescription.description AS itemdescription, idescription.long_description AS longdescription,
                UPPER(uom_tl.unit_of_measure) AS primaryuomvalue, esi.unit_width AS unitwidthquantity,
                esi.unit_length AS unitlengthquantity, esi.unit_height AS unitheightquantity,
                esi.unit_weight AS unitweightquantity, esi.unit_volume AS unitvolumequantity,
                mic.category_code AS categorycode, ecst.category_set_name AS categorycatalog,
                eic.item_class_code AS itemclass, eic.attribute6 AS otm_flag,
                esi.last_update_date
FROM egp_system_items_b esi
JOIN inv_org_parameters iop ON iop.organization_id = esi.organization_id
JOIN egp_item_classes_b eic ON eic.item_class_id = esi.item_catalog_group_id
LEFT JOIN item_desc idescription ON idescription.inventory_item_id = esi.inventory_item_id
AND idescription.organization_id = esi.organization_id
AND idescription.rn = 1
JOIN egp_item_categories eicat ON eicat.inventory_item_id = esi.inventory_item_id
AND eicat.organization_id = esi.organization_id
JOIN egp_categories_b mic ON mic.category_id = eicat.category_id
JOIN egp_category_sets_b ecsb ON ecsb.category_set_id = eicat.category_set_id
JOIN egp_category_sets_tl ecst ON ecst.category_set_id = ecsb.category_set_id
AND ecst.language IN ('PTB','US')
LEFT JOIN inv_units_of_measure_b uom_b ON uom_b.uom_code = esi.primary_uom_code
LEFT JOIN inv_units_of_measure_tl uom_tl ON uom_tl.unit_of_measure_id = uom_b.unit_of_measure_id
AND uom_tl.language = 'US'
WHERE esi.last_update_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP(:P_FROM_DATE,
                                'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
  AND esi.last_update_date <= TO_TIMESTAMP(:P_TO_DATE,
                                'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
  AND iop.organization_code = 'ITEM_ORG_MESTRE'
  AND eic.attribute6 = 'Y'
  AND ecst.category_set_name = 'Compras'
ORDER BY esi.item_number
```

```sql
SELECT OP.WO_OPERATION_ID, OP.ORGANIZATION_ID, OP.WORK_ORDER_ID, OP.OPERATION_SEQ_NUMBER,
       OP.STANDARD_OPERATION_ID, OPO.WO_OPERATION_OUTPUT_ID, OPO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, IT.ITEM_NUMBER,
       IT.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_DESCRIPTION, OPO.OUTPUT_SEQ_NUMBER, OPO.OUTPUT_TYPE, OPO.OUTPUT_QUANTITY,

  AND OP.WO_OPERATION_ID = OPO.WO_OPERATION_iD
```

### Query #39

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

### Query #39

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN inv_convert.inv_um_convert(:P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                       NULL, :P_ORGANIZATION_ID, 3,
                                       :P_ORDERED_QTY_IN_PRIMARY_UOM * (NVL(esib.unit_weight,
                                                                          0) + NVL(FND_NUMBER.CANONICAL_TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(eieb.attribute_char1),

                                                                                                                    '0')),

                                                                                 0)), esib.weight_uom_code, 'KG', :P_FROM_NAME,
                                       :P_TO_NAME) = -99999 THEN 0
                    ELSE inv_convert.inv_um_convert(:P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                       NULL, :P_ORGANIZATION_ID, 3,
                                       :P_ORDERED_QTY_IN_PRIMARY_UOM * (NVL(esib.unit_weight,
                                                                          0) + NVL(FND_NUMBER.CANONICAL_TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(eieb.attribute_number1),

                                                                                                                    '0')),

                                                                                 0)), esib.weight_uom_code, 'KG', :P_FROM_NAME,
                                       :P_TO_NAME)
                END AS peso_bruto,
                CASE
                    WHEN inv_convert.inv_um_convert(:P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                       NULL, :P_ORGANIZATION_ID, 3,
                                       :P_ORDERED_QTY_IN_PRIMARY_UOM * (NVL(esib.unit_weight,
                                                                          0) + NVL(FND_NUMBER.CANONICAL_TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(eieb.attribute_char1),

                                                                                                                    '0')),

                                                                                 0)), esib.weight_uom_code, 'KG', :P_FROM_NAME,
                                       :P_TO_NAME) = -99999 THEN 0
                    ELSE inv_convert.inv_um_convert(:P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID,
                                       NULL, :P_ORGANIZATION_ID, 3,
                                       :P_ORDERED_QTY_IN_PRIMARY_UOM * NVL(esib.unit_weight,
                                                                         0), esib.weight_uom_code, 'KG', :P_FROM_NAME,
                                       :P_TO_NAME)
                END AS peso_liquido
FROM egp_system_items_b esib, ego_item_eff_b eieb
WHERE esib.inventory_item_id = eieb.inventory_item_id(+)
  AND esib.organization_id = eieb.organization_id(+)
  AND eieb.context_code (+) = 'PLU_ATRIBUTOS_INTEGRA'
  AND esib.inventory_item_id = :P_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND esib.organization_id = :P_ORGANIZATION_ID
```

### Query #40

**Tags:** `SCM - Inventory & Costing, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_LOCATIONS_ALL, INV_ORG_PARAMETERS`

### Query #40

**Tags:** `HCM & HR, SCM - Inventory & Costing`

**Tabelas:** `INV_ORG_PARAMETERS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL`

```sql
SELECT party_site_id orig_party_site_id
FROM
  (SELECT hps.party_site_id
   FROM inv_org_parameters p ,xle_registrations xr ,xle_associations xa ,
        hr_locations hl ,INV_ORGANIZATION_DEFINITIONS_V iodv ,hz_party_sites hps ,
        hz_parties hp ,zx_party_tax_profile zptp ,zx_party_taxpayer_idntfs zpti
   WHERE p.ORGANIZATION_ID = iodv.ORGANIZATION_ID
     AND iodv.location_id = hl.location_id
     AND xr.source_id = xa.subject_id
     AND xa.object_id = hl.location_id
     AND xa.association_type_id = 10010
     AND hps.party_id = p.party_id
     AND hp.party_id = p.party_id
     AND zptp.party_id = hps.party_site_id
     AND zpti.entity_id = zptp.party_tax_profile_id
     AND zptp.party_type_code = 'THIRD_PARTY_SITE'
     AND zptp.site_flag = 'Y'
     AND zptp.customer_flag = 'Y'
     AND zpti.reporting_type_code IN ('ORA_BR_CNPJ','ORA_BR_CPF','ORA_BR_OTHER')
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(zpti.effective_from, TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1) AND NVL(zpti.effective_to,

                                                                                 TRUNC(SYSDATE+1))
     AND xr.registration_number = zpti.tax_payer_number
     AND hl.location_id = :P_FULFILLMENT_ORG_LOCATION_ID)
```

**Tabelas:** `WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS`

```sql
SELECT MP.ORGANIZATION_CODE , DHA.ORDER_NUMBER , DHL.FULFILL_LINE_ID ,msib.item_number ,
       dhl.fulfill_line_number ,dhl.status_code
FROM wsh_delivery_details wdd , wsh_delivery_assignments wda , JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL jfdha ,
     JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL jfdra , doo_fulfill_lines_all dhl , doo_headers_all dha , HR_OPERATING_UNITS hou ,
     inv_org_parameters mp ,egp_system_items_b msib
WHERE wdd.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = wda.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
  AND wda.delivery_id = jfdha.trx_id
  AND jfdha.doc_hdr_id = jfdra.doc_hdr_id
  AND dhl.fulfill_line_id = wdd.source_shipment_id
  AND dha.header_id = dhl.header_id
  AND jfdra.trx_id = wda.delivery_id
  AND hou.organization_id = dha.org_id
  AND mp.organization_id = dhl.fulfill_org_id
  AND jfdra.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
  AND msib.organization_id = mp.organization_id
  AND msib.inventory_item_id = dhl.inventory_item_id
  AND JFDRA.DOC_NUM = :pNFOriginal
  AND MP.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :pOrganizationCode
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics, LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL, WSH_DELIVERY_ASSIGNMENTS, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS, WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES`

```sql
SELECT 'Shipconfirm' AS SENDER_TRANSMISSION_NO ,dd.attribute3 AS SHIPMENT_X_ID ,'IU' AS TRANSACTION_CODE ,
       'EMISSAO_NFE' AS STATUS_TYPE ,'EMISSAO_NFE_EFETUADA' AS STATUS_VALUE ,
       SUM(nd.gross_weight) AS TOTAL_WEI_VOL_WEIGHT_VALUE ,nd.weight_uom_code AS TOTAL_WEI_VOL_WEIGHT_UOM_GID ,
       SUM(nd.volume) AS TOTAL_WEI_VOL_VOLUME_VALUE ,nd.volume_uom_code AS TOTAL_WEI_VOL_VOLUME_UOM_GID ,
       SUM(nd.volume) AS TOTAL_NET_WEI_VOLUME_VALUE ,nd.volume_uom_code AS TOTAL_NET_WEI_VOLUME_UOM_GID ,
       SUM(nd.net_weight) AS TOTAL_NET_WEI_VOLUME_WEIGHT_VALUE ,nd.weight_uom_code AS TOTAL_NET_WEI_VOLUME_WEIGHT_UOM_GID ,

  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM wsh_delivery_details dd2
   WHERE dd2.attribute3 = dd.attribute3) AS TOTAL_SHIP_UNIT_COUNT ,

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dd2.inventory_item_id)
   FROM wsh_delivery_details dd2
   WHERE dd2.attribute3 = dd.attribute3) AS TOTAL_PACKAGED_ITEM_SPEC_COUNT ,

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dd2.unit_volume)
   FROM wsh_delivery_details dd2
   WHERE dd2.attribute3 = dd.attribute3) AS TOTAL_PACKAGED_ITEM_COUNT ,'PLUMA' AS DOMAIN_NAME
FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
JOIN jg_fscl_doc_relations_all r ON r.trx_id = nd.delivery_id
AND r.status = 'APPROVED'
AND r.entity_code = 'SHIPMENTS'
JOIN wsh_delivery_assignments da ON da.delivery_id = nd.delivery_id
JOIN wsh_delivery_details dd ON dd.delivery_detail_id = da.delivery_detail_id
WHERE dd.attribute3 IS NOT NULL
  AND r.last_update_date >= :P_RUN_DATE
GROUP BY dd.attribute3, nd.weight_uom_code, nd.volume_uom_code
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics`

**Tabelas:** `WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SCM - Shipping & Logistics`

**Tabelas:** `WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES`

```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'SUCCESS'
       END AS STATUS, LISTAGG(MESSAGE, ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (
                                                            ORDER BY MESSAGE) AS MESSAGE_LIST
FROM
  (SELECT 'Peso e Volume não foram declarados.' AS MESSAGE
   FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
   WHERE (nd.net_weight IS NULL
          OR nd.gross_weight IS NULL)
     AND nd.delivery_id = :DELIVERY_ID
   UNION ALL SELECT 'FOB_CODE não foi declarados.' AS MESSAGE
   FROM wsh_new_deliveries nd
   WHERE (nd.ship_method_code IS NOT NULL
          AND nd.FOB_CODE IS NULL)
     AND nd.delivery_id = :DELIVERY_ID)
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `CMF_FISCAL_DOC_DISTRIBUTIONS, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT BU.BU_NAME BU_NAME, CFD.SHIPFROM_FORM_TAX_NUMBER CNPJ_BU,
                SUP.VENDOR_NAME FORNECEDOR, CFD.SHIPTO_FORM_TAX_NUMBER CNPJ_FORNECEDOR,
                TO_CHAR(FH.ISSUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_EMISSAO_NF, FH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER NUMERO_NF,
                FH.SERIES SERIE_NF, FL.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP CFOP,
                EC.CATEGORY_NAME NOME_CATEGORIA, ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER ITEM,
                ITEM.DESCRIPTION DESCRICAO_ITEM, FL.LINE_NUMBER NUMERO_LINHA,
                FL.FD_QUANTITY QUANTIDADE_ITENS, FL.FD_UOM UOM,
                FL.FD_PRICE VALOR_UNITARIO, FL.FD_AMOUNT VALOR_TOTAL_BONIFICACAO,
                POH.SEGMENT1 NUMERO_OC, TO_CHAR(POH.CREATION_DATE,
                                          'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_CRIACAO_OC
FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS FH, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_B FL, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_DISTRIBUTIONS FD,
     PO_HEADERS_ALL POH, FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V BU, POZ_SUPPLIERS_V SUP,
     CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LOC_INFO_V CFD, EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS ITEM, PO_LINES_ALL POL, EGP_CATEGORIES_VL EC
WHERE 1=1
  AND FH.BILL_TO_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = BU.BU_ID
  AND FH.ISSUER_PARTY_ID = SUP.PARTY_ID
  AND CFD.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = FH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND FL.ITEM_ID = ITEM.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
  AND FH.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID = FL.DOCUMENT_HEADER_ID
  AND FD.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
  AND FD.FISCAL_DOC_DISTRIBUTION_ID =
    (SELECT MIN(FD2.FISCAL_DOC_DISTRIBUTION_ID)
     FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_DISTRIBUTIONS FD2
     WHERE FD2.FISCAL_DOC_LINE_ID = FL.DOCUMENT_LINE_ID)
  AND FD.SOURCE_DOC_ID1 = POH.PO_HEADER_ID
  AND FD.SOURCE_DOC_ID2 = POL.PO_LINE_ID
  AND POL.CATEGORY_ID = EC.CATEGORY_ID
  AND FL.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP IN ('6910','5910')
  AND (BU.BU_NAME IN (:P_BU)
       OR :P_BU IS NULL)
  AND (SUP.VENDOR_NAME IN (:P_FORNECEDOR)
       OR :P_FORNECEDOR IS NULL)
  AND (CFD.SHIPFROM_FORM_TAX_NUMBER IN (:P_CNPJ_BU)
       OR :P_CNPJ_BU IS NULL)
  AND (CFD.SHIPTO_FORM_TAX_NUMBER IN (:P_CNPJ_FORNECEDOR)
       OR :P_CNPJ_FORNECEDOR IS NULL)
  AND FH.ISSUE_DATE BETWEEN NVL(:P_DATA_INI, FH.ISSUE_DATE) AND NVL(:P_DATA_FIM,
                                                                  FH.ISSUE_DATE)
  AND FH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:P_NUMERO_NF, FH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER)
  AND FL.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP = NVL(:P_CFOP, FL.FD_ORIGINAL_CFOP)
  AND (EC.CATEGORY_NAME IN (:P_CATEGORIA)
       OR COALESCE(:P_CATEGORIA, 'NULL') = 'NULL')
  AND ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER = NVL(:P_ITEM, ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER)
  AND POH.SEGMENT1 = NVL(:P_PO, POH.SEGMENT1)
ORDER BY BU.BU_NAME, FH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, FL.LINE_NUMBER
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS, FDCNF`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG)`

**Tabelas:** `FDCNF, CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS`

```sql
WITH FdcNF AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT pu.username AS comprador, cfdh_nc.document_number AS nota,
                   cfdh_nc.total_amount AS valor, hp.party_name AS fornecedor,
                   pha.segment1 AS ordemCompra
   FROM CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS cfdh_nc ,CMF_FISCAL_DOC_HEADERS cfdh_nv ,
        CMF_FISCAL_DOC_LINES_VL cfdl ,CMF_FISCAL_DOC_SCHEDULES cfds ,PO_HEADERS_ALL pha ,
        PO_LINES_ALL pla ,POZ_SUPPLIERS pps ,HZ_PARTIES hp ,
        PER_USERS pu
   WHERE 1=1
     AND cfdh_nc.document_status = 'CAPTURED'
     AND cfdl.document_header_id = cfdh_nc.document_header_id
     AND cfds.fiscal_doc_header_id = cfdh_nc.document_header_id
     AND cfds.fiscal_doc_line_id = cfdl.document_line_id
     AND cfds.source_doc_id1 = pha.po_header_id
     AND pha.po_header_id = pla.po_header_id
     AND cfds.source_doc_id2 = pla.po_line_id
     AND cfdh_nv.document_header_id = cfdh_nc.parent_document_header_id
     AND pps.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id
     AND hp.party_id = pps.party_id
     AND pu.person_id = pha.agent_id
     AND cfdh_nc.last_update_date >= FROM_TZ(TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_update_date,
                                               'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
                                       'America/Sao_Paulo'))
SELECT comprador,
       RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(e,

                      'Nota: ' || nota || ' | Valor: R$ ' || TO_CHAR(valor,
                                                               'FM999G999G999D90') || ' | Ordem Compra: ' || ordemCompra || ' | Fornecedor: ' || fornecedor || CHR(10))
                    ORDER BY nota).EXTRACT('//text()').getClobVal(), CHR(10)) AS lista_notas_fornecedores, COUNT(*) AS qtd_notas, SUM(valor) AS total_geral
FROM FdcNF
GROUP BY comprador
ORDER BY total_geral DESC
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 'NFE-FDG-Release' AS sender_transmission_no , src.shipment_xid AS shipment_xid ,
                src.release_xid AS release_xid , src.order_num AS order_num ,
                'IU' AS transaction_code , ROUND(SUM(src.total_amount),
                                             2) AS attribute_number20 ,
                src.fiscal_doc_key AS LOGLSBR_NFE_CHAVE , 'RELEASE_COMPLETA' AS LOGLSBR_STATUS_RELEASE ,
                'PLUMA' AS domain_name , src.fiscal_doc_num AS fiscal_doc_num ,
                src.fiscal_doc_series AS fiscal_doc_series , src.fiscal_doc_date AS fiscal_doc_date ,
                src.source_module AS source_module
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT wnd.attribute4 shipment_xid, TO_NUMBER(NULL) release_xid,
                   jfdl.source_document_number order_num, jfdl.assessable_value total_amount,
                   jfdr.fiscal_doc_key fiscal_doc_key, jfdr.doc_num fiscal_doc_num,
                   jfdr.series fiscal_doc_series, jfdr.fiscal_doc_date fiscal_doc_date,
                   jfdr.event_class_code source_module
   FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdr, jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdh, jg_fscl_doc_lines_all jfdl,
        WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS wdd, wsh_new_deliveries wnd, wsh_delivery_assignments wda
   WHERE WDD.RELEASED_STATUS IN ('Y', 'C')
     AND WND.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'LACLS_BR_FDGAUT_HDR'
     AND WDA.DELIVERY_ID = WND.DELIVERY_ID
     AND WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND WND.ATTRIBUTE4 IS NOT NULL
     AND jfdh.doc_hdr_id = jfdr.doc_hdr_id
     AND jfdh.doc_hdr_id = jfdl.doc_hdr_id
     AND jfdr.event_class_code = 'SALES_ORDER_SHIPMENT'
     AND jfdr.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
     AND jfdl.TRX_LINE_TYPE = 'ITEM'
     AND jfdl.TRX_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_ID
     AND jfdl.TRX_LINE_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND jfdr.last_update_date >= nvl(TO_DATE(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                        'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
                                    jfdr.last_update_date)
   UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT wnd.attribute4 shipment_xid,
                             TO_NUMBER(NULL) release_xid, jfdl.source_document_number order_num,
                             jfdl.assessable_value total_amount,
                             jfdr.fiscal_doc_key fiscal_doc_key,
                             jfdr.doc_num fiscal_doc_num,
                             jfdr.series fiscal_doc_series,
                             jfdr.fiscal_doc_date fiscal_doc_date,
                             jfdr.event_class_code source_module
   FROM jg_fscl_doc_relations_all jfdr, jg_fscl_doc_hdrs_all jfdh, jg_fscl_doc_lines_all jfdl,
        wsh_delivery_details wdd, wsh_new_deliveries wnd, wsh_delivery_assignments wda
   WHERE WDD.RELEASED_STATUS IN ('Y', 'C')
     AND WND.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'LACLS_BR_FDGAUT_HDR'
     AND WDA.DELIVERY_ID = WND.DELIVERY_ID
     AND WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID = WDD.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND WND.ATTRIBUTE4 IS NOT NULL
     AND jfdh.doc_hdr_id = jfdr.doc_hdr_id
     AND jfdh.doc_hdr_id = jfdl.doc_hdr_id
     AND jfdr.event_class_code IN ('TRANSFER_ORDER_SHIPMENT', 'RETURN_TO_VENDOR_SHIPMENT')
     AND jfdr.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
     AND jfdl.TRX_LINE_TYPE = 'ITEM'
     AND jfdl.TRX_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_ID
     AND jfdl.TRX_LINE_ID = WDA.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ID
     AND jfdr.last_update_date >= nvl(TO_DATE(:P_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                                        'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
                                    jfdr.last_update_date)) src
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY src.shipment_xid , src.release_xid , src.order_num , src.fiscal_doc_key , src.fiscal_doc_num ,
         src.fiscal_doc_series , src.fiscal_doc_date , src.source_module
ORDER BY src.shipment_xid , src.release_xid , src.order_num
OFFSET :P_OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT :P_CHUNK_SIZE ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_HDRS_ATRB_INT, ESS_REQUEST_PROPERTY, JG_FSCL_ATRB_INT_ERRORS`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `LOC - Localização Brasil (FDC/FDG), SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `JG_FSCL_ATRB_INT_ERRORS, ESS_REQUEST_PROPERTY, JG_FSCL_HDRS_ATRB_INT`

```sql
SELECT err_jg.REQUEST_ID AS REQUEST_ID, err_jg.MESSAGE_TEXT AS ERROR,
       hdr.ORG_ID AS BU,

  (SELECT MAX(VALUE)
   FROM ess_request_property
   WHERE REQUESTID = err_jg.REQUEST_ID
     AND NAME = 'submit.argument2') AS PARAM_TRX_INICIAL,

  (SELECT MAX(VALUE)
   FROM ess_request_property
   WHERE REQUESTID = err_jg.REQUEST_ID
     AND NAME = 'submit.argument3') AS PARAM_TRX_FINAL,

  (SELECT MAX(VALUE)
   FROM ess_request_property
   WHERE REQUESTID = err_jg.REQUEST_ID
     AND NAME = 'submit.argument6') AS PARAM_BU
FROM JG_FSCL_ATRB_INT_ERRORS err_jg
LEFT JOIN JG_FSCL_HDRS_ATRB_INT hdr ON err_jg.INTERFACE_HDR_ID = hdr.INTERFACE_HDR_ID
WHERE err_jg.CREATION_DATE >= :P_RUN_DATE
ORDER BY REQUEST_ID DESC
```

### Query #1

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL, JOIN, ATTRIBUTE1, NVL, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, CLIA_, CLIENT_B, HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_X, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F...`

```sql
SELECT HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS CODIGO, HAUFT.NAME AS NOME, ORG.NAME AS CODIGO_BU, HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F HAOUF
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HAUFT ON HAUFT.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HAUFT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F HOUCF ON HOUCF.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HOUCF.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL ORG ON SUBSTR(ORG.NAME,
                                             1, 7) = SUBSTR(HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                                       1, 7)
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ORG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND ORG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_X CLS ON CLS.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND CLS.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
  AND (HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :pCodigo
       OR :pCodigo IS NULL)
ORDER BY HAUFT.NAME
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, CONTRATOS, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, CONTRATOS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
WITH CONTRATOS AS
  (SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA,
          DECODE(PPTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE,
            'CLT - Geral', 1, 'CLT - Docente', 3, 'Autônomo RPA', 9, 2) AS PESO_VINCULO, PAAM.NORMAL_HOURS AS CARGA_HORARIA,
          TO_CHAR(ADM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ADMISSAO, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID, PAAM.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID,
          PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
   JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTL ON PPTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID
   AND PPTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
   JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ADM ON ADM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
   AND ADM.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE','REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION',
                           'GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                           'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL')
   JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
   AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
   AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
     (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
      FROM per_people_legislative_f
      WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
   JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS CPF ON CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
   AND CPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
   AND CPF.LEGISLATION_CODE = PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE
   WHERE PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
     AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY')
     AND CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf)
SELECT *
FROM CONTRATOS
ORDER BY PESO_VINCULO, CARGA_HORARIA DESC, ADMISSAO FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `CMP_SALARY_BASES, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `CMP_SALARY_BASES, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL, BS1.NAME AS BASE_ADM_MENSALISTA, BS2.NAME AS BASE_ADM_HORISTA,
       NVL(BS4.NAME, BS11.NAME) AS BASE_DOCENTE
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'CLIB_BASE_SALARIAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS1 ON BS1.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS2 ON BS2.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION2
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS4 ON BS4.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION4
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS11 ON BS11.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION11
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
```

### Query #4

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F`

```sql
SELECT HAUFT.NAME AS CODIGO, SUBSTR(HAUFT.NAME, 11) AS NOME, HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F HAOUF
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HAUFT ON HAUFT.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HAUFT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F HOUCF ON HOUCF.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HOUCF.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F LOC ON LOC.LEI_INFORMATION1 = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND LOC.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'Estabelecimento'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'CLIB_BASE_SALARIAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND (PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION2 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION4 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION11 IS NOT NULL)
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
  AND lower(HAUFT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%não usar%'
  AND SUBSTR(HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 7) = :p_empresa
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL, LEI_INFORMATION25 AS COD_SIND_ADM_HCM,
       SIND_ADM.NAME AS NOME_SIND_ADM_HCM, SIND_ADM.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_ADM_RM,
       LEI_INFORMATION26 AS COD_SIND_DOC_HCM, SIND_DOC.NAME AS NOME_SIND_DOC_HCM,
       SIND_DOC.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_DOC_RM, LEI_INFORMATION27 AS COD_SIND_MED_HCM,
       SIND_MED.NAME AS NOME_SIND_MED_HCM, SIND_MED.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_MED_RM,
       SIND_ESTAG.ORGANIZATION_ID AS COD_SIND_ESTAG_HCM, SIND_ESTAG.NAME AS NOME_SIND_ESTAG_HCM,
       SIND_ESTAG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_ESTAG_RM, SIND_BOL.ORGANIZATION_ID AS COD_SIND_BOLS_HCM,
       SIND_BOL.NAME AS NOME_SIND_BOLS_HCM, SIND_BOL.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_BOLS_RM
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'CLIB_SINDICATO'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_ADM ON SIND_ADM.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION25
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_ADM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_ADM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_DOC ON SIND_DOC.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION26
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_DOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_DOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_MED ON SIND_MED.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION27
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_MED.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_MED.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_ESTAG ON SIND_ESTAG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE = 'ESTAGIARIO'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_ESTAG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_ESTAG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_BOL ON SIND_BOL.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE = 'BOLSISTAS'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_BOL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_BOL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
ORDER BY LOC.LOCATION_CODE
```

### Query #8

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS`

### Query #8

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL`

```sql
SELECT CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 AS CODIGO, FFVL.DESCRIPTION AS NOME
FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V DEPT
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_INFORMATION CC ON CC.ORGANIZATION_ID = DEPT.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND CC.ORG_INFORMATION_CONTEXT = 'PER_GL_COST_CENTER_INFO'
AND ((:pCodigoEscopo = 'Nacional'
      AND (CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 like 'AA01%'
           OR CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 like 'AC01%'
           OR CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 like 'AI01%'))
     OR (:pCodigoEscopo <> 'Nacional'
         AND (CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 not like 'AA01%'
              AND CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 not like 'AC01%'
              AND CC.ORG_INFORMATION1 not like 'AI01%')))
JOIN FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVL ON FFVL.FLEX_VALUE = CC.ORG_INFORMATION1
AND NVL(FFVL.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NVL(FFVL.SUMMARY_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(FFVL.START_DATE_ACTIVE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(FFVL.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                             TRUNC(SYSDATE))
JOIN FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS ON FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVL.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
AND FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'Centro de Custo CLIENT_B'
WHERE DEPT.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND DEPT.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE IS NOT NULL
  AND DEPT.STATUS = 'A'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN DEPT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND DEPT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND DEPT.ORGANIZATION_ID = :pCodigoDepto
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

### Query #9

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, PER_PERSONS, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F`

```sql
SELECT PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER20 AS NRODEPEND, PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME, PNID.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER AS CPF,
       TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NASCIMENTO, PPLFD.SEX AS SEXO, PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE8 AS ESTADOCILVIL,
       FND.MEANING AS GRAUPARENTESCO, PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE3 AS NOMEMAEDEPEND,
       TO_CHAR(PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATACASAMENTO
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F PCRF
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE person_id = PPNF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON PP.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PP.START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(start_date)
   FROM per_persons
   WHERE PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLFD ON PPLFD.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PPLFD.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLFD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = PPLFD.PERSON_ID)
LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNID ON PNID.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND PNID.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = PCRF.PERSON_ID
AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = PPLF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI ON PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND PNI.PERSON_ID = PCRF.PERSON_ID
JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES FND ON FND.LOOKUP_CODE = PCRF.CONTACT_TYPE
AND FND.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CONTACT'
AND FND.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
WHERE PCRF.CONTACT_TYPE <> 'EMRG'
  AND PCRF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE contact_relationship_id = PCRF.CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID)
  AND FND.LOOKUP_CODE IN ('S','T','IN_S','CLIB_3','CLIB_B')
  AND PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf
ORDER BY PPNF.FULL_NAME
```

### Query #10

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

### Query #10

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT HAP.POSITION_CODE AS COD_POSICAO, HAPF.NAME AS NOME_POSICAO, HAP.ATTRIBUTE4 AS "VP"
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F HAP
JOIN HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL HAPF ON HAPF.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND HAPF.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ON PAAM.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(Z.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M Z
   WHERE Z.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMAIL ON EMAIL.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND EMAIL.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN EMAIL.DATE_FROM AND NVL(EMAIL.DATE_TO,
                                          TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                            'DD/MM/YYYY'))
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAP.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND EMAIL.EMAIL_ADDRESS = :pEmailGestor
ORDER BY HAPF.NAME
```

### Query #11

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F`

### Query #11

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL`

```sql
SELECT JB.JOB_CODE AS COD_CARGO, JTL.NAME AS NOME, FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE AS COD_FAMILIA,
       FTL.JOB_FAMILY_NAME AS FAMILIA, JB.ATTRIBUTE6 AS AGENTE_PEDAGOGICO, JB.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY AS GRADE,
       JB.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CODRECEBIMENTO,
       CASE WHEN JB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'D' WHEN JB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'H' THEN 'H' WHEN FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE = '13' THEN 'E' ELSE 'A'
       END AS TIPOFUNC, DECODE(JB.ATTRIBUTE2, 'Y', 'S', 'N') AS RISCO,
       CASE JB.ATTRIBUTE1 WHEN 'M' THEN 'S' WHEN 'P' THEN 'CLIB_P' WHEN 'H' THEN 'H'
       END AS HOURLYSALARIEDCODE
FROM PER_JOBS_F JB
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL JTL ON JTL.JOB_ID = JB.JOB_ID
AND JTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN JTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL FTL ON FTL.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND FTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN JB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND JB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND JB.JOB_CODE not like 'A-%'
  AND JB.JOB_CODE not like 'L-%'
  AND (JB.JOB_CODE = :PCodigoCargo
       OR :PCodigoCargo IS NULL)
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #12

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

### Query #12

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F`

```sql
SELECT CRESP.CODIGO, CRESP.CODIGO AS DESCRICAO
FROM
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Nacional'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION1,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION2 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Regional'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION2,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION3 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Local'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION3,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Vertical'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION4,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION5 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Marca'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION5,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION6 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Educação Digital'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION6,
             CASE WHEN PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION7 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Local (Medicina)'
             END AS LEI_INFORMATION7
      FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
      JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
      AND PLEI.INFORMATION_TYPE = 'Centro Responsabilidade'
      AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
      WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
        AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A') UNPIVOT (Codigo
                                              FOR Escopo IN ("LEI_INFORMATION1","LEI_INFORMATION2",
                                                             "LEI_INFORMATION3","LEI_INFORMATION4",
                                                             "LEI_INFORMATION5","LEI_INFORMATION6",
                                                             "LEI_INFORMATION7"))) CRESP
WHERE CRESP.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
ORDER BY 1
```

### Query #13

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, PER_POSITION_HIERARCHY_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V`

### Query #13

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_POSITION_HIERARCHY_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT DEPTO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS CODIGO, DEPTO.NAME AS NOME, COUNT(*) AS SUBORDINADOS
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POSGESTOR
JOIN PER_POSITION_HIERARCHY_F HIER ON HIER.PARENT_POSITION_ID = POSGESTOR.POSITION_ID
AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN HIER.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HIER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
JOIN HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POSSUB ON POSSUB.POSITION_ID = HIER.POSITION_ID
AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN POSSUB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND POSSUB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND POSSUB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_V DEPTO ON DEPTO.ORGANIZATION_ID = POSSUB.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND DEPTO.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'DEPARTMENT'
AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN DEPTO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND DEPTO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND DEPTO.STATUS = 'A'
WHERE POSGESTOR.POSITION_CODE = :pCodigoPosicaoGestor
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN POSGESTOR.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND POSGESTOR.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
GROUP BY DEPTO.ORGANIZATION_ID, DEPTO.NAME
ORDER BY 3 DESC,2
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL, PER_ADDRESSES_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F...`

### Query #14

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS, PER_CHECKLISTS_B, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F, PER_PERSONS, CMP_SALARY, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_JOBS_F...`

```sql
SELECT ALC.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID, TL.NAME, ITEM.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID, ITTL.TASK_NAME, ALC.CHECKLIST_ID,
       ALC.CHECKLIST_STATUS, ALC.PERSON_ID, ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID, PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME,
       CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER AS CPF, TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                                                'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NASCIMENTO,
       PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE8 AS MODALIDADE,
       CASE PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE WHEN 'CLT - Docente' THEN 44 ELSE (PAAM.NORMAL_HOURS / 5)
       END AS HORAS_SEMANAIS,
       CASE PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE WHEN 'CLT - Docente' THEN 0 ELSE PJ.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY
       END AS GRADE, CS.SALARY_AMOUNT AS SALARIO, PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS ENDERECO,
       PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_2 AS NUMERO, PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_4 AS BAIRRO, PAF.TOWN_OR_CITY AS CIDADE,
       PAF.REGION_2 AS UF_ENDERECO, PAF.POSTAL_CODE AS CEP, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
       SUBSTR(LOC.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE, 1, 7) AS CODFILIAL, SUBSTR(LOC.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE,
                                                                11) AS UNIDADE,
       PJ.JOB_CODE AS CODFUNCAO, PJTL.NAME AS NOMECARGO,
       CASE WHEN PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'CLT - Docente' THEN 'P' WHEN PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'M' THEN 'H' ELSE 'M'
       END AS CODRECEBIMENTO, PPLF.SEX AS SEXO,
       CASE WHEN PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'CLT - Docente' THEN 'D' WHEN PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'M' THEN 'H' WHEN FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE = '13' THEN 'E' ELSE 'A'
       END AS TIPOFUNC, DEPT.NAME AS DEPARTAMENTO, ECV.MEANING AS ESTADOCIVIL
FROM PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS ALC
JOIN PER_CHECKLISTS_B CHK ON CHK.CHECKLIST_ID = ALC.CHECKLIST_ID
AND CHK.CHECKLIST_CODE IN ('PRÉ-ADMISSÃO',
                           'PARABÉNS!_VOCÊ_TEM_UM_NOVO_VÍNCULO_DE_RELAÇÃO_DE_TRABALHO_CONOSCO!_ONBOARD_BR','NOVA_ATRIBUIÇÃO_DE_TRABALHO',
                           'PRÉ-ADMISSÃO_-_APRENDIZ','PRÉ-ADMISSÃO_-_ESTAGIÁRIO')
JOIN PER_CHECKLISTS_TL TL ON TL.CHECKLIST_ID = CHK.CHECKLIST_ID
AND TL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS ITEM ON ITEM.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID = ALC.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID
AND ITEM.STATUS <> 'COM'
JOIN PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL ITTL ON ITTL.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID = ITEM.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID
AND ITTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND ITTL.TASK_NAME = 'Escolha de Benefícios'
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS CPF ON CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND CPF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND CPF.LEGISLATION_CODE = PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE
JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES ECV ON ECV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MAR_STATUS'
AND ECV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND ECV.LOOKUP_CODE = PPLF.MARITAL_STATUS
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                'DD/MM/YYYY')
JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ON PAAM.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND TRUNC(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                       'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE = 'Y'
JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON PP.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PP.START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(start_date)
   FROM per_persons
   WHERE PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ON PAPF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_all_people_f
   WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
LEFT JOIN PER_GRADES_F PG ON PG.GRADE_ID = PAAM.GRADE_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN CMP_SALARY CS ON CS.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND CS.DATE_FROM =
  (SELECT MAX(X.DATE_FROM)
   FROM CMP_SALARY X
   WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F PAUF ON PAUF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAUF.ADDRESS_ID = PAPF.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID
AND PAUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_person_addr_usages_f
   WHERE person_addr_usage_id = PAUF.PERSON_ADDR_USAGE_ID
     AND person_id = PAUF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_ADDRESSES_F PAF ON PAF.ADDRESS_ID = PAUF.ADDRESS_ID
AND PAF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM PER_ADDRESSES_F
   WHERE ADDRESS_ID = PAF.ADDRESS_ID)
JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PEA ON PEA.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PEA.EMAIL_TYPE = 'H1'
AND PEA.DATE_FROM =
  (SELECT MAX(x.DATE_FROM)
   FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES x
   WHERE x.PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
     AND x.EMAIL_TYPE = PEA.EMAIL_TYPE)
JOIN PER_LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
JOIN PER_JOBS_F PJ ON PJ.JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PJ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL PJTL ON PJTL.JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID
AND PJTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PJTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = PJ.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL DEPT ON DEPT.ORGANIZATION_ID = PAAM.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND DEPT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTTL ON PPTTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PROPOSED_WORKER_TYPE
AND PPTTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
WHERE CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf
  AND ALC.CHECKLIST_STATUS <> 'COM'
```

### Query #15

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F`

### Query #15

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL`

```sql
SELECT JB.JOB_CODE AS COD_CARGO, JTL.NAME AS NOME, FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE AS COD_FAMILIA,
       FTL.JOB_FAMILY_NAME AS FAMILIA, JB.ATTRIBUTE6 AS AGENTE_PEDAGOGICO, JB.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY AS GRADE
FROM PER_JOBS_F JB
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL JTL ON JTL.JOB_ID = JB.JOB_ID
AND JTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN JTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL FTL ON FTL.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND FTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN JB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND JB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND JB.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'Y'
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_VALID_GRADES_F, PER_GRADES_F_TL, PER_RATE_VALUES_F, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, PER_JOBS_F, PER_RATES_F_VL`

### Query #16

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL, PER_RATES_F_VL, PER_RATE_VALUES_F, PER_GRADES_F_TL, PER_JOBS_F, PER_VALID_GRADES_F`

```sql
SELECT TBL.NAME AS NOME_TABELA, FREQ.MEANING AS FREQUENCIA, TBL.ACTIVE_STATUS AS STATUS,
       TO_CHAR(TBL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATA_INICIO, TO_CHAR(TBL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,

                                                                         'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATA_FIM,
       GRD.NAME AS NIVEL, GRDVL.MINIMUM AS MINIMO, GRDVL.MID_VALUE AS MEDIO, GRDVL.MAXIMUM AS MAXIMO,
       GRDVL.VALUE AS VALOR
FROM PER_RATES_F_VL TBL
JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL FREQ ON FREQ.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CMP_SALARY_BASIS'
AND FREQ.LOOKUP_CODE = TBL.RATE_FREQUENCY
JOIN PER_RATE_VALUES_F GRDVL ON GRDVL.RATE_ID = TBL.RATE_ID
AND TBL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE BETWEEN GRDVL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND GRDVL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_GRADES_F_TL GRD ON GRD.GRADE_ID = GRDVL.RATE_OBJECT_ID
AND GRD.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND TBL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE BETWEEN GRD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND GRD.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOBS_F JB ON JB.JOB_CODE = :pCodigoCargo
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN JB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND JB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
JOIN PER_VALID_GRADES_F GRVLD ON GRVLD.GRADE_ID = GRD.GRADE_ID
AND GRVLD.JOB_ID = JB.JOB_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN GRVLD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND GRVLD.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE TO_CHAR(TBL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TBL.NAME = :pNomeTabelaSalarial
ORDER BY TBL.NAME, GRD.NAME
```

### Query #18

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

```sql
SELECT pni.person_id, pni.national_identifier_id, ppnf.person_name_id,
       ppauf.person_addr_usage_id, pph.phone_id, pea.email_address_id, isub.submission_id, ic.candidate_number,
       irb.requisition_number,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(pni.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') cpf_numero,
       CASE
           WHEN ppof.date_start IS NOT NULL
                AND ppof.actual_termination_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END candidato_ativo, papf.person_number, ppof.actual_termination_date,
       ppnf.effective_start_date data_criacao
FROM per_email_addresses pea, per_national_identifiers pni, per_person_names_f ppnf,
     per_person_addr_usages_f ppauf, irc_submissions isub, irc_candidates ic,
     irc_requisitions_b irb, per_periods_of_service ppof,

  (SELECT *
   FROM per_phones
   WHERE phone_type = 'H1') pph,

  (SELECT paam1.*
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam1
   WHERE paam1.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam1.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam1.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam1.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE person_id = paam1.person_id
          AND primary_flag = paam1.primary_flag
          AND assignment_status_type = paam1.assignment_status_type
          AND assignment_type = paam1.assignment_type))paam,

  (SELECT papf1.*
   FROM per_all_people_f papf1
   WHERE papf1.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf1.person_id)) papf
WHERE pea.person_id = pni.person_id
  AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
  AND paam.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppnf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppauf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND pph.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND isub.person_id(+) = pea.person_id
  AND ic.person_id(+) = pea.person_id
  AND irb.requisition_id(+) = isub.requisition_id
  AND papf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppof.period_of_service_id (+) = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppof.person_id (+) = paam.person_id
  AND ic.candidate_number = NVL(:p_candidate_number, ic.candidate_number)
  AND pea.email_address = :p_email
```

### Query #20

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES`

### Query #20

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT apae.per_absence_entry_id unique_id,

     (SELECT haouf.attribute2 || ';' || REGEXP_REPLACE(paam.assignment_number,
                                          '[^[:digit:]]', '')
      FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, hr_all_organization_units_f haouf
      WHERE paam.assignment_id = apate.assignment_id
        AND paam.person_id = apae.person_id
        AND paam.organization_id = haouf.organization_id
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN haouf.effective_start_date AND haouf.effective_end_date
        AND rownum = 1) || ';' || 0 || ';' || TO_CHAR(apae.start_date,
                                                'dd/mm/yyyy') || ';' || 0 || ';' || aatf.attribute2 || ';' || 2 || ';' || TO_CHAR(apae.end_date,

                                                                                                                            'dd/mm/yyyy') || ';' || 0 || ';' || 'N' ODB_USU_DADOS,
          CASE WHEN ((apae.creation_date = apae.last_update_date)) THEN 'I' ELSE 'A'
          END action, 'R038AFA' TABLE_NAME, COUNT(1) OVER() AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                        ORDER BY apae.per_absence_entry_id) LINE,
                                                                                                                            aatt.name
   FROM anc_per_abs_entries apae, anc_per_abs_type_entries apate, anc_absence_types_f aatf,
        anc_absence_types_f_tl aatt
   WHERE apate.per_absence_entry_id = apae.per_absence_entry_id
     AND apate.absence_type_id = aatf.absence_type_id
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN aatf.effective_start_date AND aatf.effective_end_date
     AND aatt.absence_type_id = aatf.absence_type_id
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN aatt.effective_start_date(+) AND aatt.effective_end_date(+)
     AND aatt.LANGUAGE (+) = 'PTB'
     AND apae.last_update_date >= TO_DATE(:p_start_date,
                                    'dd.mm.yyyy hh24:mi:ss')) ddo
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '100' ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '1',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'FR_06' ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '1',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               paam.employee_category) || ';' || pplf.sex || ';' || pplf.marital_status || ';' || TO_CHAR(pp.date_of_birth,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    'dd/mm/yyyy') || ';' || 'BR' || ';' || pplf.per_information1 || ';' || pplf.per_information2 || ';' || pplf.attribute13 || ';' || TO_CHAR(pplf.per_information_date2,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        'dd/mm/yyyy') || ';' || pni_cpf.national_identifier_number || ';' || pni_pis.national_identifier_number || ';' || TO_CHAR(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (SELECT MAX(paam1.effective_start_date)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     FROM per_all_assignments_m paam1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     WHERE paam1.person_id = paam.person_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       AND paam1.assignment_type IN ('E',

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       AND paam1.effective_start_date =
```
