```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AND paam2.assignment_status_type_id = '1'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AND paam2.action_code IN ('HIRE',

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    'REHIRE')
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AND paam2.person_id = paam.person_id)), 'dd/mm/yyyy') || ';' || 'M' || ';' || DECODE(paam.hourly_salaried_code,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            '3',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'S',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'N') || ';' || DECODE(paam.hourly_salaried_code,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '3',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '4',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '2') || ';' || '1' || ';' || lider.display_name || ';' || lider.email_address || ';' || lider.cpf || ';' || 'CPF' || ';' || '' || ';' || haouf.attribute1 || ';' || '' || ';' || 'S' || ';' || '' ODB_USU_DADOS,
          CASE

          END action, 'R034FUN' TABLE_NAME, COUNT(1) OVER() AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                                                                                        ORDER BY hauft.organization_id) LINE
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam, per_person_names_f ppnf, hr_org_unit_classifications_f houcf,

     (SELECT pasf.assignment_id, ppnf_sup.display_name, UPPER(pea_sup.email_address) email_address,

      FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf, per_person_names_f ppnf_sup,
           per_email_addresses pea_sup, per_national_identifiers pni_cpf
      WHERE 1=1
        AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'

     AND hauft.effective_end_date = haouf.effective_end_date
     AND houcf.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'

     AND paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.system_person_type = 'EMP'
     AND paam.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND paam.organization_id = haouf.organization_id
     AND paam.person_id = ppnf.person_id
     AND ppnf.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND paam.job_id = pj.job_id
     AND pj.job_id = pjt.job_id
     AND pj.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND pjt.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND pjt.language = 'PTB'
     AND paam.person_id = pplf.person_id
     AND pplf.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND paam.person_id = pp.person_id
     AND paam.person_id = pni_ctps.person_id(+)
     AND pni_ctps.national_identifier_type (+) = 'CTPS'
     AND paam.person_id = pni_cpf.person_id(+)
     AND pni_cpf.national_identifier_type (+) = 'CPF'
     AND paam.person_id = pni_pis.person_id(+)
     AND pni_pis.national_identifier_type (+) = 'PIS'
     AND paam.assignment_id = lider.assignment_id(+)
     AND paam.last_update_date >= TO_DATE(:p_start_date,
                                    'dd.mm.yyyy hh24:mi:ss')) ddo
WHERE LINE BETWEEN ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + 1) AND ((:p_limit * (:p_page - 1)) + :p_limit)
```

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES`

```sql
SELECT haotl.NAME , hao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE , hao.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE , hao.ATTRIBUTE6 empresa ,
       hao.ATTRIBUTE2 estabelecimento_folha, hao.ATTRIBUTE8 centro_resultado , hao.ATTRIBUTE1 centro_custo ,
       hao.ATTRIBUTE9 Conta_Contabil_Despesas, hao.attribute6||'.'||hao.attribute2||'.'||hao.attribute8 BU,

  (SELECT b.description
   FROM fnd_flex_values a, fnd_flex_values_tl b
   WHERE a.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'GL_EMPRESA CLIENT_A'
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE_ID = b.FLEX_VALUE_ID
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE = hao.ATTRIBUTE6
     AND rownum = 1) DESCRIPTION_EMPRESA,

  (SELECT b.description
   FROM fnd_flex_values a, fnd_flex_values_tl b
   WHERE a.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'GL_FILIAL CLIENT_A'
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE_ID = b.FLEX_VALUE_ID
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE = hao.ATTRIBUTE2
     AND rownum = 1) DESCRIPTION_ESTABELECIMENTO,

  (SELECT b.description
   FROM fnd_flex_values a, fnd_flex_values_tl b
   WHERE a.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'GL_CENTRO_RESULTADO CLIENT_A'
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE_ID = b.FLEX_VALUE_ID
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE = hao.ATTRIBUTE8
     AND rownum = 1) DESCRIPTION_CR,

  (SELECT a.FLEX_VALUE
   FROM fnd_flex_values a, fnd_flex_values_tl b
   WHERE a.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'GL_EMPRESA CLIENT_A'
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE_ID = b.FLEX_VALUE_ID
     AND a.FLEX_VALUE = hao.ATTRIBUTE6
     AND rownum = 1) FLEX_VALUE
FROM HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F hac, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F hao, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL haotl
WHERE hao.ORGANIZATION_ID = hac.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND hao.ORGANIZATION_ID = haotl.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND hao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE BETWEEN hac.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hac.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND haotl.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
  AND haotl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = hao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
  AND haotl.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = hao.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hac.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND hao.ATTRIBUTE6 IS NOT NULL
  AND hao.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NOT NULL
  AND hao.ATTRIBUTE2 IS NOT NULL
```

### Query #23

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

### Query #23

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_F`

```sql
SELECT iebc.bank_account_type tipo_conta, iebc.country_code cod_pais, iebc.bank_number cod_banco,
       iebc.branch_number cod_agencia, iebc.bank_account_num_electronic numero_conta, iebc.check_digits digito,
       iebc.iban_number swift_bank_code, iebc.alternate_account_name swift_bank_code_international,
       pppm.name nome_conta, popm.currency_code moeda, popm.org_payment_method_name ind_conta_salario,
       papf.person_id, paam.assignment_number, pppm.last_update_date AS account_last_update_date,
       pppm.last_update_date AS pppmlud, popm.last_update_date AS popmlud
FROM per_all_people_f papf,pay_pay_relationships_dn pprd,pay_personal_payment_methods_f pppm,
     pay_org_pay_methods_vl popm, iby_ext_bank_accounts_v iebc, pay_payroll_assignments ppasg,
     PAY_BANK_ACCOUNTS PBA,

  (SELECT per_all_assignments_f.*,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY per_all_assignments_f.PERSON_ID
                       ORDER BY per_all_assignments_f.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE DESC) AS rank
   FROM per_all_assignments_f
   WHERE per_all_assignments_f.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND per_all_assignments_f.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE') paam
WHERE papf.person_id = pprd.person_id (+)
  AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
  AND pprd.payroll_relationship_id = pppm.payroll_relationship_id
  AND to_char(pppm.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
  AND popm.org_payment_method_id = pppm.org_payment_method_id
  AND to_char(popm.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
  AND iebc.bank_account_id = pppm.bank_account_id
  AND pppm.payroll_relationship_id = ppasg.payroll_relationship_id
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.rank = 1
  AND ppasg.HR_ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.assignment_id
  AND iebc.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = PBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
  AND ((:p_person_id IS NOT NULL
        AND papf.person_id = :p_person_id)
       OR ((:p_person_id IS NULL
            AND (PBA.account_last_update_date >= TO_DATE(:pDataProcessamento,
                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                 OR pppm.last_update_date >= TO_DATE(:pDataProcessamento,
                                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                 OR popm.last_update_date >= TO_DATE(:pDataProcessamento,
                                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')))))
```

### Query #24

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pni.person_id, pni.national_identifier_id, pni.national_identifier_type,
                pni.national_identifier_number, pni.legislation_code,
                CASE WHEN papf.primary_nid_id = national_identifier_id THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
                END AS primary_flag,pni.issue_date, pni.place_of_issue,pni.EXPIRATION_DATE,
                pplf.ATTRIBUTE6 AS SERI_CART_RESER,pplf.ATTRIBUTE7 AS CATEG_RESER,pplf.ATTRIBUTE12 AS REG_MIL

  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = pni.person_id)
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT max(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pni.person_id)
```

### Query #25

### Query #25

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F`

```sql
SELECT person_id,person_number
FROM
  (SELECT pcr.person_id, papf.person_number
   FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf
   WHERE papf.person_id = pcr.person_id
     AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
     AND (pcr.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                    TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                      'DD/MM/YYYY'))
          OR papf.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                        TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                          'DD/MM/YYYY')))
   UNION SELECT peai.person_id, papf.person_number
   FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai,PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND peai.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND to_char(papf.effective_end_date, 'yyyy') = '4712'
     AND peai.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_data_integracao,
                                    TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                      'DD/MM/YYYY'))
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 'x'
        FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F pcr
        WHERE pcr.person_id = peai.person_id)
   GROUP BY peai.person_id, papf.person_number)
ORDER BY person_number
```

### Query #31

## 📦 Integrações Anima (Módulo HCM)

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PHONES`

```sql
SELECT pni.person_id , pni.national_identifier_id , ppnf.person_name_id ,
       ppauf.person_addr_usage_id , pph.phone_id , pea.email_address_id , isub.submission_id , ic.candidate_number ,
       irb.requisition_number ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(pni.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') cpf_numero ,
       CASE
           WHEN ppof.date_start IS NOT NULL
                AND ppof.actual_termination_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END candidato_ativo , papf.person_number , ppof.actual_termination_date ,
       ppnf.effective_start_date data_criacao
FROM per_email_addresses pea , per_national_identifiers pni , per_person_names_f ppnf ,
     per_person_addr_usages_f ppauf , irc_submissions isub , irc_candidates ic ,
     irc_requisitions_b irb , per_periods_of_service ppof ,

  (SELECT *
   FROM per_phones
   WHERE phone_type = 'H1') pph ,

  (SELECT paam1.*
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam1
   WHERE paam1.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam1.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam1.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND paam1.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE person_id = paam1.person_id
          AND primary_flag = paam1.primary_flag
          AND assignment_status_type = paam1.assignment_status_type
          AND assignment_type = paam1.assignment_type))paam ,

  (SELECT papf1.*
   FROM per_all_people_f papf1
   WHERE papf1.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf1.person_id)) papf
WHERE pea.person_id = pni.person_id
  AND pni.national_identifier_type = 'CPF'
  AND paam.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppnf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppauf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND pph.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND isub.person_id(+) = pea.person_id
  AND ic.person_id(+) = pea.person_id
  AND irb.requisition_id(+) = isub.requisition_id
  AND papf.person_id (+) = pea.person_id
  AND ppof.period_of_service_id (+) = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppof.person_id (+) = paam.person_id
  AND ic.candidate_number = NVL(:p_candidate_number, ic.candidate_number)
  AND pea.email_address = :p_email
```

### Query #34

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `CMP_SALARY_BASES, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL , BS1.NAME AS BASE_ADM_MENSALISTA , BS2.NAME AS BASE_ADM_HORISTA ,
       NVL(BS4.NAME, BS11.NAME) AS BASE_DOCENTE
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'ANM_BASE_SALARIAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS1 ON BS1.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS2 ON BS2.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION2
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS4 ON BS4.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION4
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY_BASES BS11 ON BS11.SALARY_BASIS_ID = PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION11
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
```

### Query #35

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_LOCATIONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL, PER_ADDRESSES_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F...`

```sql
SELECT ALC.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID , TL.NAME , ITEM.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID , ITTL.TASK_NAME , ALC.CHECKLIST_ID ,
       ALC.CHECKLIST_STATUS , ALC.PERSON_ID , ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME ,
       CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER AS CPF , TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NASCIMENTO ,
       PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER , PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE8 AS MODALIDADE ,
       CASE PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE WHEN 'CLT - Docente' THEN 44 ELSE (PAAM.NORMAL_HOURS / 5)
       END AS HORAS_SEMANAIS ,
       CASE PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE WHEN 'CLT - Docente' THEN 0 ELSE PJ.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY
       END AS GRADE , CS.SALARY_AMOUNT AS SALARIO , PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS ENDERECO ,
       PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_2 AS NUMERO , PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_4 AS BAIRRO , PAF.TOWN_OR_CITY AS CIDADE ,
       PAF.REGION_2 AS UF_ENDERECO , PAF.POSTAL_CODE AS CEP , PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS ,
       SUBSTR(LOC.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE, 1, 7) AS CODFILIAL , SUBSTR(LOC.INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE,
                                                                 11) AS UNIDADE ,
       PJ.JOB_CODE AS CODFUNCAO , PJTL.NAME AS NOMECARGO ,
       CASE WHEN PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'CLT - Docente' THEN 'P' WHEN PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'M' THEN 'H' ELSE 'M'
       END AS CODRECEBIMENTO , PPLF.SEX AS SEXO ,
       CASE WHEN PPTTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'CLT - Docente' THEN 'D' WHEN PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'M' THEN 'H' WHEN FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE = '13' THEN 'E' ELSE 'A'
       END AS TIPOFUNC , DEPT.NAME AS DEPARTAMENTO , ECV.MEANING AS ESTADOCIVIL
FROM PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS ALC
JOIN PER_CHECKLISTS_B CHK ON CHK.CHECKLIST_ID = ALC.CHECKLIST_ID
AND CHK.CHECKLIST_CODE IN ('PRÉ-ADMISSÃO',
                           'PARABÉNS!_VOCÊ_TEM_UM_NOVO_VÍNCULO_DE_RELAÇÃO_DE_TRABALHO_CONOSCO!_ONBOARD_BR','NOVA_ATRIBUIÇÃO_DE_TRABALHO',
                           'PRÉ-ADMISSÃO_-_APRENDIZ','PRÉ-ADMISSÃO_-_ESTAGIÁRIO')
JOIN PER_CHECKLISTS_TL TL ON TL.CHECKLIST_ID = CHK.CHECKLIST_ID
AND TL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS ITEM ON ITEM.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID = ALC.ALLOCATED_CHECKLIST_ID
AND ITEM.STATUS <> 'COM'
JOIN PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL ITTL ON ITTL.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID = ITEM.ALLOCATED_TASK_ID
AND ITTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND ITTL.TASK_NAME = 'Escolha de Benefícios'
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS CPF ON CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND CPF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND CPF.LEGISLATION_CODE = PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE
JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES ECV ON ECV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MAR_STATUS'
AND ECV.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND ECV.LOOKUP_CODE = PPLF.MARITAL_STATUS
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                'DD/MM/YYYY')
JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ON PAAM.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND TRUNC(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                       'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE = 'Y'
JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON PP.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PP.START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(start_date)
   FROM per_persons
   WHERE PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ON PAPF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_all_people_f
   WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
LEFT JOIN PER_GRADES_F PG ON PG.GRADE_ID = PAAM.GRADE_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN CMP_SALARY CS ON CS.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ALC.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND CS.DATE_FROM =
  (SELECT MAX(X.DATE_FROM)
   FROM CMP_SALARY X
   WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F PAUF ON PAUF.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PAUF.ADDRESS_ID = PAPF.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID
AND PAUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_person_addr_usages_f
   WHERE person_addr_usage_id = PAUF.PERSON_ADDR_USAGE_ID
     AND person_id = PAUF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_ADDRESSES_F PAF ON PAF.ADDRESS_ID = PAUF.ADDRESS_ID
AND PAF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM PER_ADDRESSES_F
   WHERE ADDRESS_ID = PAF.ADDRESS_ID)
JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PEA ON PEA.PERSON_ID = ALC.PERSON_ID
AND PEA.EMAIL_TYPE = 'H1'
AND PEA.DATE_FROM =
  (SELECT MAX(x.DATE_FROM)
   FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES x
   WHERE x.PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
     AND x.EMAIL_TYPE = PEA.EMAIL_TYPE)
JOIN PER_LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
JOIN PER_JOBS_F PJ ON PJ.JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PJ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL PJTL ON PJTL.JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID
AND PJTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PJTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = PJ.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL DEPT ON DEPT.ORGANIZATION_ID = PAAM.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND DEPT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTTL ON PPTTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PROPOSED_WORKER_TYPE
AND PPTTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
WHERE CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf
  AND ALC.CHECKLIST_STATUS <> 'COM'
```

### Query #36

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, CONTRATOS, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
WITH CONTRATOS AS
  (SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA ,
          DECODE(PPTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE,
            'CLT - Geral', 1, 'CLT - Docente', 3, 'Autônomo RPA', 9, 2) AS PESO_VINCULO , PAAM.NORMAL_HOURS AS CARGA_HORARIA ,
          TO_CHAR(ADM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ADMISSAO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PAAM.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID ,
          PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
   JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTL ON PPTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID
   AND PPTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
   JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ADM ON ADM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
   AND ADM.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE','REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION',
                           'GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                           'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL')
   JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
   AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
   AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
     (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
      FROM per_people_legislative_f
      WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
   JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS CPF ON CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
   AND CPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
   AND CPF.LEGISLATION_CODE = PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE
   WHERE PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
     AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY')
     AND CPF.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf)
SELECT *
FROM CONTRATOS
ORDER BY PESO_VINCULO, CARGA_HORARIA DESC, ADMISSAO FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #37

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER20 AS NRODEPEND , PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME , PNID.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER AS CPF ,
       TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NASCIMENTO , PPLFD.SEX AS SEXO , PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE8 AS ESTADOCILVIL ,
       FND.MEANING AS GRAUPARENTESCO , PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE3 AS NOMEMAEDEPEND ,
       TO_CHAR(PCRF.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATACASAMENTO
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F PCRF
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE person_id = PPNF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON PP.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PP.START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(start_date)
   FROM per_persons
   WHERE PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLFD ON PPLFD.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
AND PPLFD.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLFD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = PPLFD.PERSON_ID)
LEFT JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNID ON PNID.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND PNID.PERSON_ID = PCRF.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
JOIN PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF ON PPLF.PERSON_ID = PCRF.PERSON_ID
AND PPLF.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR'
AND PPLF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_people_legislative_f
   WHERE person_id = PPLF.PERSON_ID)
JOIN PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI ON PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
AND PNI.PERSON_ID = PCRF.PERSON_ID
JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES FND ON FND.LOOKUP_CODE = PCRF.CONTACT_TYPE
AND FND.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CONTACT'
AND FND.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
WHERE PCRF.CONTACT_TYPE <> 'EMRG'
  AND PCRF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE contact_relationship_id = PCRF.CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP_ID)
  AND FND.LOOKUP_CODE IN ('S','T','IN_S','ANM_3','ANM_B')
  AND PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER = :p_cpf
ORDER BY PPNF.FULL_NAME
```

### Query #38

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F`

```sql
SELECT JB.JOB_CODE AS COD_CARGO , JTL.NAME AS NOME , FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE AS COD_FAMILIA ,
       FTL.JOB_FAMILY_NAME AS FAMILIA , JB.ATTRIBUTE6 AS AGENTE_PEDAGOGICO , JB.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY AS GRADE ,
       JB.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CODRECEBIMENTO ,
       CASE WHEN JB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'D' WHEN JB.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'H' THEN 'H' WHEN FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE = '13' THEN 'E' ELSE 'A'
       END AS TIPOFUNC , DECODE(JB.ATTRIBUTE2, 'Y', 'S', 'N') AS RISCO ,
       CASE JB.ATTRIBUTE1 WHEN 'M' THEN 'S' WHEN 'P' THEN 'ANM_P' WHEN 'H' THEN 'H'
       END AS HOURLYSALARIEDCODE
FROM PER_JOBS_F JB
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL JTL ON JTL.JOB_ID = JB.JOB_ID
AND JTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN JTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL FTL ON FTL.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND FTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN JB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND JB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND JB.JOB_CODE not like 'A-%'
  AND JB.JOB_CODE not like 'L-%'
  AND (JB.JOB_CODE = :PCodigoCargo
       OR :PCodigoCargo IS NULL)
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #39

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F`

```sql
SELECT JB.JOB_CODE AS COD_CARGO , JTL.NAME AS NOME , FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE AS COD_FAMILIA ,
       FTL.JOB_FAMILY_NAME AS FAMILIA , JB.ATTRIBUTE6 AS AGENTE_PEDAGOGICO , JB.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY AS GRADE
FROM PER_JOBS_F JB
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL JTL ON JTL.JOB_ID = JB.JOB_ID
AND JTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN JTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL FTL ON FTL.JOB_FAMILY_ID = JB.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND FTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN JB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND JB.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND JB.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'Y'
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #40

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_X`

```sql
SELECT HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE AS CODIGO , HAUFT.NAME AS NOME , ORG.NAME AS CODIGO_BU , HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F HAOUF
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HAUFT ON HAUFT.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HAUFT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F HOUCF ON HOUCF.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HOUCF.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_VL ORG ON SUBSTR(ORG.NAME,
                                             1, 7) = SUBSTR(HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE,
                                                       1, 7)
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ORG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND ORG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_X CLS ON CLS.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND CLS.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
  AND (HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE = :pCodigo
       OR :pCodigo IS NULL)
ORDER BY HAUFT.NAME
```

### Query #41

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, COM`

```sql
SELECT HAUFT.NAME AS CODIGO , SUBSTR(HAUFT.NAME, 11) AS NOME , HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F HAOUF
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HAUFT ON HAUFT.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HAUFT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAUFT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F HOUCF ON HOUCF.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HOUCF.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HOUCF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F LOC ON LOC.LEI_INFORMATION1 = HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND LOC.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'Estabelecimento'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'ANM_BASE_SALARIAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND (PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION1 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION2 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION4 IS NOT NULL
     OR PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION11 IS NOT NULL)
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAOUF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
  AND lower(HAUFT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%não usar%'
  AND SUBSTR(HAOUF.ORGANIZATION_CODE, 1, 7) = :p_empresa
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #43

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT K.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID AS CODIGO_PROVISORIO , P.POSITION_CODE AS CODIGO_POSICAO , P.POSITION_ID AS ID_POSICAO ,
                H.NAME AS NOME , P.ACTIVE_STATUS AS STATUS , P.CREATION_DATE AS DATA_CRIACAO
```

### Query #44

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT HAP.POSITION_CODE AS COD_POSICAO , HAPF.NAME AS NOME_POSICAO , HAP.ATTRIBUTE4 AS "VP"
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F HAP
JOIN HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL HAPF ON HAPF.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND HAPF.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ON PAAM.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(Z.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M Z
   WHERE Z.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMAIL ON EMAIL.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND EMAIL.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN EMAIL.DATE_FROM AND NVL(EMAIL.DATE_TO,
                                          TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                            'DD/MM/YYYY'))
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAP.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND EMAIL.EMAIL_ADDRESS = :pEmailGestor
ORDER BY HAPF.NAME
```

### Query #45

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL, PER_POSITION_HIERARCHY_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_JOBS_F_TL, FUN_BU_USAGES_V, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_JOBS_F...`

```sql
SELECT HAP.POSITION_CODE AS "Cod_Posição" ,
       CASE
           WHEN PPNF.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN HAPF.NAME || ' (' || PPNF.FULL_NAME || ')' ELSE HAPF.NAME
       END AS "Nome_Posição" , PPNF.FULL_NAME AS "Ocupante_Atual" ,
       TO_CHAR(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AS SALARIO_OCUPANTE ,
       TO_CHAR(HAP.BUDGET_AMOUNT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AS ORCAMENTO , HAP.ATTRIBUTE6 AS "Escopo" , FBU.BU_NAME AS "Empresa" ,
       LOC.LOCATION_NAME AS "Nome_Filial" , HAP.ATTRIBUTE4 AS "VP" , CC.COD_CCUSTO AS "Centro de Custo" ,
       HAP.ATTRIBUTE8 AS "Centro Responsabilidade" , '1' AS "Num_Vagas" , PJ.JOB_CODE AS "Cod_Cargo" , PJFT.NAME AS "Cargo" ,
       HOUF.NAME AS "Departamento" , NVL(HAP.ATTRIBUTE11,
                                       'Nenhuma') AS "Insalubridade" ,
       NVL(HAP.ATTRIBUTE12, 'Nenhuma') AS "Periculosidade" , HAP.WORKING_HOURS AS "Carga_Horária" ,
       PAAM_MAN.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS "Matrícula_Gestor" , PPNF_MAN.FULL_NAME AS "Nome_Gestor" ,
       EMAIL_MAN.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS "Email_Gestor" , HAP.ATTRIBUTE7 AS "Modalidade_Trabalho" ,
       PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 AS "Agente_Pedagogico" ,
       CASE FAM.JOB_FAMILY_CODE WHEN '26' THEN 'Bolsista' WHEN '13' THEN 'Estagiário' WHEN '1' THEN 'Conselheiro' ELSE 'Administrativo'
       END AS TIPO_VINCULO , PPNF_ANT.FULL_NAME AS "Ocupante Anterior"
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F HAP
JOIN HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL HAPF ON HAPF.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND HAPF.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOBS_F PJ ON PJ.JOB_ID = HAP.JOB_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PJ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOBS_F_TL PJFT ON PJFT.JOB_ID = HAP.JOB_ID
AND PJFT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PJFT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PJFT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_JOB_FAMILY_F FAM ON FAM.JOB_FAMILY_ID = PJ.JOB_FAMILY_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN FAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND FAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = HAP.LOCATION_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_POSITION_HIERARCHY_F PPH ON PPH.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPH.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPH.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM_MAN ON PAAM_MAN.POSITION_ID = PPH.PARENT_POSITION_ID
AND PAAM_MAN.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
AND PAAM_MAN.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(Z.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M Z
   WHERE Z.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM_MAN.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_MAN ON PPNF_MAN.PERSON_ID = PAAM_MAN.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF_MAN.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF_MAN.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF_MAN.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMAIL_MAN ON EMAIL_MAN.PERSON_ID = PAAM_MAN.PERSON_ID
AND EMAIL_MAN.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN EMAIL_MAN.DATE_FROM AND NVL(EMAIL_MAN.DATE_TO,
                                              TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                'DD/MM/YYYY'))
JOIN
  (SELECT FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_ID , FFVV.FLEX_VALUE AS COD_CCUSTO , FFVV.DESCRIPTION AS DESC_CCUSTO
   FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVV
   JOIN FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS ON FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
   WHERE FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
     AND NVL(FFVV.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
     AND NVL(FFVV.SUMMARY_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
     AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(FFVV.START_DATE_ACTIVE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(FFVV.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                  TRUNC(SYSDATE))) CC ON CC.FLEX_VALUE_ID = HAP.COST_CENTER
JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL HOUF ON HOUF.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAP.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND HOUF.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN HOUF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HOUF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN FUN_BU_USAGES_V FBU ON FBU.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = HAP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
AND FBU.MODULE_ID = '10'
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ON PAAM.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(Z.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M Z
   WHERE Z.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN CMP_SALARY CS ON CS.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND CS.DATE_TO = TO_DATE('31/12/4712', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM_ANT ON PAAM_ANT.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
AND (PAAM_ANT.ASSIGNMENT_ID <> PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
     OR PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NULL)
AND PAAM_ANT.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
AND PAAM_ANT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
  (SELECT MAX(Z.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M Z
   WHERE Z.POSITION_ID = HAP.POSITION_ID
     AND (Z.ASSIGNMENT_ID <> PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
          OR PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NULL)
     AND Z.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E')
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_ANT ON PPNF_ANT.PERSON_ID = PAAM_ANT.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF_ANT.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF_ANT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF_ANT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN HAP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND HAP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND HAP.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND HAP.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NOT NULL
  AND (HAP.POSITION_CODE = :pCodigoPosicao
       OR EMAIL_MAN.EMAIL_ADDRESS = :pEmailGestor
       OR (:pAgentePedagogico IS NOT NULL
           AND PJ.ATTRIBUTE6 = :pAgentePedagogico))
ORDER BY HAPF.NAME
```

### Query #46

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS, PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL`

```sql
SELECT LOC.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCAL , LEI_INFORMATION25 AS COD_SIND_ADM_HCM ,
       SIND_ADM.NAME AS NOME_SIND_ADM_HCM , SIND_ADM.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_ADM_RM ,
       LEI_INFORMATION26 AS COD_SIND_DOC_HCM , SIND_DOC.NAME AS NOME_SIND_DOC_HCM ,
       SIND_DOC.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_DOC_RM , LEI_INFORMATION27 AS COD_SIND_MED_HCM ,
       SIND_MED.NAME AS NOME_SIND_MED_HCM , SIND_MED.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_MED_RM ,
       SIND_ESTAG.ORGANIZATION_ID AS COD_SIND_ESTAG_HCM , SIND_ESTAG.NAME AS NOME_SIND_ESTAG_HCM ,
       SIND_ESTAG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_ESTAG_RM , SIND_BOL.ORGANIZATION_ID AS COD_SIND_BOLS_HCM ,
       SIND_BOL.NAME AS NOME_SIND_BOLS_HCM , SIND_BOL.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS COD_SIND_BOLS_RM
FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
JOIN PER_LOCATION_EXTRA_INFO_F PLEI ON PLEI.LOCATION_ID = LOC.LOCATION_ID
AND PLEI.LEI_INFORMATION_CATEGORY = 'ANM_SINDICATO'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PLEI.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PLEI.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_ADM ON SIND_ADM.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION25
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_ADM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_ADM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_DOC ON SIND_DOC.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION26
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_DOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_DOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_MED ON SIND_MED.ORGANIZATION_ID = LEI_INFORMATION27
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_MED.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_MED.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_ESTAG ON SIND_ESTAG.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE = 'ESTAGIARIO'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_ESTAG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_ESTAG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS SIND_BOL ON SIND_BOL.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE = 'BOLSISTAS'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SIND_BOL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SIND_BOL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND LOC.ACTIVE_STATUS = 'A'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_CODE = :pCodigoLocal
ORDER BY LOC.LOCATION_CODE
```

### Query #48

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number, aatf.base_name absence_base_name, aatf.attribute2 cod_tipo_atestado,
       apae.person_id, apae.assignment_id, apae.per_absence_entry_id, apae.period_of_service_id,
       apae.creation_date, apae.last_update_date, apae.start_date, apae.end_date,
       CASE WHEN apae.absence_status_cd = 'ORA_WITHDRAWN' THEN '-1' ELSE '1'
       END ETAPA, apae.approval_status_cd, apae.created_by, apae.absence_status_cd
FROM per_all_people_f papf, anc_absence_types_f aatf, anc_per_abs_entries apae ,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_id = apae.person_id
  AND apae.approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
  AND apae.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND aatf.absence_type_id = apae.absence_type_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND apae.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 apae.last_update_date)
  AND apae.person_id = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID = 300000367488117
ORDER BY ETAPA ASC, apae.last_update_date ASC
```

```sql
  AND PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID <> 300000367488117
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND papf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN aatf.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND aatf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
ORDER BY ETAPA ASC, apae.last_update_date ASC
```

### Query #50

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO_XML, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA, EMAIL_XML, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F`

```sql
WITH EMAIL_XML AS
  (SELECT t.DICTIONARYNAME, XMLTYPE(t.DICTIONARY,
                              nls_charset_id('AL32UTF8')) AS XML,
          REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.DICTIONARYNAME,
                                    'USER_', ''), '_jaznQ46Q', ''), 'Q46Q', '.'), 'Q64Q', '@') AS email_limpo, t.DICTIONARY
   FROM FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFRULEDICTIONARY t
   WHERE t.PACKAGENAME = 'oracle.bpel.services.workflow.user'),
     EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO_XML AS
  (SELECT EMAIL, DICTIONARYNAME
   FROM
     (SELECT REPLACE(x.EMAIL, '"', '') AS EMAIL, t.DICTIONARYNAME,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.DICTIONARYNAME
                                ORDER BY t.DICTIONARYNAME) rn
      FROM FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFRULEDICTIONARY t,
           XMLTABLE(XMLNAMESPACES(DEFAULT 'http://xmlns.oracle.com/rules/dictionary'), '//Action[Target="taskFact.newAssigneeName"]' PASSING XMLTYPE(t.DICTIONARY,

                                                                                                                                               NLS_CHARSET_ID('AL32UTF8')) COLUMNS EMAIL VARCHAR2(200) PATH 'Expression/Value/text()') x
      WHERE t.PACKAGENAME = 'oracle.bpel.services.workflow.user')
   WHERE rn = 1),
     PERIODO_INICIO AS
  (SELECT INICIO_FERIAS, DICTIONARYNAME
   FROM
     (SELECT TO_CHAR((TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' + NUMTODSINTERVAL(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(x.INICIO_FERIAS,

                                                                                        'L',
                                                                                        ''))/1000,
                                                              'SECOND')), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') INICIO_FERIAS, t.DICTIONARYNAME,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.DICTIONARYNAME
                                ORDER BY t.DICTIONARYNAME) rn
      FROM FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFRULEDICTIONARY t,
           XMLTABLE(XMLNAMESPACES(DEFAULT 'http://xmlns.oracle.com/rules/dictionary'), '//SimpleTest[IDofOperator="B}>="]' PASSING XMLTYPE(t.DICTIONARY,

                                                                                                                                     NLS_CHARSET_ID('AL32UTF8')) COLUMNS INICIO_FERIAS VARCHAR2(200) PATH 'Expression[2]/Value/text()') x
      WHERE t.PACKAGENAME = 'oracle.bpel.services.workflow.user')
   WHERE rn = 1),
     PERIODO_FIM AS
  (SELECT FIM_FERIAS, DICTIONARYNAME
   FROM
     (SELECT TO_CHAR((TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' + NUMTODSINTERVAL(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(x.FIM_FERIAS,

                                                                                        'L',
                                                                                        ''))/1000,
                                                              'SECOND')), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') FIM_FERIAS, t.DICTIONARYNAME,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.DICTIONARYNAME
                                ORDER BY t.DICTIONARYNAME) rn
      FROM FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFRULEDICTIONARY t,
           XMLTABLE(XMLNAMESPACES(DEFAULT 'http://xmlns.oracle.com/rules/dictionary'), '//SimpleTest[IDofOperator="B}<="]' PASSING XMLTYPE(t.DICTIONARY,

                                                                                                                                     NLS_CHARSET_ID('AL32UTF8')) COLUMNS FIM_FERIAS VARCHAR2(200) PATH 'Expression[2]/Value/text()') x
      WHERE t.PACKAGENAME = 'oracle.bpel.services.workflow.user')
   WHERE rn = 1),
     depto_validacao AS
  (SELECT paam_emp.organization_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sup.manager_id) qtd_lideres
   FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F sup, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam_emp
   WHERE sup.assignment_id = paam_emp.assignment_id
     AND sup.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND sup.primary_flag = 'Y'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN sup.effective_start_date AND sup.effective_end_date
     AND paam_emp.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam_emp.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam_emp.effective_end_date = DATE '4712-12-31'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN paam_emp.effective_start_date AND paam_emp.effective_end_date
   GROUP BY paam_emp.organization_id),
     sup_paam AS
  (SELECT *
   FROM
     (SELECT sup.MANAGER_ID, paam_emp.ORGANIZATION_ID, paam_emp.ASSIGNMENT_ID,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sup.MANAGER_ID,
                       paam_emp.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                ORDER BY paam_emp.ASSIGNMENT_ID) rn
      FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F sup, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam_emp
      WHERE sup.ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam_emp.ASSIGNMENT_ID
        AND sup.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND sup.MANAGER_TYPE = 'LINE_MANAGER'
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN sup.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND sup.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
        AND paam_emp.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
        AND paam_emp.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
        AND paam_emp.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = DATE '4712-12-31'
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN paam_emp.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND paam_emp.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
   WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT pn.FULL_NAME AS LIDER, email.EMAIL_LIDER, paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS MATRICULA_LIDER,
       TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 3)) AS COLIGADA_LIDER, depto_lider.NAME AS DEPARTAMENTO_QUE_E_LIDER_NAME,
       depto_lider.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE AS DEPARTAMENTO_QUE_E_LIDER, per.INICIO_FERIAS, perF.FIM_FERIAS, dados_do_substituto.NOME_SUBSTITUTO,
       dados_do_substituto.MATRICULA_SUBSTITUTO,
       TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(dados_do_substituto.MATRICULA_SUBSTITUTO, 1, 3)) AS COLIGADA_SUBSTITUTO
FROM EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO_XML email_substituto, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F pn, PER_USERS a, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS depto, sup_paam, HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS depto_lider,
     PERIODO_INICIO per, PERIODO_FIM perF, DEPTO_VALIDACAO,

  (SELECT email_xml.*,
          CASE
              WHEN email_xml.EMAIL_LIMPO LIKE '%com' THEN SUBSTR(email_xml.EMAIL_LIMPO,
                                                            1,
                                                            LENGTH(email_xml.EMAIL_LIMPO)-3) ELSE email_xml.EMAIL_LIMPO
          END EMAIL_LIDER
   FROM EMAIL_XML email_xml
   WHERE existsNode(email_xml.xml,
           '//ns:Active[text()="true"]',
           'xmlns:ns="http://xmlns.oracle.com/rules/dictionary"') = 1) email,

  (SELECT NOME_SUBSTITUTO, MATRICULA_SUBSTITUTO, EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO
   FROM
     (SELECT pnSub.FULL_NAME NOME_SUBSTITUTO, paamSub.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER MATRICULA_SUBSTITUTO,
             userS.USERNAME EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY userS.USERNAME
                                ORDER BY paamSub.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER) rn
      FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F pnSub, PER_USERS userS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papfSub, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paamSub
      WHERE userS.PERSON_ID = papfSub.PERSON_ID
        AND pnSub.PERSON_ID = papfSub.PERSON_ID
        AND pnSub.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
        AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pnSub.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pnSub.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
        AND papfSub.PERSON_ID = paamSub.PERSON_ID
        AND paamSub.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
        AND paamSub.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND paamSub.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = DATE '4712-12-31')
   WHERE rn = 1) dados_do_substituto
WHERE 1=1
  AND email_substituto.DICTIONARYNAME = email.DICTIONARYNAME
  AND per.DICTIONARYNAME = email.DICTIONARYNAME
  AND perF.DICTIONARYNAME = per.DICTIONARYNAME
  AND a.PERSON_ID = papf.PERSON_ID
  AND upper(a.USERNAME) = upper(email.EMAIL_LIDER)
  AND pn.PERSON_ID = papf.PERSON_ID
  AND pn.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN pn.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND pn.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND papf.PERSON_ID = paam.PERSON_ID
  AND paam.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
  AND paam.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = DATE '4712-12-31'
  AND depto.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND sup_paam.MANAGER_ID = papf.PERSON_ID
  AND sup_paam.ORGANIZATION_ID = depto_lider.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND depto_validacao.organization_id = depto_lider.organization_id
  AND depto_validacao.qtd_lideres = 1
  AND UPPER(dados_do_substituto.EMAIL_SUBSTITUTO) = UPPER(email_substituto.EMAIL)
  AND papf.PERSON_NUMBER = :p_person_number
```

### Query #51

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_EXTRA_INFO_M, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , paam.effective_start_date , paam.last_update_date
FROM per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf
WHERE paam_adia.information_type = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION')
  AND paam.assignment_id = paam_adia.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam_adia.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                      paam_adia.last_update_date)
ORDER BY paam_adia.last_update_date
```

### Query #52

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,
                                   'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START ,
       ppos.attribute11 TIPOESTABILIDADE , ppos.attribute_date15 FIM ,
       ppos.attribute_date14 INICIO , ppos.attribute30 MOTIVOESTABILIDADE ,
       paam.effective_start_date , ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID , paam.assignment_id ,
       paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE25 campo_auxiliar , paam.effective_end_date , paam.assignment_status_type
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov ,
     PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL
  AND ppos.date_start =
    (SELECT MAX(date_start)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE person_id = ppos.person_id
       AND PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID)
  AND hov.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND ((:p_person_number IS NOT NULL
        AND NVL(:p_integration_date, ppos.attribute_date15) = ppos.attribute_date15)
       OR (:p_person_number IS NULL
           AND TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date15, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1,
                                                                'DD/MM/YYYY')))
  AND ppos.attribute11 IS NOT NULL
```

### Query #53

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO , paam.normal_hours ,
                PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO ,
                to_char(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') SALARIO ,
                to_char(CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AUMENTO_SALARIAL ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
                TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 CIDADE_ESTADO , CS.SALARY_BASIS_CODE TIPO_SALARIO ,
                CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
                END AS TIPO_CARTA , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ,
     CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID , PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER , PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)) GESTOR , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PAAM.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID(+) = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.ASSIGNMENT_ID(+) = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.DATE_TO = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND POS.POSITION_ID (+) = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND NVL(POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) = NVL(
                                                            (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
                                                             FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
                                                             WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
                                                               AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= SYSDATE), TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND TRUNC(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) = TRUNC(:p_effective_start_date)
```

### Query #54

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(PL_TYP.NAME) "Tipo de Benefício" , UPPER(PL.NAME) "Categoria do Benefício" ,
                UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) "Descrição do Benefício" , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
FROM BEN_PL_TYP_F PL_TYP, BEN_PL_F PL, BEN_ELIG_PER_F FACT, BEN_OPT_F BOF_OPT, BEN_ELIG_PER_OPT_F OPT,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF
WHERE PL_TYP.PL_TYP_ID = PL.PL_TYP_ID
  AND FACT.PL_ID = PL.PL_ID
  AND FACT.ELIG_PER_ID = OPT.ELIG_PER_ID
  AND FACT.PER_IN_LER_ID = OPT.PER_IN_LER_ID
  AND OPT.OPT_ID = BOF_OPT.OPT_ID
  AND OPT.ELIG_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(FACT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID)
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER = NVL(:p_person_number, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%NÃO DESEJO%'
  AND UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%CANCELAR%'
ORDER BY "Tipo de Benefício", "Categoria do Benefício", "Descrição do Benefício"
```

### Query #55

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO, paam.normal_hours ,
                PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO ,
                CS.SALARY_AMOUNT SALARIO , CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT AUMENTO_SALARIAL ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
                TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 CIDADE_ESTADO
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF , CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)) GESTOR
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = GESTOR.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.DATE_TO =
    (SELECT MAX(DATE_TO)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND (TO_CHAR(DATE_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = LOC.LOCATION_ID
  AND (PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P'))
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = :p_asg_number
```

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , paam.effective_start_date ,
       GREATEST(paam_apos.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) last_update_date
FROM per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_periods_of_service ppos ,
     per_all_people_f papf
WHERE paam_apos.information_type = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_id = paam_apos.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(paam_apos.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                       GREATEST(paam_apos.last_update_date,

                                                                         ppos.last_update_date))
ORDER BY GREATEST(paam_apos.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date)
```

### Query #58

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT asg.assignment_id,
       CASE
           WHEN (
                   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
                    FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
                    WHERE X.PERSON_ID = ASG.PERSON_ID
                      AND TO_CHAR(X.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31'
                      AND X.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
                      AND X.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = ASG.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                      AND X.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE') > 2
                 AND (ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y')) THEN 'MESMA_EMPRESA'
           WHEN (
                   (SELECT B.PRIMARY_FLAG
                    FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE B, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M C
                    WHERE C.ASSIGNMENT_ID = ASG.ASSIGNMENT_ID
                      AND C.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = B.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
                      AND B.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL
                      AND C.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
                      AND TO_CHAR(C.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31'
                      AND B.PERIOD_TYPE = 'E') = 'Y'
                 AND
                   (SELECT COUNT(D.PERSON_ID)
                    FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE D
                    WHERE D.PERSON_ID = ASG.PERSON_ID
                      AND D.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL
                      AND D.PERIOD_TYPE = 'E') > 1) THEN 'EMPRESA_DIFERENTE' ELSE 'N_MV'
       END AS MV_CATEGORY
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ASG
WHERE asg.assignment_id = :p_assignment_id
  AND to_char(asg.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
```

### Query #59

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , pjf.job_code , pjf_old.job_code job_code_ant , paam.effective_start_date ,
       paam.last_update_date , NVL(paam.ass_attribute45, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.job_id old_job_id ,
          assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.effective_end_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND effective_end_date < assi.effective_start_date
                                                     AND effective_latest_change = 'Y'))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam , per_jobs_f pjf , per_jobs_f pjf_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'DESL_PARA_GLOBAL_TRANSF',
                               'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL','RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION',
                               'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG','ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO','ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_PROMO')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND pjf_old.job_id(+) = paam.old_job_id
  AND paam.old_effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf_old.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf_old.effective_end_date(+)
  AND (pjf.job_code <> NVL(pjf_old.job_code, pjf.job_code))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                        paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR paam.ass_attribute45 = 'Y')
```

### Query #60

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT POS.POSITION_CODE AS COD_POSICAO , POSTL.NAME AS NOME_POSICAO ,
       CCU.FLEX_VALUE || '-' || POS.ATTRIBUTE8 AS CCUSTO_ATUAL , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA ,
       POS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE , POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS DATA_EFETIVA_POS ,
       LE.LE_ORGANIZATION_CODE , NVL(PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE46, 'N') AS Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL POSTL , FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL CCU ,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) LE
WHERE POSTL.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND POSTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN POSTL.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND POSTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND CCU.VALUE_CATEGORY(+) = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
  AND CCU.FLEX_VALUE_ID(+) = POS.COST_CENTER
  AND PAAM.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
     WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE = 'Y'
  AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND LE.LE_ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = :p_integration_date
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = :p_assignment_number
```

### Query #61

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT POS.POSITION_CODE AS COD_POSICAO , POSTL.NAME AS NOME_POSICAO ,
                CCU.FLEX_VALUE || '-' || POS.ATTRIBUTE8 AS CCUSTO_ATUAL , CCUANT.FLEX_VALUE || '-' || POSANT.ATTRIBUTE8 AS CCUSTO_ANT ,
                PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER AS PERSON_NUMBER ,
                PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME_EDUCADOR ,
                POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS DATA_EFETIVA_POS ,
                POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE AS DATA_FINAL_POS ,
                POS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE ,
                PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS START_DATE_PAAM , PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE , PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE ,
                NVL(PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE46, 'N') AS Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL POSTL , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POSANT ,
     FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL CCU , FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL CCUANT , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf
WHERE POSTL.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND POSTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND TO_CHAR(POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(POSTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND POSANT.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND POSANT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
     WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
       AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE < POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND CCU.VALUE_CATEGORY(+) = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
  AND CCU.FLEX_VALUE_ID(+) = POS.COST_CENTER
  AND CCUANT.VALUE_CATEGORY(+) = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
  AND CCUANT.FLEX_VALUE_ID(+) = POSANT.COST_CENTER
  AND PAAM.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
     WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE = 'Y'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND (NVL(POSANT.COST_CENTER, ' ') <> NVL(POS.COST_CENTER,
                                         ' ')
       OR NVL(POSANT.ATTRIBUTE8, ' ') <> NVL(POS.ATTRIBUTE8,
                                           ' '))
  AND (POS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= :p_integration_date
       OR NVL(PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE46, 'N') = 'Y')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT POS.POSITION_CODE AS COD_POSICAO , POSTL.NAME AS NOME_POSICAO ,
                CCU.FLEX_VALUE || '-' || POS.ATTRIBUTE8 AS CCUSTO_ATUAL , CCUANT.FLEX_VALUE || '-' || POSANT.ATTRIBUTE8 AS CCUSTO_ANT ,
                PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER AS PERSON_NUMBER ,
                PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME_EDUCADOR ,
                POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS DATA_EFETIVA_POS ,
                POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE AS DATA_FINAL_POS ,
                POS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE ,
                PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS START_DATE_PAAM , PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE , PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE ,
                NVL(PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE46, 'N') AS Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL POSTL , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POSANT ,
     FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL CCU , FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL CCUANT , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM_OLD , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf
WHERE POSTL.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND POSTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND TO_CHAR(POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(POSTL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND CCU.VALUE_CATEGORY(+) = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
  AND CCU.FLEX_VALUE_ID(+) = POS.COST_CENTER
  AND PAAM.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE = 'Y'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM_OLD.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(AUX.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M AUX
     WHERE AUX.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM_OLD.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND AUX.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE < PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
  AND POSANT.POSITION_ID = PAAM_OLD.POSITION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(POSANT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND CCUANT.VALUE_CATEGORY(+) = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
  AND CCUANT.FLEX_VALUE_ID(+) = POSANT.COST_CENTER
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND (NVL(PAAM.POSITION_ID, 0) <> NVL(PAAM_OLD.POSITION_ID, 0))
  AND (PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= :p_integration_date
       OR NVL(PAAM.ASS_ATTRIBUTE46, 'N') = 'Y')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
```
