### Query #62

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , depto_old.name depto_name_ant ,
       depto_old.internal_address_line depto_code_ant , paam.effective_start_date , paam.last_update_date ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute47, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.organization_id old_organization_id
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.effective_end_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND (effective_end_date < assi.effective_end_date
                                                          AND effective_latest_change != 'Y'
                                                          OR effective_end_date < assi.effective_end_date)))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam , hr_organization_v depto , hr_organization_v depto_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'DESL_PARA_GLOBAL_TRANSF',
                               'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL','RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION',
                               'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG','ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO','ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_PROMO')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date AND depto.effective_end_date
  AND depto_old.organization_id(+) = paam.old_organization_id
  AND depto_old.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN depto_old.effective_start_date AND depto_old.effective_end_date
  AND (depto.internal_address_line <> NVL(depto_old.internal_address_line,
                                        depto.internal_address_line))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                        paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR paam.ass_attribute47 = 'Y')
```

### Query #63

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , pptl.user_person_type , paam.assignment_id ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       CASE WHEN paam.effective_start_date < sysdate THEN sysdate ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END processo_irrestrito_date , paam.effective_end_date , ppos.period_of_service_id , paam.normal_hours ,
       paam.employment_category , paam.employee_category , paam.hourly_salaried_code ,
       paam.assignment_status_type , paam.assignment_status_type_id , paam.assignment_type ,
       SUBSTR(paam.ass_attribute5, 1, INSTR(paam.ass_attribute5,
                                        ' - ')-1) escala_trabalho , paam.last_update_date , paam.creation_date , paam.category_code ,
       paam.action_code , paam.reason_code ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 jornada_mensal , paam.ass_attribute_number2 || ':00' jornada ,
       paam.establishment_id , estab.name nome_estab ,
       SUBSTR(estab.name, 1, INSTR(estab.name, ' - ')-1) cod_estab ,
       CASE WHEN paam_apos.aei_attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END aposentado ,
       paam_apos.aei_information_date1 data_aposentadoria ,
       paam_apos.aei_attribute1 tipo_aposentadoria ,
       CASE WHEN paam.primary_flag = 'Y' THEN ppos.date_start ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END AS date_start ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute24, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END prazo_contrato ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.ass_attribute_date1 = paam.date_probation_end THEN paam.ass_attribute_date4 ELSE paam.date_probation_end
       END fim_prazo_contrato ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute24, 'N') = 'N' THEN paam.ass_attribute_date1 ELSE NVL(ppos.attribute_date1,

                                                                                          paam.ass_attribute_date4)
       END fim_prazo_contrato_2 , NVL(ppos.attribute5,
                                    'Não Optante') contribuicao_sindical ,
       ppos.pds_information9 worker_category , ppos.pds_information7 tipo_regime_prev ,
       ppos.pds_information3 num_proc_judicial , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos.pds_information10 tipo_contrato_prazo , ppos.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial ,
       ppos.attribute6 area_atuacao_estagio , ppos.attribute_number2 numero_apolice_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute_date1 data_prev_fim_estagio , ppos.attribute2 instituicao_ensino_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute15 natureza_estagio , ppos.attribute16 nivel_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute17 cod_instituicao_estagio , REPLACE(REPLACE(ppos.attribute14,
                                                            '.', ''),
                                                    '-', '') cpf_coord_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute13 nome_coord_estagio , ppos.pds_information5 primeiro_emprego ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R'
           WHEN paam.action_code IN ('REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION') THEN 'R' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao , paam.full_part_time , paam.ass_attribute11 multiplos_vinculos ,
       CASE WHEN ppos.attribute11 IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
       END AS membro_cipa , pjf.job_code , pj.name job_name ,
       pjf.attribute2 job_risco_flag , cmps.salary_amount ,
       depto.organization_id depto_id , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , sind.organization_id sind_id ,
       sind.name sind_name , sind.internal_address_line sind_code ,
       paam.legal_entity_id , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       matr.ext_identifier_number cod_pessoa_rm ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '0'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '5'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '8' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_ocorrencia ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam_adia.aei_attribute1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END AS percent_adiant ,
       CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '0' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_col_fornecedor ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN LPAD(regexp_replace(paam.ass_attribute16,

                                                                                 '[^0-9]+',
                                                                                 ''),
                                                                            7, 0) ELSE ''
       END AS cod_fornecedor , paam_aiss.aei_attribute2 aliquota_iss ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                   '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18 ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,

                                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
       END AS cod_ccusto , 'P' cod_recebimento , '0' nro_dep_irrf , '0' nro_dep_sal_fam , '0' ajuda_custo ,
                                                                                              '0' arredondamento ,
                                                                                                  '1' ind_inicio_hor ,
                                                                                                      '1' reg_atual ,
                                                                                                          '50' periodo_rescisao ,

  (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
     AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
     AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date) qtde_vinculos ,
                                                                                                               mngr.matricula_lider ,
                                                                                                               paam.primary_flag ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                 'Grau máximo',
                                                                                                                 40,
                                                                                                                 'Grau médio',
                                                                                                                 20,
                                                                                                                 'Grau mínimo',
                                                                                                                 10,
                                                                                                                 'Nenhuma',
                                                                                                                 '') insalubridade ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                 '30%',
                                                                                                                 30,
                                                                                                                 'Nenhuma',
                                                                                                                 '') periculosidade ,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '5900'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0210'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0201'
                                                                                                                   ELSE ''
                                                                                                               END AS cod_evento ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information6 tipo_regime_trabalhista ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute15,

                                                                                                                 'N') necessita_usuario_acesso ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,

                                                                                                                 'N') rephorariotrabalho ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute45,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovcargo ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute46,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovccusto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute47,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovdepartamento ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(paam.ass_attribute14,

                                                                                                                 '0 - De acordo com o cargo',
                                                                                                                 DECODE(pjf.attribute3,

                                                                                                                   'Y',
                                                                                                                   '1' ,
                                                                                                                   'N',
                                                                                                                   '0') ,
                                                                                                                 '1 - Exceção - Sim (sempre bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '1' ,
                                                                                                                 '2 - Exceção - Não (nunca bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '0') utiliza_ponto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,

                                                                                                                 0) AS CONTRATACAO_ESPECIAL ,
                                                                                                               TO_CHAR(ppos.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE,

                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATA_DESLIGAMENTO ,
                                                                                                               NVL(PJF.ATTRIBUTE6,

                                                                                                                 'N') AS AGENTE_PEDAGOGICO
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia ,
     per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_aiss ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     per_jobs pj , cmp_salary cmps , hr_organization_v depto ,
     hr_organization_v estab , hr_organization_v sind , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT peai.person_id , peai.assignment_id , peai.ext_identifier_number
   FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
   WHERE peai.date_to IS NULL
     AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
     AND peai.ext_identifier_seq =
       (SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
        FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
        WHERE person_id = peai.person_id
          AND assignment_id = peai.assignment_id
          AND ext_identifier_type = peai.ext_identifier_type)) matr ,

  (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,
          pasf.effective_end_date
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_all_assignments_m pman
   WHERE pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
     AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
     AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date) mngr
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND paam_adia.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_adia.information_type(+) = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND paam_apos.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_apos.information_type(+) = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
  AND paam_aiss.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_aiss.information_type(+) = 'anm_Alíquota_ISS'
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pj.job_id (+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.classification_code(+) = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND estab.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND matr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND matr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
ORDER BY PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

```sql
SELECT pj.FULL_PART_TIME ,paam.person_id , papf.person_number , pptl.user_person_type ,

                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'

       END AS cod_ocorrencia ,

       END AS cod_fornecedor , paam_aiss.aei_attribute2 aliquota_iss ,
       CASE

                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8

                                                                                              '0' arredondamento ,
                                                                                                  '1' ind_inicio_hor ,
                                                                                                      '1' reg_atual ,
                                                                                                          '50' periodo_rescisao ,

  (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)

     AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type

                                                                                                               mngr.matricula_lider ,
                                                                                                               paam.primary_flag ,
                                                                                                               pap.attribute11 insalubridade ,

                                                                                                               CASE

                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0210'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                   ELSE ''
                                                                                                               END AS cod_evento ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information6 tipo_regime_trabalhista ,

FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_f paam , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia ,
     per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_aiss ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto

      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs

  (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,

  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id

  AND paam_aiss.information_type(+) = 'anm_Alíquota_ISS'

  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'

  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pj.job_id (+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.classification_code(+) = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND estab.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND matr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND matr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.effective_start_date = NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                    paam.effective_start_date)
```

### Query #65

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , pba.bank_account_id , pba.bank_name bank_name , pba.bank_number ,
       pba.bank_branch_name , pba.branch_number , NVL(pba.bank_account_type,
                                                    'C') bank_account_type ,
       pba.bank_account_num , pba.check_digits ,
       GREATEST(pba.account_last_update_date,
         ppr.last_update_date, ppp.last_update_date, prgd.last_update_date) last_update_date , prgd.assignment_id
FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn ppr , per_all_people_f papf , pay_person_pay_methods_f ppp ,
     pay_bank_accounts pba , pay_rel_groups_dn prgd
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppr.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppp.payroll_relationship_id = ppr.payroll_relationship_id
  AND ppp.effective_end_date = to_date('31/12/4712',
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND pba.bank_account_id = ppp.bank_account_id
  AND prgd.payroll_relationship_id = ppp.payroll_relationship_id
  AND prgd.group_type = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND prgd.assignment_id = NVL(:p_assignment_id, prgd.assignment_id)
  AND GREATEST(pba.account_last_update_date,
        ppr.last_update_date, ppp.last_update_date, prgd.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
```

### Query #66

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       peev.element_entry_value_id prtt_enrt_rslt_id , pett.reporting_name name , pett.reporting_name plan_name ,
       CASE WHEN peev2.screen_entry_value = 'ANTERIOR' THEN '1115' ELSE '1114'
       END short_code , peev.effective_start_date data_inscricao_original ,
       peev.effective_start_date data_escolha , peev.effective_start_date data_inicial_cobertura ,
       peev.effective_end_date data_final_cobertura ,
       REPLACE(TO_CHAR(peev.screen_entry_value, 'B999999D99'), '.', ',') valor_plano , peev.creation_date , peev.last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , pay_element_entry_values_f peev ,
     pay_element_entries_f pee , pay_element_types_tl pett , pay_element_types_f pet ,
     pay_input_values_f pivf , pay_element_entry_values_f peev2 , pay_input_values_f pivf2 ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND peev.effective_start_date BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND pett.language = 'PTB'
  AND pett.reporting_name LIKE ('Creche%')
  AND pett.reporting_name <> 'Creche sem elegibilidade'
  AND pee.element_type_id = pett.element_type_id
  AND pee.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pet.element_type_id = pee.element_type_id
  AND peev.element_entry_id = pee.element_entry_id
  AND pivf.input_value_id = peev.input_value_id
  AND pivf.base_name = 'Amount'
  AND pee.element_entry_id = peev2.element_entry_id
  AND peev2.input_value_id = pivf2.input_value_id
  AND pivf2.base_name = 'Full-Time Equivalent'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND peev.element_entry_value_id = NVL(:p_benefit_id,
                                      peev.element_entry_value_id)
  AND peev.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 peev.last_update_date)
ORDER BY creation_date, last_update_date
```

### Query #70

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, BEN_PL_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , le.le_name ,
                le.le_organization_code , bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id , bpt.name ,
                bpf.name plan_name , bpf.short_code short_code ,
                bper.orgnl_enrt_dt data_inscricao_original , bper.election_date data_escolha ,
                bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt data_inicial_cobertura ,
                CASE
                    WHEN TRUNC(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                          'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NULL ELSE bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt
                END AS data_final_cobertura , TRUNC(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt) + 90 data_processamento ,
                CASE
                    WHEN bpt.name = 'Auxílio Home Office' THEN replace(to_char(babr.val),
                                                                 '.', ',') ELSE '0'
                END AS valor_plano , bper.creation_date , bper.last_update_date
FROM ben_pl_f bpf , ben_pl_typ_f bpt , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper ,
     per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , ben_per_in_ler bpil ,
     ben_acty_base_rt_f babr , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE 1=1
  AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bpf.pl_typ_id
  AND bpt.name IN ('Auxílio Home Office')
  AND bpf.name LIKE 'Kit Ergonomia%'
  AND bper.pl_id = bpf.pl_id
  AND TRUNC(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                       'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND bper.orgnl_enrt_dt =
    (SELECT MIN(orgnl_enrt_dt)
     FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt
     WHERE person_id = bper.person_id
       AND pl_id = bper.pl_id)
  AND bpil.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
  AND babr.oipl_id = bper.oipl_id
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN babr.effective_start_date AND babr.effective_end_date
  AND papf.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_id = bper.assignment_id
  AND paam.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'x'
     FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl
     WHERE lookup_type = 'ANM_INTF_BEN_KIT_ERGON'
       AND lookup_code = papf.person_number)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = NVL(:p_benefit_id,
                                 bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id)
  AND TRUNC(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt) + 90 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
```

```sql
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE 1=1
  AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bpf.pl_typ_id
  AND bpt.name IN ('Auxílio Home Office')
  AND bpf.name LIKE 'Kit Ergonomia%'
  AND bper.pl_id = bpf.pl_id
  AND bpil.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
  AND babr.pl_id(+) = bper.pl_id
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN babr.effective_start_date(+) AND babr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =

  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id

  AND pet.element_type_id = pee.element_type_id
  AND peev.element_entry_id = pee.element_entry_id

  AND peev.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

ORDER BY creation_date, last_update_date
```

```sql
    AND papf.person_number         =  NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)

 AND bed.LAST_UPDATE_DATE       >= NVL(:p_integration_date, bed.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 'X'
           FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT               bed1

              , BEN_ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC      bepec1
              , ben_per_in_ler               bpil1

          WHERE bpil1.per_in_ler_stat_cd        =     'PROCD'
            AND bpil1.per_in_ler_id             =     bepec1.per_in_ler_id
            AND bed1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID     =     bepec1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
            AND bed1.per_in_ler_id              =     bepec1.per_in_ler_id
            AND bepec1.pl_typ_id                =     bepec.pl_typ_id
            AND bepec1.PL_ID                    =     bepec.PL_ID
            AND bepec1.OIPL_ID                  =     bepec.OIPL_ID
            AND bed1.ENDED_PER_IN_LER_ID        =     bpil.per_in_ler_id
            AND bed1.DPNT_PERSON_ID             =     bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
    )

      UNION ALL

      SELECT bed.dpnt_person_id
             , bptf.name
             ,''           saude_data_inscricao
             ,''           saude_data_escolha
             ,''     saude_data_inicial
             ,''      saude_data_final
               , TO_CHAR(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt)        odont_data_inscricao
             , TO_CHAR(bper.election_date)       odont_data_escolha
             , TO_CHAR(bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt)     odont_data_inicial
             , TO_CHAR(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt)     odont_data_final
             , bper.person_id
     ,  papf.person_number
     , papfd.person_number          dep_number
     , ppnf.display_name            dep_name
     , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 nro_depend
     , paam.assignment_number
     , le.le_name
     , le.le_organization_code
     , '0' as plano_saude
     , '1' as plano_odonto
  FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT               bed
     , per_contact_relships_f      pcrf
     , per_all_people_f             papf
     , BEN_ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC      bepec
     , ben_pl_typ_f                 bptf
     , ben_per_in_ler               bpil
         ,ben_prtt_enrt_rslt           bper
      , per_all_people_f            papfd
     , per_person_names_f          ppnf
     , per_all_assignments_m       paam
      , (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id
             , xep.name                le_name
             , xep.legal_entity_identifier
             , haou.organization_id    le_organization_id
             , haou.organization_code  le_organization_code
             , xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
          FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou
             , xle_entity_profiles         xep
             , xle_registrations_v         xrv
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND SYSDATE                   BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from,SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,SYSDATE)
           AND xrv.legal_entity_id       = xep.legal_entity_id
           AND xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND haou.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
                                             WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le

  WHERE pcrf.person_id             = papf.person_id
   AND bed.ENDED_PER_IN_LER_ID   IS NOT NULL
    AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd      =   'PROCD'
    AND bpil.per_in_ler_id          = bepec.per_in_ler_id
 AND bed.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID          = bper.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
    AND bed.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID          = bepec.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
    AND bed.per_in_ler_id          = bepec.per_in_ler_id
    AND bptf.pl_typ_id               =   bepec.pl_typ_id
    AND bptf.name                    IN  ('Plano Odontológico' )
    AND pcrf.contact_person_id     = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
    AND pcrf.effective_start_date   = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                         FROM per_contact_relships_f
                                        WHERE person_id         = pcrf.person_id
                                          AND contact_person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id)

    AND ppnf.person_id               = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
    AND ppnf.name_type               = 'GLOBAL'
    AND ppnf.effective_start_date    = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                          FROM per_person_names_f
                                         WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)

    AND paam.person_id                = papf.person_id
    AND paam.assignment_status_type   = 'ACTIVE'
    AND paam.assignment_type          = 'E'
    AND  paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
    AND paam.effective_end_date       = (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                          FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                         WHERE person_id               = paam.person_id
                                           AND primary_flag            = paam.primary_flag
                                           AND assignment_status_type  = paam.assignment_status_type
                                           AND assignment_type         = paam.assignment_type)

    AND papfd.person_id              = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
    AND papfd.effective_start_date   = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                         FROM per_all_people_f
                                        WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)

    AND le.le_organization_id(+)     = paam.legal_entity_id

    AND papf.person_number         =  NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)

 AND bed.LAST_UPDATE_DATE       >= NVL(:p_integration_date, bed.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    AND bpil.STRTD_DT = ( SELECT MAX(STRTD_DT)
                                     FROM ben_per_in_ler              aux
                                    WHERE aux.person_id = bpil.person_id
                                      AND aux.per_in_ler_stat_cd      =   'PROCD'    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 'X'
           FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT               bed1

              , BEN_ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC      bepec1
              , ben_per_in_ler               bpil1

          WHERE bpil1.per_in_ler_stat_cd        =     'STRTD'
            AND bpil1.per_in_ler_id             =     bepec1.per_in_ler_id
            AND bed1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID     =     bepec1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
            AND bed1.per_in_ler_id              =     bepec1.per_in_ler_id
            AND bepec1.pl_typ_id                =     bepec.pl_typ_id
            AND bepec1.PL_ID                    =     bepec.PL_ID
            AND bepec1.OIPL_ID                  =     bepec.OIPL_ID
            AND bed1.DPNT_PERSON_ID             =     bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
    )
```

### Query #75

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, BEN_PER_IN_LER, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , papfd.person_number dep_number ,
       ppnf.display_name dep_name , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 nro_depend , paam.assignment_number ,
       le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       CASE WHEN saude.name IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE '1'
       END AS plano_saude , saude.saude_data_inicial ,
       CASE
           WHEN TRUNC(saude.saude_data_final) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                  'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NULL ELSE saude.saude_data_final
       END AS saude_data_final , CASE WHEN odonto.name IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE '1'
                                 END AS plano_odonto ,
       odonto.odont_data_inicial ,
       CASE
           WHEN TRUNC(odonto.odont_data_final) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                   'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NULL ELSE odonto.odont_data_final
       END AS odont_data_final
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_all_people_f papfd ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf , per_all_assignments_m paam ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT dpnt.dpnt_person_id , bper.person_id , bpt.name ,
          bper.orgnl_enrt_dt saude_data_inscricao , bper.election_date saude_data_escolha ,
          bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt saude_data_inicial , bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt saude_data_final
   FROM ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt dpnt , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , ben_pl_typ_f bpt
   WHERE dpnt.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
     AND dpnt.prtt_enrt_rslt_id =
       (SELECT MAX(a.prtt_enrt_rslt_id)
        FROM ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt a , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt b , ben_pl_typ_f c
        WHERE a.dpnt_person_id = dpnt.dpnt_person_id
          AND a.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = b.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
          AND b.person_id = bper.person_id
          AND c.pl_typ_id = b.pl_typ_id
          AND c.name = bpt.name)
     AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
     AND bpt.name = 'Plano de Saúde'
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT pil.per_in_ler_id
        FROM ben_per_in_ler pil
        WHERE pil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
          AND pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd NOT IN ('VOIDD','BCKDT'))) saude ,

  (SELECT dpnt.dpnt_person_id , bper.person_id , bpt.name ,
          bper.orgnl_enrt_dt odont_data_inscricao , bper.election_date odont_data_escolha ,
          bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt odont_data_inicial , bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt odont_data_final
   FROM ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt dpnt , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , ben_pl_typ_f bpt
   WHERE dpnt.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
     AND dpnt.prtt_enrt_rslt_id =
       (SELECT MAX(a.prtt_enrt_rslt_id)
        FROM ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt a , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt b , ben_pl_typ_f c
        WHERE a.dpnt_person_id = dpnt.dpnt_person_id
          AND a.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = b.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
          AND b.person_id = bper.person_id
          AND c.pl_typ_id = b.pl_typ_id
          AND c.name = bpt.name)
     AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
     AND bpt.name = 'Plano Odontológico'
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT pil.per_in_ler_id
        FROM ben_per_in_ler pil
        WHERE pil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
          AND pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd NOT IN ('VOIDD','BCKDT'))) odonto
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pcrf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pcrf.contact_person_id = papfd.person_id
  AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE person_id = pcrf.person_id
       AND contact_person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id)
  AND papfd.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND saude.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND saude.dpnt_person_id(+) = papfd.person_id
  AND odonto.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND odonto.dpnt_person_id(+) = papfd.person_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
```

### Query #76

```sql
SELECT bed.dpnt_person_id , bptf.name , TO_CHAR(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt) saude_data_inscricao ,

     ben_pl_typ_f bptf , ben_elig_per_elctbl_chc bepec , ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt bed ,
     per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_all_people_f papfd , per_person_names_f ppnf ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,

   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv

WHERE bptf.name IN ('Plano de Saúde')
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_IN_LER_ID
  AND bptf.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
  AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'STRTD'
  AND bepec.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = bper.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
  AND bed.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID = bepec.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
  AND bepec.PL_TYP_ID = bper.PL_TYP_ID
  AND bepec.PL_ID = bper.PL_ID
  AND bepec.OIPL_ID = bper.OIPL_ID
  AND NOT EXISTS

     WHERE bed1.DPNT_PERSON_ID = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
       AND bed1.ELIG_CVRD_DPNT_ID <> bed.ELIG_CVRD_DPNT_ID
       AND bpil1.per_in_ler_id = bepec1.per_in_ler_id

       AND bed1.per_in_ler_id = bepec1.per_in_ler_id
       AND bepec1.pl_typ_id = bepec.pl_typ_id
       AND bepec1.PL_ID = bepec.PL_ID
       AND bepec1.OIPL_ID = bepec.OIPL_ID
       AND bed1.ENDED_PER_IN_LER_ID = bpil.per_in_ler_id

       AND bpil1.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD')
  AND papf.effective_start_date =

  AND pcrf.contact_person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND pcrf.effective_start_date =

     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE person_id = pcrf.person_id
       AND contact_person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND papfd.person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND bed.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                bed.last_update_date)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
UNION ALL
SELECT bed.dpnt_person_id , bptf.name , '' saude_data_inscricao , '' saude_data_escolha , '' saude_data_inicial ,
                                                                                             '' saude_data_final ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt) odont_data_inscricao ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.election_date) odont_data_escolha ,

FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , per_all_people_f papf , ben_per_in_ler bpil ,
     ben_pl_typ_f bptf , ben_elig_per_elctbl_chc bepec , ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt bed ,

WHERE bptf.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')

  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)

     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND papfd.person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND bed.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                bed.last_update_date)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
```

### Query #77

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT bed.dpnt_person_id , bptf.name , '' saude_data_inscricao , '' saude_data_escolha , '' saude_data_inicial ,
                                                                                             '' saude_data_final ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.orgnl_enrt_dt) odont_data_inscricao ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.election_date) odont_data_escolha ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt) odont_data_inicial ,
                                                                                                TO_CHAR(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt) odont_data_final ,
                                                                                                bper.person_id ,
                                                                                                papf.person_number ,
                                                                                                papfd.person_number dep_number ,
                                                                                                ppnf.display_name dep_name ,
                                                                                                pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 nro_depend ,
                                                                                                paam.assignment_number ,
                                                                                                le.le_name ,
                                                                                                le.le_organization_code ,
                                                                                                '0' AS plano_saude ,
                                                                                                '1' AS plano_odonto
FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , per_all_people_f papf , ben_per_in_ler bpil ,
     ben_pl_typ_f bptf , ben_elig_per_elctbl_chc bepec , ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt bed ,
     per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_all_people_f papfd , per_person_names_f ppnf ,
     per_all_assignments_m paam ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE bptf.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_IN_LER_ID
  AND bptf.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
  AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'STRTD'
  AND bepec.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = bper.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
  AND bed.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID = bepec.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
  AND bepec.PL_TYP_ID = bper.PL_TYP_ID
  AND bepec.PL_ID = bper.PL_ID
  AND bepec.OIPL_ID = bper.OIPL_ID
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 'X'
     FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT bed1 , ben_elig_per_elctbl_chc bepec1 , ben_per_in_ler bpil1
     WHERE bed1.DPNT_PERSON_ID = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
       AND bed1.ELIG_CVRD_DPNT_ID <> bed.ELIG_CVRD_DPNT_ID
       AND bpil1.per_in_ler_id = bepec1.per_in_ler_id
       AND bed1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID = bepec1.ELIG_PER_ELCTBL_CHC_ID
       AND bed1.per_in_ler_id = bepec1.per_in_ler_id
       AND bepec1.pl_typ_id = bepec.pl_typ_id
       AND bepec1.PL_ID = bepec.PL_ID
       AND bepec1.OIPL_ID = bepec.OIPL_ID
       AND bed1.ENDED_PER_IN_LER_ID = bpil.per_in_ler_id
       AND bed1.DPNT_PERSON_ID = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
       AND bpil1.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD')
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pcrf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pcrf.contact_person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE person_id = pcrf.person_id
       AND contact_person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND papfd.person_id = bed.DPNT_PERSON_ID
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND bed.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                bed.last_update_date)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
```

### Query #78

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, BEN_PER_IN_LER, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT`

```sql
SELECT bper.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id ,
       dpnt.dpnt_person_id dep_person_id , papfd.person_number dep_number ,
       ppnf.display_name dep_name , bpt.name , bpf.name plan_name ,
       bper.orgnl_enrt_dt data_inscricao_original , bper.election_date data_escolha ,
       bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt data_inicial_cobertura , bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt data_final_cobertura , dpnt.creation_date ,
       dpnt.last_update_date
FROM ben_elig_cvrd_dpnt dpnt , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , per_all_people_f papf ,
     per_all_people_f papfd , per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_person_names_f ppnf ,
     ben_pl_typ_f bpt , ben_pl_f bpf , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE dpnt.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
  AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
  AND bpt.name IN ('Plano de Saúde','Plano Odontológico')
  AND bpf.pl_id = bper.pl_id
  AND papf.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papfd.person_id = dpnt.dpnt_person_id
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND pcrf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pcrf.contact_person_id = papfd.person_id
  AND dpnt.cvg_strt_dt BETWEEN pcrf.effective_start_date AND pcrf.effective_end_date
  AND ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT pil.per_in_ler_id
     FROM ben_per_in_ler pil
     WHERE pil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
       AND pil.per_in_ler_stat_cd NOT IN ('VOIDD','BCKDT'))
  AND paam.assignment_id = bper.assignment_id
  AND dpnt.cvg_strt_dt BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
  AND bpt.name = NVL(:p_name, bpt.name)
  AND dpnt.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 dpnt.last_update_date)
ORDER BY dpnt.last_update_date
```

### Query #79

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
                bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id , bpt.name , bpf.name plan_name ,
                NVL(bpf.short_code, bof.short_code) short_code , bpf.short_name plan_short_name ,
                bof.short_name opt_short_name , bper.orgnl_enrt_dt data_inscricao_original ,
                bper.election_date data_escolha , bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt data_inicial_cobertura ,
                CASE
                    WHEN TRUNC(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                          'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NULL ELSE bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt
                END AS data_final_cobertura ,
                CASE
                    WHEN bpt.name = 'Seguro de Vida' THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(bof.short_name,

                                                                                          'N_OPT',
                                                                                          '0'),

                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                  ''),
                                                                          ',', '.'),
                                                                      '0')) WHEN bpt.name = 'Auxílio Home Office' THEN babr.val ELSE 0
                END AS valor_plano ,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                         OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                            '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18
                    ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto, '.', '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
                END AS cod_ccusto , bper.creation_date , bper.last_update_date
FROM ben_pl_f bpf , ben_pl_typ_f bpt , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper ,
     per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , ben_per_in_ler bpil ,
     ben_opt_f bof , ben_acty_base_rt_f babr , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap
WHERE 1=1
  AND bpt.pl_typ_id = bpf.pl_typ_id
  AND bpt.name IN ('Auxílio Home Office','Plano de Saúde','Plano Odontológico','Seguro de Vida','VA/VR')
  AND bper.pl_id = bpf.pl_id
  AND bpil.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_in_ler_id
  AND bof.opt_id = bper.opt_id
  AND babr.oipl_id(+) = bper.oipl_id
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN babr.effective_start_date(+) AND babr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_id = bper.assignment_id
  AND paam.person_id = bper.person_id
  AND bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id = NVL(:p_benefit_id,
                                 bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id)
  AND bpt.name = NVL(:p_name, bpt.name)
  AND bper.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 bper.last_update_date)
ORDER BY bper.creation_date, bper.last_update_date
```

### Query #80

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_ACTN, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT  bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt                data_inicial_cobertura
      , NVL(bpf.short_code,bof.short_code)   short_code
      , bpf.short_name                       plan_short_name
      , bof.short_name                       opt_short_name
      , bpf.name                          as plan_name
      , BPER.PER_IN_LER_ID                   PER_IN_LER_ID
      , bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
      , bper.orgnl_enrt_dt                   data_inscricao_original
      , bper.election_date                   data_escolha
      , bper.created_by
      , bper.creation_date
      , bper.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      , bptf.name
      , papf.person_id
      , papf.person_number
      , paam.assignment_number
      , le.le_name
      , le.le_organization_code
      , CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente') OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN    REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17 ,'.','') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18   ELSE    REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,'.','') || '-' || pap.attribute8   END AS cod_ccusto
      , '' AS data_final_cobertura
  , '2' as envio
   , '0' AS valor_plano
FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt           bper
     , ben_pl_typ_f                 bptf
     , ben_per_in_ler               bpil
     , ben_prtt_enrt_actn           bpea
     , BEN_PL_F                     bpf
     , BEN_OPT_F                    bof
     , per_all_people_f             papf
         , per_all_assignments_m                paam
   , per_person_types_tl                  pptl
, per_periods_of_service   ppos
   , (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id
             , xep.name                le_name
             , xep.legal_entity_identifier
             , haou.organization_id    le_organization_id
             , haou.organization_code  le_organization_code
             , xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
          FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou
             , xle_entity_profiles         xep
             , xle_registrations_v         xrv
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND SYSDATE                   BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from,SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,SYSDATE)
           AND xrv.legal_entity_id       = xep.legal_entity_id
           AND xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND haou.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
                                             WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
     , (SELECT posi.*
             , cc.cod_ccusto
             , cc.desc_ccusto
          FROM hr_all_positions_f          posi
             , (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id
                     , ffvv.flex_value  cod_ccusto
                     , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
                  FROM fnd_flex_values_vl  ffvv
                     , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
                 WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id      = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
                   AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name    = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
                   AND NVL( ffvv.enabled_flag,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag,'N')  = 'N'
                   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)              BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
         WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center ) pap
 WHERE bptf.name                    IN  ('Plano Odontológico' )
   AND bpil.per_in_ler_id           =   bper.per_IN_LER_ID
   AND bptf.pl_typ_id               =   bper.pl_typ_id
   AND BPER.PL_ID                   =   bpf.PL_ID
   AND bper.opt_id                  =   bof.opt_id
   AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd      =   'STRTD'
   AND bper.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID       =   bpea.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
   AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id
   AND NVL(bper.sspndd_flag,'N')    <>  'Y'
   AND bpea.ACTN_TYP_LVL_CD         IN  ('ENRTCTFN')
   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
                      FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt   bper1
                         , BEN_OPT_F            bof1
                     WHERE bper.pl_typ_id           = bper1.pl_typ_id
                       AND bper.person_id           = bper1.person_id
                       AND bper.per_in_ler_id       = bper1.per_IN_LER_ID
                       AND bof.short_code           = bof1.short_code
                       AND bper1.opt_id             = bof1.opt_id
                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X'
                                         FROM  ben_prtt_enrt_actn   bpea1
                                         WHERE bper1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID       =   bpea1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID

                                      )
                  )

   AND le.le_organization_id(+)     = paam.legal_entity_id

AND NVL(bpf.short_code,bof.short_code) <> 'N_OPT'

 AND papf.person_id     = ppos.person_id
 AND paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID      = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
 AND  ppos.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
 AND  paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'

   AND pap.position_id(+)           = paam.position_id
   AND paam.effective_start_date    BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)

   AND pptl.person_type_id(+)       = paam.person_type_id
   AND pptl.language(+)             = 'PTB'
   AND paam.person_id               = papf.person_id
   AND paam.assignment_status_type  = 'ACTIVE'
   AND paam.assignment_type         = 'E'
   AND paam.effective_end_date      = (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                        WHERE person_id               = paam.person_id
                                          AND primary_flag            = paam.primary_flag
                                          AND assignment_type         = paam.assignment_type
                                          AND assignment_status_type  = paam.assignment_status_type)
   AND papf.effective_start_date    = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                         FROM per_all_people_f
                                        WHERE person_id               = papf.person_id)
   AND papf.person_number         =  NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
   AND BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE       >= NVL(:p_integration_date, BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)

   UNION ALL

   SELECT  bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt                data_inicial_cobertura
      , NVL(bpf.short_code,bof.short_code)   short_code
      , bpf.short_name                       plan_short_name
      , bof.short_name                       opt_short_name
      , bpf.name                          as plan_name
      , BPER.PER_IN_LER_ID                   PER_IN_LER_ID
      , bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id
      , bper.orgnl_enrt_dt                   data_inscricao_original
      , bper.election_date                   data_escolha
      , bper.created_by
      , bper.creation_date
      , bper.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      , bptf.name
      , papf.person_id
      , papf.person_number
      , paam.assignment_number
      , le.le_name
      , le.le_organization_code
      , CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente') OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN    REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17 ,'.','') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18   ELSE    REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,'.','') || '-' || pap.attribute8   END AS cod_ccusto
      , '' AS data_final_cobertura
  , '2' as envio
   , '0' AS valor_plano
FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt           bper
     , ben_pl_typ_f                 bptf
     , ben_per_in_ler               bpil
     , ben_prtt_enrt_actn           bpea
     , BEN_PL_F                     bpf
     , BEN_OPT_F                    bof
     , per_all_people_f             papf
         , per_all_assignments_m                paam
   , per_person_types_tl                  pptl
, per_periods_of_service   ppos
   , (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id
             , xep.name                le_name
             , xep.legal_entity_identifier
             , haou.organization_id    le_organization_id
             , haou.organization_code  le_organization_code
```
