```sql
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND SYSDATE                   BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from,SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,SYSDATE)
           AND xrv.legal_entity_id       = xep.legal_entity_id
           AND xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND haou.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                              FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
                                             WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
     , (SELECT posi.*
             , cc.cod_ccusto
             , cc.desc_ccusto
          FROM hr_all_positions_f          posi
             , (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id
                     , ffvv.flex_value  cod_ccusto
                     , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
                  FROM fnd_flex_values_vl  ffvv
                     , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
                 WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id      = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
                   AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name    = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
                   AND NVL( ffvv.enabled_flag,'N') = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag,'N')  = 'N'
                   AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)              BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
         WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center ) pap
 WHERE bptf.name                    IN  ('Seguro de Vida Unimed')
   AND bpil.per_in_ler_id           =   bper.per_IN_LER_ID
   AND bptf.pl_typ_id               =   bper.pl_typ_id
   AND BPER.PL_ID                   =   bpf.PL_ID
   AND bper.opt_id                  =   bof.opt_id (+)

   AND ((bper.election_date BETWEEN bof.effective_start_date AND bof.effective_end_date) OR bof.effective_start_date IS NULL )
   AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd      =   'STRTD'
   AND bper.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID       =   bpea.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID (+)
   AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id

   AND NVL(bper.sspndd_flag,'N')    <>  'Y'
   AND (bpea.ACTN_TYP_LVL_CD         IN  ('ENRTCTFN') OR bpea.ACTN_TYP_LVL_CD IS NULL)
   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
                      FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt   bper1
                         , BEN_OPT_F            bof1
                     WHERE bper.pl_typ_id           = bper1.pl_typ_id
                       AND bper.person_id           = bper1.person_id
                       AND bper.per_in_ler_id       = bper1.per_IN_LER_ID
                       AND bof.short_code           = bof1.short_code
                       AND bper1.opt_id             = bof1.opt_id
                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X'
                                         FROM  ben_prtt_enrt_actn   bpea1
                                         WHERE bper1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID       =   bpea1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID

                                      )
                  )

   AND le.le_organization_id(+)     = paam.legal_entity_id

 AND (NVL(bpf.short_code,bof.short_code) <> 'N_OPT' OR bof.short_code IS NULL)

 AND papf.person_id     = ppos.person_id
 AND paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID      = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
 AND  ppos.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
 AND  paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'

   AND pap.position_id(+)           = paam.position_id
   AND paam.effective_start_date    BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)

   AND pptl.person_type_id(+)       = paam.person_type_id
   AND pptl.language(+)             = 'PTB'
   AND paam.person_id               = papf.person_id
   AND paam.assignment_status_type  = 'ACTIVE'
   AND paam.assignment_type         = 'E'
   AND paam.effective_end_date      = (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                        WHERE person_id               = paam.person_id
                                          AND primary_flag            = paam.primary_flag
                                          AND assignment_type         = paam.assignment_type
                                          AND assignment_status_type  = paam.assignment_status_type)
   AND papf.effective_start_date    = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                         FROM per_all_people_f
                                        WHERE person_id               = papf.person_id)

   AND papf.person_number          =  NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
   AND BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE       >= NVL(:p_integration_date, BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
```

```sql
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'

  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND bper.orgnl_enrt_dt = bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt
```

### Query #83

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO, PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO,
                to_char(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') SALARIO,
                to_char(CS.SALARY_FACTOR,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AUMENTO_SALARIAL,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO, GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 AS CIDADE_ESTADO,
                CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
                END AS TIPO_CARTA
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF,
     CMP_SALARY CS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME, PASF.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID)
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)) GESTOR, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID(+) = LOC.LOCATION_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = GESTOR.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND (PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P'))
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND CS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE CS.PERSON_ID = PERSON_ID)
  AND POS.POSITION_ID = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
```

### Query #84

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, DUAL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT UPPER(pl_typ.name) || ' - ' || pl.name || ' ' || bof_opt.name AS NOME_BENEFICIO
FROM ben_pl_typ_f pl_typ , ben_pl_f pl , ben_elig_per_f fact ,
     ben_opt_f bof_opt , ben_elig_per_opt_f opt , per_all_people_f papf ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf
WHERE pl_typ.pl_typ_id = pl.pl_typ_id
  AND fact.pl_id = pl.pl_id
  AND fact.elig_per_id = opt.elig_per_id
  AND fact.per_in_ler_id = opt.per_in_ler_id
  AND opt.opt_id = bof_opt.opt_id
  AND opt.elig_flag = 'Y'
  AND fact.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND fact.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
UNION ALL
SELECT '  ' AS NOME_BENEFICIO
FROM dual
```

### Query #85

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_FROM,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO, TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_FROM,

                                                                                      'YYYY/MM/DD') PUBLISH_DATE,
                PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO,
                to_char(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') SALARIO,
                to_char(CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT,
                  'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AUMENTO_SALARIAL,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO,
                TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 AS CIDADE_ESTADO,
                CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
                END AS TIPO_CARTA
FROM CMP_SALARY CS, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF,
     HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME, PASF.PERSON_ID, PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS email_gestor
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF, per_email_addresses PEA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID
          AND PPNF_LIDER.person_id = PEA.person_id
          AND pea.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
          AND PEA.date_from =
            (SELECT MAX(date_from)
             FROM per_email_addresses
             WHERE PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
               AND EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'))) GESTOR, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.ASSIGNMENT_ID = CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID = CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN PPN.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPN.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND POS.POSITION_ID = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(POS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
```

### Query #86

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_FROM,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO , PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID , jobs.NAME CARGO ,
                CS.SALARY_AMOUNT SALARIO , CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT AUMENTO_SALARIAL , CS.DATE_TO ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
                TO_CHAR(CS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 AS CIDADE_ESTADO , TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_FROM,

                                                                               'YYYY/MM/DD') PUBLISH_DATE , CS.DATE_FROM ,
                CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
                END AS TIPO_CARTA
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ,
     CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC , per_jobs_f_tl jobs ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID , PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS email_gestor ,
          PEA.EMAIL_TYPE
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER , PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF , per_email_addresses PEA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID
          AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID
          AND PPNF_LIDER.person_id = PEA.person_id)
     AND pea.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
     AND PEA.date_from =
       (SELECT MAX(date_from)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
          AND EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1')) GESTOR , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
  AND CS.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND jobs.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND jobs.JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN jobs.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND jobs.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND POS.POSITION_ID = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
     WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND cs.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                               cs.last_update_date)
```

### Query #87

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_JOBS_F_TL, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, FUSION, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO, PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO,

  (SELECT NAME
   FROM per_jobs_f_tl
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
     AND JOB_ID = PAAM.JOB_ID) CARGO, CS.SALARY_AMOUNT SALARIO, CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT AUMENTO_SALARIAL,
                CS.DATE_TO,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO,
                TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 AS CIDADE_ESTADO, TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,

                                                                              'YYYY/MM/DD') PUBLISH_DATE
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF,
     CMP_SALARY CS, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME, PASF.PERSON_ID, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS email_gestor, PEA.EMAIL_TYPE
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF, per_email_addresses PEA
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID
          AND PPNF_LIDER.person_id = PEA.person_id
          AND pea.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'
          AND PEA.date_from =
            (SELECT MAX(date_from)
             FROM per_email_addresses
             WHERE PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
               AND EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1'))) GESTOR
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = GESTOR.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = LOC.LOCATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(CS.DATE_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND (PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P'))
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
  AND paam.action_code = 'PROMOTION'
```

### Query #88

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, DUAL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT UPPER(pl_typ.name) || ' - ' || pl.name || ' ' || bof_opt.name AS NOME_BENEFICIO
FROM ben_pl_typ_f pl_typ , ben_pl_f pl , ben_elig_per_f fact ,
     ben_opt_f bof_opt , ben_elig_per_opt_f opt , per_all_people_f papf ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf
WHERE pl_typ.pl_typ_id = pl.pl_typ_id
  AND fact.pl_id = pl.pl_id
  AND fact.elig_per_id = opt.elig_per_id
  AND fact.per_in_ler_id = opt.per_in_ler_id
  AND opt.opt_id = bof_opt.opt_id
  AND opt.elig_flag = 'Y'
  AND fact.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND fact.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
UNION ALL
SELECT '  ' AS NOME_BENEFICIO
FROM dual
```

### Query #89

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pab.action_code , parb.action_reason_code ,
                paam.effective_start_date , gestor.display_name , ppnf.display_name nome_educador ,
                cmps.last_update_date , gestor.email_gestor AS email_address
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_action_reasons_b parb , per_actions_b pab ,
     per_action_reason_usages paru , per_action_role_mapping parm , per_all_people_f papf ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf , per_all_assignments_m paam ,

  (SELECT ppnf_lider.display_name , pasf.person_id , pasf.assignment_id , pea.email_address email_gestor
   FROM per_person_names_f ppnf_lider , per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf ,
        per_email_addresses pea
   WHERE 1=1
     AND ppnf_lider.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND ppnf_lider.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf_lider.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf_lider.person_id)
     AND pasf.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f
        WHERE person_id = pasf.person_id)
     AND ppnf_lider.person_id = pea.person_id
     AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
     AND pea.date_from =
       (SELECT MAX(date_from)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'W1')) gestor , PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL ppttl
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND (((pab.action_code = 'CHANGE_SALARY'
         AND parb.action_reason_code IN ('11', 'E_25', 'E_25_REMUNERACAO', 'C_25', 'D_25',
                                         'A_25'))
        OR (pab.action_code = 'GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY'
            AND parb.action_reason_code IN ('11', 'E_25', 'E_25_REMUNERACAO', 'C_25',
                                            'D_25', 'A_25')))
       OR pab.action_code IN ('LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE'))
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND gestor.person_id = PAAM.person_id
  AND gestor.assignment_id = PAAM.assignment_id
  AND ppttl.person_type_id = PAAM.person_type_id
  AND ppttl.language = 'PTB'
  AND ppttl.user_person_type <> 'CLT - Docente'
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_reason_id(+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id(+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id(+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND (parm.role_common_name != 'ANM_-_REMUNERACAO'
       OR parm.role_common_name IS NULL)
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0
  AND TRUNC(cmps.date_to) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND TO_CHAR(cmps.DATE_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND cmps.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.last_update_date)
```

### Query #90

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_GRADES_F_TL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT pgft.name grade , colig.organization_code cod_colig ,
       filial.cod_filial cod_filial , rect.meaning cod_tipo_func ,
       CASE
           WHEN pjf.job_code IS NOT NULL
                AND hapft.position_id IS NULL THEN TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(io.attribute_number1)/5) ELSE TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(io.attribute_number1)/4.5)
       END carga_horaria_semanal ,
       CASE
           WHEN pjf.job_code IS NOT NULL
                AND hapft.position_id IS NULL THEN '4.5' ELSE '5'
       END divisor , pjf.job_code cod_funcao ,
       io.attribute_char1 mod_trabalho , cmps.salary_amount salario ,
       pplf.sex sexo , NVL(io.approved_date, sysdate) proposed_start_date ,
       io.preselected_hr_action_id , colig.name legal_employer
FROM per_grades_f_tl pgft , per_all_assignments_m paam , irc_candidates ic ,
     irc_offers io , hr_organization_v colig , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     cmp_salary cmps , per_people_legislative_f pplf , irc_submissions isub ,
     irc_requisitions_b irb , hr_all_positions_f_tl hapft ,

  (SELECT flv.meaning , flv.lookup_code
   FROM fnd_lookup_values flv
   WHERE flv.lookup_type = 'ORA_IRC_RECRUITING_TYPE'
     AND flv.language = 'PTB') rect ,

  (SELECT SUBSTR(hlaf.location_name, 1, INSTR(hlaf.location_name,
                                          ' - ')-1) cod_filial , hlaf.location_name name_filial
   FROM hr_locations_all_f_vl hlaf) filial
WHERE paam.person_id = ic.person_id
  AND isub.submission_id = io.submission_id
  AND irb.requisition_id = isub.requisition_id
  AND hapft.position_id (+) = irb.position_id
  AND io.person_id = ic.person_id
  AND pgft.grade_id = paam.grade_id
  AND pgft.language = 'PTB'
  AND pgft.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_grades_f_tl
     WHERE grade_id = pgft.grade_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND primary_assignment_flag = 'Y')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
  AND rect.lookup_code = io.attribute_char4
  AND paam.job_id = pjf.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND pplf.person_id = ic.person_id
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND filial.name_filial = io.attribute_char3
  AND io.attribute_char3 IS NOT NULL
  AND colig.classification_code = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND colig.status = 'A'
  AND colig.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN colig.effective_start_date AND colig.effective_end_date
  AND colig.organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND ic.candidate_number = NVL(:p_candidate_number, ic.candidate_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
```

### Query #91

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `IRC_CANDIDATES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT ic.candidate_number , irb.requisition_number , ipt.name phases , ist.name states ,
       paam.assignment_number , isub.last_update_date
FROM irc_candidates ic , irc_submissions isub , irc_requisitions_b irb ,
     irc_states_tl ist , irc_phases_tl ipt , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE isub.person_id = ic.person_id
  AND irb.requisition_id = isub.requisition_id
  AND ist.language = 'PTB'
  AND ipt.language = 'PTB'
  AND isub.current_state_id = ist.state_id
  AND ist.name = 'Preliminar'
  AND ipt.name = 'Oferta'
  AND isub.current_phase_id = ipt.phase_id
  AND paam.person_id = ic.person_id
  AND paam.action_code = 'EMPL_OFFER_CREATE'
  AND paam.projected_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(projected_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND primary_assignment_flag = 'Y')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
  AND ic.candidate_number = NVL(:p_candidate_number, ic.candidate_number)
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
  AND isub.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_last_update_date,
                                 isub.last_update_date)
```

### Query #92

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.person_id , paam.assignment_number ,
       paam.assignment_id || ' ' || paam.assignment_name , pab.action_code AS action_code_promocao ,
       pab2.action_code AS action_code_alteracao_cargo , ppnf.display_name , parb.action_reason_code AS action_reason_code_promocao ,
       parb2.action_reason_code AS action_reason_code_alterar_cargo , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date,

                                                                        'dd/mm/yyyy') effective_start_date ,
       pea.email_address email_func , gestor.email_gestor , gestor.display_name gestor_Name ,
       paam.last_update_date , pjftl.name AS "CARGO" , 0 altera_modelo_trabalho , '' transaction_id ,
                                                                                     '' indicador_remuneracao ,
                                                                                        ppttl.USER_PERSON_TYPE AS person_type ,
                                                                                        '' grupo_documental ,
                                                                                           '' tipo_documento ,
                                                                                              '' process_category ,
                                                                                                 TO_CHAR(CASE
                                                                                                             WHEN TRUNC(cmps.date_from) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                                                                             ELSE TRUNC(cmps.date_from)
                                                                                                         END,

                                                                                                   'YYYY-MM-DD') AS effective_start_date_event
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_action_reasons_b parb , per_action_reasons_b parb2 ,
     per_action_reason_usages paru , per_action_reason_usages paru2 , per_action_role_mapping parm ,
     per_action_role_mapping parm2 , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf , per_person_names_f ppnf ,
     per_actions_b pab , per_actions_b pab2 , per_email_addresses pea , per_jobs_f_tl pjftl ,
     per_person_types_tl ppttl ,

  (SELECT ppnf_lider.display_name , pasf.person_id , pasf.assignment_id , pea.email_address email_gestor ,
          pea.email_type
   FROM per_person_names_f ppnf_lider , per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_email_addresses pea
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND ppnf_lider.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND ppnf_lider.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf_lider.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf_lider.person_id)
     AND pasf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f
        WHERE person_id = pasf.person_id
          AND assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
          AND ppnf_lider.person_id = pea.person_id)
     AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
     AND pea.date_from =
       (SELECT MAX(date_from)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'W1')) gestor
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND cmps.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND cmps.date_to = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND (pab.action_code = 'PROMOTION'
       OR pab.action_code IN ('LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE'))
  AND pab2.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_reason_id(+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id(+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id(+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND paru.action_reason_code NOT IN ('ANM_DESEMP_REMUNERACAO', '20_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RET_REMUNERACAO',
                                      'ANM_SUBST_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO',
                                      'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO_2')
  AND parb2.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND paru2.action_reason_id(+) = parb2.action_reason_id
  AND paru2.action_id(+) = pab2.action_id
  AND parm2.act_usg_id(+) = paru2.action_reason_usage_id
  AND paru2.action_reason_code NOT IN ('ANM_DESEMP_REMUNERACAO', '20_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RET_REMUNERACAO',
                                       'ANM_SUBST_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO',
                                       'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO_2')
  AND pea.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
  AND pea.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_email_addresses
     WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
       AND email_type = pea.email_type)
  AND gestor.person_id (+) = paam.person_id
  AND gestor.assignment_id (+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND ppttl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
  AND ppttl.language = 'PTB'
  AND ppttl.user_person_type = 'CLT - Docente'
  AND ppnf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pjftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjftl.job_id = paam.job_id
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN pjftl.effective_start_date AND pjftl.effective_end_date)
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id
       AND assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
       AND action_id = cmps.action_id)
  AND cmps.date_from >= to_date('01/09/2024', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND cmps.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.last_update_date)
UNION
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.person_id , paam.assignment_number ,
       paam.assignment_id || ' ' || paam.assignment_name , pab.action_code AS action_code_promocao ,
       'NA' AS action_code_alteracao_cargo , ppnf.display_name , paru.action_reason_code AS action_reason_code_promocao ,
       'NA' AS action_reason_code_alterar_cargo , TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date,
                                                    'dd/mm/yyyy') effective_start_date ,
       pea.email_address email_func , pea2.email_address email_gestor , ppnf2.display_name gestor_Name ,
       paam.last_update_date , 'NA' AS "CARGO" ,
       CASE
           WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/oldValue/text()').getStringVal () != EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal () THEN 1 ELSE 0
       END altera_modelo_trabalho , TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id) transaction_id ,
       CASE WHEN parm.role_common_name = 'ANM_-_REMUNERACAO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS indicador_remuneracao , pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE AS person_type ,
       'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupo_documental ,
       CASE
           WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal () = 'Presencial' THEN '703-Termo Retorno ao Presencial' ELSE '694-Termo Teletrabalho/Híbrido/Ergonomia'
       END AS tipo_documento , htce.process_category ,
       TO_CHAR(CASE
                   WHEN TRUNC(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                        '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/POS_ActionDate/text()').getStringVal(),
                                'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                   ELSE TRUNC(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                        '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/POS_ActionDate/text()').getStringVal(),
                                'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))
               END, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS effective_start_date_event
FROM per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf , per_person_names_f ppnf , per_email_addresses pea ,
     per_person_types_tl pptt , hrc_txn_console_entry htce , hrc_txn_header hth ,
     FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw , per_actions_b pab , per_all_assignments_m paam_gestor ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf2 , per_email_addresses pea2 , per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf ,
     per_action_reasons_b parb , per_action_reason_usages paru , per_action_role_mapping parm
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND htce.process_category IN ('Promover e Alterar Posição','Promote and Change Position')
  AND pab.action_code IN ('ANM_ALT_CARGO_PROMOTE','PROMOTION')
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,
                             '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND pab.action_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionId/DATA/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND parb.action_reason_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionReasonId/DATA/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND paru.action_reason_id (+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id (+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id (+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND pea.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
  AND pea.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_email_addresses
     WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
       AND email_type = pea.email_type)
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam_gestor.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND assignment_id = paam_gestor.assignment_id
       AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_id = NVL(EXTRACTVALUE(xml_data_cache,

                                        '//AssignmentSupervisorDEORow/ManagerAssignmentId/DATA'),
                                    pasf.manager_assignment_id)
  AND pasf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pasf.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf2.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf2.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(ppnfi.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f ppnfi
     WHERE ppnfi.person_id = ppnf2.person_id)
  AND ppnf2.person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
  AND pea2.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf2.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
```

### Query #94

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
                  'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO, paam.normal_hours ,
                PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO ,
                CS.SALARY_AMOUNT SALARIO , CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT AUMENTO_SALARIAL ,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
                TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
                LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 CIDADE_ESTADO
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM ,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF , CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)) GESTOR
WHERE PPN.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPN.PERSON_ID = CS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = GESTOR.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.DATE_TO =
    (SELECT MAX(DATE_TO)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = LOC.LOCATION_ID
  AND (PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P'))
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
```

### Query #95

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, BEN_PER_IN_LER, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT bper.pl_typ_id ,bper.PL_ID ,

  (SELECT bper2.enrt_cvg_strt_dt
   FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper2 , ben_per_in_ler bpil2 , ben_pl_typ_f bptf2 ,
        BEN_OPT_F bof2
   WHERE bpil2.per_in_ler_id = bper2.per_IN_LER_ID
     AND bptf2.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')
     AND bptf2.pl_typ_id = bper2.pl_typ_id
     AND bpil2.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD'
     AND bper2.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
     AND bper2.PL_ID = bper.PL_ID
     AND bpil2.person_id = bpil.person_id
     AND bper2.opt_id = bof2.opt_id
     AND bpil2.STRTD_DT =
       (SELECT MIN(STRTD_DT)
        FROM ben_per_in_ler aux , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt aux1 , BEN_OPT_F aux2
        WHERE aux.person_id = bpil2.person_id
          AND aux2.opt_id = aux1.opt_id
          AND aux2.short_code = bof2.short_code
          AND aux.per_in_ler_id = aux1.per_IN_LER_ID
          AND bper2.pl_typ_id = aux1.pl_typ_id
          AND aux.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD')
   ORDER BY bper2.enrt_cvg_strt_dt FETCH FIRST ROW ONLY) AS data_inicial_cobertura,

  (SELECT count(bper2.enrt_cvg_strt_dt)
   FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper2 , ben_per_in_ler bpil2 , ben_pl_typ_f bptf2 ,
        BEN_OPT_F bof2
   WHERE bpil2.per_in_ler_id = bper2.per_IN_LER_ID
     AND bptf2.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')
     AND bptf2.pl_typ_id = bper2.pl_typ_id
     AND bpil2.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD'
     AND bper2.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
     AND bper2.PL_ID = bper.PL_ID
     AND bpil2.person_id = bpil.person_id
     AND bper2.opt_id = bof2.opt_id
     AND bpil2.STRTD_DT =
       (SELECT MIN(STRTD_DT)
        FROM ben_per_in_ler aux , ben_prtt_enrt_rslt aux1 , BEN_OPT_F aux2
        WHERE aux.person_id = bpil2.person_id
          AND aux2.opt_id = aux1.opt_id
          AND aux2.short_code = bof2.short_code
          AND aux.per_in_ler_id = aux1.per_IN_LER_ID
          AND bper2.pl_typ_id = aux1.pl_typ_id
          AND aux.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD')) AS count_data_inicial_cobertura , NVL(bpf.short_code,

                                                                                     bof.short_code) short_code ,
       bpf.short_name plan_short_name , bof.short_name opt_short_name ,
       bpf.name AS plan_name , BPER.PER_IN_LER_ID PER_IN_LER_ID ,
       bper.prtt_enrt_rslt_id , bper.orgnl_enrt_dt data_inscricao_original ,
       bper.election_date data_escolha , bper.created_by , bper.creation_date , bper.LAST_UPDATE_DATE , bptf.name ,
       papf.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , le.le_name ,
       le.le_organization_code ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                   '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18 ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,

                                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
       END AS cod_ccusto ,
       CASE
           WHEN TRUNC(bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                 'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NULL ELSE bper.enrt_cvg_thru_dt
       END AS data_final_cobertura , '1' AS envio , '0' AS valor_plano
FROM ben_prtt_enrt_rslt bper , ben_pl_typ_f bptf , ben_per_in_ler bpil ,
     BEN_PL_F bpf , BEN_OPT_F bof , per_all_people_f papf ,
     per_all_assignments_m paam , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap
WHERE bpil.per_in_ler_id = bper.per_IN_LER_ID
  AND BPER.PL_ID = bpf.PL_ID
  AND bper.opt_id = bof.opt_id
  AND NVL(bper.sspndd_flag, 'N') <> 'Y'
  AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id
  AND bptf.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')
  AND bptf.pl_typ_id = bper.pl_typ_id
  AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD'
  AND bpil.STRTD_DT =
    (SELECT MAX(STRTD_DT)
     FROM ben_per_in_ler aux
     WHERE aux.person_id = bpil.person_id
       AND aux.per_in_ler_stat_cd = 'PROCD')
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 'X'
     FROM ben_pl_typ_f pl_typ1 , ben_elig_per_f fact1 , ben_elig_per_opt_f opt1 ,
          ben_pl_f pl1
     WHERE pl_typ1.name IN ('Plano Odontológico')
       AND pl_typ1.pl_typ_id = pl1.pl_typ_id
       AND fact1.pl_id = pl1.pl_id
       AND fact1.elig_per_id = opt1.elig_per_id
       AND fact1.per_in_ler_id = opt1.per_in_ler_id
       AND opt1.elig_flag = 'Y'
       AND fact1.person_id = papf.person_id
       AND fact1.per_in_ler_id = bpil.per_in_ler_id
       AND opt1.PRTN_END_DT IS NOT NULL)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND BPIL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(to_date('01/03/2025',
                                     'dd/mm/rrrr'),
                                 BPIL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
```

### Query #96

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER CHAPA
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT x.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
   WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = :p_assignment_number) ASSG_ATU ON ASSG_ATU.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
WHERE PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND PAAM.EMPLOYEE_CATEGORY <> 'AUTONOMO'
  AND TRUNC(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                         'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = ASSG_ATU.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER <> :p_assignment_number
```

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M_, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dep.person_number , dep.dep_number , dep.codcoligada , dep.assignment_number ,
                dep.nrodepend , dep.nome , dep.cpf , dep.dtnascimento , dep.sexo ,
                NVL(dep.estadocivil, 'S') estadocivil , dep.localnascimento , dep.cartorio , dep.nroregistro , dep.nrolivro ,
                dep.nrofolha , dep.incirrf , dep.incinss , dep.incpensao , dep.incdefiniveis ,
                dep.grauparentesco , dep.cartaovacina , dep.dataentregacertidao , dep.freqescolar ,
                dep.universitario , dep.incsalfam , dep.observacao , dep.numerocartaosus ,
                dep.last_update_date , dep.nomemaedepend , dep.datacasamento
FROM
  (SELECT papf.person_number person_number , papfd.person_number dep_number ,
          le.le_organization_code codcoligada , paam.assignment_number , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 nrodepend ,
          REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRANSLATE(ppnf.full_name,

                                  'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
                                  'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ') nome , REPLACE(REPLACE(pni.national_identifier_number,

                                                                                                                                       '.',
                                                                                                                                       ''),

                                                                                                                               '-',
                                                                                                                               '') cpf ,
          pp.date_of_birth dtnascimento , pplf.sex sexo ,
          pcrf.cont_attribute8 estadocivil , pp.town_of_birth localnascimento , '' cartorio ,
                                                                                   '' nroregistro ,
                                                                                      '' nrolivro ,
                                                                                         '' nrofolha ,
                                                                                            DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute4,

                                                                                              'Y',
                                                                                              '1',
                                                                                              '0') incirrf ,
                                                                                            0 incinss ,
                                                                                            DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute5,

                                                                                              'Y',
                                                                                              '1',
                                                                                              '0') incpensao ,
                                                                                            '' incdefiniveis ,
                                                                                               pcrf.contact_type grauparentesco ,
                                                                                               DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute6,

                                                                                                 'Y',
                                                                                                 '1',
                                                                                                 '0') cartaovacina ,
                                                                                               '' dataentregacertidao ,
                                                                                                  DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute7,

                                                                                                    'Y',
                                                                                                    '1',
                                                                                                    '0') freqescolar ,
                                                                                                  DECODE(pcrf.cont_information2,

                                                                                                    'Y',
                                                                                                    '1',
                                                                                                    '0') universitario ,
                                                                                                  0 incsalfam ,
                                                                                                  '' observacao ,

     (SELECT national_identifier_number
      FROM per_national_identifiers
      WHERE national_identifier_type = 'CNS'
        AND person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id) numerocartaosus ,
                                                                                                     GREATEST(NVL(int_adm.last_update_date,

                                                                                                                to_date('01/01/1900',

                                                                                                                  'dd/mm/yyyy')) ,

                                                                                                       pcrf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       papfd.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       ppnf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       pp.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       pplf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       NVL(pni.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         TO_DATE('01/01/1900',

                                                                                                           'DD/MM/YYYY'))) last_update_date ,
                                                                                                     pcrf.cont_attribute3 AS NOMEMAEDEPEND ,
                                                                                                     TO_CHAR(pcrf.cont_attribute_date1,

                                                                                                       'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATACASAMENTO
   FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_all_people_f papf , per_all_people_f papfd ,
        per_person_names_f ppnf , per_persons pp , per_people_legislative_f pplf ,
        per_national_identifiers pni , per_all_assignments_m paam ,

     (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
             haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
             xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
      FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
      WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
        AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
        AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
        AND haou.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
           FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
           WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

     (SELECT paam_old.Assignment_Id ,paam_old.assignment_number assignment_anterior ,
             paam2.assignment_number assignment_atual ,paam2.last_update_date ,paam2.last_updated_by ,papf2.person_number
      FROM per_all_assignments_m_ paam_old
      INNER JOIN per_all_assignments_m_ paam2 ON paam2.assignment_type = 'E'
      AND paam2.assignment_number NOT LIKE 'E%'
      AND paam2.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
      AND paam2.last_update_date =
        (SELECT MIN(x.last_update_date)
         FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
         WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
           AND x.last_update_date > paam_old.last_update_date)
      INNER JOIN per_all_people_f papf2 ON papf2.person_id = paam_old.person_id
      AND papf2.effective_end_date = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                       'DD/MM/YYYY')
      WHERE paam_old.assignment_type = 'E'
        AND paam_old.assignment_number LIKE 'E%'
        AND paam_old.last_update_date =
          (SELECT MAX(x.last_update_date)
           FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
           WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
             AND x.assignment_type = 'E'
             AND x.assignment_number Like 'E%')) int_adm
   WHERE 1=1
     AND pcrf.contact_type <> 'EMRG'
     AND to_char(pcrf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_contact_relships_f
        WHERE contact_relationship_id = pcrf.contact_relationship_id)
     AND papf.person_id = pcrf.person_id
     AND papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
     AND le.le_organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
     AND papfd.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
     AND papfd.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
     AND ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
     AND pp.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND pp.start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(start_date)
        FROM per_persons
        WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
     AND pplf.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
     AND pplf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_people_legislative_f
        WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
     AND pni.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
     AND pni.person_id (+) = pcrf.contact_person_id
     AND paam.person_id = pcrf.person_id
     AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
          AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
          AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
     AND int_adm.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id) dep
WHERE dep.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, dep.person_number)
  AND dep.dep_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, dep.dep_number)
  AND dep.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                dep.assignment_number)
  AND dep.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                dep.last_update_date)
```

### Query #98

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M_, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_number person_number , papfd.person_number dep_number ,
                pcrf.cont_attribute16 id_dependent , paam.assignment_number , pcrf.creation_date ,
                GREATEST(NVL(int_adm.last_update_date,
                           to_date('01/01/1900',
                             'dd/mm/yyyy')),
                  pcrf.last_update_date, papfd.last_update_date,
                  ppnf.last_update_date, pp.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date,
                  NVL(pni.last_update_date, pcrf.last_update_date)) last_update_date , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 numDep
FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrf
JOIN per_all_people_f papf ON papf.person_id = pcrf.person_id
JOIN per_all_people_f papfd ON papfd.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
JOIN per_persons pp ON pp.person_id = papfd.person_id
JOIN per_people_legislative_f pplf ON pplf.person_id = papfd.person_id
LEFT JOIN per_national_identifiers pni ON pni.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam ON paam.person_id = pcrf.person_id
JOIN PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPS ON pps.person_id = paam.person_id
AND pps.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT paam_old.Assignment_Id ,paam_old.assignment_number assignment_anterior ,
          paam2.assignment_number assignment_atual ,paam2.last_update_date ,paam2.last_updated_by ,papf2.person_number
   FROM per_all_assignments_m_ paam_old
   INNER JOIN per_all_assignments_m_ paam2 ON paam2.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND paam2.assignment_number NOT LIKE 'E%'
   AND paam2.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
   AND paam2.last_update_date =
     (SELECT MIN(x.last_update_date)
      FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
      WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
        AND x.last_update_date > paam_old.last_update_date)
   INNER JOIN per_all_people_f papf2 ON papf2.person_id = paam_old.person_id
   AND papf2.effective_end_date = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                    'DD/MM/YYYY')
   WHERE paam_old.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam_old.assignment_number LIKE 'E%'
     AND paam_old.last_update_date =
       (SELECT MAX(x.last_update_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
        WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
          AND x.assignment_type = 'E'
          AND x.assignment_number Like 'E%')) int_adm ON int_adm.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
WHERE 1=1
  AND pcrf.contact_type <> 'EMRG'
  AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_contact_relships_f
     WHERE contact_relationship_id = pcrf.contact_relationship_id)
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND pp.start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(start_date)
     FROM per_persons
     WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
  AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND papfd.person_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, papfd.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(NVL(int_adm.last_update_date, to_date('01/01/1900',
                                               'dd/mm/yyyy')),
        pcrf.last_update_date, papfd.last_update_date, ppnf.last_update_date,
        pp.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date, NVL(pni.last_update_date,
                                                      pcrf.last_update_date)) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                   GREATEST(NVL(int_adm.last_update_date,

                                                                                              to_date('01/01/1900',

                                                                                                'dd/mm/yyyy')),

                                                                                     pcrf.last_update_date,
                                                                                     papfd.last_update_date,
                                                                                     ppnf.last_update_date,
                                                                                     pp.last_update_date,
                                                                                     pplf.last_update_date,
                                                                                     NVL(pni.last_update_date,

                                                                                       pcrf.last_update_date)))
  AND to_char(pcrf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
ORDER BY paam.assignment_number , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20
```

```sql
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f

     FROM per_persons

  AND pplf.effective_start_date =

     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = :p_person_number
  AND papfd.person_number = :p_dep_number
ORDER BY papf.person_number , papfd.person_number
```

### Query #102

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT x.PESSOA_PERSON_ID_GERAL , x.ASSIGNMENT_ID_GERAL , x.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID_GERAL , x.PRIMARY_FLAG_GERAL ,
       x.DATA_EFETIVA_GERAL , x.TIPO_PESSOA_GERAL , x.SEQUENCIA_EFETIVA_GERAL , x.MATRICULA_GERAL ,
       x.WorkTermsAssignmentId_GERAL , x.WORKTERMS_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER_GERAL , x.WORKTERMS_EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE_GERAL ,
       x.DATA_EFETIVA_WORKTERMS_GERAL , x.DATE_START_GERAL , x.LEGAL_EMPLOYER_NAME_GERAL , x.ACTION_CODE
FROM
  (SELECT paam.person_id PESSOA_PERSON_ID_GERAL ,
          paam.assignment_id ASSIGNMENT_ID_GERAL ,
          paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID_GERAL , paam.primary_flag PRIMARY_FLAG_GERAL ,
          TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date, 'YYYY/MM/DD') DATA_EFETIVA_GERAL , pptl.USER_PERSON_TYPE TIPO_PESSOA_GERAL ,
          paam.effective_sequence SEQUENCIA_EFETIVA_GERAL , paam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER MATRICULA_GERAL ,
          paam2.assignment_id WorkTermsAssignmentId_GERAL ,
          paam2.assignment_number WORKTERMS_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER_GERAL ,
          paam2.effective_sequence WORKTERMS_EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE_GERAL ,
          TO_CHAR(paam2.effective_start_date, 'YYYY/MM/DD') DATA_EFETIVA_WORKTERMS_GERAL , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,

                                                                                             'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START_GERAL ,
          paam.action_code ACTION_CODE ,
          hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER_NAME_GERAL
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos ,
        PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL pptl , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam2 , HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov
   WHERE paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.primary_flag = 'N'
     AND to_char(paam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
     AND paam2.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND paam2.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND paam2.assignment_type LIKE '%T'
     AND paam2.assignment_id = paam.work_terms_assignment_id
     AND paam2.primary_flag = 'N'
     AND to_char(paam2.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND PAAM2.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
     AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
     AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL
     AND ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
     AND pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
     AND pptl.language = 'PTB'
     AND pptl.user_person_type = 'CLT - Geral'
     AND hov.organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
     AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
     AND hov.status = 'A'
     AND paam.assignment_id NOT IN
       (SELECT a.assignment_id
        FROM PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS a, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS b, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL c
        WHERE b.status = 'INI'
          AND b.allocated_checklist_id = a.allocated_checklist_id
          AND c.allocated_task_id = b.allocated_task_id
          AND c.language = 'PTB'
          AND c.task_name IN ('HCM - Atualização Automática de Vínculo Principal', 'Verificação de Atribuição Principal'))
   ORDER BY paam.effective_start_date ASC, paam.effective_sequence ASC) x
WHERE ROWNUM = 1
```

### Query #103

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT ppnf.full_name NOME , papf.person_number PERSON_NUMBER ,
       pat.status STATUS_TAREFA , patl.task_name NOME_TAREFA ,
       pat.LAST_UPDATE_DATE LAST_UPDATE_DATE, pac.assignment_id
FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf ,
     PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS pac , PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS pat ,
     PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL patl
WHERE papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND pac.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pac.creation_date =
    (SELECT MAX(pacInterno.creation_date)
     FROM PER_ALLOCATED_CHECKLISTS pacInterno
     WHERE pac.person_id = pacInterno.person_id)
  AND pat.status = 'INI'
  AND pat.allocated_checklist_id = pac.allocated_checklist_id
  AND patl.allocated_task_id = pat.allocated_task_id
  AND patl.language = 'PTB'
  AND patl.task_name IN ('HCM - Atualização Automática de Vínculo Principal', 'Verificação de Atribuição Principal')
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND pat.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                pat.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
```

### Query #104

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE, HR_ORGANIZATION_V`

```sql
SELECT PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER, TO_CHAR(POS.DATE_START,
                             'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DATE_START,
       POS.PERIOD_TYPE AS WORKER_TYPE, HOV.NAME AS LEGAL_EMPLOYER_NAME
FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE POS
INNER JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ON PAPF.PERSON_ID = POS.PERSON_ID
INNER JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_V HOV ON HOV.ORGANIZATION_ID = POS.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
WHERE POS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT X.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
     WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_ID = :p_assignment_id)
  AND PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER = :p_person_number
  AND POS.PERIOD_TYPE = 'E'
  AND POS.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL
  AND POS.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'N'
  AND HOV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND HOV.STATUS = 'A'
  AND ROWNUM = 1
```

### Query #105

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT ASG.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, ASG.ASSIGNMENT_ID,
       TO_CHAR(ASG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, ASG.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID, ASG.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE,
       ASG.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                                 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DATA_ATUAL,
       WT.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS ASSIGNMENT_ID_WT, WT.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID,
       WT.EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE AS EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE_WT, WT.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE AS EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE_WT,
       WT.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER_WT
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ASG, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M WT
WHERE 1=1
  AND ASG.PERSON_ID IN
    (SELECT W.PERSON_ID
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M W
     WHERE W.ASSIGNMENT_ID = :p_assignment_id)
  AND ASG.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID IN
    (SELECT X.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
     FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
     WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_ID = :p_assignment_id)
  AND ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'N'
  AND ASG.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID = WT.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND WT.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'ET'
  AND ASG.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(ASG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31'
  AND TO_CHAR(WT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = '4712/12/31'
  AND ASG.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ROWNUM = 1
```
