### Query #106

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `DUAL, PER_DISABILITIES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT pdf.person_number
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdff_category = 'ORA_HRX_MOTOR_D'  THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEFISICO
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdfa_category = 'SA_HEA_IMP'       THEN '2' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEAUDITIVO
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdfr_category = 'ANM_BR_DEF_FALA'  THEN '3' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEFALA
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdfv_category = 'SA_VIS_IMP'       THEN '4' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEFVISUAL
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdfm_category = 'ORA_HRX_MENTAL_D' THEN '5' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEMENTAL
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdfi_category = 'SA_INT_DIS'       THEN '6' ELSE '0' END AS DEFICIENTEINTELECTUAL
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdre_category = 'ANM_BR_REABIL'    THEN '7' ELSE '0' END AS REABILITADO
     , CASE WHEN pdf.pdff_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdfa_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdfr_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdfv_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdfm_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdfi_category IS NULL
             AND pdf.pdre_category IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS COTAPCD
     , TRIM(pdf.pdff_nome || ' ' || pdf.pdfa_nome || ' ' || pdf.pdfr_nome || ' ' || pdf.pdfv_nome || ' ' || pdf.pdfm_nome || ' ' || pdf.pdfi_nome) descricao
     , pdf_last_update_date last_update_date
  FROM (  SELECT papf.person_number  person_number
               , pdfa.pdfa_person_id
               , pdfa.pdfa_legislation_code
               , pdfa.pdfa_category
               , pdfa.pdfa_description
               , pdfa.pdfa_quota_fte
               , pdfa.pdfa_disability_id
               , pdfa.pdfa_disclosure_date
               , pdfa.pdfa_accommodation_request
               , pdfa.pdfa_self_disclosed_type
               , pdfa.pdfa_work_restriction
               , pdfa.pdfa_last_update_date
               , pdfa.pdfa_nome
               , pdff.pdff_person_id
               , pdff.pdff_legislation_code
               , pdff.pdff_category
               , pdff.pdff_description
               , pdff.pdff_quota_fte
               , pdff.pdff_disability_id
               , pdff.pdff_disclosure_date
               , pdff.pdff_accommodation_request
               , pdff.pdff_self_disclosed_type
               , pdff.pdff_work_restriction
               , pdff.pdff_last_update_date
               , pdff.pdff_nome
               , pdfm.pdfm_person_id
               , pdfm.pdfm_legislation_code
               , pdfm.pdfm_category
               , pdfm.pdfm_description
               , pdfm.pdfm_quota_fte
               , pdfm.pdfm_disability_id
               , pdfm.pdfm_disclosure_date
               , pdfm.pdfm_accommodation_request
               , pdfm.pdfm_self_disclosed_type
               , pdfm.pdfm_work_restriction
               , pdfm.pdfm_last_update_date
               , pdfm.pdfm_nome
               , pdfr.pdfr_person_id
               , pdfr.pdfr_legislation_code
               , pdfr.pdfr_category
               , pdfr.pdfr_description
               , pdfr.pdfr_quota_fte
               , pdfr.pdfr_disability_id
               , pdfr.pdfr_disclosure_date
               , pdfr.pdfr_accommodation_request
               , pdfr.pdfr_self_disclosed_type
               , pdfr.pdfr_work_restriction
               , pdfr.pdfr_last_update_date
               , pdfr.pdfr_nome
               , pdfv.pdfv_person_id
               , pdfv.pdfv_legislation_code
               , pdfv.pdfv_category
               , pdfv.pdfv_description
               , pdfv.pdfv_quota_fte
               , pdfv.pdfv_disability_id
               , pdfv.pdfv_disclosure_date
               , pdfv.pdfv_accommodation_request
               , pdfv.pdfv_self_disclosed_type
               , pdfv.pdfv_work_restriction
               , pdfv.pdfv_last_update_date
               , pdfv.pdfv_nome
               , pdfi.pdfi_person_id
               , pdfi.pdfi_legislation_code
               , pdfi.pdfi_category
               , pdfi.pdfi_description
               , pdfi.pdfi_quota_fte
               , pdfi.pdfi_disability_id
               , pdfi.pdfi_disclosure_date
               , pdfi.pdfi_accommodation_request
               , pdfi.pdfi_self_disclosed_type
               , pdfi.pdfi_work_restriction
               , pdfi.pdfi_last_update_date
               , pdfi.pdfi_nome
               , pdre.pdre_person_id
               , pdre.pdre_legislation_code
               , pdre.pdre_category
               , pdre.pdre_description
               , pdre.pdre_quota_fte
               , pdre.pdre_disability_id
               , pdre.pdre_disclosure_date
               , pdre.pdre_accommodation_request
               , pdre.pdre_self_disclosed_type
               , pdre.pdre_work_restriction
               , pdre.pdre_last_update_date
               , (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
                    FROM ( SELECT pdfa.pdfa_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual
                     UNION SELECT pdff.pdff_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual
                     UNION SELECT pdfm.pdfm_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual
                     UNION SELECT pdfr.pdfr_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual
                     UNION SELECT pdfv.pdfv_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual
                     UNION SELECT pdfi.pdfi_last_update_date last_update_date FROM dual )) pdf_last_update_date
            FROM per_all_people_f            papf
               , per_people_legislative_f    pplf
               , ( SELECT pdf_aaux.person_id             pdfa_person_id
                        , pdf_aaux.legislation_code      pdfa_legislation_code
                        , pdf_aaux.category              pdfa_category
                        , pdf_aaux.description           pdfa_description
                        , pdf_aaux.quota_fte             pdfa_quota_fte
                        , pdf_aaux.disability_id         pdfa_disability_id
                        , pdf_aaux.disclosure_date       pdfa_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_aaux.accommodation_request pdfa_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_aaux.self_disclosed_type   pdfa_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_aaux.work_restriction      pdfa_work_restriction
                        , pdf_aaux.last_update_date      pdfa_last_update_date
                        , 'Auditiva'                     pdfa_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_aaux
                    WHERE pdf_aaux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_aaux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_aaux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_aaux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_aaux.category )
                      AND pdf_aaux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_aaux.category = 'SA_HEA_IMP' ) pdfa
               , ( SELECT pdf_faux.person_id             pdff_person_id
                        , pdf_faux.legislation_code      pdff_legislation_code
                        , pdf_faux.category              pdff_category
                        , pdf_faux.description           pdff_description
                        , pdf_faux.quota_fte             pdff_quota_fte
                        , pdf_faux.disability_id         pdff_disability_id
                        , pdf_faux.disclosure_date       pdff_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_faux.accommodation_request pdff_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_faux.self_disclosed_type   pdff_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_faux.work_restriction      pdff_work_restriction
                        , pdf_faux.last_update_date      pdff_last_update_date
                        , 'Física'                             pdff_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_faux
                    WHERE pdf_faux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_faux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_faux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_faux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_faux.category )
                      AND pdf_faux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_faux.category = 'ORA_HRX_MOTOR_D' ) pdff
               , ( SELECT pdf_maux.person_id             pdfm_person_id
                        , pdf_maux.legislation_code      pdfm_legislation_code
                        , pdf_maux.category              pdfm_category
                        , pdf_maux.description           pdfm_description
                        , pdf_maux.quota_fte             pdfm_quota_fte
                        , pdf_maux.disability_id         pdfm_disability_id
                        , pdf_maux.disclosure_date       pdfm_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_maux.accommodation_request pdfm_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_maux.self_disclosed_type   pdfm_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_maux.work_restriction      pdfm_work_restriction
                        , pdf_maux.last_update_date      pdfm_last_update_date
                        , 'Mental'                       pdfm_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_maux
                    WHERE pdf_maux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_maux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_maux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_maux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_maux.category )
                      AND pdf_maux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_maux.category = 'ORA_HRX_MENTAL_D') pdfm
               , ( SELECT pdf_raux.person_id             pdfr_person_id
                        , pdf_raux.legislation_code      pdfr_legislation_code
                        , pdf_raux.category              pdfr_category
                        , pdf_raux.description           pdfr_description
                        , pdf_raux.quota_fte             pdfr_quota_fte
                        , pdf_raux.disability_id         pdfr_disability_id
                        , pdf_raux.disclosure_date       pdfr_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_raux.accommodation_request pdfr_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_raux.self_disclosed_type   pdfr_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_raux.work_restriction      pdfr_work_restriction
                        , pdf_raux.last_update_date      pdfr_last_update_date
                        , 'Fala'                         pdfr_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_raux
                    WHERE pdf_raux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_raux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_raux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_raux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_raux.category )
                      AND pdf_raux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_raux.category = 'ANM_BR_DEF_FALA') pdfr
               , ( SELECT pdf_vaux.person_id             pdfv_person_id
                        , pdf_vaux.legislation_code      pdfv_legislation_code
                        , pdf_vaux.category              pdfv_category
                        , pdf_vaux.description           pdfv_description
                        , pdf_vaux.quota_fte             pdfv_quota_fte
                        , pdf_vaux.disability_id         pdfv_disability_id
                        , pdf_vaux.disclosure_date       pdfv_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_vaux.accommodation_request pdfv_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_vaux.self_disclosed_type   pdfv_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_vaux.work_restriction      pdfv_work_restriction
                        , pdf_vaux.last_update_date      pdfv_last_update_date
                        , 'Visual'                       pdfv_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_vaux
                    WHERE pdf_vaux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_vaux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_vaux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_vaux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_vaux.category )
                      AND pdf_vaux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_vaux.category = 'SA_VIS_IMP' ) pdfv
               , ( SELECT pdf_iaux.person_id             pdfi_person_id
                        , pdf_iaux.legislation_code      pdfi_legislation_code
                        , pdf_iaux.category              pdfi_category
                        , pdf_iaux.description           pdfi_description
                        , pdf_iaux.quota_fte             pdfi_quota_fte
                        , pdf_iaux.disability_id         pdfi_disability_id
                        , pdf_iaux.disclosure_date       pdfi_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_iaux.accommodation_request pdfi_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_iaux.self_disclosed_type   pdfi_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_iaux.work_restriction      pdfi_work_restriction
                        , pdf_iaux.last_update_date      pdfi_last_update_date
                        , 'Intelectual'                  pdfi_nome
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_iaux
                    WHERE pdf_iaux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_iaux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_iaux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_iaux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_iaux.category )
                      AND pdf_iaux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_iaux.category = 'SA_INT_DIS') pdfi

               , ( SELECT pdf_reaux.person_id             pdre_person_id
                        , pdf_reaux.legislation_code      pdre_legislation_code
                        , pdf_reaux.category              pdre_category
                        , pdf_reaux.description           pdre_description
                        , pdf_reaux.quota_fte             pdre_quota_fte
                        , pdf_reaux.disability_id         pdre_disability_id
                        , pdf_reaux.disclosure_date       pdre_disclosure_date
                        , pdf_reaux.accommodation_request pdre_accommodation_request
                        , pdf_reaux.self_disclosed_type   pdre_self_disclosed_type
                        , pdf_reaux.work_restriction      pdre_work_restriction
                        , pdf_reaux.last_update_date      pdre_last_update_date
                     FROM per_disabilities_f pdf_reaux
                    WHERE pdf_reaux.disability_id = (SELECT MAX(disability_id)
                                                      FROM per_disabilities_f
                                                     WHERE person_id        = pdf_reaux.person_id
                                                       AND legislation_code = pdf_reaux.legislation_code
                                                       AND status           = pdf_reaux.status
                                                       AND category         = pdf_reaux.category )
                      AND pdf_reaux.status   = 'A'
                      AND pdf_reaux.category = 'ANM_BR_REABIL') pdre
           WHERE papf.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                FROM per_all_people_f
                                               WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
             AND pplf.person_id                = papf.person_id
             AND pplf.effective_start_date     = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                                   FROM per_people_legislative_f
                                                  WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
             AND pdfa.pdfa_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdfa.pdfa_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdff.pdff_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdff.pdff_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdfm.pdfm_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdfm.pdfm_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdfr.pdfr_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdfr.pdfr_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdfv.pdfv_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdfv.pdfv_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdfi.pdfi_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdfi.pdfi_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
             AND pdre.pdre_person_id(+)       = pplf.person_id
             AND pdre.pdre_legislation_code(+)= pplf.legislation_code
              ) pdf
 WHERE pdf.person_number         = NVL(:p_person_number , pdf.person_number)
   AND pdf.pdf_last_update_date  IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pdf.pdfa_category
       , pdf.pdff_category
       , pdf.pdfm_category
       , pdf.pdfr_category
       , pdf.pdfv_category
       , pdf.pdfi_category
       , pdf.pdre_category
       , pdf.pdfa_nome
       , pdf.pdff_nome
       , pdf.pdfm_nome
       , pdf.pdfr_nome
       , pdf.pdfv_nome
       , pdf.pdfi_nome
       , pdf.person_number
       , pdf.pdfa_person_id
       , pdf.pdfa_description
       , pdf.pdff_person_id
       , pdf.pdff_description
       , pdf.pdfm_person_id
       , pdf.pdfm_description
       , pdf.pdfr_person_id
       , pdf.pdfr_description
       , pdf.pdfv_person_id
       , pdf.pdfv_description
       , pdf.pdfi_person_id
       , pdf.pdfi_description
       , pdf.pdre_person_id
       , pdf.pdre_description
       , pdf.pdf_last_update_date
HAVING pdf.pdf_last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date , pdf.pdf_last_update_date)
```

### Query #107

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , cs.salary_amount ,
                TO_CHAR(cs.date_from, 'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_FROM , cs.salary_reason_code , csb.NAME AS SALARY_BASIS_NAME
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , CMP_SALARY cs ,
     CMP_SALARY_BASES csb
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND cs.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = cs.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
  AND csb.salary_basis_id = cs.salary_basis_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #108

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , rg.national_identifier_number rg_numero ,
       rg.place_of_issue rg_orgao_emissor ,
       rg.attribute_category rg_uf_emissao ,
       rg.issue_date rg_dt_emissao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') cpf_numero ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(pis.national_identifier_number,
                         nit.national_identifier_number), '.', ''), '-', '') pis_numero ,
       NVL(pis.issue_date, nit.issue_date) pis_dt_emissao ,
       pplf.per_information1 ctps_numero ,
       pplf.per_information2 ctps_serie ,
       NVL(ctps_uf.geography_name, pplf.attribute3) ctps_uf_emissao ,
       pplf.per_information_date1 ctps_dt_emissao ,
       REPLACE(cns.national_identifier_number, ' ', '') cns_numero ,
       ric.national_identifier_number ric_numero ,
       ric.place_of_issue ric_orgao_emissor ,
       ric.attribute3 ric_uf_emissor ,
       ric.issue_date ric_data_expedicao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(rne.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') rne_numero ,
       rne.place_of_issue rne_orgao_emissor ,
       rne.attribute3 rne_uf_emissor ,
       rne.issue_date rne_dt_expedicao , REPLACE(REPLACE(oc.national_identifier_number,
                                                   '.', ''),
                                           '-', '') oc_numero ,
       oc.place_of_issue oc_orgao_emissor ,
       oc.attribute1 oc_uf_emissor ,
       oc.issue_date oc_dt_expedicao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(nit.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') nit_numero ,
       nit.place_of_issue nit_place_of_issue ,
       nit.attribute3 nit_uf_emissor ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(nit.attribute2, '.', ''), '-', '') nit_orgao_emissor ,
       nit.issue_date nit_dt_expedicao ,
       tit.numero tit_numero , tit.zona tit_zona ,
       tit.secao tit_secao ,
       tit.dt_emissao tit_dt_emissao ,
       tit.cidade tit_cidade , tit.uf tit_uf ,
       tit.issuing_country tit_issuing_country ,
       tit.issuing_location tit_issuing_location ,
       certres.numero mil_numero_cert , NULL mil_categoria , NULL mil_circunscricao , NULL mil_orgao_emissor ,
                                                                                           NULL mil_regiao ,
                                                                                                NULL mil_situacao ,
                                                                                                     GREATEST(pplf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                       NVL(rg.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(cpf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(pis.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(cns.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(ric.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(rne.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(oc.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(tit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(nit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date)) last_update_date ,
                                                                                                     pplf.legislation_code ,
                                                                                                     tit.issuing_country
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_people_legislative_f pplf , per_national_identifiers rg ,
     per_national_identifiers cpf , per_national_identifiers pis , per_national_identifiers cns ,
     per_national_identifiers ric , per_national_identifiers rne , per_national_identifiers oc ,
     per_national_identifiers nit , hz_geographies ctps_uf ,

  (SELECT hdor.person_id , hdor.document_number numero , hdor.date_from date_from ,
          hdor.date_to date_to , hdor.issuing_country issuing_country ,
          hdor.issuing_location issuing_location , hdor.issued_date dt_emissao ,
          hdor.issuing_authority issuing_authority , hdor.dei_information1 zona , hdor.dei_information2 secao ,
          hgct.geography_name cidade , hguf.geography_name uf , hdor.last_update_date last_update_date
   FROM hr_documents_of_record hdor , hz_geographies hgct , hz_geographies hguf
   WHERE hdor.dei_information_category = 'ORA_HRX_BR_ELECTORAL_CARD'
     AND hgct.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number2
     AND hguf.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number3) tit ,

  (SELECT hdor.person_id , hdor.document_number numero , hdor.date_from date_from ,
          hdor.date_to date_to , hdor.issuing_country issuing_country ,
          hdor.issuing_location issuing_location , hdor.issued_date dt_emissao ,
          hdor.issuing_authority issuing_authority , hdor.dei_information1 zona , hdor.dei_information2 secao ,
          hgct.geography_name cidade , hguf.geography_name uf , hdor.last_update_date last_update_date
   FROM hr_documents_of_record hdor , hz_geographies hgct , hz_geographies hguf
   WHERE hdor.dei_information_category = 'ORA_HRX_BR_MILITARY_CERTIFICATE'
     AND hgct.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number2
     AND hguf.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number3) certres
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND ctps_uf.geography_id(+) = pplf.per_information_number1
  AND rg.national_identifier_type(+) = 'RG'
  AND rg.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND rg.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND cpf.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
  AND cpf.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND cpf.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND pis.national_identifier_type(+) = 'PIS'
  AND pis.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND pis.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND cns.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_CNS'
  AND cns.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND cns.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND ric.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_RIC'
  AND ric.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND ric.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND rne.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_RNE'
  AND rne.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND rne.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND oc.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_OC'
  AND oc.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND oc.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND nit.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_NIT'
  AND nit.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND nit.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND tit.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND certres.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST (pplf.last_update_date ,
         NVL(rg.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(cpf.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(pis.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(cns.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(ric.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(rne.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(oc.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(nit.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(tit.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date)) >= NVL (:p_integration_date,
                                                                                              GREATEST(pplf.last_update_date ,

                                                                                                NVL(rg.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(cpf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(pis.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(cns.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(ric.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(rne.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(oc.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(tit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(nit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date)))
```

### Query #110

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pam.ASSIGNMENT_ID, pam.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, pam.PERSON_ID, ppf.PERSON_NUMBER,
                ppnf.FULL_NAME, ppf.START_DATE, bu.NAME
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M pam
INNER JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F ppf ON ppf.PERSON_ID = PAM.PERSON_ID
AND TO_CHAR(ppf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
INNER JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea ON pea.PERSON_ID = PPF.PERSON_ID
AND NOT EXISTS
  (SELECT peanot.EMAIL_TYPE
   FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES peanot
   WHERE pea.PERSON_ID = peanot.PERSON_ID
     AND peanot.EMAIL_TYPE = 'W1')
INNER JOIN HR_ORGANIZATION_V bu ON bu.ORGANIZATION_ID = PAM.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
AND bu.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
INNER JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf ON ppf.PERSON_ID = ppnf.PERSON_ID
AND ppnf.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
INNER JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL pptl ON pptl.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pam.PERSON_TYPE_ID
AND pptl.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
WHERE 1=1
  AND pam.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND SUBSTR(pam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(pam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND pam.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE', 'REHIRE', 'HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION','ADD_ASSIGN')
  AND pptl.user_person_type != 'Autônomo RPA'
  AND pam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                pam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #111

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,
                                   'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START ,
       ppos.attribute11 TIPOESTABILIDADE , ppos.attribute_date15 FIM ,
       ppos.attribute_date14 INICIO , ppos.attribute30 MOTIVOESTABILIDADE
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov ,
     PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL
  AND ppos.date_start =
    (SELECT MAX(date_start)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE person_id(+) = ppos.person_id)
  AND hov.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #113

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.creation_date , paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       paam.effective_end_date , paam.action_code , paam.reason_code , paam.assignment_status_type ,
       paam.assignment_type , paam_old.assignment_number old_assignment_number ,
       paam_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date , paam_old.effective_end_date old_effective_end_date ,
       paam_old.action_code old_action_code , paam_old.reason_code old_reason_code ,
       paam_old.assignment_status_type old_assignment_status_type , paam_old.assignment_type old_assignment_type ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute27, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_assignments_m paam_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code IN ('ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL', 'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL_PROMO',
                           'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL_MERIT')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam_old.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam_old.action_code = 'DESL_PARA_GLOBAL_TRANSF'
  AND paam_old.assignment_status_type = 'INACTIVE'
  AND paam_old.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam_old.effective_start_date = paam.effective_start_date
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                            paam.effective_start_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                             TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR (NVL(paam.ass_attribute27, 'Y') = 'Y'
           AND paam.creation_date > paam.effective_start_date))
```

### Query #115

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_id , paam.assignment_number ,
       paam.action_code , paam.creation_date , pptl.user_person_type , bank.bank_account_num ,
       GREATEST(paam.last_update_date,
         NVL(bank.last_update_date, paam.last_update_date)) last_update_date
FROM per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT ppr.person_id , prgd.assignment_id , MIN(pba.bank_account_num) bank_account_num ,
          GREATEST(MAX(pba.account_last_update_date),
            MAX(ppr.last_update_date), max(ppp.last_update_date),
            MAX(prgd.last_update_date)) last_update_date
   FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn ppr , pay_person_pay_methods_f ppp , pay_bank_accounts pba ,
        pay_rel_groups_dn prgd
   WHERE ppp.payroll_relationship_id = ppr.payroll_relationship_id
     AND pba.bank_account_id = ppp.bank_account_id
     AND prgd.payroll_relationship_id = ppp.payroll_relationship_id
     AND prgd.group_type = 'A'
   GROUP BY ppr.person_id, prgd.assignment_id) bank
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) = 'E'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.action_code IN ('HIRE','REHIRE', 'ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION')
  AND paam.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND bank.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND bank.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN 'Y'
           WHEN UPPER(pptl.user_person_type) <> UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                AND bank.bank_account_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END) = 'Y'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(paam.last_update_date, NVL(bank.last_update_date,
                                        paam.last_update_date)) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                     GREATEST(paam.last_update_date,

                                                                       NVL(bank.last_update_date,

                                                                         paam.last_update_date)))
```

### Query #116

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       NVL(paam.reason_code, 'ALT_CAD') reason_code , paam.ass_attribute5 cod_horario ,
       paam.old_ass_attribute5 cod_horario_ant , paam.full_part_time tempo_parcial ,
       paam.old_full_part_time tempo_parcial_ant , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos_old.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada_ant ,
       (NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute_number2, 0) - NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2,
                                                   0)) * 60 hora , paam.effective_start_date ,
       GREATEST(paam.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) last_update_date ,
       CASE
           WHEN sind.internal_address_line IN ('MG_SAAE', 'MG_SAAESUL','MG_SAAETMA')
                AND NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 < NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute_number2,
                                                                0) * 60 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS proc_lancto_externo , NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,
                                      'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.person_id old_person_id ,
          assi_old.period_of_service_id old_period_of_service_id , assi_old.ass_attribute5 old_ass_attribute5 ,
          assi_old.full_part_time old_full_part_time , assi_old.ass_attribute_number2 old_ass_attribute_number2 ,
          assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date , assi_old.reason_code old_reason_code ,
          assi_old.job_id old_job_id ,assi_old.effective_start_date old_str_date
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND ((assi.effective_sequence = 1
                                                      AND assi_old.effective_start_date =
                                                        (SELECT max(x.effective_start_date)
                                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m x
                                                         WHERE x.assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                           AND x.effective_start_date < assi.effective_start_date)
                                                      AND assi_old.effective_sequence =
                                                        (SELECT max(x.effective_sequence)
                                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m x
                                                         WHERE x.assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                           AND x.effective_start_date = assi_old.effective_start_date))
                                                     OR (assi.effective_sequence > 1
                                                         AND assi_old.effective_start_date = assi.effective_start_date
                                                         AND assi_old.effective_sequence =
                                                           (SELECT max(x.effective_sequence)
                                                            FROM per_all_assignments_m x
                                                            WHERE x.assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                              AND x.effective_start_date = assi.effective_start_date
                                                              AND x.effective_sequence < assi.effective_sequence))))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_periods_of_service ppos_old ,
     hr_organization_v sind , PER_JOBS_F JOB , PER_JOBS_F OLD_JOB
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'DESL_PARA_GLOBAL_TRANSF',
                               'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL','RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION',
                               'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG','ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO','ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_PROMO')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos_old.period_of_service_id(+) = paam.old_period_of_service_id
  AND ppos_old.person_id(+) = paam.old_person_id
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND paam.job_id = job.job_id
  AND to_char(job.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND paam.old_job_id = old_job.job_id
  AND to_char(old_job.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND (paam.ass_attribute5 <> NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute5,
                                paam.ass_attribute5)
       OR paam.full_part_time <> NVL(paam.old_full_part_time,
                                   paam.full_part_time)
       OR ppos.pds_information8 <> NVL(ppos_old.pds_information8,
                                     ppos.pds_information8)
       OR job.attribute3 <> NVL(old_job.attribute3, job.attribute3)
       OR (NVL(paam.ass_attribute44, 'N') = 'Y'
           AND paam.effective_start_date >= :p_integration_date))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND (paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                       paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                    TRUNC(SYSDATE+1))
       OR (NVL(paam.ass_attribute44, 'N') = 'Y'))
```

```sql
SELECT pjf.job_id , pjf.job_code ,

       jff.job_family_code , jfm.job_family_name , eval.evaluation_system hay_points ,
       pjf.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY Grade , CASE pjf.ATTRIBUTE5 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N'
                                      END Rem_Varivel ,
       CASE pjf.ATTRIBUTE2 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N'
       END Risco ,
       CASE pjf.ATTRIBUTE3 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N'
       END Eleg_Ponto , pjf.ATTRIBUTE6 Agente_Pedag ,
       CASE pjf.ATTRIBUTE7 WHEN '30%' THEN '30' WHEN 'Nenhuma' THEN '0'
       END Periculosidade ,
       CASE pjf.ATTRIBUTE8 WHEN 'Grau Máximo' THEN '40' WHEN 'Grau Médio' THEN '20' WHEN 'Grau Mínimo' THEN '10' WHEN 'Nenhuma' THEN '0'
       END Insalubridade , pjf.ATTRIBUTE9 Apos_Especial , pjf.effective_start_date ,
       pjf.effective_end_date , pjf.created_by , pjf.creation_date ,

   FROM per_job_evaluations pje

       (SELECT MAX(pje2.date_evaluated)
        FROM per_job_evaluations pje2
        WHERE pje2.job_id = pje.job_id)) eval
WHERE pjf.effective_end_date = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',

  AND pjftl.job_id = pjf.job_id

  AND pjftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjlf.job_id(+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjlf.information_category(+)= 'ORA_HRX_BR_JOBS'
  AND pjlf.legislation_code(+) = 'BR'
  AND jff.job_family_id(+) = pjf.job_family_id
  AND jfm.job_family_id(+) = pjf.job_family_id
  AND jfm.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND eval.job_id(+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_code = NVL(:p_job_code, pjf.job_code)
  AND GREATEST(pjf.last_update_date,

        NVL(jff.last_update_date, pjf.last_update_date), NVL(jfm.last_update_date,

                                                                                           pjf.last_update_date),
                                                                                         NVL(jff.last_update_date,

                                                                                           pjf.last_update_date),
                                                                                         NVL(jfm.last_update_date,
```

### Query #120

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER PERSONNUMBER_FUNC, PPNF.FULL_NAME NOME_FUNC,
       PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER CHAPA_FUNC, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE STATUS_FUNC,
       PAPF_S.PERSON_NUMBER PERSONNUMBER_GESTOR, PPNF_S.FULL_NAME NOME_GESTOR,
       PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER CHAPA_GESTOR, PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE STATUS_GESTOR,
       CASE
           WHEN PAAM_S.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE','REHIRE','ADD_CWK_APZ','ADD_CWK',
                                       'ADD_CWK-ESTAG','ADD_ASSIGN')
                AND TRUNC(PAAM_S.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                         'DD/MM/YYYY') THEN TO_CHAR(PPOS.DATE_START,

                                                                              'DD/MM/YYYY') ELSE ''
       END DATA_ADMISSAO_GESTOR, TO_CHAR(PPOS.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE,
                                   'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_DEMISSAO_GESTOR,
       DEPTO.NAME DEPTO_NAME, DEPTO.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE DEPTO_CODE
FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM,
     PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF_S, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_S,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM_S, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS, HR_ORGANIZATION_V DEPTO
WHERE PAPF.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID
  AND PASF.MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND PASF.MANAGER_ID = PAPF_S.PERSON_ID
  AND PAPF_S.PERSON_ID = PPNF_S.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF_S.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PPNF_S.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF_S.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PAPF_S.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PAPF_S.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN PAAM_S.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PAAM_S.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PPOS.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = PAAM_S.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND DEPTO.ORGANIZATION_ID = PAAM.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND DEPTO.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND DEPTO.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE IS NOT NULL
  AND PASF.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 PASF.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
  AND PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                   PAAM_S.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND DEPTO.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE = NVL(:p_depto,
                                      DEPTO.INTERNAL_ADDRESS_LINE)
ORDER BY PPNF.FULL_NAME, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER, PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
```

### Query #121

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.creation_date , paam.last_update_date , paam.primary_flag ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute49, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , hr_organization_v hov , hr_organization_v org ,
     hr_organization_v sind , cmp_salary cs
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL' , 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY' , 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE' ,
                           'ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO' , 'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO' ,
                           'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_PROMO')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND hov.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.establishment_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND org.classification_code = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND org.status = 'A'
  AND org.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN org.effective_start_date AND org.effective_end_date
  AND org.organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND sind.organization_id = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date AND sind.effective_end_date
  AND cs.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cs.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE cs.assignment_id = assignment_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND (((paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                         paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                      TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
        OR paam.ass_attribute49 = 'Y')
       AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE,
                                               'MM') AND LAST_DAY(SYSDATE))
```

### Query #122

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, HR_ORGANIZATION_V, ALTERACOES_DEPTO_CORRETO, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, ALTERACOES_DEPTO_ANTERIOR, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
WITH alteracoes_depto_correto AS
  (SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER (PARTITION BY depto.organization_id
                            ORDER BY paam.assignment_number) row_number , paam.assignment_number , pman.assignment_number matricula_lider ,
          pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , SYSDATE start_date_gestor , MAX(pasf.effective_end_date) OVER(PARTITION BY depto.organization_id) end_date_gestor ,
                                                                                                         depto.name depto_name ,
                                                                                                         depto.internal_address_line depto_code ,
                                                                                                         MAX(pasf.last_update_date) OVER(PARTITION BY depto.organization_id) last_update_date ,
                                                                                                                                    COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(pman.assignment_number,

                                                                                                                                                     '1')) OVER(PARTITION BY depto.organization_id) n_lideres ,
                                                                                                                                                           paam.effective_start_date ,
                                                                                                                                                           depto.organization_id
   FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
   JOIN per_person_types_tl pptl ON pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
   AND pptl.language = 'PTB'
   JOIN hr_organization_v depto ON depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
   AND depto.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
   AND TO_CHAR(depto.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf ON pasf.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
   AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
   AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf_old ON pasf_old.person_id = pasf.person_id
   AND pasf_old.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
   AND pasf_old.effective_end_date = (pasf.effective_start_date - 1)
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman ON pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
   AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
   AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
   AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
   WHERE 1=1
     AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND UPPER(pptl.user_person_type) NOT IN (UPPER('Autônomo RPA'), UPPER('CLT - Docente'))
     AND depto.internal_address_line = NVL(:p_depto_code,
                                         depto.internal_address_line)
     AND depto.internal_address_line NOT IN ('009.9999','999.9999')
     AND substr(pman.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
   ORDER BY depto.internal_address_line ,paam.assignment_number),
     alteracoes_depto_anterior AS
  (SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER (PARTITION BY depto_old.organization_id
                            ORDER BY paam.assignment_number) row_number , paam_depto.assignment_number ,
          pman_depto.assignment_number matricula_lider , paam.assignment_number assignment_de_quem_saiu ,
          pman_old.assignment_number lider_de_quem_saiu , pasf.assignment_id , pasf_depto.person_id , SYSDATE start_date_gestor ,
          MAX(pasf_depto.effective_end_date) OVER(PARTITION BY depto_old.organization_id) end_date_gestor , depto_old.name depto_name ,
                                             depto_old.internal_address_line depto_code , MAX(pasf.last_update_date) OVER(PARTITION BY depto_old.organization_id) last_update_date ,
                                                                                                                     COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(pman_depto.assignment_number,

                                                                                                                                      '1')) OVER(PARTITION BY depto.organization_id) n_lideres ,
                                                                                                                                            paam.effective_start_date ,
                                                                                                                                            MAX(CASE
                                                                                                                                                    WHEN pman_depto.assignment_number <> pman_old.assignment_number THEN 'S'
                                                                                                                                                    ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                END) OVER(PARTITION BY depto.organization_id) Lider_Era_Dif
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
   JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam ON paam.assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
   AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman ON pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
   AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
   AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
   LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf_old ON pasf_old.assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
   AND pasf_old.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
   AND pasf_old.effective_end_date = (pasf.effective_start_date - 1)
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman_old ON pman_old.assignment_id = pasf_old.manager_assignment_id
   AND pman_old.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND TO_CHAR(pman_old.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam_old ON paam_old.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
   AND ((paam.effective_sequence = 1
         AND paam_old.effective_start_date =
           (SELECT max(x.effective_start_date)
            FROM per_all_assignments_m x
            WHERE x.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
              AND x.effective_start_date < paam.effective_start_date)
         AND paam_old.effective_sequence =
           (SELECT max(x.effective_sequence)
            FROM per_all_assignments_m x
            WHERE x.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
              AND x.effective_start_date = paam_old.effective_start_date))
        OR (paam.effective_sequence > 1
            AND paam_old.effective_start_date = paam.effective_start_date
            AND paam_old.effective_sequence =
              (SELECT max(x.effective_sequence)
               FROM per_all_assignments_m x
               WHERE x.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
                 AND x.effective_start_date = paam.effective_start_date
                 AND x.effective_sequence < paam.effective_sequence)))
   LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto ON depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
   AND depto.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
   AND TO_CHAR(depto.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto_old ON depto_old.organization_id = paam_old.organization_id
   AND depto_old.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
   AND TO_CHAR(depto_old.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam_depto ON paam_depto.organization_id = paam_old.organization_id
   AND paam_depto.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
   AND paam_depto.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND TO_CHAR(paam_depto.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf_depto ON pasf_depto.assignment_id = paam_depto.assignment_id
   AND pasf_depto.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
   AND TO_CHAR(pasf_depto.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
   JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman_depto ON pman_depto.assignment_id = pasf_depto.manager_assignment_id
   AND pman_depto.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
   AND pman_depto.assignment_type = 'E'
   AND pasf_depto.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman_depto.effective_start_date AND pman_depto.effective_end_date
   JOIN per_person_types_tl pptl ON pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
   AND pptl.language = 'PTB'
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND UPPER(pptl.user_person_type) NOT IN (UPPER('Autônomo RPA'))
     AND pman.assignment_number <> NVL(pman_old.assignment_number, 0)
     AND depto.organization_id <> depto_old.organization_id
     AND pasf.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                    pasf.last_update_date)
     AND depto_old.internal_address_line = NVL(:p_depto_code,
                                             depto_old.internal_address_line)
     AND depto_old.internal_address_line NOT IN ('009.9999','999.9999'))
SELECT alt.matricula_lider , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(alt.matricula_lider,
                                         1, 3)) coligada_lider ,
       alt.start_date_gestor , alt.start_date_gestor - 1 AS end_date_gestor , alt.depto_name ,
       alt.depto_code , alt.last_update_date
FROM alteracoes_depto_correto alt
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND alt.row_number = 1
  AND alt.n_lideres = 1
  AND alt.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                alt.last_update_date)
  AND alt.depto_code <> '005.0003'
UNION
SELECT ant.matricula_lider , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(ant.matricula_lider,
                                         1, 3)) coligada_lider ,
       ant.start_date_gestor , ant.start_date_gestor - 1 AS end_date_gestor , ant.depto_name ,
       ant.depto_code , ant.last_update_date
FROM alteracoes_depto_anterior ant
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND ant.row_number = 1
  AND ant.n_lideres = 1
  AND ant.lider_era_dif = 'S'
  AND ant.depto_code <> '005.0003'
```

### Query #123

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pman.assignment_number matricula_lider ,
       pman_old.assignment_number matricula_lider_anterior , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id ,
       pasf.effective_start_date start_date_gestor , pasf.effective_end_date end_date_gestor , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , depto_old.name depto_anterior_name ,
       depto_old.internal_address_line depto_anterior_code , pasf.last_update_date , paam.effective_start_date
FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
JOIN per_all_people_f papf ON papf.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman ON pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf_old ON pasf_old.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND pasf_old.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
AND pasf_old.effective_end_date = (pasf.effective_start_date - 1)
LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman_old ON pman_old.assignment_id = pasf_old.manager_assignment_id
AND pman_old.person_id = pasf_old.manager_id
AND pman_old.assignment_type = 'E'
AND TO_CHAR(pman_old.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam ON paam.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND paam.assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM_OLD ON PAAM_OLD.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND ((PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE = 1
      AND PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
        (SELECT max(x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
         FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M x
         WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
           AND x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE < PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
      AND PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE =
        (SELECT max(x.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE)
         FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M x
         WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
           AND x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE))
     OR (PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE > 1
         AND PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
           (SELECT max(x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
            FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M x
            WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
              AND x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
         AND PAAM_OLD.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE =
           (SELECT max(x.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE)
            FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M x
            WHERE x.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
              AND x.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
              AND x.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE < PAAM.EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE)))
LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto ON depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
AND depto.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date AND depto.effective_end_date
LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto_old ON depto_old.organization_id = paam_old.organization_id
AND depto_old.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
AND paam_old.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto_old.effective_start_date AND depto_old.effective_end_date
WHERE 1=1
  AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND depto.organization_id = depto_old.organization_id
  AND pasf.manager_assignment_id <> NVL(pasf_old.manager_assignment_id, 0)
  AND pasf.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 pasf.last_update_date)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
```

### Query #124

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , paam.ass_attribute8 modelo_trabalho ,
       paam.old_ass_attribute8 modelo_trabalho_ant , paam.effective_start_date , le.le_organization_code ,
       le_old.le_organization_code le_organization_code_ant , paam.last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.legal_entity_id old_legal_entity_id ,
          assi_old.ass_attribute8 old_ass_attribute8 , assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.effective_end_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND effective_end_date < assi.effective_end_date))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND le_old.le_organization_id(+) = paam.old_legal_entity_id
  AND (paam.ass_attribute8 <> NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute8,
                                paam.ass_attribute8)
       OR paam.action_code = 'HIRE')
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
```

### Query #127

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(pcrf.cont_attribute_number20) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(pcrf.cont_attribute_number20)
       END AS max_cont20, papf.person_number
FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrf
JOIN per_all_people_f papf ON papf.person_id = pcrf.person_id
JOIN per_all_people_f papfd ON papfd.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
JOIN per_persons pp ON pp.person_id = papfd.person_id
JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam ON paam.person_id = pcrf.person_id
WHERE pcrf.contact_type <> 'EMRG'
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papfd.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND pp.start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(start_date)
     FROM per_persons
     WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
GROUP BY papf.person_number
```

### Query #129

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ANC_ABSENCE_TYPES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES`

```sql
WITH DADOS AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT APAE.PERSON_ID, APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER
   FROM ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES APAE, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, ANC_ABSENCE_TYPES_F AATF,
        PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
   WHERE APAE.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
     AND APAE.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= :P_END_DATE
     AND PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER = NVL(:P_PERSON_NUMBER, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER)
     AND TO_CHAR(PAPF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
     AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN ('INACTIVE')
     AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
     AND AATF.ABSENCE_TYPE_ID = APAE.ABSENCE_TYPE_ID
     AND AATF.BASE_NAME = 'ATESTADO MÉDICO (DURAÇÃO MENOR QUE 15 DIAS)_BR'
     AND AATF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM ANC_ABSENCE_TYPES_F
        WHERE ABSENCE_TYPE_ID = AATF.ABSENCE_TYPE_ID))
SELECT X.person_number, SUM(X.soma_dias_afastamento) AS soma_dias_afastamento,
       X.dataInicialPeriodo, X.datafinalPeriodo
FROM
  (SELECT papf.person_number, apae.duration soma_dias_afastamento,

     (SELECT (MAX(Z.START_DATE) - 60)
      FROM ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES Z
      WHERE Z.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
        AND Z.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
        AND Z.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
        AND Z.DURATION <= 15) dataInicialPeriodo,

     (SELECT MAX(Z.START_DATE)
      FROM ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES Z
      WHERE Z.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
        AND Z.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
        AND Z.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
        AND Z.DURATION <= 15) datafinalPeriodo
   FROM per_all_people_f papf, anc_absence_types_f aatf, anc_per_abs_entries apae, DADOS D
   WHERE PAPF.PERSON_ID = D.PERSON_ID
     AND papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
     AND apae.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND apae.approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
     AND apae.absence_status_cd <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
     AND apae.duration <= 15
     AND aatf.absence_type_id = apae.absence_type_id
     AND aatf.base_name = 'ATESTADO MÉDICO (DURAÇÃO MENOR QUE 15 DIAS)_BR'
     AND aatf.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM anc_absence_types_f
        WHERE absence_type_id = aatf.absence_type_id)
     AND apae.start_date >=
       (SELECT (MAX(Z.START_DATE) - 60)
        FROM ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES Z
        WHERE Z.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
          AND Z.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
          AND Z.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
          AND Z.DURATION <= 15)
     AND apae.start_date <=
       (SELECT MAX(Z.START_DATE)
        FROM ANC_PER_ABS_ENTRIES Z
        WHERE Z.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
          AND Z.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
          AND Z.ABSENCE_STATUS_CD <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
          AND Z.DURATION <= 15)) X
GROUP BY X.person_number, X.dataInicialPeriodo, X.datafinalPeriodo
HAVING SUM(X.soma_dias_afastamento) > 15
```
