### Query #130

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_DISABILITIES_F, PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PERSON_ADDR_USAGES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN...`

```sql
SELECT dadospes.person_number , dadospes.last_update_date , SYSDATE referencia_folha
FROM
  (SELECT papf.person_id , papf.person_number ,
          GREATEST(papf.last_update_date ,
            ppnf.last_update_date , pp.last_update_date , pplf.last_update_date ,
            NVL(pe.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(pdl.last_update_date,

                                                                papf.last_update_date) ,
            NVL(pass.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(pdf.last_update_date,

                                                                  papf.last_update_date) ,
            NVL(pni.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(tel.last_update_date,

                                                                 papf.last_update_date) ,
            NVL(email.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(email_alt.last_update_date,

                                                                   papf.last_update_date) ,
            NVL(addr.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date) , NVL(bank.last_update_date,

                                                                  papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date , SYSDATE referencia_folha
   FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_person_names_f ppnf , per_persons pp ,
        per_people_legislative_f pplf , per_ethnicities pe , per_drivers_licenses pdl ,
        per_passports pass ,

     (SELECT person_id , max(last_update_date) last_update_date
      FROM per_disabilities_f
      WHERE 1=1
      GROUP BY person_id) pdf ,

     (SELECT person_id , max(last_update_date) last_update_date
      FROM per_national_identifiers
      WHERE legislation_code = 'BR'
        AND national_identifier_type IN ('RG','ORA_HRX_RIC','CPF','PIS','ORA_HRX_RNE',
                                         'ORA_HRX_OC')
      GROUP BY person_id) pni ,

     (SELECT papf.person_id ,
             TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.area_code, '0'), 1, 2), 2, '0')) mobile_area ,
             TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone1.phone_number, '0'), 1, 9), 9, '0')) mobile_number ,
             CASE
                 WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.area_code,
                                                                                 '0'),
                                                                          1, 2),
                                                                     2, '0')) ELSE NULL
             END AS home_phone_area ,
             CASE
                 WHEN telefone2.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone2.phone_number,
                                                                                 '0'),
                                                                          1, 9),
                                                                     9, '0')) ELSE NULL
             END AS home_phone_number ,
             CASE
                 WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.area_code,
                                                                                 '0'),
                                                                          1, 2),
                                                                     2, '0')) ELSE NULL
             END AS work_phone_area ,
             CASE
                 WHEN telefone3.phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(LPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(telefone3.phone_number,
                                                                                 '0'),
                                                                          1, 9),
                                                                     9, '0')) ELSE NULL
             END AS work_phone_number ,
             GREATEST(NVL(telefone1.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date),
               NVL(telefone2.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date),
               NVL(telefone3.last_update_date, papf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
      FROM per_all_people_f papf
      LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone1 ON papf.person_id = telefone1.person_id
      AND papf.primary_phone_id = telefone1.phone_id
      AND telefone1.date_to =
        (SELECT MAX(date_to)
         FROM per_phones
         WHERE person_id = telefone1.person_id
           AND phone_id = papf.primary_phone_id)
      LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone2 ON papf.person_id = telefone2.person_id
      AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone2.phone_id
      AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone2.date_from AND telefone2.date_to
      AND telefone2.phone_id =
        (SELECT MAX(phone_id)
         FROM per_phones
         WHERE person_id = telefone2.person_id
           AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id))
      LEFT JOIN per_phones telefone3 ON papf.person_id = telefone3.person_id
      AND papf.primary_phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
      AND telefone2.phone_id <> telefone3.phone_id
      AND SYSDATE BETWEEN telefone3.date_from AND telefone3.date_to
      AND telefone2.phone_id =
        (SELECT MAX(phone_id)
         FROM per_phones
         WHERE person_id = telefone3.person_id
           AND phone_id NOT IN (telefone1.phone_id,telefone2.phone_id))
      WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
           FROM per_all_people_f
           WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)) tel ,

     (SELECT pea.person_id , pea.last_update_date
      FROM per_email_addresses pea
      WHERE pea.email_address_id =
          (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
           FROM per_email_addresses
           WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
             AND email_type = 'W1')) email ,

     (SELECT pea.person_id , pea.last_update_date
      FROM per_email_addresses pea
      WHERE pea.email_address_id =
          (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
           FROM per_email_addresses
           WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
             AND email_type = 'H1')) email_alt ,

     (SELECT ppauf.person_id ,
             MAX(GREATEST(ppauf.last_update_date, paf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
      FROM per_person_addr_usages_f ppauf , per_addresses_f paf
      WHERE paf.address_id = ppauf.address_id
      GROUP BY ppauf.person_id) addr ,

     (SELECT ppr.person_id ,
             GREATEST(MAX(iba.last_update_date),
               MAX(ppr.last_update_date), MAX(ppp.last_update_date)) last_update_date
      FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn ppr , pay_person_pay_methods_f ppp , iby_ext_bank_accounts_v ieb ,
           iby_ext_bank_accounts iba
      WHERE ppp.payroll_relationship_id = ppr.payroll_relationship_id
        AND ieb.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL
        AND ieb.bank_account_id = ppp.bank_account_id
        AND iba.ext_bank_account_id = ieb.ext_bank_account_id
      GROUP BY ppr.person_id) bank
   WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
     AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
     AND pp.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND pp.start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(start_date)
        FROM per_persons
        WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
     AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
     AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
     AND pplf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_people_legislative_f
        WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
     AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 'x'
        FROM per_all_assignments_m paam ,per_person_types_vl pptl
        WHERE pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
          AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
          AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
          AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
          AND pptl.user_person_type != 'Pendente'
          AND paam.effective_end_date =
            (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
             FROM per_all_assignments_m
             WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
               AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
               AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type))
     AND pe.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
     AND pe.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
     AND pe.primary_flag(+) = 'Y'
     AND pdl.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND pass.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND pdf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND pni.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND tel.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND email.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND email_alt.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND addr.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
     AND bank.person_id(+) = papf.person_id) dadospes
WHERE 1=1
  AND dadospes.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number,
                                 dadospes.person_number)
  AND dadospes.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                     dadospes.last_update_date)
```

### Query #132

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code , ppos.actual_termination_date ,
       action_reasons_tl.action_reason , email_pessoal.email_address
FROM per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf , per_periods_of_service ppos ,
     per_action_occurrences action_occur , per_action_reasons_tl action_reasons_tl ,

  (SELECT pea.person_id , pea.email_address
   FROM per_email_addresses pea
   WHERE pea.email_address_id =
       (SELECT MAX(email_address_id)
        FROM per_email_addresses
        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'H1')) email_pessoal
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
  AND paam.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND email_pessoal.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND TRUNC(ppos.actual_termination_date + 1) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND action_occur.action_occurrence_id = paam.action_occurrence_id
  AND action_occur.action_reason_id = action_reasons_tl.action_reason_id
  AND action_reasons_tl.language = 'PTB'
  AND action_reasons_tl.action_reason IN ('Motivos Pessoais',
                                          'Rescisão Do Contrato De Trabalho Por Iniciativa Do Empregado - Sem Aviso',
                                          'Rescisão Do Contrato De Trabalho Por Iniciativa Do Empregado - Com Aviso', 'Solicitação do Colaborador',
                                          'Pedido pelo empregado – Imediato sem cumprimento de aviso', 'Interesse da Empresa',
                                          'Pedido pelo empregado – aviso trabalhado',
                                          'Dispensa pelo empregador – Justa causa',
                                          'Antecipação do término de contrato – dispensa pela empresa',
                                          'Término de contrato – Dispensa pela empresa',
                                          'Dispensa pela empresa – Aviso trabalhado',
                                          'Dispensa sem justa causa – Aviso indenizado', 'Admissão para preencher posição vaga',
                                          'Comum Acordo')
```

### Query #133

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , ppos.pds_information9 worker_category , paam.employee_category ,
       ppos.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial , ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
       ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R' WHEN paam.action_code = 'REHIRE' THEN 'I' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao , ppos_old.pds_information9 worker_category_ant ,
       paam.old_employee_category employee_category_ant , ppos_old.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial_ant ,
       ppos_old.pds_information2 indicador_admissao_ant , ppos_old.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada_ant ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos_old.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos_old.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R' WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'REHIRE' THEN 'I' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao_ant , paam.effective_start_date ,
       GREATEST(paam.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.person_id old_person_id ,
          assi_old.period_of_service_id old_period_of_service_id , assi_old.employee_category old_employee_category ,
          assi_old.action_code old_action_code , assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.last_update_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND last_update_date < assi.last_update_date))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_periods_of_service ppos_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos_old.period_of_service_id(+) = paam.old_period_of_service_id
  AND ppos_old.person_id(+) = paam.old_person_id
  AND (ppos.pds_information9 <> NVL(ppos_old.pds_information9,
                                  ppos.pds_information9)
       OR paam.employee_category <> NVL(paam.old_employee_category,
                                      paam.employee_category)
       OR ppos.pds_information12 <> NVL(ppos_old.pds_information12,
                                      ppos.pds_information12)
       OR ppos.pds_information2 <> NVL(ppos_old.pds_information2,
                                     ppos.pds_information2)
       OR ppos.pds_information8 <> NVL(ppos_old.pds_information8,
                                     ppos.pds_information8)
       OR CASE
              WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                   AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
              WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                   AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R' WHEN paam.action_code = 'REHIRE' THEN 'I' ELSE ''
          END <> CASE
                     WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'HIRE'
                          AND NVL(ppos_old.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
                     WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'HIRE'
                          AND NVL(ppos_old.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R' WHEN paam.old_action_code = 'REHIRE' THEN 'I' ELSE ''
                 END)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(paam.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                  GREATEST(paam.last_update_date,

                                                                    ppos.last_update_date))
```

### Query #134

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_id , paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE26 , hapf.attribute2 , PPTT.USER_PERSON_TYPE ,
                papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code assig_action_code ,
                paam.effective_start_date , paam.effective_end_date , paam.assignment_id
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , hr_all_positions_f hapf ,
     per_person_types_tl pptt
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code IN ('GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE','GLB_TRANSFER', 'PROMOTION',
                           'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'HIRE')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hapf.position_id = paam.position_id
  AND TO_CHAR(hapf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hapf.ATTRIBUTE2 IN ('N', 'Y')
  AND paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE26 != hapf.attribute2
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PPTT.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND PPTT.USER_PERSON_TYPE NOT IN ('CLT - Docente', 'Autônomo RPA')
  AND PPTT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
```

### Query #135

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT cmps.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.assignment_id ,
       pab.action_code , cmps.date_from , cmps.date_to , cmps.adjustment_percent ,
       cmps.last_update_date , cmps.salary_amount , cmps.salary_reason_code , parb.action_reason_code ,
       paam.reason_code , pptl.user_person_type , paam.hourly_salaried_code ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 jornada_mensal , paam.ass_attribute_number2 || ':00' jornada ,
       paam.effective_start_date , paam.effective_end_date , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       NVL(NVL(parb.action_reason_code, pab.action_code), paam.reason_code) mot_mudanca_salario ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '0'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '5'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '8' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_ocorrencia , NVL(paam.ass_attribute48, 'N') reprocessar_integracao
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_action_reasons_b parb , per_actions_b pab ,
     per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_percent_scale, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0)
  AND trunc(cmps.date_to) = to_date('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND cmps.date_from = NVL(:p_integration_date, cmps.date_from)
```

```sql
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id

  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'

    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND pptl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND pab.action_code NOT IN ('ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO')
  AND parb.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0

  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND cmps.date_from = NVL(:p_integration_date, cmps.date_from)
```

### Query #137

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT cmps.person_id , paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE22 , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       paam.action_code assig_action_code , paam.reason_code assig_reason_code , cmps.date_from , cmps.date_to ,
       cmps.adjustment_percent , cmps.last_update_date , cmps.salary_amount , cmps.salary_reason_code ,
       paam.effective_start_date , paam.effective_end_date , paam.assignment_id
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND trunc(cmps.date_to) = to_date('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id)
  AND TO_CHAR(NVL(paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE22, '0')) != TO_CHAR(NVL(cmps.salary_amount,
                                                           '0'))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND cmps.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.last_update_date)
```

### Query #138

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT cmps.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pab.action_code ,
       parb.action_reason_code , paam.action_code assig_action_code , paam.reason_code assig_reason_code ,
       cmps.date_from , cmps.date_to , cmps.adjustment_percent , cmps.last_update_date ,
       cmps.salary_amount , cmps.salary_reason_code , paam.effective_start_date ,
       paam.effective_end_date , NVL(paam.ass_attribute48, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao , cmps.creation_date
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_action_reasons_b parb , per_actions_b pab ,
     per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE',
                               'GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG',
                               'ANM_LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE_PROMO','ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_MRTO_PROMO',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_FILIAL_PROMO')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_percent_scale, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0)
  AND trunc(cmps.date_to) = to_date('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = CMPS.ASSIGNMENT_ID)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((cmps.date_from BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.date_from) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,
                                                       TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR (paam.ass_attribute48 = 'Y')
       OR (cmps.last_update_date BETWEEN :p_integration_date AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,
                                                                   TRUNC(SYSDATE+1))
           AND cmps.creation_date > cmps.date_from
           AND TRUNC(cmps.creation_date) = TRUNC(cmps.last_update_date)))
  AND trunc(cmps.date_from) >= to_date('01/08/2024',
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY')
```

### Query #139

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT apae.per_absence_entry_id , apae.last_update_date , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       aatf.base_name absence_base_name , aatf.attribute2 cod_tipo_atestado ,
       CASE WHEN aatf.attribute2 = '0044'
                AND apae.end_date IS NULL THEN 'P' WHEN aatf.attribute2 = '0053'
                AND apae.end_date IS NULL THEN 'T' ELSE 'A'
       END cod_situacao , TRUNC(apae.end_date + 1) hstsit_datamudanca ,
       CASE
           WHEN aatf.attribute2 = '0044'
                AND SUBSTR(NVL(apae.attribute1, '1'), 1, 3) = '1'
                AND (apae.end_date IS NULL
                     OR TRUNC(apae.end_date) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                 'DD/MM/RRRR')) THEN '06'
           WHEN aatf.attribute2 = '0044'
                AND SUBSTR(NVL(apae.attribute1, '1'), 1, 3) = '1'
                AND (apae.end_date IS NOT NULL
                     AND TRUNC(apae.end_date) != TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                                   'DD/MM/RRRR')) THEN '07'
           WHEN aatf.attribute2 = '0044'
                AND SUBSTR(NVL(apae.attribute1, '1'), 1, 3) != '1' THEN SUBSTR(NVL(apae.attribute1,

                                                                                 '1'),
                                                                          1, 3)
           WHEN aatf.attribute2 != '0044'
                AND apae.attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(NVL(apae.attribute1,
                                                              '1'),
                                                       1, 3)
           WHEN aatf.attribute2 != '0044'
                AND apae.attribute1 IS NULL THEN 'DC'
       END AS hstsit_motivo
FROM per_all_people_f papf , anc_absence_types_f aatf , anc_per_abs_entries apae ,
     per_all_assignments_m paam ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_id = apae.person_id
  AND apae.approval_status_cd ='APPROVED'
  AND apae.absence_status_cd <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
  AND apae.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND aatf.absence_type_id = apae.absence_type_id
  AND aatf.attribute2 IN ('0044','0053')
  AND paam.person_id = apae.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_id = apae.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND apae.per_absence_entry_id = NVL(:p_absence_entry_id,
                                    apae.per_absence_entry_id)
  AND apae.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 apae.last_update_date)
```

### Query #140

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL`

```sql
SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA , PPNF.FULL_NAME AS NOME_EDUCADOR ,
       LE.LE_ORGANIZATION_CODE AS EMPREGADOR_LEGAL , VINCGER.QTDE AS QTDE_VINCULOS_GERAL ,
       VINC.QTDE AS QTDE_VINCULOS_EMP_LEGAL
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ON PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
JOIN
  (SELECT X.PERSON_ID, count(*) QTDE
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
   WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(X.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND TRUNC(X.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                         'DD/MM/YYYY')
     AND X.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
   GROUP BY X.PERSON_ID) VINCGER ON VINCGER.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
JOIN
  (SELECT X.PERSON_ID, X.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID, count(*) QTDE
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
   WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(X.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND TRUNC(X.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                         'DD/MM/YYYY')
     AND X.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
   GROUP BY X.PERSON_ID, X.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID) VINC ON VINC.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
AND VINC.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = PAAM.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTL ON PPTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID
AND PPTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
JOIN
  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) LE ON LE.LE_ORGANIZATION_ID = PAAM.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
WHERE PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
  AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                  'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
```

### Query #141

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CONTRATOS`

```sql
WITH CONTRATOS AS
  (SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER AS CHAPA ,
          DECODE(PPTL.USER_PERSON_TYPE,
            'CLT - Geral', 1, 'CLT - Docente', 3, 'Autônomo RPA', 9, 2) AS PESO_VINCULO , PAAM.NORMAL_HOURS AS CARGA_HORARIA ,
          ADM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AS ADMISSAO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PAAM.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID ,
          PAAM.WORK_TERMS_ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM
   JOIN PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL PPTL ON PPTL.PERSON_TYPE_ID = PAAM.PERSON_TYPE_ID
   AND PPTL.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
   JOIN PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M ADM ON ADM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
   AND ADM.ACTION_CODE IN ('HIRE','REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION')
   WHERE PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE <> 'INACTIVE'
     AND SUBSTR(PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                     'DD/MM/YYYY')
     AND PAAM.PERSON_ID =
       (SELECT X.PERSON_ID
        FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M X
        WHERE X.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = :p_assignment_number
          AND TRUNC(X.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                              'DD/MM/YYYY'))
     AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER <> NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                     PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER))
SELECT *
FROM CONTRATOS
ORDER BY PESO_VINCULO, CARGA_HORARIA DESC, ADMISSAO FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
```

### Query #142

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number PERSON_NUMBER ,
       ppnf.full_name NOME_COMPLETO , paam.assignment_number MATRICULA ,
       hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,
                                   'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START ,
       paam.reason_code , paam.last_updated_by ,
       TO_CHAR(paam.last_update_date, 'YYYY/MM/DD') LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam ,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov
WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE ppnf.person_id = person_id
       AND ppnf.name_type = name_type)
  AND papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.date_start =
    (SELECT MAX(date_start)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE person_id(+) = ppos.person_id)
  AND hov.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
ORDER BY papf.person_number ASC
```

### Query #146

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papfemp.person_number , ppnfemp.first_name person_first_name ,
       ppnfemp.last_name person_last_name , paamemp.assignment_number person_assignment ,
       to_char(pasf.effective_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') effective_start_date ,
       to_char(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') effective_end_date , papf_mgr.person_number manager_number ,
       ppnf_mgr.first_name manager_first_name , ppnf_mgr.last_name manager_last_name ,
       paam_mgr.assignment_number manager_assignment , pasf.manager_type , pad.EMAIL_ADDRESS , pad.EMAIL_TYPE
FROM per_all_people_f papfemp , per_person_names_f ppnfemp ,
     per_all_assignments_m paamemp , per_all_people_f papf_mgr ,
     per_person_names_f ppnf_mgr , per_all_assignments_m paam_mgr ,
     per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PAD
WHERE ppnfemp.person_id = papfemp.person_id
  AND ppnfemp.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paamemp.person_id = papfemp.person_id
  AND paamemp.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C', 'N')
  AND paamemp.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
  AND paamemp.effective_start_date BETWEEN papfemp.effective_start_date AND papfemp.effective_end_date
  AND paamemp.effective_start_date BETWEEN ppnfemp.effective_start_date AND ppnfemp.effective_end_date
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN paamemp.effective_start_date AND paamemp.effective_end_date
  AND paamemp.effective_start_date BETWEEN pasf.effective_start_date AND pasf.effective_end_date
  AND ppnf_mgr.person_id = papf_mgr.person_id
  AND ppnf_mgr.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam_mgr.person_id = papf_mgr.person_id
  AND paam_mgr.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C', 'N')
  AND paam_mgr.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
  AND paam_mgr.effective_start_date BETWEEN papf_mgr.effective_start_date AND papf_mgr.effective_end_date
  AND paam_mgr.effective_start_date BETWEEN ppnf_mgr.effective_start_date AND ppnf_mgr.effective_end_date
  AND paamemp.effective_start_date BETWEEN paam_mgr.effective_start_date AND paam_mgr.effective_end_date
  AND pasf.person_id = papfemp.person_id
  AND pasf.assignment_id = paamemp.assignment_id
  AND pasf.manager_id = papf_mgr.person_id
  AND pasf.manager_assignment_id = paam_mgr.assignment_id
  AND pad.PERSON_ID = papf_mgr.person_id
  AND papfemp.person_number = :p_person_number
  AND sysdate BETWEEN DATE_FROM AND DATE_to
  AND pad.email_type = 'W1'
```

### Query #147

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number, ppnf.display_name AS nome
FROM
  (SELECT person_id, person_number,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM per_all_people_f
   WHERE (:p_person_number IS NULL
          OR UPPER(person_number) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:p_person_number) || '%')) papf
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id, display_name,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND (:p_person_name IS NULL
          OR UPPER(display_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:p_person_name) || '%')) ppnf ON (papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
                                                                                     AND ppnf.rn = 1)
JOIN
  (SELECT person_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                             ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E') paam ON (papf.person_id = paam.person_id
                                                          AND paam.rn = 1)
WHERE papf.rn = 1
  AND rownum < 50
ORDER BY papf.person_number, nome
```

### Query #148

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_EXTRA_INFO_M, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , paam.effective_start_date , paam_adia.last_update_date
FROM per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_all_people_f papf
WHERE paam_adia.information_type = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION')
  AND paam.assignment_id = paam_adia.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam_adia.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                      paam_adia.last_update_date)
ORDER BY paam_adia.last_update_date
```

### Query #149

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,
                                   'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START ,
       ppos.attribute11 TIPOESTABILIDADE , ppos.attribute_date15 FIM ,
       ppos.attribute_date14 INICIO , ppos.attribute30 MOTIVOESTABILIDADE ,
       paam.effective_start_date , ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID , paam.assignment_id ,
       paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE25 campo_auxiliar , paam.effective_end_date , paam.assignment_status_type
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov ,
     PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL
  AND ppos.date_start =
    (SELECT MAX(date_start)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE person_id = ppos.person_id
       AND PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID)
  AND hov.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND ((:p_person_number IS NOT NULL
        AND NVL(:p_integration_date, ppos.attribute_date15) = ppos.attribute_date15)
       OR (:p_person_number IS NULL
           AND TO_CHAR(ppos.attribute_date15, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1,
                                                                'DD/MM/YYYY')))
  AND ppos.attribute11 IS NOT NULL
```

### Query #150

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V`

```sql
SELECT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,
         'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_INICIO , paam.normal_hours ,
       PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO ,
       PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASSIGNMENT_ID ,
       to_char(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') SALARIO ,
       to_char(CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AUMENTO_SALARIAL ,
       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
         'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
       TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
       LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 CIDADE_ESTADO ,
       CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
       END AS TIPO_CARTA ,
       CASE PAAM.HOURLY_SALARIED_CODE WHEN 'S' THEN 'MONTHLY' WHEN 'H' THEN 'HOURLY' ELSE 'ANIMA'
       END AS TIPO_SALARIO
FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ,
     CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID , PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER , PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)) GESTOR , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PAAM.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID(+) = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.ASSIGNMENT_ID(+) = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.DATE_TO = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND POS.POSITION_ID = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
     WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = :p_assignment_number
```

### Query #151

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(PL_TYP.NAME) "Tipo de Benefício" , UPPER(PL.NAME) "Categoria do Benefício" ,
                UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) "Descrição do Benefício" , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
FROM BEN_PL_TYP_F PL_TYP, BEN_PL_F PL, BEN_ELIG_PER_F FACT, BEN_OPT_F BOF_OPT, BEN_ELIG_PER_OPT_F OPT,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF
WHERE PL_TYP.PL_TYP_ID = PL.PL_TYP_ID
  AND FACT.PL_ID = PL.PL_ID
  AND FACT.ELIG_PER_ID = OPT.ELIG_PER_ID
  AND FACT.PER_IN_LER_ID = OPT.PER_IN_LER_ID
  AND OPT.OPT_ID = BOF_OPT.OPT_ID
  AND OPT.ELIG_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(FACT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID)
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
     FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID)
  AND PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER = NVL(:p_person_number, PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%NÃO DESEJO%'
  AND UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%CANCELAR%'
ORDER BY "Tipo de Benefício", "Categoria do Benefício", "Descrição do Benefício"
```

### Query #152

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V`

```sql
SELECT TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,

       PPN.FULL_NAME NOME_COMPLETO , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NAME CARGO ,
       to_char(CS.SALARY_AMOUNT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') SALARIO ,
       to_char(CS.ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') AUMENTO_SALARIAL ,
       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
         'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO ,
       TO_CHAR(PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') LAST_UPDATE_DATE , GESTOR.display_name MANAGER_NAME , PAPF.PERSON_NUMBER ,
       LOC.TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || LOC.REGION_2 CIDADE_ESTADO , CS.SALARY_BASIS_CODE TIPO_SALARIO ,
       CASE SUBSTR(POS.ATTRIBUTE8, 9, 3) WHEN 'MDC' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '016' THEN 'INSPIRALI' WHEN '019' THEN 'INSPIRALI' ELSE 'ANIMA'
       END AS TIPO_CARTA , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF ,
     CMP_SALARY CS , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC ,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID , PASF.ASSIGNMENT_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER , PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN PASF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)) GESTOR , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE PAAM.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND ASSIGNMENT_ID = paam.ASSIGNMENT_ID
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID(+) = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND GESTOR.ASSIGNMENT_ID(+) = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
  AND CS.ASSIGNMENT_ID = PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID
  AND CS.DATE_TO = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND LOC.LOCATION_ID = PAAM.LOCATION_ID
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN LOC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
  AND POS.POSITION_ID (+) = PAAM.POSITION_ID
  AND NVL(POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) = NVL(
                                                            (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
                                                             FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
                                                             WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
                                                               AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= SYSDATE), TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER)
  AND TRUNC(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) = TRUNC(:p_effective_start_date)
```

### Query #153

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT TO_CHAR(paam.effective_start_date,
         'fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') data_inicio , paam.normal_hours , ppnf.full_name nome_completo , jobs.name cargo ,
       to_char(cmps.salary_amount,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') salario ,
       to_char(cmps.adjustment_percent,
         'FM999G999G999D90', 'nls_numeric_characters='',.''') aumento_salarial ,
       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
         'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') data_documento ,
       TO_CHAR(paam.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') last_update_date , gestor.display_name manager_name , papf.person_number ,
       loc.town_or_city || ' - ' || loc.region_2 cidade_estado , papf.person_id ,paam.assignment_id
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_person_names_f ppnf ,
     per_periods_of_service ppos , cmp_salary cmps , per_jobs_f_tl jobs ,
     hr_locations_all_f_vl loc ,

  (SELECT ppnf.display_name , pasf.person_id , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,
          pasf.effective_end_date
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_all_assignments_m pman , per_person_names_f ppnf
   WHERE pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND ppnf.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT max(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
     AND pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
     AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND pman.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date) gestor
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND jobs.job_id = paam.job_id
  AND jobs.language = 'PTB'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN jobs.effective_start_date AND jobs.effective_end_date
  AND gestor.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND gestor.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN gestor.effective_start_date AND gestor.effective_end_date
  AND loc.location_id = paam.location_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN loc.effective_start_date AND loc.effective_end_date
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = :p_assignment_number
```

### Query #154

### Query #155

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       paam.reason_code , pjf.job_code , pjf_old.job_code job_code_ant , paam.effective_start_date ,
       paam.last_update_date , NVL(paam.ass_attribute45, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.job_id old_job_id ,
          assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.last_update_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND last_update_date < assi.last_update_date))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND SUBSTR(assi.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
     AND assi.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assi.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
          AND person_id = assi.person_id)) paam , per_jobs_f pjf , per_jobs_f pjf_old
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'DESL_PARA_GLOBAL_TRANSF',
                               'ADMISSAO_TRANSFER_GLOBAL','RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION',
                               'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND pjf_old.job_id(+) = paam.old_job_id
  AND paam.old_effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf_old.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf_old.effective_end_date(+)
  AND (pjf.job_code <> NVL(pjf_old.job_code, pjf.job_code))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
```

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , pptl.user_person_type , paam.assignment_id ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       CASE WHEN paam.effective_start_date < sysdate THEN sysdate ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END processo_irrestrito_date , paam.effective_end_date , ppos.period_of_service_id , paam.normal_hours ,
       paam.employment_category , paam.employee_category , paam.hourly_salaried_code ,
       paam.assignment_status_type , paam.assignment_status_type_id , paam.assignment_type ,
       SUBSTR(paam.ass_attribute5, 1, INSTR(paam.ass_attribute5,
                                        ' - ')-1) escala_trabalho , paam.last_update_date , paam.creation_date , paam.category_code ,
       paam.action_code , paam.reason_code ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 jornada_mensal , paam.ass_attribute_number2 || ':00' jornada ,
       paam.establishment_id , estab.name nome_estab ,
       SUBSTR(estab.name, 1, INSTR(estab.name, ' - ')-1) cod_estab ,
       CASE WHEN paam_apos.aei_attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END aposentado ,
       paam_apos.aei_information_date1 data_aposentadoria ,
       paam_apos.aei_attribute1 tipo_aposentadoria ,
       CASE WHEN paam.primary_flag = 'Y' THEN ppos.date_start ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END AS date_start ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute24, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END prazo_contrato ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.ass_attribute_date1 = paam.date_probation_end THEN paam.ass_attribute_date4 ELSE paam.date_probation_end
       END fim_prazo_contrato ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute24, 'N') = 'N' THEN paam.ass_attribute_date1 ELSE NVL(ppos.attribute_date1,

                                                                                          paam.ass_attribute_date4)
       END fim_prazo_contrato_2 , NVL(ppos.attribute5,
                                    'Não Optante') contribuicao_sindical ,
       ppos.pds_information9 worker_category , ppos.pds_information7 tipo_regime_prev ,
       ppos.pds_information3 num_proc_judicial , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos.pds_information10 tipo_contrato_prazo , ppos.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial ,
       ppos.attribute6 area_atuacao_estagio , ppos.attribute_number2 numero_apolice_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute_date1 data_prev_fim_estagio , ppos.attribute2 instituicao_ensino_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute15 natureza_estagio , ppos.attribute16 nivel_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute17 cod_instituicao_estagio , REPLACE(REPLACE(ppos.attribute14,
                                                            '.', ''),
                                                    '-', '') cpf_coord_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute13 nome_coord_estagio , ppos.pds_information5 primeiro_emprego ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R'
           WHEN paam.action_code IN ('REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION') THEN 'R' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao , paam.full_part_time , paam.ass_attribute11 multiplos_vinculos ,
       CASE WHEN ppos.attribute11 IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
       END AS membro_cipa , pjf.job_code , pj.name job_name ,
       pjf.attribute2 job_risco_flag , cmps.salary_amount ,
       depto.organization_id depto_id , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , sind.organization_id sind_id ,
       sind.name sind_name , sind.internal_address_line sind_code ,
       paam.legal_entity_id , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       matr.ext_identifier_number cod_pessoa_rm ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '0'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '5'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '8' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_ocorrencia ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam_adia.aei_attribute1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END AS percent_adiant ,
       CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '0' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_col_fornecedor ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN LPAD(regexp_replace(paam.ass_attribute16,

                                                                                 '[^0-9]+',
                                                                                 ''),
                                                                            7, 0) ELSE ''
       END AS cod_fornecedor , paam_aiss.aei_attribute2 aliquota_iss ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                   '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18 ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,

                                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
       END AS cod_ccusto , 'P' cod_recebimento , '0' nro_dep_irrf , '0' nro_dep_sal_fam , '0' ajuda_custo ,
                                                                                              '0' arredondamento ,
                                                                                                  '1' ind_inicio_hor ,
                                                                                                      '1' reg_atual ,
                                                                                                          '50' periodo_rescisao ,

  (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
     AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
     AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date) qtde_vinculos ,
                                                                                                               mngr.matricula_lider ,
                                                                                                               paam.primary_flag ,
                                                                                                               pap.attribute11 insalubridade ,
                                                                                                               pap.attribute12 periculosidade ,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '5900'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0210'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0201'
                                                                                                                   ELSE ''
                                                                                                               END AS cod_evento ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information6 tipo_regime_trabalhista ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute15,

                                                                                                                 'N') necessita_usuario_acesso ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,

                                                                                                                 'N') rephorariotrabalho ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute45,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovcargo ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute46,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovccusto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute47,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovdepartamento ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(paam.ass_attribute14,

                                                                                                                 '0 - De acordo com o cargo',
                                                                                                                 DECODE(pjf.attribute3,

                                                                                                                   'Y',
                                                                                                                   '1' ,
                                                                                                                   'N',
                                                                                                                   '0') ,
                                                                                                                 '1 - Exceção - Sim (sempre bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '1' ,
                                                                                                                 '2 - Exceção - Não (nunca bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '0') utiliza_ponto
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia ,
     per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_aiss ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     per_jobs pj , cmp_salary cmps , hr_organization_v depto ,
     hr_organization_v estab , hr_organization_v sind , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT peai.person_id , peai.assignment_id , peai.ext_identifier_number
   FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
   WHERE peai.date_to IS NULL
     AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
     AND peai.ext_identifier_seq =
       (SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
        FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
        WHERE person_id = peai.person_id
          AND assignment_id = peai.assignment_id
          AND ext_identifier_type = peai.ext_identifier_type)) matr ,

  (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,
          pasf.effective_end_date
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_all_assignments_m pman
   WHERE pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
     AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
     AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date) mngr
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND paam_adia.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_adia.information_type(+) = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND paam_apos.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_apos.information_type(+) = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
  AND paam_aiss.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_aiss.information_type(+) = 'anm_Alíquota_ISS'
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pj.job_id (+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.classification_code(+) = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND estab.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND matr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND matr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
ORDER BY PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

### Query #162

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_EXT_APP_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , pptl.user_person_type , paam.assignment_id ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       CASE WHEN paam.effective_start_date < sysdate THEN sysdate ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END processo_irrestrito_date , paam.effective_end_date , ppos.period_of_service_id , paam.normal_hours ,
       paam.employment_category , paam.employee_category , paam.hourly_salaried_code ,
       paam.assignment_status_type , paam.assignment_status_type_id , paam.assignment_type ,
       SUBSTR(paam.ass_attribute5, 1, INSTR(paam.ass_attribute5,
                                        ' - ')-1) escala_trabalho , paam.last_update_date , paam.creation_date , paam.category_code ,
       paam.action_code , paam.reason_code ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 jornada_mensal , paam.ass_attribute_number2 || ':00' jornada ,
       paam.establishment_id , estab.name nome_estab ,
       SUBSTR(estab.name, 1, INSTR(estab.name, ' - ')-1) cod_estab ,
       CASE WHEN paam_apos.aei_attribute1 IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END aposentado ,
       paam_apos.aei_information_date1 data_aposentadoria ,
       paam_apos.aei_attribute1 tipo_aposentadoria ,
       CASE WHEN paam.primary_flag = 'Y' THEN ppos.date_start ELSE paam.effective_start_date
       END AS date_start ,

       END prazo_contrato ,

       END fim_prazo_contrato_2 , NVL(ppos.attribute5,
```
