```sql
       ppos.pds_information9 worker_category , ppos.pds_information7 tipo_regime_prev ,
       ppos.pds_information3 num_proc_judicial , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos.pds_information10 tipo_contrato_prazo , ppos.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial ,
       ppos.attribute6 area_atuacao_estagio , ppos.attribute_number2 numero_apolice_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute_date1 data_prev_fim_estagio , ppos.attribute2 instituicao_ensino_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute15 natureza_estagio , ppos.attribute16 nivel_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute17 cod_instituicao_estagio , REPLACE(REPLACE(ppos.attribute14,
                                                            '.', ''),
                                                    '-', '') cpf_coord_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute13 nome_coord_estagio , ppos.pds_information5 primeiro_emprego ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R'
           WHEN paam.action_code IN ('REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION') THEN 'R' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao , paam.full_part_time , paam.ass_attribute11 multiplos_vinculos ,
       CASE WHEN ppos.attribute11 IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
       END AS membro_cipa , pjf.job_code , pj.name job_name ,
       pjf.attribute2 job_risco_flag , cmps.salary_amount ,
       depto.organization_id depto_id , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , sind.organization_id sind_id ,
       sind.name sind_name , sind.internal_address_line sind_code ,
       paam.legal_entity_id , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       matr.ext_identifier_number cod_pessoa_rm ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '0'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '5'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '8' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_ocorrencia ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam_adia.aei_attribute1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END AS percent_adiant ,
       CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '0' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_col_fornecedor ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN LPAD(regexp_replace(paam.ass_attribute16,

                                                                                 '[^0-9]+',
                                                                                 ''),
                                                                            7, 0) ELSE ''
       END AS cod_fornecedor , paam_aiss.aei_attribute2 aliquota_iss ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                   '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18 ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,

                                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
       END AS cod_ccusto , 'P' cod_recebimento , '0' nro_dep_irrf , '0' nro_dep_sal_fam , '0' ajuda_custo ,
                                                                                              '0' arredondamento ,
                                                                                                  '1' ind_inicio_hor ,
                                                                                                      '1' reg_atual ,
                                                                                                          '50' periodo_rescisao ,

  (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
     AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
     AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date) qtde_vinculos ,
                                                                                                               mngr.matricula_lider ,
                                                                                                               paam.primary_flag ,
                                                                                                               pap.attribute11 insalubridade ,
                                                                                                               pap.attribute12 periculosidade ,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '5900'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0210'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0201'
                                                                                                                   ELSE ''
                                                                                                               END AS cod_evento ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information6 tipo_regime_trabalhista ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute15,

                                                                                                                 'N') necessita_usuario_acesso ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,

                                                                                                                 'N') rephorariotrabalho ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute45,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovcargo ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute46,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovccusto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute47,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovdepartamento ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(paam.ass_attribute14,

                                                                                                                 '0 - De acordo com o cargo',
                                                                                                                 DECODE(pjf.attribute3,

                                                                                                                   'Y',
                                                                                                                   '1' ,
                                                                                                                   'N',
                                                                                                                   '0') ,
                                                                                                                 '1 - Exceção - Sim (sempre bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '1' ,
                                                                                                                 '2 - Exceção - Não (nunca bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '0') utiliza_ponto
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia ,
     per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_aiss ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     per_jobs pj , cmp_salary cmps , hr_organization_v depto ,
     hr_organization_v estab , hr_organization_v sind , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT peai.person_id , peai.assignment_id , peai.ext_identifier_number
   FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
   WHERE peai.date_to IS NULL
     AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
     AND peai.ext_identifier_seq =
       (SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
        FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
        WHERE person_id = peai.person_id
          AND assignment_id = peai.assignment_id
          AND ext_identifier_type = peai.ext_identifier_type)) matr ,

  (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,
          pasf.effective_end_date
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_all_assignments_m pman
   WHERE pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
     AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND pman.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date) mngr
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND paam_adia.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_adia.information_type(+) = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND paam_apos.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_apos.information_type(+) = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
  AND paam_aiss.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_aiss.information_type(+) = 'anm_Alíquota_ISS'
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pj.job_id (+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.classification_code(+) = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND estab.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND matr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND matr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
ORDER BY PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

```sql
       END fim_prazo_contrato_2 , NVL(ppos.attribute5,
                                    'Não Optante') contribuicao_sindical ,
       ppos.pds_information9 worker_category , ppos.pds_information7 tipo_regime_prev ,
       ppos.pds_information3 num_proc_judicial , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos.pds_information10 tipo_contrato_prazo , ppos.pds_information12 nat_atv_esocial ,
       ppos.attribute6 area_atuacao_estagio , ppos.attribute_number2 numero_apolice_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute_date1 data_prev_fim_estagio , ppos.attribute2 instituicao_ensino_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute15 natureza_estagio , ppos.attribute16 nivel_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute17 cod_instituicao_estagio , REPLACE(REPLACE(ppos.attribute14,
                                                            '.', ''),
                                                    '-', '') cpf_coord_estagio ,
       ppos.attribute13 nome_coord_estagio , ppos.pds_information5 primeiro_emprego ,
       CASE
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'P'
           WHEN paam.action_code = 'HIRE'
                AND NVL(ppos.pds_information5, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'R'
           WHEN paam.action_code IN ('REHIRE','ADD_ASSIGN','HIRE_ADD_WORK_RELATION') THEN 'R' ELSE ''
       END AS tipo_admissao , paam.full_part_time , paam.ass_attribute11 multiplos_vinculos ,
       CASE WHEN ppos.attribute11 IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S'
       END AS membro_cipa , pjf.job_code , pj.name job_name ,
       pjf.attribute2 job_risco_flag , cmps.salary_amount ,
       depto.organization_id depto_id , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , sind.organization_id sind_id ,
       sind.name sind_name , sind.internal_address_line sind_code ,
       paam.legal_entity_id , le.le_name , le.le_organization_code ,
       matr.ext_identifier_number cod_pessoa_rm ,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '0'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'N'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '4'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'N' THEN '5'
           WHEN NVL(paam.ass_attribute11, 'N') = 'Y'
                AND NVL(pjf.attribute2, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '8' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_ocorrencia ,
       CASE WHEN NVL(paam_adia.aei_attribute1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0'
       END AS percent_adiant ,
       CASE WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '0' ELSE ''
       END AS cod_col_fornecedor ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN LPAD(regexp_replace(paam.ass_attribute16,

                                                                                 '[^0-9]+',
                                                                                 ''),
                                                                            7, 0) ELSE ''
       END AS cod_fornecedor , paam_aiss.aei_attribute2 aliquota_iss ,
       CASE
           WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('CLT - Docente')
                OR paam.position_id IS NULL THEN REPLACE(paam.ass_attribute17,
                                                   '.', '') || '-' || paam.ass_attribute18 ELSE REPLACE(pap.cod_ccusto,

                                                                                                  '.',
                                                                                                  '') || '-' || pap.attribute8
       END AS cod_ccusto , 'P' cod_recebimento , '0' nro_dep_irrf , '0' nro_dep_sal_fam , '0' ajuda_custo ,
                                                                                              '0' arredondamento ,
                                                                                                  '1' ind_inicio_hor ,
                                                                                                      '1' reg_atual ,
                                                                                                          '50' periodo_rescisao ,

  (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
     AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
     AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
     AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date) qtde_vinculos ,
                                                                                                               mngr.matricula_lider ,
                                                                                                               paam.primary_flag ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                 'Grau máximo',
                                                                                                                 40,
                                                                                                                 'Grau médio',
                                                                                                                 20,
                                                                                                                 'Grau mínimo',
                                                                                                                 10,
                                                                                                                 'Nenhuma',
                                                                                                                 '') insalubridade ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                 '30%',
                                                                                                                 30,
                                                                                                                 'Nenhuma',
                                                                                                                 '') periculosidade ,
                                                                                                               CASE
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) = UPPER('Autônomo RPA') THEN '5900'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute12,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0210'
                                                                                                                   WHEN upper(pptl.user_person_type) != UPPER('Autônomo RPA')
                                                                                                                        AND NVL(pap.attribute11,

                                                                                                                              'Nenhuma') != 'Nenhuma' THEN '0201'
                                                                                                                   ELSE ''
                                                                                                               END AS cod_evento ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information2 indicador_admissao ,
                                                                                                               ppos.pds_information6 tipo_regime_trabalhista ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute15,

                                                                                                                 'N') necessita_usuario_acesso ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,

                                                                                                                 'N') rephorariotrabalho ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute45,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovcargo ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute46,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovccusto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ass_attribute47,

                                                                                                                 'N') repmovdepartamento ,
                                                                                                               DECODE(paam.ass_attribute14,

                                                                                                                 '0 - De acordo com o cargo',
                                                                                                                 DECODE(pjf.attribute3,

                                                                                                                   'Y',
                                                                                                                   '1' ,
                                                                                                                   'N',
                                                                                                                   '0') ,
                                                                                                                 '1 - Exceção - Sim (sempre bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '1' ,
                                                                                                                 '2 - Exceção - Não (nunca bate ponto)',
                                                                                                                 '0') utiliza_ponto ,
                                                                                                               NVL(paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,

                                                                                                                 0) AS CONTRATACAO_ESPECIAL ,
                                                                                                               TO_CHAR(ppos.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE,

                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATA_DESLIGAMENTO
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_adia ,
     per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_apos , per_assignment_extra_info_m paam_aiss ,

  (SELECT posi.* , cc.cod_ccusto , cc.desc_ccusto
   FROM hr_all_positions_f posi ,

     (SELECT ffvv.flex_value_id , ffvv.flex_value cod_ccusto , ffvv.description desc_ccusto
      FROM fnd_flex_values_vl ffvv , fnd_flex_value_sets ffvs
      WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
        AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
        AND NVL(ffvv.enabled_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
        AND NVL(ffvv.summary_flag, 'N') = 'N'
        AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(ffvv.start_date_active,
                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ffvv.end_date_active,
                                                           TRUNC(SYSDATE))) cc
   WHERE cc.flex_value_id(+) = posi.cost_center) pap , per_periods_of_service ppos , per_jobs_f pjf ,
     per_jobs pj , cmp_salary cmps , hr_organization_v depto ,
     hr_organization_v estab , hr_organization_v sind , per_person_types_tl pptl ,

  (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
          haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
          xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
   FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from, SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,
                                                                SYSDATE)
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
        WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

  (SELECT peai.person_id , peai.assignment_id , peai.ext_identifier_number
   FROM per_ext_app_identifiers peai
   WHERE peai.date_to IS NULL
     AND peai.ext_identifier_type = 'ANM_ID_PESSOA_RM'
     AND peai.ext_identifier_seq =
       (SELECT MAX(ext_identifier_seq)
        FROM per_ext_app_identifiers
        WHERE person_id = peai.person_id
          AND assignment_id = peai.assignment_id
          AND ext_identifier_type = peai.ext_identifier_type)) matr ,

  (SELECT pman.assignment_number matricula_lider , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id , pasf.effective_start_date ,
          pasf.effective_end_date
   FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf , per_all_assignments_m pman
   WHERE pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
     AND pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
     AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
     AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
     AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date) mngr
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
  AND pap.position_id(+) = paam.position_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)
  AND paam_adia.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_adia.information_type(+) = 'Adiantamento Quinzenal'
  AND paam_apos.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_apos.information_type(+) = 'anm_Dados_Aposentadoria'
  AND paam_aiss.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam_aiss.information_type(+) = 'anm_Alíquota_ISS'
  AND pptl.person_type_id(+) = paam.person_type_id
  AND pptl.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pj.job_id (+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN pjf.effective_start_date(+) AND pjf.effective_end_date(+)
  AND cmps.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cmps.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved(+) = 'Y'
  AND cmps.date_to(+) = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND depto.organization_id(+) = paam.organization_id
  AND depto.classification_code(+) = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date(+) AND depto.effective_end_date(+)
  AND le.le_organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND estab.organization_id(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND estab.classification_code(+) = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND estab.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN estab.effective_start_date(+) AND estab.effective_end_date(+)
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND matr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND matr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND mngr.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN mngr.effective_start_date(+) AND mngr.effective_end_date(+)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND paam.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 paam.last_update_date)
ORDER BY PAAM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ASC
```

```sql
 AND papf.person_id     = ppos.person_id

      , '' AS data_final_cobertura
  , '2' as envio

             , xle_entity_profiles         xep
             , xle_registrations_v         xrv
         WHERE xep.legal_entity_id       = haou.legal_entity_id
           AND SYSDATE                   BETWEEN NVL(xep.effective_from,SYSDATE) AND NVL(xep.effective_to,SYSDATE)

           AND haou.effective_start_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)

     , (SELECT posi.*

                 WHERE ffvv.flex_value_set_id      = ffvs.flex_value_set_id
                   AND ffvs.flex_value_set_name    = 'Centro de Custo ANIMA'
                   AND NVL( ffvv.enabled_flag,'N') = 'Y'

   AND bptf.pl_typ_id               =   bper.pl_typ_id
   AND BPER.PL_ID                   =   bpf.PL_ID
   AND bper.opt_id                  =   bof.opt_id
   AND bpil.per_in_ler_stat_cd      =   'STRTD'
   AND bof.short_code               in   ('9061','9060')

   AND papf.person_id = bpil.person_id

   AND le.le_organization_id(+)     = paam.legal_entity_id

AND NVL(bpf.short_code,bof.short_code) <> 'N_OPT'

 AND papf.person_id     = ppos.person_id
 AND paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID      = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
 AND  ppos.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
 AND  paam.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'

   AND pap.position_id(+)           = paam.position_id
   AND paam.effective_start_date    BETWEEN pap.effective_start_date(+) AND pap.effective_end_date(+)

   AND pptl.person_type_id(+)       = paam.person_type_id
   AND pptl.language(+)             = 'PTB'
   AND paam.person_id               = papf.person_id
   AND paam.assignment_status_type  = 'ACTIVE'
   AND paam.assignment_type         = 'E'
   AND paam.effective_end_date      = (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
                                         FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                        WHERE person_id               = paam.person_id
                                          AND primary_flag            = paam.primary_flag
                                          AND assignment_type         = paam.assignment_type
                                          AND assignment_status_type  = paam.assignment_status_type)
   AND papf.effective_start_date    = (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
                                         FROM per_all_people_f
                                        WHERE person_id               = papf.person_id)
   AND bper.orgnl_enrt_dt          =  bper.enrt_cvg_strt_dt
   AND papf.person_number          =  NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
   AND BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE       >= NVL(:p_integration_date, BPER.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
```

```sql
       (SELECT MAX(date_from)

        WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
          AND email_type = 'W1')) gestor
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND cmps.last_updated_by <> 'FUSION_APPS_HCM_ESS_LOADER_APPID'
  AND cmps.date_to = TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'RRRR-MM-DD')
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND (pab.action_code = 'PROMOTION'
       OR pab.action_code IN ('LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE'))
  AND pab2.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_reason_id(+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id(+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id(+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND paru.action_reason_code NOT IN ('ANM_DESEMP_REMUNERACAO', '20_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RET_REMUNERACAO',
                                      'ANM_SUBST_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO',
                                      'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO_2')
  AND parb2.action_reason_id(+) = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND paru2.action_reason_id(+) = parb2.action_reason_id
  AND paru2.action_id(+) = pab2.action_id
  AND parm2.act_usg_id(+) = paru2.action_reason_usage_id
  AND paru2.action_reason_code NOT IN ('ANM_DESEMP_REMUNERACAO', '20_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RET_REMUNERACAO',
                                       'ANM_SUBST_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO',
                                       'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO_2')
  AND pea.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
  AND pea.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_email_addresses
     WHERE person_id = pea.person_id
       AND email_type = pea.email_type)
  AND gestor.person_id (+) = paam.person_id
  AND gestor.assignment_id (+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND ppttl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
  AND ppttl.language = 'PTB'
  AND ppttl.user_person_type <> 'CLT - Docente'
  AND ppnf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pjftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjftl.job_id = paam.job_id
  AND (SYSDATE BETWEEN pjftl.effective_start_date AND pjftl.effective_end_date)
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id
       AND assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
       AND action_id = cmps.action_id)
  AND cmps.date_from >= to_date('01/09/2024', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_person_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND cmps.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.last_update_date)
```


### Query #169

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M_, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT dep.person_number , dep.dep_number , dep.codcoligada , dep.assignment_number ,
                dep.nrodepend , dep.nome , dep.cpf , dep.dtnascimento , dep.sexo ,
                NVL(dep.estadocivil, 'S') estadocivil , dep.localnascimento , dep.cartorio , dep.nroregistro , dep.nrolivro ,
                dep.nrofolha , dep.incirrf , dep.incinss , dep.incpensao , dep.incdefiniveis ,
                dep.grauparentesco , dep.cartaovacina , dep.dataentregacertidao , dep.freqescolar ,
                dep.universitario , dep.incsalfam , dep.observacao , dep.numerocartaosus ,
                dep.last_update_date
FROM
  (SELECT papf.person_number person_number , papfd.person_number dep_number ,
          le.le_organization_code codcoligada , paam.assignment_number , pcrf.cont_attribute_number20 nrodepend ,
          REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRANSLATE(ppnf.full_name,

                                  'ŠŽšžŸÁÇÉÍÓÚÀÈÌÒÙÂÊÎÔÛÃÕËÜÏÖÑÝåáçéíóúàèìòùâêîôûãõëüïöñýÿ',
                                  'SZszYACEIOUAEIOUAEIOUAOEUIONYaaceiouaeiouaeiouaoeuionyy')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ') nome , REPLACE(REPLACE(pni.national_identifier_number,

                                                                                                                                       '.',
                                                                                                                                       ''),

                                                                                                                               '-',
                                                                                                                               '') cpf ,
          pp.date_of_birth dtnascimento , pplf.sex sexo ,
          pcrf.cont_attribute8 estadocivil , pp.town_of_birth localnascimento , '' cartorio ,
                                                                                   '' nroregistro ,
                                                                                      '' nrolivro ,
                                                                                         '' nrofolha ,
                                                                                            DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute4,

                                                                                              'Y',
                                                                                              '1',
                                                                                              '0') incirrf ,
                                                                                            0 incinss ,
                                                                                            DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute5,

                                                                                              'Y',
                                                                                              '1',
                                                                                              '0') incpensao ,
                                                                                            '' incdefiniveis ,
                                                                                               pcrf.contact_type grauparentesco ,
                                                                                               DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute6,

                                                                                                 'Y',
                                                                                                 '1',
                                                                                                 '0') cartaovacina ,
                                                                                               '' dataentregacertidao ,
                                                                                                  DECODE(pcrf.cont_attribute7,

                                                                                                    'Y',
                                                                                                    '1',
                                                                                                    '0') freqescolar ,
                                                                                                  DECODE(pcrf.cont_information2,

                                                                                                    'Y',
                                                                                                    '1',
                                                                                                    '0') universitario ,
                                                                                                  0 incsalfam ,
                                                                                                  '' observacao ,

     (SELECT national_identifier_number
      FROM per_national_identifiers
      WHERE national_identifier_type = 'CNS'
        AND person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id) numerocartaosus ,
                                                                                                     GREATEST(NVL(int_adm.last_update_date,

                                                                                                                to_date('01/01/1900',

                                                                                                                  'dd/mm/yyyy')) ,

                                                                                                       pcrf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       papfd.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       ppnf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       pp.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       pplf.last_update_date ,
                                                                                                       NVL(pni.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         TO_DATE('01/01/1900',

                                                                                                           'DD/MM/YYYY'))) last_update_date
   FROM per_contact_relships_f pcrf , per_all_people_f papf , per_all_people_f papfd ,
        per_person_names_f ppnf , per_persons pp , per_people_legislative_f pplf ,
        per_national_identifiers pni , per_all_assignments_m paam ,

     (SELECT xep.legal_entity_id , xep.name le_name , xep.legal_entity_identifier ,
             haou.organization_id le_organization_id , haou.organization_code le_organization_code ,
             xrv.registration_number le_registration_number
      FROM hr_all_organization_units_f haou , xle_entity_profiles xep , xle_registrations_v xrv
      WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
        AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
        AND xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
        AND haou.effective_start_date =
          (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
           FROM hr_all_organization_units_f
           WHERE organization_id = haou.organization_id)) le ,

     (SELECT paam_old.Assignment_Id ,paam_old.assignment_number assignment_anterior ,
             paam2.assignment_number assignment_atual ,paam2.last_update_date ,paam2.last_updated_by ,papf2.person_number
      FROM per_all_assignments_m_ paam_old
      INNER JOIN per_all_assignments_m_ paam2 ON paam2.assignment_type = 'E'
      AND paam2.assignment_number NOT LIKE 'E%'
      AND paam2.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
      AND paam2.last_update_date =
        (SELECT MIN(x.last_update_date)
         FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
         WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
           AND x.last_update_date > paam_old.last_update_date)
      INNER JOIN per_all_people_f papf2 ON papf2.person_id = paam_old.person_id
      AND papf2.effective_end_date = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                       'DD/MM/YYYY')
      WHERE paam_old.assignment_type = 'E'
        AND paam_old.assignment_number LIKE 'E%'
        AND paam_old.last_update_date =
          (SELECT MAX(x.last_update_date)
           FROM per_all_assignments_m_ x
           WHERE x.assignment_id = paam_old.assignment_id
             AND x.assignment_type = 'E'
             AND x.assignment_number Like 'E%')) int_adm
   WHERE 1=1
     AND pcrf.contact_type <> 'EMRG'
     AND to_char(pcrf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY') = '4712'
     AND pcrf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_contact_relships_f
        WHERE contact_relationship_id = pcrf.contact_relationship_id)
     AND papf.person_id = pcrf.person_id
     AND papf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
     AND le.le_organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
     AND papfd.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
     AND papfd.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_all_people_f
        WHERE person_id = papfd.person_id)
     AND ppnf.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_person_names_f
        WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
     AND pp.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND pp.start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(start_date)
        FROM per_persons
        WHERE person_id = pp.person_id)
     AND pplf.person_id = papfd.person_id
     AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
     AND pplf.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
        FROM per_people_legislative_f
        WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
     AND pni.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
     AND pni.person_id (+) = pcrf.contact_person_id
     AND paam.person_id = pcrf.person_id
     AND paam.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
     AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
     AND paam.effective_end_date =
       (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
        FROM per_all_assignments_m
        WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
          AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
          AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type)
     AND int_adm.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id) dep
WHERE dep.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, dep.person_number)
  AND dep.dep_number = NVL(:p_dep_number, dep.dep_number)
  AND dep.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                dep.assignment_number)
  AND dep.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                dep.last_update_date)
```

### Query #170

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , rg.national_identifier_number rg_numero ,
       rg.place_of_issue rg_orgao_emissor ,
       rg.attribute_category rg_uf_emissao ,
       rg.issue_date rg_dt_emissao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(cpf.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') cpf_numero ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(pis.national_identifier_number,
                         nit.national_identifier_number), '.', ''), '-', '') pis_numero ,
       NVL(pis.issue_date, nit.issue_date) pis_dt_emissao ,
       pplf.per_information1 ctps_numero ,
       pplf.per_information2 ctps_serie ,
       ctps_uf.geography_name ctps_uf_emissao ,
       pplf.per_information_date1 ctps_dt_emissao ,
       REPLACE(cns.national_identifier_number, ' ', '') cns_numero ,
       ric.national_identifier_number ric_numero ,
       ric.place_of_issue ric_orgao_emissor ,
       ric.attribute3 ric_uf_emissor ,
       ric.issue_date ric_data_expedicao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(rne.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') rne_numero ,
       rne.place_of_issue rne_orgao_emissor ,
       rne.attribute3 rne_uf_emissor ,
       rne.issue_date rne_dt_expedicao , REPLACE(REPLACE(oc.national_identifier_number,
                                                   '.', ''),
                                           '-', '') oc_numero ,
       oc.place_of_issue oc_orgao_emissor ,
       oc.attribute1 oc_uf_emissor ,
       oc.issue_date oc_dt_expedicao ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(nit.national_identifier_number, '.', ''), '-', '') nit_numero ,
       nit.place_of_issue nit_place_of_issue ,
       nit.attribute3 nit_uf_emissor ,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(nit.attribute2, '.', ''), '-', '') nit_orgao_emissor ,
       nit.issue_date nit_dt_expedicao ,
       tit.numero tit_numero , tit.zona tit_zona ,
       tit.secao tit_secao ,
       tit.dt_emissao tit_dt_emissao ,
       tit.cidade tit_cidade , tit.uf tit_uf ,
       tit.issuing_country tit_issuing_country ,
       tit.issuing_location tit_issuing_location ,
       certres.numero mil_numero_cert , NULL mil_categoria , NULL mil_circunscricao , NULL mil_orgao_emissor ,
                                                                                           NULL mil_regiao ,
                                                                                                NULL mil_situacao ,
                                                                                                     GREATEST(pplf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                       NVL(rg.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(cpf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(pis.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(cns.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(ric.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(rne.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(oc.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(tit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date),
                                                                                                       NVL(nit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                         pplf.last_update_date)) last_update_date ,
                                                                                                     pplf.legislation_code ,
                                                                                                     tit.issuing_country
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_people_legislative_f pplf , per_national_identifiers rg ,
     per_national_identifiers cpf , per_national_identifiers pis , per_national_identifiers cns ,
     per_national_identifiers ric , per_national_identifiers rne , per_national_identifiers oc ,
     per_national_identifiers nit , hz_geographies ctps_uf ,

  (SELECT hdor.person_id , hdor.document_number numero , hdor.date_from date_from ,
          hdor.date_to date_to , hdor.issuing_country issuing_country ,
          hdor.issuing_location issuing_location , hdor.issued_date dt_emissao ,
          hdor.issuing_authority issuing_authority , hdor.dei_information1 zona , hdor.dei_information2 secao ,
          hgct.geography_name cidade , hguf.geography_name uf , hdor.last_update_date last_update_date
   FROM hr_documents_of_record hdor , hz_geographies hgct , hz_geographies hguf
   WHERE hdor.dei_information_category = 'ORA_HRX_BR_ELECTORAL_CARD'
     AND hgct.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number2
     AND hguf.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number3) tit ,

  (SELECT hdor.person_id , hdor.document_number numero , hdor.date_from date_from ,
          hdor.date_to date_to , hdor.issuing_country issuing_country ,
          hdor.issuing_location issuing_location , hdor.issued_date dt_emissao ,
          hdor.issuing_authority issuing_authority , hdor.dei_information1 zona , hdor.dei_information2 secao ,
          hgct.geography_name cidade , hguf.geography_name uf , hdor.last_update_date last_update_date
   FROM hr_documents_of_record hdor , hz_geographies hgct , hz_geographies hguf
   WHERE hdor.dei_information_category = 'ORA_HRX_BR_MILITARY_CERTIFICATE'
     AND hgct.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number2
     AND hguf.geography_id(+) = hdor.dei_information_number3) certres
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_people_legislative_f
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND ctps_uf.geography_id(+) = pplf.per_information_number1
  AND rg.national_identifier_type(+) = 'RG'
  AND rg.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND rg.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND cpf.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
  AND cpf.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND cpf.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND pis.national_identifier_type(+) = 'PIS'
  AND pis.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND pis.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND cns.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_CNS'
  AND cns.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND cns.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND ric.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_RIC'
  AND ric.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND ric.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND rne.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_RNE'
  AND rne.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND rne.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND oc.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_OC'
  AND oc.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND oc.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND nit.national_identifier_type(+) = 'ORA_HRX_NIT'
  AND nit.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND nit.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND tit.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND certres.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST (pplf.last_update_date ,
         NVL(rg.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(cpf.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(pis.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(cns.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(ric.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(rne.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(oc.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date) ,
         NVL(nit.last_update_date, pplf.last_update_date) , NVL(tit.last_update_date,
                                                              pplf.last_update_date)) >= NVL (:p_integration_date,
                                                                                              GREATEST(pplf.last_update_date ,

                                                                                                NVL(rg.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(cpf.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(pis.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(cns.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(ric.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(rne.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(oc.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(tit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date) ,
                                                                                                NVL(nit.last_update_date,

                                                                                                  pplf.last_update_date)))
```

### Query #171

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number ,
       hov.name LEGAL_EMPLOYER , TO_CHAR(ppos.date_start,
                                   'YYYY/MM/DD') DATE_START ,
       ppos.attribute11 TIPOESTABILIDADE , ppos.attribute_date15 FIM ,
       ppos.attribute_date14 INICIO , ppos.attribute30 MOTIVOESTABILIDADE
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf , HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov ,
     PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND papf.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND ppos.actual_termination_date IS NULL
  AND ppos.date_start =
    (SELECT MAX(date_start)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE person_id(+) = ppos.person_id)
  AND hov.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #172

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.creation_date , paam.last_update_date , paam.primary_flag ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date , ROWNUM , NVL(paam.ass_attribute50,
                                                                       'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code IN ('GLB_TRANSFER', 'GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE', 'GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY',
                           'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'INACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                        paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR paam.ass_attribute50 = 'Y')
```

### Query #173

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT paam.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , paam.action_code ,
       NVL(NVL(paam.reason_code, paam.old_reason_code), 'ALT_CAD') reason_code , paam.ass_attribute5 cod_horario ,
       paam.old_ass_attribute5 cod_horario_ant , paam.full_part_time tempo_parcial ,
       paam.old_full_part_time tempo_parcial_ant , ppos.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada ,
       ppos_old.pds_information8 tipo_regime_jornada_ant ,
       (NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute_number2, 0) - NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2,
                                                   0)) * 60 hora , paam.effective_start_date ,
       GREATEST(paam.last_update_date, ppos.last_update_date) last_update_date ,
       CASE
           WHEN sind.internal_address_line IN ('MG_SAAE', 'MG_SAAESUL','MG_SAAETMA')
                AND NVL(paam.ass_attribute_number2, 0) * 60 < NVL(paam.old_ass_attribute_number2,
                                                                0) * 60 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
       END AS proc_lancto_externo , NVL(paam.ass_attribute44,
                                      'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf ,

  (SELECT assi.* , assi_old.person_id old_person_id ,
          assi_old.period_of_service_id old_period_of_service_id , assi_old.ass_attribute5 old_ass_attribute5 ,
          assi_old.full_part_time old_full_part_time , assi_old.ass_attribute_number2 old_ass_attribute_number2 ,
          assi_old.effective_start_date old_effective_start_date , assi_old.reason_code old_reason_code ,
          assi_old.job_id old_job_id
   FROM per_all_assignments_m assi
   LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m assi_old ON (assi.person_id = assi_old.person_id
                                                AND assi.assignment_id = assi_old.assignment_id
                                                AND assi_old.last_update_date =
                                                  (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
                                                   FROM per_all_assignments_m
                                                   WHERE assignment_id = assi.assignment_id
                                                     AND person_id = assi.person_id
                                                     AND last_update_date < assi.last_update_date))
   WHERE assi.assignment_type = 'E'
```

### Query #177

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_JOB_EVALUATIONS, PER_JOBS_F`

```sql
SELECT pjf.job_id , pjf.job_code ,
       CASE WHEN pjf.active_status = 'A' THEN 0 ELSE 1
       END active_status , pjf.job_family_id , pjftl.name , pjlf.information1 cbo_code ,
       jff.job_family_code , jfm.job_family_name , eval.evaluation_system hay_points ,
       pjf.effective_start_date , pjf.effective_end_date , pjf.created_by , pjf.creation_date ,
       GREATEST(pjf.last_update_date,
         pjftl.last_update_date, NVL(pjlf.last_update_date,
                                   pjf.last_update_date),
         NVL(jff.last_update_date, pjf.last_update_date), NVL(jfm.last_update_date,
                                                            pjf.last_update_date)) last_update_date
FROM per_jobs_f pjf , per_jobs_f_tl pjftl , per_job_leg_f pjlf , per_job_family_f jff ,
     per_job_family_f_tl jfm ,

  (SELECT pje.job_id , pje.evaluation_system
   FROM per_job_evaluations pje
   WHERE pje.date_evaluated =
       (SELECT MAX(pje2.date_evaluated)
        FROM per_job_evaluations pje2
        WHERE pje2.job_id = pje.job_id)) eval
WHERE pjf.effective_end_date = TO_DATE('31/12/4712',
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND pjftl.job_id = pjf.job_id
  AND pjftl.effective_start_date = pjf.effective_start_date
  AND pjftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjlf.job_id(+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjlf.information_category(+)= 'ORA_HRX_BR_JOBS'
  AND pjlf.legislation_code(+) = 'BR'
  AND jff.job_family_id(+) = pjf.job_family_id
  AND jfm.job_family_id(+) = pjf.job_family_id
  AND jfm.language(+) = 'PTB'
  AND eval.job_id(+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjf.job_code = NVL(:p_job_code, pjf.job_code)
  AND GREATEST(pjf.last_update_date,
        pjftl.last_update_date, NVL(pjlf.last_update_date,
                                  pjf.last_update_date),
        NVL(jff.last_update_date, pjf.last_update_date), NVL(jfm.last_update_date,
                                                           pjf.last_update_date)) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                       GREATEST(pjf.last_update_date,

                                                                                         pjftl.last_update_date,
                                                                                         NVL(pjlf.last_update_date,

                                                                                           pjf.last_update_date),
                                                                                         NVL(jff.last_update_date,

                                                                                           pjf.last_update_date),
                                                                                         NVL(jfm.last_update_date,

                                                                                           pjf.last_update_date)))
```

### Query #178

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, FND_TERRITORIES_VL, PER_JOBS_F_TL, PAY_PERSON_PAY_METHODS_F, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F, PER_JOBS_F, PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, CMP_SALARY...`

```sql
SELECT papf.*
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam ,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf ,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V org ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov ,
     PER_JOBS_F pjf ,
     PER_JOBS_F_TL pjftl ,
     PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos ,
     CMP_SALARY cs ,
     pay_pay_relationships_dn ppr ,
     pay_person_pay_methods_f ppp ,
     iby_ext_bank_accounts_v ieb ,
     iby_ext_bank_accounts iba ,
     PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL ppttl ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V sind ,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES email ,
     PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F pplf ,
     PER_ETHNICITIES pe ,
     PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS cpf ,
     PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS pis ,
     hz_geographies ctps_uf ,
     PER_PERSONS pp ,
     PER_JOB_FAMILY_F pjff ,
     PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL pjfftl ,
     FND_LOOKUP_VALUES flvn ,
     FND_TERRITORIES_VL ft ,
     FND_LOOKUP_VALUES flv ,
     FND_LOOKUP_VALUES flvc ,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V secao ,
     PER_DISABILITIES_F pdf
WHERE paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
  AND paam.action_code IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MIN(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id
       AND effective_end_date >= SYSDATE)
  AND org.classification_code = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND org.status = 'A'
  AND org.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN org.effective_start_date AND org.effective_end_date
  AND org.organization_id(+) = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND hov.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) = paam.establishment_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LRU'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+) AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+)
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND pjf.job_id(+) = paam.job_id
  AND pjf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_JOBS_F
     WHERE job_id = pjf.job_id)
  AND pjftl.job_id(+) = pjf.job_id
  AND pjftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjftl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_JOBS_F_TL
     WHERE job_id = pjftl.job_id)
  AND cs.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cs.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE cs.assignment_id = assignment_id)
  AND ppos.person_id(+) = paam.person_id
  AND ppr.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND ppr.START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(START_DATE)
     FROM pay_pay_relationships_dn
     WHERE person_id(+) = ppr.person_id)
  AND ppr.payroll_relationship_id(+) = ppp.payroll_relationship_id
  AND ppp.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(a.effective_end_date)
     FROM pay_person_pay_methods_f a
     WHERE a.payroll_relationship_id = ppp.payroll_relationship_id)
  AND ieb.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ppp.bank_account_id(+) = ieb.bank_account_id
  AND ieb.ext_bank_account_id(+) = iba.ext_bank_account_id
  AND sind.organization_id(+) = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code(+) = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status(+) = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date(+) AND sind.effective_end_date(+)
  AND ppttl.PERSON_TYPE_ID(+) = paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND ppttl.LANGUAGE ='PTB'
  AND email.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND email.email_type = 'H1'
  AND pplf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F
     WHERE person_id = pplf.person_id)
  AND pe.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND cpf.national_identifier_type(+) = 'CPF'
  AND cpf.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND cpf.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND pis.national_identifier_type(+) = 'PIS'
  AND pis.person_id(+) = pplf.person_id
  AND pis.legislation_code(+) = pplf.legislation_code
  AND ctps_uf.geography_id (+) = pplf.per_information_number1
  AND pp.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pjff.job_family_id(+) = pjf.job_family_id
  AND pjff.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM PER_JOB_FAMILY_F
     WHERE job_family_id = pjff.job_family_id)
  AND pjfftl.job_family_id(+) = pjff.job_family_id
  AND pjfftl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pjfftl.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_JOB_FAMILY_F_TL
     WHERE job_family_id = pjfftl.job_family_id)
  AND flvn.lookup_code(+) = pp.country_of_birth
  AND flvn.lookup_type(+) = 'NATIONALITY'
  AND flvn.language = 'PTB'
  AND ft.territory_code(+) = paam.legislation_code
  AND ft.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
     FROM FND_TERRITORIES_VL
     WHERE territory_code = ft.territory_code)
  AND flv.lookup_code(+) = pplf.highest_education_level
  AND flv.lookup_type = 'PER_HIGHEST_EDUCATION_LEVEL'
  AND flv.language = 'PTB'
  AND flvc.lookup_code(+) = pplf.marital_status
  AND flvc.lookup_type = 'MAR_STATUS'
  AND flvc.language = 'PTB'
  AND secao.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.organization_id
  AND secao.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'DEPARTMENT'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN secao.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND secao.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND secao.status = 'A'
  AND pdf.person_id(+) = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #180

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.creation_date , paam.last_update_date , paam.primary_flag ,
       paam.assignment_number , paam.effective_start_date ,
       NVL(paam.ass_attribute49, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam , hr_organization_v hov , hr_organization_v org ,
     hr_organization_v sind , cmp_salary cs
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code IN ('ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MIN(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id
       AND effective_end_date >= SYSDATE)
  AND hov.ORGANIZATION_ID = paam.establishment_id
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN hov.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND hov.status = 'A'
  AND org.classification_code = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND org.status = 'A'
  AND org.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN org.effective_start_date AND org.effective_end_date
  AND org.organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND sind.organization_id = paam.union_id
  AND sind.classification_code = 'ORA_PER_UNION'
  AND sind.status = 'A'
  AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN sind.effective_start_date AND sind.effective_end_date
  AND cs.assignment_id(+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND cs.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM CMP_SALARY
     WHERE cs.assignment_id = assignment_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((paam.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                        paam.last_update_date) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,

                                                                     TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR paam.ass_attribute49 = 'Y')
```
