### Query #181

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, HR_ORGANIZATION_V`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pman.assignment_number matricula_lider ,
       pman_old.assignment_number matricula_lider_anterior , pasf.assignment_id , pasf.person_id ,
       pasf.effective_start_date start_date_gestor , pasf.effective_end_date end_date_gestor , depto.name depto_name ,
       depto.internal_address_line depto_code , depto_old.name depto_anterior_name ,
       depto_old.internal_address_line depto_anterior_code , pasf.last_update_date , paam.effective_start_date
FROM per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
JOIN per_all_people_f papf ON papf.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman ON pman.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
AND pman.person_id = pasf.manager_id
AND pman.assignment_status_type IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
AND pman.assignment_type = 'E'
AND pasf.effective_start_date BETWEEN pman.effective_start_date AND pman.effective_end_date
LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf_old ON pasf_old.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND pasf_old.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
AND pasf_old.effective_end_date = (pasf.effective_start_date - 1)
LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m pman_old ON pman_old.assignment_id = pasf_old.manager_assignment_id
AND pman_old.person_id = pasf_old.manager_id
AND pman_old.assignment_type = 'E'
AND TO_CHAR(pman_old.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam ON paam.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND paam.assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam_old ON paam_old.person_id = pasf.person_id
AND paam_old.assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
AND paam_old.assignment_type = 'E'
AND paam_old.effective_end_date = (paam.effective_start_date - 1)
AND paam_old.effective_sequence =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_sequence)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = pasf.person_id
     AND assignment_id = pasf.assignment_id
     AND assignment_type = 'E'
     AND effective_start_date = paam_old.effective_start_date)
LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto ON depto.organization_id = paam.organization_id
AND depto.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto.effective_start_date AND depto.effective_end_date
LEFT JOIN hr_organization_v depto_old ON depto_old.organization_id = paam_old.organization_id
AND depto_old.classification_code = 'DEPARTMENT'
AND paam.effective_start_date BETWEEN depto_old.effective_start_date AND depto_old.effective_end_date
WHERE 1=1
  AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND depto.organization_id = depto_old.organization_id
  AND pasf.manager_assignment_id <> NVL(pasf_old.manager_assignment_id, 0)
  AND pasf.last_update_date >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 pasf.last_update_date)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
```

### Query #182

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `ANC_ABSENCE_TYPES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number ,
       SUM(apae.duration) soma_dias_afastamento ,
       NVL(CAST((:p_start_date)AS DATE), CAST((:p_end_date -60)AS DATE)) dataInicialPeriodo , :p_end_date datafinalPeriodo
FROM per_all_people_f papf , anc_absence_types_f aatf ,
     anc_per_abs_entries apae
WHERE papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND apae.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND apae.approval_status_cd ='APPROVED'
  AND apae.absence_status_cd <> 'ORA_WITHDRAWN'
  AND apae.duration <= 15
  AND aatf.absence_type_id = apae.absence_type_id
  AND aatf.base_name = 'ATESTADO MÉDICO (DURAÇÃO MENOR QUE 15 DIAS)_BR'
  AND aatf.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM anc_absence_types_f
     WHERE absence_type_id = aatf.absence_type_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND CAST(apae.start_date AS DATE) > NVL(CAST((:p_start_date)AS DATE),
                                        CAST((:p_end_date -60)AS DATE))
  AND CAST(apae.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(:p_end_date AS DATE)
GROUP BY papf.person_number
HAVING SUM(apae.duration) > 15
```

### Query #183

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, CMP_SALARY`

```sql
SELECT cmps.person_id , papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pab.action_code ,
       parb.action_reason_code , paam.action_code assig_action_code , paam.reason_code assig_reason_code ,
       cmps.date_from , cmps.date_to , cmps.adjustment_percent , cmps.last_update_date ,
       cmps.salary_amount , cmps.salary_reason_code , paam.effective_start_date ,
       paam.effective_end_date , NVL(paam.ass_attribute48, 'N') Reprocessar_Integracao
FROM cmp_salary cmps , per_action_reasons_b parb , per_actions_b pab ,
     per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE papf.person_id = cmps.person_id
  AND papf.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
  AND SUBSTR(paam.assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.action_code NOT IN ('GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND parb.action_reason_code IN ('NEWHIRE','11','E_25','C_25','D_25','A_25','20',
                                  'ANM_ALT_TIT_DOC','ANM_DESEMP','ANM_RECR_INTERNO','ANM_RET',
                                  'ANM_SUBST','B_31','C_31','ANM_INTE_EMP','ANM_INTE_EDU',
                                  'HIRE_ASSIGNMENT','HIRE_WORK_RELATION','21','22','28','29',
                                  'ANM_TRANSF_ENT_EMPRES', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_PROM',
                                  'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_TE_PROM', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_TE_MRTO', '21_REMUNERACAO',
                                  '22_REMUNERACAO', '28_REMUNERACAO', '29_REMUNERACAO',
                                  'ANM_INTE_EMP_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RECR_INTERNO_REMUNERACAO',
                                  'ANM_INTE_EDU_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_DESEMP_REMUNERACAO', 'ANM_RET_REMUNERACAO',
                                  'ANM_SUBST_REMUNERACAO', '11_REMUNERACAO', '20_REMUNERACAO',
                                  'E_25_REMUNERACAO', 'C_25_REMUNERACAO', 'D_25_REMUNERACAO',
                                  'A_25_REMUNERACAO')
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_percent_scale, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0)
  AND trunc(cmps.date_to) = to_date('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((cmps.last_update_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                        cmps.date_from) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,
                                                              TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR paam.ass_attribute48 = 'Y')
  AND trunc(cmps.date_from) >= to_date('01/08/2024',
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY')
```

```sql
                               'GLB_TRANSFER','GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY','GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE',
                               'RESIGNATION','DEATH','TERMINATION', 'RESIGNATION_2', 'END_ASG')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = cmps.assignment_type
  AND paam.assignment_id = cmps.assignment_id
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
       AND person_id = paam.person_id)
  AND pab.action_id = cmps.action_id
  AND parb.action_reason_id = cmps.action_reason_id
  AND cmps.salary_approved = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_percent_scale, 0) > 0
       OR NVL(cmps.adjustment_amount_scale, 0) > 0)
  AND trunc(cmps.date_to) = to_date('31/12/4712',
                              'DD/MM/RRRR')
  AND cmps.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM cmp_salary
     WHERE person_id = cmps.person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND ((cmps.date_from BETWEEN NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                 cmps.date_from) AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,
                                                       TRUNC(SYSDATE+1)))
       OR (paam.ass_attribute48 = 'Y')
       OR (cmps.last_update_date BETWEEN :p_integration_date AND NVL(:p_int_end_date,
                                                                   TRUNC(SYSDATE+1))
           AND cmps.creation_date > cmps.date_from
           AND TRUNC(cmps.creation_date) = TRUNC(cmps.last_update_date)))
  AND trunc(cmps.date_from) >= to_date('01/08/2024',
                                 'DD/MM/YYYY')
```

### Query #191

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS_TL, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT pac.allocated_checklist_id,pat.allocated_task_id,papf.person_number,ppnf.person_id,
                ppnf.display_name,patl.task_name,pac.checklist_category,pea.email_address,
                pea.email_type
FROM per_allocated_tasks pat , per_allocated_tasks_tl patl , per_allocated_checklists pac ,

WHERE ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id

     FROM per_email_addresses
     WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id
       AND email_type = 'H1')
  AND patl.language = 'PTB'
  AND patl.allocated_task_id = pat.allocated_task_id
  AND pac.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pea.email_type = 'H1'
  AND pac.allocated_checklist_id = pat.allocated_checklist_id
  AND patl.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_allocated_tasks_tl
     WHERE LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
       AND allocated_task_id=patl.allocated_task_id)
  AND pea.email_address = NVL(:p_email, pea.email_address)
  AND REPLACE(patl.task_name, '-', '') = NVL(:p_task_name,
                                           patl.task_name)
  AND pac.allocated_checklist_id = NVL(:p_allocated_checklist_id,
```

### Query #192

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number , pat.allocated_task_id ,
       REPLACE(patl.task_name, '-', '') task_name , pac.allocated_checklist_id , pact.checklist_name , papf.person_id
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam ,
     per_allocated_tasks_tl patl , per_allocated_tasks pat ,
     per_allocated_checklists pac , per_periods_of_service ppos ,
     per_allocated_checklists_tl pact
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND paam.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND patl.task_name IN ('Opção de Benefícios')
  AND pat.status = 'INI'
  AND patl.allocated_task_id = pat.allocated_task_id
  AND patl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pact.language = 'PTB'
  AND pac.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pac.allocated_checklist_id = pat.allocated_checklist_id
  AND pact.allocated_checklist_id = pat.allocated_checklist_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND pact.checklist_name IN ('Admissão')
  AND paam.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND pat.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_allocated_tasks
     WHERE pat.allocated_task_id = allocated_task_id)
  AND papf.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE papf.person_id = person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(pat.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                          GREATEST(pat.last_update_date))
```

### Query #193

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALLOCATED_TASKS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT papf.person_number , paam.assignment_number matricula ,
                REPLACE(patl.task_name, '-', '') task_name , PPNF.FULL_NAME , pac.allocated_checklist_id , pact.checklist_name ,
                papf.person_id, 'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupoDocumental,
                '126-Termo Código de Conduta e Ética' AS tipoDocumento, TO_CHAR(sysdate,

                                                                          'dd/mm/yyyy') AS dataGeraçãoDoc ,
                pea.email_address email_educa , pat.last_update_date
FROM per_all_people_f papf , per_all_assignments_m paam ,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF , per_allocated_tasks_tl patl ,
     per_allocated_tasks pat , per_allocated_checklists pac ,
     per_periods_of_service ppos , per_allocated_checklists_tl pact ,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea
WHERE papf.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND paam.legislation_code = 'BR'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('P', 'E')
  AND patl.task_name = 'Termo de Compromisso ao Código de Conduta e Ética na Ânima'
  AND pat.status = 'INI'
  AND patl.allocated_task_id = pat.allocated_task_id
  AND patl.language = 'PTB'
  AND pact.language = 'PTB'
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = paam.person_id
  AND pac.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND pac.allocated_checklist_id = pat.allocated_checklist_id
  AND pact.allocated_checklist_id = pat.allocated_checklist_id
  AND ppos.person_id = paam.person_id
  AND ppos.period_of_service_id = paam.period_of_service_id
  AND pact.checklist_name IN ('Pré-Admissão - Estagiário', 'Pré-Admissão - Bolsista Aprimoramento',
                              'Pré-Admissão', 'Pré-Admissão - Aprendiz',
                              'Nova atribuição de trabalho', 'Nova relação de trabalho - Pré Admissão')
  AND paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_type = paam.assignment_type
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type
       AND legislation_code = 'BR'
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND assignment_type IN ('P', 'E'))
  AND PEA.date_from =
    (SELECT MAX(date_from)
     FROM per_email_addresses
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PEA.PERSON_ID
       AND EMAIL_TYPE = 'H1')
  AND pea.email_type = 'H1'
  AND pea.person_id = PPNF.person_id
  AND pat.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM per_allocated_tasks
     WHERE pat.allocated_task_id = allocated_task_id)
  AND papf.effective_end_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
     FROM per_all_people_f
     WHERE papf.person_id = person_id)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
  AND GREATEST(pat.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,
                                          GREATEST(pat.last_update_date))
```

### Query #197

### Query #198

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD`

```sql
SELECT hdt.document_type_id, hth.subject_id AS person_id, hdt.system_document_type,
       'ModeloTrabalhoAssinado.pdf' AS pdf_filename, hdt.document_type AS document_type_display_value,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                          '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()
           ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttribute1/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
       END ModeloDeTrabalho,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                          '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.actions.core.publicModel.entity.ActionOccurrencesEO'']/ActionOccurrencesEORow/ActionDate/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.actions.core.publicModel.entity.ActionOccurrencesEO'']/ActionOccurrencesEORow/ActionDate/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
           ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttributeDate1/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
       END ReturnDate,
       CASE WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN 'Promover' ELSE 'Modelo de Trabalho'
       END tipo_modelo_trabalho,

  (SELECT hdor.documents_of_record_id
   FROM HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD hdor
   WHERE hdor.person_id = hth.subject_id
     AND hdor.last_update_date =
       (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
        FROM HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD
        WHERE person_id = hth.subject_id
          AND (object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%'
               OR DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%'))) documents_of_record_id
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL hdt
WHERE hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND (htce.process_category IN ('Promover','Promover e Alterar Posição',
                                 'Promote and Change Position')
       OR (htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
           AND htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')
       OR (htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global'))
  AND hdt.document_type IN ('Modelo de Trabalho')
  AND hth.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, hth.transaction_id)
```

### Query #199

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD, HRC_TXN_HEADER`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hdor.DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD_ID AS DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD_ID,
                CASE
                    WHEN hdor.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY LIKE '%Advertência%' THEN 'AdvertênciaAssinada' ELSE 'SuspensãoAssinada'
                END AS TIPO_SANCAO
FROM HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD hdor
WHERE hth.subject_id = hdor.person_id
  AND hdor.last_update_date =
    (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
     FROM HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD
     WHERE person_id = hdor.person_id
       AND hdor.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = CASE
                                             WHEN UPPER(:p_document_type_name) LIKE '%SUSPENSÃO%' THEN 'BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___SUSPENSÃO'
                                             ELSE 'BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___ADVERTÊNCIA'
                                         END)
  AND hth.transaction_id = :p_transaction_id
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hth.subject_id AS person_id, hdt.document_type_id, hdt.system_document_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN paam.ass_attribute_number4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'CartaTransferenciaComMobilidadeAssinada.pdf' ELSE 'CartaTransferenciaSemMobilidadeAssinada.pdf'
                END AS pdf_filename , htce.process_category , hth.transaction_id
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL hdt, per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND htce.process_category IN ('Transferência Local e Global','Promover e Alterar Posição',
                                'Promote and Change Position')
  AND hdt.document_type = 'Carta de Transferência'
  AND paam.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND hth.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, hth.transaction_id)
```

```sql
  AND pp.PERSON_ID = papf.person_id
  AND htce.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, htce.transaction_id)
```

### Query #203

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `FLAGS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, DUAL, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PER_ADDRESSES_F`

```sql
WITH flags AS
  (SELECT paf.flag_atualizacao_endereco, trans.flag_atualizacao_trans
   FROM
     (SELECT person_id, mailing_address_id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                                ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn
      FROM per_all_people_f
      WHERE (:PERSON_NUMBER IS NULL
             OR person_number = :PERSON_NUMBER)) papf
   LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT CASE
                 WHEN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(last_update_date)) BETWEEN 1 AND 90 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS flag_atualizacao_endereco,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY address_id
                                ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn, address_id
      FROM per_addresses_f) paf ON paf.address_id = papf.mailing_address_id
   AND paf.rn = 1
   LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT CASE
                 WHEN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(effective_start_date)) BETWEEN 1 AND 90 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
             END AS flag_atualizacao_trans,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id
                                ORDER BY effective_end_date DESC) AS rn, person_id
      FROM per_all_assignments_m
      WHERE assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
        AND assignment_type = 'E'
        AND SUBSTR(assignment_number, 1, 1) <> 'E'
        AND action_code IN ('GLB_TRANSFER', 'GLB_TRANSFER_PROMOTE', 'GLB_TRANSFER_CHGSALARY',
                            'ANM_TRANSF_LOCAL', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE')) trans ON trans.person_id = papf.person_id
   AND trans.rn = 1
   WHERE papf.rn = 1
     AND ROWNUM = 1)
SELECT :PERSON_NUMBER PERSON_NUMBER , :NOME NOME , :MATRICULA MATRICULA , :EMAIL EMAIL ,
                                                                                 :EMPRESA EMPRESA ,
                                                                                          :FILIAL FILIAL ,
                                                                                                  :CPF CPF ,
                                                                                                       :CARTAO CARTAO ,
                                                                                                               :ESTADO ESTADO ,
                                                                                                                       :CIDADE CIDADE ,
                                                                                                                               :CEP CEP ,
                                                                                                                                    :BAIRRO BAIRRO ,
                                                                                                                                            :COMPLEMENTO COMPLEMENTO ,
                                                                                                                                                         :RUA RUA ,
                                                                                                                                                              TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                                                                'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_HOJE ,
                                                                                                                                                              :MOTIVO MOTIVO ,
                                                                                                                                                                      f.flag_atualizacao_endereco FLAG_ATUALIZACAO_ENDERECO ,
                                                                                                                                                                      f.flag_atualizacao_trans FLAG_ATUALIZACAO_TRANS ,
                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN :MOTIVO = 'Alteração'
                                                                                                                                                                               AND f.flag_atualizacao_endereco = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                      END MOSTRAR_CHECK_ENDERECO ,
                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN :MOTIVO = 'Alteração'
                                                                                                                                                                               AND f.flag_atualizacao_trans = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                      END MOSTRAR_CHECK_TRANS ,
                                                                                                                                                                      CASE
                                                                                                                                                                          WHEN :MOTIVO = 'Alteração'
                                                                                                                                                                               AND NVL(f.flag_atualizacao_trans,

                                                                                                                                                                                     'N') = 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                               AND NVL(f.flag_atualizacao_endereco,

                                                                                                                                                                                     'N') = 'N' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                          ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                      END MOSTRAR_CHECK_OUTROS
FROM DUAL
CROSS JOIN flags f
```

```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           POS.POSITION_CODE
FROM per_all_people_f papf, per_person_names_f ppnf, per_all_assignments_m paam, cmp_salary cs,
     hr_locations_all_f_vl hlaf, PER_LEGAL_EMPLOYERS ple,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID)) GESTOR, hrc_txn_header hth , HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F POS
WHERE TO_CHAR(papf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND cs.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND TO_CHAR(cs.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID (+) = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = hlaf.LOCATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(hlaf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.legal_entity_id = ple.organization_id
  AND POS.POSITION_ID (+) = paam.POSITION_ID
  AND NVL(POS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) = NVL(
                                                            (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
                                                             FROM HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F X
                                                             WHERE X.POSITION_ID = POS.POSITION_ID
                                                               AND X.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= SYSDATE), TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND ((hth.transaction_id = :p_transaction)
       OR (:p_transaction IS NULL
           AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                          paam.assignment_number)))
```

### Query #205

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(PL_TYP.NAME) "Tipo de Benefício" , UPPER(PL.NAME) "Categoria do Benefício" ,
                UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) "Descrição do Benefício" , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PAAM.PERSON_ID
FROM BEN_PL_TYP_F PL_TYP, BEN_PL_F PL, BEN_ELIG_PER_F FACT, BEN_OPT_F BOF_OPT, BEN_ELIG_PER_OPT_F OPT,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF
WHERE PL_TYP.PL_TYP_ID = PL.PL_TYP_ID
  AND FACT.PL_ID = PL.PL_ID
  AND FACT.ELIG_PER_ID = OPT.ELIG_PER_ID
  AND FACT.PER_IN_LER_ID = OPT.PER_IN_LER_ID
  AND OPT.OPT_ID = BOF_OPT.OPT_ID (+)
  AND OPT.ELIG_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(FACT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID)
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TO_CHAR(PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND (UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%NÃO DESEJO%'
       OR BOF_OPT.NAME IS NULL)
  AND (UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%CANCELAR%'
       OR BOF_OPT.NAME IS NULL)
ORDER BY "Tipo de Benefício", "Categoria do Benefício", "Descrição do Benefício"
```

### Query #206

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA, PER_ACTIONS_B, PER_ACTION_ROLE_MAPPING, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_USERS, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES...`

```sql
SELECT papf.person_number , htce.creation_date ,
       GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) last_update_date , ppnf.display_name , email.email_address , ppnf2.display_name nome_gestor ,
       email2.email_address email_gestor ,
       EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

         '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName= "temPacoteMobilidade"]/NewValue/text()') pacote_mobilidade , htce.transaction_id , paam.primary_flag , paam.assignment_number ,
       'Departamento Pessoal Digital' grupo_documental ,
                                      '736 - Termo de transferência de colaborador' tipo_documento ,
                                                                                    htce.change_effective_date AS effective_start_date ,
                                                                                    EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                      '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][2]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssignmentNumber/DATA/text()').getStringVal() AS dest_assignment_number ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal() AS assignment_id ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paam.assignment_id AS AQUI ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][1]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal() assignment_id_actual ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     WHEN user_role.role_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     ELSE 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 END submitted_is_manager ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ppttl.user_person_type ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 user_role.role_name ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionReasonCode/DATA/text()').getStringVal() action_reason_code ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        htce.process_category task_name ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            WHEN parm.role_common_name = 'ANM_-_REMUNERACAO' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        END AS indicador_remuneracao,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        papf.person_id,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TO_CHAR(CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    WHEN TRUNC(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/POS_ActionDate/text()').getStringVal(),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ELSE TRUNC(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/POS_ActionDate/text()').getStringVal(),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                END,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'YYYY-MM-DD') AS effective_start_date_assignment,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        htce.last_update_date htce_last_update_date,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ffsw.UpdatedDate ffsw_UpdatedDate,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        :p_integration_date p_integration_date,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'YYYY-MM-DD') dataHoje
FROM per_all_assignments_m paam
JOIN per_all_people_f papf ON paam.person_id = papf.person_id
AND papf.effective_start_date =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_all_people_f
   WHERE person_id = papf.person_id)
JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
AND ppnf.effective_start_date =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_person_names_f
   WHERE person_id = ppnf.person_id)
JOIN per_person_types_tl ppttl ON ppttl.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
AND ppttl.language = 'PTB'
JOIN hrc_txn_header hth ON NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][1]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal(),

                         EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,
                           '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal()) = paam.assignment_id
AND hth.subject_id = papf.person_id
JOIN per_actions_b pab ON rownum=1
JOIN hrc_txn_console_entry htce ON htce.transaction_id = hth.transaction_id
JOIN FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw ON TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
JOIN per_action_reason_usages paru ON paru.action_id = pab.action_id
JOIN per_action_reasons_b parb ON parb.action_reason_id = paru.action_reason_id
AND parb.action_reason_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionReasonId/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
AND parb.action_reason_id = paru.action_reason_id
LEFT JOIN per_action_role_mapping parm ON parm.act_usg_id = paru.action_reason_usage_id
JOIN per_email_addresses email ON email.email_address_id =
  (SELECT email_address_id
   FROM
     (SELECT email_address_id
      FROM per_email_addresses
      WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf.person_id
        AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
        AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
             OR date_to IS NULL)
      ORDER BY email_type DESC)
   WHERE rownum = 1)
LEFT JOIN per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf ON pasf.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
AND pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
LEFT JOIN per_all_assignments_m paam_gestor ON paam_gestor.assignment_type IN ('E',
                                                                               'C')
AND paam_gestor.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
AND paam_gestor.effective_start_date =
  (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
   FROM per_all_assignments_m
   WHERE person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
     AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
     AND assignment_id = paam_gestor.assignment_id
     AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
AND paam_gestor.assignment_id = NVL(NVL(NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][2]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/CEO/EO/AssignmentSupervisorDEORow/NewManagerAssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal() ,

                                      EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/CEO/EO/AssignmentSupervisorDEORow/NewManagerAssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal()) ,

                                      EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                        '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/IdentifiedIncumbentAssignmentId/text()').getStringVal()) ,
                                  pasf.manager_assignment_id)
LEFT JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf2 ON ppnf2.person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
AND ppnf2.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
AND ppnf2.effective_start_date =
  (SELECT MAX(ppnfi.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnfi
   WHERE ppnfi.person_id = ppnf2.person_id
     AND ppnfi.name_type = 'GLOBAL')
LEFT JOIN per_email_addresses email2 ON email2.email_address_id =
  (SELECT email_address_id
   FROM
     (SELECT email_address_id
      FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
      WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf2.person_id
        AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
        AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
             OR date_to IS NULL)
      ORDER BY email_type DESC)
   WHERE rownum = 1)
JOIN hrc_txn_data htd ON htd.transaction_id = hth.transaction_id
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT pu.username , prdt.role_name
   FROM per_users pu , per_user_roles pur , per_roles_dn_tl prdt
   WHERE pu.user_id = pur.user_id
     AND pur.role_id = prdt.role_id
     AND prdt.language = 'PTB') user_role ON user_role.username = htd.submitted_by
AND user_role.role_name = 'ANM - Remuneração'
WHERE paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND assignment_id = paam.assignment_id)
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND user_role.role_name IS NOT NULL
  AND ((ppttl.user_person_type = 'CLT - Docente'
        AND user_role.role_name IS NOT NULL)
       OR ppttl.user_person_type = 'CLT - Geral')
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
```

### Query #207

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS`

```sql
SELECT xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" WorkType, paam.ass_attribute8 OldWorkType, xml_data."ReturnDate" ReturnDate,
       paam.assignment_number AssignmentNumber, paam.assignment_id AssignmentId, paam.person_id PersonId,
       paam.assignment_type AssignmentType, paam.assignment_name, pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE PersonType,
       ppos.PDS_INFORMATION10 ContractDuration, hov.NAME LegalEntityName, hov.ORGANIZATION_CODE LegalEntityCode,
       xrv.REGISTRATION_NUMBER LegalEntityCnpj, xrv.ADDRESS_LINE_1 LegalEntityAddress,
       xrv.ADDRESS_LINE_2 LegalEntityNumber, xrv.TOWN_OR_CITY LegalEntityCity, xrv.REGION_2 LegalEntityState,
       xrv.POSTAL_CODE LegalEntityCep, xrv.COUNTRY LegalEntityCountry, ppnf.DISPLAY_NAME DisplayName,
       NVL(ppnf.FULL_NAME,
             (SELECT ppnf2.FULL_NAME
              FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf2
              WHERE ((papf.PERSON_ID = ppnf2.PERSON_ID)
                     AND (TO_CHAR(ppnf2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                     AND (ppnf2.NAME_TYPE = 'BR')))) FullName,
       (ppnf.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || ppnf.MIDDLE_NAMES || ' ' || ppnf.LAST_NAME) GeneratedName,
       CASE WHEN pp.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH = 'BR' THEN 'Brasileiro(a)' ELSE pp.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH
       END Nationality, pplf.PER_INFORMATION1 SerieCTPS, pplf.PER_INFORMATION2 NumeroCTPS,

  (SELECT pni.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS pni
   WHERE papf.PERSON_ID = pni.PERSON_ID
     AND pni.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
     AND pni.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR') AS EmployeeCPF, ppav.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3 EmployeeAddressAtr3,
       ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_1 EmployeeAddress1, ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_2 EmployeeAddress2,
       ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_3 EmployeeAddress3, ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_4 EmployeeAddress4, ppav.TOWN_OR_CITY EmployeeCity,
       ppav.REGION_1 EmployeeRegion1, ppav.REGION_2 EmployeeRegion2, ppav.COUNTRY EmployeeContry,
       ppav.POSTAL_CODE EmployeeCEP,
       DECODE(pplf.MARITAL_STATUS,
         'M', 'Casado(a)', 'ANM_BR_DES', 'Desquitado(a)', 'ANM_BR_UE', 'União Estável',
         'D', 'Divorciado(a)', 'BR_6', 'Outros', 'ORA_ARX_SEP', 'Separado(a)', 'S',
         'Solteiro(a)', 'W', 'Viúvo(a)', MARITAL_STATUS) AS EstadoCivil,

  (SELECT pni2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS pni2
   WHERE papf.PERSON_ID = pni2.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(pni2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS RG, substr(xml_data."LastUpdateDate",
                                                               1, 19) UpdateDate,
       substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19) CreationDate,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD') Dia,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM') Mes,
       DECODE(TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19),
                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM'),
         '01', 'Janeiro', '02', 'Fevereiro', '03', 'Março', '04', 'Abril', '05', 'Maio',
         '06', 'Junho', '07', 'Julho', '08', 'Agosto', '09', 'Setembro', '10', 'Outubro', '11',
         'Novembro', '12', 'Dezembro') MesDescritivo,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') Ano,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD-MM-YYYY') DataFormatada,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') DataHoraFormatada,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'DD') DiaBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'MM') MesBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') DataBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(xml_data."ReturnDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
         'DD" de "fmMonth" de "YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=PORTUGUESE') AS SIGN_DATE
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf, PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL pptt, PER_PERSONS pp,
     PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F pplf, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos, HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V xrv,
     PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V ppav,
     XMLTABLE('/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow' PASSING hth.xml_data_cache COLUMNS "AssignmentId" NUMBER PATH 'AssignmentId/DATA', "ModeloTrabalho" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'DeiAttribute1/DATA', "ReturnDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'DeiAttributeDate1/DATA', "LastUpdateDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'LastUpdateDate/DATA', "CreationDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'CreationDate/DATA') xml_data
WHERE hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND (htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND paam.ass_attribute8 != xml_data."ModeloTrabalho"
  AND ((paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Híbrido'
        AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Teletrabalho')
       OR (paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Teletrabalho'
           AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Híbrido')
       OR paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Presencial')
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND papf.PERSON_ID = ppnf.PERSON_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE = 'Estagiário'
  AND pp.PERSON_ID = papf.person_id
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(pplf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.assignment_id = xml_data."AssignmentId"
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND papf.PERSON_ID = ppos.PERSON_ID
  AND ppos.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND ppos.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL
  AND paam.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = hov.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND xrv.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = hov.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND papf.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID = ppav.ADDRESS_ID (+)
  AND (TO_CHAR(ppav.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
       OR ppav.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL)
  AND htce.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, htce.transaction_id)
```

### Query #208

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ppnf.display_name AS nome_Func, :p_ato AS ato,
                :p_alinea AS alinea, legalEntity.Empresa AS empregador_Legal,
                :p_descricao_juridico AS descricao_Fato, hlaf.town_or_city AS cidade,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS dataHoje, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                                              'DD') AS dia,
                TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'MM') AS mes, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE),
                                                        'YYYY') AS ano,
                DECODE(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'MM'),
                  '01', 'Janeiro', '02', 'Fevereiro', '03', 'Março', '04', 'Abril', '05',
                  'Maio', '06', 'Junho', '07', 'Julho', '08', 'Agosto', '09', 'Setembro', '10',
                  'Outubro', '11', 'Novembro', '12', 'Dezembro') AS MesDescritivo
FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam,
     HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F hlaf,

  (SELECT haou.organization_id le_organization_id, xrv.registered_name Empresa,
          xrv.town_or_city Cidade
   FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F haou, XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES xep,
        XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V xrv
   WHERE xep.legal_entity_id = haou.legal_entity_id
     AND xrv.legal_entity_id = xep.legal_entity_id
     AND haou.effective_start_date =
       (SELECT MAX(haouInterno.effective_start_date)
        FROM HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F haouInterno
        WHERE haou.organization_id = haouInterno.organization_id)) legalEntity
WHERE papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND legalEntity.le_organization_id = paam.legal_entity_id
  AND paam.location_id = hlaf.location_id (+)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #210

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F`

```sql
SELECT htce.transaction_id AS registro_id, ppnf.display_name AS nome_Func,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___ADVERTÊNCIA%' THEN 'Sanção disciplinar - Advertência' ELSE 'Sanção disciplinar - Suspensão'
       END AS tipoSancao,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___ADVERTÊNCIA%' THEN 'Advertência' ELSE 'Suspensão'
       END AS sancao, papf.person_number AS person_number,
       papf.person_id AS person_id, pea.email_address AS func_Email,
       paam.assignment_number AS func_Matricula,
       'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupo_Documental,
       '15-Advertência' AS tipo_Documento, htce.process_category AS process_category,
       htce.status_category AS status_category, htce.change_effective_date AS change_effective_date,
       htce.created_by AS created_by, htce.creation_date AS creation_date,
       ffsw.assigneddate AS last_update_date, hth.xml_data_cache AS xml_data_cache,
       supervisor.nome_Supervisor AS nome_Empresa, supervisor.email_Supervidor AS email_Empresa
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_DATA htcea, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf,
     FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf,

  (SELECT DISTINCT pasf.person_id AS id, ppnf.display_name AS nome_Supervisor,
                   pea.email_address AS email_Supervidor, pasf.last_update_date, pasf.assignment_id
   FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F pasf, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND pasf.manager_id = ppnf.person_id
     AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
     AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
     AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
     AND pea.person_id(+) = ppnf.person_id
     AND (TO_CHAR(pea.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
          OR pea.date_to IS NULL)
     AND pea.email_type = 'H1') supervisor
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND (htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___ADVERTÊNCIA%'
       OR htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_SANÇÃO_DISCIPLINAR___SUSPENSÃO%')
  AND htcea.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam.Assignment_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                             '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/AssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND pea.person_id(+) = ppnf.person_id
  AND (TO_CHAR(pea.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
       OR pea.date_to IS NULL)
  AND pea.email_type = 'H1'
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.assignment_id = supervisor.assignment_id(+)
  AND ffsw.assigneddate >= NVL(:p_integration_date, ffsw.assigneddate)
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
```

### Query #211

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD`

```sql
SELECT hdt.document_type_id, hth.subject_id AS person_id, hdt.system_document_type,
       'ModeloTrabalhoAssinado.pdf' AS pdf_filename, hdt.document_type AS document_type_display_value,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                          '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()
           ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttribute1/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
       END ModeloDeTrabalho,
       CASE
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                          '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.actions.core.publicModel.entity.ActionOccurrencesEO'']/ActionOccurrencesEORow/ActionDate/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
           WHEN htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global' THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.actions.core.publicModel.entity.ActionOccurrencesEO'']/ActionOccurrencesEORow/ActionDate/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
           ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttributeDate1/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
       END ReturnDate,
       CASE WHEN htce.process_category = 'Promover' THEN 'Promover' ELSE 'Modelo de Trabalho'
       END tipo_modelo_trabalho,

  (SELECT hdor.documents_of_record_id
   FROM HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD hdor
   WHERE hdor.person_id = hth.subject_id
     AND hdor.last_update_date =
       (SELECT MAX(last_update_date)
        FROM HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD
        WHERE person_id = hth.subject_id
          AND object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')) documents_of_record_id
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL hdt
WHERE hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND (htce.process_category = 'Promover'
       OR (htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
           AND htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')
       OR (htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global'))
  AND hdt.document_type IN ('Modelo de Trabalho')
  AND hth.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, hth.transaction_id)
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT hth.subject_id AS person_id, hdt.document_type_id, hdt.system_document_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN paam.ass_attribute_number4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'CartaTransferenciaComMobilidadeAssinada.pdf' ELSE 'CartaTransferenciaSemMobilidadeAssinada.pdf'
                END AS pdf_filename
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL hdt, per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND htce.process_category = 'Transferência Local e Global'
  AND hdt.document_type = 'Carta de Transferência'
  AND paam.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam.assignment_status_type)
  AND hth.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, hth.transaction_id)
```

### Query #214

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`
