```sql
SELECT PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID,
       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
         'DD "DE" FMMONTH "DE" YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=PORTUGUESE') data_documento, ppnf.display_name nome_completo, cs.SALARY_AMOUNT salario, papf.person_id,
       GESTOR.display_name nome_gestor, hlaf.town_or_city cidade, 'Departamento Pessoal Digital' grupo_documental,
                                                                                                 paam.assignment_number matricula_atual,
                                                                                                 '736 - Termo de transferência de colaborador' tipo_documento,
                                                                                                                                               TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                                                                                                                                 'MM/YYYY') mes_ano_transferencia,
                                                                                                                                               TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') dia_mes_ano_transferencia,
                                                                                                                                               TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,

                                                                                                                                                         'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                                                                                                                                 'DD/MM/YYYY') DTEF,
                                                                                                                                               hlaf.location_name filial,
                                                                                                                                               paam.assignment_name cargo_colaborador,
                                                                                                                                               ple.name empresa ,
                                                                                                                                               EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName= "temPacoteMobilidade"]/NewValue/text()').getStringVal() AJUDA_CUSTO ,

  (SELECT DISTINCT TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || REGION_2
   FROM hr_locations_all_f
   WHERE LOCATION_ID = NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                             '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/WorkRelationshipMVORow/WorkTermsMDVORow/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''LocationId'']/OldId/text()').getStringVal(),

                     EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                       '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''LocationId'']/OldId/text()').getStringVal())
     AND ROWNUM = 1) ESTAB_ORIGEM ,

  (SELECT TOWN_OR_CITY || ' - ' || REGION_2
   FROM hr_locations_all_f
   WHERE LOCATION_ID = NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                             '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/WorkRelationshipMVORow/WorkTermsMDVORow/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''LocationId'']/NewId/text()').getStringVal(),

                     EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                       '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''LocationId'']/NewId/text()').getStringVal())
     AND ROWNUM = 1) ESTAB_DEST ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/WorkRelationshipMVORow/WorkTermsMDVORow/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''EstablishmentId'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal(),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[./AttributeName=''EstablishmentId'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()) estabelecimento
FROM per_all_people_f papf, per_person_names_f ppnf, per_all_assignments_m paam, cmp_salary cs,
     hr_locations_all_f_vl hlaf, PER_LEGAL_EMPLOYERS ple,

  (SELECT PPNF_LIDER.DISPLAY_NAME , PASF.PERSON_ID
   FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF_LIDER, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F PASF
   WHERE 1=1
     AND PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID = PASF.MANAGER_ID
     AND PPNF_LIDER.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
     AND PPNF_LIDER.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF_LIDER.PERSON_ID)
     AND PASF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
        FROM PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F
        WHERE PERSON_ID = PASF.PERSON_ID)) GESTOR, hrc_txn_header hth
WHERE TO_CHAR(papf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND cs.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND TO_CHAR(cs.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND GESTOR.PERSON_ID (+) = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = hlaf.LOCATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(hlaf.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.legal_entity_id = ple.organization_id
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND hth.transaction_id = :p_transaction
```

### Query #215

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, BEN_PL_TYP_F`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(PL_TYP.NAME) "Tipo de Benefício" , UPPER(PL.NAME) "Categoria do Benefício" ,
                UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) "Descrição do Benefício" , PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_ID , PAAM.PERSON_ID
FROM BEN_PL_TYP_F PL_TYP, BEN_PL_F PL, BEN_ELIG_PER_F FACT, BEN_OPT_F BOF_OPT, BEN_ELIG_PER_OPT_F OPT,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF
WHERE PL_TYP.PL_TYP_ID = PL.PL_TYP_ID
  AND FACT.PL_ID = PL.PL_ID
  AND FACT.ELIG_PER_ID = OPT.ELIG_PER_ID
  AND FACT.PER_IN_LER_ID = OPT.PER_IN_LER_ID
  AND OPT.OPT_ID = BOF_OPT.OPT_ID (+)
  AND OPT.ELIG_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND FACT.PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
  AND PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE = 'ACTIVE'
  AND TO_CHAR(PAAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND TO_CHAR(FACT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = '31/12/4712'
  AND PAPF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
     FROM PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID)
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND PPNF.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
     FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F
     WHERE PERSON_ID = PPNF.PERSON_ID)
  AND (UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%NÃO DESEJO%'
       OR BOF_OPT.NAME IS NULL)
  AND (UPPER(BOF_OPT.NAME) NOT LIKE '%CANCELAR%'
       OR BOF_OPT.NAME IS NULL)
ORDER BY "Tipo de Benefício", "Categoria do Benefício", "Descrição do Benefício"
```

### Query #216

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" WorkType, paam.ass_attribute8 OldWorkType, xml_data."ReturnDate" ReturnDate,
       paam.assignment_number AssignmentNumber, paam.assignment_id AssignmentId, paam.person_id PersonId,
       paam.assignment_type AssignmentType,
       CASE
           WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''AssignmentName'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal() IS NULL THEN paam.assignment_name
           ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                  '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/AssignmentMDVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''AssignmentName'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal()
       END assignment_name, pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE PersonType, ppos.PDS_INFORMATION10 ContractDuration,
       hov.NAME LegalEntityName, hov.ORGANIZATION_CODE LegalEntityCode,
       xrv.REGISTRATION_NUMBER LegalEntityCnpj, xrv.ADDRESS_LINE_1 LegalEntityAddress,
       xrv.ADDRESS_LINE_2 LegalEntityNumber, xrv.TOWN_OR_CITY LegalEntityCity, xrv.REGION_2 LegalEntityState,
       xrv.POSTAL_CODE LegalEntityCep, xrv.COUNTRY LegalEntityCountry, hov_estab.NAME ReportingEstablishmentName,
       hov_estab.ORGANIZATION_CODE EstablishmentCode, xrv_estab.REGISTRATION_NUMBER EstablishmentCnpj,
       xrv_estab.ADDRESS_LINE_1 EstablishmentAddress, xrv_estab.ADDRESS_LINE_2 EstablishmentNumber,
       xrv_estab.TOWN_OR_CITY EstablishmentCity, xrv_estab.REGION_2 EstablishmentState,
       xrv_estab.POSTAL_CODE EstablishmentCep, xrv_estab.COUNTRY EstablishmentCountry, ppnf.DISPLAY_NAME DisplayName,
       NVL(ppnf.FULL_NAME,
             (SELECT ppnf2.FULL_NAME
              FROM PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf2
              WHERE ((papf.PERSON_ID = ppnf2.PERSON_ID)
                     AND (TO_CHAR(ppnf2.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
                     AND (ppnf2.NAME_TYPE = 'BR')))) FullName,
       (ppnf.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || ppnf.MIDDLE_NAMES || ' ' || ppnf.LAST_NAME) GeneratedName,
       CASE WHEN pp.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH = 'BR' THEN 'Brasileiro(a)' ELSE pp.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH
       END Nationality, pplf.PER_INFORMATION1 SerieCTPS, pplf.PER_INFORMATION2 NumeroCTPS,

  (SELECT pni.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS pni
   WHERE papf.PERSON_ID = pni.PERSON_ID
     AND pni.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
     AND pni.LEGISLATION_CODE = 'BR') AS EmployeeCPF, ppav.ADDL_ADDRESS_ATTRIBUTE3 EmployeeAddressAtr3,
       ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_1 EmployeeAddress1, ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_2 EmployeeAddress2,
       ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_3 EmployeeAddress3, ppav.ADDRESS_LINE_4 EmployeeAddress4, ppav.TOWN_OR_CITY EmployeeCity,
       ppav.REGION_1 EmployeeRegion1, ppav.REGION_2 EmployeeRegion2, ppav.COUNTRY EmployeeContry,
       ppav.POSTAL_CODE EmployeeCEP,
       DECODE(pplf.MARITAL_STATUS,
         'M', 'Casado(a)', 'ANM_BR_DES', 'Desquitado(a)', 'ANM_BR_UE', 'União Estável',
         'D', 'Divorciado(a)', 'BR_6', 'Outros', 'ORA_ARX_SEP', 'Separado(a)', 'S',
         'Solteiro(a)', 'W', 'Viúvo(a)', MARITAL_STATUS) AS EstadoCivil,

  (SELECT pni2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS pni2
   WHERE papf.PERSON_ID = pni2.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(pni2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS RG, substr(xml_data."LastUpdateDate",
                                                               1, 19) UpdateDate,
       substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19) CreationDate,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."DataInicio", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD') Dia,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."DataInicio", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM') Mes,
       DECODE(TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."DataInicio", 1, 19),
                        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM'),
         '01', 'Janeiro', '02', 'Fevereiro', '03', 'Março', '04', 'Abril', '05', 'Maio',
         '06', 'Junho', '07', 'Julho', '08', 'Agosto', '09', 'Setembro', '10', 'Outubro', '11',
         'Novembro', '12', 'Dezembro') MesDescritivo,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."DataInicio", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') Ano,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD-MM-YYYY') DataFormatada,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') DataHoraFormatada,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'DD') DiaBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'MM') MesBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(substr(xml_data."CreationDate", 1, 19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 3/24, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') DataBrasil,
       TO_CHAR(to_date(xml_data."ReturnDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
         'DD" de "fmMonth" de "YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=PORTUGUESE') AS SIGN_DATE , htce.transaction_id
FROM hrc_txn_console_entry htce, hrc_txn_header hth, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw, per_all_people_f papf,
     per_person_names_f ppnf, per_person_types_tl pptt, per_all_assignments_m paam,
     per_email_addresses pea, per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf, per_all_assignments_m paam_gestor,
     per_person_names_f ppnf2, per_email_addresses pea2,
     XMLTABLE('/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow' PASSING hth.xml_data_cache COLUMNS "AssignmentId" NUMBER PATH 'AssignmentId/DATA', "ModeloTrabalho" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'DeiAttribute1/DATA', "ReturnDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'ActionDate/DATA', "LastUpdateDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'LastUpdateDate/DATA', "DataInicio" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'DeiAttributeDate1/DATA', "CreationDate" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'CreationDate/DATA') xml_data, per_person_addresses_v ppav, HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov,
     HR_ORGANIZATION_V hov_estab, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V xrv, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V xrv_estab,
     PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F pplf, PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE ppos, PER_PERSONS pp
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.process_category IN ('Promover', 'Promover e Alterar Posição',
                                'Gerenciar Registros de Documento', 'Manage Document Records')
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND (htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = xml_data."AssignmentId"
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.ass_attribute8 != xml_data."ModeloTrabalho"
  AND ((paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Híbrido'
        AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Teletrabalho')
       OR (paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Teletrabalho'
           AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Híbrido')
       OR paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Presencial')
  AND pea.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND pasf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pasf.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND paam_gestor.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
       AND primary_flag = paam_gestor.primary_flag
       AND assignment_status_type = paam_gestor.assignment_status_type)
  AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf2.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf2.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(ppnfi.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f ppnfi
     WHERE ppnfi.person_id = ppnf2.person_id)
  AND ppnf2.person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
  AND pea2.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf2.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE != 'Estagiário'
  AND papf.MAILING_ADDRESS_ID = ppav.ADDRESS_ID(+)
  AND pplf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND paam.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = hov.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(hov.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hov.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND xrv.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = hov.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND paam.ESTABLISHMENT_ID = hov_estab.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(hov_estab.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hov_estab.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENT'
  AND xrv_estab.ESTABLISHMENT_ID = hov_estab.ESTABLISHMENT_ID
  AND paam.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID = ppos.PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
  AND ppos.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND ppos.ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL
  AND pp.PERSON_ID = papf.person_id
  AND htce.transaction_id = NVL(:p_transaction_id, htce.transaction_id)
```

### Query #217

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY, PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M`

```sql
SELECT htce.transaction_id AS transaction_id, ppnf.display_name AS nome_Func, papf.person_number AS person_number,
       papf.person_id AS person_id, pea.email_address AS func_Email, ppnf2.display_name AS nome_Gestor,
       pea2.email_address AS gestor_Email,
       REPLACE(REPLACE(paam.assignment_number, 'E', ''), '-', '') AS func_Matricula, htce.object_name AS object_name,
       htce.process_category AS process_category, htce.status_category AS status_category,
       htce.change_effective_date AS change_effective_date, htce.created_by AS created_by, htce.creation_date AS creation_date,
       GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) AS last_update_date, paam.ass_attribute8 AS modelo_trabalho_antigo,
       xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" AS modelo_trabalho, 1 AS altera_modelo_trabalho, pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE AS person_type,
       'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupo_documental,
       CASE
           WHEN xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" = 'Presencial' THEN '703-Termo Retorno ao Presencial' ELSE '694-Termo Teletrabalho/Híbrido/Ergonomia'
       END AS tipo_documento, paam.person_type_id AS person_type_id
FROM hrc_txn_console_entry htce, hrc_txn_header hth, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw, per_all_people_f papf,
     per_person_names_f ppnf, per_person_types_tl pptt, per_all_assignments_m paam,
     per_email_addresses pea, per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf, per_all_assignments_m paam_gestor,
     per_person_names_f ppnf2, per_email_addresses pea2,
     XMLTABLE('/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/DocumentsOfRecordEORow' PASSING hth.xml_data_cache COLUMNS "AssignmentId" NUMBER PATH 'AssignmentId/DATA', "ModeloTrabalho" VARCHAR2(150) PATH 'DeiAttribute1/DATA') xml_data
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND (htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_MODELO_DE_TRABALHO%')
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = xml_data."AssignmentId"
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam.ass_attribute8 != xml_data."ModeloTrabalho"
  AND ((paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Híbrido'
        AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Teletrabalho')
       OR (paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Teletrabalho'
           AND xml_data."ModeloTrabalho" != 'Híbrido')
       OR paam.ass_attribute8 = 'Presencial')
  AND pea.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'

  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_id = pasf.manager_assignment_id

  AND paam_gestor.effective_start_date =

  AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf2.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf2.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(ppnfi.effective_start_date)

     WHERE ppnfi.person_id = ppnf2.person_id)
  AND ppnf2.person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
  AND pea2.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf2.person_id

          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
UNION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeAssignmentDEO'']/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ELSE EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             END AS modelo_trabalho,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeAssignmentDEO'']/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() != EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      AND ((EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeAssignmentDEO'']/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() = 'Híbrido'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() != 'Teletrabalho'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() IS NOT NULL)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           OR (EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeAssignmentDEO'']/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() = 'Teletrabalho'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() != 'Híbrido'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() IS NOT NULL)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() IS NOT NULL)) THEN 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal() = 'Presencial' THEN '703-Termo Retorno ao Presencial'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ELSE '694-Termo Teletrabalho/Híbrido/Ergonomia'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             END AS tipo_documento,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             paam.person_type_id AS person_type_id

             AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)

  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND htce.process_category = 'Promover'
  AND (htce.process_category = 'Promover'
       OR pab.action_code IN ('LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE'))
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,
                             '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal()
  AND paam.ASS_ATTRIBUTE8 <> EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                               '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeAssignmentDEO'']/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND pab.action_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionId/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
  AND parb.action_reason_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionReasonId/DATA/text()').getStringVal()
  AND paru.action_reason_id(+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id (+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id(+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND pea.email_address_id =

          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'

        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND pasf.person_id (+) = paam.person_id
  AND pasf.assignment_id (+) = paam.assignment_id
  AND pea2.person_id (+) = pasf.person_id
  AND ppnf2.person_id (+) = paam_gestor.person_id
  AND pasf.manager_assignment_id = paam_gestor.assignment_id (+)
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
ORDER BY last_update_date DESC

       EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

         '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/oldValue/text()').getStringVal () AS modelo_trabalho_antigo ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal () AS modelo_trabalho ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/oldValue/text()').getStringVal () != EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal () THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END altera_modelo_trabalho ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE AS person_type ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupo_documental ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO'']/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.EmployeeTermsDEO'']/EmployeeTermsDEORow/AssAttribute8/DATA/text()').getStringVal () = 'Presencial' THEN '703-Termo Retorno ao Presencial'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE '694-Termo Teletrabalho/Híbrido/Ergonomia'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END AS tipo_documento ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       paam.person_type_id AS person_type_id ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       parm.role_common_name ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           WHEN parm.role_common_name = 'ANM_-_REMUNERACAO'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                OR pab.action_code = 'ANM_ALT_CH' THEN 'Y'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ELSE 'N'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       END AS indicador_remuneracao
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce , HRC_TXN_HEADER hth , FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw , PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf ,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf , PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL pptt , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam ,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea , PER_ASSIGNMENT_SUPERVISORS_F pasf , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam_gestor ,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf2 , PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea2 , per_actions_b pab , per_action_reasons_b parb ,
     per_action_reason_usages paru , per_action_role_mapping parm
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND ((htce.process_category IN ('Promover')
        OR pab.action_code IN ('LOCAL_TRANSF_CHGSALARY', 'LOCAL_TRANSF_PROMOTE'))
       OR (htce.process_category IN ('Promover e Alterar Posição','Promote and Change Position')
           AND pab.action_code IN ('PROMOTION','ANM_MODALIDADE','ANM_ALT_CARGO_PROMOTE')))
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,
                             '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND paam.assignment_type = 'E'
  AND pab.action_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionId/DATA/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND parb.action_reason_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO/WhenAndWhyTEORow/ActionReasonId/DATA/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND paru.action_reason_id (+) = parb.action_reason_id
  AND paru.action_id (+) = pab.action_id
  AND parm.act_usg_id (+) = paru.action_reason_usage_id
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND pea.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_type IN ('E', 'C')
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND paam_gestor.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(effective_start_date)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
       AND assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
       AND assignment_id = paam_gestor.assignment_id
       AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_id = NVL(EXTRACTVALUE(xml_data_cache,

                                        '//AssignmentSupervisorDEORow/ManagerAssignmentId/DATA'),
                                    pasf.manager_assignment_id)
  AND pasf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND pasf.assignment_id = paam.assignment_id
  AND TO_CHAR(pasf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf2.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND ppnf2.effective_start_date =
    (SELECT MAX(ppnfi.effective_start_date)
     FROM per_person_names_f ppnfi
     WHERE ppnfi.person_id = ppnf2.person_id)
  AND ppnf2.person_id = paam_gestor.person_id
  AND pea2.email_address_id =
    (SELECT email_address_id
     FROM
       (SELECT email_address_id
        FROM PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
        WHERE person_id (+) = ppnf2.person_id
          AND email_type IN ('H1', 'W1', NULL)
          AND (TO_CHAR(date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
               OR date_to IS NULL)
        ORDER BY email_type DESC)
     WHERE rownum = 1)
  AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/oldValue/text()').getStringVal () != EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal ()
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
ORDER BY last_update_date DESC
```

### Query #219

### Query #222

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT`

```sql
SELECT BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID AS AnteriorID, DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID, ROWNUM AS LINHA, NAM.DISPLAY_NAME,

  (SELECT PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI3
   WHERE DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PNI3.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE(+)) = 'CPF') AS DPN_CPF
FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT DPNT, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM
WHERE BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = DPNT.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT DPN1.DPNT_PERSON_ID
     FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN1, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT DPN1
     WHERE BEN1.PL_TYP_ID = BEN.PL_TYP_ID
       AND BEN1.PERSON_ID = BEN.PERSON_ID
       AND DPN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = BEN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
       AND (BEN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD NOT IN ('BCKDT', 'VOIDD')
            OR BEN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_STAT_CD IS NULL)
       AND TO_CHAR(BEN1.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
       AND (BEN1.INTERIM_FLAG NOT IN ('Y')))
```

### Query #223

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation, HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_PASSPORTS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES, FND_LOOKUP_VALUES`

```sql
SELECT DRL.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER20 CodDependente, DRL.CONTACT_TYPE RelacTipo, DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID,
       NAM.FULL_NAME NomeDpendente, DRL.PERSON_ID, NACIONALIDADE.MEANING AS CONJ_NACLT,
       PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS CONJ_AD_LINE1, PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_2 AS CONJ_AD_LINE2,
       PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_3 AS CONJ_AD_LINE3, PPAV.ADDRESS_LINE_4 AS CONJ_AD_LINE4, PPAV.TOWN_OR_CITY AS CONJ_CITY,
       PPAV.REGION_2 AS CONJ_UF,
       CASE
           WHEN PASSPORT.ISSUING_COUNTRY IS NOT NULL
                AND PASSPORT.ISSUING_COUNTRY != 'BR' THEN LookupPassport.MEANING ELSE ''
       END CONJ_PASSPORT_COUNTRY, PPAV.REGION_2 AS CONJ_RG_UF, PPH.PHONE_NUMBER AS CONJ_PHONE,
       PPH.AREA_CODE AS CONJ_AREA_CODE, PPAV.COUNTRY AS CONJ_COUNTRY, PPAV.POSTAL_CODE AS CONJ_CEP,
       EMA.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS CONJ_EMAIL, TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                                          'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CONJBIRTH,

  (SELECT PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_RG,

  (SELECT PNI2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI2
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI2.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'CPF') AS CONJ_CPF,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(PNI3.ISSUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI3
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI3.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_DATA_EXP_RG,

  (SELECT PNI4.PLACE_OF_ISSUE
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI4
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI4.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI4.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_ORGAO_EXP_RG
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F DRL
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PEO ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PEO.PERSON_ID)
                                   AND (TO_CHAR(PEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                          'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID)
                                     AND (TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
                                     AND (NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV ON ((DRL.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID)
                                          AND (TO_CHAR(PPAV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID))
LEFT JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES NACIONALIDADE ON NACIONALIDADE.LOOKUP_CODE = PP.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH
AND NACIONALIDADE.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND NACIONALIDADE.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'NATIONALITY'
LEFT JOIN PER_PASSPORTS PASSPORT ON PASSPORT.PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID
LEFT JOIN FND_LOOKUP_VALUES LookupPassport ON LookupPassport.LOOKUP_CODE = PASSPORT.ISSUING_COUNTRY
AND LookupPassport.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
AND LookupPassport.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'HZ_DOMAIN_SUFFIX_LIST'
LEFT JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMA ON ((PEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = EMA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_PHONES PPH ON ((PEO.PERSON_ID = PPH.PERSON_ID))
WHERE (TO_CHAR(DRL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
  AND DRL.CONTACT_TYPE = 'S'
```

```sql
SELECT DRL.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER20 CodDependente, DRL.CONTACT_TYPE RelacTipo, DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID,

       PPAV.REGION_2 AS CONJ_UF, PPAV.REGION_2 AS CONJ_RG_UF, PPH.PHONE_NUMBER AS CONJ_PHONE,
       PPH.AREA_CODE AS CONJ_AREA_CODE, PPAV.COUNTRY AS CONJ_COUNTRY, PPAV.POSTAL_CODE AS CONJ_CEP,
       EMA.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS CONJ_EMAIL, TO_CHAR(PP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                                          'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CONJBIRTH,

  (SELECT PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_RG,

  (SELECT PNI2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI2
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI2.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'CPF') AS CONJ_CPF,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(PNI3.ISSUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI3
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI3.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_DATA_EXP_RG,

  (SELECT PNI4.PLACE_OF_ISSUE
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI4
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI4.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI4.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_ORGAO_EXP_RG
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F DRL
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PEO ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PEO.PERSON_ID)
                                   AND (TO_CHAR(PEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                          'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID)
                                     AND (TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
                                     AND (NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV ON ((DRL.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID)
                                          AND (TO_CHAR(PPAV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMA ON ((PEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = EMA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_PHONES PPH ON ((PEO.PERSON_ID = PPH.PERSON_ID))
WHERE (TO_CHAR(DRL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
  AND DRL.CONTACT_TYPE = 'S'
```

### Query #225

**Tabelas:** `PER_PERSONS, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F, PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F, PER_PHONES, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS, PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES`

```sql

                NAM.FULL_NAME NomeDpendente, DRL.PERSON_ID, PP.COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH AS CONJ_NACLT,

   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI2.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI2.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'CPF') AS CONJ_CPF,

  (SELECT TO_CHAR(PNI3.ISSUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI3
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI3.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI3.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_DATA_EXP_RG,

  (SELECT PNI4.PLACE_OF_ISSUE
   FROM PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI4
   WHERE DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PNI4.PERSON_ID
     AND UPPER(PNI4.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE) = 'RG') AS CONJ_ORGAO_EXP_RG
FROM PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F DRL
LEFT JOIN PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PEO ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PEO.PERSON_ID)
                                   AND (TO_CHAR(PEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                          'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID)
                                     AND (TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
                                     AND (NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV ON ((DRL.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID)
                                          AND (TO_CHAR(PPAV.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,
                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'))
LEFT JOIN PER_PERSONS PP ON ((DRL.CONTACT_PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EMA ON ((PEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = EMA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID))
LEFT JOIN PER_PHONES PPH ON ((PEO.PERSON_ID = PPH.PERSON_ID))
WHERE (TO_CHAR(DRL.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE) = '4712-12-31')
  AND DRL.CONTACT_TYPE = 'S'
```

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_2 NUMERO_COLABORADOR ,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_3 COMPLEMENTO_COLABORADOR ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.documentsOfRecord.core.protectedModel.entity.DocumentsOfRecordEO''][1]/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttributeDate1/DATA/text()').getStringVal(),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         1,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.documentsOfRecord.core.protectedModel.entity.DocumentsOfRecordEO''][1]/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttributeDate2/DATA/text()').getStringVal(),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         19),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATA_INICIO_AVISO ,
