```sql
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ffsw.UpdatedDate) AS AQUI
FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V HOV , XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V XRV , PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF ,
     PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF , PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI , PER_ADDRESSES_F PAF ,
     PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM , PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV , PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE PPOS ,
     PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF , HRC_TXN_HEADER HTH , HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY HTCE ,
     HRC_TXN_DATA HTD , FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK FFSW , HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL LOC
WHERE PPNF.PERSON_ID = PPOS.PERSON_ID
  AND PAAM.LOCATION_ID (+) = LOC.LOCATION_ID
  AND PAPF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PPLF.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID
  AND PPAV.ADDRESS_ID = PAF.ADDRESS_ID
  AND PAAM.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = HOV.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND XRV.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID(+) = HOV.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND HOV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE(+) = 'CPF'
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'
  AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (PAAM.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE IN ('E', 'C', 'P'))
  AND LOC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
     FROM HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F_VL
     WHERE location_id = loc.location_id)
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND htd.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND ppos.DATE_START =
    (SELECT MAX(DATE_START)
     FROM PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
     WHERE ppos.person_id = person_id)
  AND paam.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE =
    (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
     FROM per_all_assignments_m
     WHERE paam.person_id = person_id)
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN PPNF.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PPNF.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND paam.assignment_id = EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                             '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/TxnSimulate/getRepresentativeList/assignmentId/text()').getStringVal()
  AND EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

        '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.documentsOfRecord.core.protectedModel.entity.DocumentsOfRecordEO''][1]/DocumentsOfRecordEORow/DeiAttribute1/DATA/text()').getStringVal() IN ('Aviso_Término Antecipado do Contrato de Experiência',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Aviso Prévio_Indenizado_Opção Sindicato_Sul',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Aviso Prévio_Indenizado',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Aviso Prévio_Trabalhado',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Aviso Prévio_Trabalhado_Opção Sindicato_Sul',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Termo de Extinção do Contrato de Trabalho Por Acordo entre as Partes',
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Aviso_Término de Contrato')
  AND ffsw.assignees LIKE '%hcm.integracao%'
  AND htce.status_category = 'PENDING'
  AND htce.process_category = 'Gerenciar Registros de Documento'
  AND htce.object_name LIKE '%BR_DATA_DE_HOMOLOGAÇÃO%'
  AND htce.console_txn_status = 'ORA_HRC_TXN_IN PROGRESS'
  AND PPOS.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND paam.assignment_number = :p_assignment_number
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
```

### Query #227

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `HR_ORGANIZATION_V`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT HOV.NAME NOME_EMPREGADOR_LEGAL, XRV.REGISTRATION_NUMBER CNPJ,
                XRV.ADDRESS_LINE_1 LOGRADOURO_EMPRESA, XRV.ADDRESS_LINE_2 NUMERO_EMPRESA,
                XRV.ADDRESS_LINE_3 BAIRRO_EMPRESA, XRV.POSTAL_CODE CEP_EMPRESA,
                XRV.TOWN_OR_CITY CIDADE_EMPRESA, XRV.REGION_2 ESTADO_EMPRESA,
                PPNF.FULL_NAME NOME_FUNCIONARIO, PPLF.PER_INFORMATION1 NUMERO_CTPS,
                PPLF.PER_INFORMATION2 SERIE_CTPS, PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER CPF_COLABORADOR,
                PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_1 LOGRADOURO_COLABORADOR, PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_2 NUMERO_COLABORADOR,
                PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_3 COMPLEMENTO_COLABORADOR, PAF.ADDRESS_LINE_4 BAIRRO_COLABORADOR,
                PAF.POSTAL_CODE CEP_COLABORADOR, PAF.TOWN_OR_CITY CIDADE_COLABORADOR,
                PAF.REGION_2 ESTADO_COLABORADOR, HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE35 LOCAL_DEMISSIONAL,
                HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE37 ENDERECO_DEMISSIONAL,
                TO_CHAR(HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_DEMISSIONAL,
                TO_CHAR(HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP2, 'HH:mm') HORA_DEMISSIONAL, HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE36 LOCAL_HOMOLOGACAO,
                HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE38 ENDERECO_HOMOLOGACAO,
                TO_CHAR(HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATA_HOMOLOGACAO,
                TO_CHAR(HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_TIMESTAMP1, 'HH:mm') HORA_HOMOLOGACAO,
                TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,
                  'DD "de" fmMonth "de" YYYY', 'nls_date_language=Portuguese') DATA_DOCUMENTO
FROM HR_ORGANIZATION_V HOV, XLE_REGISTRATIONS_V XRV, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F PPNF,
     PER_PEOPLE_LEGISLATIVE_F PPLF, PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI, PER_ADDRESSES_F PAF,
     HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD HDOR , PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M PAAM, PER_PERSON_ADDRESSES_V PPAV
WHERE PPNF.PERSON_ID = PAAM.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PPLF.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = HDOR.PERSON_ID
  AND PPNF.PERSON_ID = PPAV.PERSON_ID
  AND PPAV.ADDRESS_ID = PAF.ADDRESS_ID
  AND PAAM.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = HOV.ORGANIZATION_ID
  AND XRV.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID(+) = HOV.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
  AND HOV.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'HCM_LEMP'
  AND PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
  AND HDOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'BR_DATA_DE_HOMOLOGAÇÃO'
  AND PPNF.NAME_TYPE = 'BR'
```

### Query #228

**Tags:** `HCM & HR`

**Tabelas:** `PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, PAY_BANK_ACCOUNTS, PER_PERSON_TYPE_USAGES_M`

```sql
SELECT 'MERGE' METADATA, 'ExternalBankAccount' ExternalBankAccount, 'BRL' CURRENCY_CODE, 'BR' COUNTRY_CODE,
                                                                                              BANK_NAME || '|' || BANK_NUMBER || '|' || BANK_BRANCH_NAME || '|' || BRANCH_NUMBER BANK_DETAILS,
                                                                                              DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE4 NUMERO_CONTA_BANCARIA
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M asg, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD DOR, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL HDT,
     CE_BANK_BRANCHES_V cbbv
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN asg.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND asg.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND papf.PERSON_ID = asg.PERSON_ID
  AND (asg.system_person_type =
         (SELECT MAX(pptum1.system_person_type)
          FROM per_person_type_usages_m pptum1
          WHERE asg.PERSON_ID = pptum1.PERSON_ID)
       AND ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND DOR.DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID = HDT.DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID(+)
       AND ASG.PERSON_ID = DOR.PERSON_ID
       AND HDT.SYSTEM_DOCUMENT_TYPE IN ('BR_COMPROVANTE_DA_AGÊNCIA_E_DE_CONTA_BANCÁRIA')
       AND DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3 IS NOT NULL
       AND dor.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3 = cbbv.BRANCH_PARTY_ID
       AND LENGTH(DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3) = 15
       AND NOT EXISTS
         (SELECT 'X'
          FROM PAY_BANK_ACCOUNTS PBA, PAY_PERSON_PAY_METHODS_F PPPM, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN PPRD
          WHERE PBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = PPPM.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
            AND PPRD.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID = PPPM.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID
            AND PPRD.PERSON_ID = ASG.PERSON_ID
            AND TO_CHAR(PBA.BRANCH_ID) = DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3
            AND PBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM = DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE4))
```

```sql
FROM PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M asg, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf, HR_DOCUMENTS_OF_RECORD DOR, HR_DOCUMENT_TYPES_VL HDT,
     CE_BANK_BRANCHES_V cbbv
WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN asg.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND asg.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND papf.PERSON_ID = asg.PERSON_ID
  AND (asg.system_person_type =
         (SELECT MAX(pptum1.system_person_type)
          FROM per_person_type_usages_m pptum1
          WHERE asg.PERSON_ID = pptum1.PERSON_ID)
       AND ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND DOR.DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID = HDT.DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID(+)
       AND ASG.PERSON_ID = DOR.PERSON_ID
       AND HDT.SYSTEM_DOCUMENT_TYPE IN ('BR_COMPROVANTE_DA_AGÊNCIA_E_DE_CONTA_BANCÁRIA')
       AND DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3 IS NOT NULL
       AND dor.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3 = cbbv.BRANCH_PARTY_ID
       AND LENGTH(DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3) = 15
       AND NOT EXISTS
         (SELECT 'X'
          FROM PAY_BANK_ACCOUNTS PBA, PAY_PERSON_PAY_METHODS_F PPPM, PAY_PAY_RELATIONSHIPS_DN PPRD
          WHERE PBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = PPPM.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
            AND PPRD.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID = PPPM.PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID
            AND PPRD.PERSON_ID = ASG.PERSON_ID
            AND TO_CHAR(PBA.BRANCH_ID) = DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE3
            AND PBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM = DOR.DEI_ATTRIBUTE4))
```

```sql
       AND ASG.PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG = 'Y'
```

## SYS & Foundation

### Query #1

## SYS & Foundation

### Query #1

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS`

```sql
SELECT FFVV.FLEX_VALUE AS CODIGO, FFVV.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRICAO
FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVV
JOIN FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS ON FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
WHERE FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'CLIB_NUM_APO_ESTG'
  AND NVL(FFVV.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(FFVV.START_DATE_ACTIVE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(FFVV.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

### Query #2

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS`

```sql
SELECT FFVV.FLEX_VALUE AS COD_CCUSTO, FFVV.DESCRIPTION AS DESC_CCUSTO
FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVV
JOIN FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS ON FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
WHERE FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'Centro de Custo CLIENT_B'
  AND NVL(FFVV.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
  AND NVL(FFVV.SUMMARY_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(FFVV.START_DATE_ACTIVE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(FFVV.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                               TRUNC(SYSDATE))
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, FUN_CLIENT_BU_V`

### Query #3

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_VALUES, FUN_CLIENT_BU_V`

```sql
SELECT b.bu_name bu_name_assign, b.SERVICE_PROVIDER_BU_ID, cc.comb1 cc_pass, cc.comb2 cc_pay, cc.bu_name,
       cc.lookup_type
FROM FUN_CLIENT_BU_V b,

  (SELECT description comb1, tag comb2, MEANING bu_name, lookup_type
   FROM FND_LOOKUP_VALUES
   WHERE lookup_type = 'XSUPPLIER_COMB_'||upper(:P_ORGANIZATION)||'_'||CASE
                                                                           WHEN upper(:P_COUNTRY_CODE) <> 'BR' THEN 'EX'
                                                                           ELSE 'BR'
                                                                       END
     AND LANGUAGE='US'
     AND ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y'
     AND nvl(END_DATE_ACTIVE, sysdate+1) > sysdate) cc
WHERE b.UPSTREAM_MODULE_KEY = 'REQUISITIONING_BF'
  AND substr(cc.bu_name, 1,(instr(cc.bu_name, '-')-1)) = substr(b.bu_name,
                                                           1,(instr(b.bu_name,
                                                                '-')-1))
ORDER BY 1 DESC
```

```sql
SELECT A.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,

  (SELECT FFVV.DESCRIPTION
   FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVV, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS
   WHERE FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'GL_CONTA_CONTABIL CLIENT_A'
     AND FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
     AND FFVV.FLEX_VALUE = A.SEGMENT4) DESC_CONTA, A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.SEGMENT3, A.SEGMENT4, A.SEGMENT5, A.SEGMENT6,
       A.SEGMENT7, A.SEGMENT8, A.SEGMENT9, ROWNUM LINE_NUMBER
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID CODE_COMBINATION_ID, GCC.SEGMENT1, GCC.SEGMENT2, GCC.SEGMENT3, GCC.SEGMENT4,
                   GCC.SEGMENT5, GCC.SEGMENT6, GCC.SEGMENT7, GCC.SEGMENT8, GCC.SEGMENT9
   FROM FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY FDH, FA_DEPRN_SUMMARY FDS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC
   WHERE FDH.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
     AND FDH.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
     AND FDS.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
     AND FDS.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
     AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_EMPRESA
     AND FDS.PERIOD_COUNTER IN
       (SELECT FDP.PERIOD_COUNTER
        FROM FA_DEPRN_PERIODS FDP
        WHERE :P_DATA_TRANSACAO BETWEEN FDP.CALENDAR_PERIOD_OPEN_DATE AND FDP.CALENDAR_PERIOD_CLOSE_DATE)) A
ORDER BY A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.SEGMENT3, A.SEGMENT4, A.SEGMENT5, A.SEGMENT6, A.SEGMENT7,
         A.SEGMENT8, A.SEGMENT9
```

### Query #5

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FA_BALANCES_REP_GT, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL, FA_BOOKS`

```sql
SELECT A.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,

  (SELECT FFVV.DESCRIPTION
   FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFVV, FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS FFVS
   WHERE FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'GL_CONTA_CONTABIL CLIENT_A'
     AND FFVS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = FFVV.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
     AND FFVV.FLEX_VALUE = A.SEGMENT4) DESC_CONTA, A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.SEGMENT3, A.SEGMENT4, A.SEGMENT5, A.SEGMENT6,
       A.SEGMENT7, A.SEGMENT8, A.SEGMENT9, ROWNUM LINE_NUMBER
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID CODE_COMBINATION_ID, GCC.SEGMENT1, GCC.SEGMENT2, GCC.SEGMENT3, GCC.SEGMENT4,
                   GCC.SEGMENT5, GCC.SEGMENT6, GCC.SEGMENT7, GCC.SEGMENT8, GCC.SEGMENT9
   FROM FA_BOOKS FB, FA_ADDITIONS_VL FAV, FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY FDH,
        FA_DEPRN_SUMMARY FDS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, FA_METHODS FM,

     (SELECT AD.Asset_Number ASSET, AD.Asset_ID,
             NVL(SUM(DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                           'BEGIN', NVL(BAL.Amount, 0), NULL)), 0) BEGIN, SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                       DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                         'COST',
                                                                                         'ADDITION',
                                                                                         'CIP ADDITION'),
                                                                                       NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                         0),
                                                                                       NULL)) ADDITION, SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                     DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                       'CIP COST',
                                                                                                                       'ADDITION'), - NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                        0),
                                                                                                                                      NULL)) CAPITALIZATION,
                                                                                                            SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                         DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                           'COST',
                                                                                                                           'ADJUSTMENT',
                                                                                                                           'CIP ADJUSTMENT'),
                                                                                                                         NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                           0),
                                                                                                                         NULL)) ADJUSTMENT,
                                                                                                                SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                             'RECLASS',
                                                                                                                             NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                               0),
                                                                                                                             NULL)) RECLASS,
                                                                                                                    SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                                 DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                   'COST',
                                                                                                                                   'RETIREMENT',
                                                                                                                                   'CIP RETIREMENT'), -NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                         0),
                                                                                                                                                       NULL)) RETIREMENT,
                                                                                                                        SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                                     'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                                     NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                       0),
                                                                                                                                     NULL)) REVALUATION,
                                                                                                                            SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                                         'TRANSFER',
                                                                                                                                         NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                           0),
                                                                                                                                         NULL)) TRANSFER,
                                                                                                                                NVL(SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                               'END',
                                                                                                                                               NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                 0),
                                                                                                                                               NULL)), 0) END, decode(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                 'COST',
                                                                                                                                                                 SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                         'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                                                                         NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                         0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                              DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'CIP COST',
                                                                                                                                                                                                 'ADDITION') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                 0) , NULL))) CAPREVAL,
                                                                                                                                                               FA_FASCOSTD_XMLP_PKG.out_of_balanceformula(NVL (SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                                        'BEGIN',
                                                                                                                                                                                                        NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                         0) , NULL)) , 0), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                                    DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                                        'COST',
                                                                                                                                                                                        'ADDITION',
                                                                                                                                                                                        'CIP ADDITION') , NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                           0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                                 'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                                                                                                 NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                  0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                        'RECLASS',
                                                                                                                                                                                        NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                         0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                               DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                   'COST',
                                                                                                                                                                   'RETIREMENT',
                                                                                                                                                                   'CIP RETIREMENT') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                          0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                    'COST',
                                                                                                                                                                    'ADJUSTMENT',
                                                                                                                                                                    'CIP ADJUSTMENT') , NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                         0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                               'TRANSFER',
                                                                                                                                                                               NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                      DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                          'CIP COST',
                                                                                                                                                          'ADDITION') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                           0) , NULL)), NVL (SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                      'END',
                                                                                                                                                                      NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                       0) , NULL)) , 0)) OUT_OF_BALANCE
      FROM FA_BALANCES_REP_GT BAL, FA_ADDITIONS_B AD, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS DHCC, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS AJCC
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND AD.Asset_ID = BAL.Asset_ID
        AND DHCC.Code_Combination_ID = BAL.DEPRN_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_CCID
        AND AJCC.Code_Combination_ID (+) = BAL.Adjustment_CCID
        AND :DO_INSERT = 1
      GROUP BY AD.ASSET_NUMBER, AD.ASSET_ID) AC
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND FB.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
     AND FB.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
     AND FDH.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
     AND FDH.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
     AND FDS.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
     AND FDS.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
     AND FAV.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
     AND AC.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
     AND FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
     AND FB.METHOD_ID = FM.METHOD_ID
     AND FDS.PERIOD_COUNTER = :PERIOD1_PC
     AND FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = :P_BOOK
     AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_GROUPING) A
ORDER BY A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.SEGMENT3, A.SEGMENT4, A.SEGMENT5, A.SEGMENT6, A.SEGMENT7,
         A.SEGMENT8, A.SEGMENT9
```

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_VS_VALUES_VL, FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS`

### Query #6

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS, FND_VS_VALUES_VL`

```sql
SELECT FIFS.SEGMENT_NUM - 3 GLORDER, FFV.VALUE COMPVALUE, FFVT.DESCRIPTION COMPTEXT, '' USERNAME,
                                                                                        '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                                           'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                                FFV.VALUE_ID EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                                '' INTERID,
                                                                                                   '' MIGCHANGEID,
                                                                                                      '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                                         FIFS.ID_FLEX_NUM ORGID,
                                                                                                         CASE
                                                                                                             WHEN NVL(FFV.FLEX_VALUE_ATTRIBUTE1,

                                                                                                                    'N') = 'Y'
                                                                                                                  AND NVL(FFV.ENABLED_FLAG,

                                                                                                                        'Y') = 'Y'
                                                                                                                  AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(FFV.START_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                               trunc(SYSDATE - 1)) AND NVL(FFV.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                                                         trunc(SYSDATE + 1)) THEN '1'
                                                                                                             ELSE '0'
                                                                                                         END ACTIVE,
                                                                                                         '' GLCOMPONENTSID,
                                                                                                            '' SEGMENTNAME, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                                   TO_CHAR(FFV.START_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CLIA_START_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                                   TO_CHAR(FFV.END_DATE_ACTIVE,

                                                                                                                                     'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CLIA_END_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                                   FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME
FROM FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS FIFS, FND_VS_VALUES_VL FFV, FND_FLEX_VALUES_TL FFVT
WHERE FIFS.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GL#'
  AND FFV.VALUE_SET_ID = FIFS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
  AND FFVT.FLEX_VALUE_ID = FFV.VALUE_ID
  AND FFVT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME IN ('GL_CONTA_CONTABIL', 'GL_CENTRO_DE_CUSTO')
  AND FFV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                  'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND FFV.VALUE_ID = NVL(:P_ID, FFV.VALUE_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT FIFS.SEGMENT_NUM - 3 GLORDER, FVV3.VALUE || '.' || FVV2.VALUE || '.' || FVV1.VALUE COMPVALUE,
       FVV3.DESCRIPTION || '-' || FVV1.DESCRIPTION COMPTEXT, '' USERNAME, '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                             'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                  fvv1.value_id + 50000 EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                  '' INTERID,
                                                                                     '' MIGCHANGEID,
                                                                                        '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                           FIFS.ID_FLEX_NUM ORGID,
                                                                                           CASE
                                                                                               WHEN nvl(fvv1.flex_value_attribute1,

                                                                                                      'N') = 'Y'
                                                                                                    AND NVL(fvv1.enabled_flag,

                                                                                                          'Y') = 'Y'
                                                                                                    AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(fvv1.start_date_active,

                                                                                                                                 trunc(SYSDATE - 1)) AND NVL(fvv1.end_date_active,

                                                                                                                                                           trunc(SYSDATE + 1)) THEN '1'
                                                                                               ELSE '0'
                                                                                           END ACTIVE,
                                                                                           '' GLCOMPONENTSID,
                                                                                              '' SEGMENTNAME, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                     TO_CHAR(fvv1.start_date_active,

                                                                                                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') CLIA_START_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                     TO_CHAR(fvv1.end_date_active,

                                                                                                                       'DD/MM/RRRR') CLIA_END_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                     FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME
FROM FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV1, FND_VS_RELATED_VALUES FVRV, FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV2,
     FND_VS_RELATED_VALUES FVRE, FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV3, FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS FIFS,
     FND_FLEX_VALUES_TL FFVT
WHERE NVL(FVV1.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
  AND NVL(FVV1.SUMMARY_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
  AND TRUNC(NVL(FVV1.START_DATE_ACTIVE, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND TRUNC(NVL(FVV1.END_DATE_ACTIVE, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND FVRV.VALUE_ID1 = FVV1.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE1 = 'GL_CENTRO_RESULTADO CLIENT_A'
  AND FVRV.VALUE_ID2 = FVV2.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE2 = 'GL_FILIAL CLIENT_A'
  AND FVRE.VALUE_ID1 = FVV3.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRE.VALUE_ID2 = FVV2.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRE.VALUE_SET_CODE2 = FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE2
  AND FVRE.VALUE_SET_CODE1 = 'GL_EMPRESA CLIENT_A'
  AND FIFS.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GL#'
  AND FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME = 'GL_CENTRO_RESULTADO'
  AND fvv1.value_set_id = FIFS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
  AND FFVT.FLEX_VALUE_ID = fvv1.value_id
  AND FFVT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND FVRV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                   'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND FVV1.VALUE_ID = NVL(:P_ID, FVV1.VALUE_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT FIFS.SEGMENT_NUM - 5 GLORDER, FVV3.VALUE || '.' || FVV2.VALUE || '.' || FVV1.VALUE COMPVALUE,
       FVV3.DESCRIPTION || '-' || FVV1.DESCRIPTION COMPTEXT, '' USERNAME, '' SOURCESYSID,
                                                                             'OA' OWNERSYSID,
                                                                                  fvv1.value_id + 50000 EXTERNALREFID,
                                                                                  '' INTERID,
                                                                                     '' MIGCHANGEID,
                                                                                        '' SENDERSYSID,
                                                                                           FIFS.ID_FLEX_NUM ORGID,
                                                                                           CASE
                                                                                               WHEN nvl(fvv1.flex_value_attribute1,

                                                                                                      'N') = 'Y'
                                                                                                    AND NVL(fvv1.enabled_flag,

                                                                                                          'Y') = 'Y'
                                                                                                    AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(fvv1.start_date_active,

                                                                                                                                 trunc(SYSDATE - 1)) AND NVL(fvv1.end_date_active,

                                                                                                                                                           trunc(SYSDATE + 1)) THEN '1'
                                                                                               ELSE '0'
                                                                                           END ACTIVE,
                                                                                           '' GLCOMPONENTSID,
                                                                                              '' SEGMENTNAME, ROWNUM TRANSSEQ,
                                                                                                                     TO_CHAR(fvv1.start_date_active,

                                                                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CLIA_START_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                     TO_CHAR(fvv1.end_date_active,

                                                                                                                       'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MM:SS') CLIA_END_DATE_ACTIVE,
                                                                                                                     FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME
FROM FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV1, FND_VS_RELATED_VALUES FVRV, FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV2,
     FND_VS_RELATED_VALUES FVRE, FND_VS_VALUES_VL FVV3, FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS FIFS,
     FND_FLEX_VALUES_TL FFVT
WHERE NVL(FVV1.ENABLED_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
  AND NVL(FVV1.SUMMARY_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
  AND TRUNC(NVL(FVV1.START_DATE_ACTIVE, SYSDATE)) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND TRUNC(NVL(FVV1.END_DATE_ACTIVE, SYSDATE)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND FVRV.VALUE_ID1 = FVV1.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE1 = 'GL_CENTRO_RESULTADO_CC CLIENT_A'
  AND FVRV.VALUE_ID2 = FVV2.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE2 = 'GL_INTRACOMPANHIA CLIENT_A'
  AND FVRE.VALUE_ID1 = FVV3.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRE.VALUE_ID2 = FVV2.VALUE_ID
  AND FVRE.VALUE_SET_CODE2 = FVRV.VALUE_SET_CODE2
  AND FVRE.VALUE_SET_CODE1 = 'GL_INTERCOMPANHIA CLIENT_A'
  AND FIFS.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GL#'
  AND FIFS.SEGMENT_NAME = 'GL_CENTRO_RESULTADO_CC'
  AND fvv1.value_set_id = FIFS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
  AND FFVT.FLEX_VALUE_ID = fvv1.value_id
  AND FFVT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  AND FVRV.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= NVL(:P_LAST_EXEC_DATE,
                                 TO_DATE('01/01/1900',
                                   'DD/MM/RRRR'))
  AND FVV1.VALUE_ID = NVL(:P_ID, FVV1.VALUE_ID)
```

```sql
SELECT B.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID, B.FLEX_VALUE_ID, B.FLEX_VALUE, T.FLEX_VALUE_MEANING, T.DESCRIPTION,
```

### Query #15

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `ESS_REQUEST_HISTORY, ESS_REQUEST_PROPERTY`

### Query #15

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `ESS_REQUEST_HISTORY, ESS_REQUEST_PROPERTY`

```sql
SELECT *
FROM
  (SELECT to_char(hist.requestid) AS requestid, hist.executable_status, prop.name, prop.value
   FROM ess_request_history hist
   INNER JOIN ess_request_property prop ON hist.requestid = prop.requestid
   AND hist.definition = 'JobDefinition://oracle/apps/ess/financials/genericLocalizations/transaction/fiscal/PrintFiscalDocuments'
   AND hist.submitter = 'INT.EXTENSIONS') PIVOT (max(value)
                                                 FOR name IN ('submit.argument1' AS argument1))
WHERE argument1 = nvl(:p_batch_name, argument1)
ORDER BY requestid DESC
```

```sql
   INNER JOIN ess_request_property prop ON hist.requestid = prop.requestid
   AND hist.definition = 'JobDefinition://oracle/apps/ess/financials/genericLocalizations/transaction/fiscal/PrintFiscalDocuments'
   AND hist.submitter = 'INT.EXTENSIONS') PIVOT (max(value)
                                                 FOR name IN ('submit.argument1' AS argument1))
WHERE argument1 = nvl(:p_batch_name, argument1)
ORDER BY requestid DESC
```

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `DUAL, FND_LOOKUP_TYPES`

### Query #22

**Tags:** `SYS & Foundation`

**Tabelas:** `FND_LOOKUP_TYPES, DUAL`

```sql
SELECT lookup_type
FROM
  (SELECT lookup_type
   FROM fnd_lookup_types
   WHERE lookup_type = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, lookup_type)
     AND lookup_type IN ('PLU_TIPOS_REGISTRO','PLU_AR_CANAL_ATIVIDADE','PLU_AR_RAMO_ATIVIDADE',
                         'PLU_AR_SEGMENTO_ATIVIDADE','RESPONSIBILITY','COMMUNICATION_TYPE' ,
                         'CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE','PLU_AR_TAX_NECESSARIO','PAY GROUP','BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE' ,
                         'PLU_CLIFOR_EX','PLU_COND_CONTR','PLU_TIPO_EMPRESA',
                         'PLU_TIPO_EMPRESA_EXCECAO','ORGANIZATION_TYPE')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'FND_TERRITORIES' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'FND_TERRITORIES' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'FND_TERRITORIES')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'FND_STATE' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'FND_STATE' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'FND_STATE')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'FND_CITY' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'FND_CITY' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'FND_CITY')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'ZX_REPORTING_TYPES' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'ZX_REPORTING_TYPES' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE,
                                  'ZX_REPORTING_TYPES')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'ZX_PARTY_FISCAL_CLASS' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'ZX_PARTY_FISCAL_CLASS' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE,
                                     'ZX_PARTY_FISCAL_CLASS')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'ZX_STATUS' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'ZX_STATUS' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'ZX_STATUS')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'POR_BROWSE_CATEGORIES' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'POR_BROWSE_CATEGORIES' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE,
                                     'POR_BROWSE_CATEGORIES')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'ZX_REGIMES' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'ZX_REGIMES' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'ZX_REGIMES')
   UNION ALL SELECT 'ZX_TAXES' lookup_type
   FROM dual
   WHERE 'ZX_TAXES' = NVL(:P_LOV_CODE, 'ZX_TAXES'))
```

```sql
, Q1.COUNTRY_ORIG                                         COUNTRY_ORIG

, Q1.GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO                                 GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO
, Q1.CENTRO_RESULTADO                                     CENTRO_RESULTADO
, Q1.BUYER                                                BUYER
, Q1.VENDOR_ID                                            VENDOR_ID
, Q1.VENDOR_NAME                                          VENDOR_NAME
, Q1.VENDOR_SITE_ID                                       VENDOR_SITE_ID
, Q1.VENDOR_SITE_CODE                                     VENDOR_SITE_CODE
, Q1.SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION_METHOD                        SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION_METHOD
, Q1.SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS                               SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
, Q1.RATE_TYPE                                            RATE_TYPE
, Q1.RATE_DATE                                            RATE_DATE
, (SELECT  distinct PAR.RATE_DSP
from  PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
where PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q1.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
)  RATE_USER
, Q1.PO_DESCRIPTION                                       PO_DESCRIPTION
, Q1.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID                                     PAYMENT_TERMS_ID
, Q1.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC                                 PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC
, Q1.FOB_CODE                                             FOB_CODE
, Q1.BUYER_EMAIL                                          BUYER_EMAIL
FROM (
WITH DP_BU_CENTRAL AS (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID BU_ID
, HOU.NAME            BU_NAME
FROM FUSION.ZCA_REF_ENTITIES ZRE
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
WHERE HOU.NAME = ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001
)
SELECT Q.AUCTION_HEADER_ID                                 AUCTION_HEADER_ID
, Q.NEGOCIACAO_NUM                                    NEGOCIACAO_NUM
, Q.REQUISICAO_NUM                                    REQUISICAO_NUM
, Q.REQ_BU_NAME                                       REQ_BU_NAME
, Q.BID_NUMBER                                        BID_NUMBER
, CASE WHEN (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID   = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
) = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID THEN DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
ELSE (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID    = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID <> DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
)
END PROCUREMENT_BU_ID
, CASE WHEN (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID   = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
) = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID THEN DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_NAME
ELSE (SELECT HOU.NAME
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS       HOU
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID    = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID  = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID <> DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY HOU.NAME
)
END PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME
, Q.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE                                             REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE
, Q.BU_DESTINO_ID                                                            BU_DESTINO_ID

, Q.SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS                            SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
, Q.RATE_TYPE                                         RATE_TYPE
, Q.RATE_DATE                                         RATE_DATE
, (SELECT  distinct PAR.RATE_DSP
from  PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
where PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
)  RATE_USER
, Q.REQ_BU_NAME||' - '||Q.NEGOCIACAO_NUM||' - '||Q.BID_NUMBER PO_DESCRIPTION
, Q.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID                                  PAYMENT_TERMS_ID
, Q.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC                              PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC
, Q.FOB_CODE                                          FOB_CODE
, Q.BUYER_EMAIL                                       BUYER_EMAIL
FROM (
SELECT PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID                                 AUCTION_HEADER_ID
, PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER                                   NEGOCIACAO_NUM
, LISTAGG(DISTINCT PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER) REQUISICAO_NUM
, HOU_R.NAME                                             REQ_BU_NAME
, PBH.BID_NUMBER                                         BID_NUMBER
, PAHA.ATTRIBUTE1                                        BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX
, PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2                                       BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX
, UPPER(NVL(PAHA.ATTRIBUTE2,'NÃO'))                      GERA_PO_NAC_HEADER_FLEX
, DECODE(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2,NULL,HOU_H.ORGANIZATION_ID,HOU_L.ORGANIZATION_ID)    BU_DESTINO_ID
, DECODE(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2,NULL,HOU_H.NAME,HOU_L.NAME)    BU_DESTINO_NAME
, UPPER(NVL(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE3,'NÃO'))                     GERA_PO_NAC_LINE_FLEX
, HL.LOCATION_CODE                                       REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE
, HL.COUNTRY                                             COUNTRY_ORIG
, GCC.SEGMENT3                                           CENTRO_RESULTADO
, PBH.BID_CURRENCY_CODE                                  CURRENCY_CODE
, PAHA.PERSON_ID                                         BUYER
, PBH.VENDOR_ID                                          VENDOR_ID
, PS.VENDOR_NAME                                         VENDOR_NAME
, PBH.VENDOR_SITE_ID                                     VENDOR_SITE_ID
, PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_CODE                                  VENDOR_SITE_CODE
, 'EMAIL'                                                SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION_METHOD
, PSCV.EMAIL_ADDRESS                                     SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
, PAHA.RATE_TYPE                                         RATE_TYPE
, TRUNC(SYSDATE)                                         RATE_DATE
, PAHA.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID                                  PAYMENT_TERMS_ID
, PTIN.TERM_ID                                           PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC
, PAHA.FOB_CODE                                          FOB_CODE
, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS                                      BUYER_EMAIL
FROM FUSION.PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL     PAHA
, FUSION.PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL PAIPA
, FUSION.PON_BACKING_REQUISITIONS    PBR
, FUSION.PON_BID_ITEM_PRICES         PBIP
, FUSION.PON_BID_HEADERS             PBH
, FUSION.POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL   PRDA
, FUSION.POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL   PRLA
, FUSION.POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA
, FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS_V     PSCV
, FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M    PSSA
, FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIERS_V             PS
, FUSION.GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS        GCC
, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS                HL
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS          HOU_H
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS          HOU_L
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS          HOU_R
, FUSION.PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES         PEA
, FUSION.PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F            PAPF
, (SELECT ATT.TERM_ID
FROM FUSION.AP_TERMS_TL ATT
WHERE UPPER(ATT.NAME) = 'SEM PAGAMENTO'
AND ATT.LANGUAGE    = 'PTB'
) PTIN
WHERE PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID         = PAIPA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID         = PBR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
AND PAIPA.LINE_NUMBER              = PBR.LINE_NUMBER
AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID         = PBH.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID         = PBIP.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
AND TO_CHAR(PAIPA.LINE_NUMBER)     = DECODE(INSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,'-'),0,
PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,
SUBSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,1,INSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,'-')-1))
AND PBH.BID_NUMBER                 = PBIP.BID_NUMBER
AND PAHA.AWARD_STATUS              = 'COMPLETED'
AND PBIP.AWARD_STATUS             <> 'REJECTED'
AND PBR.REQUISITION_LINE_ID        = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
AND PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID     = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID       = PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
AND PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID       = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
AND PRHA.REQ_BU_ID                 = HOU_R.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND PAHA.ATTRIBUTE1                = TO_CHAR(HOU_H.ORGANIZATION_ID(+))
AND PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2               = TO_CHAR(HOU_L.ORGANIZATION_ID(+))
AND PRLA.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID    = HL.LOCATION_ID
AND PS.VENDOR_ID                   = PBH.VENDOR_ID
AND PS.VENDOR_ID                   = PSSA.VENDOR_ID
AND PBH.VENDOR_SITE_ID             = PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_ID
AND PBH.TRADING_PARTNER_CONTACT_ID = PSCV.PER_PARTY_ID
AND PBH.VENDOR_ID                  = PSCV.VENDOR_ID
AND PBH.VENDOR_SITE_ID             = PSCV.VENDOR_SITE_ID
AND PSCV.STATUS                    = 'A'
AND PAHA.PERSON_ID                 = PAPF.PERSON_ID
AND PAPF.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID          = PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID
AND NVL(PAHA.ATTRIBUTE1,NVL(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2,'#')) <> '#'
AND NVL(PAHA.OUTCOME_STATUS,'#') <> 'OUTCOME_NOT_REQUESTED'
AND (NVL(PAHA.OUTCOME_STATUS,'#') <> 'OUTCOME_COMPLETED'
AND NVL(PAHA.PO_CREATION_PROCESS,'NULL') IN ('CREATE_IN_FUSION_PURCHASING','NULL'))
AND PAHA.AUCTION_STATUS           <> 'DELETED'
AND PAHA.CONTRACT_TYPE            <> 'BLANKET'
AND PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER = nvl(:P_AUCTION_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER)
GROUP BY PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
, PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER
, HOU_R.NAME
, PBH.BID_NUMBER
, PAHA.ATTRIBUTE1
, PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2
, UPPER(NVL(PAHA.ATTRIBUTE2,'NÃO'))
, DECODE(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2,NULL,HOU_H.ORGANIZATION_ID,HOU_L.ORGANIZATION_ID)
, DECODE(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2,NULL,HOU_H.NAME,HOU_L.NAME)
, UPPER(NVL(PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE3,'NÃO'))
, HL.LOCATION_CODE
, HL.COUNTRY
, GCC.SEGMENT3
, PBH.BID_CURRENCY_CODE
, PAHA.PERSON_ID
, PBH.VENDOR_ID
, PS.VENDOR_NAME
, PBH.VENDOR_SITE_ID
, PSSA.VENDOR_SITE_CODE
, PSCV.EMAIL_ADDRESS
, PAHA.RATE_TYPE
, PAHA.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID
, PTIN.TERM_ID
, PAHA.FOB_CODE
, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS
) Q
, DP_BU_CENTRAL
) Q1
) Q2
) Q3
ORDER BY 2
```

### Query #2

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `FUSION, PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES`

```sql
SELECT Q3.AUCTION_HEADER_ID AUCTION_HEADER_ID, Q3.NEGOCIACAO_NUM NEGOCIACAO_NUM,
       Q3.REQUISICAO_NUM REQUISICAO_NUM, Q3.REQ_BU_NAME REQ_BU_NAME,
       Q3.BID_NUMBER BID_NUMBER,
       Q3.PROCUREMENT_BU_ID PROCUREMENT_BU_ID,
       Q3.PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME, Q3.COUNTRY_ORIG COUNTRY_ORIG,
       Q3.CURRENCY_CODE CURRENCY_CODE,
       Q3.GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO, Q3.CENTRO_RESULTADO CENTRO_RESULTADO,
       Q3.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE,
       Q3.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID,
       Q3.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME,
       Q3.DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID,
       Q3.DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE, Q3.BUYER BUYER,

  (SELECT MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR004
   FROM FUSION.SVC_REF_ENTITIES MRE
   WHERE MRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIOXFORNEC_c'
     AND INSTR(UPPER(Q3.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME), UPPER(MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR016))>0
     AND MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015 = Q3.DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE
     AND INSTR(UPPER(Q3.REQ_BU_NAME), UPPER(MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR003))>0
     AND MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = Q3.CENTRO_RESULTADO) VENDOR_NAME_NAC,

  (SELECT MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005
   FROM FUSION.SVC_REF_ENTITIES MRE
   WHERE MRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIOXFORNEC_c'
     AND INSTR(UPPER(Q3.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME), UPPER(MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR016))>0
     AND MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015 = Q3.DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE
     AND INSTR(UPPER(Q3.REQ_BU_NAME), UPPER(MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR003))>0
     AND MRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002 = Q3.CENTRO_RESULTADO) VENDOR_SITE_CODE_NAC, Q3.RATE_TYPE RATE_TYPE,
       Q3.RATE_DATE RATE_DATE,

  (SELECT DISTINCT PAR.RATE_DSP
   FROM PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
   WHERE PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q3.AUCTION_HEADER_ID) RATE_USER, Q3.PO_DESCRIPTION PO_DESCRIPTION,
       Q3.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC, Q3.FOB_CODE FOB_CODE,
       Q3.BUYER_EMAIL BUYER_EMAIL
FROM
  (SELECT Q2.AUCTION_HEADER_ID AUCTION_HEADER_ID, Q2.NEGOCIACAO_NUM NEGOCIACAO_NUM,
          Q2.REQUISICAO_NUM REQUISICAO_NUM, Q2.REQ_BU_NAME REQ_BU_NAME,
          Q2.PROCUREMENT_BU_ID PROCUREMENT_BU_ID,
          Q2.PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME, Q2.BID_NUMBER BID_NUMBER,
          Q2.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE,
          Q2.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID,
          Q2.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME,

     (SELECT HL.LOCATION_ID
      FROM FUSION.MOO_REF_ENTITIES ZRE, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_TL HLAT, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HL,
           FUSION.INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
      WHERE ZRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONELOCAL_c'
        AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005) = UPPER(Q2.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE)
        AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015) = UPPER(HL.LOCATION_CODE)
        AND HL.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = Q2.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID
        AND HLAT.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = HL.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID
        AND HLAT.LANGUAGE = 'US') DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID,

     (SELECT ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015
      FROM FUSION.MOO_REF_ENTITIES ZRE, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_TL HLAT, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HL,
           FUSION.INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP
      WHERE ZRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONELOCAL_c'
        AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005) = UPPER(Q2.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE)
        AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR003) = UPPER(HLAT.LOCATION_CODE)
        AND HL.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
        AND IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = Q2.DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID
        AND HLAT.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = HL.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID
        AND HLAT.LANGUAGE = 'US') DP_NAC_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE, Q2.COUNTRY_ORIG COUNTRY_ORIG,
          Q2.CURRENCY_CODE CURRENCY_CODE,
          Q2.GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO,
          Q2.CENTRO_RESULTADO CENTRO_RESULTADO, Q2.BUYER BUYER,
          Q2.RATE_TYPE RATE_TYPE, Q2.RATE_DATE RATE_DATE,

     (SELECT DISTINCT PAR.RATE_DSP
      FROM PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
      WHERE PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q2.AUCTION_HEADER_ID) RATE_USER, Q2.PO_DESCRIPTION PO_DESCRIPTION,
          Q2.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC, Q2.FOB_CODE FOB_CODE,
          Q2.BUYER_EMAIL BUYER_EMAIL
   FROM
     (SELECT Q1.AUCTION_HEADER_ID AUCTION_HEADER_ID, Q1.NEGOCIACAO_NUM NEGOCIACAO_NUM,
             Q1.REQUISICAO_NUM REQUISICAO_NUM, Q1.REQ_BU_NAME REQ_BU_NAME,
             Q1.PROCUREMENT_BU_ID PROCUREMENT_BU_ID,
             Q1.PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME, Q1.BID_NUMBER BID_NUMBER,
             Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE,
             CASE
                 WHEN UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE) = 'OOG ODN I' THEN
                        (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
                         FROM FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME), 'MEA003')>0)
                 WHEN UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE) = 'OOG ODN II' THEN
                        (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
                         FROM FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME), 'MEA002')>0)
                 ELSE
                        (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
                         FROM FUSION.ZCA_REF_ENTITIES SRE, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE SRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                           AND INSTR(UPPER(Q1.REQ_BU_NAME),
                                 UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005))>0
                           AND SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR003 = Q1.CENTRO_RESULTADO
                           AND INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME),
                                 UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015))>0
                           AND EXISTS
                             (SELECT 1
                              FROM FUSION.MOO_REF_ENTITIES ZRE, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_TL HLAT,
                                   FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HL, FUSION.INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                   FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                              WHERE ZRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONELOCAL_c'
                                AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005) = UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE)
                                AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015) = UPPER(HL.LOCATION_CODE)
                                AND HL.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                AND HLAT.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = HL.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID
                                AND HLAT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
                                AND IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                AND INSTR(HOU.NAME,
                                      UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002))>0))
             END DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_ID,
             CASE
                 WHEN UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE) = 'OOG ODN I' THEN
                        (SELECT HOU.NAME
                         FROM FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME), 'MEA003')>0)
                 WHEN UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE) = 'OOG ODN II' THEN
                        (SELECT HOU.NAME
                         FROM FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME), 'MEA002')>0)
                 ELSE
                        (SELECT HOU.NAME
                         FROM FUSION.ZCA_REF_ENTITIES SRE, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                         WHERE SRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONEUNIDNEGOCIO_c'
                           AND INSTR(UPPER(Q1.REQ_BU_NAME),
                                 UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005))>0
                           AND SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR003 = Q1.CENTRO_RESULTADO
                           AND INSTR(UPPER(HOU.NAME),
                                 UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015))>0
                           AND EXISTS
                             (SELECT 1
                              FROM FUSION.MOO_REF_ENTITIES ZRE, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_TL HLAT,
                                   FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HL, FUSION.INV_ORG_PARAMETERS IOP,
                                   FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
                              WHERE ZRE.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY = 'POCLONELOCAL_c'
                                AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR005) = UPPER(Q1.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE)
                                AND UPPER(ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR015) = UPPER(HL.LOCATION_CODE)
                                AND HL.INVENTORY_ORGANIZATION_ID = IOP.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                AND HLAT.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID = HL.LOCATION_DETAILS_ID
                                AND HLAT.LANGUAGE = 'US'
                                AND IOP.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
                                AND INSTR(HOU.NAME,
                                      UPPER(SRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR002))>0))
             END DP_BU_DESTINO_NAC_NAME, Q1.COUNTRY_ORIG COUNTRY_ORIG,
             Q1.CURRENCY_CODE CURRENCY_CODE,
             Q1.GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO,
             Q1.CENTRO_RESULTADO CENTRO_RESULTADO, Q1.BUYER BUYER,
             Q1.RATE_TYPE RATE_TYPE, Q1.RATE_DATE RATE_DATE,

        (SELECT DISTINCT PAR.RATE_DSP
         FROM PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
         WHERE PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q1.AUCTION_HEADER_ID) RATE_USER, Q1.PO_DESCRIPTION PO_DESCRIPTION,
             Q1.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC, Q1.FOB_CODE FOB_CODE,
             Q1.BUYER_EMAIL BUYER_EMAIL
      FROM
        (WITH DP_BU_CENTRAL AS
           (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID BU_ID, HOU.NAME BU_NAME
            FROM FUSION.ZCA_REF_ENTITIES ZRE, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
            WHERE HOU.NAME = ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001) SELECT Q.AUCTION_HEADER_ID AUCTION_HEADER_ID,
                                                                Q.NEGOCIACAO_NUM NEGOCIACAO_NUM,
                                                                Q.REQUISICAO_NUM REQUISICAO_NUM,
                                                                Q.REQ_BU_NAME REQ_BU_NAME,
                                                                Q.PROCUREMENT_BU_ID PROCUREMENT_BU_ID,
                                                                Q.PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME,
                                                                Q.BID_NUMBER BID_NUMBER,
                                                                Q.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE,
                                                                Q.COUNTRY_ORIG COUNTRY_ORIG,
                                                                NVL(Q.GERA_PO_NAC_HEADER_FLEX,
                                                                  'NAO') GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO,
                                                                Q.CENTRO_RESULTADO CENTRO_RESULTADO,
                                                                Q.CURRENCY_CODE CURRENCY_CODE,
                                                                Q.BUYER BUYER,
                                                                Q.RATE_TYPE RATE_TYPE,
                                                                Q.RATE_DATE RATE_DATE,

           (SELECT DISTINCT PAR.RATE_DSP
            FROM PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
            WHERE PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q.AUCTION_HEADER_ID) RATE_USER,
                                                                Q.REQ_BU_NAME||' - '||Q.NEGOCIACAO_NUM||' - '||Q.BID_NUMBER PO_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                Q.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC,
                                                                Q.FOB_CODE FOB_CODE,
                                                                Q.BUYER_EMAIL BUYER_EMAIL
         FROM
           (SELECT PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID AUCTION_HEADER_ID,
                   PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER NEGOCIACAO_NUM, LISTAGG(DISTINCT PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER,
                                                          ',') WITHIN GROUP (
                                                                             ORDER BY PRHA.REQUISITION_NUMBER) REQUISICAO_NUM,
                                                                            HOU_R.NAME REQ_BU_NAME,
                                                                            PHA.PRC_BU_ID PROCUREMENT_BU_ID,
                                                                            HOU_P.NAME PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME,
                                                                            PBH.BID_NUMBER BID_NUMBER,
                                                                            PAHA.ATTRIBUTE2 GERA_PO_NAC_HEADER_FLEX,
                                                                            HL.LOCATION_CODE REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE,
                                                                            HL.COUNTRY COUNTRY_ORIG,
                                                                            HOU_R.NAME BU_HEADER,
                                                                            GCC.SEGMENT3 CENTRO_RESULTADO,
                                                                            PHA.CURRENCY_CODE CURRENCY_CODE,
                                                                            PAHA.PERSON_ID BUYER,
                                                                            PAHA.RATE_TYPE RATE_TYPE,
                                                                            TRUNC(SYSDATE) RATE_DATE,
                                                                            PTIN.TERM_ID PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC,
                                                                            PAHA.FOB_CODE FOB_CODE,
                                                                            PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS BUYER_EMAIL
            FROM FUSION.PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL PAHA, FUSION.PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL PAIPA,
                 FUSION.PON_BACKING_REQUISITIONS PBR, FUSION.PON_BID_ITEM_PRICES PBIP,
                 FUSION.PON_BID_HEADERS PBH, FUSION.PON_BID_PO_NUMBERS PBPN,
                 FUSION.POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL PRDA, FUSION.POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRLA,
                 FUSION.POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRHA, FUSION.PO_HEADERS_ALL PHA,
                 FUSION.GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, FUSION.HR_LOCATIONS HL,
                 FUSION.PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES PEA, FUSION.PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAPF,
                 FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU_R, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU_P,

              (SELECT ATT.TERM_ID
               FROM FUSION.AP_TERMS_TL ATT
               WHERE UPPER(ATT.NAME) = 'SEM PAGAMENTO'
                 AND ATT.LANGUAGE = 'PTB') PTIN
            WHERE PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PAIPA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
              AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PBR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
              AND PAIPA.LINE_NUMBER = PBR.LINE_NUMBER
              AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PBH.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
              AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PBIP.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(PAIPA.LINE_NUMBER) = DECODE(INSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,
                                                        '-'),
                                                 0, PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,
                                                 SUBSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,
                                                   1,
                                                   INSTR(PBIP.DOCUMENT_DISP_LINE_NUMBER,
                                                     '-')-1))
              AND PBH.BID_NUMBER = PBIP.BID_NUMBER
              AND PAHA.AWARD_STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
              AND PBIP.AWARD_STATUS <> 'REJECTED'
              AND PBR.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
              AND PRLA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRHA.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
              AND PRLA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = PRDA.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
              AND PRDA.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
              AND PRHA.REQ_BU_ID = HOU_R.ORGANIZATION_ID
              AND PRLA.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID = HL.LOCATION_ID
              AND PAHA.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL
              AND PAIPA.ATTRIBUTE2 IS NULL
              AND PAHA.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'SIM'
              AND PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = PBPN.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
              AND PBH.BID_NUMBER = PBPN.BID_NUMBER
              AND PHA.PO_HEADER_ID = PBPN.PO_HEADER_ID
              AND PHA.PRC_BU_ID = HOU_P.ORGANIZATION_ID
              AND PAHA.PERSON_ID = PAPF.PERSON_ID
              AND PAPF.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID
              AND PHA.DOCUMENT_STATUS = 'OPEN'
              AND HL.COUNTRY = 'AT'
              AND NVL(PAHA.OUTCOME_STATUS, '#') <> 'OUTCOME_NOT_REQUESTED'
              AND (NVL(PAHA.OUTCOME_STATUS, '#') <> 'OUTCOME_COMPLETED'
                   AND NVL(PAHA.PO_CREATION_PROCESS, 'NULL') IN ('CREATE_IN_FUSION_PURCHASING','NULL'))
              AND PAHA.AUCTION_STATUS <> 'DELETED'
              AND PAHA.CONTRACT_TYPE <> 'BLANKET'
            GROUP BY PAHA.AUCTION_HEADER_ID, PAHA.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, HOU_R.NAME, PHA.PRC_BU_ID, HOU_P.NAME,
                     PBH.BID_NUMBER, PAHA.ATTRIBUTE2, HL.LOCATION_CODE, HL.COUNTRY, GCC.SEGMENT3,
                     PHA.CURRENCY_CODE, PAHA.PERSON_ID, PAHA.RATE_TYPE, PAHA.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID, PTIN.TERM_ID,
                     PAHA.FOB_CODE, PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS) Q, DP_BU_CENTRAL) Q1) Q2
   WHERE NOT EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
        FROM
          (SELECT DISTINCT Q2.NEGOCIACAO_NUM
           FROM FUSION.PO_HEADERS_ALL PO
           WHERE INSTR(PO.COMMENTS,(' - '||Q2.NEGOCIACAO_NUM||' - '))>0
             AND PO.PRC_BU_ID = Q2.PROCUREMENT_BU_ID
             AND PO.DOCUMENT_STATUS <> 'CANCELED') P
        WHERE P.NEGOCIACAO_NUM = Q2.NEGOCIACAO_NUM)) Q3
ORDER BY 2
```

```sql
, Q1.COUNTRY_ORIG                                         COUNTRY_ORIG
, Q1.COUNTRY_DEST                                         COUNTRY_DEST

, Q1.GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO                                 GERA_PO_NACIONALIZAO
, Q1.CENTRO_RESULTADO                                     CENTRO_RESULTADO
, Q1.BUYER                                                BUYER
, Q1.VENDOR_ID                                            VENDOR_ID
, Q1.VENDOR_NAME                                          VENDOR_NAME
, Q1.VENDOR_SITE_ID                                       VENDOR_SITE_ID
, Q1.VENDOR_SITE_CODE                                     VENDOR_SITE_CODE
, Q1.SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION_METHOD                        SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION_METHOD
, Q1.SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS                               SUPPLIER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
, Q1.RATE_TYPE                                            RATE_TYPE
, Q1.RATE_DATE                                            RATE_DATE
, (SELECT  distinct PAR.RATE_DSP
from  PON_AUCTION_CURRENCY_RATES PAR
where PAR.AUCTION_HEADER_ID = Q1.AUCTION_HEADER_ID
)  RATE_USER
, Q1.PO_DESCRIPTION                                       PO_DESCRIPTION
, Q1.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID                                     PAYMENT_TERMS_ID
, Q1.PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC                                 PAYMENT_TERMS_ID_NAC
, Q1.FOB_CODE                                             FOB_CODE
, Q1.BUYER_EMAIL                                          BUYER_EMAIL
FROM (
WITH DP_BU_CENTRAL AS (SELECT HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID BU_ID
, HOU.NAME            BU_NAME
FROM FUSION.ZCA_REF_ENTITIES ZRE
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS HOU
WHERE HOU.NAME = ZRE.EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_CHAR001
)
SELECT Q.AUCTION_HEADER_ID                                 AUCTION_HEADER_ID
, Q.NEGOCIACAO_NUM                                    NEGOCIACAO_NUM
, Q.REQUISICAO_NUM                                    REQUISICAO_NUM
, Q.REQ_BU_NAME                                       REQ_BU_NAME
, Q.BID_NUMBER                                        BID_NUMBER
, CASE WHEN (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID   = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
) = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID THEN DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
ELSE (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID    = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID <> DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
)
END PROCUREMENT_BU_ID
, CASE WHEN (SELECT FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID   = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID
) = DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID THEN DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_NAME
ELSE (SELECT HOU.NAME
FROM FUSION.FUN_BU_SERVICE_PROVIDERS FBSP
, FUSION.HR_OPERATING_UNITS       HOU
WHERE FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID    = DECODE(Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX,NULL,NVL(Q.BU_DEST_HEADER_FLEX,FBSP.CLIENT_BU_ORG_ID),Q.BU_DEST_LINE_FLEX)
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID  = HOU.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND FBSP.PROVIDER_BU_ORG_ID <> DP_BU_CENTRAL.BU_ID
GROUP BY HOU.NAME
)
END PROCUREMENT_BU_NAME
, Q.REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE                                             REQ_DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_CODE
, Q.BU_DESTINO_ID                                                            BU_DESTINO_ID
```
