```sql
                                                                                                                        '' CUSTO_SALDO_INICIAL,
                                                                                                                           TO_CHAR(FB.DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE,

                                                                                                                             'DD/MM/RRRR') DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE,
                                                                                                                           FM.LIFE_IN_MONTHS LIFE_IN_MONTHS,
                                                                                                                           '' STL_DEPRECIATION_RATE,
                                                                                                                              FM.METHOD_CODE DEPRN_METHOD,

  (SELECT FCB.SEGMENT1 || '.' || FCB.SEGMENT2 || '.' || FCB.SEGMENT3
   FROM FA_CATEGORIES_B FCB
   WHERE FCB.CATEGORY_ID = FAV.ASSET_CATEGORY_ID) CATEGORY,

  (SELECT FL.SEGMENT1 || '.' || FL.SEGMENT2 || '.' || FL.SEGMENT3 || '.' || FL.SEGMENT4 || '.' || FL.SEGMENT5 || '.' || FL.SEGMENT6
   FROM FA_LOCATIONS FL
   WHERE FL.LOCATION_ID = FDH.LOCATION_ID) CONCAT_LOCATION,
                                                                                                                              SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                       (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(DISTINCT FAI.VENDOR_NAME,

                                                                                                                                                          ', ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                                                                                                                                             ORDER BY FAI.INVOICE_NUMBER)
                                                                                                                                        FROM FA_ASSET_INVOICES FAI
                                                                                                                                        WHERE FAI.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
                                                                                                                                          AND FAI.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE), 1,

                                                                                                                                 500) CONCAT_VENDOR_NAME,
                                                                                                                              SUBSTR(
                                                                                                                                       (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(DISTINCT FAI.INVOICE_NUMBER,

                                                                                                                                                          ', ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                                                                                                                                             ORDER BY FAI.INVOICE_NUMBER)
                                                                                                                                        FROM FA_ASSET_INVOICES FAI
                                                                                                                                        WHERE FAI.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
                                                                                                                                          AND FAI.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE), 1,

                                                                                                                                 500) CONCAT_INVOICE_NUMBER,
                                                                                                                              SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
                                                                                                                                                                       (SELECT DISTINCT LISTAGG(DISTINCT FAI.DESCRIPTION,

                                                                                                                                                                                          ', ') WITHIN GROUP(
                                                                                                                                                                                                             ORDER BY FAI.INVOICE_NUMBER)
                                                                                                                                                                        FROM FA_ASSET_INVOICES FAI
                                                                                                                                                                        WHERE FAI.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
                                                                                                                                                                          AND FAI.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE), CHR(10),

                                                                                                                                                                 ''),

                                                                                                                                                       CHR(13),
                                                                                                                                                       ''),

                                                                                                                                               ';',
                                                                                                                                               ','),

                                                                                                                                       '"',
                                                                                                                                       ''),

                                                                                                                                1,
                                                                                                                                500) CONCAT_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                                                                                              '' TIPO_BAIXA,
                                                                                                                                 '' GROUP_ASSET_NUMBER,
                                                                                                                                    '' CUSTO_BAIXA,
                                                                                                                                       '' TIPO_BAIXA2,
                                                                                                                                          '' VENDA,
                                                                                                                                             '' LOTE_ID,
                                                                                                                                                '' LINE_NUM,
                                                                                                                                                   '' TAXA_COV_2_MOEDA
FROM FA_BOOKS FB, FA_ADDITIONS_VL FAV, FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY FDH,
     FA_DEPRN_SUMMARY FDS, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS GCC, FA_METHODS FM,

  (SELECT AD.Asset_Number ASSET, AD.Asset_ID,
          NVL(SUM(DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code, 'BEGIN', NVL(BAL.Amount,
                                                           0), NULL)), 0) BEGIN, SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                              DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                'COST',
                                                                                                'ADDITION',
                                                                                                'CIP ADDITION'),
                                                                                              NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                0),
                                                                                              NULL)) ADDITION,
                                                                                     SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                  DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                    'CIP COST',
                                                                                                    'ADDITION'), - NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                     0),
                                                                                                                   NULL)) CAPITALIZATION,
                                                                                         SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                      DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                        'COST',
                                                                                                        'ADJUSTMENT',
                                                                                                        'CIP ADJUSTMENT'),
                                                                                                      NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                        0),
                                                                                                      NULL)) ADJUSTMENT,
                                                                                             SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                          'RECLASS',
                                                                                                          NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                            0),
                                                                                                          NULL)) RECLASS,
                                                                                                 SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                              DECODE(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                'COST',
                                                                                                                'RETIREMENT',
                                                                                                                'CIP RETIREMENT'), -NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                      0),
                                                                                                                                    NULL)) RETIREMENT,
                                                                                                     SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                  'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                  NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                    0),
                                                                                                                  NULL)) REVALUATION,
                                                                                                         SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,
                                                                                                                      'TRANSFER',
                                                                                                                      NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                        0),
                                                                                                                      NULL)) TRANSFER,
                                                                                                             NVL(SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                            'END',
                                                                                                                            NVL(BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                              0),
                                                                                                                            NULL)), 0) END, decode(:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                              'COST',
                                                                                                                                              SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                      'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                                                      NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                      0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                           DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                              'CIP COST',
                                                                                                                                                                              'ADDITION') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                                              0) , NULL))) CAPREVAL,
                                                                                                                                            FA_FASCOSTD_XMLP_PKG.out_of_balanceformula(NVL (SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                     'BEGIN',
                                                                                                                                                                                     NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                      0) , NULL)) , 0), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                                 DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                                     'COST',
                                                                                                                                                                     'ADDITION',
                                                                                                                                                                     'CIP ADDITION') , NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                                        0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                              'REVALUATION',
                                                                                                                                                                              NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                               0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                                     'RECLASS',
                                                                                                                                                                     NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                      0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                            DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                'COST',
                                                                                                                                                'RETIREMENT',
                                                                                                                                                'CIP RETIREMENT') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                       0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                             DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                                 'COST',
                                                                                                                                                 'ADJUSTMENT',
                                                                                                                                                 'CIP ADJUSTMENT') , NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                                      0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                            'TRANSFER',
                                                                                                                                                            NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                             0) , NULL)), SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                   DECODE (:P_REPORT_TYPE,

                                                                                                                                       'CIP COST',
                                                                                                                                       'ADDITION') , - NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                        0) , NULL)), NVL (SUM (DECODE (BAL.Source_Type_Code,

                                                                                                                                                   'END',
                                                                                                                                                   NVL (BAL.Amount,

                                                                                                                                    0) , NULL)) , 0)) OUT_OF_BALANCE
   FROM FA_BALANCES_REP_GT BAL, FA_ADDITIONS_B AD, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS DHCC, GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS AJCC
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND AD.Asset_ID = BAL.Asset_ID
     AND DHCC.Code_Combination_ID = BAL.DEPRN_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_CCID
     AND AJCC.Code_Combination_ID (+) = BAL.Adjustment_CCID
     AND :DO_INSERT = 1
   GROUP BY AD.ASSET_NUMBER, AD.ASSET_ID) AC
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND FB.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
  AND FB.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
  AND FDH.DATE_INEFFECTIVE IS NULL
  AND FDH.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = GCC.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
  AND FDS.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
  AND FDS.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
  AND FAV.ASSET_ID = FDH.ASSET_ID
  AND AC.ASSET_ID = FAV.ASSET_ID
  AND FDH.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE
  AND FB.METHOD_ID = FM.METHOD_ID
  AND GCC.SEGMENT1 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT2 || '.' || GCC.SEGMENT3 = :P_GROUPING
  AND FDS.PERIOD_COUNTER = :PERIOD1_PC
  AND FB.BOOK_TYPE_CODE = :P_BOOK
```

### Query #13

### Query #13

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `FUSION`

```sql
SELECT OH.SOURCE_ORDER_NUMBER , HDI.DOO_HEADER_ID , HDI.DOO_LINE_ID , HDI.FULFILL_LINE_ID ,
       HDI.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 , DHCB.HOLD_CODE , DHCT.HOLD_NAME , DHCT.HOLD_DESCRIPTION , DHCT.HOLD_CODE_ID ,
       DHCB.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE , DHCB.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE , DHCB.GENERAL_HOLD_FLAG , DHCB.SYSTEM_FLAG ,
       DHCB.APPLY_HOLD_ROLE_ELIGIBILITY , DHCB.RELEASE_HOLD_ROLE_ELIGIBILITY , HDI.PENDING_FLAG , HDI.DELETED_FLAG ,
       HDI.HOLD_INSTANCE_ID , HDI.APPLY_SYSTEM , HDI.APPLY_DATE , HDI.APPLY_USER_ID , HDI.RELEASE_USER_ID ,
       HDI.RELEASE_DATE , HDI.HOLD_RUNNING_TASK_FLAG , HDI.HOLD_COMMENTS ,
       HDI.HOLD_RELEASE_REASON_CODE , HDI.HOLD_RELEASE_COMMENTS , HDI.ACTIVE_FLAG , OH.LAST_UPDATE_DATE , OH.ON_HOLD
FROM FUSION.DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES HDI , FUSION.DOO_HEADERS_ALL OH , FUSION.DOO_LINES_ALL OL ,
     FUSION.DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL FL , FUSION.DOO_HOLD_CODES_B DHCB , FUSION.DOO_HOLD_CODES_TL DHCT ,
     FUSION.DOO_HEADERS_EFF_B DFLEB
WHERE 1=1
  AND HDI.HOLD_CODE_ID = DHCB.HOLD_CODE_ID
  AND OH.HEADER_ID = OL.HEADER_ID
  AND OH.HEADER_ID = FL.HEADER_ID
  AND FL.LINE_ID = OL.LINE_ID
  AND ((TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_LINES_V'
        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = OL.LINE_ID)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = OH.HEADER_ID)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = FL.FULFILL_LINE_ID))
  AND DHCT.HOLD_CODE_ID = DHCB.HOLD_CODE_ID
  AND DHCT.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
  AND OH.SUBMITTED_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(OH.creation_date) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND DFLEB.HEADER_ID = OH.HEADER_ID
  AND dhcb.HOLD_CODE IN ('PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO', 'PLU_RECLASSIFICACAO_LIMITE')
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM FUSION.DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES HDI2, FUSION.DOO_HOLD_CODES_B DHCB2
     WHERE DHCB2.HOLD_CODE_ID = HDI2.HOLD_CODE_ID
       AND DHCB2.HOLD_CODE IN ('PLU_RETENCAO_CREDITO', 'PLU_RECLASSIFICACAO_LIMITE')
       AND HDI2.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       AND ((HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_V'
             AND HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = OH.HEADER_ID)
            OR (HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_LINES_V'
                AND EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM FUSION.DOO_LINES_ALL OL2
                   WHERE OL2.LINE_ID = HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1
                     AND OL2.HEADER_ID = OH.HEADER_ID))
            OR (HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
                AND EXISTS
                  (SELECT 1
                   FROM FUSION.DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL FL2
                   WHERE FL2.FULFILL_LINE_ID = HDI2.TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1
                     AND FL2.HEADER_ID = OH.HEADER_ID))))
  AND DFLEB.ATTRIBUTE_CHAR1 = 'SALESFORCE'
ORDER BY OH.CREATION_DATE DESC
```

### Query #14

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `FUSION`

```sql
SELECT rma_dha.header_id, rma_dha.source_order_number AS returned_order,
       MIN(dcr.doc_user_key) AS original_order, TO_CHAR(rma_dha.creation_date,
                                                  'YYYY-MM-DD') AS return_date,
       MIN(dfl.RETURN_REASON_CODE_F) AS reason_code
FROM fusion.doo_document_references dcr
JOIN fusion.doo_headers_all rma_dha ON rma_dha.header_id = dcr.header_id
AND rma_dha.submitted_flag = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN fusion.doo_fulfill_lines_all dfl ON dfl.header_id = rma_dha.header_id
AND dfl.line_type_code = 'ORA_RETURN'
WHERE dcr.doc_ref_type = 'ORIGINAL_SALES_ORDER'
  AND TRUNC(rma_dha.creation_date) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
GROUP BY rma_dha.header_id, rma_dha.source_order_number, rma_dha.creation_date
```

### Query #15

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `FUSION`

```sql
SELECT oh.header_id, oh.order_number, (oh.SOURCE_ORDER_SYSTEM || oh.header_id) order_key,
       ol.line_id, ef.fulfill_line_id, ef.attribute_number4, ol.ordered_qty,
       to_char(oh.SUBMITTED_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') SUBMITTED_DATE, hp.party_name customer_name
FROM Fusion.DOO_Hold_Instances hdi , Fusion.DOO_Headers_all oh , Fusion.DOO_Lines_all ol ,
     Fusion.DOO_Fulfill_Lines_all fl, Fusion.doo_fulfill_lines_eff_b ef, Fusion.DOO_HOLD_CODES_B dhcb ,
     Fusion.DOO_HOLD_CODES_tl dhct , Fusion.hz_parties hp
WHERE 1=1
  AND hdi.hold_code_id = dhcb.hold_code_id
  AND oh.Header_ID = ol.Header_id
  AND oh.Header_ID = fl.Header_id
  AND fl.line_id = ol.line_id
  AND ef.fulfill_line_id = fl.Fulfill_Line_id
  AND ef.attribute_number4 IS NOT NULL
  AND CONTEXT_CODE = 'InformacoesDaLinha'
  AND fl.status_code <> 'CANCELED'
  AND oh.status_code = 'OPEN'
  AND hp.party_id = oh.sold_to_party_id
  AND ((TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_LINES_V'
        AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = ol.Line_id)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = oh.Header_id)
       OR (TRANSACTION_ENTITY_NAME1 = 'DOO_ORDER_FLINES_V'
           AND TRANSACTION_ENTITY_ID1 = fl.Fulfill_Line_id))
  AND dhct.hold_code_id = dhcb.hold_code_id
  AND dhct.language = USERENV('LANG')
  AND oh.submitted_flag = 'Y'
  AND active_flag = 'Y'
  AND dhcb.HOLD_CODE = 'PLU_RETENCAO_ATIVO'
ORDER BY oh.creation_Date DESC
```

### Query #27

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `IRC_REQUISITIONS_B`

```sql
SELECT irb.requisition_id ,
       CASE
           WHEN SYSDATE >= irb.ext_publish_job_start_date
                OR irb.ext_publish_job_start_date IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(sysdate,
                                                                 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(irb.ext_publish_job_start_date,

                                                                                      'YYYY-MM-DD')
       END data_inicio ,
       CASE
           WHEN SYSDATE + 1 >= irb.ext_publish_job_end_date
                OR irb.ext_publish_job_end_date IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(sysdate + 30,
                                                               'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_CHAR(irb.ext_publish_job_end_date,

                                                                                    'YYYY-MM-DD')
       END data_fim ,
       CASE
           WHEN irb.attribute_char28 <> 'Sim'
                OR ist.name = 'Cancelado'
                OR ist.name = 'Suspenso'
                OR ist.name = 'Preenchida'
                OR ist.name = 'Preenchido' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false'
       END veiculacao_suspensa
FROM irc_requisitions_b irb , irc_states_tl ist
WHERE ist.state_id = irb.current_state_id
  AND ist.language = 'PTB'
```

### Query #31

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `IRC_REQUISITIONS_B`

```sql
SELECT irb.requisition_id , irb.requisition_number ,
       GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,
         irt.last_update_date , ipt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date)last_update_date , irb.attribute_char28 enviar_para_vagas ,
       irb.attribute_char30 id_vaga_ponto_com
FROM irc_requisitions_b irb, irc_requisitions_tl irt, irc_phases_tl ipt,
     irc_states_tl ist
WHERE irb.requisition_id = irt.requisition_id
  AND irb.attribute_char28 = 'Sim'
  AND ist.state_id = irb.current_state_id
  AND ist.language = 'PTB'
  AND ist.name LIKE'Publicado'
  AND irb.ext_publish_job_status = 'ORA_POSTED'
  AND ipt.phase_id = irb.current_phase_id
  AND ipt.language = 'PTB'
  AND ipt.name LIKE'Aberto'
  AND irt.language = 'PTB'
  AND irb.last_updated_by <> 'integracao.hcm'
  AND GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,
        irt.last_update_date , ipt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                 GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,

                                                                                   irt.last_update_date ,
                                                                                   ipt.last_update_date ,
                                                                                   ist.last_update_date))
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
UNION
SELECT irb.requisition_id , irb.requisition_number ,
       GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,
         irt.last_update_date , ipt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date)last_update_date , irb.attribute_char28 enviar_para_vagas ,
       irb.attribute_char30 id_vaga_ponto_com
FROM irc_requisitions_b irb, irc_requisitions_tl irt, irc_phases_tl ipt,
     irc_states_tl ist
WHERE irb.requisition_id = irt.requisition_id
  AND irb.attribute_char28 = 'Sim'
  AND irb.attribute_char5 = 'Sim'
  AND ist.state_id = irb.current_state_id
  AND ist.language = 'PTB'
  AND ist.name LIKE'Não Publicado'
  AND ipt.phase_id = irb.current_phase_id
  AND ipt.language = 'PTB'
  AND ipt.name LIKE'Aberto'
  AND irt.language = 'PTB'
  AND GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,
        irt.last_update_date , ipt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                 GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,

                                                                                   irt.last_update_date ,
                                                                                   ipt.last_update_date ,
                                                                                   ist.last_update_date))
  AND irb.last_updated_by <> 'integracao.hcm'
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
UNION
SELECT irb.requisition_id , irb.requisition_number ,
       GREATEST(irb.last_update_date , irt.last_update_date)last_update_date , irb.attribute_char28 enviar_para_vagas ,
       irb.attribute_char30 id_vaga_ponto_com
FROM irc_requisitions_b irb, irc_requisitions_tl irt
WHERE irb.requisition_id = irt.requisition_id
  AND irb.attribute_char28 <> 'Sim'
  AND irb.attribute_char30 IS NOT NULL
  AND irb.last_updated_by <> 'integracao.hcm'
  AND GREATEST(irb.last_update_date , irt.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                 GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,

                                                                   irt.last_update_date))
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
UNION
SELECT irb.requisition_id , irb.requisition_number ,
       GREATEST(irb.last_update_date , irt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date)last_update_date , irb.attribute_char28 enviar_para_vagas ,
       irb.attribute_char30 id_vaga_ponto_com
FROM irc_requisitions_b irb, irc_requisitions_tl irt, irc_states_tl ist
WHERE irb.requisition_id = irt.requisition_id
  AND irb.attribute_char30 IS NOT NULL
  AND ist.state_id = irb.current_state_id
  AND ist.language = 'PTB'
  AND ist.name IN ('Cancelado', 'Suspenso', 'Preenchida', 'Preenchido')
  AND GREATEST(irb.last_update_date , irt.last_update_date , ist.last_update_date) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                                                        GREATEST(irb.last_update_date ,

                                                                                          irt.last_update_date ,
                                                                                          ist.last_update_date))
  AND irb.last_updated_by <> 'integracao.hcm'
  AND irb.requisition_number = NVL(:p_requisition_number,
                                 irb.requisition_number)
```

### Query #34

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT htce.transaction_id AS transaction_id, ppnf.display_name AS nome_Func,
                papf.person_number AS person_number, papf.person_id AS person_id, pea.email_address AS func_Email,
                ppnf2.display_name AS nome_Gestor, pea2.email_address AS gestor_Email,
                REPLACE(REPLACE(paam.assignment_number, 'E', ''), '-', '') AS func_Matricula, htce.object_name AS object_name,
                htce.process_category AS process_category, htce.status_category AS status_category,
                htce.change_effective_date AS change_effective_date, htce.created_by AS created_by,
                htce.creation_date AS creation_date,
                GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) AS last_update_date,
                NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                      '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/OldValue/text()').getStringVal(),

              EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/oldValue/text()').getStringVal()) AS modelo_trabalho_antigo,
                NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                      '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal(),

              EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal()) AS modelo_trabalho,
                CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 0
                END AS altera_modelo_trabalho, pptt.USER_PERSON_TYPE AS person_type,
                'Departamento Pessoal Digital' AS grupo_documental,
                CASE
                    WHEN NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                               '/TRANSACTION/COMPAREDATA/CompareVO/BaseWorkerAsgDFFVORow/Compare[AttributeName = ''modelagemDeTrabalho'']/NewValue/text()').getStringVal(),

                       EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                         '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.workStructures.positions.model.entity.PositionDEO'']/PositionDEORow/DEEventData/EventDEOData/LogicalChanges/EventEOAttrData/Attribute7/newValue/text()').getStringVal()) = 'Presencial' THEN '703-Termo Retorno ao Presencial' ELSE '694-Termo Teletrabalho/Híbrido/Ergonomia'
                END AS tipo_documento, paam.person_type_id AS person_type_id
FROM HRC_TXN_CONSOLE_ENTRY htce, HRC_TXN_HEADER hth, FA_FUSION_SOAINFRA.WFTASK ffsw, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F papf,
     PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf, PER_PERSON_TYPES_TL pptt, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea, PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M paam_gestor, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F ppnf2,
     PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES pea2
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND papf.person_id = hth.subject_id
  AND TO_CHAR(papf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND hth.transaction_id = htce.transaction_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ffsw.identificationkey) = TO_CHAR(htce.transaction_id)
  AND ppnf.person_id = papf.person_id
  AND TO_CHAR(ppnf.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND paam.PERSON_TYPE_ID = pptt.PERSON_TYPE_ID
  AND pptt.LANGUAGE = 'PTB'
  AND paam.assignment_id = NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                 '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][1]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/AssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal(),

                         EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,
                           '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/AssignmentId/text()').getStringVal())
  AND paam.assignment_type IN ('E','C')
  AND TO_CHAR(paam.effective_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND pea.person_id(+) = ppnf.person_id
  AND pea.email_type = 'W1'
  AND (TO_CHAR(pea.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
       OR pea.date_to IS NULL)
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_id (+)= NVL(EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                           '/TRANSACTION/BUSINESSDATA/AM/TXN/EO[@Name=''oracle.apps.hcm.employment.core.publicModel.entity.PeriodOfServiceEO''][2]/PeriodOfServiceEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeTermsDEORow/CEO/EO/EmployeeAssignmentDEORow/CEO/EO/AssignmentSupervisorDEORow/ManagerAssignmentId/DATA/text()').getStringVal(),

                                   EXTRACT(hth.xml_data_cache,

                                     '/TRANSACTION/TransCtx/IdentifiedIncumbentAssignmentId/text()').getStringVal())
  AND paam_gestor.assignment_type (+)= 'E'
  AND TO_CHAR(paam_gestor.effective_end_date (+), 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND ppnf2.person_id (+)= paam_gestor.person_id
  AND ppnf2.name_type (+)= 'GLOBAL'
  AND pea2.person_id (+)= ppnf2.person_id
  AND pea2.email_type = 'W1'
  AND (pea2.date_to IS NULL
       OR TO_CHAR(pea2.date_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31')
  AND GREATEST(htce.last_update_date, ffsw.UpdatedDate) >= NVL(:p_integration_date,

                                                             GREATEST(htce.last_update_date,
                                                               ffsw.UpdatedDate))
  AND paam.assignment_number = NVL(:p_assignment_number,
                                 paam.assignment_number)
  AND papf.person_number = NVL(:p_person_number, papf.person_number)
```

### Query #35

**Tags:** `Cross-Module`

**Tabelas:** `BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID AS AtualID, DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID, NAM.DISPLAY_NAME,
                TO_CHAR(pp.DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DPNT_DATA_NASCIMENTO, PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER AS DPNT_CPF,
                PCR.CONT_ATTRIBUTE3 AS DPNT_NOME_MAE,
                TO_CHAR(PCR.CONT_ATTRIBUTE_DATE1, 'DD/MM/YYYY')AS DPNT_DATA_CASAMENTO,
                DECODE(PCR.CONTACT_TYPE,
                  'ANM_3', 'Filho(a) Inválido', 'IN_FR', 'Pai', 'OT' , 'Outro', 'DP',
                  'Companheiro(a)', 'ANM_B', 'Incapaz', 'IN_S', 'Filho', 'ANM_8', 'Sogro(a)', 'BOS' ,
                  'Irmão ou Irmã', 'ORA_HRX_GP', 'Avós', 'ANM_P', 'Ex-companheiro(a)', 'ANM_M',
                  'Menor pobre', 'T' , 'Enteado', 'ORA_HRX_F_SP', 'Ex-Cônjuge', 'S' , 'Cônjuge', 'IN_MR',
                  'Mãe', CONTACT_TYPE) AS DPNT_RELACAO
FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT DPNT, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM, PER_PERSONS PP,
     PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F PCR
WHERE BEN.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = DPNT.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND (PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
       OR PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE IS NULL)
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PCR.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
```

```sql
                  'Irmão ou Irmã', 'ORA_HRX_GP', 'Avós', 'ANM_P', 'Ex-companheiro(a)', 'ANM_M',
                  'Menor pobre', 'T' , 'Enteado', 'ORA_HRX_F_SP', 'Ex-Cônjuge', 'S' , 'Cônjuge', 'IN_MR',
                  'Mãe', CONTACT_TYPE) AS DPNT_RELACAO
FROM BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT DPNT, BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN, PER_PERSON_NAMES_F NAM, PER_PERSONS PP,
     PER_NATIONAL_IDENTIFIERS PNI, PER_CONTACT_RELSHIPS_F PCR

  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = NAM.PERSON_ID
  AND TO_CHAR(NAM.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '4712-12-31'
  AND NAM.NAME_TYPE = 'GLOBAL'
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PP.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PNI.PERSON_ID(+)
  AND (PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE = 'CPF'
       OR PNI.NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER_TYPE IS NULL)
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID = PCR.CONTACT_PERSON_ID
  AND DPNT.DPNT_PERSON_ID NOT IN
    (SELECT DPN1.DPNT_PERSON_ID
     FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN1, BEN_ELIG_CVRD_DPNT DPN1
     WHERE BEN1.PL_TYP_ID = BEN.PL_TYP_ID
       AND BEN1.PERSON_ID = BEN.PERSON_ID
       AND DPN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID = BEN1.PRTT_ENRT_RSLT_ID
       AND BEN1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE =
         (SELECT MAX(BEN2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
          FROM BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT BEN2
          WHERE TO_CHAR(BEN2.ENRT_CVG_THRU_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') != '4712-12-31'
            AND BEN2.PERSON_ID = BEN1.PERSON_ID
            AND BEN2.PL_TYP_ID = BEN1.PL_TYP_ID))
```
